name: P23.high_relation_number_forces_almost_symmetric

    (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup)
    (ht : D.semigroupType = 2 ∨ D.semigroupType = 3)
    (hng : SemigroupNearlyGorenstein D)
    (hr : D.semigroupType + 4 ≤ D.semigroupRho) : D.IsAlmostSymmetric
proof:
:=
  P23.Semigroup.highRho_implies_almostSymmetric D ht hng hr

name: P23.type_two_nearly_gorenstein_not_almost_symmetric
statement:
theorem type_two_nearly_gorenstein_not_almost_symmetric
    (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup)
    (ht : D.semigroupType = 2) (hng : SemigroupNearlyGorenstein D)
    (hna : ¬ D.IsAlmostSymmetric) : D.semigroupRho = 4 ∨ D.semigroupRho = 5
proof:
:=
  P23.Semigroup.type_two_ng_notAS_rho_eq_four_or_five D ht hng hna

name: P23.type_three_nearly_gorenstein_not_almost_symmetric
statement:
theorem type_three_nearly_gorenstein_not_almost_symmetric
    (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup)
    (ht : D.semigroupType = 3) (hng : SemigroupNearlyGorenstein D)
    (hna : ¬ D.IsAlmostSymmetric) : D.semigroupRho = 6
proof:
:=
  P23.Semigroup.type_three_ng_notAS_rho_eq_six D ht hng hna

name: P23.original_p23
statement: theorem original_p23 (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup) : OriginalP23Theorem D
proof:
:=
  ⟨type_two_nearly_gorenstein_not_almost_symmetric D,
    type_three_nearly_gorenstein_not_almost_symmetric D⟩

name: P23.original_p23_of_type_two_or_three
statement:
theorem original_p23_of_type_two_or_three
    (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup)
    (ht : D.semigroupType = 2 ∨ D.semigroupType = 3)
    (hng : SemigroupNearlyGorenstein D) (hna : ¬ D.IsAlmostSymmetric) :
    (D.semigroupType = 2 ∧ (D.semigroupRho = 4 ∨ D.semigroupRho = 5)) ∨
      (D.semigroupType = 3 ∧ D.semigroupRho = 6)
proof:
:= by
  rcases ht with ht | ht
  · exact Or.inl ⟨ht, type_two_nearly_gorenstein_not_almost_symmetric D ht hng hna⟩
  · exact Or.inr ⟨ht, type_three_nearly_gorenstein_not_almost_symmetric D ht hng hna⟩

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.supportCard_le_four
statement: theorem supportCard_le_four (d : ℕ) : D.supportCard d ≤ 4
proof:
:= by
  unfold supportCard
  have hsub : D.combinedSupport d ⊆ Finset.univ := fun _ _ => Finset.mem_univ _
  simpa using Finset.card_le_card hsub

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.supportCard_eq_componentSupport_sum
statement:
theorem supportCard_eq_componentSupport_sum (d : ℕ) :
    D.supportCard d = ∑ C : D.BettiComponent d, (D.componentSupport C).card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hp : (↑(Finset.univ : Finset (D.BettiComponent d)) : Set (D.BettiComponent d)).PairwiseDisjoint
      D.componentSupport := by
    simpa using D.componentSupport_pairwiseDisjoint d
  have h := Finset.card_biUnion (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (D.BettiComponent d)))
    (t := D.componentSupport) hp
  rw [D.biUnion_componentSupport] at h
  simpa [supportCard] using h

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.componentCount_le_supportCard_of_isBetti
statement:
theorem componentCount_le_supportCard_of_isBetti {d : ℕ}
    (hd : D.IsBettiDegree d) : D.componentCount d ≤ D.supportCard d
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [D.supportCard_eq_componentSupport_sum]
  unfold componentCount
  have hsum := Finset.sum_le_sum
    (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (D.BettiComponent d)))
    (f := fun _ => 1) (g := fun C => (D.componentSupport C).card)
    (fun C _ => Finset.card_pos.mpr (D.componentSupport_nonempty_of_isBetti hd C))
  simpa using hsum

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.twice_componentCount_le_supportCard_add_singletons
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hpoint : ∀ C : D.BettiComponent d,
      2 ≤ (D.componentSupport C).card +
        (if D.IsSingletonSupportComponent C then 1 else 0) := by
    intro C
    have hpos : 0 < (D.componentSupport C).card :=
      Finset.card_pos.mpr (D.componentSupport_nonempty_of_isBetti hd C)
    by_cases hcard : (D.componentSupport C).card = 1
    · simp [IsSingletonSupportComponent, hcard]
    · have hge : 2 ≤ (D.componentSupport C).card := by omega
      simp [IsSingletonSupportComponent, hcard, hge]
  have hsum := Finset.sum_le_sum
    (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (D.BettiComponent d))) (fun C _ => hpoint C)
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib] at hsum
  have hsupport := D.supportCard_eq_componentSupport_sum d
  have hsingle :
      (∑ C : D.BettiComponent d, if D.IsSingletonSupportComponent C then 1 else 0) =
        D.singletonComponentCount d := by
    unfold singletonComponentCount
    simpa using (Finset.sum_boole
      (fun C : D.BettiComponent d => D.IsSingletonSupportComponent C) Finset.univ)
  rw [← hsupport, hsingle] at hsum
  simpa [componentCount, Nat.mul_comm] using hsum

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.localSupportInequality
statement:
theorem localSupportInequality {d : ℕ} (hd : D.IsBettiDegree d) :
    (4 - D.supportCard d) * (D.componentCount d - 1) ≤
      D.singletonComponentCount d
proof:
:= by
  have hc2 : 2 ≤ D.componentCount d := hd
  have hcv := D.componentCount_le_supportCard_of_isBetti hd
  have hv4 := D.supportCard_le_four d
  have htwice := D.twice_componentCount_le_supportCard_add_singletons hd
  interval_cases hv : D.supportCard d <;> omega

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.bettiContribution_pos
statement:
theorem bettiContribution_pos {d : ℕ} (hd : D.IsBettiDegree d) :
    0 < D.bettiContribution d
proof:
:= by
  unfold bettiContribution IsBettiDegree at *
  omega

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.singletonComponentCount_pos_of_budget
proof:
:= by
  have hlocal := D.localSupportInequality hd
  have hc : 0 < D.componentCount d - 1 := by
    unfold IsBettiDegree at hd
    omega
  have hmissing : 0 < 4 - D.supportCard d := by omega
  have hprod : 0 < (4 - D.supportCard d) * (D.componentCount d - 1) :=
    Nat.mul_pos hmissing hc
  omega

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.exists_singleton_component_of_budget
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hpos := D.singletonComponentCount_pos_of_budget hd hv
  unfold singletonComponentCount at hpos
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := Finset.card_pos.mp hpos
  exact ⟨C, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hC).2⟩

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.budgetDegreeSingletonComponent_isSingleton
statement:
theorem budgetDegreeSingletonComponent_isSingleton (d : D.BudgetDegree) :
    D.IsSingletonSupportComponent (D.budgetDegreeSingletonComponent d)
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec (D.exists_singleton_component_of_budget d.2.1 d.2.2)

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.budgetDegreeOccurrence_injective
statement:
theorem budgetDegreeOccurrence_injective :
    Function.Injective D.budgetDegreeOccurrence
proof:
:= by
  intro d e h
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact congrArg SingletonBettiOccurrence.degree h

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.budgetSingletonToOccurrence_injective
statement:
theorem budgetSingletonToOccurrence_injective :
    Function.Injective D.budgetSingletonToOccurrence
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨d, C⟩ ⟨e, E⟩ h
  have hde : d = e := Subtype.ext (congrArg SingletonBettiOccurrence.degree h)
  subst e
  have hkey := congrArg
    (fun o : D.SingletonBettiOccurrence =>
      (⟨o.degree, o.component⟩ : Sigma fun n : ℕ => D.BettiComponent n)) h
  have hCE : C.1 = E.1 := by
    simpa [budgetSingletonToOccurrence] using hkey
  have hCE' : C = E := Subtype.ext hCE
  rw [hCE']

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.budgetSingletonOccurrence_card_eq_sum
statement:
theorem budgetSingletonOccurrence_card_eq_sum :
    Fintype.card (D.BudgetSingletonOccurrence) =
      ∑ d : D.BudgetDegree, D.singletonComponentCount d.1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Fintype.card_sigma]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro d _
  unfold singletonComponentCount
  exact Fintype.card_subtype (fun C : D.BettiComponent d.1 =>
    D.IsSingletonSupportComponent C)

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.budget_singleton_sum_le_four
statement:
theorem budget_singleton_sum_le_four :
    (∑ d : D.BudgetDegree, D.singletonComponentCount d.1) ≤ 4
proof:
:= by
  rw [← D.budgetSingletonOccurrence_card_eq_sum]
  exact (Fintype.card_le_of_injective D.budgetSingletonToOccurrence
    D.budgetSingletonToOccurrence_injective).trans
      D.singletonBettiOccurrence_card_le_four

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.fourBaseBudget_includes
statement:
theorem fourBaseBudget_includes {i : Fin 4} {d : ℕ}
    (hd : D.IsBettiDegree d) (hi : i ∉ D.combinedSupport d) :
    ∃ q : D.BudgetDegree, q.1 = d ∧
      (if i ∉ D.combinedSupport q.1 then D.bettiContribution q.1 else 0) =
        D.bettiContribution d
proof:
:= by
  have hcard : D.supportCard d < 4 := by
    unfold supportCard
    have hproper : D.combinedSupport d ⊂ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 4)) := by
      refine Finset.ssubset_iff_subset_ne.mpr ⟨fun _ _ => Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
      intro heq
      apply hi
      rw [heq]
      exact Finset.mem_univ _
    simpa using Finset.card_lt_card hproper
  let q : D.BudgetDegree := ⟨d, hd, hcard⟩
  exact ⟨q, rfl, by simp [q, hi]⟩

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.omittedVariableCount
statement:
theorem omittedVariableCount (d : ℕ) :
    (Finset.univ.filter fun i : Fin 4 => i ∉ D.combinedSupport d).card =
      4 - D.supportCard d
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Finset.filter_not]
  have hfilter : (Finset.univ.filter fun i : Fin 4 => i ∈ D.combinedSupport d) =
      D.combinedSupport d := by ext i; simp
  rw [hfilter, Finset.card_sdiff]
  simp [supportCard]

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.sum_omitted_contribution
statement:
theorem sum_omitted_contribution (d : ℕ) :
    (∑ i : Fin 4, if i ∉ D.combinedSupport d then D.bettiContribution d else 0) =
      (4 - D.supportCard d) * D.bettiContribution d
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc
    (∑ i : Fin 4, if i ∉ D.combinedSupport d then D.bettiContribution d else 0) =
        ∑ i ∈ (Finset.univ.filter fun i : Fin 4 => i ∉ D.combinedSupport d),
          D.bettiContribution d := by
      exact (Finset.sum_filter
        (fun i : Fin 4 => i ∉ D.combinedSupport d)
        (fun _ => D.bettiContribution d)).symm
    _ = (Finset.univ.filter fun i : Fin 4 => i ∉ D.combinedSupport d).card *
          D.bettiContribution d := by
      exact Finset.sum_const_nat (fun _ _ => rfl)
    _ = (4 - D.supportCard d) * D.bettiContribution d := by
      rw [D.omittedVariableCount]

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.fourBaseBudget_doubleCount
statement:
theorem fourBaseBudget_doubleCount :
    (∑ i : Fin 4, D.fourBaseBudget i) =
      ∑ d : D.BudgetDegree,
        (4 - D.supportCard d.1) * D.bettiContribution d.1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold fourBaseBudget
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro d _
  exact D.sum_omitted_contribution d.1

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.fourBaseBudget_sum_le_four
statement:
theorem fourBaseBudget_sum_le_four :
    (∑ i : Fin 4, D.fourBaseBudget i) ≤ 4
proof:
:= by
  rw [D.fourBaseBudget_doubleCount]
  calc
    (∑ d : D.BudgetDegree,
        (4 - D.supportCard d.1) * D.bettiContribution d.1) ≤
        ∑ d : D.BudgetDegree, D.singletonComponentCount d.1 := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro d _
      exact D.localSupportInequality d.2.1
    _ ≤ 4 := D.budget_singleton_sum_le_four

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.fourBaseBudget_le_four
statement: theorem fourBaseBudget_le_four (i : Fin 4) : D.fourBaseBudget i ≤ 4
proof:
:= by
  exact (Finset.single_le_sum (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ i)).trans
    D.fourBaseBudget_sum_le_four

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.componentRepresentative_component
statement:
theorem componentRepresentative_component {d : ℕ} (C : D.BettiComponent d) :
    D.componentOf (D.componentRepresentative C) = C
proof:
:=
  (SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff C _).mp
    (Classical.choose_spec (SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.nonempty_supp C))

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.connectorEndpoints_components
statement:
theorem connectorEndpoints_components {d : ℕ} (hd : D.IsBettiDegree d)
    (e : D.ComponentConnector hd) :
    D.componentOf (D.connectorEndpoints hd e).1 = D.rootComponent hd ∧
      D.componentOf (D.connectorEndpoints hd e).2 = e.1
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨D.componentRepresentative_component _, D.componentRepresentative_component _⟩

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.connectorCount
statement:
theorem connectorCount {d : ℕ} (hd : D.IsBettiDegree d) :
    Fintype.card (D.ComponentConnector hd) = D.componentCount d - 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold ComponentConnector componentCount
  simpa using Fintype.card_subtype_compl
    (fun C : D.BettiComponent d => C = D.rootComponent hd)

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.componentConnectorGraph_adj
statement:
theorem componentConnectorGraph_adj {d : ℕ} (hd : D.IsBettiDegree d)
    (C E : D.BettiComponent d) :
    (D.componentConnectorGraph hd).Adj C E ↔
      C ≠ E ∧ ((C = D.rootComponent hd ∧ E ≠ D.rootComponent hd) ∨
        (E = D.rootComponent hd ∧ C ≠ D.rootComponent hd))
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.componentConnectorGraph_connected
statement:
theorem componentConnectorGraph_connected {d : ℕ} (hd : D.IsBettiDegree d) :
    (D.componentConnectorGraph hd).Connected
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hnonempty : Nonempty (D.BettiComponent d) :=
    ⟨D.rootComponent hd⟩
  rw [SimpleGraph.connected_iff]
  refine ⟨?_, hnonempty⟩
  intro C E
  have toRoot (A : D.BettiComponent d) :
      (D.componentConnectorGraph hd).Reachable A (D.rootComponent hd) := by
    by_cases hA : A = D.rootComponent hd
    · subst A
      exact SimpleGraph.Reachable.refl (G := D.componentConnectorGraph hd) _
    · exact ((D.componentConnectorGraph_adj hd A (D.rootComponent hd)).2
        ⟨hA, Or.inr ⟨rfl, hA⟩⟩).reachable
  exact (toRoot C).trans (toRoot E).symm

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.fourBaseBettiCombinatorics
statement:
theorem fourBaseBettiCombinatorics : D.FourBaseBettiCombinatorics where
  componentSupportDisjoint
proof:
:= fun _ _ _ h => D.componentSupport_disjoint h
  localInequality := fun _ h => D.localSupportInequality h
  singletonDegreeUnique := fun _ _ _ h₁ h₂ hs₁ hs₂ =>
    D.singletonComponent_degree_unique h₁ h₂ hs₁ hs₂
  singletonOccurrenceBound := D.singletonBettiOccurrence_card_le_four
  fourBaseBudgetBound := D.fourBaseBudget_sum_le_four

name: P23.Semigroup.canonicalQuotient_HL5_border_ne_four_of_liveDomain
statement:
theorem canonicalQuotient_HL5_border_ne_four_of_liveDomain
    {a b c : ℕ} [NeZero a] (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) (hlive : IsLiveTie S)
    (hanti : IsRootAntichain S)
    (htype : quotientType ℚ S (nonempty_of_isLiveTie S hlive) hdom hlive = 3)
    (hng : QuotientNearlyGorenstein ℚ S
      (nonempty_of_isLiveTie S hlive) hdom hlive) :
    (borderFinset S).card ≠ 4
proof:
:= by
  rcases hdom with ⟨ha, hbc⟩
  rcases hbc with ⟨hb,hc⟩ | ⟨hb,hc⟩
  · exact mixed_quotient_HL5_border_ne_four
      (k := ℚ) S ha hb hc hlive hanti htype hng
  · subst c
    exact pure_quotient_HL5_border_ne_four
      (k := ℚ) S ha hb hlive hanti htype hng

name: P23.Semigroup.chosenBaseCanonicalOneTie_HL5_border_ne_four
statement:
theorem chosenBaseCanonicalOneTie_HL5_border_ne_four
    {D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup} {i : Fin 4}
    (B : ChosenBaseCanonicalOneTieBridge D i) :
    (borderFinset B.normalization.roots).card ≠ 4
proof:
:=
  canonicalQuotient_HL5_border_ne_four_of_liveDomain B.normalization.roots
    B.liveDomain B.liveTie B.rootAntichain
    B.canonicalTypeThree B.canonicalNearlyGorenstein

name: P23.Semigroup.chosenBaseCanonicalOneTie_border_card_eq_four_of_rho_five
statement:
theorem chosenBaseCanonicalOneTie_border_card_eq_four_of_rho_five
    {D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup} {i : Fin 4}
    (B : ChosenBaseCanonicalOneTieBridge D i) (hr : D.semigroupRho = 5) :
    (borderFinset B.normalization.roots).card = 4
proof:
:= by
  rw [B.borderCardEqRhoSubOne,hr]

name: P23.Semigroup.budget_one_type_three_ng_rho_ne_five
statement:
theorem budget_one_type_three_ng_rho_ne_five
    (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup) (i : Fin 4)
    (hB : D.fourBaseBudget i = 1) (ht : D.semigroupType = 3)
    (hng : SemigroupNearlyGorenstein D) : D.semigroupRho ≠ 5
proof:
:= by
  intro hr
  obtain ⟨B⟩ := chosenBaseCanonicalOneTieBridge D i hB ht hng
  exact chosenBaseCanonicalOneTie_HL5_border_ne_four B
    (chosenBaseCanonicalOneTie_border_card_eq_four_of_rho_five B hr)

name: P23.Semigroup.type_three_ng_semigroupRho_ne_five
statement:
theorem type_three_ng_semigroupRho_ne_five
    (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup) (ht : D.semigroupType = 3)
    (hng : SemigroupNearlyGorenstein D) : D.semigroupRho ≠ 5
proof:
:= by
  intro hr
  have hB : D.fourBaseBudget 0 = 1 := rho_five_all_budgets_eq_one D ht hng hr 0
  exact budget_one_type_three_ng_rho_ne_five D 0 hB ht hng hr

name: P23.Semigroup.rhoFiveExclusion
statement:
theorem rhoFiveExclusion (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup)
    (ht : D.semigroupType = 3) (hng : SemigroupNearlyGorenstein D) :
    RhoFiveExclusion D where
  allBudgetsOne
proof:
:= fun hr i => rho_five_all_budgets_eq_one D ht hng hr i
  normalizesBudgetOne := fun i hB => chosenBaseCanonicalOneTieBridge D i hB ht hng
  canonicalBorderNotFour := fun _ B => chosenBaseCanonicalOneTie_HL5_border_ne_four B
  rhoFiveBorderFour := fun _ B hr => chosenBaseCanonicalOneTie_border_card_eq_four_of_rho_five B hr
  rhoNeFive := type_three_ng_semigroupRho_ne_five D ht hng

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.generator_product
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction u using Finsupp.induction with
  | zero =>
      rw [show (⟨D.weightedDegree 0, (D.mem_Gamma_iff _).2 ⟨0, rfl⟩⟩ : D.Gamma) = 0 by
        apply Subtype.ext
        simp]
      exact T_zero D
  | @single_add i e u hi he ih =>
      rw [Finsupp.prod_add_index' (fun _ => pow_zero _) (fun _ _ _ => pow_add _ _ _)]
      have hsingle :
          (Finsupp.single i e).prod (fun i e => (T (k := k) D (D.generator i)) ^ e) =
            T (k := k) D (e • D.generator i) := by
        simp [he, T, AddMonoidAlgebra.single_pow]
      rw [hsingle, ih]
      rw [T_add]
      apply congrArg (T (k := k) D)
      apply Subtype.ext
      simp [generator, weightedDegreeOf_add, weightedDegreeOf, Finsupp.single_apply,
        Finset.sum_eq_single i]

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.semigroupPolyMap_monomial
statement:
@[simp] theorem semigroupPolyMap_monomial (u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) (r : k) :
    D.semigroupPolyMap (MvPolynomial.monomial u r) =
      r • T (k := k) D ⟨D.weightedDegree u, (D.mem_Gamma_iff _).2 ⟨u, rfl⟩⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [semigroupPolyMap, MvPolynomial.aeval_monomial, D.generator_product]
  simp [Algebra.smul_def]

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.semigroupPolyMap_surjective
statement: theorem semigroupPolyMap_surjective : Function.Surjective (D.semigroupPolyMap (k := k))
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  induction x using AddMonoidAlgebra.induction_on with
  | of s =>
      rcases (D.mem_Gamma_iff s.1).1 s.2 with ⟨u, hu⟩
      refine ⟨MvPolynomial.monomial u 1, ?_⟩
      rw [D.semigroupPolyMap_monomial]
      simp only [one_smul]
      apply congrArg (T (k := k) D)
      exact Subtype.ext hu
  | add x y hx hy =>
      rcases hx with ⟨p, rfl⟩
      rcases hy with ⟨q, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨p + q, map_add _ _ _⟩
  | smul r x hx =>
      rcases hx with ⟨p, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨r • p, map_smul _ _ _⟩

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.semigroupPolyMap_fiberMonomial
statement:
@[simp] theorem semigroupPolyMap_fiberMonomial {d : ℕ} (u : D.FactorizationAt d) :
    D.semigroupPolyMap (D.fiberMonomial (k := k) u) =
      T (k := k) D ⟨d, (D.mem_Gamma_iff _).2 ⟨u.1, D.factorizationAt_degree u⟩⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [fiberMonomial, D.semigroupPolyMap_monomial]
  simp only [one_smul]
  apply congrArg (T (k := k) D)
  exact Subtype.ext (D.factorizationAt_degree u)

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.fiberBinomial_mem_toricIdeal
statement:
theorem fiberBinomial_mem_toricIdeal {d : ℕ} (u v : D.FactorizationAt d) :
    D.fiberBinomial (k := k) u v ∈ D.toricIdeal (k := k)
proof:
:= by
  change D.semigroupPolyMap (D.fiberBinomial (k := k) u v) = 0
  simp [fiberBinomial]

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.fiberBinomial_self
statement:
@[simp] theorem fiberBinomial_self {d : ℕ} (u : D.FactorizationAt d) :
    D.fiberBinomial (k := k) u u = 0
proof: := by simp [fiberBinomial]

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.fiberBinomial_swap
statement:
theorem fiberBinomial_swap {d : ℕ} (u v : D.FactorizationAt d) :
    D.fiberBinomial (k := k) u v = -D.fiberBinomial (k := k) v u
proof:
:= by
  simp [fiberBinomial, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm]

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.fiberBinomial_add
statement:
theorem fiberBinomial_add {d : ℕ} (u v w : D.FactorizationAt d) :
    D.fiberBinomial (k := k) u v + D.fiberBinomial (k := k) v w =
      D.fiberBinomial (k := k) u w
proof:
:= by

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.span_fiberBinomials_le_toricIdeal
statement:
theorem span_fiberBinomials_le_toricIdeal :
    Ideal.span (D.fiberBinomialSet (k := k)) ≤ D.toricIdeal (k := k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.span_le]
  rintro p ⟨d, u, v, rfl⟩
  exact D.fiberBinomial_mem_toricIdeal u v

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.coeff_semigroupPolyMap
statement:
theorem coeff_semigroupPolyMap (p : FourPoly k) (u₀ : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) :
    (D.semigroupPolyMap p).coeff
        ⟨D.weightedDegree u₀, (D.mem_Gamma_iff _).2 ⟨u₀, rfl⟩⟩ =
      ∑ u ∈ p.support with D.weightedDegree u = D.weightedDegree u₀,
        MvPolynomial.coeff u p
proof:
:= by
  classical
  conv_lhs => rw [MvPolynomial.as_sum p]
  simp only [map_sum, D.semigroupPolyMap_monomial, T, Finset.sum_apply,
    Finset.smul_sum]
  simp [Finsupp.single_apply, Subtype.ext_iff, Finset.sum_filter]

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.exists_other_same_degree_of_mem_toricIdeal
statement:
private theorem exists_other_same_degree_of_mem_toricIdeal
    {p : FourPoly k} (hp : p ∈ D.toricIdeal (k := k))
    {u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ} (hu : u ∈ p.support) :
    ∃ v ∈ p.support, D.weightedDegree v = D.weightedDegree u ∧ v ≠ u
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hsum :
      (∑ v ∈ p.support with D.weightedDegree v = D.weightedDegree u,
        MvPolynomial.coeff v p) = 0 := by
    change D.semigroupPolyMap p = 0 at hp
    have h := congrArg
      (fun f : SemigroupAlgebra (k := k) D =>
        f.coeff ⟨D.weightedDegree u, (D.mem_Gamma_iff _).2 ⟨u, rfl⟩⟩) hp
    rw [D.coeff_semigroupPolyMap] at h
    simpa using h
  by_contra h
  push_neg at h
  have hfilter :
      p.support.filter (fun v => D.weightedDegree v = D.weightedDegree u) = {u} := by
    ext v
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_singleton]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hv, hdeg⟩
      by_contra hvu
      exact hvu (h v hv hdeg)
    · rintro rfl
      exact ⟨hu, rfl⟩
  rw [hfilter] at hsum
  simp only [Finset.sum_singleton] at hsum
  exact (MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff.mp hu) hsum

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.mem_span_fiberBinomials_of_mem_toricIdeal
statement:
theorem mem_span_fiberBinomials_of_mem_toricIdeal
    (p : FourPoly k) (hp : p ∈ D.toricIdeal (k := k)) :
    p ∈ Ideal.span (D.fiberBinomialSet (k := k))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hp0 : p = 0
  · simpa [hp0]
  have hsupp : p.support.Nonempty := by
    exact Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr fun h =>
      hp0 (MvPolynomial.support_eq_empty.mp h)
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hsupp
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hdeg, hvu⟩ :=
    D.exists_other_same_degree_of_mem_toricIdeal hp hu
  let fu : D.FactorizationAt (D.weightedDegree u) := D.exponentFactorization u
  let fv : D.FactorizationAt (D.weightedDegree u) :=
    ⟨v, D.mem_factorizations.mpr hdeg⟩
  let c := MvPolynomial.coeff u p
  let q := p - (MvPolynomial.monomial u c - MvPolynomial.monomial v c)
  have hqker : q ∈ D.toricIdeal (k := k) := by
    apply Ideal.sub_mem _ hp
    have hb := D.fiberBinomial_mem_toricIdeal (k := k) fu fv
    have hscaled : c • D.fiberBinomial (k := k) fu fv ∈ D.toricIdeal (k := k) := by
      rw [Algebra.smul_def]
      exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ hb
    simpa [q, fu, fv, c, fiberBinomial, fiberMonomial, exponentFactorization, smul_sub,
      MvPolynomial.smul_monomial, smul_eq_mul] using hscaled
  have hsubset : q.support ⊆ p.support.erase u := by
    intro x hx
    have hraw := MvPolynomial.support_sub_monomial_sub_monomial_subset
      p u v c hvu.symm (by rfl) hx
    rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hraw with hx' | hxv
    · exact hx'
    · have hxv' : x = v := Finset.mem_singleton.mp hxv
      subst x
      exact Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hvu, hv⟩
  have hcard : q.support.card < p.support.card :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt (Finset.card_le_card hsubset) (Finset.card_erase_lt_of_mem hu)
  have hqspan := mem_span_fiberBinomials_of_mem_toricIdeal q hqker
  have hbspan : D.fiberBinomial (k := k) fu fv ∈
      Ideal.span (D.fiberBinomialSet (k := k)) := by
    apply Ideal.subset_span
    exact ⟨D.weightedDegree u, fu, fv, rfl⟩
  have hscaled : c • D.fiberBinomial (k := k) fu fv ∈
      Ideal.span (D.fiberBinomialSet (k := k)) := by
    rw [Algebra.smul_def]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ hbspan
  have hbin : MvPolynomial.monomial u c - MvPolynomial.monomial v c ∈
      Ideal.span (D.fiberBinomialSet (k := k)) := by
    simpa [fu, fv, c, fiberBinomial, fiberMonomial, exponentFactorization, smul_sub,
      MvPolynomial.smul_monomial, smul_eq_mul] using hscaled
  have hpq : p = q + (MvPolynomial.monomial u c - MvPolynomial.monomial v c) := by
    simp [q]
  rw [hpq]
  exact Ideal.add_mem _ hqspan hbin

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.toricIdeal_eq_span_fiberBinomials
statement:
theorem toricIdeal_eq_span_fiberBinomials :
    D.toricIdeal (k := k) = Ideal.span (D.fiberBinomialSet (k := k))
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro p hp
    exact D.mem_span_fiberBinomials_of_mem_toricIdeal p hp
  · exact D.span_fiberBinomials_le_toricIdeal

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.lowerToricIdeal_mono
statement:
theorem lowerToricIdeal_mono {e d : ℕ} (hed : e ≤ d) :
    D.lowerToricIdeal (k := k) e ≤ D.lowerToricIdeal (k := k) d
proof:
:= by
  unfold lowerToricIdeal
  rw [Ideal.span_le]
  rintro p ⟨f, hfe, u, v, rfl⟩
  apply Ideal.subset_span
  exact ⟨f, lt_of_lt_of_le hfe hed, u, v, rfl⟩

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.lowerToricIdeal_le_toricIdeal
statement:
theorem lowerToricIdeal_le_toricIdeal (d : ℕ) :
    D.lowerToricIdeal (k := k) d ≤ D.toricIdeal (k := k)
proof:
:= by
  unfold lowerToricIdeal
  rw [Ideal.span_le]
  rintro p ⟨e, he, u, v, rfl⟩
  exact D.fiberBinomial_mem_toricIdeal u v

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.removeFactor_add_single
statement:
theorem removeFactor_add_single {u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ} {j : Fin 4} (hj : 0 < u j) :
    D.removeFactor u j + Finsupp.single j 1 = u
proof:
:= by
  exact Finsupp.sub_add_single_one_cancel (Nat.ne_of_gt hj)

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.weightedDegree_removeFactor
statement:
theorem weightedDegree_removeFactor {u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ} {j : Fin 4} (hj : 0 < u j) :
    D.weightedDegree (D.removeFactor u j) + D.n j = D.weightedDegree u
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg D.weightedDegree (D.removeFactor_add_single hj)
  simpa [weightedDegreeOf_add, D.weightedDegree_single] using h

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.lowerFactorization_degree_lt
statement:
theorem lowerFactorization_degree_lt {d : ℕ} (u : D.FactorizationAt d)
    (j : Fin 4) (hj : 0 < u.1 j) : d - D.n j < d
proof:
:= by
  have hweight := D.weightedDegree_removeFactor hj
  rw [D.factorizationAt_degree u] at hweight
  have hn := D.positive j
  omega

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.fiberMonomial_remove_mul
statement:
theorem fiberMonomial_remove_mul {d : ℕ} (u : D.FactorizationAt d)
    (j : Fin 4) (hj : 0 < u.1 j) :
    MvPolynomial.X j * D.fiberMonomial (k := k) (D.lowerFactorization u j hj) =
      D.fiberMonomial (k := k) u
proof:
:= by
  rw [fiberMonomial, fiberMonomial, MvPolynomial.X, MvPolynomial.monomial_mul]
  simp only [one_mul]
  change MvPolynomial.monomial (Finsupp.single j 1 + D.removeFactor u.1 j) 1 = _
  rw [show Finsupp.single j 1 + D.removeFactor u.1 j = u.1 by
    rw [add_comm, D.removeFactor_add_single hj]]

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.fiberBinomial_remove_mul
statement:
theorem fiberBinomial_remove_mul {d : ℕ} (u v : D.FactorizationAt d)
    (j : Fin 4) (hu : 0 < u.1 j) (hv : 0 < v.1 j) :
    MvPolynomial.X j * D.fiberBinomial (k := k)
      (D.lowerFactorization u j hu) (D.lowerFactorization v j hv) =
      D.fiberBinomial (k := k) u v
proof:
:= by
  simp only [fiberBinomial, mul_sub]
  rw [D.fiberMonomial_remove_mul u j hu, D.fiberMonomial_remove_mul v j hv]

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.fiberBinomial_mem_lower_of_overlap
statement:
theorem fiberBinomial_mem_lower_of_overlap {d : ℕ} (u v : D.FactorizationAt d)
    (h : D.FactorizationOverlap u v) :
    D.fiberBinomial (k := k) u v ∈ D.lowerToricIdeal (k := k) d
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨j, hu, hv⟩
  rw [← D.fiberBinomial_remove_mul u v j hu hv]
  apply Ideal.mul_mem_left
  apply Ideal.subset_span
  exact ⟨d - D.n j, D.lowerFactorization_degree_lt u j hu,
    D.lowerFactorization u j hu, D.lowerFactorization v j hv, rfl⟩

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.fiberBinomial_mem_lower_of_adj
proof:
:=
  D.fiberBinomial_mem_lower_of_overlap u v ((D.factorizationGraph_adj u v).mp h).2

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.fiberBinomial_mem_lower_of_reachable
proof:
:= by
  rw [SimpleGraph.reachable_iff_reflTransGen] at h
  induction h with
  | refl => simp
  | tail hreach hadj ih =>
      rw [← D.fiberBinomial_add]
      exact Ideal.add_mem _ ih (D.fiberBinomial_mem_lower_of_adj hadj)

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.fiberBinomial_mem_lower_of_sameComponent
proof:
:=
  D.fiberBinomial_mem_lower_of_reachable ((D.componentOf_eq_iff_reachable u v).mp h)

name: P23.Semigroup.chosenBase_budget_zero_type_three_ng_mu_ne_five
statement:
theorem chosenBase_budget_zero_type_three_ng_mu_ne_five
    (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup) (i : Fin 4)
    (hz : D.fourBaseBudget i=0) (ht : chosenBaseType (k := ℚ) D i=3)
    (hn : ChosenBaseNearlyGorenstein (k := ℚ) D i) :
    idealGeneratorMu (chosenBaseDefiningIdeal (k := ℚ) D i) ≠ 5
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨G,hI,hcard,hm⟩ := chosenBase_plain_exponentPresentation_of_budget_zero D i hz
  have hf := chosenBase_plainSurvivors_finite D i G hI
  have h0 := chosenBase_plain_unit_survives D i G hI
  let R := plainSurvivorRoots ℚ G hf
  have hR : R.Nonempty := plainSurvivorRoots_nonempty ℚ G hf h0
  have ha : PlainRootAntichain R := plainSurvivorRoots_antichain ℚ G hf
  have hG := plainGenerators_eq_border ℚ G hf (plainGenerators_antichain_of_minimal ℚ G hm)
  let E := chosenBasePlainQuotientEquiv D i G hI hf hG
  have hv : PlainVariablesSurvive R := chosenBase_plain_variables_survive D i G hI hf
  have hed : plainEmbeddingDimension ℚ R hR=3 :=
    (plain_embeddingDimension_eq_three_iff_variablesSurvive R hR).mpr hv
  have htype : plainDirectType ℚ R hR=3 :=
    (chosenPlain_type_eq R hR E).trans ht
  have hng : PlainDirectNearlyGorenstein ℚ R hR :=
    (chosenPlain_ng_iff R hR E).mp hn
  have hno := plainMonomial_typeThree_nearlyGorenstein_mu_ne_five G hf h0 hm hed htype hng
  rwa [hI] at hno

name: P23.Semigroup.budget_zero_type_three_ng_rho_ne_five
statement:
theorem budget_zero_type_three_ng_rho_ne_five
    (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup) (i : Fin 4)
    (hz : D.fourBaseBudget i=0) (ht : D.semigroupType=3)
    (hn : SemigroupNearlyGorenstein D) : D.semigroupRho ≠ 5
proof:
:= by
  have h := chosenBase_budget_zero_type_three_ng_mu_ne_five D i hz
    ((chosenBaseType_eq_semigroupType D i).trans ht)
    (semigroupNearlyGorenstein_to_chosenBaseNearlyGorenstein D i hn)
  rwa [chosenBaseDefiningIdeal_mu_eq_rho] at h

name: P23.Semigroup.rho_five_budget_positive
statement:
theorem rho_five_budget_positive (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup)
    (ht : D.semigroupType=3) (hn : SemigroupNearlyGorenstein D)
    (hr : D.semigroupRho=5) (i : Fin 4) : 0<D.fourBaseBudget i
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  have hz : D.fourBaseBudget i=0 := by omega
  exact budget_zero_type_three_ng_rho_ne_five D i hz ht hn hr

name: P23.Semigroup.rho_five_all_budgets_eq_one
statement:
theorem rho_five_all_budgets_eq_one (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup)
    (ht : D.semigroupType=3) (hn : SemigroupNearlyGorenstein D)
    (hr : D.semigroupRho=5) (i : Fin 4) : D.fourBaseBudget i=1
proof:
:= by
  have h0 := rho_five_budget_positive D ht hn hr 0
  have h1 := rho_five_budget_positive D ht hn hr 1
  have h2 := rho_five_budget_positive D ht hn hr 2
  have h3 := rho_five_budget_positive D ht hn hr 3
  have hs := D.fourBaseBudget_sum_le_four
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_four] at hs
  have he0 : D.fourBaseBudget 0=1 := by omega
  have he1 : D.fourBaseBudget 1=1 := by omega
  have he2 : D.fourBaseBudget 2=1 := by omega
  have he3 : D.fourBaseBudget 3=1 := by omega
  fin_cases i
  · exact he0
  · exact he1
  · exact he2
  · exact he3

name: P23.Semigroup.monomialFiveGeneratorObstruction
statement:
theorem monomialFiveGeneratorObstruction (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup)
    (ht : D.semigroupType=3) (hn : SemigroupNearlyGorenstein D) :
    MonomialFiveGeneratorObstruction D where
  budgetZeroNotFive
proof:
:= fun i hz => budget_zero_type_three_ng_rho_ne_five D i hz ht hn
  rhoFivePositive := fun hr i => rho_five_budget_positive D ht hn hr i
  rhoFiveAllOne := fun hr i => rho_five_all_budgets_eq_one D ht hn hr i

name: P23.Semigroup.tailIndexEquiv_apply

name: P23.Semigroup.baseSpecialization_X_base
statement:
@[simp] theorem baseSpecialization_X_base :
    baseSpecialization (k := k) D i (MvPolynomial.X i) = 0

    baseSpecialization (k := k) D i (MvPolynomial.X (D.tailIndex i j)) =
      MvPolynomial.X j
proof:
:= by

    MvPolynomial.killCompl_rename_app (D.tailIndex i).injective (MvPolynomial.X j : TailPoly k)

name: P23.Semigroup.baseSpecialization_surjective
statement:

    Function.Surjective (baseSpecialization (k := k) D i)

name: P23.Semigroup.restrictToTails_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem restrictToTails_apply (u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) (j : Fin 3) :
    restrictToTails D i u j = u (D.tailIndex i j)
proof: := tailExponent_apply D i u j

name: P23.Semigroup.tailEmbeddingExponent_eq_mapDomain
statement:
theorem tailEmbeddingExponent_eq_mapDomain (v : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) :
    tailEmbeddingExponent i v = v.mapDomain (D.tailIndex i)
proof:
:= by
  ext j
  refine Fin.succAboveCases i ?_ (fun l => ?_) j
  · rw [extendTailExponent_base, Finsupp.mapDomain_of_notMem_range]
    rintro ⟨l, hl⟩
    exact D.tailIndex_ne_base i l hl
  · change extendTailExponent i v (i.succAbove l) =
      v.mapDomain (D.tailIndex i) (D.tailIndex i l)
    rw [Finsupp.mapDomain_apply (D.tailIndex i).injective]
    exact extendTailExponent_tail i v l

name: P23.Semigroup.tailEmbedding_restrictToTails
statement:
theorem tailEmbedding_restrictToTails (u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) (hu : u i = 0) :
    tailEmbeddingExponent i (restrictToTails D i u) = u
proof:
:= by
  ext j
  refine Fin.succAboveCases i ?_ (fun l => ?_) j
  · simpa using hu.symm
  · simp [tailEmbeddingExponent, restrictToTails]

name: P23.Semigroup.restrictToTails_degree
statement:
theorem restrictToTails_degree (u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) (hu : u i = 0) :
    tailDegree D i (restrictToTails D i u) = D.weightedDegree u
proof:
:=
  (weightedDegree_eq_tailDegree_of_base_zero D i u hu).symm

name: P23.Semigroup.baseSpecialization_monomial_of_base_pos
statement:
theorem baseSpecialization_monomial_of_base_pos (u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) (r : k)
    (hu : 0 < u i) : baseSpecialization D i (MvPolynomial.monomial u r) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply MvPolynomial.killCompl_monomial_eq_zero_of_notMem_range
  · exact Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mpr (Nat.ne_of_gt hu)
  · rintro ⟨j, hj⟩
    exact D.tailIndex_ne_base i j hj

name: P23.Semigroup.baseSpecialization_monomial_of_base_zero
statement:
theorem baseSpecialization_monomial_of_base_zero (u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) (r : k)
    (hu : u i = 0) : baseSpecialization D i (MvPolynomial.monomial u r) =
      MvPolynomial.monomial (restrictToTails D i u) r
proof:
:= by
  have h := tailEmbedding_restrictToTails D i u hu
  rw [tailEmbeddingExponent_eq_mapDomain D i] at h
  conv_lhs => rw [← h]
  exact MvPolynomial.killCompl_monomial_mapDomain (R := k) (D.tailIndex i).injective

name: P23.Semigroup.baseSpecialization_ker
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro p hp
    change baseSpecialization D i p = 0 at hp
    have h := (MvPolynomial.mem_ideal_span_X_image
      (x := p) (s := ({i} : Set (Fin 4))))
    rw [Set.image_singleton] at h
    apply h.mpr
    intro u hu
    refine ⟨i, Set.mem_singleton _, ?_⟩
    intro hui
    have hrecon := tailEmbedding_restrictToTails D i u hui
    rw [tailEmbeddingExponent_eq_mapDomain D i] at hrecon
    have hc := congrArg (MvPolynomial.coeff (restrictToTails D i u)) hp
    change MvPolynomial.coeff _ (MvPolynomial.killCompl (D.tailIndex i).injective p) = _ at hc
    rw [MvPolynomial.coeff_killCompl, hrecon, MvPolynomial.coeff_zero] at hc
    exact (MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff.mp hu) hc
  · rw [Ideal.span_le]
    rintro p (rfl : p = _)
    exact baseSpecialization_X_base D i

name: P23.Semigroup.fourPolyToChosenBase_eq
statement:
theorem fourPolyToChosenBase_eq : fourPolyToChosenBase (k := k) D i =
    (tailPolyToChosenBase D i).comp (baseSpecialization D i)
proof:
:= by
  apply MvPolynomial.algHom_ext
  intro j
  refine Fin.succAboveCases i ?_ (fun l => ?_) j
  · apply (chosenBaseEquivApery (k := k) D i).injective
    have hnot : ¬D.IsApery i (D.generator i) := D.base_not_isApery i
    simp [fourPolyToChosenBase, semigroupPolyMap,
      baseSpecialization_X_base, semigroupToAperyAlg_T, truncatedAperyMonomial,
      hnot]
  · change fourPolyToChosenBase D i (MvPolynomial.X (D.tailIndex i l)) =
      tailPolyToChosenBase D i (baseSpecialization D i (MvPolynomial.X (D.tailIndex i l)))
    rw [baseSpecialization_X_tail]
    apply (chosenBaseEquivApery (k := k) D i).injective
    simp only [fourPolyToChosenBase, AlgHom.comp_apply, Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ_eq_mk,
      semigroupPolyMap, MvPolynomial.aeval_X, chosenBaseEquivApery_mk,
      semigroupToAperyAlg_T, tailPolyToChosenBase, AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom,
      AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply, tailPolyToApery]
    exact truncatedAperyMonomial_tail D i l

name: P23.Semigroup.fourPolyToChosenBase_ker
proof:
:= by
  have hmap : Ideal.map D.semigroupPolyMap.toRingHom
      (Ideal.span {MvPolynomial.X i}) = baseMonomialIdeal (k := k) D i := by
    rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
    simp [semigroupPolyMap, baseMonomialIdeal, base]
  change RingHom.ker ((Ideal.Quotient.mk (baseMonomialIdeal D i)).comp
    D.semigroupPolyMap.toRingHom) = _
  rw [← RingHom.comap_ker, Ideal.mk_ker, ← hmap,
    Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective D.semigroupPolyMap.toRingHom D.semigroupPolyMap_surjective,
    ← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot]
  exact sup_comm _ _

name: P23.Semigroup.fourPolyToChosenBase_ker_comap

theorem fourPolyToChosenBase_ker_comap :

name: P23.Semigroup.map_toricIdeal_eq_chosenBaseDefiningIdeal

theorem map_toricIdeal_eq_chosenBaseDefiningIdeal :
    Ideal.map (baseSpecialization (k := k) D i).toRingHom D.toricIdeal =
      chosenBaseDefiningIdeal D i
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (Ideal.map (baseSpecialization (k := k) D i).toRingHom)
    ((fourPolyToChosenBase_ker D i).symm.trans (fourPolyToChosenBase_ker_comap D i))
  have hX : (baseSpecialization (k := k) D i).toRingHom (MvPolynomial.X i) = 0 :=
    baseSpecialization_X_base D i
  simpa only [Ideal.map_sup, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton, hX,
    Ideal.span_singleton_zero, sup_bot_eq,
    Ideal.map_comap_of_surjective (baseSpecialization D i).toRingHom
      (baseSpecialization_surjective D i)] using h

name: P23.Semigroup.plain_standard_degree_injective
statement:
theorem plain_standard_degree_injective (M : BudgetZeroPlainModel D i)
    (p q : PlainMonomialIndex M.roots) (he : tailDegree D i p.1=tailDegree D i q.1) : p=q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra hn
  have hpq : p.1≠q.1 := fun h=>hn (Subtype.ext h)
  let f : TailPoly ℚ := MvPolynomial.monomial p.1 1-MvPolynomial.monomial q.1 1
  have hmap : tailPolyToChosenBase (k:=ℚ) D i f=0 := by
    apply (chosenBaseEquivApery D i).injective
    simp only [map_zero,map_sub,f,tailPolyToChosenBase_monomial,one_smul]
    have hd : tailDegreeGamma D i p.1=tailDegreeGamma D i q.1 := Subtype.ext he
    rw [hd,sub_self]
  have hf : f∈plainMonomialIdeal ℚ (plainBorderFinset M.roots) := by
    rw [←M.generators_eq_border,M.idealEq]
    exact RingHom.mem_ker.mpr hmap
  have hz : plainPolyToArtin ℚ M.roots f=0 :=
    RingHom.mem_ker.mp ((plainPolyToArtin_kernel ℚ M.roots).symm ▸ hf)
  have hc := congrArg (fun x : PlainMonomialArtin ℚ M.roots =>x.coeff p) hz
  rw [coeff_plainPolyToArtin] at hc
  simpa [f,MvPolynomial.coeff_monomial,hpq,Ne.symm hpq] using hc

name: P23.Semigroup.plainStandardApery_bijective
statement:
theorem plainStandardApery_bijective (M : BudgetZeroPlainModel D i) :
    Function.Bijective (plainStandardApery M)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro p q he
    exact plain_standard_degree_injective M p q (congrArg (fun s : D.AperyIndex i =>s.1.1) he)
  · intro w
    obtain ⟨u,hu⟩ := exists_tailExponent_of_isApery D i w.2
    have hg : tailDegreeGamma D i u=w.1 := Subtype.ext hu
    have hs : u∈plainStandardFinset M.roots := by
      apply (mem_plainStandardFinset _ _).mpr
      apply (chosenBase_plain_monomial_isApery_iff_standard D i M.generators M.roots
        M.idealEq M.generators_eq_border u).mp
      rw [hg]
      exact w.2
    exact ⟨⟨u,hs⟩,Subtype.ext hg⟩

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.aperyOfResidue_residue
statement:
theorem aperyOfResidue_residue (i : Fin 4) (r : Fin (D.n i)) :
    aperyResidue D i (D.aperyOfResidue i r)=(r.1 : ZMod (D.n i))
proof:
:=
  (aperyResidueEquiv D i).apply_symm_apply _

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.aperyOfResidue_mod
statement:
theorem aperyOfResidue_mod (i : Fin 4) (r : Fin (D.n i)) :
    (D.aperyOfResidue i r).1.1 % D.n i=r.1
proof:
:= by
  have h := (ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff _ _ _).mp (D.aperyOfResidue_residue i r)
  simpa [Nat.ModEq,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt r.isLt] using h

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.apery_residue_decomposition
statement:
theorem apery_residue_decomposition (i : Fin 4) (r : Fin (D.n i)) :
    (D.aperyOfResidue i r).1.1=r.1+D.n i*D.aperyQuotient i r
proof:
:= by
  have h := Nat.mod_add_div (D.aperyOfResidue i r).1.1 (D.n i)
  rw [D.aperyOfResidue_mod i r] at h
  exact h.symm

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.gap_iff_lt_aperyQuotient
statement:
theorem gap_iff_lt_aperyQuotient (i : Fin 4) (r : Fin (D.n i)) (k : ℕ) :
    r.1+D.n i*k∈D.gapFinset ↔ k<D.aperyQuotient i r
proof:
:= by
  rw [D.mem_gapFinset]
  let s := D.aperyOfResidue i r
  have hs := D.apery_residue_decomposition i r
  have hq := D.positive i
  constructor
  · intro hnot
    by_contra hn
    have hk : D.aperyQuotient i r≤k := by omega
    let g : D.Gamma := s.1+(k-D.aperyQuotient i r) • D.base i
    have hmul := congrArg (fun x : ℕ=>D.n i*x)
      (Nat.add_sub_of_le hk : D.aperyQuotient i r+(k-D.aperyQuotient i r)=k)
    have he : g.1=r.1+D.n i*k := by
      change s.1.1+(k-D.aperyQuotient i r)*D.n i=_
      change s.1.1=r.1+D.n i*D.aperyQuotient i r at hs
      nlinarith
    exact hnot (he ▸ g.2)
  · intro hk hmem
    apply s.2
    let g : D.Gamma := ⟨r.1+D.n i*k,hmem⟩+
      (D.aperyQuotient i r-k-1) • D.base i
    refine ⟨g,Subtype.ext ?_⟩
    change s.1.1=D.n i+(r.1+D.n i*k+(D.aperyQuotient i r-k-1)*D.n i)
    have hsum : (D.aperyQuotient i r-k-1)+k+1=D.aperyQuotient i r := by omega
    have hmul := congrArg (fun x : ℕ=>D.n i*x) hsum
    change s.1.1=r.1+D.n i*D.aperyQuotient i r at hs
    nlinarith

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.residueGap_bijective
statement: theorem residueGap_bijective (i : Fin 4) : Function.Bijective (D.residueGap i)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨r,k⟩ ⟨t,l⟩ he
    have hv := congrArg Subtype.val he
    change r.1+D.n i*k.1=t.1+D.n i*l.1 at hv
    have hm := congrArg (fun x : ℕ=>x % D.n i) hv
    rw [Nat.add_mul_mod_self_left,Nat.add_mul_mod_self_left,
      Nat.mod_eq_of_lt r.isLt,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt t.isLt] at hm
    have hrt : r=t := Fin.ext hm
    subst t
    have hq := D.positive i
    have hkl : k.1=l.1 := by nlinarith
    have hke : k=l := Fin.ext hkl
    subst l
    rfl
  · intro a
    let r : Fin (D.n i) := ⟨a.1 % D.n i,Nat.mod_lt _ (D.positive i)⟩
    have he : r.1+D.n i*(a.1 / D.n i)=a.1 := Nat.mod_add_div _ _
    have hk : a.1 / D.n i<D.aperyQuotient i r :=
      (D.gap_iff_lt_aperyQuotient i r _).mp (he.symm ▸ a.2)
    exact ⟨⟨r,⟨a.1 / D.n i,hk⟩⟩,Subtype.ext he⟩

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.genus_eq_sum_aperyQuotient
statement:
theorem genus_eq_sum_aperyQuotient (i : Fin 4) :
    D.genus=∑ r : Fin (D.n i),D.aperyQuotient i r
proof:
:= by
  have h := Fintype.card_congr (D.gapResidueEquiv i)
  simpa [genus,Fintype.card_sigma] using h

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.aperyOfResidue_bijective
statement: theorem aperyOfResidue_bijective (i : Fin 4) : Function.Bijective (D.aperyOfResidue i)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro r t h
    have hm := congrArg (fun w : D.AperyIndex i=>w.1.1 % D.n i) h
    rw [D.aperyOfResidue_mod,D.aperyOfResidue_mod] at hm
    exact Fin.ext hm
  · intro w
    let r : Fin (D.n i) := ⟨w.1.1 % D.n i,Nat.mod_lt _ (D.positive i)⟩
    refine ⟨r,aperyResidue_injective D i ?_⟩
    rw [D.aperyOfResidue_residue]
    simp [r,aperyResidue]

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.doubled_fin_val_sum
statement:
private theorem doubled_fin_val_sum (q : ℕ) :
    2*(∑ r : Fin q,(r.1:ℤ))=(q:ℤ)*((q:ℤ)-1)
proof:
:= by
  induction q with
  | zero => simp
  | succ q ih =>
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
    simp only [Fin.val_castSucc,Fin.val_last]
    push_cast
    nlinarith

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.apery_genus_formula_doubled
statement:
theorem apery_genus_formula_doubled (i : Fin 4) :
    2*(D.n i:ℤ)*(D.genus:ℤ)=
      2*(∑ w : D.AperyIndex i,(w.1.1:ℤ))-(D.n i:ℤ)*((D.n i:ℤ)-1)
proof:
:= by
  have hs := (D.aperyOfResidueEquiv i).sum_comp (fun w : D.AperyIndex i=>(w.1.1:ℤ))
  have hv : (∑ w : D.AperyIndex i,(w.1.1:ℤ))=
      (∑ r : Fin (D.n i),(r.1:ℤ))+(D.n i:ℤ)*(∑ r : Fin (D.n i),(D.aperyQuotient i r:ℤ)) := by
    rw [←hs]
    change (∑ r : Fin (D.n i),((D.aperyOfResidue i r).1.1:ℤ))=_
    simp_rw [D.apery_residue_decomposition]
    simp [Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_mul,Finset.sum_add_distrib,Finset.mul_sum]
  have hg : (D.genus:ℤ)=∑ r : Fin (D.n i),(D.aperyQuotient i r:ℤ) := by
    exact_mod_cast D.genus_eq_sum_aperyQuotient i
  have hr := doubled_fin_val_sum (D.n i)
  rw [hv,hg]
  nlinarith

name: P23.Semigroup.mul_mem_upwardNormalSpan
proof:
:= by
  induction hf using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem f hf =>
    obtain ⟨p,⟨g,hg,hgp⟩,rfl⟩ := hf
    induction r using MonoidAlgebra.induction_linear with
    | zero => simp
    | add r t hr ht => simpa [add_mul] using (upwardNormalSpan G).add_mem hr ht
    | single q t =>
      have hmem : monomial (k := ℚ) (q * p) ∈ upwardNormalSpan G :=
        Submodule.subset_span ⟨q*p,⟨g,hg,dvd_trans hgp (dvd_mul_left p q)⟩,rfl⟩
      have hs := (upwardNormalSpan G).smul_mem t hmem
      simpa [monomial, MonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single, MonoidAlgebra.smul_single] using hs
  | zero => simp
  | add f t hf ht hr ht' => simpa [mul_add] using (upwardNormalSpan G).add_mem hr ht'
  | smul t f hf hi => simpa [mul_smul_comm] using (upwardNormalSpan G).smul_mem t hi

name: P23.Semigroup.normalGeneratorIdeal_eq_upward
statement:
private theorem normalGeneratorIdeal_eq_upward (G : Finset (Normal a b c)) :
    normalGeneratorIdeal G = upwardNormalIdeal G
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
    rintro f ⟨g,hg,rfl⟩
    exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨g,⟨g,hg,dvd_refl g⟩,rfl⟩
  · intro f hf
    change f ∈ upwardNormalSpan G at hf
    induction hf using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem f hf =>
      obtain ⟨p,⟨g,hg,⟨q,rfl⟩⟩,rfl⟩ := hf
      have hm : monomial (k := ℚ) g ∈ normalGeneratorIdeal G := Ideal.subset_span ⟨g,hg,rfl⟩
      simpa [monomial_mul, mul_comm] using (normalGeneratorIdeal G).mul_mem_left (monomial q) hm
    | zero => exact (normalGeneratorIdeal G).zero_mem
    | add f t hf ht hr ht' => exact (normalGeneratorIdeal G).add_mem hr ht'
    | smul t f hf hi =>
      simpa [Algebra.smul_def] using (normalGeneratorIdeal G).mul_mem_left (algebraMap ℚ _ t) hi

name: P23.Semigroup.monomial_mem_normalGeneratorIdeal_iff
statement:
theorem monomial_mem_normalGeneratorIdeal_iff (G : Finset (Normal a b c)) (p : Normal a b c) :
    monomial (k := ℚ) p ∈ normalGeneratorIdeal G ↔ ∃ g ∈ G, g ∣ p
proof:
:= by
  rw [normalGeneratorIdeal_eq_upward]
  change monomial (k := ℚ) p ∈ upwardNormalSpan G ↔ p ∈ normalKilledSet G
  exact MonoidAlgebra.single_mem_span_single

name: P23.Semigroup.normalGeneratorIdeal_coeff_zero
statement:
theorem normalGeneratorIdeal_coeff_zero (G : Finset (Normal a b c)) (p : Normal a b c)
    (hp : monomial (k := ℚ) p ∉ normalGeneratorIdeal G)
    (f : NormalMonoidAlgebra ℚ a b c) (hf : f ∈ normalGeneratorIdeal G) : f.coeff p = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [normalGeneratorIdeal_eq_upward] at hf
  change f ∈ upwardNormalSpan G at hf
  have hpk : p ∉ normalKilledSet G := fun h => hp ((monomial_mem_normalGeneratorIdeal_iff G p).mpr h)
  induction hf using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem f hf =>
    obtain ⟨q,hq,rfl⟩ := hf
    have hqp : q ≠ p := fun he => hpk (he ▸ hq)
    simp [hqp]
  | zero => simp
  | add f g hf hg hi hj => simp [hi,hj]
  | smul t f hf hi => simp [hi]

name: P23.Semigroup.normal_survivor_downward
proof:
:= by
  intro hd
  obtain ⟨g,hg,hgd⟩ := (monomial_mem_normalGeneratorIdeal_iff G d).mp hd
  exact hp ((monomial_mem_normalGeneratorIdeal_iff G p).mpr ⟨g,hg,dvd_trans hgd hdiv⟩)

name: P23.Semigroup.normal_surviving_quotient_monomials_independent
statement:
theorem normal_surviving_quotient_monomials_independent (G : Finset (Normal a b c)) :
    LinearIndependent ℚ (fun p : {p : Normal a b c | monomial (k := ℚ) p ∉ normalGeneratorIdeal G} =>
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (normalGeneratorIdeal G) (monomial (k := ℚ) p.1))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply linearIndependent_iff'.mpr
  intro s t hz j hj
  have hm : (∑ q ∈ s, t q • monomial (k := ℚ) q.1) ∈ normalGeneratorIdeal G := by
    apply Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mp
    change (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ ℚ (normalGeneratorIdeal G)) (∑ q ∈ s, t q • monomial q.1) = 0
    simpa only [map_sum, map_smul, Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ_eq_mk] using hz
  have hc := normalGeneratorIdeal_coeff_zero G j.1 j.2 _ hm
  have hmono (q : {p : Normal a b c | monomial (k := ℚ) p ∉ normalGeneratorIdeal G}) :
      (monomial (k := ℚ) q.1).coeff j.1 = if q = j then 1 else 0 := by
    simp only [monomial_coeff, Subtype.val_inj]
  simpa [MonoidAlgebra.coeff_sum, MonoidAlgebra.coeff_smul, hmono, hj] using hc

name: P23.Semigroup.normal_survivors_finite
statement:
theorem normal_survivors_finite (G : Finset (Normal a b c))
    [Module.Finite ℚ (NormalMonoidAlgebra ℚ a b c ⧸ normalGeneratorIdeal G)] :
    {p : Normal a b c | monomial (k := ℚ) p ∉ normalGeneratorIdeal G}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  haveI := (normal_surviving_quotient_monomials_independent G).finite
  exact Set.toFinite _

name: P23.Semigroup.normalizedMonomialIdeal_map
statement:
theorem normalizedMonomialIdeal_map {D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup} {i : Fin 4}
    {p : TailPoly ℚ} (C : OneTieCoordinates D i p) (E : Finset (Fin 3 →₀ ℕ))
    (hspan : Ideal.span (↑(rawLiftGeneratorFinset C E) : Set (ThreePoly ℚ)) = renamedChosenBaseIdeal C) :
    (renamedChosenBaseIdeal C).map
        (polyToNormalAlg (k := ℚ) (a := C.a) (b := C.b) (c := C.c)).toRingHom =
      normalGeneratorIdeal (normalizedMonomialGeneratorFinset C E)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hspan, ← normalizedLiftGeneratorFinset_span_eq]
  simp [normalizedLiftGeneratorFinset, normalGeneratorIdeal, Ideal.map_span,
    Finset.coe_insert, Finset.coe_image, Set.image_insert_eq, Set.image_image, Function.comp_def]

name: P23.Semigroup.chosenBase_normal_survivorQuotient_finite
statement:
theorem chosenBase_normal_survivorQuotient_finite {D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup} {i : Fin 4}
    {p : TailPoly ℚ} (C : OneTieCoordinates D i p) (E : Finset (Fin 3 →₀ ℕ))
    (hspan : Ideal.span (↑(rawLiftGeneratorFinset C E) : Set (ThreePoly ℚ)) = renamedChosenBaseIdeal C) :
    Module.Finite ℚ (NormalMonoidAlgebra ℚ C.a C.b C.c ⧸
      normalGeneratorIdeal (normalizedMonomialGeneratorFinset C E))
proof:
:= by
  letI : Module.Finite ℚ (ChosenBaseQuotient (k := ℚ) D i) :=
    (chosenBaseEquivApery (k := ℚ) D i).symm.toLinearEquiv.finiteDimensional
  exact (chosenBaseQuotientEquivNormalGenerators C E hspan).toLinearEquiv.finiteDimensional

name: P23.Semigroup.normalSurvivorRoots_antichain
statement:
theorem normalSurvivorRoots_antichain (G : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (hf : {p : Normal a b c | monomial (k := ℚ) p ∉ normalGeneratorIdeal G}.Finite) :
    IsRootAntichain (normalSurvivorRoots G hf)
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp q hq hne hd
  have hpmax := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).2
  have hqsurv := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hq).1
  exact hne (hpmax q hqsurv hd)

name: P23.Semigroup.normalSurvivorRoots_standardSet_iff
statement:
theorem normalSurvivorRoots_standardSet_iff (G : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (hf : {p : Normal a b c | monomial (k := ℚ) p ∉ normalGeneratorIdeal G}.Finite)
    (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) (p : Normal a b c) :
    p ∈ standardSet (normalSurvivorRoots G hf) ↔ monomial (k := ℚ) p ∉ normalGeneratorIdeal G
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨s,hs,hps⟩
    have hsurv : monomial (k := ℚ) s ∉ normalGeneratorIdeal G :=
      hf.mem_toFinset.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hs).1
    exact normal_survivor_downward G hsurv hps
  · intro hp
    let K := hf.toFinset.filter (fun q => p ∣ q)
    have hpK : p ∈ K := Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hf.mem_toFinset.mpr hp, dvd_refl p⟩
    obtain ⟨s,hs,hmax⟩ := K.exists_max_image normalWeight ⟨p,hpK⟩
    have hsu : s ∈ hf.toFinset := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hs).1
    have hps : p ∣ s := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hs).2
    have hsm : ∀ q ∈ hf.toFinset, s ∣ q → s = q := by
      intro q hq hsq
      by_contra hne
      have hqK : q ∈ K := Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hq,dvd_trans hps hsq⟩
      have hle := hmax q hqK
      have hlt := normalWeight_lt_of_proper_dvd hdom hsq hne
      omega
    exact ⟨s,Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hsu,hsm⟩,hps⟩

name: P23.Semigroup.normalSurvivorRoots_nonempty
statement:
theorem normalSurvivorRoots_nonempty (G : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (hf : {p : Normal a b c | monomial (k := ℚ) p ∉ normalGeneratorIdeal G}.Finite)
    (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c)
    (h1 : monomial (k := ℚ) (1 : Normal a b c) ∉ normalGeneratorIdeal G) :
    (normalSurvivorRoots G hf).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s,hs,_⟩ := (normalSurvivorRoots_standardSet_iff G hf hdom 1).mpr h1
  exact ⟨s,hs⟩

name: P23.Semigroup.normalPresentationFinset_card
statement:
theorem normalPresentationFinset_card (G : Finset (Normal a b c)) :
    (normalPresentationFinset G).card = G.card + 1
proof:
:= by
  have hn : tiePolynomial a b c ∉ G.image (polynomialLift (k := ℚ)) := by
    rintro h
    obtain ⟨q,_,he⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp h
    exact tiePolynomial_ne_polynomialLift a b c q he.symm
  rw [normalPresentationFinset, Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hn,
    Finset.card_image_of_injective _ polynomialLift_injective]

name: P23.Semigroup.normalPresentationFinset_map
statement:
theorem normalPresentationFinset_map (G : Finset (Normal a b c)) :
    (Ideal.span (↑(normalPresentationFinset G) : Set (ThreePoly ℚ))).map
      (polyToNormalAlg (k := ℚ) (a := a) (b := b) (c := c)).toRingHom = normalGeneratorIdeal G
proof:
:= by
  simp [normalPresentationFinset, normalGeneratorIdeal, Ideal.map_span,
    Finset.coe_insert, Finset.coe_image, Set.image_insert_eq, Set.image_image]

name: P23.Semigroup.normalGeneratorIdeal_comap
statement:
theorem normalGeneratorIdeal_comap (G : Finset (Normal a b c)) :
    (normalGeneratorIdeal G).comap
      (polyToNormalAlg (k := ℚ) (a := a) (b := b) (c := c)).toRingHom =
      Ideal.span (↑(normalPresentationFinset G) : Set (ThreePoly ℚ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← normalPresentationFinset_map G,
    Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective
      (polyToNormalAlg (k := ℚ) (a := a) (b := b) (c := c)).toRingHom
      (polyToNormalAlg_surjective (k := ℚ) (a := a) (b := b) (c := c)),
    ← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot, polyToNormalAlg_ker]
  apply sup_of_le_left
  apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
  intro f hf
  rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hf]
  exact Ideal.subset_span (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)

name: P23.Semigroup.normalGenerators_incomparable_of_minimal
statement:
theorem normalGenerators_incomparable_of_minimal (G : Finset (Normal a b c)) (n : ℕ)
    (hm : HasMinimalGeneratorCard (Ideal.span (↑(normalPresentationFinset G) : Set (ThreePoly ℚ))) n)
    (hc : (normalPresentationFinset G).card = n) :
    ∀ g ∈ G, ∀ q ∈ G, q ∣ g → q = g
proof:
:= by
  intro g hg q hq hqg
  by_contra hne
  let R := Ideal.span (↑(normalPresentationFinset (G.erase g)) : Set (ThreePoly ℚ))
  have hgR : polynomialLift (k := ℚ) g ∈ R := by
    change polynomialLift (k := ℚ) g ∈ Ideal.span (↑(normalPresentationFinset (G.erase g)) : Set (ThreePoly ℚ))
    rw [← normalGeneratorIdeal_comap]
    change polyToNormalAlg (polynomialLift g) ∈ normalGeneratorIdeal (G.erase g)
    rw [polyToNormalAlg_polynomialLift, monomial_mem_normalGeneratorIdeal_iff]
    exact ⟨q,Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hne,hq⟩,hqg⟩
  have hs : Ideal.span (↑(normalPresentationFinset G) : Set (ThreePoly ℚ)) = R := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
      intro f hf
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hf with he | hf
      · subst f; exact Ideal.subset_span (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)
      · obtain ⟨t,ht,rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hf
        by_cases he : t = g
        · subst t; exact hgR
        · exact Ideal.subset_span (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem
            (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨t,Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨he,ht⟩,rfl⟩))
    · apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
      intro f hf
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hf with he | hf
      · subst f; exact Ideal.subset_span (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)
      · obtain ⟨t,ht,rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hf
        exact Ideal.subset_span (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem
          (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨t,(Finset.mem_erase.mp ht).2,rfl⟩))
  have hl := hm.2 (normalPresentationFinset (G.erase g)) hs.symm
  rw [normalPresentationFinset_card, Finset.card_erase_of_mem hg] at hl
  rw [normalPresentationFinset_card] at hc
  have hpos : 0 < G.card := Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨g,hg⟩
  omega

name: P23.Semigroup.normalWeight_le_of_dvd
statement:
private theorem normalWeight_le_of_dvd {p q : Normal a b c} (h : p ∣ q) :
    normalWeight p ≤ normalWeight q
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t,rfl⟩ := h
  rw [normalWeight_mul]
  omega

name: P23.Semigroup.normalGenerators_eq_exact_border
statement:
theorem normalGenerators_eq_exact_border (G : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (hf : {p : Normal a b c | monomial (k := ℚ) p ∉ normalGeneratorIdeal G}.Finite)
    (hd : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c)
    (h1 : monomial (k := ℚ) (1 : Normal a b c) ∉ normalGeneratorIdeal G)
    (hm : ∀ g ∈ G, ∀ q ∈ G, q ∣ g → q = g) :
    G = borderFinset (normalSurvivorRoots G hf)
proof:
:= by
  let S := normalSurvivorRoots G hf
  have hS : S.Nonempty := normalSurvivorRoots_nonempty G hf hd h1
  have hstd (p : Normal a b c) : p ∈ standardSet S ↔ monomial (k := ℚ) p ∉ normalGeneratorIdeal G :=
    normalSurvivorRoots_standardSet_iff G hf hd p
  have hkilled (g : Normal a b c) (hg : g ∈ G) : g ∉ standardSet S := by
    intro hs
    exact (hstd g).mp hs ((monomial_mem_normalGeneratorIdeal_iff G g).mpr ⟨g,hg,dvd_refl g⟩)
  have hvars := variableGenerators_ne_one_of_two_le (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) hd.1
  ext g
  constructor
  · intro hg
    apply (mem_borderFinset_iff hS g).mpr
    apply (isMinimalBorder_iff_isDivisibilityMinimalKilled S g hvars).mpr
    refine ⟨hkilled g hg, ?_⟩
    intro d hdg hdne
    apply (hstd d).mpr
    intro hdI
    obtain ⟨q,hq,hqd⟩ := (monomial_mem_normalGeneratorIdeal_iff G d).mp hdI
    have he := hm g hg q hq (dvd_trans hqd hdg)
    have hgd : g ∣ d := he ▸ hqd
    have hle := normalWeight_le_of_dvd hgd
    have hlt := normalWeight_lt_of_proper_dvd hd hdg hdne
    omega
  · intro hg
    have hb := (mem_borderFinset_iff hS g).mp hg
    have hmkill := (isMinimalBorder_iff_isDivisibilityMinimalKilled S g hvars).mp hb
    have hgI : monomial (k := ℚ) g ∈ normalGeneratorIdeal G := by
      by_contra hn
      exact hmkill.1 ((hstd g).mpr hn)
    obtain ⟨q,hq,hqg⟩ := (monomial_mem_normalGeneratorIdeal_iff G g).mp hgI
    by_cases he : q = g
    · exact he ▸ hq
    · exact False.elim (hkilled q hq (hmkill.2 q hqg he))

name: P23.Semigroup.renamedChosenBaseIdeal_mem_iff
statement:
theorem renamedChosenBaseIdeal_mem_iff (C : OneTieCoordinates D i p) (f : TailPoly ℚ) :
    renameToOneTie C f ∈ renamedChosenBaseIdeal C ↔ f ∈ chosenBaseDefiningIdeal D i
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨q,hq,he⟩ := (Ideal.mem_map_iff_of_surjective
      (renameToOneTie C).toRingHom (renameToOneTie C).surjective).mp h
    exact (renameToOneTie C).injective he ▸ hq
  · exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _

name: P23.Semigroup.normalGeneratorIdeal_comap_of_raw_span
statement:
theorem normalGeneratorIdeal_comap_of_raw_span (C : OneTieCoordinates D i p)
    (E : Finset (Fin 3 →₀ ℕ))
    (hs : Ideal.span (↑(rawLiftGeneratorFinset C E) : Set (ThreePoly ℚ)) = renamedChosenBaseIdeal C) :
    (normalGeneratorIdeal (normalizedMonomialGeneratorFinset C E)).comap
      (polyToNormalAlg (k := ℚ) (a := C.a) (b := C.b) (c := C.c)).toRingHom =
      renamedChosenBaseIdeal C
proof:
:= by
  rw [normalGeneratorIdeal_comap]
  change Ideal.span (↑(normalizedLiftGeneratorFinset C E) : Set (ThreePoly ℚ)) = _
  rw [normalizedLiftGeneratorFinset_span_eq, hs]

name: P23.Semigroup.chosenBase_normal_unit_survives
statement:
theorem chosenBase_normal_unit_survives (C : OneTieCoordinates D i p)
    (E : Finset (Fin 3 →₀ ℕ))
    (hs : Ideal.span (↑(rawLiftGeneratorFinset C E) : Set (ThreePoly ℚ)) = renamedChosenBaseIdeal C) :
    monomial (k := ℚ) (1 : Normal C.a C.b C.c) ∉
      normalGeneratorIdeal (normalizedMonomialGeneratorFinset C E)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hr : (1 : ThreePoly ℚ) ∈ renamedChosenBaseIdeal C := by
    rw [← normalGeneratorIdeal_comap_of_raw_span C E hs]
    simpa using h
  have hj : (1 : TailPoly ℚ) ∈ chosenBaseDefiningIdeal D i := by
    apply (renamedChosenBaseIdeal_mem_iff C 1).mp
    simpa using hr
  have hz : (1 : ChosenBaseQuotient (k := ℚ) D i) = 0 := by
    simpa using (RingHom.mem_ker.mp hj)
  apply tailVariableChosenBase_ne_zero (k := ℚ) D i 0
  calc
    tailPolyToChosenBase D i (MvPolynomial.X 0) =
      tailPolyToChosenBase D i (MvPolynomial.X 0) * 1 := (mul_one _).symm
    _ = 0 := by rw [hz, mul_zero]

name: P23.Semigroup.chosenBase_renamed_variable_survives
statement:
theorem chosenBase_renamed_variable_survives (C : OneTieCoordinates D i p)
    (j : Fin 3) : (MvPolynomial.X j : ThreePoly ℚ) ∉ renamedChosenBaseIdeal C
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have he : renameToOneTie C (MvPolynomial.X (C.sigma.symm j)) = MvPolynomial.X j := by
    simp [renameToOneTie, MvPolynomial.renameEquiv]
  have hj : (MvPolynomial.X (C.sigma.symm j) : TailPoly ℚ) ∈ chosenBaseDefiningIdeal D i := by
    apply (renamedChosenBaseIdeal_mem_iff C _).mp
    simpa only [he] using h
  exact tailVariableChosenBase_ne_zero (k := ℚ) D i _ (RingHom.mem_ker.mp hj)

name: P23.Semigroup.chosenBase_normal_variables_survive
statement:
theorem chosenBase_normal_variables_survive (C : OneTieCoordinates D i p)
    (E : Finset (Fin 3 →₀ ℕ))
    (hs : Ideal.span (↑(rawLiftGeneratorFinset C E) : Set (ThreePoly ℚ)) = renamedChosenBaseIdeal C) :
    monomial (k := ℚ) (Normal.xGenerator : Normal C.a C.b C.c) ∉ normalGeneratorIdeal (normalizedMonomialGeneratorFinset C E) ∧
    monomial (k := ℚ) (Normal.yGenerator : Normal C.a C.b C.c) ∉ normalGeneratorIdeal (normalizedMonomialGeneratorFinset C E) ∧
    monomial (k := ℚ) (Normal.zGenerator : Normal C.a C.b C.c) ∉ normalGeneratorIdeal (normalizedMonomialGeneratorFinset C E)
proof:
:= by
  have hx := chosenBase_renamed_variable_survives C 0
  have hy := chosenBase_renamed_variable_survives C 1
  have hz := chosenBase_renamed_variable_survives C 2
  rw [← normalGeneratorIdeal_comap_of_raw_span C E hs] at hx hy hz
  change (polyToNormalAlg (k := ℚ) (a := C.a) (b := C.b) (c := C.c)) polyX ∉
    normalGeneratorIdeal (normalizedMonomialGeneratorFinset C E) at hx
  change (polyToNormalAlg (k := ℚ) (a := C.a) (b := C.b) (c := C.c)) polyY ∉
    normalGeneratorIdeal (normalizedMonomialGeneratorFinset C E) at hy
  change (polyToNormalAlg (k := ℚ) (a := C.a) (b := C.b) (c := C.c)) polyZ ∉
    normalGeneratorIdeal (normalizedMonomialGeneratorFinset C E) at hz
  simpa using And.intro hx (And.intro hy hz)

name: P23.Semigroup.chosenBase_normal_tie_survives
statement:
theorem chosenBase_normal_tie_survives (C : OneTieCoordinates D i p)
    (E : Finset (Fin 3 →₀ ℕ))
    (hs : Ideal.span (↑(rawLiftGeneratorFinset C E) : Set (ThreePoly ℚ)) = renamedChosenBaseIdeal C) :
    monomial (k := ℚ) (liveTiePoint : Normal C.a C.b C.c) ∉
      normalGeneratorIdeal (normalizedMonomialGeneratorFinset C E)
proof:
:= by
  let d : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ := Finsupp.single 0 C.a
  have ha : C.a ≠ 0 := by have := C.liveDomain.1; omega
  have hneq : d ≠ Finsupp.single 1 C.b + Finsupp.single 2 C.c := by
    intro h
    have he := congrArg (fun w : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ => w 0) h
    simp [d] at he
    exact ha he
  have ht : MvPolynomial.coeff d (tiePolynomial (k := ℚ) C.a C.b C.c) = 1 := by
    simp [tiePolynomial, polyX, polyY, polyZ, MvPolynomial.X_pow_eq_monomial,
      MvPolynomial.monomial_mul, d, Ne.symm hneq]
  have he : renameToOneTie C p =
      MvPolynomial.monomial (C.original.u.mapDomain C.sigma) 1 -
      MvPolynomial.monomial (C.original.v.mapDomain C.sigma) 1 := by
    calc
      renameToOneTie C p = renameToOneTie C
          (MvPolynomial.monomial C.original.u 1 - MvPolynomial.monomial C.original.v 1) :=
        congrArg (renameToOneTie C) C.original.equation
      _ = _ := by simp [renameToOneTie, MvPolynomial.rename_monomial]
  have hmatch : C.original.u.mapDomain C.sigma = d ∨ C.original.v.mapDomain C.sigma = d := by
    by_contra hn
    push_neg at hn
    have hc : MvPolynomial.coeff d (renameToOneTie C p) = 0 := by
      simp [he, hn.1, hn.2]
    rcases renameToOneTie_live C with h | h
    · rw [h,ht] at hc; norm_num at hc
    · rw [h, MvPolynomial.coeff_neg, ht] at hc; norm_num at hc
  intro h
  have hd : normalizeExponent C.a C.b C.c d = (liveTiePoint : Normal C.a C.b C.c) := by
    apply Normal.ext <;> simp [normalizeExponent, exponentRaw, d, Normal.normalize, liveTiePoint,
      Nat.pos_of_ne_zero ha]
  have hm : (MvPolynomial.monomial d (1 : ℚ)) ∈ renamedChosenBaseIdeal C := by
    rw [← normalGeneratorIdeal_comap_of_raw_span C E hs]
    change (polyToNormalAlg (k := ℚ) (a := C.a) (b := C.b) (c := C.c))
      (MvPolynomial.monomial d (1 : ℚ)) ∈ normalGeneratorIdeal (normalizedMonomialGeneratorFinset C E)
    simpa [polyToNormalAlg_monomial, hd] using h
  have hkill (w : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) (hw : w.mapDomain C.sigma = d) :
      tailPolyToChosenBase (k := ℚ) D i (MvPolynomial.monomial w 1) = 0 := by
    apply RingHom.mem_ker.mp
    apply (renamedChosenBaseIdeal_mem_iff C _).mp
    simpa [renameToOneTie, MvPolynomial.rename_monomial, hw] using hm
  rcases hmatch with hu | hv
  · exact C.original.liveImage (hkill _ hu)
  · exact C.original.liveImage (C.original.equalImage.trans (hkill _ hv))

name: P23.Semigroup.budgetOneNormalizedPresentation
statement:
theorem budgetOneNormalizedPresentation (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup) (i : Fin 4)
    (hB : D.fourBaseBudget i = 1) : Nonempty (BudgetOneNormalizedPresentation D i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p,C,E,hs,hc,hpos⟩ := budgetOne_raw_normalization_data D i hB
  letI := chosenBase_normal_survivorQuotient_finite C E hs
  exact ⟨⟨p,C,E,hs,hc,hpos,normal_survivors_finite _⟩⟩

name: P23.Semigroup.BudgetOneNormalizedPresentation.roots_nonempty
statement: theorem roots_nonempty : B.roots.Nonempty
proof:
:=
  normalSurvivorRoots_nonempty _ _ B.coordinates.liveDomain
    (chosenBase_normal_unit_survives _ _ B.spanEq)

name: P23.Semigroup.BudgetOneNormalizedPresentation.roots_antichain
statement: theorem roots_antichain : IsRootAntichain B.roots
proof: := normalSurvivorRoots_antichain _ _

name: P23.Semigroup.BudgetOneNormalizedPresentation.survivor_iff_standard
statement:
theorem survivor_iff_standard (q : Normal B.coordinates.a B.coordinates.b B.coordinates.c) :
    monomial (k := ℚ) q ∉ normalGeneratorIdeal B.generators ↔ q ∈ standardSet B.roots
proof:
:=
  (normalSurvivorRoots_standardSet_iff _ _ B.coordinates.liveDomain q).symm

name: P23.Semigroup.BudgetOneNormalizedPresentation.roots_live
statement: theorem roots_live : IsLiveTie B.roots
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hx,hy,hz⟩ := chosenBase_normal_variables_survive _ _ B.spanEq
  exact ⟨(B.survivor_iff_standard _).mp hx, (B.survivor_iff_standard _).mp hy,
    (B.survivor_iff_standard _).mp hz,
    (B.survivor_iff_standard _).mp (chosenBase_normal_tie_survives _ _ B.spanEq)⟩

name: P23.Semigroup.BudgetOneNormalizedPresentation.normalized_span
statement:
theorem normalized_span : Ideal.span (↑(normalPresentationFinset B.generators) : Set (ThreePoly ℚ)) =
    renamedChosenBaseIdeal B.coordinates
proof:
:= by
  change Ideal.span (↑(normalizedLiftGeneratorFinset B.coordinates B.rawExponents) : Set (ThreePoly ℚ)) = _
  rw [normalizedLiftGeneratorFinset_span_eq, B.spanEq]

name: P23.Semigroup.BudgetOneNormalizedPresentation.normalized_card
statement:
theorem normalized_card : (normalPresentationFinset B.generators).card = D.semigroupRho ∧
    B.generators.card = D.semigroupRho - 1
proof:
:=
  normalizedGeneratorFinsets_card _ _ B.spanEq B.rawCard B.rhoPos

name: P23.Semigroup.BudgetOneNormalizedPresentation.raw_family_card
statement: theorem raw_family_card : (rawLiftGeneratorFinset B.coordinates B.rawExponents).card = D.semigroupRho
proof:
:= by
  have hlo := (renamedChosenBaseIdeal_minimalGeneratorCard B.coordinates).2 _ B.spanEq
  have hup : (rawLiftGeneratorFinset B.coordinates B.rawExponents).card ≤ B.rawExponents.card + 1 := by
    unfold rawLiftGeneratorFinset
    exact (Finset.card_insert_le _ _).trans (Nat.add_le_add_right Finset.card_image_le 1)
  have hc := B.rawCard
  have hp := B.rhoPos
  omega

name: P23.Semigroup.BudgetOneNormalizedPresentation.tie_ne_raw_monomial
statement:
theorem tie_ne_raw_monomial (d : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) :
    tiePolynomial (k := ℚ) B.coordinates.a B.coordinates.b B.coordinates.c ≠ MvPolynomial.monomial d 1
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have he := congrArg (polyToNormalAlg (k := ℚ) (a := B.coordinates.a)
    (b := B.coordinates.b) (c := B.coordinates.c)) h
  simp only [polyToNormalAlg_tiePolynomial, polyToNormalAlg_monomial, one_smul] at he
  exact normalMonomial_ne_zero _ _ _ _ he.symm

name: P23.Semigroup.BudgetOneNormalizedPresentation.normalized_lift_ne_zero
statement:
theorem normalized_lift_ne_zero (q : Normal B.coordinates.a B.coordinates.b B.coordinates.c) :
    polynomialLift (k := ℚ) q ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have he := congrArg (polyToNormalAlg (k := ℚ) (a := B.coordinates.a)
    (b := B.coordinates.b) (c := B.coordinates.c)) h
  simp only [polyToNormalAlg_polynomialLift, map_zero] at he
  exact normalMonomial_ne_zero _ _ _ _ he

name: P23.Semigroup.BudgetOneNormalizedPresentation.normalization_injective
statement:
theorem normalization_injective : Set.InjOn
    (normalizeExponent B.coordinates.a B.coordinates.b B.coordinates.c) B.rawExponents
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.card_image_iff.mp
  exact B.normalized_card.2.trans B.rawCard.symm

name: P23.Semigroup.BudgetOneNormalizedPresentation.generators_ne_one
statement:
theorem generators_ne_one (q : Normal B.coordinates.a B.coordinates.b B.coordinates.c)
    (hq : q ∈ B.generators) : q ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  intro h; subst q
  exact chosenBase_normal_unit_survives _ _ B.spanEq
    ((monomial_mem_normalGeneratorIdeal_iff _ _).mpr ⟨1,hq,dvd_refl _⟩)

name: P23.Semigroup.BudgetOneNormalizedPresentation.generators_exact_border
statement: theorem generators_exact_border : B.generators = borderFinset B.roots
proof:
:= by
  apply normalGenerators_eq_exact_border _ _ B.coordinates.liveDomain
    (chosenBase_normal_unit_survives _ _ B.spanEq)
  apply normalGenerators_incomparable_of_minimal _ D.semigroupRho
  · rw [B.normalized_span]
    exact renamedChosenBaseIdeal_minimalGeneratorCard B.coordinates
  · exact B.normalized_card.1

name: P23.Semigroup.BudgetOneNormalizedPresentation.border_card
statement: theorem border_card : (borderFinset B.roots).card = D.semigroupRho - 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← B.generators_exact_border]
  exact B.normalized_card.2

name: P23.Semigroup.BudgetOneNormalizedPresentation.canonical_ideal
statement:
theorem canonical_ideal : renamedChosenBaseIdeal B.coordinates =
    finitePresentationIdeal (k := ℚ) B.roots
proof:
:= by
  rw [← B.normalized_span, ← normalGeneratorIdeal_comap, B.generators_exact_border]
  have he : normalGeneratorIdeal (borderFinset B.roots) = borderMonomialIdeal (k := ℚ) B.roots := by
    unfold normalGeneratorIdeal borderMonomialIdeal
    congr 1
    ext f
    simp [borderMonomialSet, eq_comm]
  rw [he, borderMonomialIdeal_comap]

name: P23.Semigroup.repeated_dominant_pf_centre_genus
statement:
theorem repeated_dominant_pf_centre_genus
    (Bi : DominantAperyBase D i) (Bj : DominantAperyBase D j)
    (he : Bi.centerPF=Bj.centerPF) (hij : i≠j) :
    2*D.genus=D.pseudoFrobeniusNat Bi.centerPF+D.semigroupType
proof:
:= by
  have hi := dominant_base_pivot Bi
  have hj := dominant_base_pivot Bj
  rw [←he] at hj
  have hn : D.n i≠D.n j := fun h=>hij (D.injective h)
  have hnz : (D.n i:ℤ)≠(D.n j:ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hp : ((D.n i:ℤ)-(D.n j:ℤ)) *
      (2*(D.genus:ℤ)-Bi.centerPF.1-(D.semigroupType:ℤ))=0 := by nlinarith [hi,hj]
  have hc := (mul_eq_zero.mp hp).resolve_left (sub_ne_zero.mpr hnz)
  have hz : 2*(D.genus:ℤ)=Bi.centerPF.1+(D.semigroupType:ℤ) := by
    linarith
  rw [←D.pseudoFrobeniusNat_cast Bi.centerPF] at hz
  exact_mod_cast hz

name: P23.Semigroup.repeated_dominant_pf_centre_implies_almostSymmetric
statement:
theorem repeated_dominant_pf_centre_implies_almostSymmetric
    (Bi : DominantAperyBase D i) (Bj : DominantAperyBase D j)
    (he : Bi.centerPF=Bj.centerPF) (hij : i≠j) : D.IsAlmostSymmetric
proof:
:= by
  apply D.almostSymmetric_iff_two_genus_eq.mpr
  have hc := repeated_dominant_pf_centre_genus Bi Bj he hij
  have hf := D.pseudoFrobeniusNat_le_frobenius Bi.centerPF
  have hg := D.frobenius_type_le_two_genus
  omega

name: P23.Semigroup.four_dominant_bases_imply_almostSymmetric
statement:
theorem four_dominant_bases_imply_almostSymmetric
    (ht : D.semigroupType=2 ∨ D.semigroupType=3)
    (hall : ∀ i : Fin 4, Nonempty (DominantAperyBase D i)) : D.IsAlmostSymmetric
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let B (i : Fin 4) : DominantAperyBase D i := Classical.choice (hall i)
  let f : Fin 4 → D.PseudoFrobeniusIndex := fun i=>(B i).centerPF
  have hn : ¬Function.Injective f := by
    intro hi
    have hc := Fintype.card_le_of_injective f hi
    change 4≤D.semigroupType at hc
    omega
  have hp : ∃ i j : Fin 4, i≠j ∧ f i=f j := by
    by_contra h
    apply hn
    intro i j he
    by_contra hij
    exact h ⟨i,j,hij,he⟩
  obtain ⟨i,j,hij,he⟩ := hp
  exact repeated_dominant_pf_centre_implies_almostSymmetric (B i) (B j) he hij

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.betti_of_distinct_components

proof:
