name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.lowerToricIdeal_le_globalConnectorSpan
statement:
private theorem lowerToricIdeal_le_globalConnectorSpan
    (d : ℕ)
    (ih : ∀ e < d, ∀ (u v : D.FactorizationAt e),
      D.fiberBinomial (k := k) u v ∈
        Ideal.span (Set.range (D.globalConnectorBinomial (k := k)))) :
    D.lowerToricIdeal (k := k) d ≤
      Ideal.span (Set.range (D.globalConnectorBinomial (k := k)))
proof:
:= by
  unfold lowerToricIdeal
  rw [Ideal.span_le]
  rintro p ⟨e, hed, u, v, rfl⟩
  exact ih e hed u v

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.representativeBinomial_mem_globalConnectorSpan
statement:
private theorem representativeBinomial_mem_globalConnectorSpan
    {d : ℕ} (hd : D.IsBettiDegree d)
    (C E : D.BettiComponent d) :
    D.fiberBinomial (k := k) (D.componentRepresentative C)
        (D.componentRepresentative E) ∈
      Ideal.span (Set.range (D.globalConnectorBinomial (k := k)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hC : C = D.rootComponent hd
  · subst C
    by_cases hE : E = D.rootComponent hd
    · subst E
      simp
    · let e : D.ComponentConnector hd := ⟨E, hE⟩
      apply Ideal.subset_span
      refine ⟨⟨⟨d, hd⟩, e⟩, ?_⟩
      change D.fiberBinomial (k := k)
        (D.componentRepresentative (D.rootComponent hd))
        (D.componentRepresentative E) = _
      rfl
  · by_cases hE : E = D.rootComponent hd
    · subst E
      let e : D.ComponentConnector hd := ⟨C, hC⟩
      have hg : D.globalConnectorBinomial (k := k) ⟨⟨d, hd⟩, e⟩ ∈
          Ideal.span (Set.range (D.globalConnectorBinomial (k := k))) :=
        Ideal.subset_span ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hneg : -D.globalConnectorBinomial (k := k) ⟨⟨d, hd⟩, e⟩ ∈
          Ideal.span (Set.range (D.globalConnectorBinomial (k := k))) := neg_mem hg
      simpa only [globalConnectorBinomial, globalConnectorRelation,
        presentationRelationBinomial, connectorEndpoints, fiberBinomial,
        neg_sub] using hneg
    · let eC : D.ComponentConnector hd := ⟨C, hC⟩
      let eE : D.ComponentConnector hd := ⟨E, hE⟩
      have hGC : D.globalConnectorBinomial (k := k) ⟨⟨d, hd⟩, eC⟩ ∈
          Ideal.span (Set.range (D.globalConnectorBinomial (k := k))) :=
        Ideal.subset_span ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hGE : D.globalConnectorBinomial (k := k) ⟨⟨d, hd⟩, eE⟩ ∈
          Ideal.span (Set.range (D.globalConnectorBinomial (k := k))) :=
        Ideal.subset_span ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hsub := Ideal.sub_mem _ hGE hGC
      have heq :
          D.globalConnectorBinomial (k := k) ⟨⟨d, hd⟩, eE⟩ -
              D.globalConnectorBinomial (k := k) ⟨⟨d, hd⟩, eC⟩ =
            D.fiberBinomial (k := k) (D.componentRepresentative C)
              (D.componentRepresentative E) := by
        change
          (D.fiberMonomial (k := k) (D.componentRepresentative (D.rootComponent hd)) -
              D.fiberMonomial (k := k) (D.componentRepresentative E)) -
            (D.fiberMonomial (k := k) (D.componentRepresentative (D.rootComponent hd)) -
              D.fiberMonomial (k := k) (D.componentRepresentative C)) =
            D.fiberMonomial (k := k) (D.componentRepresentative C) -
              D.fiberMonomial (k := k) (D.componentRepresentative E)
        abel
      rw [← heq]
      exact hsub

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.fiberBinomial_mem_span_globalConnectorBinomials
statement:
theorem fiberBinomial_mem_span_globalConnectorBinomials
    {d : ℕ} (u v : D.FactorizationAt d) :
    D.fiberBinomial (k := k) u v ∈
      Ideal.span (Set.range (D.globalConnectorBinomial (k := k)))
proof:
:= by
  induction d using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h d ih =>
      by_cases hcomp : D.componentOf u = D.componentOf v
      · exact D.lowerToricIdeal_le_globalConnectorSpan d ih
          (D.fiberBinomial_mem_lower_of_sameComponent (k := k) hcomp)
      · let C := D.componentOf u
        let E := D.componentOf v
        have hd : D.IsBettiDegree d := D.betti_of_distinct_components hcomp
        let ru := D.componentRepresentative C
        let rv := D.componentRepresentative E
        have hucomp : D.componentOf u = D.componentOf ru := by
          simp [ru, C, D.componentRepresentative_component]
        have hvcomp : D.componentOf rv = D.componentOf v := by
          simp [rv, E, D.componentRepresentative_component]
        have hu : D.fiberBinomial (k := k) u ru ∈
            Ideal.span (Set.range (D.globalConnectorBinomial (k := k))) :=
          D.lowerToricIdeal_le_globalConnectorSpan d ih
            (D.fiberBinomial_mem_lower_of_sameComponent (k := k) hucomp)
        have hv : D.fiberBinomial (k := k) rv v ∈
            Ideal.span (Set.range (D.globalConnectorBinomial (k := k))) :=
          D.lowerToricIdeal_le_globalConnectorSpan d ih
            (D.fiberBinomial_mem_lower_of_sameComponent (k := k) hvcomp)
        have hm := D.representativeBinomial_mem_globalConnectorSpan
          (k := k) hd C E
        have hadd := Ideal.add_mem _ (Ideal.add_mem _ hu hm) hv
        simpa [ru, rv, fiberBinomial] using hadd

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.toricIdeal_eq_span_globalConnectorBinomials
statement:
theorem toricIdeal_eq_span_globalConnectorBinomials :
    D.toricIdeal (k := k) =
      Ideal.span (Set.range (D.globalConnectorBinomial (k := k)))
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [D.toricIdeal_eq_span_fiberBinomials (k := k), Ideal.span_le]
    rintro p ⟨d, u, v, rfl⟩
    exact D.fiberBinomial_mem_span_globalConnectorBinomials (k := k) u v
  · rw [Ideal.span_le]
    rintro p ⟨g, rfl⟩
    exact D.fiberBinomial_mem_toricIdeal _ _

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.relationOfFiberBinomial_spec
statement:
private theorem relationOfFiberBinomial_spec
    (p : {p : FourPoly ℚ // p ∈ D.fiberBinomialSet (k := ℚ)}) :
    D.presentationRelationBinomial (k := ℚ) (D.relationOfFiberBinomial p) = p.1
proof:
:= by
  change D.fiberBinomial (k := ℚ)
      (Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec p.2))
      (Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec
        (Classical.choose_spec p.2))) = p.1
  exact (Classical.choose_spec
    (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec p.2))).symm

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.exists_finite_semigroupPresentation
statement:
theorem exists_finite_semigroupPresentation :
    ∃ R : Finset (SemigroupPresentationRelation D),
      D.IsSemigroupPresentation (k := ℚ) R
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hfg : (Ideal.span (D.fiberBinomialSet (k := ℚ)) :
      Ideal (FourPoly ℚ)).FG := by
    rw [← D.toricIdeal_eq_span_fiberBinomials (k := ℚ)]
    exact Ideal.FG.of_isNoetherianRing _
  obtain ⟨S, hSsub, hSspan⟩ :=
    (Submodule.fg_span_iff_fg_span_finset_subset
      (D.fiberBinomialSet (k := ℚ))).1 hfg
  let R : Finset (SemigroupPresentationRelation D) :=
    S.attach.image fun p => D.relationOfFiberBinomial
      ⟨p.1, hSsub p.2⟩
  refine ⟨R, ?_⟩
  unfold IsSemigroupPresentation
  rw [D.toricIdeal_eq_span_fiberBinomials (k := ℚ)]
  change Submodule.span (FourPoly ℚ)
      {p | ∃ r ∈ R, p = D.presentationRelationBinomial (k := ℚ) r} =
    Submodule.span (FourPoly ℚ) (D.fiberBinomialSet (k := ℚ))
  rw [hSspan]
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [Ideal.span_le]
    rintro p ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩
    unfold R at hr
    obtain ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hr
    apply Ideal.subset_span
    change D.presentationRelationBinomial (k := ℚ)
        (D.relationOfFiberBinomial ⟨q.1, hSsub q.2⟩) ∈ S
    rw [D.relationOfFiberBinomial_spec]
    exact q.2
  · rw [Ideal.span_le]
    intro p hp
    have hpFiber : p ∈ D.fiberBinomialSet (k := ℚ) := hSsub hp
    let q : {q : FourPoly ℚ // q ∈ D.fiberBinomialSet (k := ℚ)} := ⟨p, hpFiber⟩
    have hr : D.relationOfFiberBinomial q ∈ R := by
      unfold R
      apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
      refine ⟨⟨p, hp⟩, Finset.mem_attach _ _, ?_⟩
      rfl
    apply Submodule.subset_span
    refine ⟨D.relationOfFiberBinomial q, hr, ?_⟩
    exact (D.relationOfFiberBinomial_spec q).symm

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.weightedDegree_pos_of_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem weightedDegree_pos_of_ne_zero
    (w : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) (hw : w ≠ 0) : 0 < D.weightedDegree w
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Finsupp.support_nonempty_iff.mpr hw
  have hwj : 0 < w j := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hj)
  have hterm : 0 < w j * D.n j := Nat.mul_pos hwj (D.positive j)
  have hle : w j * D.n j ≤ ∑ i : Fin 4, w i * D.n i :=
    Finset.single_le_sum (s := Finset.univ) (f := fun i => w i * D.n i)
      (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ j)
  change 0 < ∑ i : Fin 4, w i * D.n i
  exact lt_of_lt_of_le hterm hle

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.degreeComponentCoeffVector_mul_relation_of_lt
statement:
theorem degreeComponentCoeffVector_mul_relation_of_lt
    (d : ℕ) (r : SemigroupPresentationRelation D) (p : FourPoly k)
    (h : r.degree < d) :
    D.degreeComponentCoeffVector (k := k) d
        (p * D.presentationRelationBinomial (k := k) r) = 0
proof:
:=
  D.degreeComponentCoeffVector_mul_fiberBinomial h r.left r.right p

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.degreeComponentCoeffVector_monomial_mul_relation_of_gt
statement:
private theorem degreeComponentCoeffVector_monomial_mul_relation_of_gt
    (d : ℕ) (r : SemigroupPresentationRelation D)
    (h : d < r.degree) (w : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) (c : k) :
    D.degreeComponentCoeffVector (k := k) d
        (MvPolynomial.monomial w c *
          D.presentationRelationBinomial (k := k) r) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hleft : D.weightedDegree (w + r.left.1) ≠ d := by
    change weightedDegreeOf D.n (w + r.left.1) ≠ d
    rw [weightedDegreeOf_add]
    have hdeg := D.factorizationAt_degree r.left
    change weightedDegreeOf D.n r.left.1 = r.degree at hdeg
    rw [hdeg]
    omega
  have hright : D.weightedDegree (w + r.right.1) ≠ d := by
    change weightedDegreeOf D.n (w + r.right.1) ≠ d
    rw [weightedDegreeOf_add]
    have hdeg := D.factorizationAt_degree r.right
    change weightedDegreeOf D.n r.right.1 = r.degree at hdeg
    rw [hdeg]
    omega
  have hpoly : MvPolynomial.monomial w c *
        D.presentationRelationBinomial (k := k) r =
      MvPolynomial.monomial (w + r.left.1) c -
        MvPolynomial.monomial (w + r.right.1) c := by
    simp [presentationRelationBinomial, fiberBinomial, fiberMonomial, mul_sub,
      MvPolynomial.monomial_mul]
  rw [hpoly, map_sub,
    D.degreeComponentCoeffVector_monomial_of_degree_ne d _ _ hleft,
    D.degreeComponentCoeffVector_monomial_of_degree_ne d _ _ hright,
    sub_zero]

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.degreeComponentCoeffVector_mul_relation_of_gt
statement:
theorem degreeComponentCoeffVector_mul_relation_of_gt
    (d : ℕ) (r : SemigroupPresentationRelation D) (p : FourPoly k)
    (h : d < r.degree) :
    D.degreeComponentCoeffVector (k := k) d
        (p * D.presentationRelationBinomial (k := k) r) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  conv_lhs => rw [MvPolynomial.as_sum p]
  simp only [Finset.sum_mul, map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro w _
  exact D.degreeComponentCoeffVector_monomial_mul_relation_of_gt d r h w _

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.degreeComponentCoeffVector_monomial_mul_relation_of_eq
statement:
private theorem degreeComponentCoeffVector_monomial_mul_relation_of_eq
    (r : SemigroupPresentationRelation D) (w : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) (c : k) :
    D.degreeComponentCoeffVector (k := k) r.degree
        (MvPolynomial.monomial w c *
          D.presentationRelationBinomial (k := k) r) =
      (if w = 0 then c else 0) •
        D.componentDelta (k := k) r.left r.right
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hw : w = 0
  · subst w
    simp only [if_pos, MvPolynomial.monomial_zero']
    have hpoly : MvPolynomial.C c *
          D.presentationRelationBinomial (k := k) r =
        c • D.fiberBinomial (k := k) r.left r.right := by
      simp [presentationRelationBinomial, Algebra.smul_def]
    rw [hpoly]
    rw [← D.fiberPolynomial_fiberDelta r.left r.right, map_smul,
      D.degreeComponentCoeffVector_fiberPolynomial]
    have hcomp : D.componentCoeff (k := k) r.degree
          (D.fiberDelta (k := k) r.left r.right) =
        D.componentDelta (k := k) r.left r.right :=
      congrArg Subtype.val
        (D.fiberToComponentRelation_fiberDelta (k := k) r.left r.right)
    rw [hcomp]
  · have hpos := D.weightedDegree_pos_of_ne_zero w hw
    change 0 < weightedDegreeOf D.n w at hpos
    have hleft : D.weightedDegree (w + r.left.1) ≠ r.degree := by
      change weightedDegreeOf D.n (w + r.left.1) ≠ r.degree
      rw [weightedDegreeOf_add]
      have hdeg := D.factorizationAt_degree r.left
      change weightedDegreeOf D.n r.left.1 = r.degree at hdeg
      rw [hdeg]
      omega
    have hright : D.weightedDegree (w + r.right.1) ≠ r.degree := by
      change weightedDegreeOf D.n (w + r.right.1) ≠ r.degree
      rw [weightedDegreeOf_add]
      have hdeg := D.factorizationAt_degree r.right
      change weightedDegreeOf D.n r.right.1 = r.degree at hdeg
      rw [hdeg]
      omega
    have hpoly : MvPolynomial.monomial w c *
          D.presentationRelationBinomial (k := k) r =
        MvPolynomial.monomial (w + r.left.1) c -
          MvPolynomial.monomial (w + r.right.1) c := by
      simp [presentationRelationBinomial, fiberBinomial, fiberMonomial, mul_sub,
        MvPolynomial.monomial_mul]
    rw [hpoly, map_sub,
      D.degreeComponentCoeffVector_monomial_of_degree_ne _ _ _ hleft,
      D.degreeComponentCoeffVector_monomial_of_degree_ne _ _ _ hright,
      sub_zero, if_neg hw, zero_smul]

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.degreeComponentCoeffVector_mul_relation_of_eq
statement:
theorem degreeComponentCoeffVector_mul_relation_of_eq
    (d : ℕ) (r : SemigroupPresentationRelation D) (p : FourPoly k)
    (h : r.degree = d) :
    D.degreeComponentCoeffVector (k := k) d
        (p * D.presentationRelationBinomial (k := k) r) =
      relationMultiplierConstantCoeff p •
        D.relationComponentDeltaAt (k := k) d r h
proof:
:= by
  subst d
  classical
  conv_lhs => rw [MvPolynomial.as_sum p]
  simp only [Finset.sum_mul, map_sum,
    D.degreeComponentCoeffVector_monomial_mul_relation_of_eq]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single 0]
  · simp [relationMultiplierConstantCoeff, MvPolynomial.constantCoeff_eq,
      relationComponentDeltaAt]
  · intro b hb hb0
    simp [hb0]
  · intro h0
    have hc0 : MvPolynomial.coeff 0 p = 0 := by
      simpa [MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff] using h0
    simp [hc0, relationMultiplierConstantCoeff, MvPolynomial.constantCoeff_eq]

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.mem_relationsAtDegree
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_relationsAtDegree
    {R : Finset (SemigroupPresentationRelation D)} {d : ℕ}
    {r : SemigroupPresentationRelation D} :
    r ∈ D.relationsAtDegree R d ↔ r ∈ R ∧ r.degree = d
proof:
:= by
  simp [relationsAtDegree]

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.relationComponentDeltaAt_mem_componentVectorFinset
statement:
private theorem relationComponentDeltaAt_mem_componentVectorFinset
    {R : Finset (SemigroupPresentationRelation D)} {d : ℕ}
    {r : SemigroupPresentationRelation D} (hr : r ∈ R)
    (h : r.degree = d) :
    D.relationComponentDeltaAt (k := k) d r h ∈
      D.relationsAtDegreeComponentVectorFinset (k := k) R d
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold relationsAtDegreeComponentVectorFinset relationsAtDegreeFiberFinset
  apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
  let rr : {s // s ∈ D.relationsAtDegree R d} :=
    ⟨r, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hr, h⟩⟩
  refine ⟨D.relationFiberAtDegree (k := k) d r h, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
    refine ⟨rr, Finset.mem_attach _ _, ?_⟩
    rfl
  · subst d
    exact congrArg Subtype.val
      (D.fiberToComponentRelation_fiberDelta (k := k) r.left r.right)

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.detector_mem_span_componentVectors_of_mem_presentationIdeal
statement:
private theorem detector_mem_span_componentVectors_of_mem_presentationIdeal
    (R : Finset (SemigroupPresentationRelation D)) (d : ℕ)
    (p : FourPoly k) (hp : p ∈ D.presentationIdeal (k := k) R) :
    D.degreeComponentCoeffVector (k := k) d p ∈
      Submodule.span k
        (D.relationsAtDegreeComponentVectorFinset (k := k) R d :
          Set (D.BettiComponent d → k))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold presentationIdeal at hp
  have hall : ∀ q : FourPoly k,
      D.degreeComponentCoeffVector (k := k) d (q * p) ∈
        Submodule.span k
          (D.relationsAtDegreeComponentVectorFinset (k := k) R d :
            Set (D.BettiComponent d → k)) := by
    refine Submodule.span_induction
      (p := fun x (_hx : x ∈ Submodule.span (FourPoly k)
        {p | ∃ r ∈ R, p = D.presentationRelationBinomial (k := k) r}) =>
        ∀ q : FourPoly k,
          D.degreeComponentCoeffVector (k := k) d (q * x) ∈
            Submodule.span k
              (D.relationsAtDegreeComponentVectorFinset (k := k) R d :
                Set (D.BettiComponent d → k))) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hp
    · intro x hx
      rcases hx with ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩
      intro q
      rcases lt_trichotomy r.degree d with hlt | heq | hgt
      · rw [D.degreeComponentCoeffVector_mul_relation_of_lt d r q hlt]
        exact Submodule.zero_mem _
      · rw [D.degreeComponentCoeffVector_mul_relation_of_eq d r q heq]
        exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _
          (Submodule.subset_span
            (D.relationComponentDeltaAt_mem_componentVectorFinset hr heq))
      · rw [D.degreeComponentCoeffVector_mul_relation_of_gt d r q hgt]
        exact Submodule.zero_mem _
    · intro q
      simpa using (Submodule.zero_mem
        (Submodule.span k
          (D.relationsAtDegreeComponentVectorFinset (k := k) R d :
            Set (D.BettiComponent d → k))))
    · intro x y hx hy ihx ihy q
      rw [mul_add, map_add]
      exact Submodule.add_mem _ (ihx q) (ihy q)
    · intro a x hx ih q
      simpa [smul_eq_mul, mul_assoc] using ih (q * a)
  simpa using hall 1

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.componentVectorFinset_eq_image
statement:
private theorem componentVectorFinset_eq_image
    (R : Finset (SemigroupPresentationRelation D)) (d : ℕ) :
    (D.relationsAtDegreeComponentVectorFinset (k := k) R d :
        Set (D.BettiComponent d → k)) =
      (fun a : D.FiberRelationSpace k d =>
        D.fiberToComponentVector (k := k) d a) ''
        (D.relationsAtDegreeFiberFinset (k := k) R d :
          Set (D.FiberRelationSpace k d))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext z
  simp [relationsAtDegreeComponentVectorFinset]

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.relationsAtDegree_span_actualDegreeNew
statement:
theorem relationsAtDegree_span_actualDegreeNew
    (R : Finset (SemigroupPresentationRelation D))
    (hR : D.IsSemigroupPresentation (k := k) R) (d : ℕ) :
    D.GeneratesActualDegreeNewRelations (k := k)
      (D.relationsAtDegreeFiberFinset (k := k) R d)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← D.generatesDegreeDModuloLower_iff_actual]
  intro a
  have hpT : D.fiberPolynomial (k := k) d a.1 ∈ D.toricIdeal (k := k) :=
    (D.fiberPolynomial_mem_toricIdeal_iff d a.1).2 a.2
  have hpP : D.fiberPolynomial (k := k) d a.1 ∈
      D.presentationIdeal (k := k) R := by
    rw [hR]
    exact hpT
  have hdet := D.detector_mem_span_componentVectors_of_mem_presentationIdeal
    R d (D.fiberPolynomial (k := k) d a.1) hpP
  rw [D.degreeComponentCoeffVector_fiberPolynomial,
    D.componentVectorFinset_eq_image] at hdet
  change D.fiberToComponentVector (k := k) d a ∈ _ at hdet
  rw [← LinearMap.map_span] at hdet
  rcases hdet with ⟨b, hb, hab⟩
  refine ⟨b, hb, ?_⟩
  apply (D.fiberPolynomial_mem_lower_iff_componentKernel (k := k) (a - b)).2
  change D.fiberToComponentRelation (k := k) d (a - b) = 0
  rw [map_sub]
  apply sub_eq_zero.mpr
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact hab.symm

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.globalPresentation_degree_card_lower_bound
statement:
theorem globalPresentation_degree_card_lower_bound
    (R : Finset (SemigroupPresentationRelation D))
    (hR : D.IsSemigroupPresentation (k := k) R)
    {d : ℕ} (hd : D.IsBettiDegree d) :
    D.bettiContribution d ≤ (D.relationsAtDegree R d).card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hlocal := D.actualDegreeToricRelation_generator_card_lower_bound
    (k := k) hd (D.relationsAtDegreeFiberFinset (k := k) R d)
    (D.relationsAtDegree_span_actualDegreeNew R hR d)
  refine hlocal.trans ?_
  unfold relationsAtDegreeFiberFinset
  calc
    ((D.relationsAtDegree R d).attach.image fun
        (r : {s // s ∈ D.relationsAtDegree R d}) =>
      D.relationFiberAtDegree (k := k) d r.1
        ((D.mem_relationsAtDegree.mp r.2).2)).card ≤
        (D.relationsAtDegree R d).attach.card := Finset.card_image_le
    _ = (D.relationsAtDegree R d).card := Finset.card_attach

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.finitePresentation_isPresentation
statement:
private theorem finitePresentation_isPresentation :
    D.IsSemigroupPresentation (k := ℚ) D.finitePresentation
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec D.exists_finite_semigroupPresentation

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.relationsAtDegree_finitePresentation_nonempty
statement:
private theorem relationsAtDegree_finitePresentation_nonempty
    (d : D.BettiDegreeIndex) :
    (D.relationsAtDegree D.finitePresentation d.1).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty]
  intro hempty
  have hlower := D.globalPresentation_degree_card_lower_bound
    D.finitePresentation D.finitePresentation_isPresentation d.2
  rw [hempty] at hlower
  simp only [Finset.card_empty] at hlower
  exact (Nat.not_succ_le_zero 0)
    ((D.bettiContribution_pos d.2).trans_le hlower)

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.bettiWitnessRelation_mem
statement:
private theorem bettiWitnessRelation_mem (d : D.BettiDegreeIndex) :
    D.bettiWitnessRelation d ∈ D.relationsAtDegree D.finitePresentation d.1
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec (D.relationsAtDegree_finitePresentation_nonempty d)

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.bettiWitnessRelation_degree
statement:
@[simp] private theorem bettiWitnessRelation_degree (d : D.BettiDegreeIndex) :
    (D.bettiWitnessRelation d).degree = d.1
proof:
:=
  (D.mem_relationsAtDegree.mp (D.bettiWitnessRelation_mem d)).2

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.finite_bettiDegrees
statement: theorem finite_bettiDegrees : Finite D.BettiDegreeIndex
proof:
:= by
  apply Finite.of_injective D.bettiWitnessInPresentation
  intro d e h
  apply Subtype.ext
  have hr : D.bettiWitnessRelation d = D.bettiWitnessRelation e :=
    congrArg Subtype.val h
  calc
    d.1 = (D.bettiWitnessRelation d).degree :=
      (D.bettiWitnessRelation_degree d).symm
    _ = (D.bettiWitnessRelation e).degree := congrArg (·.degree) hr
    _ = e.1 := D.bettiWitnessRelation_degree e

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.globalConnectorRelation_injective
statement:
private theorem globalConnectorRelation_injective :
    Function.Injective D.globalConnectorRelation
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rintro ⟨gd, gc⟩ ⟨hd, hc⟩ heq
  have hdeg : gd.1 = hd.1 := congrArg (fun r => r.degree) heq
  have htag : gd = hd := Subtype.ext hdeg
  subst hd
  have hrightVal :
      (D.connectorEndpoints gd.2 gc).2.1 =
        (D.connectorEndpoints gd.2 hc).2.1 :=
    congrArg (fun r => r.right.1) heq
  have hright :
      (D.connectorEndpoints gd.2 gc).2 =
        (D.connectorEndpoints gd.2 hc).2 :=
    Subtype.ext hrightVal
  congr 1
  apply Subtype.ext
  have hc := congrArg D.componentOf hright
  simpa [D.connectorEndpoints_components] using hc

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.globalConnectorFinset_isPresentation
statement:
theorem globalConnectorFinset_isPresentation :
    D.IsSemigroupPresentation (k := k) D.globalConnectorFinset
proof:
:= by
  unfold IsSemigroupPresentation presentationIdeal globalConnectorFinset
  rw [D.toricIdeal_eq_span_globalConnectorBinomials (k := k)]
  congr 1
  ext p
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨g, -, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hr
    exact ⟨g, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨g, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨D.globalConnectorRelation g, ?_, rfl⟩
    exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨g, Finset.mem_univ g, rfl⟩

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.globalConnectorFinset_card
statement:
theorem globalConnectorFinset_card :
    D.globalConnectorFinset.card =
      ∑ d : D.BettiDegreeIndex, D.bettiContribution d.1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold globalConnectorFinset
  rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ D.globalConnectorRelation_injective]
  change Fintype.card D.GlobalConnector = _
  rw [Fintype.card_sigma]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro d _
  exact D.degreeToricRelation_connector_card_exact d.2

name: P23.Semigroup.ResidualTop.residual_roots_exact
statement:
theorem residual_roots_exact : R.residual.roots =
    {residualRootX R,residualRootY R,residualRootZ R}
proof:
:=
  pureResidual_roots_exact R.residual.residual R.residual.nonempty R.residual.antichain

name: P23.Semigroup.ResidualTop.residualRoot_mem
statement: theorem residualRoot_mem (j : Fin 3) : rootByResidualAxis R j ∈ R.residual.roots
proof:
:= by
  rw [residual_roots_exact]
  fin_cases j <;> simp [rootByResidualAxis]

name: P23.Semigroup.ResidualTop.residualRoot_distinct
statement:
theorem residualRoot_distinct : residualRootX R ≠ residualRootY R ∧
    residualRootX R ≠ residualRootZ R ∧ residualRootY R ≠ residualRootZ R
proof:
:= by
  have ha := R.residual.a'_ge_two
  have hu := R.residual.residual.u_pos
  have hb := R.residual.b'_ge_two
  constructor
  · intro h; have := congrArg Normal.x h; dsimp [residualRootX,residualRootY] at this; omega
  · constructor
    · intro h; have := congrArg Normal.x h; dsimp [residualRootX,residualRootZ] at this; omega
    · intro h; have := congrArg Normal.y h; dsimp [residualRootY,residualRootZ] at this; omega

name: P23.Semigroup.ResidualTop.residualRoot_mul_not_standard
statement:
theorem residualRoot_mul_not_standard (j l : Fin 3) :
    rootByResidualAxis R j * coordinateGenerator l ∉ standardSet R.residual.roots
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨s,hs,hdiv⟩
  have hr := residualRoot_mem R j
  have hd : rootByResidualAxis R j ∣ s := dvd_trans (dvd_mul_right _ _) hdiv
  have he : rootByResidualAxis R j = s := by
    by_contra hn
    exact R.residual.antichain _ hr s hs hn hd
  obtain ⟨q,hq⟩ := hdiv
  have hdeg := congrArg (residualDegree R) hq
  rw [residualDegree_mul,residualDegree_mul,residualDegree_coordinateGenerator,←he] at hdeg
  have hp := D.tailGen_positive i (residualToTail R l)
  omega

name: P23.Semigroup.ResidualTop.residualRoot_top_equation
statement:
theorem residualRoot_top_equation (j : Fin 3) :
    residualTopDegree R = residualDegree R (rootByResidualAxis R j) +
      D.tailGen i (residualToTail R j)
proof:
:= by
  have hh := pureResidual_top_equations R.residual.residual
    (D.tailGen i (residualToTail R 0)) (D.tailGen i (residualToTail R 1))
    (D.tailGen i (residualToTail R 2)) (residual_weighted_tie R)
  fin_cases j <;> simp only [rootByResidualAxis, Fin.reduceEq, ite_true, ite_false,
    residualDegree_formula] <;>
    dsimp [residualRootX,residualRootY,residualRootZ,residualTopDegree] <;>
    (try simp only [zero_mul,zero_add]) <;>
    first | exact hh.1.symm | exact hh.2.1.symm | exact hh.2.2.symm

name: P23.Semigroup.ResidualTop.residualAperySocle_top_equation
statement:
theorem residualAperySocle_top_equation (j : Fin 3) :
    residualTopDegree R = aperySocleDegree D i (residualAperySocleIndex R j) + D.tailGen i j
proof:
:= by
  have hh := residualRoot_top_equation R (tailToResidual R j)
  simpa [tailToResidual,residualAperySocleIndex,aperySocleDegree,
    ResidualDegree.residualDegree,tailDegreeGamma] using hh

name: P23.Semigroup.ResidualTop.residualAperySocleIndex_injective
statement: theorem residualAperySocleIndex_injective : Function.Injective (residualAperySocleIndex R)
proof:
:= by
  intro j l he
  have hd := congrArg (aperySocleDegree D i) he
  have hj := residualAperySocle_top_equation R j
  have hl := residualAperySocle_top_equation R l
  apply D.tailGen_injective i
  omega

name: P23.Semigroup.T_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem T_zero : T (k := k) D 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [AddMonoidAlgebra.one_def]
  rfl

name: P23.Semigroup.T_add
statement:
@[simp] theorem T_add (s t : D.Gamma) :
    T (k := k) D s * T (k := k) D t = T (k := k) D (s + t)
proof:
:= by
  simp [T, AddMonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single]

name: P23.Semigroup.AperyArtin.ext
statement: @[ext] theorem ext {x y : AperyArtin k D i} (h : x.coeff = y.coeff) : x = y
proof:
:=
  (coeffEquiv (k := k) (D := D) (i := i)).injective h

name: P23.Semigroup.AperyArtin.coeff_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem coeff_zero : coeff (0 : AperyArtin k D i) = 0
proof: := rfl

name: P23.Semigroup.AperyArtin.coeff_add
statement: @[simp] theorem coeff_add (x y : AperyArtin k D i) : coeff (x + y) = coeff x + coeff y
proof: := rfl

name: P23.Semigroup.AperyArtin.coeff_neg
statement: @[simp] theorem coeff_neg (x : AperyArtin k D i) : coeff (-x) = -coeff x
proof: := rfl

name: P23.Semigroup.AperyArtin.coeff_smul
statement: @[simp] theorem coeff_smul (r : k) (x : AperyArtin k D i) : coeff (r • x) = r • coeff x
proof: := rfl

name: P23.Semigroup.AperyArtin.induction_linear
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem induction_linear {P : AperyArtin k D i → Prop} (x : AperyArtin k D i)
    (zero : P 0) (add : ∀ x y, P x → P y → P (x + y))
    (single : ∀ p r, P (.mk (Finsupp.single p r))) : P x
proof:
:= by
  change P (.mk x.coeff)
  induction x.coeff using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => exact zero
  | add x y hx hy => exact add (.mk x) (.mk y) hx hy
  | single p r => exact single p r

name: P23.Semigroup.AperyArtin.coeff_A
statement:
@[simp] theorem coeff_A (s : D.Gamma) (hs : D.IsApery i s) (t : D.AperyIndex i) :
    (A (k := k) s hs).coeff t = if t.1 = s then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change (Finsupp.single ⟨s, hs⟩ 1) t = if t.1 = s then 1 else 0
  by_cases h : t.1 = s
  · have heq : t = (⟨s, hs⟩ : D.AperyIndex i) := Subtype.ext h
    simp [h, heq, Finsupp.single_apply]
  · have hne : t ≠ (⟨s, hs⟩ : D.AperyIndex i) := fun heq => h (congrArg Subtype.val heq)
    simp [h, hne, Finsupp.single_apply]

name: P23.Semigroup.AperyArtin.smul_A
statement:
@[simp] theorem smul_A (r : k) (s : D.Gamma) (hs : D.IsApery i s) :
    r • A (k := k) s hs = .mk (Finsupp.single ⟨s, hs⟩ r)
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp [A, Finsupp.single_apply]

name: P23.Semigroup.AperyArtin.isApery_of_add_left
statement:
theorem isApery_of_add_left {s t : D.Gamma} (h : D.IsApery i (s + t)) :
    D.IsApery i s
proof:
:= by
  intro hs
  rcases hs with ⟨u, hu⟩
  apply h
  refine ⟨u + t, ?_⟩
  rw [hu, add_assoc]

name: P23.Semigroup.AperyArtin.isApery_of_add_right
statement:
theorem isApery_of_add_right {s t : D.Gamma} (h : D.IsApery i (s + t)) :
    D.IsApery i t
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_comm] at h
  exact isApery_of_add_left h

name: P23.Semigroup.AperyArtin.mul_def
statement:
theorem mul_def (x y : AperyArtin k D i) :
    x * y = x.coeff.sum fun s rs => y.coeff.sum fun t rt =>
      (rs * rt) • basisProduct (k := k) s t
proof: := rfl

name: P23.Semigroup.AperyArtin.A_mul_A
statement:
@[simp] theorem A_mul_A (s t : D.Gamma) (hs : D.IsApery i s) (ht : D.IsApery i t) :
    A (k := k) s hs * A (k := k) t ht =
      if h : D.IsApery i (s + t) then A (k := k) (s + t) h else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [mul_def, A, basisProduct]

name: P23.Semigroup.AperyArtin.smul_mul_raw
statement: theorem smul_mul_raw (r : k) (x y : AperyArtin k D i) : (r • x) * y = r • (x * y)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [mul_def, coeff_smul]
  rw [Finsupp.sum_smul_index (h0 := by simp), Finsupp.smul_sum]
  apply Finsupp.sum_congr
  intro p _
  rw [Finsupp.smul_sum]
  apply Finsupp.sum_congr
  intro q _
  rw [smul_smul]
  congr 1
  ring

name: P23.Semigroup.AperyArtin.mul_smul_raw
statement: theorem mul_smul_raw (r : k) (x y : AperyArtin k D i) : x * (r • y) = r • (x * y)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [mul_def, coeff_smul]
  rw [Finsupp.smul_sum]
  apply Finsupp.sum_congr
  intro p _
  rw [Finsupp.sum_smul_index (h0 := by simp), Finsupp.smul_sum]
  apply Finsupp.sum_congr
  intro q _
  rw [smul_smul]
  congr 1
  ring

name: P23.Semigroup.AperyArtin.A_assoc
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases htotal : D.IsApery i ((s.1 + t.1) + u.1)
  · have hst := isApery_of_add_left htotal
    have htu : D.IsApery i (t.1 + u.1) := by
      apply isApery_of_add_right (s := s.1)
      simpa [add_assoc] using htotal
    simp [A_mul_A, hst, htu, htotal, add_assoc]
  · have htotal' : ¬ D.IsApery i (s.1 + (t.1 + u.1)) := by simpa [add_assoc] using htotal
    by_cases hst : D.IsApery i (s.1 + t.1) <;>
      by_cases htu : D.IsApery i (t.1 + u.1) <;>
      simp [A_mul_A, hst, htu, htotal, htotal', add_assoc]

name: P23.Semigroup.AperyArtin.A_comm
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [A_mul_A, add_comm]

name: P23.Semigroup.AperyArtin.one_mul_A
statement:
private theorem one_mul_A (s : D.AperyIndex i) :
    (1 : AperyArtin k D i) * A (k := k) s.1 s.2 = A (k := k) s.1 s.2
proof:
:= by
  change A (k := k) 0 (D.zero_isApery i) * A (k := k) s.1 s.2 = _
  rw [A_mul_A]
  simp only [zero_add, dif_pos s.2]

name: P23.Semigroup.AperyArtin.A_mul_one
statement:
private theorem A_mul_one (s : D.AperyIndex i) :
    A (k := k) s.1 s.2 * (1 : AperyArtin k D i) = A (k := k) s.1 s.2
proof:
:= by
  change A (k := k) s.1 s.2 * A (k := k) 0 (D.zero_isApery i) = _
  calc
    _ = A (k := k) 0 (D.zero_isApery i) * A (k := k) s.1 s.2 :=
      A_comm (k := k) s ⟨0, D.zero_isApery i⟩
    _ = _ := one_mul_A (k := k) s

name: P23.Semigroup.truncatedAperyMonomial_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem truncatedAperyMonomial_zero :
    truncatedAperyMonomial (k := k) D i 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change (if hs : D.IsApery i 0 then A (k := k) 0 hs else 0) =
    A (k := k) 0 (D.zero_isApery i)
  simp only [dif_pos (D.zero_isApery i)]

name: P23.Semigroup.truncatedAperyMonomial_add
statement:
@[simp] theorem truncatedAperyMonomial_add (s t : D.Gamma) :
    truncatedAperyMonomial (k := k) D i (s + t) =
      truncatedAperyMonomial (k := k) D i s * truncatedAperyMonomial (k := k) D i t
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hst : D.IsApery i (s + t)
  · have hs := AperyArtin.isApery_of_add_left hst
    have ht := AperyArtin.isApery_of_add_right hst
    simp [truncatedAperyMonomial, hst, hs, ht, A_mul_A]
  · by_cases hs : D.IsApery i s <;> by_cases ht : D.IsApery i t <;>
      simp [truncatedAperyMonomial, hst, hs, ht, A_mul_A]

name: P23.Semigroup.semigroupToAperyAlg_single
statement:
@[simp] theorem semigroupToAperyAlg_single (s : D.Gamma) (r : k) :
    semigroupToAperyAlg (k := k) D i (AddMonoidAlgebra.single s r) =
      r • truncatedAperyMonomial (k := k) D i s
proof:
:= by
  exact AddMonoidAlgebra.lift_single _ _ _

name: P23.Semigroup.semigroupToAperyAlg_T
statement:
@[simp] theorem semigroupToAperyAlg_T (s : D.Gamma) :
    semigroupToAperyAlg (k := k) D i (T (k := k) D s) =
      truncatedAperyMonomial (k := k) D i s
proof: := by simp [T]

name: P23.Semigroup.semigroupToAperyAlg_surjective
statement:
theorem semigroupToAperyAlg_surjective :
    Function.Surjective (semigroupToAperyAlg (k := k) D i)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  induction x using AperyArtin.induction_linear with
  | zero => exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
  | add x y hx hy =>
      rcases hx with ⟨fx, rfl⟩
      rcases hy with ⟨fy, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨fx + fy, by simp⟩
  | single s r =>
      refine ⟨AddMonoidAlgebra.single s.1 r, ?_⟩
      simp [truncatedAperyMonomial, s.2, AperyArtin.smul_A]

name: P23.Semigroup.coeff_semigroupToAperyAlg
statement:
theorem coeff_semigroupToAperyAlg (f : SemigroupAlgebra (k := k) D)
    (s : D.AperyIndex i) :
    (semigroupToAperyAlg (k := k) D i f).coeff s = f.coeff s.1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction f using AddMonoidAlgebra.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add f g hf hg => simp [hf, hg]
  | single t r =>
      by_cases ht : D.IsApery i t
      · by_cases hts : t = s.1
        · subst t; simp [truncatedAperyMonomial, ht]
        · have hne : (⟨t, ht⟩ : D.AperyIndex i) ≠ s := fun h => hts (congrArg Subtype.val h)
          simp [truncatedAperyMonomial, ht, hts, hne]
      · have hne : t ≠ s.1 := fun h => ht (h ▸ s.2)
        simp [truncatedAperyMonomial, ht, Finsupp.single_apply, hne]

name: P23.Semigroup.T_mem_baseMonomialIdeal
statement:
theorem T_mem_baseMonomialIdeal (s : D.Gamma) (hs : ¬ D.IsApery i s) :
    T (k := k) D s ∈ baseMonomialIdeal (k := k) D i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases not_not.mp hs with ⟨h, rfl⟩
  have hb : T (k := k) D (D.base i) ∈ baseMonomialIdeal (k := k) D i := by
    apply Ideal.subset_span
    simp
  rw [← T_add]
  exact (baseMonomialIdeal (k := k) D i).mul_mem_right (T (k := k) D h) hb

name: P23.Semigroup.baseMonomialIdeal_le_ker
statement:
theorem baseMonomialIdeal_le_ker :
    baseMonomialIdeal (k := k) D i ≤ RingHom.ker (semigroupToAperyAlg (k := k) D i).toRingHom
proof:
:= by
  apply Ideal.span_le.2
  intro f hf
  simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hf
  subst f
  apply RingHom.mem_ker.2
  simp [truncatedAperyMonomial, D.base_not_isApery i]

name: P23.Semigroup.ker_le_baseMonomialIdeal
statement:
theorem ker_le_baseMonomialIdeal :
    RingHom.ker (semigroupToAperyAlg (k := k) D i).toRingHom ≤ baseMonomialIdeal (k := k) D i
proof:
:= by
  intro f hf
  have hf0 : semigroupToAperyAlg (k := k) D i f = 0 := RingHom.mem_ker.1 hf
  rw [← AddMonoidAlgebra.sum_coeff_single f]
  apply Submodule.sum_mem
  intro s hsupp
  by_cases hs : D.IsApery i s
  · have hc := congrArg (fun x : AperyArtin k D i => x.coeff ⟨s, hs⟩) hf0
    have hz : f.coeff s = 0 := by simpa [coeff_semigroupToAperyAlg] using hc
    simp [hz]
  · have hm := T_mem_baseMonomialIdeal (k := k) D i s hs
    have hsmul := (baseMonomialIdeal (k := k) D i).mul_mem_left
      (algebraMap k (SemigroupAlgebra (k := k) D) (f.coeff s)) hm
    simpa [T, Algebra.smul_def] using hsmul

name: P23.Semigroup.semigroupToAperyAlg_ker
statement:
theorem semigroupToAperyAlg_ker :
    RingHom.ker (semigroupToAperyAlg (k := k) D i).toRingHom =
      baseMonomialIdeal (k := k) D i
proof:
:= by
  exact le_antisymm (ker_le_baseMonomialIdeal (k := k) D i)
    (baseMonomialIdeal_le_ker (k := k) D i)

name: P23.Semigroup.chosenBaseEquivApery_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem chosenBaseEquivApery_mk (f : SemigroupAlgebra (k := k) D) :
    chosenBaseEquivApery (k := k) D i
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (baseMonomialIdeal (k := k) D i) f) =
      semigroupToAperyAlg (k := k) D i f
proof: := by rfl

name: P23.Semigroup.type_three_ng_semigroupRho_ge_six
statement:
theorem type_three_ng_semigroupRho_ge_six (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup)
    (ht : D.semigroupType = 3) (hn : SemigroupNearlyGorenstein D) :
    6 ≤ D.semigroupRho
proof:
:= by
  have h4 := type_three_semigroupRho_ge_four D ht
  have hn4 := type_three_ng_semigroupRho_ne_four D ht hn
  have hn5 := type_three_ng_semigroupRho_ne_five D ht hn
  omega

name: P23.Semigroup.typeThreeLowerBound
statement:
theorem typeThreeLowerBound (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup) : TypeThreeLowerBound D where
  baseline
proof:
:= smallPresentationBaseline D
  typeThreeNgRhoNotFour := type_three_ng_semigroupRho_ne_four D
  typeThreeNgRhoNotFive := type_three_ng_semigroupRho_ne_five D
  typeThreeNgRhoSix := type_three_ng_semigroupRho_ge_six D

name: P23.Semigroup.chosenBase_plainSurvivors_finite
statement:
theorem chosenBase_plainSurvivors_finite (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup) (i : Fin 4)
    (G : Finset PlainExp) (hI : plainMonomialIdeal ℚ G = chosenBaseDefiningIdeal D i) :
    (plainSurvivors ℚ G).Finite
proof:
:= by
  letI : Module.Finite ℚ (ChosenBaseQuotient (k := ℚ) D i) :=
    (chosenBaseEquivApery (k := ℚ) D i).symm.toLinearEquiv.finiteDimensional
  letI : Module.Finite ℚ (TailPoly ℚ ⧸ plainMonomialIdeal ℚ G) :=
    (chosenBasePlainPolynomialQuotientEquiv D i G hI).symm.toLinearEquiv.finiteDimensional
  exact plainSurvivors_finite ℚ G

name: P23.Semigroup.chosenBase_plain_unit_survives
statement:
theorem chosenBase_plain_unit_survives (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup) (i : Fin 4)
    (G : Finset PlainExp) (hI : plainMonomialIdeal ℚ G = chosenBaseDefiningIdeal D i) :
    (0 : PlainExp) ∈ plainSurvivors ℚ G
proof:
:= by
  change ¬MvPolynomial.monomial 0 (1 : ℚ) ∈ plainMonomialIdeal ℚ G
  rw [hI]
  intro hm
  have hz := RingHom.mem_ker.mp hm
  have hunit : (1 : ChosenBaseQuotient (k := ℚ) D i) = 0 := by simpa using hz
  let c : ChosenBaseQuotient (k := ℚ) D i →ₐ[ℚ] ℚ :=
    (aperyAugmentationAlgHom (k := ℚ) D i).comp (chosenBaseEquivApery D i).toAlgHom
  have hc := congrArg c hunit
  simpa using hc

name: P23.Semigroup.chosenBase_plain_variables_survive
statement:
theorem chosenBase_plain_variables_survive (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup) (i : Fin 4)
    (G : Finset PlainExp) (hI : plainMonomialIdeal ℚ G = chosenBaseDefiningIdeal D i)
    (hf : (plainSurvivors ℚ G).Finite) :
    PlainVariablesSurvive (plainSurvivorRoots ℚ G hf)
proof:
:= by
  intro j
  apply (plainSurvivorRoots_standard_iff ℚ G hf _).mpr
  change ¬MvPolynomial.monomial (plainUnitVector j) (1 : ℚ) ∈ plainMonomialIdeal ℚ G
  rw [hI]
  intro hm
  change MvPolynomial.X j ∈ chosenBaseDefiningIdeal (k := ℚ) D i at hm
  exact tailVariableChosenBase_ne_zero (k := ℚ) D i j (RingHom.mem_ker.mp hm)

name: P23.Semigroup.canonicalSourceNormal_degree
statement:
theorem canonicalSourceNormal_degree (T : TaggedBudgetOneNormalization D i) (u : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) :
    canonicalDegree T (canonicalSourceNormal T u) = tailDegree D i u
proof:
:= by
  change T.presentation.coordinates.coordinateDegree (normalExponent
    (normalizeExponent _ _ _ (u.mapDomain T.presentation.coordinates.sigma))) = _
  rw [T.presentation.coordinates.normalize_preserves_coordinateDegree,
    T.presentation.coordinates.coordinateDegree_rename]

name: P23.Semigroup.canonical_tailInK_iff_not_standard
statement:
theorem canonical_tailInK_iff_not_standard (T : TaggedBudgetOneNormalization D i)
    (p : Normal T.presentation.coordinates.a T.presentation.coordinates.b T.presentation.coordinates.c) :
    TailInK D i (canonicalDegree T p) ↔ p ∉ standardSet T.presentation.roots
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_,g,hg⟩ hp
    exact (chosenBase_canonical_isApery_iff_standard T p).mpr hp ⟨g,Subtype.ext hg⟩
  · intro hp
    have hn := mt (chosenBase_canonical_isApery_iff_standard T p).mp hp
    obtain ⟨g,hg⟩ := not_not.mp hn
    exact ⟨⟨canonicalTailExponent T p,rfl⟩,g,congrArg Subtype.val hg⟩

name: P23.Semigroup.canonicalDegree_positive_of_ne_one
statement:
theorem canonicalDegree_positive_of_ne_one (T : TaggedBudgetOneNormalization D i)
    (p : Normal T.presentation.coordinates.a T.presentation.coordinates.b T.presentation.coordinates.c)
    (hp : p ≠ 1) : 0 < canonicalDegree T p
proof:
:= by
  apply tailDegree_pos_of_ne_zero
  intro he
  have hh := canonicalTailExponent_rename T p
  rw [he,Finsupp.mapDomain_zero] at hh
  apply hp
  apply Normal.ext
  · have h := congrArg (fun e : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ => e 0) hh
    simpa using h.symm
  · have h := congrArg (fun e : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ => e 1) hh
    simpa using h.symm
  · have h := congrArg (fun e : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ => e 2) hh
    simpa using h.symm

name: P23.Semigroup.source_normal_mem_original_border
statement:
theorem source_normal_mem_original_border (T : TaggedBudgetOneNormalization D i)
    {d : ℕ} (hs : IsTailSource D i d) (u : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) (hu : tailDegree D i u=d) :
    canonicalSourceNormal T u ∈ borderFinset T.presentation.roots
proof:
:= by
  let p := canonicalSourceNormal T u
  have hpdeg : canonicalDegree T p=d := (canonicalSourceNormal_degree T u).trans hu
  have hp : p ∉ standardSet T.presentation.roots :=
    (canonical_tailInK_iff_not_standard T p).mp (hpdeg.symm ▸ hs.1)
  obtain ⟨g,hg,hgp⟩ := killed_has_border_divisor T.presentation.roots
    T.presentation.roots_nonempty T.presentation.coordinates.liveDomain p hp
  by_cases he : g=p
  · change p ∈ borderFinset T.presentation.roots
    exact he ▸ hg
  obtain ⟨r,hr⟩ := hgp
  have hr1 : r ≠ 1 := by intro h; apply he; simpa [h] using hr.symm
  have hgk : TailInK D i (canonicalDegree T g) :=
    (canonical_tailInK_iff_not_standard T g).mpr
      ((mem_borderFinset_iff T.presentation.roots_nonempty g).mp hg).1
  have hpos := canonicalDegree_positive_of_ne_one T r hr1
  have hsum : d = canonicalDegree T g + canonicalDegree T r := by
    rw [←hpdeg,hr,canonicalDegree_mul]
  exact False.elim ((isTailSource_iff_no_nonzero_tail_predecessor D i d).mp hs |>.2
    ⟨canonicalDegree T g,canonicalDegree T r,hgk,⟨canonicalTailExponent T r,rfl⟩,
      Nat.ne_of_gt hpos,hsum⟩)

name: P23.Semigroup.source_normal_external_tag
statement:
theorem source_normal_external_tag (T : TaggedBudgetOneNormalization D i)
    {d : ℕ} (hs : IsTailSource D i d) (u : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) (hu : tailDegree D i u=d) :
    ∃ g ∈ T.externalTags, T.normalizedOfExternal g=canonicalSourceNormal T u ∧
      ∀ h ∈ T.externalTags, T.normalizedOfExternal h=canonicalSourceNormal T u → h=g
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hp := source_normal_mem_original_border T hs u hu
  rw [←T.external_image_exact_border] at hp
  obtain ⟨g,hg,hgp⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hp
  refine ⟨g,hg,hgp,?_⟩
  intro h hh hhp
  exact T.normalized_external_injective hh hg (hhp.trans hgp.symm)

name: P23.Semigroup.ResidualSource.residualSourceNormal_degree
statement:
theorem residualSourceNormal_degree (u : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) :
    residualDegree R (residualSourceNormal R u) = tailDegree D i u
proof:
:= by
  change canonicalDegree R.tagged (R.residual.normalCoordinates.symm
    (R.residual.normalCoordinates (canonicalSourceNormal R.tagged u))) = _
  rw [MulEquiv.symm_apply_apply,canonicalSourceNormal_degree]

name: P23.Semigroup.ResidualSource.transport_minimal
statement:
private theorem transport_minimal {M N : Type*} [CommMonoid M] [CommMonoid N]
    (E : M ≃* N) (O : Set M) (P : Set N) (hc : ∀ p, E p ∈ P ↔ p ∈ O)
    (m : M) (hm : m ∉ O ∧ ∀ d, d ∣ m → d ≠ m → d ∈ O) :
    E m ∉ P ∧ ∀ d, d ∣ E m → d ≠ E m → d ∈ P
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => hm.1 ((hc m).mp h),?_⟩
  intro d hd hn
  have hdiv : E.symm d ∣ m := by
    obtain ⟨q,hq⟩ := hd
    refine ⟨E.symm q,?_⟩
    have hh := congrArg E.symm hq
    simpa [IsDivisibilityMinimalKilled] using hh
  have hne : E.symm d ≠ m := by intro he; apply hn; simpa using congrArg E he
  have hh := (hc (E.symm d)).mpr (hm.2 _ hdiv hne)
  simpa using hh

name: P23.Semigroup.ResidualSource.residual_border_correspondence
statement:
theorem residual_border_correspondence
    (p : Normal R.tagged.presentation.coordinates.a R.tagged.presentation.coordinates.b
      R.tagged.presentation.coordinates.c) :
    R.residual.normalCoordinates p ∈ borderFinset R.residual.roots ↔
      p ∈ borderFinset R.tagged.presentation.roots
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_borderFinset_iff R.residual.nonempty,
    mem_borderFinset_iff R.tagged.presentation.roots_nonempty,
    isMinimalBorder_iff_isDivisibilityMinimalKilled _ _
      (variableGenerators_ne_one_of_two_le R.residual.a'_ge_two),
    isMinimalBorder_iff_isDivisibilityMinimalKilled _ _
      (variableGenerators_ne_one_of_two_le R.tagged.presentation.coordinates.liveDomain.1)]
  constructor
  · intro hp
    have hc (q) : R.residual.normalCoordinates.symm q ∈ standardSet R.tagged.presentation.roots ↔
        q ∈ standardSet R.residual.roots := by
      simpa using (R.residual.standardCorrespondence (R.residual.normalCoordinates.symm q)).symm
    have hh := transport_minimal R.residual.normalCoordinates.symm _ _ hc _ hp
    simpa [IsDivisibilityMinimalKilled] using hh
  · intro hp
    exact transport_minimal R.residual.normalCoordinates _ _ R.residual.standardCorrespondence p hp

name: P23.Semigroup.ResidualSource.residualSourceNormal_mem_border
statement:
theorem residualSourceNormal_mem_border {d : ℕ} (hs : IsTailSource D i d)
    (u : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) (hu : tailDegree D i u=d) :
    residualSourceNormal R u ∈ borderFinset R.residual.roots
proof:
:=
  (residual_border_correspondence R _).mpr (source_normal_mem_original_border R.tagged hs u hu)

name: P23.Semigroup.ResidualSource.residualSourceNormal_add
statement:
theorem residualSourceNormal_add (u v : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) :
    residualSourceNormal R (u+v) = residualSourceNormal R u * residualSourceNormal R v
proof:
:= by
  simp only [residualSourceNormal,canonicalSourceNormal,Finsupp.mapDomain_add,
    normalizeExponent_add,map_mul]

name: P23.Semigroup.ResidualSource.residualSourceNormal_single
statement:
theorem residualSourceNormal_single (j : Fin 3) :
    residualSourceNormal R (Finsupp.single j 1) = coordinateGenerator (tailToResidual R j)
proof:
:= by
  have hg (l : Fin 3) : normalizeExponent R.tagged.presentation.coordinates.a
      R.tagged.presentation.coordinates.b R.tagged.presentation.coordinates.c
      (Finsupp.single l 1) = coordinateGenerator l := by
    fin_cases l <;> simp [coordinateGenerator]
  simp only [residualSourceNormal,canonicalSourceNormal,Finsupp.mapDomain_single,hg,
    R.residual.variablesCorrespondence]
  rfl

name: P23.Semigroup.ResidualSource.generator_mul_support
statement:
private theorem generator_mul_support (j : Fin 3)
    (q : Normal R.residual.a' R.residual.b' 0) :
    if j=2 then 0 < (coordinateGenerator j * q).z else
      0 < (coordinateGenerator j * q).x ∨ 0 < (coordinateGenerator j * q).y
proof:
:= by
  have ha := R.residual.a'_ge_two
  have hb := R.residual.b'_ge_two
  have ha1 : R.residual.a' ≠ 1 := by omega
  fin_cases j
  · simp only [coordinateGenerator,ite_true]
    change 0 < (Normal.xGenerator*q).x ∨ 0 < (Normal.xGenerator*q).y
    simp only [Normal.mul_x,Normal.mul_y,Normal.xGenerator,dif_neg ha1,zero_add]
    change 0 < (1+q.x)%R.residual.a' ∨
      0 < q.y + ((1+q.x)/R.residual.a')*R.residual.b'
    by_cases hd : (1+q.x)/R.residual.a'=0
    · left
      have hh := Nat.mod_add_div (1+q.x) R.residual.a'
      rw [hd] at hh
      omega
    · right
      have hpos : 0 < ((1+q.x)/R.residual.a')*R.residual.b' :=
        Nat.mul_pos (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hd) (by omega)
      omega
  · simp [coordinateGenerator,Normal.mul_y,Normal.yGenerator]
  · simp [coordinateGenerator,Normal.mul_z,Normal.zGenerator]

name: P23.Semigroup.ResidualSource.residualSourceNormal_selected_support
statement:
theorem residualSourceNormal_selected_support (u : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) (j : Fin 3)
    (hj : 0 < u j) :
    if tailToResidual R j=2 then 0 < (residualSourceNormal R u).z else
      0 < (residualSourceNormal R u).x ∨ 0 < (residualSourceNormal R u).y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hle : Finsupp.single j 1 ≤ u := by
    intro l
    by_cases hl : j=l
    · subst l; simp; omega
    · simp [Finsupp.single_apply,hl]
  have he : u = Finsupp.single j 1 + (u-Finsupp.single j 1) := by
    exact (add_tsub_cancel_of_le hle).symm
  rw [he,residualSourceNormal_add,residualSourceNormal_single]
  exact generator_mul_support R (tailToResidual R j) _

name: P23.Semigroup.mem_chosenBaseRelationSubmodule_iff
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_chosenBaseRelationSubmodule_iff
    (f : chosenBaseDefiningIdeal (k := k) D i) :
    f ∈ chosenBaseRelationSubmodule D i ↔
      (f : TailPoly k) ∈ polyVariableIdeal * chosenBaseDefiningIdeal D i
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: P23.Semigroup.chosenBaseRelationClass_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem chosenBaseRelationClass_zero :
    chosenBaseRelationClass (k := k) D i 0 (chosenBaseDefiningIdeal D i).zero_mem = 0
proof:
:= by
  exact map_zero (chosenBaseRelationSubmodule (k := k) D i).mkQ

name: P23.Semigroup.chosenBaseRelationClass_add
statement:
theorem chosenBaseRelationClass_add (f g : TailPoly k)
    (hf : f ∈ chosenBaseDefiningIdeal D i) (hg : g ∈ chosenBaseDefiningIdeal D i) :
    chosenBaseRelationClass D i (f + g) ((chosenBaseDefiningIdeal D i).add_mem hf hg) =
      chosenBaseRelationClass D i f hf + chosenBaseRelationClass D i g hg
proof:
:= by
  exact map_add (chosenBaseRelationSubmodule D i).mkQ ⟨f, hf⟩ ⟨g, hg⟩

name: P23.Semigroup.chosenBaseRelationClass_smul
statement:
theorem chosenBaseRelationClass_smul (r : k) (f : TailPoly k)
    (hf : f ∈ chosenBaseDefiningIdeal D i) :
    chosenBaseRelationClass D i (r • f)
      ((chosenBaseDefiningIdeal D i).restrictScalars k |>.smul_mem r hf) =
      r • chosenBaseRelationClass D i f hf
proof:
:= by
  exact map_smul (chosenBaseRelationSubmodule D i).mkQ r ⟨f, hf⟩

name: P23.Semigroup.chosenBaseRelationClass_mul_eq_smul
statement:
theorem chosenBaseRelationClass_mul_eq_smul (q f : TailPoly k)
    (hf : f ∈ chosenBaseDefiningIdeal D i) :
    chosenBaseRelationClass D i (q * f) ((chosenBaseDefiningIdeal D i).mul_mem_left q hf) =
      MvPolynomial.constantCoeff q • chosenBaseRelationClass D i f hf
proof:
:= by
  change Submodule.Quotient.mk
      (⟨q * f, _⟩ : chosenBaseDefiningIdeal D i) =
    MvPolynomial.constantCoeff q • Submodule.Quotient.mk
      (⟨f, hf⟩ : chosenBaseDefiningIdeal D i)
  rw [← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul]
  apply (Submodule.Quotient.eq (chosenBaseRelationSubmodule D i)).2
  apply (mem_chosenBaseRelationSubmodule_iff D i _).2
  have hmem : q * f - MvPolynomial.C (MvPolynomial.constantCoeff q) * f ∈
      polyVariableIdeal * chosenBaseDefiningIdeal D i := by
    rw [← sub_mul]
    apply Ideal.mul_mem_mul
    · apply (mem_polyVariableIdeal_iff _).2
      simp
    · exact hf
  simpa [Algebra.smul_def] using hmem

name: P23.Semigroup.specializedConnectorFinset_span_eq
statement:
theorem specializedConnectorFinset_span_eq :
    Ideal.span (↑(specializedConnectorFinset (k := k) D i) : Set (TailPoly k)) =
      chosenBaseDefiningIdeal D i
proof:
:= by
  rw [specializedConnectorFinset, Finset.coe_image, Finset.coe_univ, Set.image_univ]
  exact (D.chosenBaseDefiningIdeal_eq_span_specializedConnectors i).symm

name: P23.Semigroup.baseAdaptedGlobalConnector_card_eq_rho
statement:
theorem baseAdaptedGlobalConnector_card_eq_rho :
    Fintype.card (D.BaseAdaptedGlobalConnector i) = D.semigroupRho
proof:
:= by
  have h := D.baseAdaptedConnectorRelationFinset_card_eq_rho i
  rw [baseAdaptedConnectorRelationFinset,
    Finset.card_image_of_injective _ (D.baseAdaptedGlobalConnectorRelation_injective i)] at h
  exact h

name: P23.Semigroup.specializedConnectorFinset_card_le_rho
statement:
theorem specializedConnectorFinset_card_le_rho :
    (specializedConnectorFinset (k := k) D i).card ≤ D.semigroupRho
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ ≤ (Finset.univ : Finset (D.BaseAdaptedGlobalConnector i)).card := Finset.card_image_le
    _ = D.semigroupRho := baseAdaptedGlobalConnector_card_eq_rho D i

name: P23.Semigroup.chosenBaseConnectorCoeff_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem chosenBaseConnectorCoeff_apply (g : D.BaseAdaptedGlobalConnector i)
    (p : TailPoly k) :
    chosenBaseConnectorCoeff D i g p =
      -(D.degreeComponentCoeffVector g.1.1 (tailEmbedding D i p)) g.2.1
proof: := rfl

name: P23.Semigroup.connectorTargetFactorization_base_zero
statement:
theorem connectorTargetFactorization_base_zero (g : D.BaseAdaptedGlobalConnector i)
    (u : D.FactorizationAt g.1.1) (hu : D.componentOf u = g.2.1) : u.1 i = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hi : i ∈ D.combinedSupport g.1.1
  · apply D.factorization_base_zero_of_other_component i g.1.2 hi
    rw [hu]
    simpa only [baseAdaptedRootComponent, dif_pos hi] using g.2.2
  · exact D.factorization_base_zero_of_internal i hi u

name: P23.Semigroup.coeff_tailEmbedding_specialization_of_base_zero
statement:
theorem coeff_tailEmbedding_specialization_of_base_zero (p : FourPoly k)
    (u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) (hu : u i = 0) :
    (tailEmbedding D i (baseSpecialization D i p)).coeff u = p.coeff u
proof:
:= by
  let v := restrictToTails D i u
  have hm : v.mapDomain (D.tailIndex i) = u :=
    (tailEmbeddingExponent_eq_mapDomain D i v).symm.trans
      (tailEmbedding_restrictToTails D i u hu)
  rw [← hm]
  calc
    _ = (baseSpecialization D i p).coeff v :=
      MvPolynomial.coeff_rename_mapDomain (D.tailIndex i) (D.tailIndex i).injective (baseSpecialization D i p) v
    _ = p.coeff (v.mapDomain (D.tailIndex i)) :=
      MvPolynomial.coeff_killCompl (D.tailIndex i).injective

name: P23.Semigroup.degreeComponentCoeffVector_tailEmbedding_specialization_target
statement:
theorem degreeComponentCoeffVector_tailEmbedding_specialization_target
    (g : D.BaseAdaptedGlobalConnector i) (p : FourPoly k) :
    (D.degreeComponentCoeffVector g.1.1 (tailEmbedding D i (baseSpecialization D i p))) g.2.1 =
      (D.degreeComponentCoeffVector g.1.1 p) g.2.1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [degreeComponentCoeffVector, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro u hu
  exact coeff_tailEmbedding_specialization_of_base_zero D i p u.1
    (connectorTargetFactorization_base_zero D i g u (Finset.mem_filter.mp hu).2)

name: P23.Semigroup.chosenBaseConnectorCoeff_specialization
statement:
theorem chosenBaseConnectorCoeff_specialization (g : D.BaseAdaptedGlobalConnector i)
    (p : FourPoly k) :
    chosenBaseConnectorCoeff D i g (baseSpecialization D i p) =
      -(D.degreeComponentCoeffVector g.1.1 p) g.2.1
proof:
:= by
  rw [chosenBaseConnectorCoeff_apply,
    degreeComponentCoeffVector_tailEmbedding_specialization_target D i g p]

name: P23.Semigroup.degreeComponentCoeffVector_fiberBinomial
statement:
theorem degreeComponentCoeffVector_fiberBinomial {d : ℕ}
    (u v : D.FactorizationAt d) :
    D.degreeComponentCoeffVector (k := k) d (D.fiberBinomial u v) =
      D.componentDelta u v
proof:
:= by
  rw [← D.fiberPolynomial_fiberDelta u v, D.degreeComponentCoeffVector_fiberPolynomial]
  exact congrArg Subtype.val (D.fiberToComponentRelation_fiberDelta (k := k) u v)

name: P23.Semigroup.chosenBaseConnectorCoeff_specializedConnector
statement:
theorem chosenBaseConnectorCoeff_specializedConnector
    (g h : D.BaseAdaptedGlobalConnector i) :
    chosenBaseConnectorCoeff (k := k) D i g (D.specializedConnectorPolynomial i h) =
      if g = h then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases g with ⟨d, g⟩
  rcases h with ⟨e, h⟩
  simp only [specializedConnectorPolynomial, chosenBaseConnectorCoeff_specialization]
  by_cases hde : d = e
  · subst e
    change -(D.degreeComponentCoeffVector d.1
      (D.fiberBinomial (D.baseAdaptedRootFactorization i d.2)
        (D.componentRepresentative h.1))) g.1 = _
    rw [degreeComponentCoeffVector_fiberBinomial]
    by_cases hgh : g = h
    · subst h
      simp [componentDelta, D.baseAdaptedRootFactorization_component,
        D.componentRepresentative_component, g.2, Ne.symm g.2]
    · have hval : g.1 ≠ h.1 := fun hv => hgh (Subtype.ext hv)
      have hsig : (⟨d, g⟩ : D.BaseAdaptedGlobalConnector i) ≠ ⟨d, h⟩ := by
        intro hs
        exact hgh (eq_of_heq (Sigma.mk.inj hs).2)
      simp [componentDelta, D.baseAdaptedRootFactorization_component,
        D.componentRepresentative_component, g.2, Ne.symm g.2, hval, Ne.symm hval, hsig]
  · have hval : d.1 ≠ e.1 := fun hv => hde (Subtype.ext hv)
    have hsig : (⟨d, g⟩ : D.BaseAdaptedGlobalConnector i) ≠ ⟨e, h⟩ :=
      fun hs => hde (congrArg Sigma.fst hs)
    have hz : D.degreeComponentCoeffVector (k := k) d.1
        (D.baseAdaptedGlobalConnectorBinomial i ⟨e, h⟩) = 0 := by
      rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne (Ne.symm hval) with hlt | hgt
      · simpa only [one_mul, baseAdaptedGlobalConnectorBinomial, baseAdaptedConnectorBinomial,
          baseAdaptedGlobalConnectorRelation] using D.degreeComponentCoeffVector_mul_relation_of_lt
          (k := k) d.1 (D.baseAdaptedGlobalConnectorRelation i ⟨e,h⟩) 1 hlt
      · simpa only [one_mul, baseAdaptedGlobalConnectorBinomial, baseAdaptedConnectorBinomial,
          baseAdaptedGlobalConnectorRelation] using D.degreeComponentCoeffVector_mul_relation_of_gt
          (k := k) d.1 (D.baseAdaptedGlobalConnectorRelation i ⟨e,h⟩) 1 hgt
    rw [hz]
    simp [hsig]

name: P23.Semigroup.chosenBaseConnectorCoeff_of_degree_ne
statement:
theorem chosenBaseConnectorCoeff_of_degree_ne (g h : D.BaseAdaptedGlobalConnector i)
    (hne : g.1.1 ≠ h.1.1) :
    chosenBaseConnectorCoeff (k := k) D i g (D.specializedConnectorPolynomial i h) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hgh : g ≠ h := fun hh => hne (congrArg (fun t => t.1.1) hh)
  rw [chosenBaseConnectorCoeff_specializedConnector, if_neg hgh]

name: P23.Semigroup.chosenBaseConnectorCoeff_same_degree_other_target
statement:
theorem chosenBaseConnectorCoeff_same_degree_other_target (d : D.BettiDegreeIndex)
    (g h : D.BaseAdaptedConnector i d.2) (hne : g.1 ≠ h.1) :
    chosenBaseConnectorCoeff (k := k) D i ⟨d,g⟩
      (D.specializedConnectorPolynomial i ⟨d,h⟩) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hgh : (⟨d,g⟩ : D.BaseAdaptedGlobalConnector i) ≠ ⟨d,h⟩ := by
    intro hh
    exact hne (congrArg Subtype.val (eq_of_heq (Sigma.mk.inj hh).2))
  rw [chosenBaseConnectorCoeff_specializedConnector, if_neg hgh]

name: P23.Semigroup.chosenBaseConnectorCoeff_mul_specializedConnector_eq_zero
statement:
theorem chosenBaseConnectorCoeff_mul_specializedConnector_eq_zero
    (g h : D.BaseAdaptedGlobalConnector i) (q : TailPoly k)
    (hq : q ∈ polyVariableIdeal) :
    chosenBaseConnectorCoeff D i g (q * D.specializedConnectorPolynomial i h) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hp : baseSpecialization D i
      (tailEmbedding D i q * D.baseAdaptedGlobalConnectorBinomial i h) =
      q * D.specializedConnectorPolynomial i h := by
    simp only [map_mul, baseSpecialization_tailEmbedding, specializedConnectorPolynomial]
  rw [← hp, chosenBaseConnectorCoeff_specialization]
  have hc : relationMultiplierConstantCoeff (tailEmbedding D i q) = 0 := by
    simpa only [relationMultiplierConstantCoeff, tailEmbedding, MvPolynomial.constantCoeff_rename]
      using (mem_polyVariableIdeal_iff q).mp hq
  have hz : D.degreeComponentCoeffVector (k := k) g.1.1
      (tailEmbedding D i q * D.baseAdaptedGlobalConnectorBinomial i h) = 0 := by
    change D.degreeComponentCoeffVector g.1.1
      (tailEmbedding D i q * D.presentationRelationBinomial
        (D.baseAdaptedGlobalConnectorRelation i h)) = 0
    by_cases he : (D.baseAdaptedGlobalConnectorRelation i h).degree = g.1.1
    · rw [D.degreeComponentCoeffVector_mul_relation_of_eq _ _ _ he, hc, zero_smul]
    · rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne he with hlt | hgt
      · exact D.degreeComponentCoeffVector_mul_relation_of_lt _ _ _ hlt
      · exact D.degreeComponentCoeffVector_mul_relation_of_gt _ _ _ hgt
  rw [hz]
  simp

name: P23.Semigroup.chosenBaseConnectorCoeff_mul_external_eq_zero
statement:
theorem chosenBaseConnectorCoeff_mul_external_eq_zero
    (g h : D.BaseAdaptedGlobalConnector i) (q : TailPoly k)
    (hq : q ∈ polyVariableIdeal) (hi : i ∈ D.combinedSupport h.1.1) :
    chosenBaseConnectorCoeff D i g
      (q * (-MvPolynomial.monomial (D.connectorRightTail i h) 1)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← D.specializedConnectorPolynomial_external i h hi]
  exact chosenBaseConnectorCoeff_mul_specializedConnector_eq_zero D i g h q hq

name: P23.Semigroup.chosenBaseConnectorCoeff_mul_internal_eq_zero
statement:
theorem chosenBaseConnectorCoeff_mul_internal_eq_zero
    (g h : D.BaseAdaptedGlobalConnector i) (q : TailPoly k)
    (hq : q ∈ polyVariableIdeal) (hi : i ∉ D.combinedSupport h.1.1) :
    chosenBaseConnectorCoeff D i g
      (q * (MvPolynomial.monomial (D.connectorLeftTail i h) 1 -
        MvPolynomial.monomial (D.connectorRightTail i h) 1)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← D.specializedConnectorPolynomial_internal i h hi]
  exact chosenBaseConnectorCoeff_mul_specializedConnector_eq_zero D i g h q hq

name: P23.Semigroup.chosenBaseConnectorCoeff_positive_monomial_mul_external
statement:
theorem chosenBaseConnectorCoeff_positive_monomial_mul_external
    (g h : D.BaseAdaptedGlobalConnector i) (w : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) (c : k)
    (hw : w ≠ 0) (hi : i ∈ D.combinedSupport h.1.1) :
    chosenBaseConnectorCoeff D i g
      (MvPolynomial.monomial w c * (-MvPolynomial.monomial (D.connectorRightTail i h) 1)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply chosenBaseConnectorCoeff_mul_external_eq_zero D i g h _ _ hi
  simp [mem_polyVariableIdeal_iff, MvPolynomial.constantCoeff_monomial, hw]

name: P23.Semigroup.chosenBaseConnectorCoeff_eq_zero_of_mem_mul
statement:
theorem chosenBaseConnectorCoeff_eq_zero_of_mem_mul
    (g : D.BaseAdaptedGlobalConnector i) (p : TailPoly k)
    (hp : p ∈ polyVariableIdeal * chosenBaseDefiningIdeal D i) :
    chosenBaseConnectorCoeff D i g p = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hp' : p ∈ polyVariableIdeal (k := k) •
      Submodule.span (TailPoly k)
        ((id : TailPoly k → TailPoly k) '' (↑(specializedConnectorFinset (k := k) D i) : Set (TailPoly k))) := by
    change p ∈ polyVariableIdeal •
      (chosenBaseDefiningIdeal D i : Submodule (TailPoly k) (TailPoly k)) at hp
    rw [← specializedConnectorFinset_span_eq D i] at hp
    simpa using hp
  obtain ⟨coeff, hcoeff, hsum⟩ :=
    (Submodule.mem_ideal_smul_span_iff_exists_sum' (polyVariableIdeal (k := k))
      (↑(specializedConnectorFinset (k := k) D i) : Set (TailPoly k)) (id : TailPoly k → TailPoly k) p).1 hp'
  rw [← hsum]
  simp only [Finsupp.sum, id_eq, smul_eq_mul, map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro b _
  obtain ⟨h, _, hh⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp b.2
  simpa only [hh] using chosenBaseConnectorCoeff_mul_specializedConnector_eq_zero D i g h
    (coeff b) (hcoeff b)

name: P23.Semigroup.chosenBaseRelationDetector_class
statement:
@[simp] theorem chosenBaseRelationDetector_class (f : TailPoly k)
    (hf : f ∈ chosenBaseDefiningIdeal D i) (g : D.BaseAdaptedGlobalConnector i) :
    chosenBaseRelationDetector D i (chosenBaseRelationClass D i f hf) g =
      chosenBaseConnectorCoeff D i g f
proof: := rfl

name: P23.Semigroup.chosenBaseRelationDetector_displayed
statement:
@[simp] theorem chosenBaseRelationDetector_displayed (g : D.BaseAdaptedGlobalConnector i) :
    chosenBaseRelationDetector (k := k) D i (displayedChosenBaseRelation D i g) =
      Pi.single g 1
proof:
:= by
  funext h
  change chosenBaseConnectorCoeff D i h (D.specializedConnectorPolynomial i g) = _
  rw [chosenBaseConnectorCoeff_specializedConnector]
  simp only [Pi.single_apply, eq_comm]

name: P23.Semigroup.chosenBaseGeneratorClasses_span_eq_top
statement:
theorem chosenBaseGeneratorClasses_span_eq_top (G : Finset (TailPoly k))
    (hG : Ideal.span (↑G : Set (TailPoly k)) = chosenBaseDefiningIdeal D i) :
    Submodule.span k (Set.range (chosenBaseGeneratorClass D i G hG)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  apply top_unique
  intro z _
  obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ := (chosenBaseRelationSubmodule (k := k) D i).mkQ_surjective z
  change chosenBaseRelationClass D i f.1 f.2 ∈ _
  have hf : f.1 ∈ Ideal.span (↑G : Set (TailPoly k)) := by rw [hG]; exact f.2
  let W := Submodule.span k (Set.range (chosenBaseGeneratorClass D i G hG))
  have claim : ∀ (x : TailPoly k) (hx : x ∈ Ideal.span (↑G : Set (TailPoly k))),
      chosenBaseRelationClass D i x (by rw [← hG]; exact hx) ∈ W := by
    intro x hx
    induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem x hx => exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨⟨x,hx⟩, rfl⟩
    | zero => exact W.zero_mem
    | add x y hx hy ihx ihy =>
        have hxI : x ∈ chosenBaseDefiningIdeal D i := by rw [← hG]; exact hx
        have hyI : y ∈ chosenBaseDefiningIdeal D i := by rw [← hG]; exact hy
        rw [chosenBaseRelationClass_add D i x y hxI hyI]
        exact W.add_mem ihx ihy
    | smul q x hx ih =>
        have hxI : x ∈ chosenBaseDefiningIdeal D i := by rw [← hG]; exact hx
        change chosenBaseRelationClass D i (q*x) _ ∈ W
        rw [chosenBaseRelationClass_mul_eq_smul D i q x hxI]
        exact W.smul_mem _ ih
  exact claim f.1 hf

name: P23.Semigroup.displayedChosenBaseRelations_span_eq_top
statement:
theorem displayedChosenBaseRelations_span_eq_top :
    Submodule.span k (Set.range (displayedChosenBaseRelation (k := k) D i)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  apply top_unique
  rw [← chosenBaseGeneratorClasses_span_eq_top D i (specializedConnectorFinset D i)
    (specializedConnectorFinset_span_eq D i)]
  apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
  rintro _ ⟨p, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨g, _, hg⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp p.2
  apply Submodule.subset_span
  refine ⟨g, ?_⟩
  simp only [displayedChosenBaseRelation, chosenBaseGeneratorClass, hg]

name: P23.Semigroup.chosenBaseRelationDetector_surjective
statement:
theorem chosenBaseRelationDetector_surjective :
    Function.Surjective (chosenBaseRelationDetector (k := k) D i)
proof:
:= by
  intro v
  refine ⟨∑ g, v g • displayedChosenBaseRelation D i g, ?_⟩
  rw [map_sum]
  simp_rw [map_smul, chosenBaseRelationDetector_displayed]
  ext h
  simp only [Finset.sum_apply, Pi.single_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single h]
  · simp
  · intro g _ hgh
    simp [Pi.single_apply, hgh, Ne.symm hgh]
  · simp

name: P23.Semigroup.chosenBaseRelationSpace_finrank
statement:
theorem chosenBaseRelationSpace_finrank :
    Module.finrank k (ChosenBaseRelationSpace k D i) = D.semigroupRho
proof:
:= by
  apply Nat.le_antisymm
  · have h := finrank_le_of_span_eq_top (displayedChosenBaseRelations_span_eq_top (k := k) D i)
    simpa only [baseAdaptedGlobalConnector_card_eq_rho] using h
  · have h := LinearMap.finrank_le_finrank_of_surjective
      (chosenBaseRelationDetector_surjective (k := k) D i)
    simpa only [Module.finrank_pi, Module.finrank_self, mul_one,
      baseAdaptedGlobalConnector_card_eq_rho] using h

name: P23.Semigroup.chosenBaseRelationDetector_bijective
statement:
theorem chosenBaseRelationDetector_bijective :
    Function.Bijective (chosenBaseRelationDetector (k := k) D i)
proof:
:= by
  apply OrzechProperty.bijective_of_surjective_of_finrank_le
  · exact chosenBaseRelationDetector_surjective D i
  · rw [chosenBaseRelationSpace_finrank]
    rw [Module.finrank_pi, baseAdaptedGlobalConnector_card_eq_rho]

name: P23.Semigroup.chosenBaseRelationBasis_apply
statement:
theorem chosenBaseRelationBasis_apply (g : D.BaseAdaptedGlobalConnector i) :
    chosenBaseRelationBasis (k := k) D i g = displayedChosenBaseRelation D i g
proof:
:= by
  apply (chosenBaseRelationDetector_bijective (k := k) D i).1
  simp [chosenBaseRelationBasis, chosenBaseRelationDetectorEquiv]

name: P23.Semigroup.rho_four_all_budgets_eq_one
statement: theorem rho_four_all_budgets_eq_one (i : Fin 4) : D.fourBaseBudget i=1
proof:
:= by
  have h0 := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (rho_four_budget_zero_impossible D 0 ht hn hr)
  have h1 := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (rho_four_budget_zero_impossible D 1 ht hn hr)
  have h2 := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (rho_four_budget_zero_impossible D 2 ht hn hr)
  have h3 := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (rho_four_budget_zero_impossible D 3 ht hn hr)
  have hs := D.fourBaseBudget_sum_le_four
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_four] at hs
  have he0 : D.fourBaseBudget 0=1 := by omega
  have he1 : D.fourBaseBudget 1=1 := by omega
  have he2 : D.fourBaseBudget 2=1 := by omega
  have he3 : D.fourBaseBudget 3=1 := by omega
  fin_cases i
  · exact he0
  · exact he1
  · exact he2
  · exact he3

name: P23.Semigroup.rho_four_budget_sum_eq_four
statement: theorem rho_four_budget_sum_eq_four : (∑ i : Fin 4,D.fourBaseBudget i)=4
proof:
:= by
  simp [rho_four_all_budgets_eq_one D ht hn hr]

name: P23.Semigroup.rho_four_budget_singleton_sum_eq_four
statement:
theorem rho_four_budget_singleton_sum_eq_four :
    (∑ d : D.BudgetDegree,D.singletonComponentCount d.1)=4
proof:
:= by
  have hs := rho_four_budget_sum_eq_four D ht hn hr
  rw [D.fourBaseBudget_doubleCount] at hs
  have hle : (∑ d : D.BudgetDegree,(4-D.supportCard d.1)*D.bettiContribution d.1) ≤
      ∑ d : D.BudgetDegree,D.singletonComponentCount d.1 := by
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro d _
    exact D.localSupportInequality d.2.1
  have hupper := D.budget_singleton_sum_le_four
  omega

name: P23.Semigroup.rho_four_singleton_bound_saturated
statement: theorem rho_four_singleton_bound_saturated : Fintype.card D.SingletonBettiOccurrence=4
proof:
:= by
  have hb : Fintype.card D.BudgetSingletonOccurrence=4 :=
    D.budgetSingletonOccurrence_card_eq_sum.trans (rho_four_budget_singleton_sum_eq_four D ht hn hr)
  have hle := Fintype.card_le_of_injective D.budgetSingletonToOccurrence
    D.budgetSingletonToOccurrence_injective
  have hu := D.singletonBettiOccurrence_card_le_four
  omega

name: P23.Semigroup.rho_four_budget_singletons_exhaust_all
statement:
theorem rho_four_budget_singletons_exhaust_all :
    Function.Surjective D.budgetSingletonToOccurrence
proof:
:= by
  have hb : Fintype.card D.BudgetSingletonOccurrence=4 :=
    D.budgetSingletonOccurrence_card_eq_sum.trans (rho_four_budget_singleton_sum_eq_four D ht hn hr)
  have ha := rho_four_singleton_bound_saturated D ht hn hr
  exact ((Fintype.bijective_iff_injective_and_card D.budgetSingletonToOccurrence).mpr
    ⟨D.budgetSingletonToOccurrence_injective,hb.trans ha.symm⟩).2

name: P23.Semigroup.rho_four_singleton_occurrence_in_budget
statement:
theorem rho_four_singleton_occurrence_in_budget (o : D.SingletonBettiOccurrence) :
    D.supportCard o.degree<4
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b,he⟩ := rho_four_budget_singletons_exhaust_all D ht hn hr o
  have hd : b.1.1=o.degree := congrArg SingletonBettiOccurrence.degree he
  have hb := b.1.2.2
  rwa [hd] at hb

name: P23.Semigroup.rho_four_budget_degree_local_equality
statement:
private theorem rho_four_budget_degree_local_equality (d : D.BudgetDegree) :
    (4-D.supportCard d.1)*(D.componentCount d.1-1)=D.singletonComponentCount d.1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hle := D.localSupportInequality d.2.1
  by_contra hne
  have hstrict : (4-D.supportCard d.1)*(D.componentCount d.1-1)<
      D.singletonComponentCount d.1 := by omega
  have hslt : (∑ x : D.BudgetDegree,(4-D.supportCard x.1)*D.bettiContribution x.1)<
      ∑ x : D.BudgetDegree,D.singletonComponentCount x.1 := by
    apply Finset.sum_lt_sum
    · intro x _
      exact D.localSupportInequality x.2.1
    · exact ⟨d,Finset.mem_univ d,hstrict⟩
  have hs := rho_four_budget_sum_eq_four D ht hn hr
  rw [D.fourBaseBudget_doubleCount] at hs
  have he := rho_four_budget_singleton_sum_eq_four D ht hn hr
  omega

name: P23.Semigroup.rho_four_local_support_equality
statement:
theorem rho_four_local_support_equality {d : ℕ} (hd : D.IsBettiDegree d) :
    (4-D.supportCard d)*(D.componentCount d-1)=D.singletonComponentCount d
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hv : D.supportCard d<4
  · exact rho_four_budget_degree_local_equality D ht hn hr ⟨d,hd,hv⟩
  · have hv4 : D.supportCard d=4 := by have := D.supportCard_le_four d; omega
    have hell : D.singletonComponentCount d=0 := by
      unfold singletonComponentCount
      apply Finset.card_eq_zero.mpr
      apply Finset.filter_eq_empty_iff.mpr
      intro C _ hC
      exact hv (rho_four_singleton_occurrence_in_budget D ht hn hr ⟨d,hd,C,hC⟩)
    rw [hv4,hell]
    simp

name: P23.Semigroup.rho_four_betti_two_components
statement:
theorem rho_four_betti_two_components {d : ℕ} (hd : D.IsBettiDegree d) :
    D.componentCount d=2
proof:
:= by
  have hc2 : 2≤D.componentCount d := hd
  have hcv := D.componentCount_le_supportCard_of_isBetti hd
  have hv4 := D.supportCard_le_four d
  have htwice := D.twice_componentCount_le_supportCard_add_singletons hd
  have he := rho_four_local_support_equality D ht hn hr hd
  rw [←he] at htwice
  interval_cases hv : D.supportCard d <;> omega

name: P23.Semigroup.component_support_card_pair_le_four
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hsub : D.componentSupport C∪D.componentSupport E ⊆ D.combinedSupport d :=
    Finset.union_subset (D.componentSupport_subset_combinedSupport C)
      (D.componentSupport_subset_combinedSupport E)
  have hcard := Finset.card_le_card hsub
  rw [Finset.card_union_of_disjoint (D.componentSupport_disjoint hCE)] at hcard
  exact hcard.trans (D.supportCard_le_four d)

name: P23.Semigroup.rho_four_no_support_partition_one_plus_three
statement:
theorem rho_four_no_support_partition_one_plus_three {d : ℕ} (hd : D.IsBettiDegree d) :
    ¬∃ C E : D.BettiComponent d,
      (D.componentSupport C).card=1 ∧ (D.componentSupport E).card=3
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rintro ⟨C,E,hC,hE⟩
  have hCE : C≠E := by intro h; subst E; omega
  have hsub : D.componentSupport C∪D.componentSupport E ⊆ D.combinedSupport d :=
    Finset.union_subset (D.componentSupport_subset_combinedSupport C)
      (D.componentSupport_subset_combinedSupport E)
  have hcard := Finset.card_le_card hsub
  rw [Finset.card_union_of_disjoint (D.componentSupport_disjoint hCE),hC,hE] at hcard
  have hv : D.supportCard d=4 := by
    have hu := D.supportCard_le_four d
    change 1+3≤D.supportCard d at hcard
    omega
  have hlocal := rho_four_local_support_equality D ht hn hr hd
  have hell : 0<D.singletonComponentCount d := by
    unfold singletonComponentCount
    apply Finset.card_pos.mpr
    exact ⟨C,Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _,hC⟩⟩
  rw [hv] at hlocal
  omega

name: P23.Semigroup.rho_four_no_three_or_four_component_betti_degree
statement:
theorem rho_four_no_three_or_four_component_betti_degree {d : ℕ}
    (hd : D.IsBettiDegree d) : D.componentCount d≠3 ∧ D.componentCount d≠4
proof:
:= by
  have := rho_four_betti_two_components D ht hn hr hd
  omega

name: P23.Semigroup.rho_four_betti_support_partition
statement:
theorem rho_four_betti_support_partition {d : ℕ} (hd : D.IsBettiDegree d)
    (C E : D.BettiComponent d) (hCE : C≠E) :
    ((D.componentSupport C).card=1 ∧ (D.componentSupport E).card=1) ∨
    ((D.componentSupport C).card=1 ∧ (D.componentSupport E).card=2) ∨
    ((D.componentSupport C).card=2 ∧ (D.componentSupport E).card=1) ∨
    ((D.componentSupport C).card=2 ∧ (D.componentSupport E).card=2)
proof:
:= by
  have hC := Finset.card_pos.mpr (D.componentSupport_nonempty_of_isBetti hd C)
  have hE := Finset.card_pos.mpr (D.componentSupport_nonempty_of_isBetti hd E)
  have hpair := component_support_card_pair_le_four D C E hCE
  have hno := rho_four_no_support_partition_one_plus_three D ht hn hr hd
  have hnoCE : ¬((D.componentSupport C).card=1 ∧ (D.componentSupport E).card=3) :=
    fun h => hno ⟨C,E,h⟩
  have hnoEC : ¬((D.componentSupport E).card=1 ∧ (D.componentSupport C).card=3) :=
    fun h => hno ⟨E,C,h⟩
  omega

name: P23.Semigroup.rho_four_canonical_base_bridge
statement:
theorem rho_four_canonical_base_bridge (i : Fin 4)
    (ht : D.semigroupType=3) (hn : SemigroupNearlyGorenstein D) (hr : D.semigroupRho=4) :
    Nonempty (RhoFourCanonicalBaseBridge D i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨B⟩ := chosenBaseCanonicalOneTieBridge D i
    (rho_four_all_budgets_eq_one D ht hn hr i) ht hn
  refine ⟨⟨B,?_⟩⟩
  rw [B.borderCardEqRhoSubOne,hr]

name: P23.Semigroup.rhoFourStructuralReduction
statement:
theorem rhoFourStructuralReduction : RhoFourStructuralReduction D where
  sourcePatterns
proof:
:= fun i P => exists_two_tail_sources D i P hn
  noMonomialBase := fun i => rho_four_budget_zero_impossible D i ht hn hr
  budgetsOne := rho_four_all_budgets_eq_one D ht hn hr
  budgetSum := rho_four_budget_sum_eq_four D ht hn hr
  singletonSaturation := rho_four_singleton_bound_saturated D ht hn hr
  allSingletonsInBudget := rho_four_singleton_occurrence_in_budget D ht hn hr
  localEquality := fun _ hd => rho_four_local_support_equality D ht hn hr hd
  twoComponents := fun _ hd => rho_four_betti_two_components D ht hn hr hd
  noOnePlusThree := fun _ hd => rho_four_no_support_partition_one_plus_three D ht hn hr hd
  canonicalAtEveryBase := fun i => rho_four_canonical_base_bridge D i ht hn hr

name: P23.Semigroup.chosenCanonical_maximal_mem_iff
statement:
theorem chosenCanonical_maximal_mem_iff (x : ChosenBaseQuotient (k := ℚ) D i) :
    letI
proof:
:= chosenBaseIsLocalRing (k := ℚ) D i
    letI := quotientIsLocalRing (k := ℚ) S hS hd hl
    x ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (ChosenBaseQuotient (k := ℚ) D i) ↔
      E x ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (FinitePolynomialQuotient ℚ S) := by
  letI := chosenBaseIsLocalRing (k := ℚ) D i
  letI := quotientIsLocalRing (k := ℚ) S hS hd hl
  simp only [IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal, mem_nonunits_iff]
  exact not_iff_not.mpr (MulEquiv.isUnit_map (f := E.toRingEquiv.toMulEquiv)).symm

name: P23.Semigroup.chosenCanonical_socle_mem_iff
statement:
theorem chosenCanonical_socle_mem_iff (x : ChosenBaseQuotient (k := ℚ) D i) :
    x ∈ ChosenBaseSocle (k := ℚ) D i ↔ E x ∈ QuotientSocle (k := ℚ) S hS hd hl
proof:
:= by
  letI := chosenBaseIsLocalRing (k := ℚ) D i
  letI := quotientIsLocalRing (k := ℚ) S hS hd hl
  constructor
  · intro hx r hr
    have hr' := (chosenCanonical_maximal_mem_iff S hS hd hl E (E.symm r)).mpr
      (by simpa using hr)
    have hz := congrArg E (hx (E.symm r) hr')
    simpa using hz
  · intro hx r hr
    apply E.injective
    simpa using hx (E r) ((chosenCanonical_maximal_mem_iff S hS hd hl E r).mp hr)
