statement: theorem chosenCanonical_type_eq : quotientType ℚ S hS hd hl = chosenBaseType (k := ℚ) D i

:=

name: P23.Semigroup.chosenCanonicalOmegaEquiv_smul
statement:
theorem chosenCanonicalOmegaEquiv_smul (x : ChosenBaseQuotient (k := ℚ) D i)
    (φ : ChosenBaseOmega ℚ D i) :
    chosenCanonicalOmegaEquiv S E (x • φ) = E x • chosenCanonicalOmegaEquiv S E φ
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro r
  change φ (x * E.symm r) = φ (E.symm (E x * r))
  congr 1
  simp

name: P23.Semigroup.chosenCanonicalOmegaEquiv_symm_smul
statement:
theorem chosenCanonicalOmegaEquiv_symm_smul (x : FinitePolynomialQuotient ℚ S)
    (ψ : QuotientOmega ℚ S) :
    (chosenCanonicalOmegaEquiv S E).symm (x • ψ) =
      E.symm x • (chosenCanonicalOmegaEquiv S E).symm ψ
proof:
:= by
  apply (chosenCanonicalOmegaEquiv S E).injective
  rw [chosenCanonicalOmegaEquiv_smul]
  simp

name: P23.Semigroup.chosenCanonical_trace_mem_iff
statement:
theorem chosenCanonical_trace_mem_iff (x : ChosenBaseQuotient (k := ℚ) D i) :
    x ∈ ChosenBaseTraceSubmodule (k := ℚ) D i ↔ E x ∈ QuotientTraceSubmodule ℚ S
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hx
    refine Submodule.iSup_induction
      (fun F : ChosenBaseOmega ℚ D i →ₗ[ChosenBaseQuotient (k := ℚ) D i] ChosenBaseQuotient (k := ℚ) D i => F.range)
      (motive := fun x => E x ∈ QuotientTraceSubmodule ℚ S) hx ?_ (by simp) ?_
    · intro F x hx
      obtain ⟨φ,rfl⟩ := hx
      exact quotientTrace_range_le S (pushChosenCanonicalHom S E F)
        ⟨chosenCanonicalOmegaEquiv S E φ, by simp [pushChosenCanonicalHom]⟩
    · intro x y hx hy; simpa using (QuotientTraceSubmodule ℚ S).add_mem hx hy
  · intro hx
    have hback : E.symm (E x) ∈ ChosenBaseTraceSubmodule (k := ℚ) D i := by
      refine Submodule.iSup_induction
        (fun F : QuotientOmega ℚ S →ₗ[FinitePolynomialQuotient ℚ S] FinitePolynomialQuotient ℚ S => F.range)
        (motive := fun x => E.symm x ∈ ChosenBaseTraceSubmodule (k := ℚ) D i) hx ?_ (by simp) ?_
      · intro F x hx
        obtain ⟨ψ,rfl⟩ := hx
        exact chosenBaseTrace_range_le D i (pullChosenCanonicalHom S E F)
          ⟨(chosenCanonicalOmegaEquiv S E).symm ψ, by simp [pullChosenCanonicalHom]⟩
      · intro x y hx hy; simpa using (ChosenBaseTraceSubmodule (k := ℚ) D i).add_mem hx hy
    simpa using hback

name: P23.Semigroup.chosenCanonical_ng_iff
statement:
theorem chosenCanonical_ng_iff : ChosenBaseNearlyGorenstein (k := ℚ) D i ↔
    QuotientNearlyGorenstein ℚ S hS hd hl
proof:
:= by
  unfold ChosenBaseNearlyGorenstein QuotientNearlyGorenstein
  letI := chosenBaseIsLocalRing (k := ℚ) D i
  letI := quotientIsLocalRing (k := ℚ) S hS hd hl
  constructor
  · intro h x hx
    have hm := (chosenCanonical_maximal_mem_iff S hS hd hl E (E.symm x)).mpr (by simpa using hx)
    have ht := (chosenCanonical_trace_mem_iff S E (E.symm x)).mp (h hm)
    simpa using ht
  · intro h x hx
    exact (chosenCanonical_trace_mem_iff S E x).mpr
      (h ((chosenCanonical_maximal_mem_iff S hS hd hl E x).mp hx))

name: P23.Semigroup.idealGeneratorMu_eq_minimal_card
statement:
theorem idealGeneratorMu_eq_minimal_card (I : Ideal (ThreePoly ℚ)) (n : ℕ)
    (hmin : HasMinimalGeneratorCard I n) : idealGeneratorMu I = n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨G,hG,hc⟩ := hmin.1
  have hex : ∃ m : ℕ, ∃ H : Finset (ThreePoly ℚ), Ideal.span (↑H : Set (ThreePoly ℚ)) = I ∧ H.card = m :=
    ⟨n,G,hG,hc⟩
  rw [idealGeneratorMu, dif_pos hex]
  apply Nat.le_antisymm
  · exact Nat.find_min' hex ⟨G,hG,hc⟩
  · obtain ⟨H,hH,hcH⟩ := Nat.find_spec hex
    rw [← hcH]
    exact hmin.2 H hH

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.doubleGap_subset_nonFrobeniusPF
statement:
private theorem doubleGap_subset_nonFrobeniusPF (has : D.IsAlmostSymmetric) :
    D.doubleGapFinset⊆D.nonFrobeniusPFFinset
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro a ha
  have hh := Finset.mem_filter.mp ha
  let f : D.PseudoFrobeniusIndex := ⟨a,has a hh.1 hh.2⟩
  have hf : f≠D.frobeniusPF := by
    intro he
    have hv := congrArg Subtype.val he
    change (a:ℤ)=(D.frobenius:ℤ) at hv
    have haf : a=D.frobenius := by exact_mod_cast hv
    have hz : 0∈D.gapFinset := by simpa [haf] using hh.2
    have hn := (D.mem_gapFinset 0).mp hz
    exact hn D.Gamma.zero_mem
  apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
  refine ⟨f,Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hf,Finset.mem_univ f⟩,?_⟩
  simp [pseudoFrobeniusNat,f]

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.almostSymmetric_iff_doubleGap_card
statement:
theorem almostSymmetric_iff_doubleGap_card :
    D.IsAlmostSymmetric ↔ D.doubleGapFinset.card=D.semigroupType-1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro has
    have he := Finset.Subset.antisymm (D.doubleGap_subset_nonFrobeniusPF has)
      D.nonFrobeniusPF_subset_doubleGap
    rw [he,D.nonFrobeniusPF_card]
  · intro hc
    have he : D.nonFrobeniusPFFinset=D.doubleGapFinset :=
      Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le D.nonFrobeniusPF_subset_doubleGap
        (by rw [hc,D.nonFrobeniusPF_card])
    intro a ha hra
    have hd : a∈D.doubleGapFinset := Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨ha,hra⟩
    rw [←he] at hd
    obtain ⟨f,_,hf⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hd
    have hz : f.1=(a:ℤ) := by
      have := congrArg (fun n : ℕ=>(n:ℤ)) hf
      simpa using this
    exact hz ▸ f.2

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.almostSymmetric_iff_two_genus_eq

theorem almostSymmetric_iff_two_genus_eq :
    D.IsAlmostSymmetric ↔ 2*D.genus=D.frobenius+D.semigroupType
proof:
:= by

  have hg := D.two_genus_eq_frobenius_one_add_doubleGapCard

  omega

name: P23.Semigroup.aperySocle_pf_degree

theorem aperySocle_pf_degree (s : D.AperySocleIndex i) :
    (s.1.1.1:ℤ)=((D.pseudoFrobeniusEquivAperySocle i).symm s).1+(D.n i:ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  change (s.1.1.1:ℤ)=((s.1.1.1:ℤ)-(D.n i:ℤ))+(D.n i:ℤ)
  ring

name: P23.Semigroup.aperySocle_divides_iff_eq
statement:
theorem aperySocle_divides_iff_eq (w : D.AperyIndex i) (hw : IsAperySocle w)
    (s : D.AperyIndex i) : AperyDivides w s ↔ w=s
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨g,hg⟩
    by_cases hz : g=0
    · apply Subtype.ext; simpa [hz] using hg.symm
    let f := (D.pseudoFrobeniusEquivAperySocle i).symm ⟨w,hw⟩
    obtain ⟨v,hv⟩ := f.2.2 g hz
    have hf := aperySocle_pf_degree (D:=D) (i:=i) ⟨w,hw⟩
    have hg' := congrArg (fun x : D.Gamma => (x.1:ℤ)) hg
    have hnot := s.2
    exfalso
    apply hnot
    refine ⟨v,Subtype.ext ?_⟩
    change s.1.1=D.n i+v.1
    simp only [AddSubmonoid.coe_add] at hg'
    change (w.1.1:ℤ)=f.1+(D.n i:ℤ) at hf
    omega
  · rintro rfl
    exact ⟨0,by simp⟩

name: P23.Semigroup.canonicalRoot_mul_not_standard
statement:
theorem canonicalRoot_mul_not_standard (T : TaggedBudgetOneNormalization D i)
    (s : ↥T.presentation.roots) (j : Fin 3) :
    s.1*coordinateGenerator j∉standardSet T.presentation.roots
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨t,ht,hd⟩
  have hsdiv : s.1∣t := dvd_trans ⟨coordinateGenerator j,rfl⟩ hd
  have he : t=s.1 := by
    by_contra hn
    exact T.presentation.roots_antichain s.1 s.2 t ht (Ne.symm hn) hsdiv
  subst t
  obtain ⟨r,hr⟩ := hd
  have hdeg := congrArg (canonicalDegree T) hr
  rw [canonicalDegree_mul,canonicalDegree_mul,canonicalDegree_coordinateGenerator] at hdeg
  have hp := D.tailGen_positive i (T.presentation.coordinates.sigma.symm j)
  omega

name: P23.Semigroup.canonicalAperyRepresentative_exists
statement:
theorem canonicalAperyRepresentative_exists (T : TaggedBudgetOneNormalization D i)
    (w : D.AperyIndex i) :
    ∃ p, p∈standardSet T.presentation.roots ∧ canonicalDegree T p=w.1.1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u,hu⟩ := exists_tailExponent_of_isApery D i w.2
  refine ⟨canonicalSourceNormal T u,?_,(canonicalSourceNormal_degree T u).trans hu⟩
  apply (chosenBase_canonical_isApery_iff_standard T _).mp
  have he : tailDegreeGamma D i (canonicalTailExponent T (canonicalSourceNormal T u))=w.1 :=
    Subtype.ext ((canonicalSourceNormal_degree T u).trans hu)

name: P23.Semigroup.canonicalAperyRepresentative_degree
statement:

name: P23.Semigroup.canonical_divides_implies_semigroup_divides
statement:
theorem canonical_divides_implies_semigroup_divides (T : TaggedBudgetOneNormalization D i)
    (p s : Normal T.presentation.coordinates.a T.presentation.coordinates.b T.presentation.coordinates.c)
    (hd : p∣s) : ∃ g : D.Gamma,canonicalDegree T s=canonicalDegree T p+g.1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r,rfl⟩ := hd
  exact ⟨tailDegreeGamma D i (canonicalTailExponent T r),canonicalDegree_mul T p r⟩

name: P23.Semigroup.canonical_dominant_actual_decomposition
statement:
theorem canonical_dominant_actual_decomposition (T : TaggedBudgetOneNormalization D i)
    (s : ↥T.presentation.roots) (hd : IsDominantRoot T.presentation.roots s.1)
    (w : D.AperyIndex i) :
    ¬AperyDivides w (canonicalRootAperySocleIndex T s).1 ↔
      IsAperySocle w ∧ w≠(canonicalRootAperySocleIndex T s).1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro hn
    constructor
    · by_contra hw
      let p := canonicalAperyRepresentative T w
      have hpr : p.1∉T.presentation.roots := by
        intro hp
        have hs := (canonicalRootAperySocleIndex T ⟨p.1,hp⟩).2
        have he : (canonicalRootAperySocleIndex T ⟨p.1,hp⟩).1=w := by
          apply Subtype.ext; apply Subtype.ext
          exact canonicalAperyRepresentative_degree T w
        exact hw (he ▸ hs)
      have hdiv : p.1∣s.1 := by
        have hp : p.1∈Normal.divisorDownset s.1 ∪
            (↑(T.presentation.roots.erase s.1) : Set _) :=
          Eq.mp (congrArg (fun U : Set _ => p.1∈U) hd.2) p.2
        rcases hp with hp | hp
        · exact hp
        · exact False.elim (hpr (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hp))
      obtain ⟨g,hg⟩ := canonical_divides_implies_semigroup_divides T p.1 s.1 hdiv
      apply hn
      refine ⟨g,Subtype.ext ?_⟩
      change canonicalDegree T s.1=w.1.1+g.1
      rwa [canonicalAperyRepresentative_degree T w] at hg
    · intro he
      apply hn
      exact (aperySocle_divides_iff_eq w (he.symm ▸ (canonicalRootAperySocleIndex T s).2) _).mpr he
  · rintro ⟨hw,hne⟩ hdiv
    exact hne ((aperySocle_divides_iff_eq w hw _).mp hdiv)

name: P23.Semigroup.semigroupNearlyGorenstein_iff_ngVector
statement:

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.relationsAtDegree_pairwiseDisjoint
statement:
private theorem relationsAtDegree_pairwiseDisjoint
    (R : Finset (SemigroupPresentationRelation D)) :
    ((Finset.univ : Finset D.BettiDegreeIndex) : Set D.BettiDegreeIndex).PairwiseDisjoint
      (fun d => D.relationsAtDegree R d.1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro d _ e _ hde
  change Disjoint (D.relationsAtDegree R d.1)
    (D.relationsAtDegree R e.1)
  rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro r hrd hre
  have hd := (D.mem_relationsAtDegree.mp hrd).2
  have he := (D.mem_relationsAtDegree.mp hre).2
  apply hde
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact hd.symm.trans he

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.sum_relationsAtDegree_card_le
statement:
private theorem sum_relationsAtDegree_card_le
    (R : Finset (SemigroupPresentationRelation D)) :
    (∑ d : D.BettiDegreeIndex, (D.relationsAtDegree R d.1).card) ≤ R.card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let U := (Finset.univ : Finset D.BettiDegreeIndex).biUnion
    (fun d => D.relationsAtDegree R d.1)
  have hU : U ⊆ R := by
    intro r hr
    rcases Finset.mem_biUnion.mp hr with ⟨d, -, hdr⟩
    exact (D.mem_relationsAtDegree.mp hdr).1
  have hcard := Finset.card_biUnion (D.relationsAtDegree_pairwiseDisjoint R)
  change U.card = _ at hcard
  calc
    (∑ d : D.BettiDegreeIndex, (D.relationsAtDegree R d.1).card) =
        U.card := hcard.symm
    _ ≤ R.card := Finset.card_le_card hU

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.globalPresentation_card_lower_bound
statement:
theorem globalPresentation_card_lower_bound
    (R : Finset (SemigroupPresentationRelation D))
    (hR : D.IsSemigroupPresentation (k := ℚ) R) :
    (∑ d : D.BettiDegreeIndex, D.bettiContribution d.1) ≤ R.card
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (∑ d : D.BettiDegreeIndex, D.bettiContribution d.1) ≤
        ∑ d : D.BettiDegreeIndex, (D.relationsAtDegree R d.1).card := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro d _
      exact D.globalPresentation_degree_card_lower_bound R hR d.2
    _ ≤ R.card := D.sum_relationsAtDegree_card_le R

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.semigroupRho_eq_sum_bettiContribution
statement:
theorem semigroupRho_eq_sum_bettiContribution :
    D.semigroupRho =
      ∑ d : D.BettiDegreeIndex, D.bettiContribution d.1
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [← D.globalConnectorFinset_card]
    exact D.semigroupRho_le_of_presentation D.globalConnectorFinset
      D.globalConnectorFinset_isPresentation
  · obtain ⟨R, hR, hcard⟩ := D.semigroupRho_spec
    rw [← hcard]
    exact D.globalPresentation_card_lower_bound R hR

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.budgetDegreeToBetti_injective
statement:
private theorem budgetDegreeToBetti_injective :
    Function.Injective D.budgetDegreeToBetti
proof:

  intro d e h
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact congrArg (fun z : D.BettiDegreeIndex => z.1) h

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.fourBaseBudget_le_rho
statement:
theorem fourBaseBudget_le_rho (i : Fin 4) :
    D.fourBaseBudget i ≤ D.semigroupRho
proof:
:= by
  rw [D.semigroupRho_eq_sum_bettiContribution]
  calc
    D.fourBaseBudget i ≤
        ∑ d : D.BudgetDegree, D.bettiContribution d.1 := by
      unfold fourBaseBudget
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro d _
      split <;> omega
    _ = ((Finset.univ : Finset D.BudgetDegree).image
          D.budgetDegreeToBetti).sum (fun e => D.bettiContribution e.1) := by
      symm
      rw [Finset.sum_image]
      · rfl
      · intro a _ b _ hab
        exact D.budgetDegreeToBetti_injective hab
    _ ≤ ∑ d : D.BettiDegreeIndex, D.bettiContribution d.1 := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
      · exact Finset.image_subset_iff.mpr fun _ _ => Finset.mem_univ _
      · intro _ _ _
        exact Nat.zero_le _

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.globalToricPresentationBridge
statement:
theorem globalToricPresentationBridge : D.GlobalToricPresentationBridge where
  connectorGeneration
proof:
:= fun k _ =>
    D.toricIdeal_eq_span_globalConnectorBinomials (k := k)
  finitePresentation := D.exists_finite_semigroupPresentation
  finiteBetti := D.finite_bettiDegrees
  connectorPresentation := fun k _ =>
    D.globalConnectorFinset_isPresentation (k := k)
  connectorCard := D.globalConnectorFinset_card
  universalLower := fun R hR => D.globalPresentation_card_lower_bound R hR
  rhoFormula := D.semigroupRho_eq_sum_bettiContribution
  budgetCompatibility := fun i => D.fourBaseBudget_le_rho i

name: P23.Semigroup.canonicalTailExponent_degree
statement:
theorem canonicalTailExponent_degree (T : TaggedBudgetOneNormalization D i)
    (p : Normal T.presentation.coordinates.a T.presentation.coordinates.b
      T.presentation.coordinates.c) :
    tailDegree D i (canonicalTailExponent T p) =
      T.presentation.coordinates.coordinateDegree (normalExponent p)
proof: := rfl

name: P23.Semigroup.canonicalTailExponent_rename
statement:
theorem canonicalTailExponent_rename (T : TaggedBudgetOneNormalization D i)
    (p : Normal T.presentation.coordinates.a T.presentation.coordinates.b
      T.presentation.coordinates.c) :
    (canonicalTailExponent T p).mapDomain T.presentation.coordinates.sigma = normalExponent p
proof:
:= by
  unfold canonicalTailExponent
  have he : T.presentation.coordinates.sigma ∘ T.presentation.coordinates.sigma.symm = id := by
    funext j; simp
  rw [← Finsupp.mapDomain_comp, he, Finsupp.mapDomain_id]

name: P23.Semigroup.chosenBase_canonical_isApery_iff_standard
statement:
theorem chosenBase_canonical_isApery_iff_standard (T : TaggedBudgetOneNormalization D i)
    (p : Normal T.presentation.coordinates.a T.presentation.coordinates.b
      T.presentation.coordinates.c) :
    D.IsApery i (tailDegreeGamma D i (canonicalTailExponent T p)) ↔
      p ∈ standardSet T.presentation.roots
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let B := T.presentation
  let C := B.coordinates
  let e := canonicalTailExponent T p
  have hm : MvPolynomial.monomial e (1 : ℚ) ∈ chosenBaseDefiningIdeal (k := ℚ) D i ↔
      monomial (k := ℚ) p ∈ normalGeneratorIdeal B.generators := by
    rw [← renamedChosenBaseIdeal_mem_iff C,
      ← normalGeneratorIdeal_comap_of_raw_span C B.rawExponents B.spanEq]
    change polyToNormalAlg (a := C.a) (b := C.b) (c := C.c)
      (renameToOneTie C (MvPolynomial.monomial e (1 : ℚ))) ∈ normalGeneratorIdeal B.generators ↔
        monomial (k := ℚ) p ∈ normalGeneratorIdeal B.generators
    simp only [renameToOneTie, MvPolynomial.renameEquiv_apply, MvPolynomial.rename_monomial,
      polyToNormalAlg_monomial, one_smul]
    rw [show e.mapDomain C.sigma = normalExponent p from canonicalTailExponent_rename T p,
      normalizeExponent_normalExponent]
  have hk : TailInK D i (tailDegree D i e) ↔ p ∉ standardSet B.roots := by
    rw [← tail_monomial_mem_chosenBaseDefiningIdeal_iff (k := ℚ) D i e, hm]
    simpa only [not_not] using not_congr (B.survivor_iff_standard p)
  constructor
  · intro ha
    by_contra hp
    obtain ⟨_,γ,hγ⟩ := hk.mpr hp
    exact ha ⟨γ,Subtype.ext hγ⟩
  · intro hp
    rintro ⟨γ,hγ⟩
    apply hk.mp ⟨⟨e,rfl⟩,γ,congrArg Subtype.val hγ⟩ hp

name: P23.Semigroup.canonicalDegree_mul
statement:
theorem canonicalDegree_mul (T : TaggedBudgetOneNormalization D i)
    (p q : Normal T.presentation.coordinates.a T.presentation.coordinates.b
      T.presentation.coordinates.c) : canonicalDegree T (p*q) = canonicalDegree T p + canonicalDegree T q
proof:
:= by
  let C := T.presentation.coordinates
  have he : normalizeExponent C.a C.b C.c (normalExponent p + normalExponent q) = p*q := by
    rw [normalizeExponent_add]; simp
  change C.coordinateDegree (normalExponent (p*q)) =
    C.coordinateDegree (normalExponent p) + C.coordinateDegree (normalExponent q)
  rw [←he, C.normalize_preserves_coordinateDegree]
  simp [OneTieCoordinates.coordinateDegree, Finsupp.mapDomain_add, tailDegree_add]

name: P23.Semigroup.canonicalDegree_one
statement: theorem canonicalDegree_one (T : TaggedBudgetOneNormalization D i) : canonicalDegree T 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [canonicalDegree,canonicalTailExponent,normalExponent]

name: P23.Semigroup.canonicalDegree_coordinateGenerator
statement:
theorem canonicalDegree_coordinateGenerator (T : TaggedBudgetOneNormalization D i) (j : Fin 3) :
    canonicalDegree T (coordinateGenerator j) = D.tailGen i (T.presentation.coordinates.sigma.symm j)
proof:
:= by
  have ha : T.presentation.coordinates.a ≠ 1 := by
    have := T.presentation.coordinates.liveDomain.1; omega
  change T.presentation.coordinates.coordinateDegree (normalExponent (coordinateGenerator j)) = _
  rw [T.presentation.coordinates.coordinateDegree_formula]
  fin_cases j <;> simp [coordinateGenerator, Normal.xGenerator, Normal.yGenerator, Normal.zGenerator, ha]

name: P23.Semigroup.normal_coordinate_power_product
statement:
theorem normal_coordinate_power_product {a b c : ℕ} [NeZero a] (p : Normal a b c) :
    Normal.xGenerator^p.x * Normal.yGenerator^p.y * Normal.zGenerator^p.z = p
proof:
:= by
  have mpow (q : Normal a b c) (n : ℕ) :
      monomial (k := ℚ) q ^ n = monomial (k := ℚ) (q^n) := by
    induction n with
    | zero => simp
    | succ n ih => simp [pow_succ,ih]
  have hx : MvPolynomial.monomial (normalExponent p) (1 : ℚ) =
      polyX^p.x * polyY^p.y * polyZ^p.z := by
    simp [normalExponent,polyX,polyY,polyZ,MvPolynomial.X_pow_eq_monomial,
      MvPolynomial.monomial_mul]
  have hh := polyToNormalAlg_normalExponent (k := ℚ) p
  rw [hx, map_mul, map_mul, map_pow, map_pow, map_pow,
    polyToNormalAlg_polyX, polyToNormalAlg_polyY, polyToNormalAlg_polyZ,
    mpow,mpow,mpow,monomial_mul,monomial_mul] at hh
  exact MonoidAlgebra.single_left_injective (by norm_num : (1 : ℚ) ≠ 0) hh

name: P23.Semigroup.ResidualDegree.residualDegree_mul
statement:
theorem residualDegree_mul (p q : Normal R.residual.a' R.residual.b' 0) :
    residualDegree R (p*q) = residualDegree R p + residualDegree R q
proof:
:= by
  change canonicalDegree R.tagged (R.residual.normalCoordinates.symm (p*q)) = _
  rw [map_mul,canonicalDegree_mul]
  rfl

name: P23.Semigroup.ResidualDegree.residualDegree_one
statement: theorem residualDegree_one : residualDegree R 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  change canonicalDegree R.tagged (R.residual.normalCoordinates.symm 1) = 0
  rw [map_one,canonicalDegree_one]

name: P23.Semigroup.ResidualDegree.residualDegree_pow
statement:
theorem residualDegree_pow (p : Normal R.residual.a' R.residual.b' 0) (n : ℕ) :
    residualDegree R (p^n) = n * residualDegree R p
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [residualDegree_one]
  | succ n ih => rw [pow_succ,residualDegree_mul,ih]; ring

name: P23.Semigroup.ResidualDegree.residualDegree_coordinateGenerator
statement:
theorem residualDegree_coordinateGenerator (j : Fin 3) :
    residualDegree R (coordinateGenerator j) = D.tailGen i (residualToTail R j)
proof:
:= by
  have he : R.residual.normalCoordinates.symm (coordinateGenerator j) =
      coordinateGenerator (R.residual.coordinatePermutation.symm j) := by
    apply R.residual.normalCoordinates.injective
    rw [MulEquiv.apply_symm_apply,R.residual.variablesCorrespondence]
    simp
  change canonicalDegree R.tagged (R.residual.normalCoordinates.symm (coordinateGenerator j)) = _
  rw [he,canonicalDegree_coordinateGenerator]
  rfl

name: P23.Semigroup.ResidualDegree.residualDegree_formula
statement:
theorem residualDegree_formula (p : Normal R.residual.a' R.residual.b' 0) :
    residualDegree R p = p.x * D.tailGen i (residualToTail R 0) +
      p.y * D.tailGen i (residualToTail R 1) + p.z * D.tailGen i (residualToTail R 2)
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [←normal_coordinate_power_product p]
  rw [residualDegree_mul,residualDegree_mul,
    residualDegree_pow,residualDegree_pow,residualDegree_pow]
  change _ = _
  have h0 := residualDegree_coordinateGenerator R 0
  have h1 := residualDegree_coordinateGenerator R 1
  have h2 := residualDegree_coordinateGenerator R 2
  change residualDegree R Normal.xGenerator = _ at h0
  change residualDegree R Normal.yGenerator = _ at h1
  change residualDegree R Normal.zGenerator = _ at h2
  rw [h0,h1,h2]

name: P23.Semigroup.ResidualDegree.residual_weighted_tie
statement:
theorem residual_weighted_tie :
    R.residual.a' * D.tailGen i (residualToTail R 0) =
      R.residual.b' * D.tailGen i (residualToTail R 1)
proof:
:= by
  have he : (Normal.xGenerator : Normal R.residual.a' R.residual.b' 0)^R.residual.a' =
      Normal.yGenerator^R.residual.b' := by
    
    have ht := polyToNormalAlg_tiePolynomial (k := ℚ) (a := R.residual.a') (b := R.residual.b') (c := 0)
    simp only [tiePolynomial,map_sub,map_mul,map_pow,pow_zero,map_one,mul_one,
      polyToNormalAlg_polyX,polyToNormalAlg_polyY,sub_eq_zero] at ht
    have mpow (q : Normal R.residual.a' R.residual.b' 0) (n : ℕ) :
        monomial (k := ℚ) q ^ n = monomial (k := ℚ) (q^n) := by
      induction n with
      | zero => simp
      | succ n ih => simp [pow_succ,ih]
    rw [mpow,mpow] at ht
    exact MonoidAlgebra.single_left_injective (by norm_num : (1 : ℚ) ≠ 0) ht
  have hd := congrArg (residualDegree R) he
  rw [residualDegree_pow,residualDegree_pow] at hd
  have h0 := residualDegree_coordinateGenerator R 0
  have h1 := residualDegree_coordinateGenerator R 1
  change residualDegree R Normal.xGenerator = _ at h0
  change residualDegree R Normal.yGenerator = _ at h1
  rwa [h0,h1] at hd

name: P23.Semigroup.ResidualDegree.residual_isApery_iff_standard
statement:
theorem residual_isApery_iff_standard (p : Normal R.residual.a' R.residual.b' 0) :
    D.IsApery i (tailDegreeGamma D i (residualTailExponent R p)) ↔
      p ∈ standardSet R.residual.roots
proof:
:= by
  rw [residualTailExponent,chosenBase_canonical_isApery_iff_standard]
  have he := R.residual.standardCorrespondence (R.residual.normalCoordinates.symm p)
  simpa using he.symm

name: P23.Semigroup.budgetOneDominantCanonicalRoot
statement:
theorem budgetOneDominantCanonicalRoot (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup) (i : Fin 4)
    (hB : D.fourBaseBudget i=1) (ht : D.semigroupType=2 ∨ D.semigroupType=3)
    (hn : SemigroupNearlyGorenstein D) (hr : D.semigroupType+4≤D.semigroupRho) :
    Nonempty (BudgetOneDominantCanonicalRoot D i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨B⟩ := budgetOneOneTieNormalization D i hB
  have he : B.roots.card=D.semigroupType :=
    (quotientType_eq_rootCard (k:=ℚ) B.roots B.roots_nonempty
      B.coordinates.liveDomain B.roots_live B.roots_antichain).symm.trans
      (B.canonicalOneTieType_eq_chosenBaseType.trans (chosenBaseType_eq_semigroupType D i))
  have hc : B.roots.card=2 ∨ B.roots.card=3 := by rwa [he]
  have hng := B.canonicalOneTie_ng_iff.mp
    (semigroupNearlyGorenstein_to_chosenBaseNearlyGorenstein D i hn)
  have hm : B.roots.card+4 ≤ idealGeneratorMu (finitePresentationIdeal (k:=ℚ) B.roots) := by
    rwa [he,B.canonicalKernelMu_eq_rho]
  obtain ⟨s,hs,hd⟩ := oneTie_ng_kernel_mu_ge_type_plus_four_has_dominant
    B.roots B.roots_nonempty B.coordinates.liveDomain B.roots_live B.roots_antichain hc hng hm
  exact ⟨⟨hB,B,⟨s,hs⟩,hd,hc,he,B.canonicalKernelMu_eq_rho⟩⟩

name: P23.Semigroup.chosenPlain_maximal_mem_iff
statement:
theorem chosenPlain_maximal_mem_iff (x : ChosenBaseQuotient (k := ℚ) D i) :
    letI
proof:
:= chosenBaseIsLocalRing (k := ℚ) D i
    letI := plainIsLocalRing (k := ℚ) R hR
    x ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (ChosenBaseQuotient (k := ℚ) D i) ↔
      E x ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (PlainMonomialArtin ℚ R) := by
  letI := chosenBaseIsLocalRing (k := ℚ) D i
  letI := plainIsLocalRing (k := ℚ) R hR
  simp only [IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal, mem_nonunits_iff]
  exact not_iff_not.mpr (MulEquiv.isUnit_map (f := E.toRingEquiv.toMulEquiv)).symm

name: P23.Semigroup.chosenPlain_socle_mem_iff
statement:
theorem chosenPlain_socle_mem_iff (x : ChosenBaseQuotient (k := ℚ) D i) :
    x ∈ ChosenBaseSocle (k := ℚ) D i ↔ E x ∈ PlainDirectSocle (k := ℚ) R hR
proof:
:= by
  letI := chosenBaseIsLocalRing (k := ℚ) D i
  letI := plainIsLocalRing (k := ℚ) R hR
  have hmax : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (PlainMonomialArtin ℚ R) = plainAugmentationIdeal R hR :=
    plainMaximalIdeal_eq_augmentationIdeal R hR _ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal _)
  constructor
  · intro hx r hr
    have hr' := (chosenPlain_maximal_mem_iff R hR E (E.symm r)).mpr
      (by simpa [hmax] using hr)
    have hz := congrArg E (hx (E.symm r) hr')
    simpa using hz
  · intro hx r hr
    apply E.injective
    simpa using hx (E r) (by simpa [hmax] using (chosenPlain_maximal_mem_iff R hR E r).mp hr)

name: P23.Semigroup.chosenPlain_type_eq
statement: theorem chosenPlain_type_eq : plainDirectType ℚ R hR = chosenBaseType (k := ℚ) D i
proof:
:=
  (chosenPlainSocleEquiv R hR E).finrank_eq.symm

name: P23.Semigroup.chosenPlainOmegaEquiv_smul
statement:
theorem chosenPlainOmegaEquiv_smul (x : ChosenBaseQuotient (k := ℚ) D i)
    (φ : ChosenBaseOmega ℚ D i) :
    chosenPlainOmegaEquiv R E (x • φ) = E x • chosenPlainOmegaEquiv R E φ
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro r
  change φ (x * E.symm r) = φ (E.symm (E x * r))
  congr 1
  simp

name: P23.Semigroup.chosenPlainOmegaEquiv_symm_smul
statement:
theorem chosenPlainOmegaEquiv_symm_smul (x : PlainMonomialArtin ℚ R)
    (ψ : PlainOmega ℚ R) :
    (chosenPlainOmegaEquiv R E).symm (x • ψ) =
      E.symm x • (chosenPlainOmegaEquiv R E).symm ψ
proof:
:= by
  apply (chosenPlainOmegaEquiv R E).injective
  rw [chosenPlainOmegaEquiv_smul]
  simp

name: P23.Semigroup.chosenPlain_trace_mem_iff
statement:
theorem chosenPlain_trace_mem_iff (x : ChosenBaseQuotient (k := ℚ) D i) :
    x ∈ ChosenBaseTraceSubmodule (k := ℚ) D i ↔ E x ∈ PlainTraceSubmodule ℚ R
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hx
    refine Submodule.iSup_induction
      (fun F : ChosenBaseOmega ℚ D i →ₗ[ChosenBaseQuotient (k := ℚ) D i] ChosenBaseQuotient (k := ℚ) D i => F.range)
      (motive := fun x => E x ∈ PlainTraceSubmodule ℚ R) hx ?_ (by simp) ?_
    · intro F x hx
      obtain ⟨φ,rfl⟩ := hx
      exact plainTrace_range_le R (pushChosenPlainHom R E F)
        ⟨chosenPlainOmegaEquiv R E φ, by simp [pushChosenPlainHom]⟩
    · intro x y hx hy; simpa using (PlainTraceSubmodule ℚ R).add_mem hx hy
  · intro hx
    have hback : E.symm (E x) ∈ ChosenBaseTraceSubmodule (k := ℚ) D i := by
      refine Submodule.iSup_induction
        (fun F : PlainOmega ℚ R →ₗ[PlainMonomialArtin ℚ R] PlainMonomialArtin ℚ R => F.range)
        (motive := fun x => E.symm x ∈ ChosenBaseTraceSubmodule (k := ℚ) D i) hx ?_ (by simp) ?_
      · intro F x hx
        obtain ⟨ψ,rfl⟩ := hx
        exact chosenBaseTrace_range_le D i (pullChosenPlainHom R E F)
          ⟨(chosenPlainOmegaEquiv R E).symm ψ, by simp [pullChosenPlainHom]⟩
      · intro x y hx hy; simpa using (ChosenBaseTraceSubmodule (k := ℚ) D i).add_mem hx hy
    simpa using hback

name: P23.Semigroup.chosenPlain_ng_iff
statement:
theorem chosenPlain_ng_iff : ChosenBaseNearlyGorenstein (k := ℚ) D i ↔
    PlainDirectNearlyGorenstein ℚ R hR
proof:
:= by
  unfold ChosenBaseNearlyGorenstein PlainDirectNearlyGorenstein
  letI := chosenBaseIsLocalRing (k := ℚ) D i
  letI := plainIsLocalRing (k := ℚ) R hR
  have hmax : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (PlainMonomialArtin ℚ R) = plainAugmentationIdeal R hR :=
    plainMaximalIdeal_eq_augmentationIdeal R hR _ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal _)
  rw [← hmax]
  constructor
  · intro h x hx
    have hm := (chosenPlain_maximal_mem_iff R hR E (E.symm x)).mpr (by simpa using hx)
    have ht := (chosenPlain_trace_mem_iff R E (E.symm x)).mp (h hm)
    simpa using ht
  · intro h x hx
    exact (chosenPlain_trace_mem_iff R E x).mpr
      (h ((chosenPlain_maximal_mem_iff R hR E x).mp hx))

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.intInGamma_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem intInGamma_zero : IntInGamma D 0
proof: := ⟨0, by simp⟩

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.intInGamma_generator
statement: theorem intInGamma_generator (j : Fin 4) : IntInGamma D (D.n j)
proof:
:=
  ⟨D.generator j, by simp [generator]⟩

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.intInGamma_add
statement:
theorem intInGamma_add {x y : ℤ} (hx : IntInGamma D x)
    (hy : IntInGamma D y) : IntInGamma D (x + y)
proof:
:= by
  rcases hx with ⟨s, rfl⟩
  rcases hy with ⟨t, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨s + t, by simp⟩

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.intInGamma_natCast
statement:
@[simp] theorem intInGamma_natCast (s : ℕ) :
    IntInGamma D (s : ℤ) ↔ s ∈ D.Gamma
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨t, ht⟩
    have hts : t.1 = s := by exact_mod_cast ht
    simpa [hts] using t.2
  · intro hs
    exact ⟨⟨s, hs⟩, rfl⟩

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.exists_generator_add_of_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem exists_generator_add_of_ne_zero (s : D.Gamma) (hs : s ≠ 0) :
    ∃ j : Fin 4, ∃ h : D.Gamma, s = D.generator j + h
proof:
:= by
  rcases (D.mem_Gamma_iff s.1).1 s.2 with ⟨u, hu⟩
  have une : u ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    subst u
    simp at hu
    apply hs
    exact Subtype.ext hu.symm
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Finsupp.ne_iff.mp une
  have hjpos : 0 < u j := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hj
  let v : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ := u - Finsupp.single j 1
  have huv : u = Finsupp.single j 1 + v := by
    apply Finsupp.ext
    intro l
    by_cases hlj : l = j
    · subst l
      simp only [Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.single_eq_same, v,
        Finsupp.tsub_apply]
      omega
    · simp [v, Finsupp.single_apply, hlj]
  have hvGamma : D.weightedDegree v ∈ D.Gamma :=
    (D.mem_Gamma_iff _).2 ⟨v, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨j, ⟨D.weightedDegree v, hvGamma⟩, ?_⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  change s.1 = D.n j + D.weightedDegree v
  rw [← hu, huv]
  change weightedDegreeOf D.n (Finsupp.single j 1 + v) = _
  rw [weightedDegreeOf_add]
  simpa [generatorFactorization] using
    congrArg (fun z => z + D.weightedDegree v)
      (D.weightedDegree_generatorFactorization j)

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.isPseudoFrobenius_iff_generators
statement:
theorem isPseudoFrobenius_iff_generators (f : ℤ) :
    D.IsPseudoFrobenius f ↔
      (¬ IntInGamma D f ∧ ∀ j : Fin 4, IntInGamma D (f + D.n j))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hnot, hpos⟩
    refine ⟨hnot, fun j => hpos (D.generator j) ?_⟩
    intro hz
    have := congrArg Subtype.val hz
    simpa [generator] using (Nat.ne_of_gt (D.positive j) this)
  · rintro ⟨hnot, hgen⟩
    refine ⟨hnot, ?_⟩
    intro s hs
    rcases D.exists_generator_add_of_ne_zero s hs with ⟨j, h, rfl⟩
    have hh : IntInGamma D (h.1 : ℤ) := (D.intInGamma_natCast h.1).2 h.2
    convert D.intInGamma_add (hgen j) hh using 1
    simp only [generator]
    push_cast
    ring

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.pfToApery_val
statement:
private theorem pfToApery_val (i : Fin 4) (f : D.PseudoFrobeniusIndex) :
    ((D.pfToApery i f).1.1 : ℤ) = f.1 + D.n i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [pfToApery]
  exact Classical.choose_spec
    ((D.isPseudoFrobenius_iff_generators f.1).1 f.2 |>.2 i)

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.pfToApery_injective
statement:
private theorem pfToApery_injective (i : Fin 4) :
    Function.Injective (D.pfToApery i)
proof:
:= by
  intro f g h
  apply Subtype.ext
  have hv := congrArg (fun s : D.AperyIndex i => (s.1.1 : ℤ)) h
  rw [D.pfToApery_val i f, D.pfToApery_val i g] at hv
  omega

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.pseudoFrobenius_card_eq_aperySocle_card
statement:
theorem pseudoFrobenius_card_eq_aperySocle_card (i : Fin 4) :
    Fintype.card (D.AperySocleIndex i) = D.semigroupType
proof:
:= by
  rw [semigroupType, Fintype.card_congr (D.pseudoFrobeniusEquivAperySocle i)]

name: P23.Semigroup.tailVariableA_mul_A_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem tailVariableA_mul_A_eq_zero_iff (s : D.AperyIndex i) (j : Fin 3) :
    tailVariableA (k := k) D i j * A (k := k) s.1 s.2 = 0 ↔
      ¬ D.IsApery i (s.1 + D.tail i j)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change A (k := k) (D.tail i j) (D.tail_isApery i j) *
      A (k := k) s.1 s.2 = 0 ↔ _
  rw [A_mul_A]
  by_cases h : D.IsApery i (D.tail i j + s.1)
  · rw [dif_pos h]
    have h' : D.IsApery i (s.1 + D.tail i j) := by simpa [add_comm] using h
    constructor
    · intro hz
      have hc := congrArg (fun x : AperyArtin k D i =>
        x.coeff ⟨D.tail i j + s.1, h⟩) hz
      simp [coeff_A] at hc
    · intro hn
      exact (hn h').elim
  · have h' : ¬ D.IsApery i (s.1 + D.tail i j) := by simpa [add_comm] using h
    simp [h, h']

name: P23.Semigroup.tailVariableA_pow_eq
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n hn =>
      rw [pow_succ, hn, ← truncatedAperyMonomial_tail,
        ← truncatedAperyMonomial_add]
      congr 2
      rw [add_nsmul]
      simp [add_comm]

name: P23.Semigroup.tailVariableA_isNilpotent
statement:
theorem tailVariableA_isNilpotent (j : Fin 3) :
    IsNilpotent (tailVariableA (k := k) D i j)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨D.conductor + D.n i, ?_⟩
  rw [tailVariableA_pow_eq]
  simp only [truncatedAperyMonomial]
  split
  · rename_i h
    have hb := D.isApery_lt i h
    have htail : 0 < (D.tail i j).1 := D.tailGen_positive i j
    have hv : (D.conductor + D.n i) ≤
        ((D.conductor + D.n i) • D.tail i j).1 := by
      change D.conductor + D.n i ≤
        (D.conductor + D.n i) * (D.tail i j).1
      exact Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ htail
    omega
  · rfl

name: P23.Semigroup.aperyAugmentationAlgHom_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem aperyAugmentationAlgHom_apply (x : AperyArtin k D i) :
    aperyAugmentationAlgHom (k := k) D i x =
      aperyConstantCoeff (k := k) D i x
proof: := rfl

name: P23.Semigroup.apery_basis_expansion
statement:
theorem apery_basis_expansion (x : AperyArtin k D i) :
    x = x.coeff.sum fun s r => r • A (k := k) s.1 s.2
proof:
:= by
  induction x using AperyArtin.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add x y hx hy =>
      rw [AperyArtin.coeff_add,
        Finsupp.sum_add_index'
          (fun a => zero_smul k (A (k := k) a.1 a.2))
          (fun a b₁ b₂ => add_smul b₁ b₂ (A (k := k) a.1 a.2)),
        ← hx, ← hy]
  | single s r =>
      change AperyArtin.mk (Finsupp.single s r) =
        (Finsupp.single s r).sum fun t c => c • A (k := k) t.1 t.2
      rw [Finsupp.sum_single_index]
      · exact (AperyArtin.smul_A (k := k) r s.1 s.2).symm
      · simp

name: P23.Semigroup.mem_aperyAugmentationIdeal_of_constantCoeff_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem mem_aperyAugmentationIdeal_of_constantCoeff_eq_zero
    (x : AperyArtin k D i) (hx : aperyConstantCoeff (k := k) D i x = 0) :
    x ∈ aperyAugmentationIdeal (k := k) D i
proof:
:= by
  rw [apery_basis_expansion (k := k) D i x]
  apply Submodule.sum_mem
  intro s hs
  by_cases hs0 : s.1 = 0
  · have se : s = ⟨0, D.zero_isApery i⟩ := Subtype.ext hs0
    subst s
    have hc : x.coeff ⟨0, D.zero_isApery i⟩ = 0 := hx
    simp [hc]
  · simpa [Algebra.smul_def] using
      (aperyAugmentationIdeal (k := k) D i).mul_mem_left
        (algebraMap k (AperyArtin k D i) (x.coeff s))
        (A_mem_aperyAugmentationIdeal (k := k) D i s hs0)

name: P23.Semigroup.aperyAugmentationAlgHom_ker
statement:
theorem aperyAugmentationAlgHom_ker :
    RingHom.ker (aperyAugmentationAlgHom (k := k) D i).toRingHom =
      aperyAugmentationIdeal (k := k) D i
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x hx
    exact mem_aperyAugmentationIdeal_of_constantCoeff_eq_zero
      (k := k) D i x hx
  · rw [aperyAugmentationIdeal_eq_tailVariableIdeal, tailVariableIdeal,
      Ideal.span_le]
    rintro x ⟨j, rfl⟩
    change aperyConstantCoeff (k := k) D i
      (tailVariableA (k := k) D i j) = 0
    simp [tailVariableA, aperyConstantCoeff_A]
    intro h
    have hv := congrArg Subtype.val h
    simpa [FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.tail,
      FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.generator] using
      (Nat.ne_of_gt (D.tailGen_positive i j) hv)

name: P23.Semigroup.aperyAugmentationAlgHom_surjective
statement:
theorem aperyAugmentationAlgHom_surjective :
    Function.Surjective (aperyAugmentationAlgHom (k := k) D i)
proof:
:= by
  intro r
  exact ⟨algebraMap k (AperyArtin k D i) r,
    (aperyAugmentationAlgHom (k := k) D i).commutes r⟩

name: P23.Semigroup.aperyAugmentationIdeal_isMaximal
statement:
theorem aperyAugmentationIdeal_isMaximal :
    (aperyAugmentationIdeal (k := k) D i).IsMaximal
proof:
:= by
  rw [← aperyAugmentationAlgHom_ker (k := k) D i]
  exact RingHom.ker_isMaximal_of_surjective
    (aperyAugmentationAlgHom (k := k) D i).toRingHom
    (aperyAugmentationAlgHom_surjective (k := k) D i)

name: P23.Semigroup.aperyMaximalIdeal_eq_augmentationIdeal
statement:
theorem aperyMaximalIdeal_eq_augmentationIdeal
    (I : Ideal (AperyArtin k D i)) (hI : I.IsMaximal) :
    I = aperyAugmentationIdeal (k := k) D i
proof:
:= by
  have htail : tailVariableIdeal (k := k) D i ≤ I := by
    rw [tailVariableIdeal, Ideal.span_le]
    rintro x ⟨j, rfl⟩
    exact (nilpotent_iff_mem_prime.mp
      (tailVariableA_isNilpotent (k := k) D i j)) I hI.isPrime
  have haug : aperyAugmentationIdeal (k := k) D i ≤ I := by
    rw [aperyAugmentationIdeal_eq_tailVariableIdeal]
    exact htail
  exact (aperyAugmentationIdeal_isMaximal (k := k) D i).eq_of_le
    hI.ne_top haug |>.symm

name: P23.Semigroup.aperyIsLocalRing
statement: theorem aperyIsLocalRing : IsLocalRing (AperyArtin k D i)
proof:
:= by
  apply IsLocalRing.of_unique_max_ideal
  exact ⟨aperyAugmentationIdeal (k := k) D i,
    aperyAugmentationIdeal_isMaximal (k := k) D i,
    fun I hI => aperyMaximalIdeal_eq_augmentationIdeal (k := k) D i I hI⟩

name: P23.Semigroup.mem_aperySocle_iff_tail_variables
statement:
theorem mem_aperySocle_iff_tail_variables (x : AperyArtin k D i) :
    x ∈ AperySocle (k := k) D i ↔
      ∀ j : Fin 3, tailVariableA (k := k) D i j * x = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hx j
    exact hx _ (tailVariableA_mem_aperyAugmentationIdeal (k := k) D i j)
  · intro hx r hr
    rw [aperyAugmentationIdeal_eq_tailVariableIdeal] at hr
    let K : Ideal (AperyArtin k D i) :=
      { carrier := {z | z * x = 0}
        zero_mem' := by simp
        add_mem' := by
          intro a b ha hb
          change (a + b) * x = 0
          rw [add_mul, ha, hb, add_zero]
        smul_mem' := by
          intro a b hb
          change (a * b) * x = 0
          rw [mul_assoc, hb, mul_zero] }
    have hle : tailVariableIdeal (k := k) D i ≤ K := by
      rw [tailVariableIdeal, Ideal.span_le]
      rintro z ⟨j, rfl⟩
      exact hx j
    exact hle hr

name: P23.Semigroup.A_mem_aperySocle_iff
statement:
theorem A_mem_aperySocle_iff (s : D.AperyIndex i) :
    A (k := k) s.1 s.2 ∈ AperySocle (k := k) D i ↔
      ∀ j : Fin 3, ¬ D.IsApery i (s.1 + D.tail i j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_aperySocle_iff_tail_variables]
  constructor
  · intro h j
    exact (tailVariableA_mul_A_eq_zero_iff (k := k) D i s j).1 (h j)
  · intro h j
    exact (tailVariableA_mul_A_eq_zero_iff (k := k) D i s j).2 (h j)

name: P23.Semigroup.coeff_tail_mul
statement:
private theorem coeff_tail_mul (x : AperyArtin k D i)
    (p : D.AperyIndex i) (j : Fin 3)
    (hpt : D.IsApery i (p.1 + D.tail i j)) :
    (tailVariableA (k := k) D i j * x).coeff
        ⟨p.1 + D.tail i j, hpt⟩ = x.coeff p
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction x using AperyArtin.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add x y hx hy => simpa [mul_add] using congrArg₂ (· + ·) hx hy
  | single q r =>
      rw [← AperyArtin.smul_A (k := k) r q.1 q.2, mul_smul_comm]
      change (r • (A (k := k) (D.tail i j) (D.tail_isApery i j) *
        A (k := k) q.1 q.2)).coeff _ = _
      rw [A_mul_A]
      by_cases hq : D.IsApery i (D.tail i j + q.1)
      · rw [dif_pos hq]
        simp only [AperyArtin.coeff_smul, coeff_A, Finsupp.smul_apply,
          smul_eq_mul]
        by_cases hpq : p = q
        · subst q
          simp [add_comm]
        · have hne : (p.1 + D.tail i j) ≠ (D.tail i j + q.1) := by
            intro he
            apply hpq
            apply Subtype.ext
            have he' : p.1 + D.tail i j = q.1 + D.tail i j := by
              simpa [add_comm] using he
            exact add_right_cancel he'
          have hval : p.1 ≠ q.1 := fun hv => hpq (Subtype.ext hv)
          simp [hne, hval]
      · have hpq : p ≠ q := by
          intro he
          subst q
          exact hq (by simpa [add_comm] using hpt)
        simp [hq, hpq]

name: P23.Semigroup.coeff_eq_zero_of_mem_aperySocle_of_not_index
statement:
private theorem coeff_eq_zero_of_mem_aperySocle_of_not_index
    (x : AperyArtin k D i) (hx : x ∈ AperySocle (k := k) D i)
    (p : D.AperyIndex i)
    (hp : ¬ ∀ j : Fin 3, ¬ D.IsApery i (p.1 + D.tail i j)) :
    x.coeff p = 0
proof:
:= by
  push_neg at hp
  rcases hp with ⟨j, hpj⟩
  have hz := (mem_aperySocle_iff_tail_variables (k := k) D i x).1 hx j
  rw [← coeff_tail_mul (k := k) D i x p j hpj, hz]
  simp

name: P23.Semigroup.aperySocle_eq_rootSpan
statement:
theorem aperySocle_eq_rootSpan :
    AperySocle (k := k) D i = aperySocleRootSpan (k := k) D i
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x hx
    rw [apery_basis_expansion (k := k) D i x]
    apply Submodule.sum_mem
    intro p hpSupport
    by_cases hp : ∀ j : Fin 3, ¬ D.IsApery i (p.1 + D.tail i j)
    · apply Submodule.smul_mem
      apply Submodule.subset_span
      exact ⟨⟨p, hp⟩, rfl⟩
    · have hc := coeff_eq_zero_of_mem_aperySocle_of_not_index
        (k := k) D i x hx p hp
      simp [hc]
  · apply Submodule.span_le.2
    rintro x ⟨s, rfl⟩
    exact (A_mem_aperySocle_iff (k := k) D i s.1).2 s.2

name: P23.Semigroup.aperySocleBasisIndex_injective
statement:
private theorem aperySocleBasisIndex_injective :
    Function.Injective (aperySocleBasisIndex D i)
proof: := Subtype.val_injective

name: P23.Semigroup.aperySocleBasis_linearIndependent
statement:
theorem aperySocleBasis_linearIndependent :
    LinearIndependent k (aperySocleBasisVector (k := k) D i)
proof:
:= by
  change LinearIndependent k
    ((AperyArtin.aperyBasis (k := k) (D := D) (i := i)) ∘
      aperySocleBasisIndex D i)
  exact (AperyArtin.aperyBasis (k := k) (D := D) (i := i)).linearIndependent.comp
    (aperySocleBasisIndex D i) (aperySocleBasisIndex_injective D i)

name: P23.Semigroup.aperyType_eq_semigroupType
statement:
theorem aperyType_eq_semigroupType :
    aperyType (k := k) D i = D.semigroupType
proof:
:= by
  rw [aperyType, ← pseudoFrobenius_card_eq_aperySocle_card D i,
    ← Module.finrank_eq_card_basis (aperySocleBasis (k := k) D i)]

name: P23.Semigroup.chosenBaseIsLocalRing
statement: theorem chosenBaseIsLocalRing : IsLocalRing (ChosenBaseQuotient (k := k) D i)
proof:
:= by
  letI := aperyIsLocalRing (k := k) D i
  exact RingEquiv.isLocalRing (chosenBaseEquivApery (k := k) D i).symm.toRingEquiv

name: P23.Semigroup.chosenBaseMaximalIdeal_eq_augmentationIdeal
statement:
theorem chosenBaseMaximalIdeal_eq_augmentationIdeal :
    letI
proof:
:= chosenBaseIsLocalRing (k := k) D i
    IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (ChosenBaseQuotient (k := k) D i) =
      chosenBaseAugmentationIdeal (k := k) D i := by
  letI := chosenBaseIsLocalRing (k := k) D i
  have hmax : (chosenBaseAugmentationIdeal (k := k) D i).IsMaximal :=
    (aperyAugmentationIdeal_isMaximal (k := k) D i).comap_bijective
      (chosenBaseEquivApery (k := k) D i).toRingHom
      (chosenBaseEquivApery (k := k) D i).bijective
  exact (IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal hmax).symm

name: P23.Semigroup.mem_chosenBaseSocle_iff_equiv_mem_aperySocle
statement:
theorem mem_chosenBaseSocle_iff_equiv_mem_aperySocle
    (x : ChosenBaseQuotient (k := k) D i) :
    x ∈ ChosenBaseSocle (k := k) D i ↔
      chosenBaseEquivApery (k := k) D i x ∈ AperySocle (k := k) D i
proof:
:= by
  let E := chosenBaseEquivApery (k := k) D i
  letI := chosenBaseIsLocalRing (k := k) D i
  change (∀ r ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal
      (ChosenBaseQuotient (k := k) D i), r * x = 0) ↔
    (∀ r ∈ aperyAugmentationIdeal (k := k) D i, r * E x = 0)
  rw [chosenBaseMaximalIdeal_eq_augmentationIdeal (k := k) D i]
  constructor
  · intro hx r hr
    let q := E.symm r
    have hq : q ∈ chosenBaseAugmentationIdeal (k := k) D i := by
      simpa [q, E, chosenBaseAugmentationIdeal] using hr
    have hz := hx q hq
    have := congrArg E hz
    simpa [q, E] using this
  · intro hx r hr
    have hEr : E r ∈ aperyAugmentationIdeal (k := k) D i := hr
    have hz := hx (E r) hEr
    apply E.injective
    simpa [E] using hz

name: P23.Semigroup.chosenBaseType_eq_semigroupType
statement:
theorem chosenBaseType_eq_semigroupType :
    chosenBaseType (k := k) D i = D.semigroupType
proof:
:= by
  rw [chosenBaseType,
    (chosenBaseSocleEquivAperySocle (k := k) D i).finrank_eq,
    ← aperyType, aperyType_eq_semigroupType (k := k) D i]

name: P23.Semigroup.chosenBaseType_eq_three_iff
statement:
theorem chosenBaseType_eq_three_iff :
    chosenBaseType (k := k) D i = 3 ↔ D.semigroupType = 3
proof:
:= by
  rw [chosenBaseType_eq_semigroupType (k := k) D i]

name: P23.Semigroup.chosenBase_plain_exponentPresentation_of_budget_zero
statement:
theorem chosenBase_plain_exponentPresentation_of_budget_zero
    (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup) (i : Fin 4)
    (hB : D.fourBaseBudget i = 0) :
    ∃ G : Finset PlainExp, plainMonomialIdeal ℚ G = chosenBaseDefiningIdeal D i ∧
      G.card = D.semigroupRho ∧ HasMinimalGeneratorCard (plainMonomialIdeal ℚ G) G.card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨H,hspan,hcard,hmono,hmin⟩ :=
    chosenBase_minimalMonomialPresentation_of_budget_zero (k := ℚ) D i hB
  let f : ↥H → PlainExp := fun h => Classical.choose (hmono h.1 h.2)
  have hf (h : ↥H) : MvPolynomial.monomial (f h) (1 : ℚ) = h.1 :=
    (Classical.choose_spec (hmono h.1 h.2)).1.symm
  have hinj : Function.Injective f := by
    intro s t he
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [← hf s,← hf t,he]
  let G : Finset PlainExp := Finset.univ.image f
  have hi : (fun p => MvPolynomial.monomial p (1 : ℚ)) '' (↑G : Set PlainExp) = ↑H := by
    ext p
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨g,hg,rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨h,_,rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hg
      change MvPolynomial.monomial (f h) (1 : ℚ) ∈ H
      rw [hf h]
      exact h.2
    · intro hp
      let h : ↥H := ⟨p,hp⟩
      exact ⟨f h,Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨h,Finset.mem_univ _,rfl⟩,hf h⟩
  have hI : plainMonomialIdeal ℚ G = chosenBaseDefiningIdeal D i := by
    unfold plainMonomialIdeal
    rw [hi]
    exact hspan
  have hc : G.card = D.semigroupRho := by
    dsimp only [G]
    rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ hinj]
    simpa using hcard
  refine ⟨G,hI,hc,?_⟩
  rw [hI,hc]
  exact hmin

name: P23.Semigroup.TaggedBudgetOneNormalization.external_card
statement: theorem external_card : T.externalTags.card = D.semigroupRho - 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [externalBaseConnectorFinset_card, T.budget]

name: P23.Semigroup.TaggedBudgetOneNormalization.raw_external_injective
statement: theorem raw_external_injective : Set.InjOn T.rawOfExternal T.externalTags
proof:
:= by
  intro g hg h hh he
  have hg' : i ∈ D.combinedSupport g.1.1 := by
    simpa [externalBaseConnectorFinset, IsInternalBaseConnector] using hg
  have hh' : i ∈ D.combinedSupport h.1.1 := by
    simpa [externalBaseConnectorFinset, IsInternalBaseConnector] using hh
  have hw : D.connectorRightTail i g = D.connectorRightTail i h :=
    Finsupp.mapDomain_injective T.presentation.coordinates.sigma.injective he
  apply specializedConnectorPolynomial_injective (k := ℚ) D i
  rw [D.specializedConnectorPolynomial_external i g hg',
    D.specializedConnectorPolynomial_external i h hh', hw]

name: P23.Semigroup.TaggedBudgetOneNormalization.normalized_external_injective
statement: theorem normalized_external_injective : Set.InjOn T.normalizedOfExternal T.externalTags
proof:
:= by
  intro g hg h hh he
  apply T.raw_external_injective hg hh
  apply T.presentation.normalization_injective
  · rw [T.raw_eq]; exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨g,hg,rfl⟩
  · rw [T.raw_eq]; exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨h,hh,rfl⟩
  · exact he

name: P23.Semigroup.TaggedBudgetOneNormalization.external_image_exact_border
statement:
theorem external_image_exact_border :
    T.externalTags.image T.normalizedOfExternal = borderFinset T.presentation.roots
proof:
:= by
  rw [← T.presentation.generators_exact_border]
  change _ = T.presentation.rawExponents.image (normalizeExponent _ _ _)
  rw [T.raw_eq, Finset.image_image]
  rfl

name: P23.Semigroup.taggedBudgetOneNormalization
statement:
theorem taggedBudgetOneNormalization (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup) (i : Fin 4)
    (hB : D.fourBaseBudget i = 1) : Nonempty (TaggedBudgetOneNormalization D i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨g,hg,hu⟩ := D.existsUnique_internal_connector_of_budget_one i hB
  let p : TailPoly ℚ := D.specializedConnectorPolynomial i g
  obtain ⟨L⟩ := liveTailTieData_exists D i p
    (D.specializedConnector_isLiveBinomial_of_base_not_mem_support i g hg)
  obtain ⟨C⟩ := oneTieCoordinates_exists L
  let E := (D.externalBaseConnectorFinset i).image
    (fun h => (D.connectorRightTail i h).mapDomain C.sigma)
  have hEinj : Set.InjOn (fun h => (D.connectorRightTail i h).mapDomain C.sigma)
      (D.externalBaseConnectorFinset i) := by
    intro h hh j hj he
    have hh' : i ∈ D.combinedSupport h.1.1 := by
      simpa [externalBaseConnectorFinset, IsInternalBaseConnector] using hh
    have hj' : i ∈ D.combinedSupport j.1.1 := by
      simpa [externalBaseConnectorFinset, IsInternalBaseConnector] using hj
    have hw := Finsupp.mapDomain_injective C.sigma.injective he
    apply specializedConnectorPolynomial_injective (k := ℚ) D i
    rw [D.specializedConnectorPolynomial_external i h hh',
      D.specializedConnectorPolynomial_external i j hj', hw]
  have hcard : E.card = D.semigroupRho - 1 := by
    rw [Finset.card_image_iff.mpr hEinj, D.externalBaseConnectorFinset_card i, hB]
  have hspan : Ideal.span (↑(rawLiftGeneratorFinset C E) : Set (ThreePoly ℚ)) =
      renamedChosenBaseIdeal C := by
    let R := Ideal.span (↑(rawLiftGeneratorFinset C E) : Set (ThreePoly ℚ))
    have he (h : D.BaseAdaptedGlobalConnector i) : renameToOneTie C
        (-MvPolynomial.monomial (D.connectorRightTail i h) 1) =
        -MvPolynomial.monomial ((D.connectorRightTail i h).mapDomain C.sigma) 1 := by
      simp [renameToOneTie, MvPolynomial.rename_monomial]
    apply le_antisymm
    · apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
      intro q hq
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hq with hq | hq
      · subst q
        apply tiePolynomial_mem_renamedChosenBaseIdeal C
        rw [D.chosenBaseDefiningIdeal_eq_span_specializedConnectors i]
        exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨g,rfl⟩
      · obtain ⟨d,hd,rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hq
        obtain ⟨h,hh,rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hd
        have hh' : i ∈ D.combinedSupport h.1.1 := by
          simpa [externalBaseConnectorFinset, IsInternalBaseConnector] using hh
        have hm : D.specializedConnectorPolynomial (k := ℚ) i h ∈ chosenBaseDefiningIdeal D i := by
          rw [D.chosenBaseDefiningIdeal_eq_span_specializedConnectors i]
          exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨h,rfl⟩
        have hi := Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (renameToOneTie C).toRingHom hm
        change renameToOneTie C (D.specializedConnectorPolynomial i h) ∈ renamedChosenBaseIdeal C at hi
        rw [D.specializedConnectorPolynomial_external i h hh', he] at hi
        change MvPolynomial.monomial ((D.connectorRightTail i h).mapDomain C.sigma) 1 ∈
          renamedChosenBaseIdeal C
        simpa only [neg_neg] using neg_mem hi
    · change (chosenBaseDefiningIdeal D i).map (renameToOneTie C).toRingHom ≤ R
      rw [D.chosenBaseDefiningIdeal_eq_span_specializedConnectors i, Ideal.map_span]
      apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
      rintro q ⟨q',⟨h,rfl⟩,rfl⟩
      change renameToOneTie C (D.specializedConnectorPolynomial i h) ∈ R
      by_cases hh : D.IsInternalBaseConnector i h
      · rw [hu h hh]
        change renameToOneTie C p ∈ R
        have ht : tiePolynomial C.a C.b C.c ∈ R :=
          Ideal.subset_span (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)
        rcases renameToOneTie_live C with ht' | ht'
        · rwa [ht']
        · rw [ht']; exact neg_mem ht
      · have hd : (D.connectorRightTail i h).mapDomain C.sigma ∈ E :=
          Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨h, by simp [externalBaseConnectorFinset, hh], rfl⟩
        have hm : MvPolynomial.monomial ((D.connectorRightTail i h).mapDomain C.sigma) 1 ∈ R :=
          Ideal.subset_span (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨_,hd,rfl⟩))
        rw [D.specializedConnectorPolynomial_external i h (not_not.mp hh), he]
        exact neg_mem hm
  have hpos : 0 < D.semigroupRho := by
    have hle : (D.internalBaseConnectorFinset i).card ≤ Fintype.card (D.BaseAdaptedGlobalConnector i) :=
      Finset.card_le_univ _
    rw [D.internalBaseConnectorFinset_card i, hB, D.baseAdaptedGlobalConnector_card_eq_rho i] at hle
    omega
  letI := chosenBase_normal_survivorQuotient_finite C E hspan
  let B : BudgetOneNormalizedPresentation D i :=
    ⟨p,C,E,hspan,hcard,hpos,normal_survivors_finite _⟩
  exact ⟨⟨g,hg,hu,B,rfl,rfl,hB⟩⟩

name: P23.Semigroup.AperyOmega.smul_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem smul_apply (a : AperyArtin k D i) (φ : AperyOmega k D i)
    (x : AperyArtin k D i) : (a • φ) x = φ (a * x)
proof: := rfl

name: P23.Semigroup.aperyBasis_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem aperyBasis_apply (p : D.AperyIndex i) :
    aperyBasis (k := k) (D := D) (i := i) p =
      A (k := k) p.1 p.2
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: P23.Semigroup.AU_apply_A
statement:
@[simp] theorem AU_apply_A (p q : D.AperyIndex i) :
    AU (k := k) D i p (A (k := k) q.1 q.2) =
      if p = q then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← aperyBasis_apply (k := k) D i q]
  simpa [AU, aperyDualBasis] using
    (Module.Basis.dualBasis_apply_self
      (aperyBasis (k := k) (D := D) (i := i)) p q).trans
        (by simp [eq_comm])

name: P23.Semigroup.A_smul_AU_apply_A
statement:
theorem A_smul_AU_apply_A (h p q : D.AperyIndex i) :
    (A (k := k) h.1 h.2 • AU (k := k) D i p)
        (A (k := k) q.1 q.2) =
      if h.1 + q.1 = p.1 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [AperyOmega.smul_apply, A_mul_A]
  by_cases hhq : D.IsApery i (h.1 + q.1)
  · rw [dif_pos hhq]
    let t : D.AperyIndex i := ⟨h.1 + q.1, hhq⟩
    change AU (k := k) D i p (A (k := k) t.1 t.2) = _
    rw [AU_apply_A]
    simp [t, Subtype.ext_iff, eq_comm]
  · have hne : h.1 + q.1 ≠ p.1 := by
      intro he
      apply hhq
      simpa [he] using p.2
    simp [hhq, hne]

name: P23.Semigroup.A_smul_AU_eq_AU
statement:
theorem A_smul_AU_eq_AU (h p q : D.AperyIndex i)
    (hp : h.1 + q.1 = p.1) :
    A (k := k) h.1 h.2 • AU (k := k) D i p = AU (k := k) D i q
proof:
:= by
  apply (aperyBasis (k := k) (D := D) (i := i)).ext
  intro r
  simp only [aperyBasis_apply]
  rw [A_smul_AU_apply_A, AU_apply_A]
  have hiff : h.1 + r.1 = p.1 ↔ r = q := by
    constructor
    · intro hr
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact add_left_cancel (hr.trans hp.symm)
    · rintro rfl
      exact hp
  simp [hiff, eq_comm]

name: P23.Semigroup.A_smul_AU_eq_zero
statement:
theorem A_smul_AU_eq_zero (h p : D.AperyIndex i)
    (hn : ¬ ∃ q : D.AperyIndex i, h.1 + q.1 = p.1) :
    A (k := k) h.1 h.2 • AU (k := k) D i p = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply (aperyBasis (k := k) (D := D) (i := i)).ext
  intro q
  simp only [aperyBasis_apply]
  rw [A_smul_AU_apply_A]
  have hne : h.1 + q.1 ≠ p.1 := fun he => hn ⟨q, he⟩
  simp [hne]

name: P23.Semigroup.exists_aperySocle_above
statement:
theorem exists_aperySocle_above (p : D.AperyIndex i) :
    ∃ s : D.AperySocleIndex i, ∃ h : D.Gamma,
      s.1.1 = p.1 + h
proof:
:= by
  let B := D.conductor + D.n i
  let rec go (p : D.AperyIndex i) :
      ∃ s : D.AperySocleIndex i, ∃ h : D.Gamma,
        s.1.1 = p.1 + h := by
    by_cases hp : ∀ j : Fin 3, ¬ D.IsApery i (p.1 + D.tail i j)
    · exact ⟨⟨p, hp⟩, 0, by simp⟩
    · push_neg at hp
      rcases hp with ⟨j, hpj⟩
      let p' : D.AperyIndex i := ⟨p.1 + D.tail i j, hpj⟩
      have hpBound : p.1.1 < B := D.isApery_lt i p.2
      have hp'Bound : p'.1.1 < B := D.isApery_lt i p'.2
      have htail : 0 < (D.tail i j).1 := D.tailGen_positive i j
      rcases go p' with ⟨s, h, hs⟩
      refine ⟨s, D.tail i j + h, ?_⟩
      rw [hs]
      simp only [p']
      ac_rfl
  termination_by D.conductor + D.n i - p.1.1
  decreasing_by
    simp only [p', AddSubmonoid.coe_add]
    omega
  exact go p

name: P23.Semigroup.reflectionCenter_all_apery
proof:
:= by
  rcases exists_aperySocle_above D i p with ⟨s, h, hs⟩
  have hh : IntInGamma D (h.1 : ℤ) :=
    (D.intInGamma_natCast h.1).2 h.2
  have hadd := D.intInGamma_add (hC s) hh
  convert hadd using 1
  have hsv := congrArg Subtype.val hs
  simp only [AddSubmonoid.coe_add] at hsv
  omega

name: P23.Semigroup.reflectionGamma_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem reflectionGamma_val (C : ℤ)
    (hC : IsAperyReflectionCenter D i C) (p : D.AperyIndex i) :
    ((reflectionGamma D i C hC p).1 : ℤ) = C - (p.1.1 : ℤ)
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec (reflectionCenter_all_apery D i hC p)

name: P23.Semigroup.reflectionLinearMap_AU
statement:
@[simp] theorem reflectionLinearMap_AU (C : ℤ)
    (hC : IsAperyReflectionCenter D i C) (p : D.AperyIndex i) :
    reflectionLinearMap (k := k) D i C hC (AU (k := k) D i p) =
      reflectionMonomial (k := k) D i C hC p
proof:
:= by
  exact Module.Basis.constr_basis (aperyDualBasis (k := k) D i) k
    (fun q => reflectionMonomial (k := k) D i C hC q) p

name: P23.Semigroup.reflection_basis_identity
statement:
private theorem reflection_basis_identity (C : ℤ)
    (hC : IsAperyReflectionCenter D i C)
    (h p : D.AperyIndex i) :
    reflectionLinearMap (k := k) D i C hC
        (A (k := k) h.1 h.2 • AU (k := k) D i p) =
      A (k := k) h.1 h.2 *
        reflectionMonomial (k := k) D i C hC p
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hpred : ∃ q : D.AperyIndex i, h.1 + q.1 = p.1
  · rcases hpred with ⟨q, hq⟩
    rw [A_smul_AU_eq_AU (k := k) D i h p q hq,
      reflectionLinearMap_AU]
    have hAh : truncatedAperyMonomial (k := k) D i h.1 =
        A (k := k) h.1 h.2 := by
      simp [truncatedAperyMonomial, h.2]
    rw [← hAh]
    simp only [reflectionMonomial]
    rw [← truncatedAperyMonomial_add]
    congr 2
    apply Subtype.ext
    have hpq := congrArg Subtype.val hq
    have hrp := reflectionGamma_val D i C hC p
    have hrq := reflectionGamma_val D i C hC q
    simp only [AddSubmonoid.coe_add] at hpq ⊢
    exact_mod_cast (show
      ((reflectionGamma D i C hC q).1 : ℤ) =
        (h.1.1 : ℤ) + (reflectionGamma D i C hC p).1 by omega)
  · rw [A_smul_AU_eq_zero (k := k) D i h p hpred, map_zero]
    have hnot : ¬ D.IsApery i
        (h.1 + reflectionGamma D i C hC p) := by
      intro hsurv
      let t : D.AperyIndex i :=
        ⟨h.1 + reflectionGamma D i C hC p, hsurv⟩
      rcases exists_aperySocle_above D i t with ⟨s, v, hsv⟩
      rcases hC s with ⟨c, hc⟩
      let d : D.Gamma := c + v
      have hsum : h.1 + d = p.1 := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        have hsv' := congrArg Subtype.val hsv
        have hrp := reflectionGamma_val D i C hC p
        simp only [t, AddSubmonoid.coe_add] at hsv' ⊢
        change (c.1 : ℤ) = C - (s.1.1.1 : ℤ) at hc
        exact_mod_cast (show
          (h.1.1 : ℤ) + ((d.1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (p.1.1 : ℤ) by
            simp only [d, AddSubmonoid.coe_add]
            omega)
      have hdA : D.IsApery i d := by
        apply isApery_of_add_right
        rw [hsum]
        exact p.2
      exact hpred ⟨⟨d, hdA⟩, hsum⟩
    have hAh : truncatedAperyMonomial (k := k) D i h.1 =
        A (k := k) h.1 h.2 := by
      simp [truncatedAperyMonomial, h.2]
    rw [← hAh]
    simp only [reflectionMonomial]
    rw [← truncatedAperyMonomial_add]
    simp [truncatedAperyMonomial, hnot]

name: P23.Semigroup.reflection_basis_smul
statement:
private theorem reflection_basis_smul (C : ℤ)
    (hC : IsAperyReflectionCenter D i C)
    (h : D.AperyIndex i) (φ : AperyOmega k D i) :
    reflectionLinearMap (k := k) D i C hC
        (A (k := k) h.1 h.2 • φ) =
      A (k := k) h.1 h.2 *
        reflectionLinearMap (k := k) D i C hC φ
proof:
:= by
  let L : AperyOmega k D i →ₗ[k] AperyArtin k D i :=
    (reflectionLinearMap (k := k) D i C hC).comp
      (dualBasisSmulLinearMap (k := k) D i h)
  let R : AperyOmega k D i →ₗ[k] AperyArtin k D i :=
    (basisMulLinearMap (k := k) D i h).comp
      (reflectionLinearMap (k := k) D i C hC)
  have heq : L = R := (aperyDualBasis (k := k) D i).ext fun p => by
    change reflectionLinearMap (k := k) D i C hC
        (A (k := k) h.1 h.2 • AU (k := k) D i p) =
      A (k := k) h.1 h.2 *
        reflectionLinearMap (k := k) D i C hC (AU (k := k) D i p)
    rw [reflectionLinearMap_AU]
    exact reflection_basis_identity (k := k) D i C hC h p
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun heq φ

name: P23.Semigroup.reflectionLinearMap_map_smul
statement:
theorem reflectionLinearMap_map_smul (C : ℤ)
    (hC : IsAperyReflectionCenter D i C)
    (a : AperyArtin k D i) (φ : AperyOmega k D i) :
    reflectionLinearMap (k := k) D i C hC (a • φ) =
      a * reflectionLinearMap (k := k) D i C hC φ
proof:
:= by
  induction a using AperyArtin.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add a b ha hb => simp [add_smul, add_mul, ha, hb]
  | single p r =>
      rw [← smul_A (k := k) r p.1 p.2, smul_assoc,
        map_smul, reflection_basis_smul (k := k) D i C hC p,
        smul_mul_assoc]

name: P23.Semigroup.reflectionCanonicalHom_AU
statement:
@[simp] theorem reflectionCanonicalHom_AU (C : ℤ)
    (hC : IsAperyReflectionCenter D i C) (p : D.AperyIndex i) :
    reflectionCanonicalHom (k := k) D i C hC (AU (k := k) D i p) =
      reflectionMonomial (k := k) D i C hC p
proof:
:=
  reflectionLinearMap_AU (k := k) D i C hC p

name: P23.Semigroup.pseudoFrobeniusEquivAperySocle_val
statement:
theorem pseudoFrobeniusEquivAperySocle_val
    (f : D.PseudoFrobeniusIndex) :
    ((((D.pseudoFrobeniusEquivAperySocle i) f).1.1.1 : ℕ) : ℤ) =
      f.1 + D.n i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.pseudoFrobeniusEquivAperySocle]
  exact Classical.choose_spec
    ((D.isPseudoFrobenius_iff_generators f.1).1 f.2 |>.2 i)

name: P23.Semigroup.tail_ngWitness_reflectionCenter
statement:
theorem tail_ngWitness_reflectionCenter (j : Fin 3)
    (f : D.PseudoFrobeniusIndex)
    (hf : NGWitnessForGenerator D (D.tailIndex i j) f) :
    IsAperyReflectionCenter D i (tailReflectionCenter D i j f)
proof:
:= by
  intro s
  let g : D.PseudoFrobeniusIndex :=
    (D.pseudoFrobeniusEquivAperySocle i).symm s
  have hgval := pseudoFrobeniusEquivAperySocle_val D i g
  have hgs : (D.pseudoFrobeniusEquivAperySocle i) g = s := by
    exact (D.pseudoFrobeniusEquivAperySocle i).apply_symm_apply s
  have hsval : ((s.1.1.1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = g.1 + D.n i := by
    rw [← hgs]
    exact hgval
  have hw := hf g
  convert hw using 1
  simp only [tailReflectionCenter, FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.tailGen]
  omega

name: P23.Semigroup.reflectionCanonicalHom_AU_pf_eq_tailVariableA
statement:
theorem reflectionCanonicalHom_AU_pf_eq_tailVariableA (j : Fin 3)
    (f : D.PseudoFrobeniusIndex)
    (hf : NGWitnessForGenerator D (D.tailIndex i j) f) :
    let C
proof:
:= tailReflectionCenter D i j f
    let hC := tail_ngWitness_reflectionCenter D i j f hf
    reflectionCanonicalHom (k := k) D i C hC
        (AU (k := k) D i ((D.pseudoFrobeniusEquivAperySocle i) f).1) =
      tailVariableA (k := k) D i j := by
  dsimp only
  rw [reflectionCanonicalHom_AU]
  have href : reflectionGamma D i (tailReflectionCenter D i j f)
      (tail_ngWitness_reflectionCenter D i j f hf)
      ((D.pseudoFrobeniusEquivAperySocle i f).1) = D.tail i j := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    have hv := reflectionGamma_val D i (tailReflectionCenter D i j f)
      (tail_ngWitness_reflectionCenter D i j f hf)
      ((D.pseudoFrobeniusEquivAperySocle i) f).1
    have hs := pseudoFrobeniusEquivAperySocle_val D i f
    have hv' :
        ((reflectionGamma D i (tailReflectionCenter D i j f)
          (tail_ngWitness_reflectionCenter D i j f hf)
          ((D.pseudoFrobeniusEquivAperySocle i) f).1).1 : ℤ) =
            D.n (D.tailIndex i j) := by
      calc
        _ = (D.n (D.tailIndex i j) : ℤ) + f.1 + D.n i -
            ((((D.pseudoFrobeniusEquivAperySocle i) f).1.1.1 : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
              simpa [tailReflectionCenter,
                FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.tailGen] using hv
        _ = D.n (D.tailIndex i j) := by rw [hs]; omega
    simp only [
      FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.tailGen,
      FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.tail,
      FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.generator] at hv ⊢
    exact_mod_cast hv'
  simp [reflectionMonomial, href, truncatedAperyMonomial,
    D.tail_isApery i j, tailVariableA]

name: P23.Semigroup.aperyTrace_range_le

theorem aperyTrace_range_le
    (F : AperyOmega k D i →ₗ[AperyArtin k D i] AperyArtin k D i) :

name: P23.Semigroup.tailVariableA_mem_aperyTrace
statement:
theorem tailVariableA_mem_aperyTrace
    (hng : SemigroupNearlyGorenstein D) (j : Fin 3) :
    tailVariableA (k := k) D i j ∈ AperyTraceSubmodule (k := k) D i
proof:
:= by
  rcases exists_tail_ngWitness D hng i j with ⟨f, hf⟩
  let C := tailReflectionCenter D i j f
  let hC := tail_ngWitness_reflectionCenter D i j f hf
  let F := reflectionCanonicalHom (k := k) D i C hC
  apply aperyTrace_range_le (k := k) D i F
  refine ⟨AU (k := k) D i ((D.pseudoFrobeniusEquivAperySocle i) f).1, ?_⟩
  exact reflectionCanonicalHom_AU_pf_eq_tailVariableA
    (k := k) D i j f hf

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.mem_componentSupport_iff
statement:
theorem mem_componentSupport_iff {d : ℕ} {C : D.BettiComponent d} {j : Fin 4} :
    j ∈ D.componentSupport C ↔
      ∃ u : D.FactorizationAt d, D.componentOf u = C ∧ 0 < u.1 j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro hj
    obtain ⟨u, hu, hj⟩ := Finset.mem_biUnion.mp hj
    exact ⟨u, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hu).2, (D.mem_factorizationSupport u j).mp hj⟩
  · rintro ⟨u, huC, huj⟩
    exact Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨u, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, huC⟩,
      (D.mem_factorizationSupport u j).mpr huj⟩

statement:

proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro hj
    obtain ⟨u, _, hj⟩ := Finset.mem_biUnion.mp hj
    exact ⟨u, (D.mem_factorizationSupport u j).mp hj⟩
  · rintro ⟨u, huj⟩
    exact Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr
      ⟨u, Finset.mem_univ _, (D.mem_factorizationSupport u j).mpr huj⟩

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.componentSupport_subset_combinedSupport

theorem componentSupport_subset_combinedSupport {d : ℕ} (C : D.BettiComponent d) :
    D.componentSupport C ⊆ D.combinedSupport d
proof:
:= by

  rw [D.mem_componentSupport_iff] at hj

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.biUnion_componentSupport
statement:
theorem biUnion_componentSupport (d : ℕ) :
    Finset.univ.biUnion (fun C : D.BettiComponent d => D.componentSupport C) =
      D.combinedSupport d
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext j
  simp only [Finset.mem_biUnion, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨C, hj⟩
    exact D.componentSupport_subset_combinedSupport C hj
  · intro hj
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := D.mem_combinedSupport_iff.mp hj
    exact ⟨D.componentOf u, D.mem_componentSupport_iff.mpr ⟨u, rfl, hu⟩⟩

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.componentSupport_disjoint
statement:
theorem componentSupport_disjoint {d : ℕ} {C E : D.BettiComponent d}
    (hCE : C ≠ E) : Disjoint (D.componentSupport C) (D.componentSupport E)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro j hjC hjE
  obtain ⟨u, huC, huj⟩ := D.mem_componentSupport_iff.mp hjC
  obtain ⟨v, hvE, hvj⟩ := D.mem_componentSupport_iff.mp hjE
  apply hCE
  rw [← huC, ← hvE]
  by_cases huv : u = v
  · exact congrArg D.componentOf huv
  · exact SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.sound
      ((D.factorizationGraph_adj u v).2 ⟨huv, ⟨j, huj, hvj⟩⟩).reachable

statement:
@[simp] theorem weightedDegree_single (j : Fin 4) (m : ℕ) :

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.componentSupport_nonempty_of_isBetti
statement:
theorem componentSupport_nonempty_of_isBetti {d : ℕ} (hd : D.IsBettiDegree d)
    (C : D.BettiComponent d) : (D.componentSupport C).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨u, huC⟩ := SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.nonempty_supp C
  by_contra hempty
  have husupp : D.factorizationSupport u = ∅ := by
    apply Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp
    intro hsupp
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hsupp
    apply hempty
    exact ⟨j, D.mem_componentSupport_iff.mpr
      ⟨u, (SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff C u).mp huC,
        (D.mem_factorizationSupport u j).mp hj⟩⟩
  have hu0 : u.1 = 0 := Finsupp.support_eq_empty.mp husupp
  have hd0 : d = 0 := by simpa [hu0] using (D.factorizationAt_degree u).symm
  letI : Subsingleton (D.FactorizationAt d) :=
    ⟨fun x y => Subtype.ext (by
      rw [D.factorization_eq_zero_of_degree_eq_zero hd0 x,
        D.factorization_eq_zero_of_degree_eq_zero hd0 y])⟩
  have hcard : D.componentCount d ≤ 1 :=
    Fintype.card_le_one_iff_subsingleton.mpr inferInstance
  unfold IsBettiDegree at hd
  omega
