name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.factorization_eq_single_of_singleton_component
statement:
theorem factorization_eq_single_of_singleton_component {d : ℕ}
    {C : D.BettiComponent d} (hC : D.IsSingletonSupportComponent C)
    {u : D.FactorizationAt d} (hu : D.componentOf u = C) :
    u.1 = Finsupp.single (D.singletonSupportVariable C)
      (u.1 (D.singletonSupportVariable C))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply Finsupp.ext
  intro j
  by_cases hj : j = D.singletonSupportVariable C
  · subst j
    simp
  · have hjnot : j ∉ D.factorizationSupport u := by
      intro hmem
      have := D.factorizationSupport_subset_componentSupport hu hmem
      rw [D.componentSupport_eq_singleton hC] at this
      simpa [hj] using this
    have hz : u.1 j = 0 := by
      simpa [factorizationSupport] using hjnot
    simp [Finsupp.single_apply, hj, hz]

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.singleton_component_vertex_unique
statement:
theorem singleton_component_vertex_unique {d : ℕ} {C : D.BettiComponent d}
    (hC : D.IsSingletonSupportComponent C)
    {u v : D.FactorizationAt d} (hu : D.componentOf u = C)
    (hv : D.componentOf v = C) : u = v
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [D.factorization_eq_single_of_singleton_component hC hu,
    D.factorization_eq_single_of_singleton_component hC hv]
  apply congrArg (Finsupp.single (D.singletonSupportVariable C))
  have hdu := D.factorizationAt_degree u
  have hdv := D.factorizationAt_degree v
  rw [D.factorization_eq_single_of_singleton_component hC hu] at hdu
  rw [D.factorization_eq_single_of_singleton_component hC hv] at hdv
  simp only [D.weightedDegree_single] at hdu hdv
  have hn : 0 < D.n (D.singletonSupportVariable C) := D.positive _
  exact Nat.mul_right_cancel hn (hdu.trans hdv.symm)

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.singleton_degree_lt_impossible
statement:
private theorem singleton_degree_lt_impossible {j : Fin 4} {d₁ d₂ : ℕ}
    (h₁ : D.IsBettiDegree d₁) (h₂ : D.IsBettiDegree d₂)
    {C₁ : D.BettiComponent d₁} (hC₁ : D.IsSingletonSupportComponent C₁)
    (hj₁ : D.singletonSupportVariable C₁ = j)
    {C₂ : D.BettiComponent d₂} (hC₂ : D.IsSingletonSupportComponent C₂)
    (hj₂ : D.singletonSupportVariable C₂ = j)
    {u₁ : D.FactorizationAt d₁} (hu₁ : D.componentOf u₁ = C₁)
    {u₂ : D.FactorizationAt d₂} (hu₂ : D.componentOf u₂ = C₂)
    (hm : u₁.1 j < u₂.1 j) : False
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hc₁gt : 1 < Fintype.card (D.BettiComponent d₁) := by
    unfold IsBettiDegree componentCount at h₁
    omega
  obtain ⟨E, hEC⟩ := Fintype.exists_ne_of_one_lt_card hc₁gt C₁
  have hEn : (D.componentSupport E).Nonempty :=
    D.componentSupport_nonempty_of_isBetti h₁ E
  obtain ⟨k, hkE⟩ := hEn
  obtain ⟨v, hvE, hvk⟩ := D.mem_componentSupport_iff.mp hkE
  have hC₁support : D.componentSupport C₁ = {j} := by
    rw [D.componentSupport_eq_singleton hC₁, hj₁]
  have hC₂support : D.componentSupport C₂ = {j} := by
    rw [D.componentSupport_eq_singleton hC₂, hj₂]
  have hjC₁ : j ∈ D.componentSupport C₁ := by simp [hC₁support]
  have hvj : v.1 j = 0 := by
    by_contra hvj0
    have hjE : j ∈ D.componentSupport E :=
      D.mem_componentSupport_iff.mpr ⟨v, hvE, Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hvj0⟩
    exact (Finset.disjoint_left.mp (D.componentSupport_disjoint hEC) hjE hjC₁)
  have hkj : k ≠ j := by
    intro h
    subst k
    exact (Nat.ne_of_gt hvk) hvj
  have hu₁pure := D.factorization_eq_single_of_singleton_component hC₁ hu₁
  have hu₂pure := D.factorization_eq_single_of_singleton_component hC₂ hu₂
  rw [hj₁] at hu₁pure
  rw [hj₂] at hu₂pure
  have hd₁ : d₁ = u₁.1 j * D.n j :=
    (D.factorizationAt_degree u₁).symm.trans
      ((congrArg D.weightedDegree hu₁pure).trans (D.weightedDegree_single j _))
  have hd₂ : d₂ = u₂.1 j * D.n j :=
    (D.factorizationAt_degree u₂).symm.trans
      ((congrArg D.weightedDegree hu₂pure).trans (D.weightedDegree_single j _))
  let shift : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ := Finsupp.single j (u₂.1 j - u₁.1 j)
  have hshiftDegree : D.weightedDegree (v.1 + shift) = d₂ := by
    rw [show D.weightedDegree (v.1 + shift) =
      D.weightedDegree v.1 + D.weightedDegree shift from weightedDegreeOf_add D.n v.1 shift]
    rw [show D.weightedDegree shift = (u₂.1 j - u₁.1 j) * D.n j by
      exact D.weightedDegree_single j _]
    rw [D.factorizationAt_degree v]
    calc
      d₁ + (u₂.1 j - u₁.1 j) * D.n j =
          u₁.1 j * D.n j + (u₂.1 j - u₁.1 j) * D.n j :=
        congrArg (fun z => z + (u₂.1 j - u₁.1 j) * D.n j) hd₁
      _ = (u₁.1 j + (u₂.1 j - u₁.1 j)) * D.n j := (Nat.add_mul ..).symm
      _ = u₂.1 j * D.n j :=
        congrArg (fun z => z * D.n j) (Nat.add_sub_of_le (Nat.le_of_lt hm))
      _ = d₂ := hd₂.symm
  let w : D.FactorizationAt d₂ :=
    ⟨v.1 + shift, D.mem_factorizations.mpr hshiftDegree⟩
  have hwj : 0 < w.1 j := by
    change 0 < (v.1 + shift) j
    simp [shift, hvj]
    omega
  have hu₂j : 0 < u₂.1 j := by omega
  have hwu : w ≠ u₂ := by
    intro heq
    have hkEq := congrArg (fun z : D.FactorizationAt d₂ => z.1 k) heq
    change (v.1 + shift) k = u₂.1 k at hkEq
    rw [hu₂pure] at hkEq
    simp [shift, Finsupp.single_apply, hkj] at hkEq
    omega
  have hcompw : D.componentOf w = C₂ := by
    rw [← hu₂]
    exact SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.sound
      ((D.factorizationGraph_adj w u₂).2 ⟨hwu, ⟨j, hwj, hu₂j⟩⟩).reachable
  exact hwu (D.singleton_component_vertex_unique hC₂ hcompw hu₂)

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.singletonComponent_degree_unique
statement:
theorem singletonComponent_degree_unique {j : Fin 4} {d₁ d₂ : ℕ}
    (h₁ : D.IsBettiDegree d₁) (h₂ : D.IsBettiDegree d₂)
    (hs₁ : D.HasSingletonComponentAt j d₁)
    (hs₂ : D.HasSingletonComponentAt j d₂) : d₁ = d₂
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨C₁, hC₁, hj₁⟩ := hs₁
  obtain ⟨C₂, hC₂, hj₂⟩ := hs₂
  obtain ⟨u₁, hu₁⟩ := SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.nonempty_supp C₁
  obtain ⟨u₂, hu₂⟩ := SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.nonempty_supp C₂
  have hu₁C : D.componentOf u₁ = C₁ :=
    (SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff C₁ u₁).mp hu₁
  have hu₂C : D.componentOf u₂ = C₂ :=
    (SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff C₂ u₂).mp hu₂
  have hpure₁ := D.factorization_eq_single_of_singleton_component hC₁ hu₁C
  have hpure₂ := D.factorization_eq_single_of_singleton_component hC₂ hu₂C
  rw [hj₁] at hpure₁
  rw [hj₂] at hpure₂
  have hd₁ : d₁ = u₁.1 j * D.n j :=
    (D.factorizationAt_degree u₁).symm.trans
      ((congrArg D.weightedDegree hpure₁).trans (D.weightedDegree_single j _))
  have hd₂ : d₂ = u₂.1 j * D.n j :=
    (D.factorizationAt_degree u₂).symm.trans
      ((congrArg D.weightedDegree hpure₂).trans (D.weightedDegree_single j _))
  rcases lt_trichotomy (u₁.1 j) (u₂.1 j) with hlt | heq | hgt
  · exact False.elim (D.singleton_degree_lt_impossible h₁ h₂ hC₁ hj₁ hC₂ hj₂
      hu₁C hu₂C hlt)
  · simpa [hd₁, hd₂, heq]
  · exact False.elim (D.singleton_degree_lt_impossible h₂ h₁ hC₂ hj₂ hC₁ hj₁
      hu₂C hu₁C hgt)

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.singletonOccurrenceVariable_injective
statement:
theorem singletonOccurrenceVariable_injective :
    Function.Injective D.singletonOccurrenceVariable
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hab
  rcases a with ⟨d₁, hd₁, C₁, hC₁⟩
  rcases b with ⟨d₂, hd₂, C₂, hC₂⟩
  dsimp [singletonOccurrenceVariable] at hab
  have hdeg : d₁ = d₂ := D.singletonComponent_degree_unique hd₁ hd₂
    ⟨C₁, hC₁, rfl⟩ ⟨C₂, hC₂, hab.symm⟩
  subst d₂
  have hcomp : C₁ = C₂ := by
    by_contra hne
    have hmem₁ := D.singletonSupportVariable_mem hC₁
    have hmem₂ := D.singletonSupportVariable_mem hC₂
    rw [hab] at hmem₁
    exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp (D.componentSupport_disjoint hne) hmem₁ hmem₂
  subst C₂
  rfl

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.singletonBettiOccurrence_card_le_four
statement:
theorem singletonBettiOccurrence_card_le_four :
    Fintype.card (D.SingletonBettiOccurrence) ≤ 4
proof:
:= by
  simpa using Fintype.card_le_of_injective D.singletonOccurrenceVariable
    D.singletonOccurrenceVariable_injective

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.generator_ne_one
statement: theorem generator_ne_one (j : Fin 4) : D.n j ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  intro hj
  let k : Fin 4 := if j=0 then 1 else 0
  have hkj : k≠j := by
    dsimp [k]; split_ifs with h
    · subst j; decide
    · exact Ne.symm h
  let u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ := Finsupp.single j (D.n k)
  have huk : u k=0 := by simp [u,hkj]
  apply D.minimal k u huk
  change (∑ x : Fin 4, (Finsupp.single j (D.n k)) x * D.n x)=D.n k
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j]
  · simp [hj]
  · intro x _ hx
    simp [hx]
  · simp

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.exists_minimum_generator
statement: theorem exists_minimum_generator : ∃ m : Fin 4,∀ j,D.n m≤D.n j
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m,_,hm⟩ := Finset.exists_min_image (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 4)) D.n
    Finset.univ_nonempty
  exact ⟨m,fun j=>hm j (Finset.mem_univ j)⟩

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.minimum_generator_le
statement:
theorem minimum_generator_le {m : Fin 4} (hm : ∀ j,D.n m≤D.n j)
    {s : ℕ} (hs : s ∈ D.Gamma) (hpos : 0 < s) : D.n m ≤ s
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u,hu⟩ := (D.mem_Gamma_iff s).mp hs
  have hne : u≠0 := by intro hz; subst u; simp at hu; omega
  obtain ⟨j,hj⟩ := Finsupp.ne_iff.mp hne
  have hp : 1≤u j := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hj
  have hterm : u j*D.n j≤D.weightedDegree u := by
    apply Finset.single_le_sum (fun _ _=>Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ j)
  have hmul : D.n j≤u j*D.n j := by
    simpa using Nat.mul_le_mul_right (D.n j) hp
  rw [hu] at hterm
  exact (hm j).trans (hmul.trans hterm)

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.one_not_mem_Gamma
statement: theorem one_not_mem_Gamma : 1∉D.Gamma
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨m,hm⟩ := D.exists_minimum_generator
  have hle := D.minimum_generator_le hm h (by omega)
  have hp := D.positive m
  exact D.generator_ne_one m (by omega)

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.gapFinset_nonempty
statement: theorem gapFinset_nonempty : D.gapFinset.Nonempty
proof:
:=
  ⟨1,(D.mem_gapFinset 1).mpr D.one_not_mem_Gamma⟩

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.frobenius_mem_gapFinset
statement: theorem frobenius_mem_gapFinset : D.frobenius∈D.gapFinset
proof:
:=
  Finset.max'_mem _ _

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.gap_le_frobenius
statement: theorem gap_le_frobenius {s : ℕ} (hs : s∈D.gapFinset) : s≤D.frobenius
proof:
:=
  Finset.le_max' _ _ hs

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.frobenius_not_mem_Gamma
statement: theorem frobenius_not_mem_Gamma : D.frobenius∉D.Gamma
proof:
:=
  (D.mem_gapFinset _).mp D.frobenius_mem_gapFinset

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.frobenius_lt_imp_mem_Gamma
statement: theorem frobenius_lt_imp_mem_Gamma {s : ℕ} (hs : D.frobenius<s) : s∈D.Gamma
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hn
  have := D.gap_le_frobenius ((D.mem_gapFinset s).mpr hn)
  omega

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.frobenius_isPseudoFrobenius
statement: theorem frobenius_isPseudoFrobenius : D.IsPseudoFrobenius (D.frobenius : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨by simpa using D.frobenius_not_mem_Gamma,?_⟩
  intro s hs
  have hp : 0<s.1 := by
    by_contra hn
    apply hs
    exact Subtype.ext (show s.1=0 by omega)
  have hmem := D.frobenius_lt_imp_mem_Gamma (s:=D.frobenius+s.1) (by omega)
  simpa using (D.intInGamma_natCast _).mpr hmem

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.pseudoFrobenius_pos
statement: theorem pseudoFrobenius_pos (f : D.PseudoFrobeniusIndex) : 0<f.1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m,hm⟩ := D.exists_minimum_generator
  by_contra hn
  have hn' : f.1≤0 := by omega
  have hne : f.1≠0 := by intro hz; exact f.2.1 (hz ▸ D.intInGamma_zero)
  have hf : f.1<0 := by omega
  obtain ⟨s,hs⟩ := (D.isPseudoFrobenius_iff_generators f.1).mp f.2 |>.2 m
  have hslt : s.1<D.n m := by omega
  have hs0 : s.1=0 := by
    by_contra hh
    have := D.minimum_generator_le hm s.2 (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hh)
    omega
  have he : f.1=-(D.n m : ℤ) := by omega
  let k := D.tailIndex m 0
  obtain ⟨g,hg⟩ := (D.isPseudoFrobenius_iff_generators f.1).mp f.2 |>.2 k
  apply D.tail_isApery m 0
  refine ⟨g,Subtype.ext ?_⟩
  change D.n k=D.n m+g.1
  omega

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.pseudoFrobeniusNat_cast
statement:
@[simp] theorem pseudoFrobeniusNat_cast (f : D.PseudoFrobeniusIndex) :
    (D.pseudoFrobeniusNat f : ℤ)=f.1
proof:
:=
  Int.toNat_of_nonneg (le_of_lt (D.pseudoFrobenius_pos f))

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.pseudoFrobeniusNat_mem_gapFinset
statement:
theorem pseudoFrobeniusNat_mem_gapFinset (f : D.PseudoFrobeniusIndex) :
    D.pseudoFrobeniusNat f∈D.gapFinset
proof:
:= by
  apply (D.mem_gapFinset _).mpr
  intro hm
  apply f.2.1
  simpa using (D.intInGamma_natCast _).mpr hm

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.pseudoFrobeniusNat_le_frobenius
statement:
theorem pseudoFrobeniusNat_le_frobenius (f : D.PseudoFrobeniusIndex) :
    D.pseudoFrobeniusNat f≤D.frobenius
proof:
:=
  D.gap_le_frobenius (D.pseudoFrobeniusNat_mem_gapFinset f)

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.pseudoFrobenius_le_frobenius
statement:
theorem pseudoFrobenius_le_frobenius (f : D.PseudoFrobeniusIndex) :
    f.1≤(D.frobenius : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  have := D.pseudoFrobeniusNat_le_frobenius f
  rw [←D.pseudoFrobeniusNat_cast f]
  exact_mod_cast this

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.pseudoFrobeniusNat_injective
statement: theorem pseudoFrobeniusNat_injective : Function.Injective D.pseudoFrobeniusNat
proof:
:= by
  intro f g h
  apply Subtype.ext
  simpa using congrArg (fun a : ℕ=>(a:ℤ)) h

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.pseudoFrobeniusSum_erase
statement:
theorem pseudoFrobeniusSum_erase (h : D.PseudoFrobeniusIndex) :
    ∑ f ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset D.PseudoFrobeniusIndex).erase h,f.1 =
      D.pseudoFrobeniusSum-h.1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hh := Finset.sum_erase_add (Finset.univ : Finset D.PseudoFrobeniusIndex)
    (fun f=>f.1) (Finset.mem_univ h)
  change (∑ f ∈ Finset.univ.erase h,f.1)+h.1=D.pseudoFrobeniusSum at hh
  omega

name: P23.Semigroup.taggedBudgetOneDominantRoot_on
statement:
theorem taggedBudgetOneDominantRoot_on (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup) (i : Fin 4)
    (T : TaggedBudgetOneNormalization D i) (ht : D.semigroupType=2 ∨ D.semigroupType=3)
    (hn : SemigroupNearlyGorenstein D) (hr : D.semigroupType+4≤D.semigroupRho) :
    ∃ s : ↥T.presentation.roots, IsDominantRoot T.presentation.roots s
proof:
:= by
  let B := T.presentation
  have he : B.roots.card=D.semigroupType :=
    (quotientType_eq_rootCard (k:=ℚ) B.roots B.roots_nonempty
      B.coordinates.liveDomain B.roots_live B.roots_antichain).symm.trans
      (B.canonicalOneTieType_eq_chosenBaseType.trans (chosenBaseType_eq_semigroupType D i))
  have hc : B.roots.card=2 ∨ B.roots.card=3 := by rwa [he]
  have hng := B.canonicalOneTie_ng_iff.mp
    (semigroupNearlyGorenstein_to_chosenBaseNearlyGorenstein D i hn)
  have hm : B.roots.card + 4 ≤ idealGeneratorMu (finitePresentationIdeal (k:=ℚ) B.roots) := by
    rwa [he,B.canonicalKernelMu_eq_rho]
  obtain ⟨s,hs,hd⟩ := oneTie_ng_kernel_mu_ge_type_plus_four_has_dominant B.roots
    B.roots_nonempty B.coordinates.liveDomain B.roots_live B.roots_antichain hc hng hm
  exact ⟨⟨s,hs⟩,hd⟩

name: P23.Semigroup.taggedBudgetOneDominantRoot
statement:
theorem taggedBudgetOneDominantRoot (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup) (i : Fin 4)
    (hB : D.fourBaseBudget i=1) (ht : D.semigroupType=2 ∨ D.semigroupType=3)
    (hn : SemigroupNearlyGorenstein D) (hr : D.semigroupType+4≤D.semigroupRho) :
    Nonempty (TaggedBudgetOneDominantRoot D i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨T⟩ := taggedBudgetOneNormalization D i hB
  obtain ⟨s,hd⟩ := taggedBudgetOneDominantRoot_on D i T ht hn hr
  refine ⟨⟨T,s,hd,?_,T.presentation.canonicalKernelMu_eq_rho⟩⟩
  exact (quotientType_eq_rootCard (k:=ℚ) T.presentation.roots T.presentation.roots_nonempty
    T.presentation.coordinates.liveDomain T.presentation.roots_live T.presentation.roots_antichain).symm.trans
    (T.presentation.canonicalOneTieType_eq_chosenBaseType.trans (chosenBaseType_eq_semigroupType D i))

name: P23.Semigroup.weightedDegreeOf_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem weightedDegreeOf_zero (n : Fin 4 → ℕ) :
    weightedDegreeOf n 0 = 0
proof: := by simp [weightedDegreeOf]

name: P23.Semigroup.weightedDegreeOf_add
statement:
theorem weightedDegreeOf_add (n : Fin 4 → ℕ) (u v : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) :
    weightedDegreeOf n (u + v) = weightedDegreeOf n u + weightedDegreeOf n v
proof:
:= by
  simp [weightedDegreeOf, add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.mem_Gamma_iff
statement:
theorem mem_Gamma_iff (s : ℕ) :
    s ∈ D.Gamma ↔ ∃ u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ, D.weightedDegree u = s
proof:
:= by
  exact AddMonoidHom.mem_mrange

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.weightedDegree_generatorFactorization
statement:
@[simp] theorem weightedDegree_generatorFactorization (j : Fin 4) :
    D.weightedDegree (generatorFactorization j) = D.n j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [weightedDegreeOf, generatorFactorization]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j]
  · simp
  · intro b _ hbj
    simp [Finsupp.single_apply, hbj]
  · simp

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.generator_mem_Gamma
statement: theorem generator_mem_Gamma (j : Fin 4) : D.n j ∈ D.Gamma
proof:
:=
  (D.mem_Gamma_iff (D.n j)).2 ⟨generatorFactorization j,
    D.weightedDegree_generatorFactorization j⟩

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.coordinate_le_weightedDegree
statement:
theorem coordinate_le_weightedDegree (u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) (j : Fin 4) :
    u j ≤ D.weightedDegree u
proof:
:= by
  have hterm : u j * D.n j ≤ D.weightedDegree u := by
    apply Finset.single_le_sum (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ j)
  have hone : 1 ≤ D.n j := D.positive j
  simpa only [Nat.mul_one] using (Nat.mul_le_mul_left (u j) hone).trans hterm

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.factorization_coordinate_le
statement:
theorem factorization_coordinate_le {s : ℕ} (u : D.Factorization s) (j : Fin 4) :
    u.1 j ≤ s
proof:
:= by
  simpa [u.2] using D.coordinate_le_weightedDegree u.1 j

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.mem_factorizations
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_factorizations {s : ℕ} {u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ} :
    u ∈ D.factorizations s ↔ D.weightedDegree u = s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [factorizations]

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.tailIndex_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem tailIndex_apply (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 3) :
    D.tailIndex i j = i.succAbove j
proof: := rfl

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.tailIndex_ne_base
statement: theorem tailIndex_ne_base (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 3) : D.tailIndex i j ≠ i
proof:
:= by
  simpa [tailIndex] using Fin.succAbove_ne i j

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.tailIndex_injective
statement: theorem tailIndex_injective (i : Fin 4) : Function.Injective (D.tailIndex i)
proof:
:=
  (D.tailIndex i).injective

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.tailGen_positive
statement: theorem tailGen_positive (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 3) : 0 < D.tailGen i j
proof:
:=
  D.positive _

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.tailGen_injective
statement: theorem tailGen_injective (i : Fin 4) : Function.Injective (D.tailGen i)
proof:
:=
  D.injective.comp (D.tailIndex_injective i)

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.tailGen_ne_base
statement: theorem tailGen_ne_base (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 3) : D.tailGen i j ≠ D.n i
proof:
:= by
  exact fun h => D.tailIndex_ne_base i j (D.injective h)

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.zero_isApery
statement: theorem zero_isApery (i : Fin 4) : D.IsApery i 0
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨h, hh⟩
  have := congrArg Subtype.val hh
  have hq := D.positive i
  simp only [AddSubmonoid.coe_zero, AddSubmonoid.coe_add, base, generator] at this
  omega

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.base_not_isApery
statement: theorem base_not_isApery (i : Fin 4) : ¬ D.IsApery i (D.base i)
proof:
:= by
  refine fun h => h ⟨0, ?_⟩
  simp

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.weighted_term_le
statement:
private theorem weighted_term_le (u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) (j : Fin 4) :
    u j * D.n j ≤ D.weightedDegree u
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.single_le_sum (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ j)

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.tail_isApery
statement: theorem tail_isApery (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 3) : D.IsApery i (D.tail i j)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨h, hh⟩
  rcases (D.mem_Gamma_iff h.1).1 h.2 with ⟨u, hu⟩
  let tj : Fin 4 := D.tailIndex i j
  have heq : D.n tj = D.n i + D.weightedDegree u := by
    have hraw := congrArg Subtype.val hh
    have hraw' : D.n tj = D.n i + h.1 := by
      simpa [tj, tail, generator, base] using hraw
    rw [hraw', hu]
  have hut : u tj = 0 := by
    by_contra hne
    have hone : 1 ≤ u tj := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 hne
    have hterm := D.weighted_term_le u tj
    have hmul : D.n tj ≤ u tj * D.n tj := by
      simpa [one_mul] using Nat.mul_le_mul_right (D.n tj) hone
    have hni := D.positive i
    omega
  let v : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ := Finsupp.single i 1 + u
  have hvzero : v tj = 0 := by
    have hit : i ≠ tj := (D.tailIndex_ne_base i j).symm
    simp [v, Finsupp.single_apply, hit, hut]
  have hsingle : weightedDegreeOf D.n (Finsupp.single i 1) = D.n i := by
    simpa [generatorFactorization] using D.weightedDegree_generatorFactorization i
  have hvdeg : D.weightedDegree v = D.n tj := by
    change weightedDegreeOf D.n v = D.n tj
    rw [show v = Finsupp.single i 1 + u by rfl, weightedDegreeOf_add, hsingle]
    exact heq.symm
  exact (D.minimal tj v hvzero) hvdeg

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.mem_gapFinset
statement: @[simp] theorem mem_gapFinset (s : ℕ) : s ∈ D.gapFinset ↔ s ∉ D.Gamma
proof:
:= by
  simp [gapFinset]

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.mem_Gamma_of_conductor_le
statement: theorem mem_Gamma_of_conductor_le {s : ℕ} (hs : D.conductor ≤ s) : s ∈ D.Gamma
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hnot
  have hmem : s ∈ D.gapFinset := (D.mem_gapFinset s).2 hnot
  have hle : s ≤ D.gapFinset.sup id := Finset.le_sup (f := id) hmem
  simp [conductor] at hs
  omega

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.isApery_lt
statement:
theorem isApery_lt (i : Fin 4) {s : D.Gamma} (hs : D.IsApery i s) :
    s.1 < D.conductor + D.n i
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hnot
  have hqi : D.n i ≤ s.1 := by
    have hc : D.conductor ≤ s.1 := by omega
    have hq := D.positive i
    omega
  let d : ℕ := s.1 - D.n i
  have hdcond : D.conductor ≤ d := by omega
  have hdmem : d ∈ D.Gamma := D.mem_Gamma_of_conductor_le hdcond
  apply hs
  refine ⟨⟨d, hdmem⟩, ?_⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp [base, generator, d, Nat.add_sub_of_le hqi]

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.mem_aperyFinset
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_aperyFinset (i : Fin 4) (s : D.Gamma) :
    s ∈ D.aperyFinset i ↔ D.IsApery i s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [aperyFinset]

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.zero_mem_aperyFinset
statement: theorem zero_mem_aperyFinset (i : Fin 4) : 0 ∈ D.aperyFinset i
proof:
:= by
  simpa using D.zero_isApery i

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.base_not_mem_aperyFinset
statement: theorem base_not_mem_aperyFinset (i : Fin 4) : D.base i ∉ D.aperyFinset i
proof:
:= by
  simpa using D.base_not_isApery i

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.tail_mem_aperyFinset
statement:
theorem tail_mem_aperyFinset (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 3) :
    D.tail i j ∈ D.aperyFinset i
proof:
:= by
  simpa using D.tail_isApery i j

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.apery_factorization_base_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hnonzero
  have hui : 0 < u i := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hnonzero
  let v : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ := Finsupp.single i (u i - 1) + u.erase i
  have huv : u = Finsupp.single i 1 + v := by
    apply Finsupp.ext
    intro j
    by_cases hji : j = i
    · subst j
      simp [v]
      omega
    · simp [v, Finsupp.single_apply, hji]
  have hvGamma : D.weightedDegree v ∈ D.Gamma :=
    (D.mem_Gamma_iff _).2 ⟨v, rfl⟩
  apply hs
  refine ⟨⟨D.weightedDegree v, hvGamma⟩, ?_⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  have hsingle : D.weightedDegree (Finsupp.single i 1) = D.n i := by
    simpa [generatorFactorization] using D.weightedDegree_generatorFactorization i
  rw [← hu, huv]
  change weightedDegreeOf D.n (Finsupp.single i 1 + v) =
    D.n i + weightedDegreeOf D.n v
  change weightedDegreeOf D.n (Finsupp.single i 1) = D.n i at hsingle
  rw [weightedDegreeOf_add, hsingle]

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.existsUnique_baseSupportComponent
statement:
theorem existsUnique_baseSupportComponent {d : ℕ} (hi : i ∈ D.combinedSupport d) :
    ∃! C : D.BettiComponent d, i ∈ D.componentSupport C
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hui⟩ := D.mem_combinedSupport_iff.mp hi
  refine ⟨D.componentOf u, D.mem_componentSupport_iff.mpr ⟨u, rfl, hui⟩, ?_⟩
  intro C hC
  by_contra hne
  exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp (D.componentSupport_disjoint hne) hC
    (D.mem_componentSupport_iff.mpr ⟨u, rfl, hui⟩)

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.baseSupportComponent_mem
statement:
theorem baseSupportComponent_mem {d : ℕ} (hd : D.IsBettiDegree d)
    (hi : i ∈ D.combinedSupport d) : i ∈ D.componentSupport (D.baseSupportComponent i hd hi)
proof:
:=
  (D.existsUnique_baseSupportComponent i hi).choose_spec.1

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.baseUsingFactorization_component
statement:
theorem baseUsingFactorization_component {d : ℕ} (hd : D.IsBettiDegree d)
    (hi : i ∈ D.combinedSupport d) :
    D.componentOf (D.baseUsingFactorization i hd hi) = D.baseSupportComponent i hd hi
proof:
:=
  (D.mem_componentSupport_iff.mp (D.baseSupportComponent_mem i hd hi)).choose_spec.1

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.baseUsingFactorization_pos
statement:
theorem baseUsingFactorization_pos {d : ℕ} (hd : D.IsBettiDegree d)
    (hi : i ∈ D.combinedSupport d) : 0 < (D.baseUsingFactorization i hd hi).1 i
proof:
:=
  (D.mem_componentSupport_iff.mp (D.baseSupportComponent_mem i hd hi)).choose_spec.2

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.factorization_base_zero_of_other_component
statement:
theorem factorization_base_zero_of_other_component {d : ℕ}
    (hd : D.IsBettiDegree d) (hi : i ∈ D.combinedSupport d)
    (u : D.FactorizationAt d) (hu : D.componentOf u ≠ D.baseSupportComponent i hd hi) :
    u.1 i = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp (D.componentSupport_disjoint hu)
    (D.mem_componentSupport_iff.mpr ⟨u, rfl, Nat.pos_of_ne_zero h⟩)
    (D.baseSupportComponent_mem i hd hi)

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.factorization_base_zero_of_internal
statement:
theorem factorization_base_zero_of_internal {d : ℕ}
    (hi : i ∉ D.combinedSupport d) (u : D.FactorizationAt d) : u.1 i = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  exact hi (D.mem_combinedSupport_iff.mpr ⟨u, Nat.pos_of_ne_zero h⟩)

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.baseAdaptedRootFactorization_component
statement:
@[simp] theorem baseAdaptedRootFactorization_component {d : ℕ} (hd : D.IsBettiDegree d) :
    D.componentOf (D.baseAdaptedRootFactorization i hd) = D.baseAdaptedRootComponent i hd
proof:
:= by
  unfold baseAdaptedRootFactorization baseAdaptedRootComponent
  split <;> simp [D.baseUsingFactorization_component, D.componentRepresentative_component]

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.baseAdaptedRootFactorization_pos
statement:
theorem baseAdaptedRootFactorization_pos {d : ℕ} (hd : D.IsBettiDegree d)
    (hi : i ∈ D.combinedSupport d) : 0 < (D.baseAdaptedRootFactorization i hd).1 i
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [baseAdaptedRootFactorization, dif_pos hi] using D.baseUsingFactorization_pos i hd hi

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.baseAdaptedConnectorEndpoints_components
statement:
theorem baseAdaptedConnectorEndpoints_components {d : ℕ} (hd : D.IsBettiDegree d)
    (g : D.BaseAdaptedConnector i hd) :
    D.componentOf (D.baseAdaptedConnectorEndpoints i hd g).1 = D.baseAdaptedRootComponent i hd ∧

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.adaptedPair_mem_span
statement:
private theorem adaptedPair_mem_span {d : ℕ} (hd : D.IsBettiDegree d)
    (C E : D.BettiComponent d) :
    D.fiberBinomial (k := k) (D.adaptedRepresentative i hd C) (D.adaptedRepresentative i hd E) ∈
      Ideal.span (Set.range (D.baseAdaptedGlobalConnectorBinomial (k := k) i))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let J := Ideal.span (Set.range (D.baseAdaptedGlobalConnectorBinomial (k := k) i))
  have hstar : ∀ C : D.BettiComponent d,
      D.fiberBinomial (k := k) (D.baseAdaptedRootFactorization i hd)
        (D.adaptedRepresentative i hd C) ∈ J := by
    intro C
    by_cases hC : C = D.baseAdaptedRootComponent i hd
    · simp [adaptedRepresentative, hC, fiberBinomial]
    · have hgen : D.baseAdaptedGlobalConnectorBinomial (k := k) i
          ⟨⟨d, hd⟩, ⟨C, hC⟩⟩ ∈ J := Ideal.subset_span ⟨_, rfl⟩
      simpa [baseAdaptedGlobalConnectorBinomial, baseAdaptedConnectorBinomial,
        baseAdaptedConnectorRelation, baseAdaptedConnectorEndpoints, presentationRelationBinomial,
        adaptedRepresentative, hC] using hgen
  have h := J.sub_mem (hstar E) (hstar C)
  have heq :
      D.fiberBinomial (k := k) (D.baseAdaptedRootFactorization i hd) (D.adaptedRepresentative i hd E) -
        D.fiberBinomial (k := k) (D.baseAdaptedRootFactorization i hd) (D.adaptedRepresentative i hd C) =
      D.fiberBinomial (k := k) (D.adaptedRepresentative i hd C) (D.adaptedRepresentative i hd E) := by
    unfold fiberBinomial
    abel
  rw [heq] at h
  exact h

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.fiberBinomial_mem_span_baseAdaptedGlobalConnectorBinomials
proof:
:= by
  induction d using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h d ih =>
      have hlower : D.lowerToricIdeal (k := k) d ≤
          Ideal.span (Set.range (D.baseAdaptedGlobalConnectorBinomial (k := k) i)) := by
        rw [lowerToricIdeal, Ideal.span_le]
        rintro p ⟨e, he, u, v, rfl⟩
        exact ih e he u v
      by_cases hcomp : D.componentOf u = D.componentOf v
      · exact hlower (D.fiberBinomial_mem_lower_of_sameComponent hcomp)
      · have hd : D.IsBettiDegree d := by
          have hc := Fintype.one_lt_card_iff.mpr ⟨D.componentOf u, D.componentOf v, hcomp⟩
          unfold IsBettiDegree componentCount
          omega
        let ru := D.adaptedRepresentative i hd (D.componentOf u)
        let rv := D.adaptedRepresentative i hd (D.componentOf v)
        have hu : D.fiberBinomial (k := k) u ru ∈ _ :=
          hlower (D.fiberBinomial_mem_lower_of_sameComponent
            (D.adaptedRepresentative_component i hd (D.componentOf u)).symm)
        have hv : D.fiberBinomial (k := k) rv v ∈ _ :=
          hlower (D.fiberBinomial_mem_lower_of_sameComponent
            (D.adaptedRepresentative_component i hd (D.componentOf v)))
        have hm := D.adaptedPair_mem_span (k := k) i hd (D.componentOf u) (D.componentOf v)
        have hsum := Ideal.add_mem _ (Ideal.add_mem _ hu hm) hv
        simpa [ru, rv, fiberBinomial] using hsum

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.toricIdeal_eq_span_baseAdaptedGlobalConnectorBinomials
statement:
theorem toricIdeal_eq_span_baseAdaptedGlobalConnectorBinomials : D.toricIdeal (k := k) =
    Ideal.span (Set.range (D.baseAdaptedGlobalConnectorBinomial (k := k) i))
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [D.toricIdeal_eq_span_fiberBinomials, Ideal.span_le]
    rintro p ⟨d, u, v, rfl⟩
    exact D.fiberBinomial_mem_span_baseAdaptedGlobalConnectorBinomials i u v
  · rw [Ideal.span_le]
    rintro p ⟨g, rfl⟩
    exact D.fiberBinomial_mem_toricIdeal _ _

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.baseAdaptedGlobalConnectorRelation_injective
statement:
theorem baseAdaptedGlobalConnectorRelation_injective :
    Function.Injective (D.baseAdaptedGlobalConnectorRelation i)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨d, C⟩ ⟨e, E⟩ h
  have hde : d = e := Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun r => r.degree) h)
  subst e
  have hr : (D.componentRepresentative C.1).1 = (D.componentRepresentative E.1).1 :=
    congrArg (fun r => r.right.1) h
  have hCE : C = E := Subtype.ext (by
    have hc := congrArg D.componentOf (Subtype.ext hr)
    simpa [D.componentRepresentative_component] using hc)
  subst E
  rfl

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.connector_tail_supports_disjoint
statement:
theorem connector_tail_supports_disjoint (g : D.BaseAdaptedGlobalConnector i) :
    Disjoint (D.connectorLeftTail i g).support (D.connectorRightTail i g).support
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro j hjl hjr
  have hl : 0 < (D.baseAdaptedRootFactorization i g.1.2).1 (D.tailIndex i j) := by
    simpa only [connectorLeftTail, restrictToTails_apply, Finsupp.mem_support_iff,
      Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero] using hjl
  have hr : 0 < (D.componentRepresentative g.2.1).1 (D.tailIndex i j) := by
    simpa only [connectorRightTail, restrictToTails_apply, Finsupp.mem_support_iff,
      Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero] using hjr
  exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp (D.componentSupport_disjoint g.2.2)
    (D.mem_componentSupport_iff.mpr ⟨_, D.componentRepresentative_component _, hr⟩)
    (D.mem_componentSupport_iff.mpr ⟨_, D.baseAdaptedRootFactorization_component i _, hl⟩)

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.factorization_ne_zero_of_isBetti
statement:
theorem factorization_ne_zero_of_isBetti {d : ℕ} (hd : D.IsBettiDegree d)
    (u : D.FactorizationAt d) : u.1 ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hu
  have hd0 : d = 0 := by simpa [hu] using (D.factorizationAt_degree u).symm
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := D.componentSupport_nonempty_of_isBetti hd (D.componentOf u)
  obtain ⟨v, _, hvj⟩ := D.mem_componentSupport_iff.mp hj
  have hv := D.factorization_eq_zero_of_degree_eq_zero hd0 v
  simp [hv] at hvj

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.restricted_factorization_support_nonempty
statement:
theorem restricted_factorization_support_nonempty {d : ℕ} (hd : D.IsBettiDegree d)

proof:

  intro he
  have hzero := Finsupp.support_eq_empty.mp he
  have hr := tailEmbedding_restrictToTails D i u.1 hu
  rw [hzero] at hr
  rw [tailEmbeddingExponent_eq_mapDomain D i] at hr
  apply D.factorization_ne_zero_of_isBetti hd u

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.internalDegree_isApery
statement:
theorem internalDegree_isApery (d : D.BettiDegreeIndex) (hi : i ∉ D.combinedSupport d.1) :
    D.IsApery i (D.bettiDegreeGamma d)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨h, he⟩
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := (D.mem_Gamma_iff h.1).mp h.2
  let w := Finsupp.single i 1 + v
  have hw : D.weightedDegree w = d.1 := by
    have hh := congrArg Subtype.val he
    change d.1 = D.n i + h.1 at hh
    change D.weightedDegree (Finsupp.single i 1 + v) = d.1
    have hadd : D.weightedDegree (Finsupp.single i 1 + v) =
        D.weightedDegree (Finsupp.single i 1) + D.weightedDegree v :=
      weightedDegreeOf_add D.n _ _
    rw [hadd, D.weightedDegree_single, one_mul, hv]
    exact hh.symm
  let u : D.FactorizationAt d.1 := ⟨w, D.mem_factorizations.mpr hw⟩
  apply hi
  apply D.mem_combinedSupport_iff.mpr
  refine ⟨u, ?_⟩
  simp [u, w]

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.internal_term_image
statement:
theorem internal_term_image (d : D.BettiDegreeIndex) (hi : i ∉ D.combinedSupport d.1)
    (u : D.FactorizationAt d.1) :
    chosenBaseEquivApery (k := k) D i
      (tailPolyToChosenBase D i (MvPolynomial.monomial (restrictToTails D i u.1) 1)) =
      AperyArtin.A (D.bettiDegreeGamma d) (D.internalDegree_isApery i d hi)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tailPolyToChosenBase_monomial, one_smul]
  have he : tailDegreeGamma D i (restrictToTails D i u.1) = D.bettiDegreeGamma d := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact (restrictToTails_degree D i u.1 (D.factorization_base_zero_of_internal i hi u)).trans
      (D.factorizationAt_degree u)
  rw [he]
  simp [truncatedAperyMonomial, D.internalDegree_isApery i d hi]

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.internal_connector_images_live
statement:
theorem internal_connector_images_live (g : D.BaseAdaptedGlobalConnector i)
    (hi : i ∉ D.combinedSupport g.1.1) :
    tailPolyToChosenBase (k := k) D i (MvPolynomial.monomial (D.connectorLeftTail i g) 1) =
      tailPolyToChosenBase D i (MvPolynomial.monomial (D.connectorRightTail i g) 1) ∧
    tailPolyToChosenBase (k := k) D i (MvPolynomial.monomial (D.connectorLeftTail i g) 1) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hl := D.internal_term_image (k := k) i g.1 hi (D.baseAdaptedRootFactorization i g.1.2)
  have hr := D.internal_term_image (k := k) i g.1 hi (D.componentRepresentative g.2.1)
  refine ⟨(chosenBaseEquivApery D i).injective (hl.trans hr.symm), ?_⟩
  intro hz
  change tailPolyToChosenBase (k := k) D i
    (MvPolynomial.monomial (restrictToTails D i (D.baseAdaptedRootFactorization i g.1.2).1) 1) = 0 at hz
  have hA : AperyArtin.A (k := k) (D.bettiDegreeGamma g.1)
      (D.internalDegree_isApery i g.1 hi) = 0 := by rw [← hl, hz]; exact map_zero _
  have hc := congrArg (fun x : AperyArtin k D i =>
    x.coeff ⟨D.bettiDegreeGamma g.1, D.internalDegree_isApery i g.1 hi⟩) hA
  simpa using hc

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.specializedConnector_isLiveBinomial_of_base_not_mem_support
statement:
theorem specializedConnector_isLiveBinomial_of_base_not_mem_support
    (g : D.BaseAdaptedGlobalConnector i) (hi : i ∉ D.combinedSupport g.1.1) :

proof:

  have himg := D.internal_connector_images_live (k := k) i g hi
  refine ⟨_, _, D.specializedConnectorPolynomial_internal i g hi, hsup.1, hsup.2,
    D.connector_tail_supports_disjoint i g, D.internal_connector_tail_ne i g hi, ?_, himg⟩
  rw [D.specializedConnectorPolynomial_internal i g hi, sub_ne_zero]

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.chosenBaseDefiningIdeal_eq_span_specializedConnectors

    D.toricIdeal_eq_span_baseAdaptedGlobalConnectorBinomials i, Ideal.map_span]

  ext p

  · rintro ⟨q, ⟨g, rfl⟩, rfl⟩

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.disjoint_three_supports_one_singleton
statement:
theorem disjoint_three_supports_one_singleton (u v : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ)
    (hu : u.support.Nonempty) (hv : v.support.Nonempty) (h : Disjoint u.support v.support) :
    u.support.card = 1 ∨ v.support.card = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hc : (u.support ∪ v.support).card ≤ 3 := by
    simpa using Finset.card_le_card (Finset.subset_univ (u.support ∪ v.support))
  rw [Finset.card_union_of_disjoint h] at hc
  have hcu := Finset.card_pos.mpr hu
  have hcv := Finset.card_pos.mpr hv
  omega

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.internal_connector_pure_side

proof:

    (D.internal_connector_tail_supports_nonempty i g hi).1
    (D.internal_connector_tail_supports_nonempty i g hi).2 (D.connector_tail_supports_disjoint i g)

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.internalBaseConnectorFinset_card
statement:
theorem internalBaseConnectorFinset_card :
    (D.internalBaseConnectorFinset i).card = D.fourBaseBudget i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc
    (D.internalBaseConnectorFinset i).card =
        Fintype.card {g : D.BaseAdaptedGlobalConnector i // D.IsInternalBaseConnector i g} :=
      (Fintype.card_subtype (D.IsInternalBaseConnector i)).symm
    _ = Fintype.card (Σ d : {d : D.BettiDegreeIndex // i ∉ D.combinedSupport d.1},
        D.BaseAdaptedConnector i d.1.2) :=
      Fintype.card_congr (Equiv.subtypeSigmaEquiv
        (fun d : D.BettiDegreeIndex => D.BaseAdaptedConnector i d.2)
        (fun d : D.BettiDegreeIndex => i ∉ D.combinedSupport d.1))
    _ = ∑ d : {d : D.BettiDegreeIndex // i ∉ D.combinedSupport d.1},
        D.bettiContribution d.1.1 := by
      rw [Fintype.card_sigma]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d _ => D.baseAdaptedConnector_card i d.1.2)
    _ = ∑ d : {d : D.BudgetDegree // i ∉ D.combinedSupport d.1},
        D.bettiContribution d.1.1 :=
      Fintype.sum_equiv (D.internalBettiBudgetEquiv i) _ _ (fun _ => rfl)
    _ = D.fourBaseBudget i := by
      unfold fourBaseBudget
      rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
      exact (Finset.sum_subtype
        (Finset.univ.filter (fun d : D.BudgetDegree => i ∉ D.combinedSupport d.1))
        (by intro d; simp) (fun d : D.BudgetDegree => D.bettiContribution d.1)).symm

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.baseAdaptedGlobalConnector_card_eq_rho
statement:

    Fintype.card (D.BaseAdaptedGlobalConnector i) = D.semigroupRho

  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d _ => D.baseAdaptedConnector_card i d.2)

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.externalBaseConnectorFinset_card
statement:
theorem externalBaseConnectorFinset_card :
    (D.externalBaseConnectorFinset i).card = D.semigroupRho - D.fourBaseBudget i
proof:
:= by
  have h := Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not
    (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (D.BaseAdaptedGlobalConnector i))) (D.IsInternalBaseConnector i)
  change (D.internalBaseConnectorFinset i).card + (D.externalBaseConnectorFinset i).card =
    Fintype.card (D.BaseAdaptedGlobalConnector i) at h
  rw [D.internalBaseConnectorFinset_card, D.baseAdaptedGlobalConnector_card_eq_rho] at h
  omega

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.chosenBaseReducedRelationFamily_generates
proof:
:= by
  rw [D.chosenBaseDefiningIdeal_eq_span_specializedConnectors i]
  congr 1
  ext p
  simp [chosenBaseReducedRelationFamily, Set.mem_range, eq_comm]

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.all_connectors_external_of_budget_zero
statement:
theorem all_connectors_external_of_budget_zero (hB : D.fourBaseBudget i = 0)
    (g : D.BaseAdaptedGlobalConnector i) : i ∈ D.combinedSupport g.1.1
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hi
  have hempty : D.internalBaseConnectorFinset i = ∅ :=
    Finset.card_eq_zero.mp ((D.internalBaseConnectorFinset_card i).trans hB)
  have hg : g ∈ D.internalBaseConnectorFinset i := by simp [internalBaseConnectorFinset, IsInternalBaseConnector, hi]
  rw [hempty] at hg
  exact Finset.notMem_empty g hg

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.chosenBaseIdeal_monomial_of_budget_eq_zero
statement:
theorem chosenBaseIdeal_monomial_of_budget_eq_zero (hB : D.fourBaseBudget i = 0) :
    D.IsMonomialChosenBaseIdeal (k := k) i
proof:
:= by
  let M := (Finset.univ : Finset (D.BaseAdaptedGlobalConnector i)).image (D.connectorRightTail i)
  refine ⟨M, ?_⟩
  rw [D.chosenBaseDefiningIdeal_eq_span_specializedConnectors i]
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [Ideal.span_le]
    rintro p ⟨g, rfl⟩
    rw [D.specializedConnectorPolynomial_external i g (D.all_connectors_external_of_budget_zero i hB g)]
    apply neg_mem
    apply Ideal.subset_span
    refine ⟨D.connectorRightTail i g, ?_, rfl⟩
    exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨g, Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩
  · rw [Ideal.span_le]
    rintro p ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨g, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hu
    have hg : D.specializedConnectorPolynomial (k := k) i g ∈
        Ideal.span (Set.range (D.specializedConnectorPolynomial (k := k) i)) :=
      Ideal.subset_span ⟨g, rfl⟩
    rw [D.specializedConnectorPolynomial_external i g (D.all_connectors_external_of_budget_zero i hB g)] at hg
    simpa using neg_mem hg

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.existsUnique_internal_connector_of_budget_one
statement:
theorem existsUnique_internal_connector_of_budget_one (hB : D.fourBaseBudget i = 1) :
    ∃! g : D.BaseAdaptedGlobalConnector i, D.IsInternalBaseConnector i g
proof:
:= by
  have hcard := (D.internalBaseConnectorFinset_card i).trans hB
  obtain ⟨g, hg, huniq⟩ := Finset.card_eq_one_iff_existsUnique.mp hcard
  refine ⟨g, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa [internalBaseConnectorFinset] using hg
  · intro h hh
    apply huniq
    simpa [internalBaseConnectorFinset] using hh

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.chosenBaseIdeal_one_live_binomial_generation_of_budget_eq_one
statement:
theorem chosenBaseIdeal_one_live_binomial_generation_of_budget_eq_one
    (hB : D.fourBaseBudget i = 1) : D.OneLiveBinomialGeneration (k := k) i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hg, huniq⟩ := D.existsUnique_internal_connector_of_budget_one i hB
  refine ⟨g, hg, huniq, ?_, D.specializedConnector_isLiveBinomial_of_base_not_mem_support i g hg,
    D.internal_connector_pure_side i g hg, ?_⟩
  · rw [D.chosenBaseDefiningIdeal_eq_span_specializedConnectors i]
    congr 1
    ext p
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨h, rfl⟩
      by_cases hh : D.IsInternalBaseConnector i h
      · exact Or.inl (by rw [huniq h hh]; exact Set.mem_singleton _)
      · exact Or.inr ⟨h, hh, rfl⟩
    · rintro (hp | ⟨h, hh, rfl⟩)
      · exact ⟨g, (Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hp).symm⟩
      · exact ⟨h, rfl⟩
  · intro h hne
    have hh : i ∈ D.combinedSupport h.1.1 := by
      by_contra hi
      exact hne (huniq h hi)
    exact D.specializedConnector_isMonomial_of_base_mem_support i h hh

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.chosenBaseReduction
statement:
theorem chosenBaseReduction : D.ChosenBaseReduction (k := k) i where
  commuting
proof:
:= fourPolyToChosenBase_eq D i
  exactImage := map_toricIdeal_eq_chosenBaseDefiningIdeal D i
  toricGeneration := D.toricIdeal_eq_span_baseAdaptedGlobalConnectorBinomials i
  taggedCard := D.baseAdaptedConnectorRelationFinset_card_eq_rho i
  externalShape := D.specializedConnector_isMonomial_of_base_mem_support i
  internalShape := D.specializedConnector_isLiveBinomial_of_base_not_mem_support i
  chosenGeneration := D.chosenBaseDefiningIdeal_eq_span_specializedConnectors i
  internalCard := D.internalBaseConnectorFinset_card i
  externalCard := D.externalBaseConnectorFinset_card i
  zeroBudget := D.chosenBaseIdeal_monomial_of_budget_eq_zero i
  oneBudget := D.chosenBaseIdeal_one_live_binomial_generation_of_budget_eq_one i

name: P23.Semigroup.rho_four_residual_pure_at_every_base
statement:
theorem rho_four_residual_pure_at_every_base (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup)
    (ht : D.semigroupType = 3) (hn : SemigroupNearlyGorenstein D) (hr : D.semigroupRho = 4) :
    ∀ i, Nonempty (RhoFourResidualPureBase D i)
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  obtain ⟨T⟩ := taggedBudgetOneNormalization D i (rho_four_all_budgets_eq_one D ht hn hr i)
  let B := T.presentation
  let C := T.canonicalBridge ht hn
  have hcard : (borderFinset B.roots).card = 3 := by rw [B.border_card,hr]
  have hnf : ∀ q ∈ borderFinset B.roots, ¬NormalHasFullSupport q :=
    fun _ hq => T.rho_four_normalized_border_no_full_support ht hn hr hq
  have ht' : quotientType ℚ B.roots B.roots_nonempty B.coordinates.liveDomain B.roots_live = 3 := C.canonicalTypeThree
  have hn' : QuotientNearlyGorenstein ℚ B.roots B.roots_nonempty B.coordinates.liveDomain B.roots_live := C.canonicalNearlyGorenstein
  obtain ⟨R⟩ := three_border_ng_reoriented_residual B.roots B.roots_nonempty B.coordinates.liveDomain
    B.roots_live B.roots_antichain ht' hcard hnf hn'
  have hpure : B.coordinates.c = 0 := by
    by_contra hnz
    exact rho_four_mixed_canonical_impossible B.roots B.roots_nonempty B.coordinates.liveDomain
      B.roots_live B.roots_antichain (by omega) ht' hcard hnf hn'
  exact ⟨⟨T,R,hpure,hcard,hnf,
    fun _ hq => border_not_pure_x B.roots_nonempty B.roots_live hq⟩⟩

name: P23.Semigroup.rho_four_local_three_border_reduction

theorem rho_four_local_three_border_reduction (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup)

    Nonempty (RhoFourLocalThreeBorderReduction D)

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.doubleGap_reflection
statement:
theorem doubleGap_reflection {a : ℕ} (ha : a∈D.doubleGapFinset) :
    D.frobenius-a∈D.doubleGapFinset
proof:
:= by
  have h := Finset.mem_filter.mp ha
  have hb := D.gap_le_frobenius h.1
  simp only [doubleGapFinset,Finset.mem_filter]
  exact ⟨h.2,by simpa [Nat.sub_sub_self hb] using h.1⟩

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.small_reflection_image
statement:
private theorem small_reflection_image :
    (D.smallSemigroup.image (fun a=>D.frobenius-a))=D.reflectedGoodGaps
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext a
  constructor
  · rintro h
    obtain ⟨s,hs,rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp h
    have hh := Finset.mem_filter.mp hs
    have hsF : s≤D.frobenius := by simpa using hh.1
    have hn : D.frobenius-s∉D.Gamma := by
      intro hmem
      apply D.frobenius_not_mem_Gamma
      have hsum := D.Gamma.add_mem hh.2 hmem
      simpa [Nat.add_sub_of_le hsF] using hsum
    exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨(D.mem_gapFinset _).mpr hn,
      by simpa [Nat.sub_sub_self hsF] using hh.2⟩
  · intro ha
    have hh := Finset.mem_filter.mp ha
    have haF := D.gap_le_frobenius hh.1
    apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
    refine ⟨D.frobenius-a,?_,Nat.sub_sub_self haF⟩
    apply Finset.mem_filter.mpr
    exact ⟨Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega),hh.2⟩

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.reflectedGoodGaps_card
statement: private theorem reflectedGoodGaps_card : D.reflectedGoodGaps.card=D.smallSemigroup.card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [←D.small_reflection_image]
  apply Finset.card_image_of_injOn
  intro a ha b hb he
  have haF : a≤D.frobenius := by
    have := (Finset.mem_filter.mp ha).1
    simpa using this
  have hbF : b≤D.frobenius := by
    have := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hb).1
    simpa using this
  change D.frobenius-a=D.frobenius-b at he
  omega

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.two_genus_eq_frobenius_one_add_doubleGapCard
statement:
theorem two_genus_eq_frobenius_one_add_doubleGapCard :
    2*D.genus=D.frobenius+1+D.doubleGapFinset.card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hg : (Finset.range (D.frobenius+1)).filter (fun a=>a∉D.Gamma)=D.gapFinset := by
    ext a
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter,Finset.mem_range,D.mem_gapFinset]
    constructor
    · exact fun h=>h.2
    · intro ha
      have hb := D.gap_le_frobenius ((D.mem_gapFinset a).mpr ha)
      exact ⟨by omega,ha⟩
  have hinterval := Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not
    (s:=Finset.range (D.frobenius+1)) (fun a=>a∈D.Gamma)
  rw [hg,Finset.card_range] at hinterval
  change D.smallSemigroup.card+D.genus=D.frobenius+1 at hinterval
  have hpartition := Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not
    (s:=D.gapFinset) (fun a=>D.frobenius-a∈D.Gamma)
  have hb : D.gapFinset.filter (fun a=>¬D.frobenius-a∈D.Gamma)=D.doubleGapFinset := by
    ext a
    simp [doubleGapFinset]
  rw [hb] at hpartition
  change D.reflectedGoodGaps.card+D.doubleGapFinset.card=D.genus at hpartition
  rw [D.reflectedGoodGaps_card] at hpartition
  omega

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.nonFrobeniusPF_card
statement: theorem nonFrobeniusPF_card : D.nonFrobeniusPFFinset.card=D.semigroupType-1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [nonFrobeniusPFFinset,Finset.card_image_of_injective _ D.pseudoFrobeniusNat_injective]
  simp [semigroupType]

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.nonFrobeniusPF_subset_doubleGap
statement: theorem nonFrobeniusPF_subset_doubleGap : D.nonFrobeniusPFFinset⊆D.doubleGapFinset
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro a ha
  obtain ⟨f,hf,rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp ha
  have hfne := (Finset.mem_erase.mp hf).1
  have hle := D.pseudoFrobeniusNat_le_frobenius f
  have hne : D.pseudoFrobeniusNat f≠D.frobenius := by
    intro he
    apply hfne
    apply Subtype.ext
    have hz := congrArg (fun n : ℕ=>(n:ℤ)) he
    simpa [frobeniusPF] using hz
  have hnot : D.frobenius-D.pseudoFrobeniusNat f∉D.Gamma := by
    intro hmem
    let g : D.Gamma := ⟨D.frobenius-D.pseudoFrobeniusNat f,hmem⟩
    have hg : g≠0 := by
      intro he
      have := congrArg Subtype.val he
      change D.frobenius-D.pseudoFrobeniusNat f=0 at this
      omega
    have hfg := f.2.2 g hg
    have he : f.1+(g.1:ℤ)=(D.frobenius:ℤ) := by
      rw [←D.pseudoFrobeniusNat_cast f]
      dsimp [g]
      omega
    rw [he] at hfg
    exact D.frobenius_not_mem_Gamma ((D.intInGamma_natCast _).mp hfg)
  apply Finset.mem_filter.mpr
  exact ⟨D.pseudoFrobeniusNat_mem_gapFinset f,(D.mem_gapFinset _).mpr hnot⟩

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.semigroupType_pos
statement: theorem semigroupType_pos : 0<D.semigroupType
proof:
:= by
  have : Nonempty D.PseudoFrobeniusIndex := ⟨D.frobeniusPF⟩
  exact Fintype.card_pos

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.frobenius_type_le_two_genus
statement: theorem frobenius_type_le_two_genus : D.frobenius+D.semigroupType≤2*D.genus
proof:
:= by
  have hc := Finset.card_le_card D.nonFrobeniusPF_subset_doubleGap
  rw [D.nonFrobeniusPF_card] at hc
  have ht := D.semigroupType_pos
  have hg := D.two_genus_eq_frobenius_one_add_doubleGapCard
  omega

name: P23.Semigroup.liveTailTieData_exists
statement:
theorem liveTailTieData_exists (p : TailPoly ℚ) (hp : D.LiveTailBinomial i p) :
    Nonempty (LiveTailTieData D i p)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u,v,he,hu,hv,hd,hn,hp,hi,hl⟩ := hp
  exact ⟨⟨u,v,he,hu,hv,hd,hn,hp,hi,hl,
    disjoint_three_supports_one_singleton u v hu hv hd⟩⟩

name: P23.Semigroup.LiveTailTieData.degree_eq
statement:
theorem LiveTailTieData.degree_eq {p : TailPoly ℚ} (T : LiveTailTieData D i p) :
    tailDegree D i T.u = tailDegree D i T.v
proof:
:= by
  have hE := congrArg (chosenBaseEquivApery (k := ℚ) D i) T.equalImage
  simp only [tailPolyToChosenBase_monomial, one_smul] at hE
  have hu : D.IsApery i (tailDegreeGamma D i T.u) := by
    by_contra hn
    apply T.liveImage
    apply (chosenBaseEquivApery (k := ℚ) D i).injective
    simp [tailPolyToChosenBase_monomial, truncatedAperyMonomial, hn]
  have hv : D.IsApery i (tailDegreeGamma D i T.v) := by
    by_contra hn
    have hz : tailPolyToChosenBase (k := ℚ) D i (MvPolynomial.monomial T.v 1) = 0 := by
      apply (chosenBaseEquivApery (k := ℚ) D i).injective
      simp [tailPolyToChosenBase_monomial, truncatedAperyMonomial, hn]
    exact T.liveImage (T.equalImage.trans hz)
  have hg : tailDegreeGamma D i T.u = tailDegreeGamma D i T.v := by
    by_contra hn
    have hc := congrArg (fun x : AperyArtin ℚ D i =>
      x.coeff ⟨tailDegreeGamma D i T.u, hu⟩) hE
    simp [truncatedAperyMonomial, hu, hv, AperyArtin.coeff_A, hn, Ne.symm hn] at hc
  exact congrArg Subtype.val hg

name: P23.Semigroup.singleton_live_exponent_two_le
statement:
theorem singleton_live_exponent_two_le (u v : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ)
    (hd : Disjoint u.support v.support) (he : tailDegree D i u = tailDegree D i v)
    (x : Fin 3) (hu : u.support = {x}) : 2 ≤ u x
proof:
:= by
  have hx : u x ≠ 0 := Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp (hu ▸ Finset.mem_singleton_self x)
  by_contra hn
  have hx1 : u x = 1 := by omega
  have hu1 : u = Finsupp.single x 1 := by
    ext j
    by_cases hj : j = x
    · subst j; simp [hx1]
    · have hz : u j = 0 := Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp (by simp [hu, hj])
      simp [Finsupp.single_apply, hj, hz]
  have hv1 : v = Finsupp.single x 1 := (tailDegree_eq_tailGen_iff D i).mp (by
    rw [← he, hu1, tailDegree_single, one_mul])
  have hvx : x ∈ v.support := by simp [hv1]
  exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp hd (by simp [hu]) hvx

name: P23.Semigroup.axisPermutation
statement:
private theorem axisPermutation (x y : Fin 3) (hne : x ≠ y) :
    ∃ σ : Fin 3 ≃ Fin 3, σ x = 0 ∧ σ y = 1
proof:
:= by
  let τ := Equiv.swap x 0
  have hy0 : τ y ≠ 0 := by
    intro hy
    have hx : τ x = 0 := by simp [τ]
    exact hne (τ.injective (hx.trans hy.symm))
  refine ⟨τ.trans (Equiv.swap (τ y) 1), ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp [τ, Equiv.trans_apply, Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne, Ne.symm hy0]
  · simp [Equiv.trans_apply]

name: P23.Semigroup.oriented_live_coordinates
statement:
private theorem oriented_live_coordinates {p : TailPoly ℚ} (T : LiveTailTieData D i p)
    (hcard : T.u.support.card = 1) :
    ∃ (σ : Fin 3 ≃ Fin 3) (a b c : ℕ), IsLiveParameterDomain a b c ∧
      MvPolynomial.renameEquiv ℚ σ p = tiePolynomial a b c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨x,hx⟩ := Finset.card_eq_one.mp hcard
  obtain ⟨y,hy⟩ := T.vNonempty
  have hvx : T.v x = 0 := Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp (by
    intro h
    exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp T.disjoint (by simp [hx]) h)
  have hxy : x ≠ y := by
    intro h; subst y
    exact (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hy) hvx
  obtain ⟨σ,hσx,hσy⟩ := axisPermutation x y hxy
  let a := T.u x
  let w := T.v.mapDomain σ
  let b := w 1
  let c := w 2
  have ha : 2 ≤ a := singleton_live_exponent_two_le T.u T.v T.disjoint T.degree_eq x hx
  have hu : T.u = Finsupp.single x a := by
    ext j
    by_cases hj : j = x
    · subst j; simp [a]
    · have hz : T.u j = 0 := Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp (by simp [hx, hj])
      simp [Finsupp.single_apply, hj, hz]
  have hw0 : w 0 = 0 := by
    have he : w (σ x) = T.v x := Finsupp.mapDomain_apply σ.injective T.v x
    simpa [hσx, hvx] using he
  have hb : 1 ≤ b := by
    have he : w (σ y) = T.v y := Finsupp.mapDomain_apply σ.injective T.v y
    have hypos : 0 < T.v y := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hy)
    change 1 ≤ w 1
    rw [← hσy, he]
    omega
  have hw : w = Finsupp.single 1 b + Finsupp.single 2 c := by
    ext j; fin_cases j <;> simp [hw0, b, c]
  have hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c := by
    refine ⟨ha, ?_⟩
    by_cases hc : c = 0
    · right
      have hv : T.v = Finsupp.single y b := by
        apply Finsupp.mapDomain_injective σ.injective
        simp only [Finsupp.mapDomain_single, hσy]
        simpa [hc] using hw
      have hbn : b ≠ 0 := by omega
      have hvs : T.v.support = {y} := by simp [hv, hbn]
      have hvb := singleton_live_exponent_two_le T.v T.u T.disjoint.symm T.degree_eq.symm y hvs
      exact ⟨by simpa [hv] using hvb, hc⟩
    · left; exact ⟨hb, by omega⟩
  refine ⟨σ,a,b,c,hdom,?_⟩
  change MvPolynomial.rename σ p = tiePolynomial a b c
  calc
    MvPolynomial.rename σ p = MvPolynomial.rename σ
        (MvPolynomial.monomial T.u 1 - MvPolynomial.monomial T.v 1) :=
      congrArg (MvPolynomial.rename σ) T.equation
    _ = tiePolynomial a b c := by
      rw [map_sub, MvPolynomial.rename_monomial, MvPolynomial.rename_monomial]
      rw [hu, Finsupp.mapDomain_single, hσx]
      change MvPolynomial.monomial (Finsupp.single 0 a) 1 - MvPolynomial.monomial w 1 = _
      rw [hw]
      simp [tiePolynomial, polyX, polyY, polyZ, MvPolynomial.X_pow_eq_monomial,
        MvPolynomial.monomial_mul]

name: P23.Semigroup.oneTieCoordinates_exists
statement:
theorem oneTieCoordinates_exists {p : TailPoly ℚ} (T : LiveTailTieData D i p) :
    Nonempty (OneTieCoordinates D i p)
proof:
:= by
  rcases T.singletonSide with hu | hv
  · obtain ⟨σ,a,b,c,hd,he⟩ := oriented_live_coordinates T hu
    exact ⟨⟨T,σ,a,b,c,hd,Or.inl he⟩⟩
  · let T' : LiveTailTieData D i (-p) :=
      ⟨T.v,T.u,(congrArg Neg.neg T.equation).trans (neg_sub _ _),T.vNonempty,T.uNonempty,
        T.disjoint.symm,Ne.symm T.distinct,neg_ne_zero.mpr T.nonzero,
        T.equalImage.symm,by rw [← T.equalImage]; exact T.liveImage,Or.inl hv⟩
    obtain ⟨σ,a,b,c,hd,he⟩ := oriented_live_coordinates T' hv
    refine ⟨⟨T,σ,a,b,c,hd,Or.inr ?_⟩⟩
    have := congrArg Neg.neg he
    simpa only [map_neg, neg_neg] using this

name: P23.Semigroup.oneTieCoordinates_of_budget_one
statement:
theorem oneTieCoordinates_of_budget_one (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup)
    (i : Fin 4) (hB : D.fourBaseBudget i = 1) :
    ∃ p : TailPoly ℚ, p ∈ chosenBaseDefiningIdeal D i ∧
      Nonempty (OneTieCoordinates D i p)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨G,g,hspan,_,hmem,hlive,_⟩ :=
    chosenBase_minimal_one_live_binomial_of_budget_one (k := ℚ) D i hB
  obtain ⟨T⟩ := liveTailTieData_exists D i _ hlive
  refine ⟨D.specializedConnectorPolynomial i g, ?_, oneTieCoordinates_exists T⟩
  rw [← hspan]
  exact Ideal.subset_span hmem

name: P23.Semigroup.oneTieCoordinates_liveDomain
statement:
theorem oneTieCoordinates_liveDomain {p : TailPoly ℚ} (C : OneTieCoordinates D i p) :
    IsLiveParameterDomain C.a C.b C.c
proof: := C.liveDomain

name: P23.Semigroup.renameToOneTie_live
statement:
theorem renameToOneTie_live {p : TailPoly ℚ} (C : OneTieCoordinates D i p) :
    renameToOneTie C p = tiePolynomial C.a C.b C.c ∨
      renameToOneTie C p = -tiePolynomial C.a C.b C.c
proof: := C.signedEquation

name: P23.Semigroup.tiePolynomial_mem_renamedChosenBaseIdeal
proof:
:= by
  have hm : renameToOneTie C p ∈ renamedChosenBaseIdeal C := Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hp
  rcases C.signedEquation with he | he
  · rwa [← he]
  · have hneg : -tiePolynomial C.a C.b C.c ∈ renamedChosenBaseIdeal C := he ▸ hm
    simpa only [neg_neg] using neg_mem hneg

name: P23.Semigroup.span_image_algEquiv
statement:
theorem span_image_algEquiv (e : ThreePoly ℚ ≃ₐ[ℚ] ThreePoly ℚ)
    (G : Finset (ThreePoly ℚ)) :
    Ideal.span (↑(G.image e) : Set (ThreePoly ℚ)) =
      (Ideal.span (↑G : Set (ThreePoly ℚ))).map e.toRingHom
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Ideal.map_span]
  congr 1
  exact Finset.coe_image

name: P23.Semigroup.minimalGeneratorCard_map_algEquiv
statement:
theorem minimalGeneratorCard_map_algEquiv (e : ThreePoly ℚ ≃ₐ[ℚ] ThreePoly ℚ)
    (I : Ideal (ThreePoly ℚ)) (n : ℕ) (h : HasMinimalGeneratorCard I n) :
    HasMinimalGeneratorCard (I.map e.toRingHom) n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · obtain ⟨G,hG,hc⟩ := h.1
    exact ⟨G.image e, by rw [span_image_algEquiv, hG],
      by rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ e.injective, hc]⟩
  · intro G hG
    have hs : Ideal.span (↑(G.image e.symm) : Set (ThreePoly ℚ)) = I := by
      rw [span_image_algEquiv, hG]
      exact Ideal.map_of_equiv e.toRingEquiv
    have hl := h.2 _ hs
    rwa [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ e.symm.injective] at hl

name: P23.Semigroup.renamedChosenBaseIdeal_minimalGeneratorCard
proof:
:=
  minimalGeneratorCard_map_algEquiv (renameToOneTie C) _ _
    (chosenBaseDefiningIdeal_minimalGeneratorCard D i)

name: P23.Semigroup.normalizedLiftGeneratorFinset_span_eq
statement:
theorem normalizedLiftGeneratorFinset_span_eq {p : TailPoly ℚ}
    (C : OneTieCoordinates D i p) (E : Finset (Fin 3 →₀ ℕ)) :
    Ideal.span (↑(normalizedLiftGeneratorFinset C E) : Set (ThreePoly ℚ)) =
      Ideal.span (↑(rawLiftGeneratorFinset C E) : Set (ThreePoly ℚ))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let R := Ideal.span (↑(rawLiftGeneratorFinset C E) : Set (ThreePoly ℚ))
  let N := Ideal.span (↑(normalizedLiftGeneratorFinset C E) : Set (ThreePoly ℚ))
  have hrTie : tieIdeal ℚ C.a C.b C.c ≤ R := by
    apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
    intro f hf
    rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hf]
    exact Ideal.subset_span (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)
  have hnTie : tieIdeal ℚ C.a C.b C.c ≤ N := by
    apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
    intro f hf
    rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hf]
    exact Ideal.subset_span (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)
  have hdiff (d : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) :
      MvPolynomial.monomial d (1 : ℚ) - polynomialLift (normalizeExponent C.a C.b C.c d) ∈
        tieIdeal ℚ C.a C.b C.c := monomial_sub_normalMonomial_mem_tieIdeal d 1
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
    intro f hf
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hf with he | hm
    · subst f; exact hrTie (tiePolynomial_mem_tieIdeal)
    · obtain ⟨q,hq,rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hm
      obtain ⟨d,hd,rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hq
      change polynomialLift (normalizeExponent C.a C.b C.c d) ∈ R
      have hraw : MvPolynomial.monomial d (1 : ℚ) ∈ R :=
        Ideal.subset_span (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨d,hd,rfl⟩))
      simpa only [sub_sub_cancel, R] using R.sub_mem hraw (hrTie (hdiff d))
  · apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
    intro f hf
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hf with he | hm
    · subst f; exact hnTie tiePolynomial_mem_tieIdeal
    · obtain ⟨d,hd,rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hm
      change MvPolynomial.monomial d (1 : ℚ) ∈ N
      have hnorm : polynomialLift (normalizeExponent C.a C.b C.c d) ∈ N :=
        Ideal.subset_span (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_image.mpr
          ⟨_,Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨d,hd,rfl⟩,rfl⟩))
      simpa only [add_sub_cancel, N] using N.add_mem hnorm (hnTie (hdiff d))

name: P23.Semigroup.normalMonomial_ne_zero
statement:
theorem normalMonomial_ne_zero (a b c : ℕ) [NeZero a] (q : Normal a b c) :
    monomial (k := ℚ) q ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hz
  have hc := congrArg (fun f : NormalMonoidAlgebra ℚ a b c => f.coeff q) hz
  simpa using hc

name: P23.Semigroup.tiePolynomial_ne_polynomialLift
statement:
theorem tiePolynomial_ne_polynomialLift (a b c : ℕ) [NeZero a] (q : Normal a b c) :
    tiePolynomial (k := ℚ) a b c ≠ polynomialLift q
proof:
:= by
  intro he
  have hm := congrArg (polyToNormalAlg (k := ℚ) (a := a) (b := b) (c := c)) he
  have hz : monomial (k := ℚ) q = 0 := by simpa using hm.symm
  exact normalMonomial_ne_zero a b c q hz

name: P23.Semigroup.normalizedGeneratorFinsets_card
statement:
theorem normalizedGeneratorFinsets_card {p : TailPoly ℚ} (C : OneTieCoordinates D i p)
    (E : Finset (Fin 3 →₀ ℕ))
    (hspan : Ideal.span (↑(rawLiftGeneratorFinset C E) : Set (ThreePoly ℚ)) =
      renamedChosenBaseIdeal C) (hcard : E.card = D.semigroupRho - 1)
    (hpos : 0 < D.semigroupRho) :
    (normalizedLiftGeneratorFinset C E).card = D.semigroupRho ∧
      (normalizedMonomialGeneratorFinset C E).card = D.semigroupRho - 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hs := (normalizedLiftGeneratorFinset_span_eq C E).trans hspan
  have hl := (renamedChosenBaseIdeal_minimalGeneratorCard C).2 _ hs
  have hn : tiePolynomial C.a C.b C.c ∉
      (normalizedMonomialGeneratorFinset C E).image (polynomialLift (k := ℚ)) := by
    rintro hm
    obtain ⟨q,_,he⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hm
    exact tiePolynomial_ne_polynomialLift C.a C.b C.c q he.symm
  have hc : (normalizedLiftGeneratorFinset C E).card =
      (normalizedMonomialGeneratorFinset C E).card + 1 := by
    rw [normalizedLiftGeneratorFinset, Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hn,
      Finset.card_image_of_injective _ polynomialLift_injective]
  have hle : (normalizedMonomialGeneratorFinset C E).card ≤ E.card := Finset.card_image_le
  constructor <;> omega

name: P23.Semigroup.budgetOne_raw_normalization_data
statement:
theorem budgetOne_raw_normalization_data (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup)
    (i : Fin 4) (hB : D.fourBaseBudget i = 1) :
    ∃ (p : TailPoly ℚ) (C : OneTieCoordinates D i p) (E : Finset (Fin 3 →₀ ℕ)),
      Ideal.span (↑(rawLiftGeneratorFinset C E) : Set (ThreePoly ℚ)) = renamedChosenBaseIdeal C ∧
      E.card = D.semigroupRho - 1 ∧ 0 < D.semigroupRho
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨G,g,hspan,hcard,hmem,hlive,_,hmon,hErase,_,_⟩ :=
    chosenBase_minimal_one_live_binomial_of_budget_one (k := ℚ) D i hB
  let p := D.specializedConnectorPolynomial (k := ℚ) i g
  obtain ⟨T⟩ := liveTailTieData_exists D i p hlive
  obtain ⟨C⟩ := oneTieCoordinates_exists T
  let M := G.erase p
  have hshape (q : ↥M) : ∃ w, (q : TailPoly ℚ) = -MvPolynomial.monomial w 1 := by
    obtain ⟨w,he,_⟩ := hmon q.1 (Finset.mem_erase.mp q.2).2 (Finset.mem_erase.mp q.2).1
    exact ⟨w,he⟩
  let w (q : ↥M) : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ := Classical.choose (hshape q)
  let E := M.attach.image (fun q => (w q).mapDomain C.sigma)
  have heq (q : ↥M) : renameToOneTie C (q : TailPoly ℚ) =
      -MvPolynomial.monomial ((w q).mapDomain C.sigma) 1 := by
    change MvPolynomial.rename C.sigma (q : TailPoly ℚ) = _
    have hq : (q : TailPoly ℚ) = -MvPolynomial.monomial (w q) 1 := Classical.choose_spec (hshape q)
    calc
      MvPolynomial.rename C.sigma (q : TailPoly ℚ) =
          MvPolynomial.rename C.sigma (-MvPolynomial.monomial (w q) 1) :=
        congrArg (MvPolynomial.rename C.sigma) hq
      _ = _ := by simp [MvPolynomial.rename_monomial]
  have hEcard : E.card ≤ D.semigroupRho - 1 := by
    calc E.card ≤ M.attach.card := Finset.card_image_le
         _ = M.card := Finset.card_attach
         _ = D.semigroupRho - 1 := by
           dsimp only [M]
           rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem hmem, hcard]
  have hpI : p ∈ chosenBaseDefiningIdeal D i := by
    rw [← hspan]; exact Ideal.subset_span hmem
  let R := Ideal.span (↑(rawLiftGeneratorFinset C E) : Set (ThreePoly ℚ))
  have hraw : R = renamedChosenBaseIdeal C := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
      intro f hf
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hf with he | hm
      · subst f; exact tiePolynomial_mem_renamedChosenBaseIdeal C hpI
      · obtain ⟨d,hd,rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hm
        obtain ⟨q,_,rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hd
        change MvPolynomial.monomial ((w q).mapDomain C.sigma) (1 : ℚ) ∈ renamedChosenBaseIdeal C
        have hqI : (q : TailPoly ℚ) ∈ chosenBaseDefiningIdeal D i := by
          rw [← hspan]
          exact Ideal.subset_span (Finset.mem_erase.mp q.2).2
        have hmI : renameToOneTie C (q : TailPoly ℚ) ∈ renamedChosenBaseIdeal C :=
          Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (renameToOneTie C).toRingHom hqI
        rw [heq] at hmI
        simpa only [neg_neg] using neg_mem hmI
    · change (chosenBaseDefiningIdeal D i).map (renameToOneTie C).toRingHom ≤ R
      rw [← hspan, Ideal.map_span]
      apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
      rintro f ⟨q,hq,rfl⟩
      change renameToOneTie C q ∈ R
      by_cases hqp : q = p
      · rw [hqp]
        have ht : tiePolynomial C.a C.b C.c ∈ R := Ideal.subset_span (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)
        rcases renameToOneTie_live C with he | he
        · rwa [he]
        · rw [he]; exact neg_mem ht
      · let q' : ↥M := ⟨q, Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hqp,hq⟩⟩
        have hd : (w q').mapDomain C.sigma ∈ E :=
          Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨q',Finset.mem_attach _ _,rfl⟩
        have hm : MvPolynomial.monomial ((w q').mapDomain C.sigma) (1 : ℚ) ∈ R :=
          Ideal.subset_span (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨_,hd,rfl⟩))
        change renameToOneTie C (q' : TailPoly ℚ) ∈ R
        rw [heq]; exact neg_mem hm
  have hpos : 0 < D.semigroupRho := by
    rw [← hcard]
    exact Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨p,hmem⟩
  have hl := (renamedChosenBaseIdeal_minimalGeneratorCard C).2 (rawLiftGeneratorFinset C E) hraw
  have hu : (rawLiftGeneratorFinset C E).card ≤ E.card + 1 := by
    exact (Finset.card_insert_le _ _).trans (Nat.add_le_add_right Finset.card_image_le 1)
  exact ⟨p,C,E,hraw,by omega,hpos⟩

name: P23.Semigroup.chosenBaseDefiningIdeal_generator_card_lower_bound
statement:
theorem chosenBaseDefiningIdeal_generator_card_lower_bound (G : Finset (TailPoly k))
    (hG : Ideal.span (↑G : Set (TailPoly k)) = chosenBaseDefiningIdeal D i) :
    D.semigroupRho ≤ G.card
proof:
:= by
  have h := finrank_le_of_span_eq_top (chosenBaseGeneratorClasses_span_eq_top D i G hG)
  rw [chosenBaseRelationSpace_finrank] at h
  simpa using h

name: P23.Semigroup.specializedConnectorFinset_card_eq_rho
statement:
theorem specializedConnectorFinset_card_eq_rho :
    (specializedConnectorFinset (k := k) D i).card = D.semigroupRho
proof:
:=
  Nat.le_antisymm (specializedConnectorFinset_card_le_rho D i)
    (chosenBaseDefiningIdeal_generator_card_lower_bound D i _ (specializedConnectorFinset_span_eq D i))

name: P23.Semigroup.specializedConnectorPolynomial_injective
statement:
theorem specializedConnectorPolynomial_injective :
    Function.Injective (D.specializedConnectorPolynomial (k := k) i)
proof:
:= by
  intro g h he
  by_contra hn
  have hc := congrArg (chosenBaseConnectorCoeff (k := k) D i g) he
  rw [chosenBaseConnectorCoeff_specializedConnector,
    chosenBaseConnectorCoeff_specializedConnector] at hc
  simp only [ite_eq_left rfl, ite_eq_right hn] at hc
  exact one_ne_zero hc

name: P23.Semigroup.chosenBaseDefiningIdeal_minimalGeneratorCard
statement:
theorem chosenBaseDefiningIdeal_minimalGeneratorCard :
    HasMinimalGeneratorCard (chosenBaseDefiningIdeal (k := k) D i) D.semigroupRho
proof:
:=
  ⟨⟨specializedConnectorFinset D i, specializedConnectorFinset_span_eq D i,
    specializedConnectorFinset_card_eq_rho D i⟩,
    chosenBaseDefiningIdeal_generator_card_lower_bound D i⟩

name: P23.Semigroup.chosenBaseDefiningIdeal_mu_eq_rho
statement:
theorem chosenBaseDefiningIdeal_mu_eq_rho :
    idealGeneratorMu (chosenBaseDefiningIdeal (k := k) D i) = D.semigroupRho
proof:
:= by
  have hmin := chosenBaseDefiningIdeal_minimalGeneratorCard (k := k) D i
  rcases hmin.1 with ⟨G₀, hG₀, hcard₀⟩
  have hex : ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ G : Finset (TailPoly k),
      Ideal.span (↑G : Set (TailPoly k)) = chosenBaseDefiningIdeal D i ∧ G.card = n :=
    ⟨D.semigroupRho, G₀, hG₀, hcard₀⟩
  rw [idealGeneratorMu, dif_pos hex]
  apply Nat.le_antisymm
  · exact Nat.find_min' hex ⟨G₀, hG₀, hcard₀⟩
  · rcases Nat.find_spec hex with ⟨G,hG,hcard⟩
    rw [← hcard]
    exact hmin.2 G hG

name: P23.Semigroup.chosenBase_mu_eq_rho_Q
statement:
theorem chosenBase_mu_eq_rho_Q :
    idealGeneratorMu (chosenBaseDefiningIdeal (k := ℚ) D i) = D.semigroupRho
proof:
:=
  chosenBaseDefiningIdeal_mu_eq_rho D i

name: P23.Semigroup.semigroupRhoAsChosenBaseIdealMu
statement: theorem semigroupRhoAsChosenBaseIdealMu : SemigroupRhoAsChosenBaseIdealMu (k := k) D
proof:
:=
  fun i => ⟨chosenBaseDefiningIdeal_minimalGeneratorCard D i, chosenBaseDefiningIdeal_mu_eq_rho D i⟩

name: P23.Semigroup.chosenBase_minimalMonomialPresentation_of_budget_zero
statement:
theorem chosenBase_minimalMonomialPresentation_of_budget_zero
    (hB : D.fourBaseBudget i = 0) : MinimalMonomialChosenBasePresentation (k := k) D i
proof:
:= by
  let G := (specializedConnectorFinset (k := k) D i).image Neg.neg
  have hspan : Ideal.span (↑G : Set (TailPoly k)) = chosenBaseDefiningIdeal D i := by
    rw [← specializedConnectorFinset_span_eq (k := k) D i]
    apply le_antisymm
    · apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
      intro p hp
      obtain ⟨q,hq,rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hp
      exact neg_mem (Ideal.subset_span hq)
    · apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
      intro p hp
      have hneg : -p ∈ Ideal.span (↑G : Set (TailPoly k)) :=
        Ideal.subset_span (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨p,hp,rfl⟩)
      simpa using neg_mem hneg
  refine ⟨G,hspan,?_,?_,chosenBaseDefiningIdeal_minimalGeneratorCard D i⟩
  · rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ neg_injective, specializedConnectorFinset_card_eq_rho]
  · intro p hp
    obtain ⟨q,hq,rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hp
    obtain ⟨g,_,rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hq
    have hg := D.specializedConnector_isMonomial_of_base_mem_support (k := k) i g
      (D.all_connectors_external_of_budget_zero i hB g)
    exact ⟨D.connectorRightTail i g, by simp [hg.1], neg_ne_zero.mpr hg.2⟩

name: P23.Semigroup.neg_monomial_not_live
statement:
theorem neg_monomial_not_live (w : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) :
    ¬D.LiveTailBinomial (k := k) i (-MvPolynomial.monomial w 1)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨u,v,he,_,_,_,huv,_⟩
  have hcu := congrArg (MvPolynomial.coeff u) he
  have hw : w = u := by
    by_contra hwu
    have : (0 : k) = 1 := by simpa [MvPolynomial.coeff_monomial, hwu, Ne.symm hwu, huv, Ne.symm huv] using hcu
    exact zero_ne_one this
  subst w
  have hcv := congrArg (MvPolynomial.coeff v) he
  have : (0 : k) = -1 := by simpa [MvPolynomial.coeff_monomial, huv, Ne.symm huv] using hcv
  exact neg_ne_zero.mpr one_ne_zero this.symm

name: P23.Semigroup.chosenBase_minimal_one_live_binomial_of_budget_one
statement:
theorem chosenBase_minimal_one_live_binomial_of_budget_one
    (hB : D.fourBaseBudget i = 1) : MinimalOneLiveBinomialChosenBasePresentation (k := k) D i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g,hg,huniq⟩ := D.existsUnique_internal_connector_of_budget_one i hB
  have hlive := D.specializedConnector_isLiveBinomial_of_base_not_mem_support (k := k) i g hg
  have hmem : D.specializedConnectorPolynomial (k := k) i g ∈ specializedConnectorFinset D i :=
    Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨g,Finset.mem_univ _,rfl⟩
  have external : ∀ h : D.BaseAdaptedGlobalConnector i, h ≠ g →
      D.specializedConnectorPolynomial (k := k) i h = -MvPolynomial.monomial (D.connectorRightTail i h) 1 ∧
      D.specializedConnectorPolynomial (k := k) i h ≠ 0 := by
    intro h hne
    apply D.specializedConnector_isMonomial_of_base_mem_support
    by_contra hi
    exact hne (huniq h hi)
  refine ⟨specializedConnectorFinset D i,g,specializedConnectorFinset_span_eq D i,
    specializedConnectorFinset_card_eq_rho D i,hmem,hlive,?_,?_,?_,
    D.internal_connector_pure_side i g hg,chosenBaseDefiningIdeal_minimalGeneratorCard D i⟩
  · intro p hp
    obtain ⟨h,_,rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hp
    constructor
    · intro hh
      by_cases he : h = g
      · rw [he]
      · rw [(external h he).1] at hh
        exact False.elim (neg_monomial_not_live D i _ hh)
    · intro he
      rw [he]
      exact hlive
  · intro p hp hne
    obtain ⟨h,_,rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hp
    have he : h ≠ g := fun he => hne (congrArg (D.specializedConnectorPolynomial i) he)
    exact ⟨_,external h he⟩
  · rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem hmem, specializedConnectorFinset_card_eq_rho]

name: P23.Semigroup.semigroup_type_three_ng_chosenBase_fullBridge
statement:
theorem semigroup_type_three_ng_chosenBase_fullBridge
    (htype : D.semigroupType = 3) (hNG : SemigroupNearlyGorenstein D) :
    chosenBaseType (k := ℚ) D i = 3 ∧ ChosenBaseNearlyGorenstein (k := ℚ) D i ∧
      idealGeneratorMu (chosenBaseDefiningIdeal (k := ℚ) D i) = D.semigroupRho
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ht,hn⟩ := semigroup_type_three_ng_gives_chosenBase_type_three_ng (k := ℚ) D i htype hNG
  exact ⟨ht,hn,chosenBase_mu_eq_rho_Q D i⟩

name: P23.Semigroup.chosenBaseMinimalityBridge
statement:
theorem chosenBaseMinimalityBridge : ChosenBaseMinimalityBridge (k := k) D i where
  exactSubmodule
proof:
:= mem_chosenBaseRelationSubmodule_iff D i
  basis := chosenBaseRelationBasis_apply D i
  dimension := chosenBaseRelationSpace_finrank D i
  arbitraryLower := chosenBaseDefiningIdeal_generator_card_lower_bound D i
  exactCard := specializedConnectorFinset_card_eq_rho D i
  minimal := chosenBaseDefiningIdeal_minimalGeneratorCard D i
  numeric := chosenBaseDefiningIdeal_mu_eq_rho D i
  allBaseSemantic := semigroupRhoAsChosenBaseIdealMu D
  budgetZero := chosenBase_minimalMonomialPresentation_of_budget_zero D i
  budgetOne := chosenBase_minimal_one_live_binomial_of_budget_one D i

name: P23.Semigroup.mem_aperyDivisorFinset

@[simp] theorem mem_aperyDivisorFinset (B : DominantAperyBase D i) (w : D.AperyIndex i) :

name: P23.Semigroup.pfAperyPoint_injective
statement:
theorem pfAperyPoint_injective (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup) (i : Fin 4) :
    Function.Injective (pfAperyPoint D i)

:= by

name: P23.Semigroup.pfAperyPoint_degree
statement:
theorem pfAperyPoint_degree (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup) (i : Fin 4)
    (f : D.PseudoFrobeniusIndex) : (pfAperyPoint D i f).1.1=(f.1+(D.n i:ℤ)).toNat
proof:
:= by
