name: P23.Semigroup.pfAperyPoint_degree_int
statement:
theorem pfAperyPoint_degree_int (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup) (i : Fin 4)
    (f : D.PseudoFrobeniusIndex) : ((pfAperyPoint D i f).1.1:ℤ)=f.1+(D.n i:ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  have h := aperySocle_pf_degree (D.pseudoFrobeniusEquivAperySocle i f)
  rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply] at h
  exact h

name: P23.Semigroup.dominant_center_pf_point
statement:
theorem dominant_center_pf_point (B : DominantAperyBase D i) :
    pfAperyPoint D i B.centerPF=B.center.1
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Subtype.ext
  have h := pfAperyPoint_degree_int D i B.centerPF
  have hc := B.centerDegreeEq
  exact_mod_cast h.trans hc.symm

name: P23.Semigroup.exceptionalApery_eq_pf_image
statement:
theorem exceptionalApery_eq_pf_image (B : DominantAperyBase D i) :
    exceptionalAperyFinset B=(Finset.univ.erase B.centerPF).image (pfAperyPoint D i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext w
  simp only [exceptionalAperyFinset,Finset.mem_sdiff,Finset.mem_univ,true_and,
    aperyDivisor_complement,Finset.mem_image,Finset.mem_erase,Finset.mem_univ,and_true]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hw,hn⟩
    let s : D.AperySocleIndex i := ⟨w,hw⟩
    let f := (D.pseudoFrobeniusEquivAperySocle i).symm s
    have hf : pfAperyPoint D i f=w := by
      change ((D.pseudoFrobeniusEquivAperySocle i)
        ((D.pseudoFrobeniusEquivAperySocle i).symm s)).1=w
      simp [s]
    refine ⟨f,?_,hf⟩
    intro he
    rw [he,dominant_center_pf_point B] at hf
    exact hn hf.symm
  · rintro ⟨f,hf,rfl⟩
    refine ⟨(D.pseudoFrobeniusEquivAperySocle i f).2,?_⟩
    intro he
    apply hf
    apply pfAperyPoint_injective D i
    exact he.trans (dominant_center_pf_point B).symm

name: P23.Semigroup.exceptionalApery_card
statement:
theorem exceptionalApery_card (B : DominantAperyBase D i) :
    (exceptionalAperyFinset B).card=D.semigroupType-1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [exceptionalApery_eq_pf_image,
    Finset.card_image_of_injective _ (pfAperyPoint_injective D i)]
  simp [semigroupType]

name: P23.Semigroup.aperyDivisor_card_int
statement:
theorem aperyDivisor_card_int (B : DominantAperyBase D i) :
    ((aperyDivisorFinset B).card:ℤ)=(D.n i:ℤ)-(D.semigroupType:ℤ)+1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hc := Finset.card_sdiff_add_card_eq_card
    (Finset.subset_univ (aperyDivisorFinset B))
  change (exceptionalAperyFinset B).card+(aperyDivisorFinset B).card=
    Fintype.card (D.AperyIndex i) at hc
  rw [exceptionalApery_card] at hc
  have hq : Fintype.card (D.AperyIndex i)=D.n i := by
    simpa [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using aperyIndex_card D i
  rw [hq] at hc
  have ht := D.semigroupType_pos
  have hz := congrArg (fun n : ℕ=>(n:ℤ)) hc
  rw [Nat.cast_add,Int.natCast_sub (by omega)] at hz
  push_cast at hz
  omega

name: P23.Semigroup.dominantMultiplier_eq
statement:
theorem dominantMultiplier_eq (B : DominantAperyBase D i) (w : ↥(aperyDivisorFinset B)) :
    B.center.1.1=w.1.1+dominantMultiplier B w
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec ((mem_aperyDivisorFinset B w.1).mp w.2)

name: P23.Semigroup.dominantMultiplier_isApery
statement:
theorem dominantMultiplier_isApery (B : DominantAperyBase D i)
    (w : ↥(aperyDivisorFinset B)) : D.IsApery i (dominantMultiplier B w)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨g,hg⟩
  apply B.center.1.2
  refine ⟨w.1.1+g,?_⟩
  rw [dominantMultiplier_eq B w,hg]
  abel

name: P23.Semigroup.dominantReflectionPoint_degree
statement:
theorem dominantReflectionPoint_degree (B : DominantAperyBase D i)
    (w : ↥(aperyDivisorFinset B)) :
    B.center.1.1.1=w.1.1.1+(dominantReflectionPoint B w).1.1.1
proof:
:=
  congrArg Subtype.val (dominantMultiplier_eq B w)

name: P23.Semigroup.dominantReflectionPoint_involutive
statement:
theorem dominantReflectionPoint_involutive (B : DominantAperyBase D i) :
    Function.Involutive (dominantReflectionPoint B)
proof:
:= by
  intro w
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Subtype.ext
  have h1 := dominantReflectionPoint_degree B w
  have h2 := dominantReflectionPoint_degree B (dominantReflectionPoint B w)
  omega

name: P23.Semigroup.dominantReflection_degree
statement:
theorem dominantReflection_degree (B : DominantAperyBase D i)
    (w : ↥(aperyDivisorFinset B)) :
    B.center.1.1.1=w.1.1.1+(dominantReflection B w).1.1.1
proof:
:=
  dominantReflectionPoint_degree B w

name: P23.Semigroup.dominant_divisor_sum_doubled
statement:
theorem dominant_divisor_sum_doubled (B : DominantAperyBase D i) :
    2*(∑ w ∈ aperyDivisorFinset B,(w.1.1:ℤ))=
      ((aperyDivisorFinset B).card:ℤ)*(B.center.1.1.1:ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hs := (dominantReflection B).sum_comp
    (fun w : ↥(aperyDivisorFinset B)=>(w.1.1.1:ℤ))
  have hp : (∑ w : ↥(aperyDivisorFinset B),
      ((w.1.1.1:ℤ)+((dominantReflection B w).1.1.1:ℤ)))=
      ((aperyDivisorFinset B).card:ℤ)*(B.center.1.1.1:ℤ) := by
    calc
      _=∑ _w : ↥(aperyDivisorFinset B),(B.center.1.1.1:ℤ) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro w _
        exact_mod_cast (dominantReflection_degree B w).symm
      _=_ := by simp
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib,hs] at hp
  have hc : (∑ w : ↥(aperyDivisorFinset B),(w.1.1.1:ℤ)) =
      ∑ w ∈ aperyDivisorFinset B,(w.1.1:ℤ) :=
    Finset.sum_coe_sort (aperyDivisorFinset B) (fun w : D.AperyIndex i => (w.1.1:ℤ))
  rw [hc] at hp
  nlinarith

name: P23.Semigroup.exceptional_apery_sum
statement:
theorem exceptional_apery_sum (B : DominantAperyBase D i) :
    (∑ w ∈ exceptionalAperyFinset B,(w.1.1:ℤ))=
      D.pseudoFrobeniusSum-B.centerPF.1+((D.semigroupType:ℤ)-1)*(D.n i:ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [exceptionalApery_eq_pf_image,
    Finset.sum_image (pfAperyPoint_injective D i).injOn]
  simp_rw [pfAperyPoint_degree_int]
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib,D.pseudoFrobeniusSum_erase]
  have ht : 1≤D.semigroupType := D.semigroupType_pos
  simp only [Finset.sum_const,Finset.card_erase_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ B.centerPF),
    Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul]
  change _ + ((D.semigroupType-1:ℕ):ℤ)*(D.n i:ℤ) = _
  rw [Int.natCast_sub ht]
  rfl

name: P23.Semigroup.dominant_apery_sum_formula
statement:
theorem dominant_apery_sum_formula (B : DominantAperyBase D i) :
    2*(∑ w : D.AperyIndex i,(w.1.1:ℤ))=
      ((D.n i:ℤ)-(D.semigroupType:ℤ)+1)*(B.centerPF.1+(D.n i:ℤ))+
      2*(D.pseudoFrobeniusSum-B.centerPF.1+((D.semigroupType:ℤ)-1)*(D.n i:ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hp := Finset.sum_sdiff (f:=fun w : D.AperyIndex i=>(w.1.1:ℤ))
    (Finset.subset_univ (aperyDivisorFinset B))
  change (∑ w ∈ exceptionalAperyFinset B,(w.1.1:ℤ))+
    (∑ w ∈ aperyDivisorFinset B,(w.1.1:ℤ))=(∑ w : D.AperyIndex i,(w.1.1:ℤ)) at hp
  have hd := dominant_divisor_sum_doubled B
  rw [aperyDivisor_card_int B,B.centerDegreeEq] at hd
  rw [exceptional_apery_sum B] at hp
  nlinarith

name: P23.Semigroup.dominant_base_pivot
statement:
theorem dominant_base_pivot (B : DominantAperyBase D i) :
    (D.n i:ℤ)*(2*(D.genus:ℤ)-B.centerPF.1-(D.semigroupType:ℤ))=
      2*D.pseudoFrobeniusSum-((D.semigroupType:ℤ)+1)*B.centerPF.1
proof:
:= by
  have hg := D.apery_genus_formula_doubled i
  have hs := dominant_apery_sum_formula B
  nlinarith

name: P23.Semigroup.BudgetZeroPlainModel.centres_of_ng
statement:
theorem centres_of_ng (hcard : 2≤M.roots.card) (hn : SemigroupNearlyGorenstein D) :

proof:
:= by
  have hng := (chosenPlain_ng_iff M.roots M.roots_nonempty M.chosenBaseEquivPlain).mp
    (semigroupNearlyGorenstein_to_chosenBaseNearlyGorenstein D i hn)
  have htrace : PlainVariablesInTrace ℚ M.roots M.variables_survive := by
    intro j
    apply hng
    apply plain_PX_mem_augmentation
    intro he
    have he' := congrArg (fun p : PlainExp => p j) he
    simpa using he'
  exact plain_hasDirectionalCentres_of_variablesInTrace M.roots M.roots_nonempty hcard
    M.roots_antichain M.variables_survive htrace

name: P23.Semigroup.budget_zero_type_two_mu_le_five_Q

    (h0 : D.fourBaseBudget i=0) (ht : chosenBaseType (k:=ℚ) D i=2) :

  have hb := plain_type_two_border_card_le_five M.roots M.roots_antichain h2 M.variables_survive

theorem budget_zero_type_two_mu_le_five {k : Type*} [Field k]

      ((chosenBaseType_eq_semigroupType (k:=k) D i).symm.trans ht)

proof:
:= by

  have h3 : M.roots.card=3 := M.rootCard_eq_semigroupType.trans ht
  have hc := M.centres_of_ng (by omega) hn

name: P23.Semigroup.budgetZeroTypeThreeSevenDominant
statement:
theorem budgetZeroTypeThreeSevenDominant (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup) (i : Fin 4)
    (h0 : D.fourBaseBudget i=0) (ht : D.semigroupType=3) (hn : SemigroupNearlyGorenstein D)
    (hr : 7≤D.semigroupRho) : Nonempty (BudgetZeroTypeThreeSevenDominant D i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨F⟩ := budgetZeroTypeThreeFrontier D i h0 ht hn
  have h7 : D.semigroupRho=7 := by have := F.rhoFrontier; omega
  have hc := F.model.centres_of_ng (by have := F.typeThree; omega) hn
  have hb : (plainBorderFinset F.model.roots).card=7 := F.model.borderCard_eq_rho.trans h7
  obtain ⟨s,hs,hd⟩ := plain_type_three_border_seven_has_dominant_root
    F.model.roots F.model.roots_antichain F.typeThree F.model.variables_survive hc hb
  exact ⟨⟨F,h7,⟨s,hs⟩,⟨hs,hd⟩⟩⟩

statement:

    (a : D.FiberRelationSpace k d) :
    D.fiberRelationPolynomial (k := k) d a =
      D.fiberPolynomial (k := k) d a.1

    a ∈ D.ActualLowerDegreeRelationSubmodule (k := k) d ↔
      D.fiberPolynomial (k := k) d a.1 ∈ D.lowerToricIdeal (k := k) d

:=

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.degreeComponentCoeffVector_fiberPolynomial
statement:
theorem degreeComponentCoeffVector_fiberPolynomial (d : ℕ)
    (a : D.FiberCoeff k d) :
    D.degreeComponentCoeffVector (k := k) d
        (D.fiberPolynomial (k := k) d a) =
      D.componentCoeff (k := k) d a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  funext C
  simp only [degreeComponentCoeffVector, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk,
    componentCoeff]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro u _
  exact D.coeff_fiberPolynomial d a u

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.shiftedFactorizations_sameComponent
statement:
theorem shiftedFactorizations_sameComponent {e d : ℕ}
    (u v : D.FactorizationAt e) (w : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ)
    (hdeg : D.weightedDegree w + e = d) (hw : w ≠ 0) :
    D.componentOf (D.shiftedFactorization u w hdeg) =
      D.componentOf (D.shiftedFactorization v w hdeg)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨j, hjmem⟩ := Finsupp.support_nonempty_iff.mpr hw
  have hwj : 0 < w j := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hjmem)
  let su := D.shiftedFactorization u w hdeg
  let sv := D.shiftedFactorization v w hdeg
  by_cases huv : su = sv
  · exact congrArg D.componentOf huv
  · apply (D.componentOf_eq_iff_reachable su sv).2
    exact ((D.factorizationGraph_adj su sv).2 ⟨huv, j,
      by
        change 0 < w j + u.1 j
        omega,
      by
        change 0 < w j + v.1 j
        omega⟩).reachable

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.degreeComponentCoeffVector_monomial_of_degree_ne
statement:
theorem degreeComponentCoeffVector_monomial_of_degree_ne
    (d : ℕ) (w : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) (r : k)
    (hdeg : D.weightedDegree w ≠ d) :
    D.degreeComponentCoeffVector (k := k) d (MvPolynomial.monomial w r) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  funext C
  simp only [degreeComponentCoeffVector, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk,
    Pi.zero_apply]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro u _
  have huw : u.1 ≠ w := by
    intro h
    apply hdeg
    rw [← D.factorizationAt_degree u, h]
  simp [MvPolynomial.coeff_monomial, huw.symm]

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.degreeComponentCoeffVector_monomial_mul_fiberBinomial
statement:
theorem degreeComponentCoeffVector_monomial_mul_fiberBinomial
    {e d : ℕ} (hed : e < d) (u v : D.FactorizationAt e)
    (w : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) (r : k) :
    D.degreeComponentCoeffVector (k := k) d
      (MvPolynomial.monomial w r * D.fiberBinomial (k := k) u v) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hdeg : D.weightedDegree w + e = d
  · have hw : w ≠ 0 := by
      intro hw
      subst w
      simp only [weightedDegreeOf_zero, zero_add] at hdeg
      omega
    let su := D.shiftedFactorization u w hdeg
    let sv := D.shiftedFactorization v w hdeg
    have hcomp : D.componentOf su = D.componentOf sv :=
      D.shiftedFactorizations_sameComponent u v w hdeg hw
    have hpoly :
        MvPolynomial.monomial w r * D.fiberBinomial (k := k) u v =
          r • D.fiberBinomial (k := k) su sv := by
      simp [fiberBinomial, fiberMonomial, su, sv, shiftedFactorization,
        mul_sub, MvPolynomial.monomial_mul, smul_sub,
        MvPolynomial.smul_monomial, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [hpoly, ← D.fiberPolynomial_fiberDelta su sv, ← map_smul,
      D.degreeComponentCoeffVector_fiberPolynomial]
    have hcomponent :
        D.componentCoeff (k := k) d (D.fiberDelta (k := k) su sv) =
          D.componentDelta (k := k) su sv := by
      exact congrArg Subtype.val
        (D.fiberToComponentRelation_fiberDelta (k := k) su sv)
    rw [map_smul, hcomponent]
    simp [componentDelta, hcomp]
  · have huDegree : D.weightedDegree (w + u.1) ≠ d := by
      have hu := D.factorizationAt_degree u
      change weightedDegreeOf D.n u.1 = e at hu
      change weightedDegreeOf D.n (w + u.1) ≠ d
      rw [weightedDegreeOf_add, hu]
      exact hdeg
    have hvDegree : D.weightedDegree (w + v.1) ≠ d := by
      have hv := D.factorizationAt_degree v
      change weightedDegreeOf D.n v.1 = e at hv
      change weightedDegreeOf D.n (w + v.1) ≠ d
      rw [weightedDegreeOf_add, hv]
      exact hdeg
    have hpoly :
        MvPolynomial.monomial w r * D.fiberBinomial (k := k) u v =
          MvPolynomial.monomial (w + u.1) r -
            MvPolynomial.monomial (w + v.1) r := by
      simp [fiberBinomial, fiberMonomial, mul_sub,
        MvPolynomial.monomial_mul]
    rw [hpoly, map_sub,
      D.degreeComponentCoeffVector_monomial_of_degree_ne d (w + u.1) r huDegree,
      D.degreeComponentCoeffVector_monomial_of_degree_ne d (w + v.1) r hvDegree,
      sub_zero]

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.degreeComponentCoeffVector_mul_fiberBinomial
statement:
theorem degreeComponentCoeffVector_mul_fiberBinomial
    {e d : ℕ} (hed : e < d) (u v : D.FactorizationAt e)
    (p : FourPoly k) :
    D.degreeComponentCoeffVector (k := k) d
      (p * D.fiberBinomial (k := k) u v) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  conv_lhs => rw [MvPolynomial.as_sum p]
  simp only [Finset.sum_mul, map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro w _
  exact D.degreeComponentCoeffVector_monomial_mul_fiberBinomial
    (k := k) hed u v w (MvPolynomial.coeff w p)

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.mem_lowerToricIdeal_componentCoeff_zero
statement:
theorem mem_lowerToricIdeal_componentCoeff_zero (d : ℕ) (p : FourPoly k)
    (hp : p ∈ D.lowerToricIdeal (k := k) d) :
    D.degreeComponentCoeffVector (k := k) d p = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold lowerToricIdeal at hp
  have hall : ∀ q : FourPoly k,
      D.degreeComponentCoeffVector (k := k) d (q * p) = 0 := by
    refine Submodule.span_induction
      (p := fun x (_hx : x ∈ Submodule.span (FourPoly k)
        {p | ∃ (e : ℕ) (_ : e < d) (u v : D.FactorizationAt e),
          p = D.fiberBinomial (k := k) u v}) =>
        ∀ q : FourPoly k,
          D.degreeComponentCoeffVector (k := k) d (q * x) = 0)
      ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hp
    · intro x hx
      rcases hx with ⟨e, hed, u, v, rfl⟩
      intro q
      exact D.degreeComponentCoeffVector_mul_fiberBinomial hed u v q
    · intro q
      simp
    · intro x y hx hy ihx ihy q
      rw [mul_add, map_add, ihx q, ihy q, add_zero]
    · intro a x hx ihx q
      change D.degreeComponentCoeffVector (k := k) d (q * (a * x)) = 0
      rw [← mul_assoc]
      exact ihx (q * a)
  simpa using hall 1

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.actualConnectorRelationFinset_generates
statement:
theorem actualConnectorRelationFinset_generates {d : ℕ}
    (hd : D.IsBettiDegree d) :
    D.GeneratesActualDegreeNewRelations
      (D.connectorRelationFinset (k := k) hd)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold GeneratesActualDegreeNewRelations
  have hle :
      Submodule.span k (Set.range (D.actualConnectorClass (k := k) hd)) ≤
        Submodule.span k
          (D.actualDegreeNewGeneratorFinset (k := k)
            (D.connectorRelationFinset (k := k) hd) :
              Set (D.ActualDegreeNewToricRelationSpace k d)) := by
    rw [Submodule.span_le]
    rintro z ⟨e, rfl⟩
    apply Submodule.subset_span (R := k)
    show D.actualConnectorClass (k := k) hd e ∈
      D.actualDegreeNewGeneratorFinset (k := k)
        (D.connectorRelationFinset (k := k) hd)
    unfold actualDegreeNewGeneratorFinset actualConnectorClass
    apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
    refine ⟨D.connectorFiberRelation (k := k) hd e, ?_, rfl⟩
    unfold connectorRelationFinset
    exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨e, Finset.mem_univ e, rfl⟩
  rw [D.actualConnectorClass_span_eq_top (k := k) hd] at hle
  exact top_unique hle

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.actualDegreeToricRelation_generator_card_lower_bound
statement:
theorem actualDegreeToricRelation_generator_card_lower_bound {d : ℕ}
    (hd : D.IsBettiDegree d) (G : Finset (D.FiberRelationSpace k d))
    (hG : D.GeneratesActualDegreeNewRelations (k := k) G) :
    D.bettiContribution d ≤ G.card
proof:
:= by
  rw [← D.actualDegreeNewToricRelationSpace_finrank (k := k) hd]
  classical
  unfold GeneratesActualDegreeNewRelations at hG
  have h := finrank_span_le_card (R := k)
    (D.actualDegreeNewGeneratorFinset (k := k) G :
      Set (D.ActualDegreeNewToricRelationSpace k d))
  rw [hG] at h
  calc
    Module.finrank k (D.ActualDegreeNewToricRelationSpace k d) ≤
        (D.actualDegreeNewGeneratorFinset (k := k) G).card := by simpa using h
    _ ≤ G.card := by
      unfold actualDegreeNewGeneratorFinset
      exact Finset.card_image_le

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.generatesDegreeDModuloLower_iff_sup_span
statement:
theorem generatesDegreeDModuloLower_iff_sup_span {d : ℕ}
    (G : Finset (D.FiberRelationSpace k d)) :
    D.GeneratesDegreeDModuloLower (k := k) G ↔
      D.ActualLowerDegreeRelationSubmodule (k := k) d ⊔
        Submodule.span k (G : Set (D.FiberRelationSpace k d)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [eq_top_iff]
    intro a _
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hab⟩ := h a
    have hdiff : a - b ∈
        D.ActualLowerDegreeRelationSubmodule (k := k) d :=
      (D.mem_actualLowerDegreeRelationSubmodule_iff d (a - b)).2 hab
    have hsum := Submodule.add_mem
      (D.ActualLowerDegreeRelationSubmodule (k := k) d ⊔
        Submodule.span k (G : Set (D.FiberRelationSpace k d)))
      (Submodule.mem_sup_left hdiff) (Submodule.mem_sup_right hb)
    simpa using hsum
  · intro htop a
    have ha : a ∈ D.ActualLowerDegreeRelationSubmodule (k := k) d ⊔
        Submodule.span k (G : Set (D.FiberRelationSpace k d)) := by
      rw [htop]
      exact Submodule.mem_top
    obtain ⟨x, hx, b, hb, hxb⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp ha
    refine ⟨b, hb, ?_⟩
    apply (D.mem_actualLowerDegreeRelationSubmodule_iff d (a - b)).1
    have hab : a - b = x := by
      rw [← hxb]
      abel
    simpa [hab] using hx

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.generatesActualDegreeNewRelations_iff_sup_span
statement:
theorem generatesActualDegreeNewRelations_iff_sup_span {d : ℕ}
    (G : Finset (D.FiberRelationSpace k d)) :
    D.GeneratesActualDegreeNewRelations (k := k) G ↔
      D.ActualLowerDegreeRelationSubmodule (k := k) d ⊔

proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold GeneratesActualDegreeNewRelations actualDegreeNewGeneratorFinset
  have hset :
      ((G.image (D.actualDegreeNewMk (k := k) d) :
          Finset (D.ActualDegreeNewToricRelationSpace k d)) :
          Set (D.ActualDegreeNewToricRelationSpace k d)) =
        D.actualDegreeNewMk (k := k) d ''
          (G : Set (D.FiberRelationSpace k d)) := by
    ext z
    simp
  rw [hset, ← Submodule.map_span]
  simpa [actualDegreeNewMk] using
    ((D.ActualLowerDegreeRelationSubmodule (k := k) d).map_mkQ_eq_top
      (Submodule.span k (G : Set (D.FiberRelationSpace k d))))

    D.ExactToricBettiPresentationBridge (k := k) d hd where

proof:

name: P23.Semigroup.TaggedBudgetOneNormalization.normalized_external_not_full_support
statement:
theorem normalized_external_not_full_support (ht : D.semigroupType = 3)
    (hn : SemigroupNearlyGorenstein D) (hr : D.semigroupRho = 4)
    (g : D.BaseAdaptedGlobalConnector i) : ¬NormalHasFullSupport (T.normalizedOfExternal g)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro hf
  let u := T.normalizedExternalFactorization g
  let E := D.componentOf u
  have htail (j : Fin 3) : 0 < u.1 (D.tailIndex i j) := by
    change 0 < extendTailExponent i (T.externalTailExponent g) (i.succAbove j)
    rw [extendTailExponent_tail]
    change 0 < (normalExponent (T.normalizedOfExternal g)).mapDomain
      T.presentation.coordinates.sigma.symm j
    rw [Finsupp.mapDomain_equiv_apply]
    change 0 < normalExponent (T.normalizedOfExternal g) (T.presentation.coordinates.sigma j)
    generalize T.presentation.coordinates.sigma j = l
    fin_cases l
    · simpa using hf.1
    · simpa using hf.2.1
    · simpa using hf.2.2
  have hall (j : Fin 3) : D.tailIndex i j ∈ D.componentSupport E :=
    D.mem_componentSupport_iff.mpr ⟨u,rfl,htail j⟩
  have hE3 : 3 ≤ (D.componentSupport E).card := by
    have hs : Finset.univ.image (D.tailIndex i) ⊆ D.componentSupport E := by
      intro j hj
      obtain ⟨l,_,rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hj
      exact hall l
    have hc := Finset.card_le_card hs
    rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ (D.tailIndex i).injective] at hc
    simpa using hc
  have hc2 := rho_four_betti_two_components D ht hn hr g.1.2
  have hex : ∃ C : D.BettiComponent g.1.1, C ≠ E := by
    have hc : 1 < Fintype.card (D.BettiComponent g.1.1) := by
      change 1 < D.componentCount g.1.1
      omega
    obtain ⟨C,C',hne⟩ := Fintype.one_lt_card_iff.mp hc
    by_cases hC : C = E
    · exact ⟨C', fun h => hne (hC.trans h.symm)⟩
    · exact ⟨C,hC⟩
  obtain ⟨C,hCE⟩ := hex
  have hCsub : D.componentSupport C ⊆ {i} := by
    intro j hj
    apply Finset.mem_singleton.mpr
    by_contra hji
    let l := (tailIndexEquiv D i).symm ⟨j,hji⟩
    have hl : D.tailIndex i l = j := tailIndexEquiv_symm_apply D i j hji
    have hjE : j ∈ D.componentSupport E := hl ▸ hall l
    exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp (D.componentSupport_disjoint hCE) hj hjE
  have hC1 : (D.componentSupport C).card = 1 := by
    have hlo := Finset.card_pos.mpr (D.componentSupport_nonempty_of_isBetti g.1.2 C)
    have hhi := Finset.card_le_card hCsub
    simp only [Finset.card_singleton] at hhi
    omega
  have hsum : (D.componentSupport C).card + (D.componentSupport E).card ≤ 4 := by
    rw [← Finset.card_union_of_disjoint (D.componentSupport_disjoint hCE)]
    simpa using Finset.card_le_card (Finset.subset_univ
      (D.componentSupport C ∪ D.componentSupport E))
  have hE : (D.componentSupport E).card = 3 := by omega
  exact rho_four_no_support_partition_one_plus_three D ht hn hr g.1.2 ⟨C,E,hC1,hE⟩

theorem rho_four_border_support_card_le_two (ht : D.semigroupType = 3)

name: P23.Semigroup.OneTieCoordinates.coordinateDegree_rename
statement:
theorem coordinateDegree_rename (d : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) :
    C.coordinateDegree (d.mapDomain C.sigma) = tailDegree D i d
proof:
:= by
  unfold coordinateDegree
  have he : C.sigma.symm ∘ C.sigma = id := by funext j; simp
  rw [← Finsupp.mapDomain_comp, he, Finsupp.mapDomain_id]

name: P23.Semigroup.OneTieCoordinates.coordinateDegree_formula
statement:
theorem coordinateDegree_formula (d : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) :
    C.coordinateDegree d = d 0 * D.tailGen i (C.sigma.symm 0) +
      d 1 * D.tailGen i (C.sigma.symm 1) + d 2 * D.tailGen i (C.sigma.symm 2)
proof:
:= by
  unfold coordinateDegree tailDegree
  calc
    _ = ∑ j : Fin 3, d j * D.tailGen i (C.sigma.symm j) := by
      apply Fintype.sum_equiv C.sigma _ _
      intro j
      simp
    _ = _ := by rw [Fin.sum_univ_three]

name: P23.Semigroup.OneTieCoordinates.weighted_tie_equation
statement:
theorem weighted_tie_equation :
    C.a * D.tailGen i (C.sigma.symm 0) =
      C.b * D.tailGen i (C.sigma.symm 1) + C.c * D.tailGen i (C.sigma.symm 2)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let dx : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ := Finsupp.single 0 C.a
  let dy : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ := Finsupp.single 1 C.b + Finsupp.single 2 C.c
  let u := C.original.u.mapDomain C.sigma
  let v := C.original.v.mapDomain C.sigma
  have ha : C.a ≠ 0 := NeZero.ne _
  have hxy : dx ≠ dy := by
    intro he
    have hh := congrArg (fun d : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ => d 0) he
    exact ha (by simpa [dx,dy] using hh)
  have ht : tiePolynomial (k := ℚ) C.a C.b C.c =
      MvPolynomial.monomial dx 1 - MvPolynomial.monomial dy 1 := by
    simp [tiePolynomial, polyX, polyY, polyZ, dx, dy,
      MvPolynomial.X_pow_eq_monomial, MvPolynomial.monomial_mul]
  have he : renameToOneTie C p =
      MvPolynomial.monomial u 1 - MvPolynomial.monomial v 1 := by
    calc
      _ = renameToOneTie C (MvPolynomial.monomial C.original.u 1 -
          MvPolynomial.monomial C.original.v 1) := congrArg (renameToOneTie C) C.original.equation
      _ = _ := by simp [renameToOneTie, MvPolynomial.rename_monomial, u, v]
  have hmatch (d : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) (hd : d = dx ∨ d = dy) : u = d ∨ v = d := by
    by_contra hn
    push_neg at hn
    have hz : MvPolynomial.coeff d (renameToOneTie C p) = 0 := by
      simp [he, hn.1, hn.2]
    rcases renameToOneTie_live C with hs | hs <;> rw [hs, ht] at hz
    all_goals rcases hd with rfl | rfl
    all_goals simp [MvPolynomial.coeff_monomial, hxy, Ne.symm hxy] at hz
  have hx := hmatch dx (Or.inl rfl)
  have hy := hmatch dy (Or.inr rfl)
  have hdeg : C.coordinateDegree u = C.coordinateDegree v := by
    simpa [u,v,C.coordinateDegree_rename] using C.original.degree_eq
  have hpair : C.coordinateDegree dx = C.coordinateDegree dy := by
    rcases hx with hx | hx <;> rcases hy with hy | hy
    · exact False.elim (hxy (hx.symm.trans hy))
    · simpa [hx,hy] using hdeg
    · simpa [hx,hy] using hdeg.symm
    · exact False.elim (hxy (hx.symm.trans hy))
  simpa [C.coordinateDegree_formula, dx,dy] using hpair

name: P23.Semigroup.OneTieCoordinates.normalize_preserves_coordinateDegree
statement:
theorem normalize_preserves_coordinateDegree (d : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) :
    C.coordinateDegree (normalExponent (normalizeExponent C.a C.b C.c d)) =
      C.coordinateDegree d
proof:
:= by
  rw [C.coordinateDegree_formula, C.coordinateDegree_formula]
  simp only [normalExponent_x, normalExponent_y, normalExponent_z,
    normalizeExponent, exponentRaw, Normal.normalize_x, Normal.normalize_y, Normal.normalize_z]
  have hdiv : d 0 % C.a + d 0 / C.a * C.a = d 0 := by
    simpa [Nat.mul_comm] using Nat.mod_add_div (d 0) C.a
  have ht := C.weighted_tie_equation
  calc
    _ = (d 0 % C.a + d 0 / C.a * C.a) * D.tailGen i (C.sigma.symm 0) +
        d 1 * D.tailGen i (C.sigma.symm 1) + d 2 * D.tailGen i (C.sigma.symm 2) := by
      nlinarith [congrArg (fun n : ℕ => (d 0 / C.a) * n) ht]
    _ = _ := by rw [hdiv]

name: P23.Semigroup.TaggedBudgetOneNormalization.normalized_external_degree
statement:
theorem normalized_external_degree (g : D.BaseAdaptedGlobalConnector i) :
    tailDegree D i (T.externalTailExponent g) = g.1.1
proof:
:= by
  change T.presentation.coordinates.coordinateDegree
    (normalExponent (normalizeExponent _ _ _ (T.rawOfExternal g))) = _
  rw [T.presentation.coordinates.normalize_preserves_coordinateDegree]
  change T.presentation.coordinates.coordinateDegree
    ((D.connectorRightTail i g).mapDomain T.presentation.coordinates.sigma) = _
  rw [T.presentation.coordinates.coordinateDegree_rename]
  exact (restrictToTails_degree D i _ (D.connector_target_base_zero i g)).trans
    (D.factorizationAt_degree _)

name: P23.Semigroup.TaggedBudgetOneNormalization.normalized_external_factorization_at_betti_degree
statement:
theorem normalized_external_factorization_at_betti_degree (g : D.BaseAdaptedGlobalConnector i) :
    (T.normalizedExternalFactorization g).1 = extendTailExponent i (T.externalTailExponent g) ∧
    (T.normalizedExternalFactorization g).1 i = 0 ∧
    D.weightedDegree (T.normalizedExternalFactorization g).1 = g.1.1
proof:
:=
  ⟨rfl, extendTailExponent_base _ _, D.factorizationAt_degree _⟩

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.apery_eq_of_le_residue
proof:
:= by
  have hm : s.1.1 ≡ t.1.1 [MOD D.n i] := (ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff _ _ _).mp he
  obtain ⟨k,hk⟩ := (Nat.modEq_iff_exists_eq_add hle).mp hm
  cases k with
  | zero => apply Subtype.ext; apply Subtype.ext; simpa using hk.symm
  | succ k =>
    exfalso
    apply t.2
    refine ⟨s.1 + k • D.base i, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    change t.1.1 = D.n i + (s.1.1 + k * D.n i)
    rw [hk]; ring

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.aperyResidue_injective
statement:
theorem aperyResidue_injective (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup) (i : Fin 4) :
    Function.Injective (aperyResidue D i)
proof:
:= by
  intro s t he
  rcases le_total s.1.1 t.1.1 with h | h
  · exact apery_eq_of_le_residue D i s t h he
  · exact (apery_eq_of_le_residue D i t s h he.symm).symm

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.aperyResidue_surjective
statement:
theorem aperyResidue_surjective (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup) (i : Fin 4) :
    Function.Surjective (aperyResidue D i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : NeZero (D.n i) := ⟨Nat.ne_of_gt (D.positive i)⟩
  intro r
  let P : ℕ → Prop := fun s => s ∈ D.Gamma ∧ (s : ZMod (D.n i))=r
  have hex : ∃ s, P s := by
    refine ⟨r.val + D.conductor * D.n i, ?_, ?_⟩
    · apply D.mem_Gamma_of_conductor_le
      have := Nat.mul_le_mul_left D.conductor (D.positive i)
      omega
    · simp
  let s := Nat.find hex
  have hs := Nat.find_spec hex
  have ha : D.IsApery i ⟨s,hs.1⟩ := by
    rintro ⟨h,he⟩
    have hval : s=D.n i+h.1 := congrArg Subtype.val he
    have hp : P h.1 := by
      refine ⟨h.2, ?_⟩
      have hh := hs.2
      change (s : ZMod (D.n i))=r at hh
      rw [hval] at hh
      simpa using hh
    have hh := Nat.find_min' hex hp
    have hq := D.positive i
    omega
  exact ⟨⟨⟨s,hs.1⟩,ha⟩,hs.2⟩

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.aperyIndex_card
statement:
theorem aperyIndex_card (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup) (i : Fin 4) :
    Nat.card (D.AperyIndex i)=D.n i
proof:
:= by
  letI : NeZero (D.n i) := ⟨Nat.ne_of_gt (D.positive i)⟩
  rw [Nat.card_congr (aperyResidueEquiv D i),Nat.card_eq_fintype_card,ZMod.card]

name: P23.Semigroup.tailDegree_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem tailDegree_zero : tailDegree D i 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [tailDegree]

name: P23.Semigroup.tailDegree_add
statement:
theorem tailDegree_add (u v : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) :
    tailDegree D i (u + v) = tailDegree D i u + tailDegree D i v
proof:
:= by
  simp [tailDegree, add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]

name: P23.Semigroup.tailDegree_single
statement:
@[simp] theorem tailDegree_single (j : Fin 3) (n : ℕ) :
    tailDegree D i (Finsupp.single j n) = n * D.tailGen i j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [tailDegree, Finsupp.single_apply]

name: P23.Semigroup.tailExponent_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem tailExponent_apply (u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) (j : Fin 3) :
    tailExponent D i u j = u (D.tailIndex i j)
proof:
:= by
  simp [tailExponent]

name: P23.Semigroup.weightedDegree_eq_tailDegree_of_base_zero
statement:
theorem weightedDegree_eq_tailDegree_of_base_zero (u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ)
    (hu : u i = 0) :
    D.weightedDegree u = tailDegree D i (tailExponent D i u)
proof:
:= by
  change (∑ j : Fin 4, u j * D.n j) =
    ∑ j : Fin 3, u (i.succAbove j) * D.n (i.succAbove j)
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_succAbove _ i]
  simp [hu, tailDegree, tailExponent, FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.tailGen,
    FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.tailIndex]

name: P23.Semigroup.extendTailExponent_base
statement:
@[simp] theorem extendTailExponent_base (u : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) :
    extendTailExponent i u i = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [extendTailExponent]

name: P23.Semigroup.extendTailExponent_tail
statement:
@[simp] theorem extendTailExponent_tail (u : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) (j : Fin 3) :
    extendTailExponent i u (i.succAbove j) = u j
proof:
:= by
  simp [extendTailExponent]

name: P23.Semigroup.weightedDegree_extendTailExponent
statement:
theorem weightedDegree_extendTailExponent (u : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) :
    D.weightedDegree (extendTailExponent i u) = tailDegree D i u
proof:
:= by
  rw [weightedDegree_eq_tailDegree_of_base_zero D i _ (extendTailExponent_base i u)]
  congr 1
  apply Finsupp.ext
  intro j
  simp [tailExponent, extendTailExponent]

name: P23.Semigroup.tailDegreeGamma_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem tailDegreeGamma_zero : tailDegreeGamma D i 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp [tailDegreeGamma]

name: P23.Semigroup.tailDegreeGamma_add
statement:
theorem tailDegreeGamma_add (u v : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) :
    tailDegreeGamma D i (u + v) = tailDegreeGamma D i u + tailDegreeGamma D i v
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact tailDegree_add D i u v

name: P23.Semigroup.truncatedAperyMonomial_tail
statement:
@[simp] theorem truncatedAperyMonomial_tail (j : Fin 3) :
    truncatedAperyMonomial (k := k) D i (D.tail i j) =
      tailVariableA (k := k) D i j
proof:
:= by
  simp [truncatedAperyMonomial, tailVariableA, D.tail_isApery i j]

name: P23.Semigroup.tailPolyToApery_X
statement:
@[simp] theorem tailPolyToApery_X (j : Fin 3) :
    tailPolyToApery (k := k) D i (MvPolynomial.X j) = tailVariableA (k := k) D i j
proof:
:= by
  simp [tailPolyToApery]

name: P23.Semigroup.tailVariable_prod
statement:
private theorem tailVariable_prod (u : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) :
    u.prod (fun j n => (tailVariableA (k := k) D i j) ^ n) =
      truncatedAperyMonomial (k := k) D i
        (tailDegreeGamma D i u)
proof:
:= by
  induction u using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add u v hu hv =>
      rw [Finsupp.prod_add_index' (fun _ => pow_zero _) (fun _ _ _ => pow_add _ _ _)]
      rw [hu, hv, ← truncatedAperyMonomial_add]
      congr 2
      exact (tailDegreeGamma_add D i u v).symm
  | single j n =>
      rw [Finsupp.prod_single_index]
      · induction n with
        | zero => simp
        | succ n hn =>
            rw [pow_succ, hn, ← truncatedAperyMonomial_tail,
              ← truncatedAperyMonomial_add]
            congr 2
            apply Subtype.ext
            simp only [AddSubmonoid.coe_add]
            change tailDegree D i (Finsupp.single j n) + D.tailGen i j =
              tailDegree D i (Finsupp.single j (n + 1))
            rw [tailDegree_single, tailDegree_single]
            simp [Nat.add_mul]
      · simp

name: P23.Semigroup.tailPolyToApery_monomial
statement:
@[simp] theorem tailPolyToApery_monomial (u : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) (r : k) :
    tailPolyToApery (k := k) D i (MvPolynomial.monomial u r) =
      r • truncatedAperyMonomial (k := k) D i
        (tailDegreeGamma D i u)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tailPolyToApery, MvPolynomial.aeval_monomial, tailVariable_prod]
  simp [Algebra.smul_def]

name: P23.Semigroup.exists_tailExponent_of_isApery
statement:
theorem exists_tailExponent_of_isApery {s : D.Gamma} (hs : D.IsApery i s) :
    ∃ u : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ, tailDegree D i u = s.1
proof:
:= by
  rcases (D.mem_Gamma_iff s.1).1 s.2 with ⟨v, hv⟩
  have hvi := D.apery_factorization_base_eq_zero i hs v hv
  refine ⟨tailExponent D i v, ?_⟩
  rw [← weightedDegree_eq_tailDegree_of_base_zero D i v hvi, hv]

name: P23.Semigroup.tailDegree_eq_tailGen_iff
statement:
theorem tailDegree_eq_tailGen_iff {u : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ} {j : Fin 3} :
    tailDegree D i u = D.tailGen i j ↔ u = Finsupp.single j 1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hdeg
    let w := extendTailExponent i u
    let tj : Fin 4 := D.tailIndex i j
    have hwdeg : D.weightedDegree w = D.n tj := by
      rw [weightedDegree_extendTailExponent, hdeg]
      rfl
    have huj0 : u j ≠ 0 := by
      intro huj
      have hwtj : w tj = 0 := by
        simp [w, tj, extendTailExponent, huj]
      exact D.minimal tj w hwtj hwdeg
    have hujpos : 0 < u j := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero huj0
    have hterm : u j * D.tailGen i j ≤ tailDegree D i u := by
      apply Finset.single_le_sum (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ j)
    have hgenpos := D.tailGen_positive i j
    have huj : u j = 1 := by nlinarith [hterm]
    have hrest : ∑ l ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, u l * D.tailGen i l = 0 := by
      have hsplit := Finset.sum_erase_add (s := Finset.univ)
        (f := fun l : Fin 3 => u l * D.tailGen i l) (Finset.mem_univ j)
      change (∑ l ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, u l * D.tailGen i l) +
        u j * D.tailGen i j = tailDegree D i u at hsplit
      rw [hdeg, huj, one_mul] at hsplit
      omega
    apply Finsupp.ext
    intro l
    by_cases hlj : l = j
    · subst l
      simp [huj]
    · have hlmem : l ∈ Finset.univ.erase j := by simp [hlj]
      have hle : u l * D.tailGen i l ≤
          ∑ x ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, u x * D.tailGen i x := by
        exact Finset.single_le_sum
          (f := fun x : Fin 3 => u x * D.tailGen i x)
          (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) hlmem
      have hlpos := D.tailGen_positive i l
      have hul : u l = 0 := by nlinarith [hle, hrest]
      simp [Finsupp.single_apply, hlj, hul]
  · rintro rfl
    simp

name: P23.Semigroup.tailPolyToApery_surjective
statement:
theorem tailPolyToApery_surjective :
    Function.Surjective (tailPolyToApery (k := k) D i)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  induction x using AperyArtin.induction_linear with
  | zero => exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
  | add x y hx hy =>
      rcases hx with ⟨f, rfl⟩
      rcases hy with ⟨g, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨f + g, by simp⟩
  | single s r =>
      rcases exists_tailExponent_of_isApery D i s.2 with ⟨u, hu⟩
      refine ⟨MvPolynomial.monomial u r, ?_⟩
      rw [tailPolyToApery_monomial]
      simp only [truncatedAperyMonomial]
      split
      · rw [AperyArtin.smul_A]
        congr 2
        apply Subtype.ext
        apply Subtype.ext
        exact hu
      · rename_i hnot
        exfalso
        apply hnot
        have heq : tailDegreeGamma D i u = s.1 := Subtype.ext hu
        exact heq ▸ s.2

name: P23.Semigroup.tailPolyToChosenBase_surjective
statement:
theorem tailPolyToChosenBase_surjective :
    Function.Surjective (tailPolyToChosenBase (k := k) D i)
proof:
:= by
  intro q
  rcases tailPolyToApery_surjective (k := k) D i
      ((chosenBaseEquivApery (k := k) D i) q) with ⟨f, hf⟩
  refine ⟨f, ?_⟩
  apply (chosenBaseEquivApery (k := k) D i).injective
  simpa [tailPolyToChosenBase] using hf

name: P23.Semigroup.tailPolyToChosenBase_monomial
statement:
theorem tailPolyToChosenBase_monomial (u : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) (r : k) :
    chosenBaseEquivApery (k := k) D i
        (tailPolyToChosenBase (k := k) D i (MvPolynomial.monomial u r)) =
      r • truncatedAperyMonomial (k := k) D i (tailDegreeGamma D i u)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [tailPolyToChosenBase] using tailPolyToApery_monomial (k := k) D i u r

name: P23.Semigroup.tailVariableA_ne_zero
statement:
theorem tailVariableA_ne_zero (j : Fin 3) :
    tailVariableA (k := k) D i j ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hc := congrArg (fun x : AperyArtin k D i =>
    x.coeff ⟨D.tail i j, D.tail_isApery i j⟩) h
  simpa [tailVariableA] using hc

name: P23.Semigroup.tailVariableChosenBase_ne_zero
statement:
theorem tailVariableChosenBase_ne_zero (j : Fin 3) :
    tailPolyToChosenBase (k := k) D i (MvPolynomial.X j) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have he := congrArg (chosenBaseEquivApery (k := k) D i) h
  exact tailVariableA_ne_zero (k := k) D i j (by
    simpa [tailPolyToChosenBase, tailPolyToApery] using he)

name: P23.Semigroup.tailVariable_ne_zero
statement:
theorem tailVariable_ne_zero (j : Fin 3) :
    tailPolyToChosenBase (k := k) D i (MvPolynomial.X j) ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  tailVariableChosenBase_ne_zero (k := k) D i j

name: P23.Semigroup.A_mem_aperyAugmentationIdeal
statement:
theorem A_mem_aperyAugmentationIdeal (s : D.AperyIndex i) (hs : s.1 ≠ 0) :
    A (k := k) s.1 s.2 ∈ aperyAugmentationIdeal (k := k) D i
proof:
:= by
  apply Ideal.subset_span
  exact ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩

name: P23.Semigroup.tailVariableA_mem_aperyAugmentationIdeal
statement:
theorem tailVariableA_mem_aperyAugmentationIdeal (j : Fin 3) :
    tailVariableA (k := k) D i j ∈ aperyAugmentationIdeal (k := k) D i
proof:
:= by
  simpa [tailVariableA] using
    A_mem_aperyAugmentationIdeal (k := k) D i
      ⟨D.tail i j, D.tail_isApery i j⟩
      (by
        intro h
        have hv := congrArg Subtype.val h
        simpa [FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.tail,
          FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.generator] using
          (Nat.ne_of_gt (D.tailGen_positive i j) hv))

name: P23.Semigroup.truncatedAperyMonomial_mem_tailVariableIdeal_of_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem truncatedAperyMonomial_mem_tailVariableIdeal_of_ne_zero
    (u : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) (hu : u ≠ 0) :
    truncatedAperyMonomial (k := k) D i (tailDegreeGamma D i u) ∈
      tailVariableIdeal (k := k) D i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Finsupp.ne_iff.mp hu
  have hjpos : 0 < u j := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hj
  let v : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ := u - Finsupp.single j 1
  have huv : u = Finsupp.single j 1 + v := by
    apply Finsupp.ext
    intro l
    by_cases hlj : l = j
    · subst l
      simp only [Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.single_eq_same, v,
        Finsupp.tsub_apply]
      exact (Nat.add_sub_of_le hjpos).symm
    · simp [v, Finsupp.single_apply, hlj]
  rw [huv, tailDegreeGamma_add, truncatedAperyMonomial_add]
  have hsingleGamma :
      tailDegreeGamma D i (Finsupp.single j 1) = D.tail i j := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp [tailDegreeGamma, tailDegree_single,
      FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.tail,
      FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.generator,
      FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.tailGen,
      FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.tailIndex]
  rw [hsingleGamma, truncatedAperyMonomial_tail]
  exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ (tailVariableIdeal (k := k) D i)
    (Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_range_self j))

name: P23.Semigroup.aperyAugmentationIdeal_eq_tailVariableIdeal
statement:
theorem aperyAugmentationIdeal_eq_tailVariableIdeal :
    aperyAugmentationIdeal (k := k) D i = tailVariableIdeal (k := k) D i
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [aperyAugmentationIdeal, Ideal.span_le]
    rintro x ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
    rcases exists_tailExponent_of_isApery D i s.2 with ⟨u, hu⟩
    have une : u ≠ 0 := by
      intro hz
      subst u
      simp at hu
      exact hs (Subtype.ext hu.symm)
    have hm := truncatedAperyMonomial_mem_tailVariableIdeal_of_ne_zero
      (k := k) D i u une
    have hgamma : tailDegreeGamma D i u = s.1 := Subtype.ext hu
    rw [hgamma, truncatedAperyMonomial, dif_pos s.2] at hm
    exact hm
  · rw [tailVariableIdeal, Ideal.span_le]
    rintro x ⟨j, rfl⟩
    exact tailVariableA_mem_aperyAugmentationIdeal (k := k) D i j

name: P23.Semigroup.A_mem_aperyAugmentationSquare_of_ne_tail
statement:
theorem A_mem_aperyAugmentationSquare_of_ne_tail
    (s : D.AperyIndex i) (hs : s.1 ≠ 0)
    (hnot : ∀ j : Fin 3, s.1 ≠ D.tail i j) :
    A (k := k) s.1 s.2 ∈ aperyAugmentationSquare (k := k) D i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases exists_tailExponent_of_isApery D i s.2 with ⟨u, hu⟩
  have une : u ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    subst u
    simp at hu
    exact hs (Subtype.ext hu.symm)
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Finsupp.ne_iff.mp une
  have hjpos : 0 < u j := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hj
  let v : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ := u - Finsupp.single j 1
  have huv : u = Finsupp.single j 1 + v := by
    apply Finsupp.ext
    intro l
    by_cases hlj : l = j
    · subst l
      simp only [Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.single_eq_same, v,
        Finsupp.tsub_apply]
      exact (Nat.add_sub_of_le hjpos).symm
    · simp [v, Finsupp.single_apply, hlj]
  have vne : v ≠ 0 := by
    intro hv
    have husingle : u = Finsupp.single j 1 := by simpa [hv] using huv
    have hval : s.1.1 = D.tailGen i j := by
      rw [← hu, husingle, tailDegree_single, one_mul]
    apply hnot j
    apply Subtype.ext
    simpa [FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.tail,
      FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.generator,
      FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.tailGen,
      FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.tailIndex] using hval
  have hgamma : tailDegreeGamma D i u = s.1 := Subtype.ext hu
  have hsumApery : D.IsApery i
      (tailDegreeGamma D i (Finsupp.single j 1) + tailDegreeGamma D i v) := by
    rw [← tailDegreeGamma_add, ← huv, hgamma]
    exact s.2
  have hvApery : D.IsApery i (tailDegreeGamma D i v) :=
    AperyArtin.isApery_of_add_right hsumApery
  have hsingleGamma :
      tailDegreeGamma D i (Finsupp.single j 1) = D.tail i j := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp [tailDegreeGamma, tailDegree_single,
      FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.tail,
      FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.generator,
      FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.tailGen,
      FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.tailIndex]
  have hfactor :
      A (k := k) s.1 s.2 =
        tailVariableA (k := k) D i j *
          A (k := k) (tailDegreeGamma D i v) hvApery := by
    rw [← truncatedAperyMonomial_tail, ← hsingleGamma,
      ← show truncatedAperyMonomial (k := k) D i (tailDegreeGamma D i v) =
        A (k := k) (tailDegreeGamma D i v) hvApery by
          simp [truncatedAperyMonomial, hvApery],
      ← truncatedAperyMonomial_add]
    rw [← tailDegreeGamma_add, ← huv, hgamma]
    simp [truncatedAperyMonomial, s.2]
  rw [hfactor, aperyAugmentationSquare, pow_two]
  exact Ideal.mul_mem_mul
    (tailVariableA_mem_aperyAugmentationIdeal (k := k) D i j)
    (A_mem_aperyAugmentationIdeal (k := k) D i
      ⟨tailDegreeGamma D i v, hvApery⟩
      (by
        intro hz
        apply vne
        apply Finsupp.ext
        intro l
        have hnonneg : v l * D.tailGen i l ≤ tailDegree D i v := by
          apply Finset.single_le_sum (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ l)
        have hdegzero : tailDegree D i v = 0 := by
          simpa [tailDegreeGamma] using congrArg Subtype.val hz
        have hpos := D.tailGen_positive i l
        simp only [Finsupp.zero_apply]
        nlinarith))

name: P23.Semigroup.tailCoeff_tailVariable
statement:
@[simp] theorem tailCoeff_tailVariable (j l : Fin 3) :
    tailCoeff (k := k) D i j (tailVariableA (k := k) D i l) =
      if j = l then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change (A (k := k) (D.tail i l) (D.tail_isApery i l)).coeff
    ⟨D.tail i j, D.tail_isApery i j⟩ = _
  rw [coeff_A]
  by_cases hjl : j = l
  · subst l
    simp
  · have htail : D.tail i j ≠ D.tail i l := by
      intro h
      apply hjl
      apply D.tailGen_injective i
      exact congrArg Subtype.val h
    simp [hjl, htail]

name: P23.Semigroup.positive_basis_mul_tailCoeff_zero
statement:
theorem positive_basis_mul_tailCoeff_zero
    (p q : D.AperyIndex i) (hp : p.1 ≠ 0) (hq : q.1 ≠ 0) (j : Fin 3) :
    tailCoeff (k := k) D i j
      (A (k := k) p.1 p.2 * A (k := k) q.1 q.2) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [A_mul_A]
  split
  · rename_i hpq
    change (A (k := k) (p.1 + q.1) hpq).coeff
      ⟨D.tail i j, D.tail_isApery i j⟩ = 0
    rw [coeff_A]
    by_cases heq : D.tail i j = p.1 + q.1
    · simp only [if_pos heq]
      exfalso
      rcases (D.mem_Gamma_iff p.1.1).1 p.1.2 with ⟨up, hup⟩
      rcases (D.mem_Gamma_iff q.1.1).1 q.1.2 with ⟨uq, huq⟩
      let tj := D.tailIndex i j
      have hsumdeg : D.weightedDegree (up + uq) = D.n tj := by
        change weightedDegreeOf D.n (up + uq) = D.n tj
        rw [weightedDegreeOf_add]
        change D.weightedDegree up + D.weightedDegree uq = D.n tj
        rw [hup, huq]
        have hv := congrArg (fun z : D.Gamma => z.1) heq
        simpa [FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.tail,
          FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.generator, tj] using hv.symm
      have hcoord : (up + uq) tj ≠ 0 := by
        intro hz
        exact D.minimal tj (up + uq) hz hsumdeg
      have hcases : up tj ≠ 0 ∨ uq tj ≠ 0 := by
        by_cases hz : up tj = 0
        · right
          intro hzq
          apply hcoord
          simp [hz, hzq]
        · exact Or.inl hz
      rcases hcases with hupj | huqj
      · have hterm : up tj * D.n tj ≤ D.weightedDegree up := by
          change up tj * D.n tj ≤ weightedDegreeOf D.n up
          apply Finset.single_le_sum
            (f := fun x : Fin 4 => up x * D.n x)
            (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ tj)
        have hge : D.n tj ≤ p.1.1 := by
          have hpos : 1 ≤ up tj := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 hupj
          have hmul : D.n tj ≤ up tj * D.n tj := by
            simpa using Nat.mul_le_mul_right (D.n tj) hpos
          omega
        have hqnat : q.1.1 ≠ 0 := by
          intro hz
          apply hq
          exact Subtype.ext hz
        have hqpos : 0 < q.1.1 := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hqnat
        have hv := congrArg (fun z : D.Gamma => z.1) heq
        have hgen := D.tailGen_positive i j
        simp [FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.tail,
          FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.generator, tj] at hv
        change D.n (i.succAbove j) ≤ p.1.1 at hge
        omega
      · have hterm : uq tj * D.n tj ≤ D.weightedDegree uq := by
          change uq tj * D.n tj ≤ weightedDegreeOf D.n uq
          apply Finset.single_le_sum
            (f := fun x : Fin 4 => uq x * D.n x)
            (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ tj)
        have hge : D.n tj ≤ q.1.1 := by
          have hpos : 1 ≤ uq tj := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 huqj
          have hmul : D.n tj ≤ uq tj * D.n tj := by
            simpa using Nat.mul_le_mul_right (D.n tj) hpos
          omega
        have hpnat : p.1.1 ≠ 0 := by
          intro hz
          apply hp
          exact Subtype.ext hz
        have hppos : 0 < p.1.1 := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hpnat
        have hv := congrArg (fun z : D.Gamma => z.1) heq
        simp [FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.tail,
          FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.generator, tj] at hv
        change D.n (i.succAbove j) ≤ q.1.1 at hge
        omega
    · simp [heq]
  · simp [tailCoeff]

name: P23.Semigroup.aperyConstantCoeff_A
statement:
@[simp] theorem aperyConstantCoeff_A (s : D.Gamma) (hs : D.IsApery i s) :
    aperyConstantCoeff (k := k) D i (A (k := k) s hs) =
      if s = 0 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change (A (k := k) s hs).coeff ⟨0, D.zero_isApery i⟩ = _
  rw [coeff_A]
  simp [eq_comm]

name: P23.Semigroup.aperyFirstOrderLinear_fst
statement:
@[simp] theorem aperyFirstOrderLinear_fst (x : AperyArtin k D i) :
    (aperyFirstOrderLinear (k := k) D i x).fst =
      aperyConstantCoeff (k := k) D i x
proof: := rfl

name: P23.Semigroup.aperyFirstOrderLinear_snd
statement:
@[simp] theorem aperyFirstOrderLinear_snd (x : AperyArtin k D i) (j : Fin 3) :
    (aperyFirstOrderLinear (k := k) D i x).snd j =
      tailCoeff (k := k) D i j x
proof: := rfl

name: P23.Semigroup.aperyFirstOrderLinear_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem aperyFirstOrderLinear_one :
    aperyFirstOrderLinear (k := k) D i (1 : AperyArtin k D i) = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply TrivSqZeroExt.ext
  · change (A (k := k) 0 (D.zero_isApery i)).coeff
      ⟨0, D.zero_isApery i⟩ = 1
    simp [coeff_A]
  · funext j
    change (A (k := k) 0 (D.zero_isApery i)).coeff
      ⟨D.tail i j, D.tail_isApery i j⟩ = 0
    rw [coeff_A]
    have hne : D.tail i j ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      have hv := congrArg Subtype.val h
      simpa [FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.tail,
        FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.generator] using
        (Nat.ne_of_gt (D.tailGen_positive i j) hv)
    simp [hne]

name: P23.Semigroup.positive_basis_mul_constantCoeff_zero
statement:
private theorem positive_basis_mul_constantCoeff_zero
    (p q : D.AperyIndex i) (hp : p.1 ≠ 0) (hq : q.1 ≠ 0) :
    aperyConstantCoeff (k := k) D i
      (A (k := k) p.1 p.2 * A (k := k) q.1 q.2) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [A_mul_A]
  split
  · rename_i hpq
    rw [aperyConstantCoeff_A]
    split
    · rename_i hzero
      have hv := congrArg (fun z : D.Gamma => z.1) hzero
      have hpval : p.1.1 ≠ 0 := fun hz => hp (Subtype.ext hz)
      have hqval : q.1.1 ≠ 0 := fun hz => hq (Subtype.ext hz)
      simp only [AddSubmonoid.coe_add, AddSubmonoid.coe_zero] at hv
      omega
    · rfl
  · simp [aperyConstantCoeff]

name: P23.Semigroup.aperyFirstOrderLinear_A_mul_A
statement:
private theorem aperyFirstOrderLinear_A_mul_A
    (p q : D.AperyIndex i) :
    aperyFirstOrderLinear (k := k) D i
        (A (k := k) p.1 p.2 * A (k := k) q.1 q.2) =
      aperyFirstOrderLinear (k := k) D i (A (k := k) p.1 p.2) *
        aperyFirstOrderLinear (k := k) D i (A (k := k) q.1 q.2)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hp : p.1 = 0
  · have peq : p = ⟨0, D.zero_isApery i⟩ := Subtype.ext hp
    subst p
    have hA0 : A (k := k) (⟨0, D.zero_isApery i⟩ : D.AperyIndex i).1
        (⟨0, D.zero_isApery i⟩ : D.AperyIndex i).2 =
        (1 : AperyArtin k D i) := rfl
    rw [hA0, one_mul, aperyFirstOrderLinear_one, one_mul]
  · by_cases hq : q.1 = 0
    · have qeq : q = ⟨0, D.zero_isApery i⟩ := Subtype.ext hq
      subst q
      have hA0 : A (k := k) (⟨0, D.zero_isApery i⟩ : D.AperyIndex i).1
          (⟨0, D.zero_isApery i⟩ : D.AperyIndex i).2 =
          (1 : AperyArtin k D i) := rfl
      rw [hA0, mul_one, aperyFirstOrderLinear_one, mul_one]
    · apply TrivSqZeroExt.ext
      · change aperyConstantCoeff (k := k) D i
            (A (k := k) p.1 p.2 * A (k := k) q.1 q.2) =
          aperyConstantCoeff (k := k) D i (A (k := k) p.1 p.2) *
            aperyConstantCoeff (k := k) D i (A (k := k) q.1 q.2)
        rw [positive_basis_mul_constantCoeff_zero (k := k) D i p q hp hq]
        simp [aperyConstantCoeff_A, hp, hq]
      · funext j
        have hz := positive_basis_mul_tailCoeff_zero (k := k) D i p q hp hq j
        change tailCoeff (k := k) D i j
            (A (k := k) p.1 p.2 * A (k := k) q.1 q.2) = _
        rw [hz]
        simp [aperyConstantCoeff_A, hp, hq]

name: P23.Semigroup.aperyFirstOrder_tail_fst
statement:
theorem aperyFirstOrder_tail_fst (j : Fin 3) :
    (aperyFirstOrderAlgHom (k := k) D i
      (tailVariableA (k := k) D i j)).fst = 0
proof:
:= by
  change aperyConstantCoeff (k := k) D i
    (tailVariableA (k := k) D i j) = 0
  simp [tailVariableA, aperyConstantCoeff_A]
  have hne : D.tail i j ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have hv := congrArg Subtype.val h
    simpa [FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.tail,
      FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.generator] using
      (Nat.ne_of_gt (D.tailGen_positive i j) hv)
  simp [hne]

name: P23.Semigroup.aperyFirstOrder_tail_snd
statement:
@[simp] theorem aperyFirstOrder_tail_snd (j l : Fin 3) :
    (aperyFirstOrderAlgHom (k := k) D i
      (tailVariableA (k := k) D i l)).snd j =
      if j = l then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  exact tailCoeff_tailVariable (k := k) D i j l

name: P23.Semigroup.aperyAugmentationIdeal_le_firstOrder_kerIdeal
statement:
theorem aperyAugmentationIdeal_le_firstOrder_kerIdeal :
    aperyAugmentationIdeal (k := k) D i ≤
      Ideal.comap (aperyFirstOrderAlgHom (k := k) D i).toRingHom
        (TrivSqZeroExt.kerIdeal k (Fin 3 → k))
proof:
:= by
  rw [aperyAugmentationIdeal_eq_tailVariableIdeal, tailVariableIdeal,
    Ideal.span_le]
  rintro x ⟨j, rfl⟩
  change aperyFirstOrderAlgHom (k := k) D i
      (tailVariableA (k := k) D i j) ∈
    TrivSqZeroExt.kerIdeal k (Fin 3 → k)
  rw [TrivSqZeroExt.mem_kerIdeal_iff_inr]
  apply TrivSqZeroExt.ext
  · simp [aperyFirstOrder_tail_fst]
  · rfl

name: P23.Semigroup.aperyFirstOrder_eq_zero_of_mem_square
statement:
theorem aperyFirstOrder_eq_zero_of_mem_square
    {x : AperyArtin k D i}
    (hx : x ∈ aperyAugmentationSquare (k := k) D i) :
    aperyFirstOrderAlgHom (k := k) D i x = 0
proof:
:= by
  let F := aperyFirstOrderAlgHom (k := k) D i
  let I := aperyAugmentationIdeal (k := k) D i
  let K := TrivSqZeroExt.kerIdeal k (Fin 3 → k)
  have hI : Ideal.map F.toRingHom I ≤ K :=
    (Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap).2
      (aperyAugmentationIdeal_le_firstOrder_kerIdeal (k := k) D i)
  have hxmap : F x ∈ Ideal.map F.toRingHom (I ^ 2) := by
    apply Ideal.mem_map_of_mem
    simpa [I, aperyAugmentationSquare] using hx
  rw [Ideal.map_pow] at hxmap
  have hpow : Ideal.map F.toRingHom I ^ 2 ≤ K ^ 2 := by
    gcongr
  have hxK : F x ∈ K ^ 2 := hpow hxmap
  simpa [K, TrivSqZeroExt.kerIdeal_sq] using hxK

name: P23.Semigroup.tailVariableA_not_mem_aperyAugmentationSquare
statement:
theorem tailVariableA_not_mem_aperyAugmentationSquare (j : Fin 3) :
    tailVariableA (k := k) D i j ∉ aperyAugmentationSquare (k := k) D i
proof:
:= by
  intro hj
  have hz := aperyFirstOrder_eq_zero_of_mem_square (k := k) D i hj
  have hsnd := congrArg (fun z : TrivSqZeroExt k (Fin 3 → k) => z.snd j) hz
  simpa using hsnd

name: P23.Semigroup.tail_linearCombination_mem_aperyAugmentationSquare_iff
statement:
theorem tail_linearCombination_mem_aperyAugmentationSquare_iff
    (c : Fin 3 → k) :
    (∑ j : Fin 3, c j • tailVariableA (k := k) D i j) ∈
        aperyAugmentationSquare (k := k) D i ↔
      ∀ j, c j = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h j
    have hz := aperyFirstOrder_eq_zero_of_mem_square (k := k) D i h
    have hcalc :
        (aperyFirstOrderAlgHom (k := k) D i
          (∑ l : Fin 3, c l • tailVariableA (k := k) D i l)).snd j = c j := by
      rw [map_sum]
      change ((TrivSqZeroExt.sndHom k (Fin 3 → k))
        (∑ l : Fin 3, c l • aperyFirstOrderAlgHom (k := k) D i
          (tailVariableA (k := k) D i l))) j = c j
      rw [map_sum]
      simp [aperyFirstOrder_tail_snd]
    have hsnd := congrArg
      (fun z : TrivSqZeroExt k (Fin 3 → k) => z.snd j) hz
    rw [hcalc] at hsnd
    simpa using hsnd
  · intro hc
    simp [hc]

proof:

    aperyAugmentationIdeal_eq_tailVariableIdeal (k := k) D i

name: P23.Semigroup.ResidualExclusion.residualTopBorder_degree
statement: theorem residualTopBorder_degree : residualDegree R (residualTopBorder R) = residualTopDegree R
proof:
:= by
  rw [residualDegree_formula]
  simp [residualTopBorder,ResidualTop.residualTopDegree,PureResidualThreeBorder.formalTop]

name: P23.Semigroup.ResidualExclusion.residualSourceNormal_not_top
statement:
theorem residualSourceNormal_not_top (ht : D.semigroupType=3) (u : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ)
    (t : Fin 3) (hu : tailDegree D i u=D.n i+D.tailGen i t) :
    residualSourceNormal R u ≠ residualTopBorder R
proof:
:= by
  intro he
  have hd := congrArg (residualDegree R) he
  rw [residualSourceNormal_degree,residualTopBorder_degree,hu] at hd
  exact (rhoFourResidualTopPattern R ht).top_ne_base_add_tail t hd.symm

name: P23.Semigroup.ResidualExclusion.supported_non_top_border_unique
statement:
private theorem supported_non_top_border_unique
    (j : Fin 3) (p q : Normal R.residual.a' R.residual.b' 0)
    (hp : p ∈ borderFinset R.residual.roots) (hq : q ∈ borderFinset R.residual.roots)
    (hpn : p ≠ residualTopBorder R) (hqn : q ≠ residualTopBorder R)
    (hps : if j=2 then 0<p.z else 0<p.x ∨ 0<p.y)
    (hqs : if j=2 then 0<q.z else 0<q.x ∨ 0<q.y) : p=q
proof:
:= by
  rw [R.residual.residual.border] at hp hq
  simp only [Finset.mem_insert,Finset.mem_singleton] at hp hq
  have hp' : p=(⟨1,R.residual.residual.u,0,by have := R.residual.a'_ge_two; omega⟩ :
      Normal R.residual.a' R.residual.b' 0) ∨ p=zAxis R.residual.residual.C := by
    rcases hp with hp | hp | hp
    · exact Or.inl hp
    · exact Or.inr hp
    · exact False.elim (hpn hp)
  have hq' : q=(⟨1,R.residual.residual.u,0,by have := R.residual.a'_ge_two; omega⟩ :
      Normal R.residual.a' R.residual.b' 0) ∨ q=zAxis R.residual.residual.C := by
    rcases hq with hq | hq | hq
    · exact Or.inl hq
    · exact Or.inr hq
    · exact False.elim (hqn hq)
  by_cases hj : j=2
  all_goals simp only [hj,ite_true,ite_false] at hps hqs
  all_goals rcases hp' with rfl | rfl <;> rcases hq' with rfl | rfl <;>
    simp_all [zAxis]

name: P23.Semigroup.ResidualExclusion.two_sources_same_residual_border
statement:
theorem two_sources_same_residual_border (ht : D.semigroupType=3) (S : TwoTailSources D i) :
    residualSourceNormal R S.first_factorization = residualSourceNormal R S.second_factorization
proof:
:= by
  apply supported_non_top_border_unique R (tailToResidual R S.selected)
  · exact residualSourceNormal_mem_border R S.first_source _ S.first_degree
  · exact residualSourceNormal_mem_border R S.second_source _ S.second_degree
  · exact residualSourceNormal_not_top R ht _ S.first S.first_degree
  · exact residualSourceNormal_not_top R ht _ S.second S.second_degree
  · exact residualSourceNormal_selected_support R _ _ S.first_contains_selected
  · exact residualSourceNormal_selected_support R _ _ S.second_contains_selected

name: P23.Semigroup.ResidualExclusion.residual_pure_base_impossible
statement:
theorem residual_pure_base_impossible (ht : D.semigroupType=3)
    (hn : SemigroupNearlyGorenstein D) : False
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S⟩ := exists_two_tail_sources D i (rhoFourResidualTopPattern R ht) hn
  have he := congrArg (residualDegree R) (two_sources_same_residual_border R ht S)
  rw [residualSourceNormal_degree,residualSourceNormal_degree,S.first_degree,S.second_degree] at he
  exact S.degrees_ne he

name: P23.Semigroup.type_three_ng_semigroupRho_ne_four
statement:
theorem type_three_ng_semigroupRho_ne_four (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup)

proof:

  obtain ⟨R⟩ := rho_four_residual_pure_at_every_base D ht hn hr 0

name: P23.Semigroup.rhoFourRealizabilityExclusion
statement:
theorem rhoFourRealizabilityExclusion (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup)
    (ht : D.semigroupType=3) (hn : SemigroupNearlyGorenstein D) : RhoFourRealizabilityExclusion D

  ⟨type_three_ng_semigroupRho_ne_four D ht hn⟩

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.coeff_fiberPolynomial
statement:
@[simp] theorem coeff_fiberPolynomial (d : ℕ) (a : D.FiberCoeff k d)
    (u : D.FactorizationAt d) :
    MvPolynomial.coeff u.1 (D.fiberPolynomial (k := k) d a) = a u
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [fiberPolynomial, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk, MvPolynomial.coeff_sum,
    MvPolynomial.coeff_smul, fiberMonomial, MvPolynomial.coeff_monomial]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single u]
  · simp
  · intro v _ hv
    have hne : v.1 ≠ u.1 := fun h => hv (Subtype.ext h)
    simp [hne]
  · simp

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.fiberPolynomial_injective
statement:
theorem fiberPolynomial_injective (d : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (D.fiberPolynomial (k := k) d)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b h
  funext u
  exact (D.coeff_fiberPolynomial d a u).symm.trans
    ((congrArg (MvPolynomial.coeff u.1) h).trans (D.coeff_fiberPolynomial d b u))

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.semigroupPolyMap_fiberPolynomial
statement:
theorem semigroupPolyMap_fiberPolynomial (d : ℕ) [Nonempty (D.FactorizationAt d)]
    (a : D.FiberCoeff k d) :
    D.semigroupPolyMap (D.fiberPolynomial (k := k) d a) =
      (D.totalCoeff (k := k) d a) •
        T (k := k) D ⟨d, (D.mem_Gamma_iff _).2
          ⟨(Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty (D.FactorizationAt d))).1,
            D.factorizationAt_degree
              (Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty (D.FactorizationAt d)))⟩⟩
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [fiberPolynomial, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk, map_sum, map_smul,
    D.semigroupPolyMap_fiberMonomial, totalCoeff]
  rw [Finset.sum_smul]

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.fiberPolynomial_mem_toricIdeal_iff
statement:
theorem fiberPolynomial_mem_toricIdeal_iff (d : ℕ) (a : D.FiberCoeff k d) :
    D.fiberPolynomial (k := k) d a ∈ D.toricIdeal (k := k) ↔
      a ∈ D.FiberRelationSpace k d
proof:
:= by
  classical
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty (D.FactorizationAt d) with
  | inl hempty =>
      letI := hempty
      have ha : a = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
      subst a
      simp [toricIdeal]
  | inr hnonempty =>
      letI := hnonempty
      change D.semigroupPolyMap (D.fiberPolynomial (k := k) d a) = 0 ↔
        D.totalCoeff (k := k) d a = 0
      rw [D.semigroupPolyMap_fiberPolynomial]
      constructor
      · intro h
        by_contra hn
        have hT : T (k := k) D ⟨d, (D.mem_Gamma_iff _).2
              ⟨(Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty (D.FactorizationAt d))).1,
                D.factorizationAt_degree
                  (Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty (D.FactorizationAt d)))⟩⟩ ≠ 0 := by
          simpa [T] using
            (Finsupp.single_ne_zero.mpr (one_ne_zero : (1 : k) ≠ 0) :
              AddMonoidAlgebra.single
                (⟨d, (D.mem_Gamma_iff _).2
                  ⟨(Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty (D.FactorizationAt d))).1,
                    D.factorizationAt_degree
                      (Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty (D.FactorizationAt d)))⟩⟩ : D.Gamma)
                (1 : k) ≠ 0)
        exact hT (smul_eq_zero.mp h |>.resolve_left hn)
      · intro h
        simp [h]

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.component_total_componentCoeff
statement:
theorem component_total_componentCoeff (d : ℕ) (a : D.FiberCoeff k d) :
    D.componentTotalCoeff (k := k) d (D.componentCoeff (k := k) d a) =
      D.totalCoeff (k := k) d a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [componentTotalCoeff, componentCoeff, totalCoeff, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk]
  exact Finset.sum_fiberwise Finset.univ D.componentOf a

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.fiberDelta_mem_relation
statement:
theorem fiberDelta_mem_relation {d : ℕ} (u v : D.FactorizationAt d) :
    D.fiberDelta (k := k) u v ∈ D.FiberRelationSpace k d
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change (∑ x, ((Pi.single u (1 : k) : D.FactorizationAt d → k) -
    (Pi.single v (1 : k) : D.FactorizationAt d → k)) x) = 0
  simp

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.fiberPolynomial_fiberDelta
statement:
@[simp] theorem fiberPolynomial_fiberDelta {d : ℕ} (u v : D.FactorizationAt d) :
    D.fiberPolynomial (k := k) d (D.fiberDelta (k := k) u v) =
      D.fiberBinomial (k := k) u v
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hsingle (w : D.FactorizationAt d) :
      D.fiberPolynomial (k := k) d
          (Pi.single w (1 : k) : D.FactorizationAt d → k) =
        D.fiberMonomial (k := k) w := by
    ext q
    by_cases hq : q = w.1
    · subst q
      rw [D.coeff_fiberPolynomial]
      simp [Pi.single_apply, fiberMonomial]
    · simp [fiberPolynomial, fiberMonomial, Pi.single_apply, hq]
  change D.fiberPolynomial (k := k) d
      ((Pi.single u (1 : k) : D.FactorizationAt d → k) - Pi.single v 1) = _
  rw [map_sub, hsingle u, hsingle v]
  rfl

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.componentDelta_mem_relation
statement:
theorem componentDelta_mem_relation {d : ℕ} (u v : D.FactorizationAt d) :
    D.componentDelta (k := k) u v ∈ D.ComponentRelationSpace k d
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change (∑ C, D.componentDelta (k := k) u v C) = 0
  simp [componentDelta]

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.fiberToComponentRelation_fiberDelta
statement:
theorem fiberToComponentRelation_fiberDelta {d : ℕ} (u v : D.FactorizationAt d) :
    (D.fiberToComponentRelation (k := k) d) (D.fiberDeltaRelation (k := k) u v) =
      ⟨D.componentDelta (k := k) u v, D.componentDelta_mem_relation u v⟩
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply Subtype.ext
  change D.componentCoeff (k := k) d (D.fiberDelta (k := k) u v) =
    D.componentDelta (k := k) u v
  simp only [fiberDelta, map_sub]
  congr 1 <;> funext C <;>
    simp [componentCoeff, componentDelta, Pi.single_apply, eq_comm]

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.componentCoeff_single
statement:
theorem componentCoeff_single (d : ℕ) (u : D.FactorizationAt d) :
    D.componentCoeff (k := k) d
        (Pi.single u (1 : k) : D.FactorizationAt d → k) =
      D.componentSingle (k := k) (D.componentOf u)
proof:
:= by

  funext C
  simp [componentCoeff, componentSingle, Pi.single_apply, eq_comm]

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.componentCoeff_componentLift
statement:
theorem componentCoeff_componentLift (d : ℕ) (b : D.BettiComponent d → k) :

proof:
:= by

  simp only [componentLift, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk, map_sum, map_smul,
    D.componentCoeff_single]
  funext C
  simp [componentSingle, Pi.single_apply, D.componentRepresentative_component]

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.fiberToComponentRelation_componentRelationLift
statement:
theorem fiberToComponentRelation_componentRelationLift (d : ℕ)
    (b : D.ComponentRelationSpace k d) :
    D.fiberToComponentRelation (k := k) d (D.componentRelationLift (k := k) d b) = b
proof:

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.fiberToComponentRelation_surjective
statement:
theorem fiberToComponentRelation_surjective (d : ℕ) :
    Function.Surjective (D.fiberToComponentRelation (k := k) d)
proof:
:= by

    D.fiberToComponentRelation_componentRelationLift d b⟩

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.componentTotalCoeff_surjective
statement:
theorem componentTotalCoeff_surjective {d : ℕ} (hd : D.IsBettiDegree d) :
    Function.Surjective (D.componentTotalCoeff (k := k) d)
proof:
:= by

  intro r
  let C := D.rootComponent hd
  refine ⟨Pi.single C r, ?_⟩
  simp [componentTotalCoeff, Pi.single_apply]

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.componentRelationSpace_finrank
statement:
theorem componentRelationSpace_finrank {d : ℕ} (hd : D.IsBettiDegree d) :
    Module.finrank k (D.ComponentRelationSpace k d) = D.bettiContribution d
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hsurj := D.componentTotalCoeff_surjective (k := k) hd
  have hrange : LinearMap.range (D.componentTotalCoeff (k := k) d) = ⊤ :=
    LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr hsurj
  have hdim := (D.componentTotalCoeff (k := k) d).finrank_range_add_finrank_ker
  rw [hrange] at hdim
  simp at hdim
  change 1 + Module.finrank k (D.ComponentRelationSpace k d) =
    Fintype.card (D.BettiComponent d) at hdim
  unfold bettiContribution componentCount
  omega

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.toricBettiContribution_eq_componentCount_sub_one
statement:
theorem toricBettiContribution_eq_componentCount_sub_one {d : ℕ}
    (hd : D.IsBettiDegree d) :

      D.componentCount d - 1
proof:

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.degreeNewEquiv_connectorClass
statement:
theorem degreeNewEquiv_connectorClass {d : ℕ} (hd : D.IsBettiDegree d)
    (e : D.ComponentConnector hd) :
    D.degreeNewToricRelationSpaceEquiv (k := k) d (D.connectorClass (k := k) hd e) =
      ⟨D.componentDelta (k := k) (D.connectorEndpoints hd e).1
          (D.connectorEndpoints hd e).2,
        D.componentDelta_mem_relation _ _⟩
proof:
:= by
  unfold connectorClass degreeNewMk degreeNewToricRelationSpaceEquiv
  change ((D.fiberToComponentRelation (k := k) d).quotKerEquivOfSurjective _)
      (Submodule.Quotient.mk (D.connectorFiberRelation (k := k) hd e)) = _
  rw [LinearMap.quotKerEquivOfSurjective_apply_mk]
  exact D.fiberToComponentRelation_fiberDelta _ _

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.connectorClass_linearIndependent
statement:
theorem connectorClass_linearIndependent {d : ℕ} (hd : D.IsBettiDegree d) :
    LinearIndependent k (D.connectorClass (k := k) hd)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Fintype.linearIndependent_iff]
  intro g h e
  have hmap := congrArg (D.degreeNewToricRelationSpaceEquiv (k := k) d) h
  simp only [map_sum, map_smul, map_zero, D.degreeNewEquiv_connectorClass] at hmap
  have hcoord := congrArg
    (fun z : D.ComponentRelationSpace k d => z.1 e.1) hmap
  simp only [Submodule.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply, Submodule.coe_smul_of_tower,
    Pi.smul_apply, Submodule.coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply] at hcoord
  have heroot : e.1 ≠ D.rootComponent hd := e.2
  have hends := D.connectorEndpoints_components hd e
  simp [componentDelta, componentSingle, Pi.single_apply, heroot,
    D.connectorEndpoints_components, Subtype.ext_iff] at hcoord
  have heq (x : D.ComponentConnector hd) : (e.1 = x.1) ↔ e = x := by
    exact ⟨fun h => Subtype.ext h, fun h => congrArg Subtype.val h⟩
  simp_rw [heq] at hcoord
  simpa using hcoord

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.connectorClass_span_eq_top
statement:
theorem connectorClass_span_eq_top {d : ℕ} (hd : D.IsBettiDegree d) :
    Submodule.span k (Set.range (D.connectorClass (k := k) hd)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  apply (D.connectorClass_linearIndependent (k := k) hd).span_eq_top_of_card_eq_finrank'

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.connectorClassBasis_apply

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.degreeToricRelation_connector_card_exact
statement:
theorem degreeToricRelation_connector_card_exact {d : ℕ} (hd : D.IsBettiDegree d) :

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.withinComponentStarSum_eq_of_mem_ker
statement:
theorem withinComponentStarSum_eq_of_mem_ker {d : ℕ}
    (a : D.FiberRelationSpace k d)
    (ha : a ∈ LinearMap.ker (D.fiberToComponentRelation (k := k) d)) :
    D.withinComponentStarSum (k := k) d a = a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply Subtype.ext
  funext x
  have hcomp : D.componentCoeff (k := k) d a.1 = 0 := by
    exact congrArg Subtype.val ha
  have hzero (C : D.BettiComponent d) :
      (∑ u with D.componentOf u = C, a.1 u) = 0 := by
    exact congrFun hcomp C
  simp only [withinComponentStarSum, Submodule.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply,
    Submodule.coe_smul_of_tower, Pi.smul_apply, fiberDeltaRelation, fiberDelta,
    Pi.sub_apply, Pi.single_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_sub, mul_one, mul_zero]
  rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  have hfirst : (∑ u, a.1 u * if x = u then 1 else 0) = a.1 x := by
    simp
  rw [hfirst, sub_eq_self]
  by_cases hx : x = D.componentRepresentative (D.componentOf x)
  · have hiff (u : D.FactorizationAt d) :
        x = D.componentRepresentative (D.componentOf u) ↔
          D.componentOf u = D.componentOf x := by
      constructor
      · intro h
        rw [h, D.componentRepresentative_component]
      · intro h
        rw [hx, h]
    simp_rw [hiff]
    have hz := hzero (D.componentOf x)
    rw [Finset.sum_filter] at hz
    simpa only [mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero] using hz
  · apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro u _
    have hne : x ≠ D.componentRepresentative (D.componentOf u) := by
      intro h
      have hc : D.componentOf x = D.componentOf u := by
        rw [h, D.componentRepresentative_component]
      apply hx
      calc
        x = D.componentRepresentative (D.componentOf u) := h
        _ = D.componentRepresentative (D.componentOf x) :=
          congrArg D.componentRepresentative hc.symm
    simp [hne]

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.fiberPolynomial_mem_lower_of_componentKernel
statement:
theorem fiberPolynomial_mem_lower_of_componentKernel {d : ℕ}
    (a : D.FiberRelationSpace k d)
    (ha : a ∈ LinearMap.ker (D.fiberToComponentRelation (k := k) d)) :
    D.fiberPolynomial (k := k) d a.1 ∈ D.lowerToricIdeal (k := k) d
proof:
:= by
  rw [← D.withinComponentStarSum_eq_of_mem_ker a ha]
  simp only [withinComponentStarSum, Submodule.coe_sum, Submodule.coe_smul_of_tower,
    map_sum, map_smul]
  apply Submodule.sum_mem
  intro u _
  rw [Algebra.smul_def]
  apply Ideal.mul_mem_left
  simpa [fiberDeltaRelation] using
    (D.fiberBinomial_mem_lower_of_sameComponent (k := k)
      (D.componentRepresentative_component (D.componentOf u)).symm)

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.ker_fiberToComponentRelation_eq_withinComponentSpan
statement:
theorem ker_fiberToComponentRelation_eq_withinComponentSpan (d : ℕ) :
    LinearMap.ker (D.fiberToComponentRelation (k := k) d) =
      Submodule.span k (D.withinComponentDifferenceSet (k := k) d)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro a ha
    rw [← D.withinComponentStarSum_eq_of_mem_ker a ha]
    apply Submodule.sum_mem
    intro u _
    apply Submodule.smul_mem
    apply Submodule.subset_span
    exact ⟨u, D.componentRepresentative (D.componentOf u),
      (D.componentRepresentative_component (D.componentOf u)).symm, rfl⟩
  · rw [Submodule.span_le]
    rintro a ⟨u, v, huv, rfl⟩
    change D.fiberToComponentRelation (k := k) d
      (D.fiberDeltaRelation (k := k) u v) = 0
    rw [D.fiberToComponentRelation_fiberDelta]
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp [componentDelta, huv]

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.connectorRelationFinset_generates
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold GeneratesDegreeNewRelations
  have hle : Submodule.span k (Set.range (D.connectorClass (k := k) hd)) ≤
      Submodule.span k
        (D.degreeNewGeneratorFinset (k := k)
          (D.connectorRelationFinset (k := k) hd) :
            Set (D.DegreeNewToricRelationSpace k d)) := by
    rw [Submodule.span_le]
    rintro z ⟨e, rfl⟩
    apply Submodule.subset_span (R := k)
    show D.connectorClass (k := k) hd e ∈
      D.degreeNewGeneratorFinset (k := k) (D.connectorRelationFinset (k := k) hd)
    unfold degreeNewGeneratorFinset connectorClass
    apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
    refine ⟨D.connectorFiberRelation (k := k) hd e, ?_, rfl⟩
    unfold connectorRelationFinset
    exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨e, Finset.mem_univ e, rfl⟩
  rw [D.connectorClass_span_eq_top (k := k) hd] at hle
  exact top_unique hle

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.degreeToricRelation_generator_card_lower_bound
statement:
theorem degreeToricRelation_generator_card_lower_bound {k : Type*} [Field k]
    {d : ℕ} (hd : D.IsBettiDegree d) (G : Finset (D.FiberRelationSpace k d))
    (hG : D.GeneratesDegreeNewRelations G) :
    D.bettiContribution d ≤ G.card
proof:
:= by
  unfold bettiContribution
  rw [← D.toricBettiContribution_eq_componentCount_sub_one (k := k) hd]
  classical
  unfold GeneratesDegreeNewRelations at hG
  have h := finrank_span_le_card (R := k)
    (D.degreeNewGeneratorFinset (k := k) G : Set (D.DegreeNewToricRelationSpace k d))
  rw [hG] at h
  calc
    Module.finrank k (D.DegreeNewToricRelationSpace k d) ≤
        (D.degreeNewGeneratorFinset (k := k) G).card := by simpa using h
    _ ≤ G.card := by
      unfold degreeNewGeneratorFinset
      exact Finset.card_image_le

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.connectorRelationFinset_card_exact
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold connectorRelationFinset
  have hinj : Function.Injective (D.connectorFiberRelation (k := k) hd) := by
    intro e f hef
    apply (D.connectorClass_linearIndependent (k := k) hd).injective
    exact congrArg (D.degreeNewMk (k := k) d) hef
  rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ hinj, Finset.card_univ]
  exact D.degreeToricRelation_connector_card_exact hd

name: P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.toricBettiPresentationBridge
proof:
:= D.toricIdeal_eq_span_fiberBinomials
  componentKernelExact := D.ker_fiberToComponentRelation_eq_withinComponentSpan d
  localContributionExact := D.toricBettiContribution_eq_componentCount_sub_one hd
  connectorClassesSpan := D.connectorClass_span_eq_top hd
  connectorFamilyGenerates := D.connectorRelationFinset_generates hd
  universalLocalLowerBound := fun G hG =>
    D.degreeToricRelation_generator_card_lower_bound hd G hG
  connectorCardExact := D.connectorRelationFinset_card_exact hd

name: P23.Semigroup.highRho_budget_positive
statement:
theorem highRho_budget_positive (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup)
    (ht : D.semigroupType=2 ∨ D.semigroupType=3) (hn : SemigroupNearlyGorenstein D)
    (hr : D.semigroupType+4≤D.semigroupRho) (i : Fin 4) : 0<D.fourBaseBudget i
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hh
  have hz : D.fourBaseBudget i=0 := by omega
  rcases ht with ht | ht
  · have hb := budget_zero_type_two_rho_le_five D i hz ht; omega
  · have hb := budget_zero_type_three_rho_le_six D i hz ht hn; omega

name: P23.Semigroup.highRho_all_budgets_eq_one
statement:
theorem highRho_all_budgets_eq_one (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup)
    (ht : D.semigroupType=2 ∨ D.semigroupType=3) (hn : SemigroupNearlyGorenstein D)
    (hr : D.semigroupType+4≤D.semigroupRho) (i : Fin 4) : D.fourBaseBudget i=1
proof:
:= by
  have h0 := highRho_budget_positive D ht hn hr 0
  have h1 := highRho_budget_positive D ht hn hr 1
  have h2 := highRho_budget_positive D ht hn hr 2
  have h3 := highRho_budget_positive D ht hn hr 3
  have hs := D.fourBaseBudget_sum_le_four
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_four] at hs
  have he0 : D.fourBaseBudget 0=1 := by omega
  have he1 : D.fourBaseBudget 1=1 := by omega
  have he2 : D.fourBaseBudget 2=1 := by omega
  have he3 : D.fourBaseBudget 3=1 := by omega
  fin_cases i
  · exact he0
  · exact he1
  · exact he2
  · exact he3

statement:
theorem highRho_budget_at_least_two_impossible (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup)

    (hr : D.semigroupType+4≤D.semigroupRho) (i : Fin 4) (hB : 2≤D.fourBaseBudget i) : False
proof:
:= by
