name: P23.Semigroup.highRho_dominantAperyBase
statement:
theorem highRho_dominantAperyBase (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup)
    (ht : D.semigroupType=2 ∨ D.semigroupType=3) (hn : SemigroupNearlyGorenstein D)
    (hr : D.semigroupType+4≤D.semigroupRho) (i : Fin 4) :
    Nonempty (DominantAperyBase D i)
proof:
:= by

statement:

name: P23.Semigroup.ChosenBaseOmega.smul_apply

name: P23.Semigroup.chosenBaseOmegaEquivAperyOmega_apply_equiv

    (φ : ChosenBaseOmega k D i) (q : Q k D i) :
    chosenBaseOmegaEquivAperyOmega (k := k) D i φ
        (chosenBaseEquivApery (k := k) D i q) = φ q

    (chosenBaseEquivApery (k := k) D i q)) = φ q

name: P23.Semigroup.chosenBaseOmegaEquivAperyOmega_smul
statement:
theorem chosenBaseOmegaEquivAperyOmega_smul
    (q : Q k D i) (φ : ChosenBaseOmega k D i) :
    chosenBaseOmegaEquivAperyOmega (k := k) D i (q • φ) =
      chosenBaseEquivApery (k := k) D i q •
        chosenBaseOmegaEquivAperyOmega (k := k) D i φ
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro a
  change φ (q * (chosenBaseEquivApery (k := k) D i).symm a) =
    φ ((chosenBaseEquivApery (k := k) D i).symm
      (chosenBaseEquivApery (k := k) D i q * a))
  congr 1
  simp

      (chosenBaseEquivApery (k := k) D i).symm a •
        (chosenBaseOmegaEquivAperyOmega (k := k) D i).symm ψ
proof:
:= by
  apply (chosenBaseOmegaEquivAperyOmega (k := k) D i).injective
  rw [chosenBaseOmegaEquivAperyOmega_smul]

name: P23.Semigroup.chosenBaseTrace_range_le
statement:
theorem chosenBaseTrace_range_le
    (F : ChosenBaseOmega k D i →ₗ[Q k D i] Q k D i) :
    F.range ≤ ChosenBaseTraceSubmodule (k := k) D i
proof:
:=
  le_iSup (fun G : ChosenBaseOmega k D i →ₗ[Q k D i] Q k D i => G.range) F

name: P23.Semigroup.mem_chosenBaseTrace_iff_equiv_mem_aperyTrace
statement:
theorem mem_chosenBaseTrace_iff_equiv_mem_aperyTrace (q : Q k D i) :
    q ∈ ChosenBaseTraceSubmodule (k := k) D i ↔
      chosenBaseEquivApery (k := k) D i q ∈
        AperyTraceSubmodule (k := k) D i
proof:
:= by
  let E := chosenBaseEquivApery (k := k) D i
  constructor
  · intro hq
    refine Submodule.iSup_induction
      (fun F : ChosenBaseOmega k D i →ₗ[Q k D i] Q k D i => F.range)
      (motive := fun x => E x ∈ AperyTraceSubmodule (k := k) D i)
      hq ?_ (by simp) ?_
    · intro F x hx
      rcases hx with ⟨φ, rfl⟩
      exact aperyTrace_range_le (k := k) D i
        (pushChosenBaseCanonicalHom (k := k) D i F)
        ⟨chosenBaseOmegaEquivAperyOmega (k := k) D i φ,
          by simp [pushChosenBaseCanonicalHom, E]⟩
    · intro x y hx hy
      simpa using (AperyTraceSubmodule (k := k) D i).add_mem hx hy
  · intro hq
    have hback : E.symm (E q) ∈ ChosenBaseTraceSubmodule (k := k) D i := by
      refine Submodule.iSup_induction
        (fun F : AperyOmega k D i →ₗ[A k D i] A k D i => F.range)
        (motive := fun x => E.symm x ∈ ChosenBaseTraceSubmodule (k := k) D i)
        hq ?_ (by simp) ?_
      · intro F x hx
        rcases hx with ⟨ψ, rfl⟩
        exact chosenBaseTrace_range_le (k := k) D i
          (pullChosenBaseCanonicalHom (k := k) D i F)
          ⟨(chosenBaseOmegaEquivAperyOmega (k := k) D i).symm ψ,
            by simp [pullChosenBaseCanonicalHom, E]⟩
      · intro x y hx hy
        simpa using (ChosenBaseTraceSubmodule (k := k) D i).add_mem hx hy
    simpa [E] using hback

name: P23.Semigroup.chosenBaseNearlyGorenstein_iff_aperyNearlyGorenstein
statement:
theorem chosenBaseNearlyGorenstein_iff_aperyNearlyGorenstein :
    ChosenBaseNearlyGorenstein (k := k) D i ↔
      AperyNearlyGorenstein (k := k) D i
proof:
:= by
  let E := chosenBaseEquivApery (k := k) D i
  unfold ChosenBaseNearlyGorenstein AperyNearlyGorenstein
  letI := chosenBaseIsLocalRing (k := k) D i
  rw [chosenBaseMaximalIdeal_eq_augmentationIdeal (k := k) D i]
  constructor
  · intro hng a ha
    let q : Q k D i := E.symm a
    have hqaug : q ∈ chosenBaseAugmentationIdeal (k := k) D i := by
      change E q ∈ aperyAugmentationIdeal (k := k) D i
      simpa [q, E] using ha
    have hqt := hng hqaug
    have ht := (mem_chosenBaseTrace_iff_equiv_mem_aperyTrace
      (k := k) D i q).1 hqt
    simpa [q, E] using ht
  · intro hng q hq
    have hEq : E q ∈ aperyAugmentationIdeal (k := k) D i := hq
    have hEt := hng hEq
    exact (mem_chosenBaseTrace_iff_equiv_mem_aperyTrace
      (k := k) D i q).2 hEt

name: P23.Semigroup.semigroupNearlyGorenstein_to_chosenBaseNearlyGorenstein
statement:
theorem semigroupNearlyGorenstein_to_chosenBaseNearlyGorenstein
    (hng : SemigroupNearlyGorenstein D) :
    ChosenBaseNearlyGorenstein (k := k) D i
proof:
:=
  (chosenBaseNearlyGorenstein_iff_aperyNearlyGorenstein
    (k := k) D i).2
      (semigroupNearlyGorenstein_to_aperyNearlyGorenstein
        (k := k) D i hng)

name: P23.Semigroup.semigroup_type_three_ng_gives_chosenBase_type_three_ng
statement:
theorem semigroup_type_three_ng_gives_chosenBase_type_three_ng
    (htype : D.semigroupType = 3) (hng : SemigroupNearlyGorenstein D) :
    chosenBaseType (k := k) D i = 3 ∧
      ChosenBaseNearlyGorenstein (k := k) D i
proof:
:=
  ⟨(chosenBaseType_eq_semigroupType (k := k) D i).trans htype,
    semigroupNearlyGorenstein_to_chosenBaseNearlyGorenstein
      (k := k) D i hng⟩

name: P23.Semigroup.chosenBaseNGBridge
statement:
theorem chosenBaseNGBridge : ChosenBaseNGBridge (k := k) D i where
  ngVectorInterface
proof:
:= semigroupNearlyGorenstein_iff_ngVector D
  aperyOrdinaryTrace := rfl
  semigroupToAperyNG := semigroupNearlyGorenstein_to_aperyNearlyGorenstein
    (k := k) D i
  chosenBaseOrdinaryTrace := rfl
  traceTransport := mem_chosenBaseTrace_iff_equiv_mem_aperyTrace
    (k := k) D i
  ngTransport := chosenBaseNearlyGorenstein_iff_aperyNearlyGorenstein
    (k := k) D i
  semigroupToChosenBaseNG :=
    semigroupNearlyGorenstein_to_chosenBaseNearlyGorenstein (k := k) D i

name: P23.Semigroup.tailInH_zero
statement: theorem tailInH_zero : TailInH D i 0
proof: := ⟨0, tailDegree_zero D i⟩

name: P23.Semigroup.tailInH_tailGen
statement: theorem tailInH_tailGen (j : Fin 3) : TailInH D i (D.tailGen i j)
proof:
:=
  ⟨Finsupp.single j 1, by simp⟩

name: P23.Semigroup.tailInH_add
statement:
theorem tailInH_add {h r : ℕ} (hh : TailInH D i h) (hr : TailInH D i r) :
    TailInH D i (h+r)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u,hu⟩ := hh
  obtain ⟨v,hv⟩ := hr
  exact ⟨u+v, by rw [tailDegree_add,hu,hv]⟩

name: P23.Semigroup.not_tailInH_base
statement: theorem not_tailInH_base : ¬TailInH D i (D.n i)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨u,hu⟩
  exact D.minimal i (extendTailExponent i u) (extendTailExponent_base i u)
    ((weightedDegree_extendTailExponent D i u).trans hu)

name: P23.Semigroup.tailDegree_pos_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem tailDegree_pos_of_ne_zero (u : PlainExp) (hu : u≠0) :
    0<tailDegree D i u
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j,hj⟩ := Finsupp.ne_iff.mp hu
  have hp : 0<u j := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hj
  have hterm : u j * D.tailGen i j ≤ tailDegree D i u := by
    apply Finset.single_le_sum (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ j)
  exact lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.mul_pos hp (D.tailGen_positive i j)) hterm

name: P23.Semigroup.tailInK_add_tailInH
statement:
theorem tailInK_add_tailInH {h r : ℕ} (hh : TailInK D i h) (hr : TailInH D i r) :
    TailInK D i (h+r)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hh,γ,hγ⟩ := hh
  obtain ⟨u,hu⟩ := hr
  refine ⟨tailInH_add D i hh ⟨u,hu⟩, γ+tailDegreeGamma D i u, ?_⟩
  change h+r=D.n i+(γ.1+tailDegree D i u)
  rw [hγ,hu]
  omega

name: P23.Semigroup.truncatedAperyMonomial_eq_zero_iff_not_isApery
statement:
theorem truncatedAperyMonomial_eq_zero_iff_not_isApery
    {k : Type*} [Field k] (s : D.Gamma) :
    truncatedAperyMonomial (k := k) D i s=0 ↔ ¬D.IsApery i s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hs : D.IsApery i s
  · constructor
    · intro hz
      have hc := congrArg (fun x : AperyArtin k D i => x.coeff ⟨s,hs⟩) hz
      simp [truncatedAperyMonomial,hs] at hc
    · intro hn
      exact False.elim (hn hs)
  · simp [truncatedAperyMonomial,hs]

name: P23.Semigroup.tail_monomial_mem_chosenBaseDefiningIdeal_iff
statement:
theorem tail_monomial_mem_chosenBaseDefiningIdeal_iff
    {k : Type*} [Field k] (u : PlainExp) :
    MvPolynomial.monomial u (1 : k) ∈ chosenBaseDefiningIdeal (k := k) D i ↔
      TailInK D i (tailDegree D i u)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change tailPolyToChosenBase (k := k) D i (MvPolynomial.monomial u 1)=0 ↔ _
  have he := tailPolyToChosenBase_monomial (k := k) D i u 1
  simp only [one_smul] at he
  have hz : tailPolyToChosenBase (k := k) D i (MvPolynomial.monomial u 1)=0 ↔
      truncatedAperyMonomial (k := k) D i (tailDegreeGamma D i u)=0 := by
    constructor
    · intro h
      rw [←he,h,map_zero]
    · intro h
      apply (chosenBaseEquivApery (k := k) D i).injective
      rw [he,h,map_zero]
  rw [hz,truncatedAperyMonomial_eq_zero_iff_not_isApery]
  constructor
  · intro hn
    obtain ⟨γ,hγ⟩ := not_not.mp hn
    refine ⟨⟨u,rfl⟩,γ,?_⟩
    exact congrArg Subtype.val hγ
  · rintro ⟨_,γ,hγ⟩ ha
    apply ha
    exact ⟨γ,Subtype.ext hγ⟩

name: P23.Semigroup.isTailSource_iff_no_nonzero_tail_predecessor
statement:
theorem isTailSource_iff_no_nonzero_tail_predecessor (h : ℕ) :
    IsTailSource D i h ↔ TailInK D i h ∧
      ¬∃ k r : ℕ, TailInK D i k ∧ TailInH D i r ∧ r≠0 ∧ h=k+r
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hh,hmin⟩
    refine ⟨hh,?_⟩
    rintro ⟨k,r,hk,⟨u,hu⟩,hr,he⟩
    have hune : u≠0 := by intro hz; subst u; simp at hu; exact hr hu.symm
    obtain ⟨j,hj⟩ := Finsupp.ne_iff.mp hune
    have hjpos : 0<u j := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hj
    let v : PlainExp := u-Finsupp.single j 1
    have huv : u=Finsupp.single j 1+v := by
      ext l
      by_cases hl : l=j
      · subst l
        simp only [Finsupp.add_apply,Finsupp.single_eq_same,v,Finsupp.tsub_apply]
        exact (Nat.add_sub_of_le hjpos).symm
      · simp [v,Finsupp.single_apply,hl]
    have hrdeg : r=D.tailGen i j+tailDegree D i v := by
      rw [←hu,huv,tailDegree_add,tailDegree_single,one_mul]
    apply hmin j
    exact ⟨k+tailDegree D i v,
      tailInK_add_tailInH D i hk ⟨v,rfl⟩,by omega⟩
  · rintro ⟨hh,hmin⟩
    refine ⟨hh,?_⟩
    rintro j ⟨k,hk,he⟩
    apply hmin
    exact ⟨k,D.tailGen i j,hk,tailInH_tailGen D i j,
      Nat.ne_of_gt (D.tailGen_positive i j),by omega⟩

name: P23.Semigroup.generator_not_add_other
statement:
theorem generator_not_add_other (j l : Fin 4) (hjl : j≠l) (γ : D.Gamma) :
    D.n j≠D.n l+γ.1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro he
  obtain ⟨u,hu⟩ := (D.mem_Gamma_iff γ.1).mp γ.2
  have hut : u j=0 := by
    by_contra hn
    have hone : 1≤u j := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hn
    have hterm : u j*D.n j≤D.weightedDegree u := by
      apply Finset.single_le_sum (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ j)
    have hmul : D.n j≤u j*D.n j := by
      simpa only [one_mul] using Nat.mul_le_mul_right (D.n j) hone
    have hp := D.positive l
    omega
  let v := generatorFactorization l+u
  have hvzero : v j=0 := by
    simp [v,generatorFactorization,Finsupp.single_apply,hjl.symm,hut]
  have hvdeg : D.weightedDegree v=D.n j := by
    change weightedDegreeOf D.n (generatorFactorization l+u)=D.n j
    rw [weightedDegreeOf_add]
    change D.weightedDegree (generatorFactorization l)+D.weightedDegree u=D.n j
    rw [D.weightedDegree_generatorFactorization,hu]
    exact he.symm
  exact D.minimal j v hvzero hvdeg

name: P23.Semigroup.TailSocleTopPattern.socleDegree_injective
statement:
theorem socleDegree_injective :
    Function.Injective (fun j => aperySocleDegree D i (P.byTail j))
proof:
:= by
  intro j l h
  change aperySocleDegree D i (P.byTail j)=aperySocleDegree D i (P.byTail l) at h
  apply D.tailGen_injective i
  have hj := P.top_eq j
  have hl := P.top_eq l
  omega

name: P23.Semigroup.TailSocleTopPattern.pseudoFrobenius_injective
statement:
theorem pseudoFrobenius_injective : Function.Injective
    (fun j => (D.pseudoFrobeniusEquivAperySocle i).symm (P.byTail j))
proof:
:=
  (D.pseudoFrobeniusEquivAperySocle i).symm.injective.comp P.byTail.injective

name: P23.Semigroup.TailSocleTopPattern.top_ne_base_add_tail
statement: theorem top_ne_base_add_tail (j : Fin 3) : P.top≠D.n i+D.tailGen i j
proof:
:= by
  intro he
  have hj := P.top_eq j
  have hd : aperySocleDegree D i (P.byTail j)=D.n i := by omega
  have hs : (P.byTail j).1.1=D.base i := Subtype.ext hd
  exact D.base_not_isApery i (hs ▸ (P.byTail j).1.2)

name: P23.Semigroup.pf_inverse_degree
statement:
theorem pf_inverse_degree (s : D.AperySocleIndex i) :
    ((D.pseudoFrobeniusEquivAperySocle i).symm s).1 =
      (aperySocleDegree D i s : ℤ)-(D.n i : ℤ)
proof: := rfl

name: P23.Semigroup.exists_selected_tail_ng_relations
statement:
theorem exists_selected_tail_ng_relations (P : TailSocleTopPattern D i)
    (hn : SemigroupNearlyGorenstein D) :
    ∃ s : Fin 3, ∀ t : Fin 3, t≠s → ∃ γ : D.Gamma,
      D.n i+D.tailGen i t=D.tailGen i s+γ.1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f,hf⟩ := exists_base_ngWitness D hn i
  let s := P.byTail.symm (D.pseudoFrobeniusEquivAperySocle i f)
  have hfs : (D.pseudoFrobeniusEquivAperySocle i).symm (P.byTail s)=f := by
    simp [s]
  have hfval : f.1=(aperySocleDegree D i (P.byTail s) : ℤ)-(D.n i : ℤ) := by
    rw [←hfs,pf_inverse_degree]
  refine ⟨s,?_⟩
  intro t _
  let g := (D.pseudoFrobeniusEquivAperySocle i).symm (P.byTail t)
  obtain ⟨γ,hγ⟩ := hf g
  have hgval : g.1=(aperySocleDegree D i (P.byTail t) : ℤ)-(D.n i : ℤ) :=
    pf_inverse_degree D i (P.byTail t)
  have hstop := P.top_eq s
  have httop := P.top_eq t
  change (γ.1 : ℤ)=(D.n i : ℤ)+f.1-g.1 at hγ
  refine ⟨γ,?_⟩
  omega

name: P23.Semigroup.gamma_isApery_of_ng_tail_relation
statement:
theorem gamma_isApery_of_ng_tail_relation (s t : Fin 3) (hst : s≠t)
    (γ : D.Gamma) (he : D.n i+D.tailGen i t=D.tailGen i s+γ.1) :
    D.IsApery i γ
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨δ,hδ⟩
  have hv := congrArg Subtype.val hδ
  change γ.1=D.n i+δ.1 at hv
  have hbad : D.tailGen i t=D.tailGen i s+δ.1 := by omega
  exact generator_not_add_other D (D.tailIndex i t) (D.tailIndex i s)
    (fun h => hst ((D.tailIndex_injective i h).symm)) δ hbad

name: P23.Semigroup.ng_tail_factorization_base_zero
statement:
theorem ng_tail_factorization_base_zero (s t : Fin 3) (hst : s≠t)
    (γ : D.Gamma) (he : D.n i+D.tailGen i t=D.tailGen i s+γ.1)
    (u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) (hu : D.weightedDegree u=γ.1) : u i=0
proof:
:=
  D.apery_factorization_base_eq_zero i
    (gamma_isApery_of_ng_tail_relation D i s t hst γ he) u hu

name: P23.Semigroup.exists_tail_factorization_containing_selected
statement:
theorem exists_tail_factorization_containing_selected (s t : Fin 3) (hst : s≠t)
    (γ : D.Gamma) (he : D.n i+D.tailGen i t=D.tailGen i s+γ.1) :
    ∃ u : PlainExp, tailDegree D i u=D.n i+D.tailGen i t ∧ 0<u s
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v,hv⟩ := exists_tailExponent_of_isApery D i
    (gamma_isApery_of_ng_tail_relation D i s t hst γ he)
  refine ⟨Finsupp.single s 1+v,?_,?_⟩
  · rw [tailDegree_add,tailDegree_single,one_mul,hv]
    exact he.symm
  · simp

name: P23.Semigroup.source_of_ng_tail_relation
statement:
theorem source_of_ng_tail_relation (s t : Fin 3) (hst : s≠t)
    (γ : D.Gamma) (he : D.n i+D.tailGen i t=D.tailGen i s+γ.1) :
    IsTailSource D i (D.n i+D.tailGen i t)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u,hu,_⟩ := exists_tail_factorization_containing_selected D i s t hst γ he
  refine ⟨⟨⟨u,hu⟩,D.tail i t,rfl⟩,?_⟩
  rintro j ⟨k,⟨hk,δ,hδ⟩,hj⟩
  have hbad : D.tailGen i t=D.tailGen i j+δ.1 := by omega
  by_cases htj : t=j
  · subst j
    have hkq : k=D.n i := by omega
    exact not_tailInH_base D i (hkq ▸ hk)
  · exact generator_not_add_other D (D.tailIndex i t) (D.tailIndex i j)
      (fun h => htj (D.tailIndex_injective i h)) δ hbad

name: P23.Semigroup.exists_two_tail_sources
statement:
theorem exists_two_tail_sources (P : TailSocleTopPattern D i)
    (hn : SemigroupNearlyGorenstein D) : Nonempty (TwoTailSources D i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s,hs⟩ := exists_selected_tail_ng_relations D i P hn
  have hother : ∃ a b : Fin 3, a≠s ∧ b≠s ∧ a≠b := by
    fin_cases s
    · exact ⟨1,2,by norm_num [Fin.ext_iff],by norm_num [Fin.ext_iff],
        by norm_num [Fin.ext_iff]⟩
    · exact ⟨0,2,by norm_num [Fin.ext_iff],by norm_num [Fin.ext_iff],
        by norm_num [Fin.ext_iff]⟩
    · exact ⟨0,1,by norm_num [Fin.ext_iff],by norm_num [Fin.ext_iff],
        by norm_num [Fin.ext_iff]⟩
  obtain ⟨a,b,has,hbs,hab⟩ := hother
  obtain ⟨γa,ha⟩ := hs a has
  obtain ⟨γb,hb⟩ := hs b hbs
  obtain ⟨ua,hua,husa⟩ :=
    exists_tail_factorization_containing_selected D i s a has.symm γa ha
  obtain ⟨ub,hub,husb⟩ :=
    exists_tail_factorization_containing_selected D i s b hbs.symm γb hb
  refine ⟨{
    selected := s, first := a, second := b
    first_ne_selected := has, second_ne_selected := hbs, first_ne_second := hab
    first_source := source_of_ng_tail_relation D i s a has.symm γa ha
    second_source := source_of_ng_tail_relation D i s b hbs.symm γb hb
    first_factorization := ua, second_factorization := ub
    first_degree := hua, second_degree := hub
    first_contains_selected := husa, second_contains_selected := husb
    degrees_ne := ?_ }⟩
  intro h
  apply hab
  apply D.tailGen_injective i
  omega

name: P23.Semigroup.source_factorization_eq_displayed_monomial
statement:
theorem source_factorization_eq_displayed_monomial (G : Finset PlainExp)
    (hI : plainMonomialIdeal ℚ G=chosenBaseDefiningIdeal (k := ℚ) D i)
    {d : ℕ} (hs : IsTailSource D i d) (u : PlainExp) (hu : tailDegree D i u=d)
    (hm : MvPolynomial.monomial u (1 : ℚ) ∈ plainMonomialIdeal ℚ G) : u∈G
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨g,hg,hgu⟩ := (monomial_mem_plainMonomialIdeal_iff ℚ G u).mp hm
  by_cases he : g=u
  · simpa [he] using hg
  · let w : PlainExp := u-g
    have huw : u=g+w := by
      ext j
      simp only [Finsupp.add_apply,Finsupp.tsub_apply,w]
      exact (Nat.add_sub_of_le (hgu j)).symm
    have hw : w≠0 := by
      intro hz
      apply he
      simpa [hz] using huw.symm
    have hgm : MvPolynomial.monomial g (1 : ℚ) ∈ plainMonomialIdeal ℚ G :=
      (monomial_mem_plainMonomialIdeal_iff ℚ G g).mpr ⟨g,hg,plainDivides_refl g⟩
    have hgK : TailInK D i (tailDegree D i g) :=
      (tail_monomial_mem_chosenBaseDefiningIdeal_iff D i g).mp (hI ▸ hgm)
    have hfull := (isTailSource_iff_no_nonzero_tail_predecessor D i d).mp hs
    apply False.elim
    apply hfull.2
    refine ⟨tailDegree D i g,tailDegree D i w,hgK,⟨w,rfl⟩,
      Nat.ne_of_gt (tailDegree_pos_of_ne_zero D i w hw),?_⟩
    rw [←hu,huw,tailDegree_add]

name: P23.Semigroup.tailDegree_coordinate_inverse
statement:
theorem tailDegree_coordinate_inverse (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) (p : PlainExp) :
    tailDegree D i (plainCoordinatePerm e.symm p)=
      ∑ j : Fin 3,p j*D.tailGen i (e j)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold tailDegree
  apply Finset.sum_bij (fun j _=>e.symm j)
  · intro j _; exact Finset.mem_univ _
  · intro a _ b _ he; exact e.symm.injective he
  · intro b _; exact ⟨e b,Finset.mem_univ _,by simp⟩
  · intro j _; simp

name: P23.Semigroup.sevenBoxToPlain_bijective
statement:
theorem sevenBoxToPlain_bijective (M : BudgetZeroPlainModel D i) (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3))
    (hA : 0<A) (hB : 0<B) (hC : 0<C)
    (he : M.roots.image (plainCoordinatePerm e)=plainDominantAxisRoots (A-1) (B-1) (C-1)) :
    Function.Bijective (sevenBoxToPlain M e hA hB hC he)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro p r hh
    apply sevenBoxExponent_injective A B C hA hB
    exact (plainCoordinatePerm e.symm).injective (congrArg Subtype.val hh)
  · intro p
    have hp := (plainStandard_coordinatePerm_iff e M.roots p.1).mpr
      ((mem_plainStandardFinset _ _).mp p.2)
    rw [he] at hp
    obtain ⟨r,hr⟩ := (sevenBoxExponent_range A B C hA hB hC _).mpr hp
    refine ⟨r,Subtype.ext ?_⟩
    change plainCoordinatePerm e.symm (sevenBoxExponent A B C r)=p.1
    rw [hr]
    ext j
    simp

name: P23.Semigroup.sevenBoxApery_card
statement:
theorem sevenBoxApery_card (M : BudgetZeroPlainModel D i) (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3))
    (hA : 0<A) (hB : 0<B) (hC : 0<C)
    (he : M.roots.image (plainCoordinatePerm e)=plainDominantAxisRoots (A-1) (B-1) (C-1)) :
    D.n i=A*B*C+2
proof:
:= by
  have hh := Nat.card_congr (sevenBoxAperyEquiv M e hA hB hC he)
  rw [D.aperyIndex_card] at hh
  simpa [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card,sevenBoxShape_card,Nat.mul_assoc] using hh.symm

name: P23.Semigroup.sevenBox_actual_residue
statement:
theorem sevenBox_actual_residue (M : BudgetZeroPlainModel D i) (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3))
    (hA : 0<A) (hB : 0<B) (hC : 0<C)
    (he : M.roots.image (plainCoordinatePerm e)=plainDominantAxisRoots (A-1) (B-1) (C-1))
    (p : SevenBoxShape A B C) :
    ((sevenBoxAperyEquiv M e hA hB hC he).trans (D.aperyResidueEquiv i)) p=
      sevenBoxResidue (D.tailGen i (e 0):ZMod (D.n i))
        (D.tailGen i (e 1):ZMod (D.n i)) (D.tailGen i (e 2):ZMod (D.n i)) p
proof:
:= by
  change (tailDegree D i (plainCoordinatePerm e.symm (sevenBoxExponent A B C p)):ZMod (D.n i))=_
  rw [tailDegree_coordinate_inverse]
  cases p with
  | inl p => simp [sevenBoxExponent,sevenBoxResidue,boxWeight,Fin.sum_univ_succ,plainExp,add_assoc]
  | inr j => fin_cases j <;> simp [sevenBoxExponent,sevenBoxResidue,Fin.sum_univ_succ,plainExp]

name: P23.Semigroup.budget_zero_type_three_rho_seven_impossible
statement:
theorem budget_zero_type_three_rho_seven_impossible (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup)
    (i : Fin 4) (h0 : D.fourBaseBudget i=0) (ht : D.semigroupType=3)
    (hn : SemigroupNearlyGorenstein D) (h7 : D.semigroupRho=7) : False
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M⟩ := budgetZeroPlainModel D i h0
  have h3 : M.roots.card=3 := M.rootCard_eq_semigroupType.trans ht
  obtain ⟨e,A,B,C,hA,hB,hC,he⟩ := plain_seven_border_exact_box M.roots M.roots_antichain
    h3 M.variables_survive (M.centres_of_ng (by omega) hn) (M.borderCard_eq_rho.trans h7)
  letI : NeZero (D.n i) := ⟨(Nat.ne_of_gt (D.positive i))⟩
  have hAp : 0<A := by omega
  have hBp : 0<B := by omega
  have hCp : 0<C := by omega
  let E := (sevenBoxAperyEquiv M e hAp hBp hCp he).trans (D.aperyResidueEquiv i)
  have heq : E.toFun=sevenBoxResidue (D.tailGen i (e 0):ZMod (D.n i))
      (D.tailGen i (e 1):ZMod (D.n i)) (D.tailGen i (e 2):ZMod (D.n i)) :=
    funext (sevenBox_actual_residue M e hAp hBp hCp he)
  have hb : Function.Bijective (sevenBoxResidue (A:=A) (B:=B) (C:=C)
      (D.tailGen i (e 0):ZMod (D.n i)) (D.tailGen i (e 1):ZMod (D.n i))
      (D.tailGen i (e 2):ZMod (D.n i))) := by
    rw [←heq]
    exact E.bijective
  exact sevenBox_residue_bijective_impossible hA hB hC _ _ _ hb

name: P23.Semigroup.budget_zero_type_three_rho_le_six
statement:
theorem budget_zero_type_three_rho_le_six (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup)
    (i : Fin 4) (h0 : D.fourBaseBudget i=0) (ht : D.semigroupType=3)

proof:

  omega

name: P23.Semigroup.chosenBase_plain_monomial_isApery_iff_standard
statement:
theorem chosenBase_plain_monomial_isApery_iff_standard (G R : Finset PlainExp)
    (hI : plainMonomialIdeal ℚ G=chosenBaseDefiningIdeal (k := ℚ) D i)
    (hG : G=plainBorderFinset R) (p : PlainExp) :
    D.IsApery i (tailDegreeGamma D i p) ↔ p∈plainStandardSet R
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hm : MvPolynomial.monomial p (1 : ℚ) ∈ chosenBaseDefiningIdeal (k := ℚ) D i ↔
      p∉plainStandardSet R := by
    rw [←hI,hG,monomial_mem_plainMonomialIdeal_iff]
    exact (killed_iff_border_divisor R p).symm
  apply not_iff_not.mp
  constructor
  · intro hn
    obtain ⟨γ,hγ⟩ := not_not.mp hn
    apply hm.mp
    apply (tail_monomial_mem_chosenBaseDefiningIdeal_iff D i p).mpr
    exact ⟨⟨p,rfl⟩,γ,congrArg Subtype.val hγ⟩
  · intro hp ha
    have hk := (tail_monomial_mem_chosenBaseDefiningIdeal_iff D i p).mp (hm.mpr hp)
    obtain ⟨_,γ,hγ⟩ := hk
    exact ha ⟨γ,Subtype.ext hγ⟩

name: P23.Semigroup.triangle_topPattern_of_chosenBase_border
statement:
theorem triangle_topPattern_of_chosenBase_border (G : Finset PlainExp) (r u v : ℕ)
    (hI : plainMonomialIdeal ℚ G=chosenBaseDefiningIdeal (k := ℚ) D i)
    (hG : G=plainTriangleBorder r u v)
    (ha : PlainRootAntichain (plainTriangleRoots r u v))
    (ht : D.semigroupType=3) :
    ∃ P : TailSocleTopPattern D i, P.top=tailDegree D i (plainExp (r+1) (u+1) (v+1))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let R := plainTriangleRoots r u v
  let p := plainExp (r+1) (u+1) (v+1)
  let w := fun j : Fin 3 => plainPredecessor j p
  have hGb : G=plainBorderFinset R := hG.trans (plainTriangle_border_exact r u v).symm
  have hiff (e : PlainExp) : D.IsApery i (tailDegreeGamma D i e) ↔ e∈plainStandardSet R :=
    chosenBase_plain_monomial_isApery_iff_standard D i G R hI hGb e
  have hw0 : w 0=plainExp r (u+1) (v+1) := by
    rw [plainExp_eq_coordinates]; simp [w,p,plainPredecessor_apply]
  have hw1 : w 1=plainExp (r+1) u (v+1) := by
    rw [plainExp_eq_coordinates]; simp [w,p,plainPredecessor_apply]
  have hw2 : w 2=plainExp (r+1) (u+1) v := by
    rw [plainExp_eq_coordinates]; simp [w,p,plainPredecessor_apply]
  have hwm (j : Fin 3) : w j∈R := by
    fin_cases j <;> simp [R,plainTriangleRoots,hw0,hw1,hw2]
  have hwadd (j : Fin 3) : w j+plainUnitVector j=p := by
    apply plainPredecessor_add_unitVector
    fin_cases j <;> simp [p]
  have htop (j : Fin 3) : tailDegree D i p=tailDegree D i (w j)+D.tailGen i j := by
    rw [←hwadd j,tailDegree_add]
    simp [plainUnitVector]
  have hk (j l : Fin 3) : plainUnitVector l+w j∉plainStandardSet R := by
    rintro ⟨s,hs,hps⟩
    have hws : plainDivides (w j) s := by
      intro x
      have hx := hps x
      simp only [Finsupp.add_apply] at hx
      omega
    have he := ha (w j) (hwm j) s hs hws
    have hcoord := congrArg (fun e : PlainExp => e l) he
    have hl := hps l
    simp only [Finsupp.add_apply,plainUnitVector_apply,ite_true] at hl
    omega
  let idx : Fin 3 → D.AperySocleIndex i := fun j =>
    ⟨⟨tailDegreeGamma D i (w j),
      (hiff (w j)).mpr ⟨w j,hwm j,plainDivides_refl _⟩⟩,by
      intro l hl
      apply hk j l
      apply (hiff _).mp
      have hγ : tailDegreeGamma D i (plainUnitVector l+w j)=
          tailDegreeGamma D i (w j)+D.tail i l := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        change tailDegree D i (plainUnitVector l+w j)=tailDegree D i (w j)+D.tailGen i l
        rw [tailDegree_add]
        simp [plainUnitVector,add_comm]
      rwa [hγ]⟩
  have hinj : Function.Injective idx := by
    intro j l he
    have hdeg := congrArg (fun s : D.AperySocleIndex i => aperySocleDegree D i s) he
    change tailDegree D i (w j)=tailDegree D i (w l) at hdeg
    apply D.tailGen_injective i
    have hj := htop j
    have hl := htop l
    omega
  have hcard : Fintype.card (Fin 3)=Fintype.card (D.AperySocleIndex i) := by
    rw [Fintype.card_fin,D.pseudoFrobenius_card_eq_aperySocle_card,ht]
  let E : Fin 3 ≃ D.AperySocleIndex i :=
    Equiv.ofBijective idx ((Fintype.bijective_iff_injective_and_card idx).mpr ⟨hinj,hcard⟩)
  refine ⟨⟨tailDegree D i p,E,?_⟩,rfl⟩
  intro j
  exact htop j

name: P23.Semigroup.triangle_border_positive_non_top_unique
statement: private theorem triangle_border_positive_non_top_unique (r u v : ℕ) (s : Fin 3) (p q : PlainExp) (hp : p∈plainTriangleBorder r u v) (hq : q∈plainTriangleBorder r u v) (hps : 0
proof:

name: P23.Semigroup.rho_four_budget_zero_impossible
statement:
theorem rho_four_budget_zero_impossible (ht : D.semigroupType=3)
    (hn : SemigroupNearlyGorenstein D) (hr : D.semigroupRho=4) : D.fourBaseBudget i≠0
proof:
:= by
  intro hz
  obtain ⟨G,hI,hcard,hm⟩ := chosenBase_plain_exponentPresentation_of_budget_zero D i hz
  have hf := chosenBase_plainSurvivors_finite D i G hI
  have h0 := chosenBase_plain_unit_survives D i G hI
  let R := plainSurvivorRoots ℚ G hf
  have hR : R.Nonempty := plainSurvivorRoots_nonempty ℚ G hf h0
  have ha : PlainRootAntichain R := plainSurvivorRoots_antichain ℚ G hf
  have hG := plainGenerators_eq_border ℚ G hf (plainGenerators_antichain_of_minimal ℚ G hm)
  let E := chosenBasePlainQuotientEquiv D i G hI hf hG
  have hv : PlainVariablesSurvive R := chosenBase_plain_variables_survive D i G hI hf
  have htype : plainDirectType ℚ R hR=3 := (chosenPlain_type_eq R hR E).trans
    ((chosenBaseType_eq_semigroupType D i).trans ht)
  have hng : PlainDirectNearlyGorenstein ℚ R hR :=
    (chosenPlain_ng_iff R hR E).mp
      (semigroupNearlyGorenstein_to_chosenBaseNearlyGorenstein D i hn)
  have h3 : R.card=3 := by rwa [plainDirectType_eq_rootCard R hR ha] at htype
  have htrace : PlainVariablesInTrace ℚ R hv := by
    intro j
    apply hng
    apply plain_PX_mem_augmentation
    intro he
    have he' := congrArg (fun p : PlainExp => p j) he
    simpa using he'
  have hc := plain_hasDirectionalCentres_of_variablesInTrace R hR (by omega) ha hv htrace
  have h4 : (plainBorderFinset R).card=4 := by rw [←hG,hcard,hr]
  obtain ⟨r,u,v,htri,hborder⟩ := plain_three_root_four_border_exact_triangle R ha h3 hv hc h4
  have hGtri : G=plainTriangleBorder r u v := hG.trans hborder
  obtain ⟨P,hP⟩ := triangle_topPattern_of_chosenBase_border D i G r u v hI hGtri (htri ▸ ha) ht
  obtain ⟨T⟩ := exists_two_tail_sources D i P hn
  have sourceMem (e : PlainExp) (t : Fin 3)
      (hs : IsTailSource D i (D.n i+D.tailGen i t))
      (he : tailDegree D i e=D.n i+D.tailGen i t) : e∈plainTriangleBorder r u v := by
    have hmJ := (tail_monomial_mem_chosenBaseDefiningIdeal_iff (k := ℚ) D i e).mpr
      (he ▸ hs.1)
    have heG := source_factorization_eq_displayed_monomial D i G hI hs e he (hI.symm ▸ hmJ)
    exact hGtri ▸ heG
  have sourceNotTop (e : PlainExp) (t : Fin 3)
      (he : tailDegree D i e=D.n i+D.tailGen i t) : e≠plainExp (r+1) (u+1) (v+1) := by
    intro heTop
    apply P.top_ne_base_add_tail t
    rw [hP,←heTop,he]
  have heq := triangle_border_positive_non_top_unique r u v T.selected
    T.first_factorization T.second_factorization
    (sourceMem _ _ T.first_source T.first_degree)
    (sourceMem _ _ T.second_source T.second_degree)
    T.first_contains_selected T.second_contains_selected
    (sourceNotTop _ _ T.first_degree) (sourceNotTop _ _ T.second_degree)
  apply T.degrees_ne
  rw [←T.first_degree,←T.second_degree,heq]

name: P23.Semigroup.budget_zero_rho_le_three_semigroupType_eq_one

proof:

  have hR : R.Nonempty := plainSurvivorRoots_nonempty ℚ G hf h0
  have ha : PlainRootAntichain R := plainSurvivorRoots_antichain ℚ G hf
  have hG := plainGenerators_eq_border ℚ G hf (plainGenerators_antichain_of_minimal ℚ G hm)
  let E := chosenBasePlainQuotientEquiv D i G hI hf hG

    (by rw [hcard]; exact hr)

name: P23.Semigroup.budget_one_rho_le_three_semigroupType_eq_one
