name: P23.Monomial.plainTrace_eq_span_plainTraceValueSet
statement:
theorem plainTrace_eq_span_plainTraceValueSet (S : Finset PlainExp) :
    PlainTraceSubmodule k S =
      Submodule.span (PlainMonomialArtin k S) (plainTraceValueSet k S)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · refine iSup_le ?_
    intro F
    rintro v ⟨φ, rfl⟩
    exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨F, φ, rfl⟩
  · apply Submodule.span_le.2
    rintro v ⟨F, φ, rfl⟩
    exact plainTrace_range_le (k := k) S F ⟨φ, rfl⟩

name: P23.Monomial.plainTrace_eq_span_rootTraceValueSet
statement:
theorem plainTrace_eq_span_rootTraceValueSet (S : Finset PlainExp) :
    PlainTraceSubmodule k S =
      Submodule.span (PlainMonomialArtin k S) (plainRootTraceValueSet k S)
proof:
:= by
  rw [plainTrace_eq_span_plainTraceValueSet]
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply Submodule.span_le.2
    rintro v ⟨F, φ, rfl⟩
    have hφ : φ ∈ Submodule.span (PlainMonomialArtin k S) (plainRootDualSet k S) := by
      rw [plainRootDual_span_eq_top]
      trivial
    refine Submodule.span_induction
      (p := fun ψ _ ↦ F ψ ∈
        Submodule.span (PlainMonomialArtin k S) (plainRootTraceValueSet k S))
      ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hφ
    · rintro ψ ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
      exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨F, s, hs, rfl⟩
    · simp
    · intro x y _ _ ihx ihy
      rw [F.map_add]
      exact Submodule.add_mem _ ihx ihy
    · intro r x _ ihx
      rw [F.map_smul]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ r ihx
  · apply Submodule.span_mono
    rintro v ⟨F, s, hs, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨F, PU (k := k) S (plainRootIndex S s hs), rfl⟩

name: P23.Monomial.plainRootTraceValue_constantCoeff_eq_zero
statement:
theorem plainRootTraceValue_constantCoeff_eq_zero (S : Finset PlainExp)
    (hS : S.Nonempty) (hcard : 2 ≤ S.card) (hanti : PlainRootAntichain S)
    (F : PlainOmega k S →ₗ[PlainMonomialArtin k S] PlainMonomialArtin k S)
    (s : PlainExp) (hs : s ∈ S) :
    plainConstantCoeff (k := k) S hS
        (F (PU (k := k) S (plainRootIndex S s hs))) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hex : ∃ r ∈ S, r ≠ s := by
    by_contra hn
    push_neg at hn
    have hsub : S ⊆ {s} := by
      intro r hr
      simp [hn r hr]
    have hc := Finset.card_le_card hsub
    simp at hc
    omega
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hrs⟩ := hex
  let ri := plainRootIndex S r hr
  let si := plainRootIndex S s hs
  have hndiv : ¬plainDivides r s := fun hd => hrs (hanti r hr s hs hd)
  have hann : PX (k := k) S ri.1 ri.2 • PU (k := k) S si = 0 :=
    (PX_smul_plainRootDual_eq_zero_iff (k := k) S s hs ri).2 (by
      change ¬plainDivides r s
      exact hndiv)
  have hzero : PX (k := k) S ri.1 ri.2 * F (PU (k := k) S si) = 0 := by
    calc
      PX (k := k) S ri.1 ri.2 * F (PU (k := k) S si) =
          PX (k := k) S ri.1 ri.2 • F (PU (k := k) S si) := by
            simp [smul_eq_mul]
      _ = F (PX (k := k) S ri.1 ri.2 • PU (k := k) S si) := by
            symm
            exact F.map_smul _ _
      _ = 0 := by rw [hann]; simp
  have hc := congrArg (plainCoeffAt (k := k) S ri) hzero
  rw [plainCoeffAt_PX_mul (k := k) S ri (plainUnitIndex S hS) ri] at hc
  · simpa [plainConstantCoeff, si] using hc
  · simp [plainUnitIndex]

name: P23.Monomial.plain_variable_coeff_eq_zero_of_trace
statement:
theorem plain_variable_coeff_eq_zero_of_trace
    (S : Finset PlainExp) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hcard : 2 ≤ S.card) (hanti : PlainRootAntichain S)
    (e : Fin 3)
    (heS : plainUnitVector e ∈ plainStandardFinset S)
    (hroot : ∀ (F : PlainOmega k S →ₗ[PlainMonomialArtin k S] PlainMonomialArtin k S)
      (s : PlainExp) (hs : s ∈ S),
      plainCoeffAt (k := k) S ⟨plainUnitVector e, heS⟩
        (F (PU (k := k) S (plainRootIndex S s hs))) = 0)
    (t : PlainMonomialArtin k S) (ht : t ∈ PlainTraceSubmodule k S) :
    plainCoeffAt (k := k) S ⟨plainUnitVector e, heS⟩ t = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [plainTrace_eq_span_rootTraceValueSet] at ht
  let Z : Submodule (PlainMonomialArtin k S) (PlainMonomialArtin k S) := {
    carrier := {v | plainConstantCoeff (k := k) S hS v = 0 ∧
      plainCoeffAt (k := k) S ⟨plainUnitVector e, heS⟩ v = 0}
    zero_mem' := by simp
    add_mem' := by
      rintro x y ⟨hx0, hxe⟩ ⟨hy0, hye⟩
      constructor
      · rw [map_add, hx0, hy0, add_zero]
      · rw [map_add, hxe, hye, add_zero]
    smul_mem' := by
      rintro u v ⟨hv0, hve⟩
      constructor
      · simpa [smul_eq_mul, plainConstantCoeff_mul (k := k) S hS] using
          congrArg (fun z : k ↦ plainConstantCoeff (k := k) S hS u * z) hv0
      · simpa [smul_eq_mul] using
          plainCoeffAt_mul_eq_zero_of_right (k := k) S hS e heS u v hv0 hve
  }
  have hrootZ : plainRootTraceValueSet k S ⊆ Z := by
    rintro v ⟨F, s, hs, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨plainRootTraceValue_constantCoeff_eq_zero (k := k) S hS hcard hanti F s hs,
      hroot F s hs⟩
  have hspanZ : Submodule.span (PlainMonomialArtin k S) (plainRootTraceValueSet k S) ≤ Z :=
    Submodule.span_le.2 hrootZ
  exact (hspanZ ht).2

name: P23.Monomial.plain_exists_root_image_with_variable_coeff_of_mem_trace
statement:
theorem plain_exists_root_image_with_variable_coeff_of_mem_trace
    (S : Finset PlainExp) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hcard : 2 ≤ S.card) (hanti : PlainRootAntichain S)
    (e : Fin 3)
    (heS : plainUnitVector e ∈ plainStandardFinset S)
    (htrace : PX (k := k) S (plainUnitVector e) heS ∈ PlainTraceSubmodule k S) :
    ∃ (F : PlainOmega k S →ₗ[PlainMonomialArtin k S] PlainMonomialArtin k S)
      (s : PlainExp) (hs : s ∈ S),
      plainCoeffAt (k := k) S ⟨plainUnitVector e, heS⟩
        (F (PU (k := k) S (plainRootIndex S s hs))) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hn
  push_neg at hn
  have hz := plain_variable_coeff_eq_zero_of_trace (k := k) S hS hcard hanti
    e heS hn _ htrace
  have hone : plainCoeffAt (k := k) S ⟨plainUnitVector e, heS⟩
      (PX (k := k) S (plainUnitVector e) heS) = 1 := by
    simpa using plainCoeffAt_PX (k := k) S
      (⟨plainUnitVector e, heS⟩ : PlainMonomialIndex S) ⟨plainUnitVector e, heS⟩
  rw [hone] at hz
  exact one_ne_zero hz

name: P23.Monomial.plainCoeffAt_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem plainCoeffAt_apply (S : Finset PlainExp) (p : PlainMonomialIndex S)
    (v : PlainMonomialArtin k S) : plainCoeffAt (k := k) S p v = v.coeff p
proof: := rfl

name: P23.Monomial.plainCoeffAt_PX
statement:
theorem plainCoeffAt_PX (S : Finset PlainExp) (p q : PlainMonomialIndex S) :
    plainCoeffAt (k := k) S p (PX (k := k) S q.1 q.2) =
      if p = q then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  change (PX (k := k) S q.1 q.2).coeff p = _
  rw [PlainMonomialArtin.coeff_PX]
  by_cases h : p = q <;> simp [h]

name: P23.Monomial.plainConstantCoeff_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem plainConstantCoeff_one (S : Finset PlainExp) (hS : S.Nonempty) :
    plainConstantCoeff (k := k) S hS 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← PlainMonomialArtin.PX_one (k := k) S hS]
  simp [plainConstantCoeff, plainUnitIndex]

name: P23.Monomial.plainCoeffAt_PX_mul
statement:
theorem plainCoeffAt_PX_mul (S : Finset PlainExp)
    (m e t : PlainMonomialIndex S) (hmet : m.1 + e.1 = t.1)
    (v : PlainMonomialArtin k S) :
    plainCoeffAt (k := k) S t (PX (k := k) S m.1 m.2 * v) =
      plainCoeffAt (k := k) S e v
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction v using PlainMonomialArtin.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add v w hv hw =>
      rw [mul_add, map_add, map_add, hv, hw]
  | single q r =>
      rw [← PlainMonomialArtin.smul_PX (k := k) r S q.1 q.2]
      rw [PlainMonomialArtin.mul_smul_comm']
      by_cases hqe : q = e
      · subst q
        simp [PlainMonomialArtin.PX_mul_PX, hmet, t.2, plainCoeffAt_PX]
      · have hprod : m.1 + q.1 ≠ t.1 := by
          intro hp
          apply hqe
          apply Subtype.ext
          apply add_left_cancel
          exact hp.trans hmet.symm
        by_cases hsurv : m.1 + q.1 ∈ plainStandardFinset S
        · rw [PlainMonomialArtin.PX_mul_PX]
          simp only [dif_pos hsurv, map_smul]
          simp only [plainCoeffAt_apply, PlainMonomialArtin.coeff_PX]
          have ht : t ≠ ⟨m.1 + q.1, hsurv⟩ := by
            intro heq
            apply hprod
            exact (congrArg Subtype.val heq).symm
          have heq : e ≠ q := fun heq => hqe heq.symm
          have hval : t.1 ≠ m.1 + q.1 := fun hval => hprod hval.symm
          simp [ht, heq, hval]
        · simp [PlainMonomialArtin.PX_mul_PX, hsurv, hqe, plainCoeffAt_PX]

name: P23.Monomial.plainCoeffAt_mul_PX
statement:
theorem plainCoeffAt_mul_PX (S : Finset PlainExp)
    (m e t : PlainMonomialIndex S) (hmet : e.1 + m.1 = t.1)
    (v : PlainMonomialArtin k S) :
    plainCoeffAt (k := k) S t (v * PX (k := k) S m.1 m.2) =
      plainCoeffAt (k := k) S e v
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm]
  exact plainCoeffAt_PX_mul (k := k) S m e t (by simpa [add_comm] using hmet) v

name: P23.Monomial.plain_add_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem plain_add_eq_zero_iff (p q : PlainExp) : p + q = 0 ↔ p = 0 ∧ q = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hc j := congrArg (fun p : PlainExp => p j) h
    constructor <;> ext j <;> specialize hc j <;> simp only [Finsupp.add_apply,Finsupp.zero_apply] at hc ⊢ <;> omega
  · rintro ⟨rfl,rfl⟩; simp

name: P23.Monomial.plain_variable_is_atom
statement:
theorem plain_variable_is_atom (j : Fin 3) (p q : PlainExp)
    (h : p+q=plainUnitVector j) : p=0 ∨ q=0
proof:
:= by
  have hc r := congrArg (fun p : PlainExp => p r) h
  have hj : p j + q j = 1 := by simpa using hc j
  have ho r (hr : r ≠ j) : p r = 0 ∧ q r = 0 := by
    have := hc r
    simp [plainUnitVector,Finsupp.single_apply,Ne.symm hr] at this
    exact this
  have hp : p j = 0 ∨ q j = 0 := by omega
  rcases hp with hp | hq
  · left; ext r; by_cases hr : r=j
    · subst r; exact hp
    · exact (ho r hr).1
  · right; ext r; by_cases hr : r=j
    · subst r; exact hq
    · exact (ho r hr).2

name: P23.Monomial.plainConstantCoeff_PX_mul_PX
statement:
private theorem plainConstantCoeff_PX_mul_PX (S : Finset PlainExp) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (p q : PlainMonomialIndex S) :
    plainConstantCoeff (k := k) S hS (PX S p.1 p.2 * PX S q.1 q.2) =
      plainConstantCoeff (k := k) S hS (PX S p.1 p.2) *
      plainConstantCoeff (k := k) S hS (PX S q.1 q.2)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [PX_mul_PX]
  by_cases hpq : p.1 + q.1 ∈ plainStandardFinset S
  · simp only [dite_eq_left hpq]
    have hu := plain_add_eq_zero_iff p.1 q.1
    simp only [plainConstantCoeff,plainCoeffAt_PX,plainUnitIndex]
    by_cases hp : p.1=0 <;> by_cases hq : q.1=0 <;>
      simp_all [Subtype.ext_iff,eq_comm]
  · simp only [dite_eq_right hpq,map_zero]
    have hnotboth : ¬ (p.1=0 ∧ q.1=0) := by
      rintro ⟨hp,hq⟩
      exact hpq (by simpa [hp,hq] using zero_mem_plainStandardFinset S hS)
    simp only [plainConstantCoeff,plainCoeffAt_PX,plainUnitIndex]
    by_cases hp : p.1=0 <;> by_cases hq : q.1=0 <;>
      simp_all [Subtype.ext_iff,eq_comm]

name: P23.Monomial.plainConstantCoeff_mul
statement:
theorem plainConstantCoeff_mul (S : Finset PlainExp) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (u v : PlainMonomialArtin k S) :
    plainConstantCoeff (k := k) S hS (u*v) =
      plainConstantCoeff (k := k) S hS u * plainConstantCoeff S hS v
proof:
:= by
  induction u using PlainMonomialArtin.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add u₁ u₂ hu₁ hu₂ => rw [add_mul,map_add,map_add,hu₁,hu₂,add_mul]
  | single p rp =>
    rw [←PlainMonomialArtin.smul_PX rp S p.1 p.2]
    induction v using PlainMonomialArtin.induction_linear with
    | zero => simp
    | add v₁ v₂ hv₁ hv₂ => rw [mul_add,map_add,map_add,hv₁,hv₂,mul_add]
    | single q rq =>
      rw [←PlainMonomialArtin.smul_PX rq S q.1 q.2]
      simp only [PlainMonomialArtin.smul_mul_assoc',PlainMonomialArtin.mul_smul_comm',
        map_smul,smul_eq_mul]
      rw [plainConstantCoeff_PX_mul_PX S hS p q]
      ring

 theorem plainCoeffAt_mul_eq_zero_of_right (S : Finset PlainExp)
    (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (e : Fin 3) (heS : plainUnitVector e ∈ plainStandardFinset S)
    (u v : PlainMonomialArtin k S)
    (hv0 : plainConstantCoeff (k := k) S hS v = 0)
    (hve : plainCoeffAt (k := k) S ⟨plainUnitVector e, heS⟩ v = 0) :
    plainCoeffAt (k := k) S ⟨plainUnitVector e, heS⟩ (u * v) = 0 := by
  classical
  let ei : PlainMonomialIndex S := ⟨plainUnitVector e, heS⟩
  have he_ne_one : plainUnitVector e ≠ (0 : PlainExp) := by
    intro h
    have hc := congrArg (fun p : PlainExp => p e) h
    simpa using hc
  have hother (p : PlainMonomialIndex S) (hp1 : p.1 ≠ 0)
      (hpe : p.1 ≠ plainUnitVector e) (w : PlainMonomialArtin k S) :
      plainCoeffAt (k := k) S ei (PX (k := k) S p.1 p.2 * w) = 0 := by
    induction w using PlainMonomialArtin.induction_linear with
    | zero => simp
    | add w₁ w₂ hw₁ hw₂ => rw [mul_add, map_add, hw₁, hw₂, add_zero]
    | single q r =>
        rw [← PlainMonomialArtin.smul_PX (k := k) r S q.1 q.2]
        rw [PlainMonomialArtin.mul_smul_comm']
        rw [PlainMonomialArtin.PX_mul_PX]
        by_cases hpq : p.1 + q.1 ∈ plainStandardFinset S
        · simp only [dif_pos hpq, map_smul]
          have hprod : p.1 + q.1 ≠ plainUnitVector e := by
            intro hprod
            rcases plain_variable_is_atom e p.1 q.1 hprod with hp | hq
            · exact hp1 hp
            · apply hpe
              simpa [hq] using hprod
          have hidx : (⟨p.1 + q.1, hpq⟩ : PlainMonomialIndex S) ≠ ei := by
            intro hidx
            apply hprod
            exact congrArg Subtype.val hidx
          have hprod' : plainUnitVector e ≠ p.1 + q.1 := fun h => hprod h.symm
          simp only [plainCoeffAt_apply, PlainMonomialArtin.coeff_PX]
          simp [ei, hprod']
        · simp [hpq]
  have hbasis (p : PlainMonomialIndex S) :
      plainCoeffAt (k := k) S ei (PX (k := k) S p.1 p.2 * v) = 0 := by
    by_cases hp1 : p.1 = 0
    · have hp : p = plainUnitIndex S hS := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        exact hp1
      subst p
      have hX : PX (k := k) S (plainUnitIndex S hS).1 (plainUnitIndex S hS).2 = 1 := by
        simpa [plainUnitIndex] using PlainMonomialArtin.PX_one (k := k) S hS
      rw [hX, one_mul]
      exact hve
    by_cases hpe : p.1 = plainUnitVector e
    · have hp : p = ei := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        exact hpe
      subst p
      rw [plainCoeffAt_PX_mul (k := k) S ei (plainUnitIndex S hS) ei]
      · exact hv0
      · simp [plainUnitIndex]
    exact hother p hp1 hpe v
  induction u using PlainMonomialArtin.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add u w hu hw => rw [add_mul, map_add, hu, hw, add_zero]
  | single p r =>
      rw [← PlainMonomialArtin.smul_PX (k := k) r S p.1 p.2]
      rw [PlainMonomialArtin.smul_mul_assoc', map_smul, hbasis]
      simp

name: P23.Monomial.plainCoeffAt_mul_eq_zero_of_right
statement:
theorem plainCoeffAt_mul_eq_zero_of_right (S : Finset PlainExp)
    (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (e : Fin 3) (heS : plainUnitVector e ∈ plainStandardFinset S)
    (u v : PlainMonomialArtin k S)
    (hv0 : plainConstantCoeff (k := k) S hS v = 0)
    (hve : plainCoeffAt (k := k) S ⟨plainUnitVector e, heS⟩ v = 0) :
    plainCoeffAt (k := k) S ⟨plainUnitVector e, heS⟩ (u * v) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let ei : PlainMonomialIndex S := ⟨plainUnitVector e, heS⟩
  have he_ne_one : plainUnitVector e ≠ (0 : PlainExp) := by
    intro h
    have hc := congrArg (fun p : PlainExp => p e) h
    simpa using hc
  have hother (p : PlainMonomialIndex S) (hp1 : p.1 ≠ 0)
      (hpe : p.1 ≠ plainUnitVector e) (w : PlainMonomialArtin k S) :
      plainCoeffAt (k := k) S ei (PX (k := k) S p.1 p.2 * w) = 0 := by
    induction w using PlainMonomialArtin.induction_linear with
    | zero => simp
    | add w₁ w₂ hw₁ hw₂ => rw [mul_add, map_add, hw₁, hw₂, add_zero]
    | single q r =>
        rw [← PlainMonomialArtin.smul_PX (k := k) r S q.1 q.2]
        rw [PlainMonomialArtin.mul_smul_comm']
        rw [PlainMonomialArtin.PX_mul_PX]
        by_cases hpq : p.1 + q.1 ∈ plainStandardFinset S
        · simp only [dif_pos hpq, map_smul]
          have hprod : p.1 + q.1 ≠ plainUnitVector e := by
            intro hprod
            rcases plain_variable_is_atom e p.1 q.1 hprod with hp | hq
            · exact hp1 hp
            · apply hpe
              simpa [hq] using hprod
          have hidx : (⟨p.1 + q.1, hpq⟩ : PlainMonomialIndex S) ≠ ei := by
            intro hidx
            apply hprod
            exact congrArg Subtype.val hidx
          have hprod' : plainUnitVector e ≠ p.1 + q.1 := fun h => hprod h.symm
          simp only [plainCoeffAt_apply, PlainMonomialArtin.coeff_PX]
          simp [ei, hprod']
        · simp [hpq]
  have hbasis (p : PlainMonomialIndex S) :
      plainCoeffAt (k := k) S ei (PX (k := k) S p.1 p.2 * v) = 0 := by
    by_cases hp1 : p.1 = 0
    · have hp : p = plainUnitIndex S hS := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        exact hp1
      subst p
      have hX : PX (k := k) S (plainUnitIndex S hS).1 (plainUnitIndex S hS).2 = 1 := by
        simpa [plainUnitIndex] using PlainMonomialArtin.PX_one (k := k) S hS
      rw [hX, one_mul]
      exact hve
    by_cases hpe : p.1 = plainUnitVector e
    · have hp : p = ei := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        exact hpe
      subst p
      rw [plainCoeffAt_PX_mul (k := k) S ei (plainUnitIndex S hS) ei]
      · exact hv0
      · simp [plainUnitIndex]
    exact hother p hp1 hpe v
  induction u using PlainMonomialArtin.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add u w hu hw => rw [add_mul, map_add, hu, hw, add_zero]
  | single p r =>
      rw [← PlainMonomialArtin.smul_PX (k := k) r S p.1 p.2]
      rw [PlainMonomialArtin.smul_mul_assoc', map_smul, hbasis]
      simp

name: P23.Monomial.zero_mem_plainStandardFinset
statement:
theorem zero_mem_plainStandardFinset (S : Finset PlainExp) (hS : S.Nonempty) :
    (0 : PlainExp) ∈ plainStandardFinset S
proof:
:=
  (mem_plainStandardFinset S 0).mpr (plain_zero_mem_standard S hS)

name: P23.Monomial.PlainMonomialArtin.coeff_injective
statement:
theorem coeff_injective :
    Function.Injective (coeff : PlainMonomialArtin k S → PlainMonomialIndex S →₀ k)
proof:
:=
  (coeffEquiv k S).injective

name: P23.Monomial.PlainMonomialArtin.ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem ext {x y : PlainMonomialArtin k S} (h : x.coeff = y.coeff) : x = y
proof:
:=
  coeff_injective h

name: P23.Monomial.PlainMonomialArtin.coeff_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem coeff_zero :
    coeff (0 : PlainMonomialArtin k S) = 0
proof: := rfl

name: P23.Monomial.PlainMonomialArtin.coeff_add
statement:
@[simp] theorem coeff_add (x y : PlainMonomialArtin k S) :
    coeff (x + y) = coeff x + coeff y
proof: := rfl

name: P23.Monomial.PlainMonomialArtin.coeff_neg
statement:
@[simp] theorem coeff_neg (x : PlainMonomialArtin k S) :
    coeff (-x) = -coeff x
proof: := rfl

name: P23.Monomial.PlainMonomialArtin.coeff_smul
statement:
@[simp] theorem coeff_smul (r : k) (x : PlainMonomialArtin k S) :
    coeff (r • x) = r • coeff x
proof: := rfl

name: P23.Monomial.PlainMonomialArtin.induction_linear
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem induction_linear {P : PlainMonomialArtin k S → Prop}
    (x : PlainMonomialArtin k S) (zero : P 0)
    (add : ∀ x y, P x → P y → P (x + y))
    (single : ∀ p r, P (.ofCoeff (Finsupp.single p r))) : P x
proof:
:= by
  change P (.ofCoeff x.coeff)
  induction x.coeff using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => exact zero
  | add x y hx hy => exact add (.ofCoeff x) (.ofCoeff y) hx hy
  | single p r => exact single p r

name: P23.Monomial.PlainMonomialArtin.coeff_PX
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeff_PX (S : Finset (PlainExp)) (p : PlainExp)
    (hp : p ∈ plainStandardFinset S) (q : PlainMonomialIndex S) :
    (PX (k := k) S p hp).coeff q = if q.1 = p then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [PX, Finsupp.single_apply, eq_comm, Subtype.ext_iff]

name: P23.Monomial.PlainMonomialArtin.smul_PX
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smul_PX (r : k) (S : Finset (PlainExp)) (p : PlainExp)
    (hp : p ∈ plainStandardFinset S) :
    r • PX (k := k) S p hp =
      .ofCoeff (Finsupp.single ⟨p, hp⟩ r)
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp [PX, Finsupp.single_apply]

name: P23.Monomial.PlainMonomialArtin.mul_def
statement:
theorem mul_def (x y : PlainMonomialArtin k S) :
    x * y = x.coeff.sum fun p rp ↦
      y.coeff.sum fun q rq ↦ (rp * rq) • basisProduct (k := k) S p q
proof: := rfl

name: P23.Monomial.PlainMonomialArtin.PX_mul_PX
statement:
@[simp]
theorem PX_mul_PX (S : Finset (PlainExp)) (p q : PlainExp)
    (hp : p ∈ plainStandardFinset S) (hq : q ∈ plainStandardFinset S) :
    PX (k := k) S p hp * PX (k := k) S q hq =
      if h : p + q ∈ plainStandardFinset S then PX (k := k) S (p + q) h else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [mul_def, PX, basisProduct]

name: P23.Monomial.PlainMonomialArtin.smul_mul_raw
statement:
theorem smul_mul_raw (r : k) (x y : PlainMonomialArtin k S) :
    (r • x) * y = r • (x * y)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [mul_def, coeff_smul]
  rw [Finsupp.sum_smul_index (h0 := by simp)]
  rw [Finsupp.smul_sum]
  apply Finsupp.sum_congr
  intro p _
  rw [Finsupp.smul_sum]
  apply Finsupp.sum_congr
  intro q _
  rw [smul_smul]
  apply congrArg (fun t : k ↦ t • basisProduct (k := k) S p q)
  ring

name: P23.Monomial.PlainMonomialArtin.mul_smul_raw
statement:
theorem mul_smul_raw (r : k) (x y : PlainMonomialArtin k S) :
    x * (r • y) = r • (x * y)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [mul_def, coeff_smul]
  rw [Finsupp.smul_sum]
  apply Finsupp.sum_congr
  intro p _
  rw [Finsupp.sum_smul_index (h0 := by simp)]
  rw [Finsupp.smul_sum]
  apply Finsupp.sum_congr
  intro q _
  rw [smul_smul]
  apply congrArg (fun t : k ↦ t • basisProduct (k := k) S p q)
  ring

name: P23.Monomial.PlainMonomialArtin.mem_plainStandardFinset_of_add_mem_left
statement:
theorem mem_plainStandardFinset_of_add_mem_left (S : Finset (PlainExp))
    {p q : PlainExp} (h : p + q ∈ plainStandardFinset S) :
    p ∈ plainStandardFinset S
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_plainStandardFinset] at h ⊢
  exact plainStandard_downward S h (fun j => Nat.le_add_right _ _)

name: P23.Monomial.PlainMonomialArtin.mem_plainStandardFinset_of_add_mem_right
statement:
theorem mem_plainStandardFinset_of_add_mem_right (S : Finset (PlainExp))
    {p q : PlainExp} (h : p + q ∈ plainStandardFinset S) :
    q ∈ plainStandardFinset S
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_plainStandardFinset] at h ⊢
  exact plainStandard_downward S h (fun j => Nat.le_add_left _ _)

name: P23.Monomial.PlainMonomialArtin.PX_mul_PX_mul_PX
statement:
private theorem PX_mul_PX_mul_PX (S : Finset (PlainExp))
    (p q r : PlainMonomialIndex S) :
    (PX (k := k) S p.1 p.2 * PX (k := k) S q.1 q.2) * PX (k := k) S r.1 r.2 =
      PX (k := k) S p.1 p.2 * (PX (k := k) S q.1 q.2 * PX (k := k) S r.1 r.2)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases htotal : (p.1 + q.1) + r.1 ∈ plainStandardFinset S
  · have hpq : p.1 + q.1 ∈ plainStandardFinset S :=
      mem_plainStandardFinset_of_add_mem_left S htotal
    have hqr : q.1 + r.1 ∈ plainStandardFinset S := by
      apply mem_plainStandardFinset_of_add_mem_right S (p := p.1)
      simpa [add_assoc] using htotal
    simp [PX_mul_PX, hpq, hqr, htotal, add_assoc]
  · have htotal' : p.1 + (q.1 + r.1) ∉ plainStandardFinset S := by
      simpa [add_assoc] using htotal
    by_cases hpq : p.1 + q.1 ∈ plainStandardFinset S <;>
      by_cases hqr : q.1 + r.1 ∈ plainStandardFinset S <;>
      simp [PX_mul_PX, hpq, hqr, htotal, htotal', add_assoc]

name: P23.Monomial.PlainMonomialArtin.PX_mul_PX_comm
statement:
private theorem PX_mul_PX_comm (S : Finset (PlainExp))
    (p q : PlainMonomialIndex S) :
    PX (k := k) S p.1 p.2 * PX (k := k) S q.1 q.2 =
      PX (k := k) S q.1 q.2 * PX (k := k) S p.1 p.2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [PX_mul_PX, add_comm]

name: P23.Monomial.PlainMonomialArtin.one_def
statement:
theorem one_def : (1 : PlainMonomialArtin k S) =
    if h : (0 : PlainExp) ∈ plainStandardFinset S then PX (k := k) S 0 h else 0
proof: := rfl

name: P23.Monomial.PlainMonomialArtin.plainStandardFinset_nonempty_of_index
statement: private theorem plainStandardFinset_nonempty_of_index (p : PlainMonomialIndex S) : S.Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  have hp := p.2
  rw [mem_plainStandardFinset] at hp
  rcases hp with ⟨s, hs, -⟩
  exact ⟨s, hs⟩

name: P23.Monomial.PlainMonomialArtin.one_mul_PX
statement:
private theorem one_mul_PX (p : PlainMonomialIndex S) :
    (1 : PlainMonomialArtin k S) * PX (k := k) S p.1 p.2 = PX (k := k) S p.1 p.2
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := zero_mem_plainStandardFinset S (plainStandardFinset_nonempty_of_index p)
  simp [one_def, h1, PX_mul_PX]

name: P23.Monomial.PlainMonomialArtin.smul_mul_assoc'
statement:
theorem smul_mul_assoc' (r : k) (x y : PlainMonomialArtin k S) :
    (r • x) * y = r • (x * y)
proof:
:= by
  exact smul_mul_raw r x y

name: P23.Monomial.PlainMonomialArtin.mul_smul_comm'
statement:
theorem mul_smul_comm' (r : k) (x y : PlainMonomialArtin k S) :
    x * (r • y) = r • (x * y)
proof:
:= by
  exact mul_smul_raw r x y

name: P23.Monomial.PlainMonomialArtin.PX_one
statement:
theorem PX_one (S : Finset (PlainExp)) (hS : S.Nonempty) :
    PX (k := k) S 0 (zero_mem_plainStandardFinset S hS) = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [one_def, zero_mem_plainStandardFinset S hS]

name: P23.Monomial.PlainMonomialArtin.PX_ne_zero
statement:
theorem PX_ne_zero (S : Finset (PlainExp)) (p : PlainExp)
    (hp : p ∈ plainStandardFinset S) : PX (k := k) S p hp ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hc := congrArg (fun x : PlainMonomialArtin k S ↦ x.coeff ⟨p, hp⟩) h
  simpa [coeff_PX] using hc

name: P23.Monomial.PlainMonomialArtin.basisSurvives_iff
statement:
theorem basisSurvives_iff (k : Type*) [Field k]
    (S : Finset (PlainExp)) (p : PlainExp) :
    BasisSurvives k S p ↔ p ∈ plainStandardSet S
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hp, -⟩
    exact (mem_plainStandardFinset S p).1 hp
  · intro hp
    have hp' := (mem_plainStandardFinset S p).2 hp
    exact ⟨hp', PX_ne_zero (k := k) S p hp'⟩

name: P23.Monomial.PlainMonomialArtin.monomialBasis_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem monomialBasis_apply (S : Finset (PlainExp)) (p : PlainMonomialIndex S) :
    monomialBasis k S p = PX (k := k) S p.1 p.2
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: P23.Monomial.PlainMonomialArtin.basis_expansion
statement:
theorem basis_expansion (x : PlainMonomialArtin k S) :
    x = x.coeff.sum fun p r ↦ r • PX (k := k) S p.1 p.2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction x using induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add x y hx hy =>
      rw [coeff_add, Finsupp.sum_add_index']
      · exact congrArg₂ (fun u v : PlainMonomialArtin k S ↦ u + v) hx hy
      · simp
      · intro p r s
        exact add_smul r s _
  | single p r =>
      rw [Finsupp.sum_single_index]
      · exact (smul_PX r S p.1 p.2).symm
      · simp

name: P23.Monomial.PlainMonomialArtin.finrank_plainMonomialArtin
statement:
theorem finrank_plainMonomialArtin (k : Type*) [Field k]
    (S : Finset (PlainExp)) :
    Module.finrank k (PlainMonomialArtin k S) = (plainStandardFinset S).card
proof:
:= by
  rw [Module.finrank_eq_card_basis (monomialBasis k S), Fintype.card_coe]

name: P23.Monomial.sevenBoxShape_card
statement:
theorem sevenBoxShape_card (A B C : ℕ) :
    Fintype.card (SevenBoxShape A B C)=A*B*C+2
proof:
:= by
  simp [SevenBoxShape,Nat.mul_assoc]

name: P23.Monomial.sevenBoxExponent_injective
statement:
theorem sevenBoxExponent_injective (A B C : ℕ) (hA : 0<A) (hB : 0<B) :
    Function.Injective (sevenBoxExponent A B C)
proof:
:= by
  intro p q he
  cases p with
  | inl p =>
    cases q with
    | inl q =>
      have hh : (p.1:ℕ)=(q.1:ℕ) ∧ (p.2.1:ℕ)=(q.2.1:ℕ) ∧ (p.2.2:ℕ)=(q.2.2:ℕ) := by
        simpa [sevenBoxExponent,plainExp_eq] using he
      congr 1
      apply Prod.ext
      · exact Fin.ext hh.1
      · exact Prod.ext (Fin.ext hh.2.1) (Fin.ext hh.2.2)
    | inr j =>
      fin_cases j <;> simp [sevenBoxExponent,plainExp_eq] at he
      · have := p.1.isLt; omega
      · have := p.2.1.isLt; omega
  | inr j =>
    cases q with
    | inl q =>
      fin_cases j <;> simp [sevenBoxExponent,plainExp_eq] at he
      · have := q.1.isLt; omega
      · have := q.2.1.isLt; omega
    | inr k =>
      fin_cases j <;> fin_cases k <;> simp [sevenBoxExponent,plainExp_eq] at he ⊢
      all_goals omega

name: P23.Monomial.sevenBox_standard_iff
statement:
theorem sevenBox_standard_iff (A B C : ℕ) (hA : 0<A) (hB : 0<B) (hC : 0<C)
    (p : PlainExp) :
    p∈plainStandardSet (plainDominantAxisRoots (A-1) (B-1) (C-1)) ↔
    (p 0<A ∧ p 1<B ∧ p 2<C) ∨ p=plainExp A 0 0 ∨ p=plainExp 0 B 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [plainDominantAxis_standard]
  simp only [plainExp_eq_coordinates]
  omega

name: P23.Monomial.sevenBoxExponent_range
statement:
theorem sevenBoxExponent_range (A B C : ℕ) (hA : 0<A) (hB : 0<B) (hC : 0<C)
    (p : PlainExp) :
    (∃ u : SevenBoxShape A B C,sevenBoxExponent A B C u=p) ↔
    p∈plainStandardSet (plainDominantAxisRoots (A-1) (B-1) (C-1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [sevenBox_standard_iff A B C hA hB hC]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨u,rfl⟩
    cases u with
    | inl u =>
      exact Or.inl ⟨by simpa [sevenBoxExponent] using u.1.isLt,
        by simpa [sevenBoxExponent] using u.2.1.isLt,
        by simpa [sevenBoxExponent] using u.2.2.isLt⟩
    | inr j => fin_cases j <;> simp [sevenBoxExponent]
  · rintro (hp | hp | hp)
    · exact ⟨.inl (⟨p 0,hp.1⟩,⟨p 1,hp.2.1⟩,⟨p 2,hp.2.2⟩),plainExp_coordinates p⟩
    · exact ⟨.inr 0,by simpa [sevenBoxExponent] using hp.symm⟩
    · exact ⟨.inr 1,by simpa [sevenBoxExponent] using hp.symm⟩

name: P23.Monomial.plain_axis_pair_exact_box
statement: theorem plain_axis_pair_exact_box (p q r : PlainExp) (ha : PlainRootAntichain {p,q,r}) (hc : HasPlainDirectionalCentres {p,q,r}) (hp : 0
proof:
:= by
  have centre (j : Fin 3) (hj : j ≠ 2) : PlainDirectionalCentre {p,q,r} j p := by
    obtain ⟨c,hc⟩ := hc j
    have hb := hc.2 p (by simp) (by fin_cases j <;> simp_all)
    have hb2 := hb 2
    have hh : p 2 ≤ c 2 := by
      simpa [plainPredecessor_apply,hj,Ne.symm hj] using hb2
    have hm := hc.1
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert,Finset.mem_singleton] at hm
    rcases hm with h | h | h
    · simpa [h] using hc
    · subst c; omega
    · subst c; omega
  have hqp : q ≠ p := by intro h; have he := congrArg (fun s : PlainExp => s 1) h; omega
  have hrp : r ≠ p := by intro h; have he := congrArg (fun s : PlainExp => s 0) h; omega
  have hx := (plain_centre_other_root_coordinates {p,q,r} ha
    (centre 0 (by decide)) (by simp) hqp hq.1).1
  have hy := (plain_centre_other_root_coordinates {p,q,r} ha
    (centre 1 (by decide)) (by simp) hrp hr.2.1).1
  exact plain_three_finset_congr (plainExp_coordinates p).symm
    (by rw [plainExp_eq_coordinates]; omega)
    (by rw [plainExp_eq_coordinates]; omega)

name: P23.Monomial.plain_permuted_pair_exact_box
statement: theorem plain_permuted_pair_exact_box (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) (p q r : PlainExp) (ha : PlainRootAntichain {p,q,r}) (hc : HasPlainDirectionalCentres {p,q,r}) (hp : 0
proof:
:= by
  have hi : ({p,q,r} : Finset PlainExp).image (plainCoordinatePerm e) =
      {plainCoordinatePerm e p,plainCoordinatePerm e q,plainCoordinatePerm e r} := by simp
  have he := plain_axis_pair_exact_box (plainCoordinatePerm e p) (plainCoordinatePerm e q)
    (plainCoordinatePerm e r) (by rw [←hi]; exact plainAntichain_coordinatePerm e _ ha)
    (by rw [←hi]; exact plainCentres_coordinatePerm e _ hc)
    (by simpa using hp) (by simpa using hq) (by simpa using hr)
  refine ⟨p (e 0)+1,p (e 1)+1,p (e 2)+1,by omega,by omega,by omega,?_⟩
  simpa [hi] using he

name: P23.Monomial.plain_pure_axes_exact_box
statement: theorem plain_pure_axes_exact_box (p q r : PlainExp) (hqr : q≠r) (ha : PlainRootAntichain {p,q,r}) (hc : HasPlainDirectionalCentres {p,q,r}) (hp : 0
proof:
:= by
  have hnc : ¬plainDivides q r := fun h => hqr (ha q (by simp) r (by simp) h)
  have hnc' : ¬plainDivides r q := fun h => hqr (ha r (by simp) q (by simp) h).symm
  have same (j : Fin 3) (hqz : ∀ a, a≠j → q a=0)
      (hrz : ∀ a, a≠j → r a=0) : False := by
    by_cases hle : q j≤r j
    · apply hnc; intro a; by_cases he : a=j
      · simpa [he] using hle
      · simp [hqz a he,hrz a he]
    · apply hnc'; intro a; by_cases he : a=j
      · simp only [he]; omega
      · simp [hqz a he,hrz a he]
  rcases hq with hq | hq | hq <;> rcases hr with hr | hr | hr
  · exfalso; apply same 0
    all_goals intro j hj; fin_cases j <;> simp_all
  · refine ⟨Equiv.refl _,?_⟩
    exact plain_permuted_pair_exact_box _ p q r ha hc hp hq hr
  · refine ⟨Equiv.swap (1 : Fin 3) 2,?_⟩
    apply plain_permuted_pair_exact_box _ p q r ha hc
    all_goals simp [Equiv.swap_apply_def]; omega
  · refine ⟨Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 3) 1,?_⟩
    apply plain_permuted_pair_exact_box _ p q r ha hc
    all_goals simp [Equiv.swap_apply_def]; omega
  · exfalso; apply same 1
    all_goals intro j hj; fin_cases j <;> simp_all
  · refine ⟨(Equiv.swap (1 : Fin 3) 2).trans (Equiv.swap 0 1),?_⟩
    apply plain_permuted_pair_exact_box _ p q r ha hc
    all_goals simp [Equiv.swap_apply_def]; omega
  · refine ⟨(Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 3) 1).trans (Equiv.swap 1 2),?_⟩
    apply plain_permuted_pair_exact_box _ p q r ha hc
    all_goals simp [Equiv.swap_apply_def]; omega
  · refine ⟨Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 3) 2,?_⟩
    apply plain_permuted_pair_exact_box _ p q r ha hc
    all_goals simp [Equiv.swap_apply_def]; omega
  · exfalso; apply same 2
    all_goals intro j hj; fin_cases j <;> simp_all

name: P23.Monomial.plain_seven_border_exact_box
statement:
theorem plain_seven_border_exact_box (R : Finset PlainExp)
    (ha : PlainRootAntichain R) (h3 : R.card=3) (hv : PlainVariablesSurvive R)
    (hc : HasPlainDirectionalCentres R) (h7 : (plainBorderFinset R).card=7) :
    ∃ e : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3), ∃ A B C, 2≤A ∧ 2≤B ∧ 2≤C ∧
      R.image (plainCoordinatePerm e)=plainDominantAxisRoots (A-1) (B-1) (C-1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p,q,r,hpq,hpr,hqr,rfl⟩ := Finset.card_eq_three.mp h3
  rcases plain_three_root_coordinate_patterns p q r hpq hpr hqr ha hv hc with h | h | h
  · have := plain_triangle_pattern_card p q r h; omega
  · have := plain_plane_pattern_card p q r hpq hpr hqr ha h; omega
  · rcases h with h | h | h
    · exact plain_pure_axes_exact_box p q r hqr ha hc ⟨h.1,h.2.1,h.2.2.1⟩ h.2.2.2.1 h.2.2.2.2
    · have he : ({p,q,r} : Finset PlainExp)={q,r,p} := by ext; simp; tauto
      rw [he]
      exact plain_pure_axes_exact_box q r p (Ne.symm hpr) (he ▸ ha) (he ▸ hc)
        ⟨h.1,h.2.1,h.2.2.1⟩ h.2.2.2.1 h.2.2.2.2
    · have he : ({p,q,r} : Finset PlainExp)={r,p,q} := by ext; simp; tauto
      rw [he]
      exact plain_pure_axes_exact_box r p q hpq (he ▸ ha) (he ▸ hc)
        ⟨h.1,h.2.1,h.2.2.1⟩ h.2.2.2.1 h.2.2.2.2

name: P23.Monomial.plainPair_opposite_card_le_two
statement:
theorem plainPair_opposite_card_le_two (p q : PlainExp) :
    (plainPairOppositeDirections p q).card ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  let P := Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin 3 => p i < q i)
  let N := Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin 3 => q i < p i)
  have he : plainPairOppositeDirections p q = P ×ˢ N := by
    ext ij; simp [plainPairOppositeDirections,P,N]
  have hd : Disjoint P N := by
    apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
    intro i hp hn
    simp only [P,N,Finset.mem_filter,Finset.mem_univ,true_and] at hp hn
    omega
  have hu : P.card + N.card ≤ 3 := by
    rw [← Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hd]
    have hh := Finset.card_le_card (Finset.subset_univ (P ∪ N))
    simpa using hh
  rw [he,Finset.card_product]
  have hp : P.card=0 ∨ P.card=1 ∨ P.card=2 ∨ P.card=3 := by omega
  rcases hp with hp | hp | hp | hp <;> rw [hp] <;> simp_all <;> omega

name: P23.Monomial.plainPair_killed_eq_of_border
proof:
:= by
  have hh := (plain_border_iff_minimalKilled {p,q} m).mp hm
  by_contra hn
  exact hk (hh.2 w hw (Ne.symm hn))

name: P23.Monomial.plainPair_border_subset
statement:
theorem plainPair_border_subset (p q : PlainExp) :
    plainBorderFinset {p,q} ⊆
      (Finset.univ.image (plainPairAxisCap p q)) ∪
      ((plainPairOppositeDirections p q).image (plainPairCross p q))
proof:
:= by
  intro m hm
  have hk := ((mem_plainBorderFinset_iff {p,q} m).mp hm).1
  have hnp : ¬plainDivides m p := fun h => hk ⟨p,by simp,h⟩
  have hnq : ¬plainDivides m q := fun h => hk ⟨q,by simp,h⟩
  simp only [plainDivides,not_forall] at hnp hnq
  obtain ⟨i,hi⟩ := hnp
  obtain ⟨j,hj⟩ := hnq
  have hi' : p i < m i := by omega
  have hj' : q j < m j := by omega
  have cap (k : Fin 3) (hk : max (p k) (q k) < m k) :
      m ∈ Finset.univ.image (plainPairAxisCap p q) := by
    have hd : plainDivides (plainPairAxisCap p q k) m := by
      intro l
      by_cases he : k=l
      · subst l; simp [plainPairAxisCap]; omega
      · simp [plainPairAxisCap,Finsupp.single_apply,he]
    have hz : plainPairAxisCap p q k ∉ plainStandardSet {p,q} := by
      rintro ⟨r,hr,hd⟩
      have hh := hd k
      simp only [Finset.mem_insert,Finset.mem_singleton] at hr
      rcases hr with rfl | rfl <;> simp [plainPairAxisCap] at hh <;> omega
    have he := plainPair_killed_eq_of_border hm hd hz
    exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨k,Finset.mem_univ k,he.symm⟩
  by_cases hpi : p i < q i
  · by_cases hqj : q j < p j
    · have hij : i ≠ j := by intro he; subst j; omega
      have hd : plainDivides (plainPairCross p q (i,j)) m := by
        intro l
        by_cases hil : i=l <;> by_cases hjl : j=l <;>
          simp [plainPairCross,Finsupp.single_apply,hil,hjl] <;> subst_vars <;> omega
      have hz : plainPairCross p q (i,j) ∉ plainStandardSet {p,q} := by
        rintro ⟨r,hr,hd⟩
        simp only [Finset.mem_insert,Finset.mem_singleton] at hr
        rcases hr with rfl | rfl
        · have hh := hd i; simp [plainPairCross,Finsupp.single_apply,hij,Ne.symm hij] at hh
        · have hh := hd j; simp [plainPairCross,Finsupp.single_apply,hij,Ne.symm hij] at hh
      have he := plainPair_killed_eq_of_border hm hd hz
      apply Finset.mem_union_right
      exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨(i,j),by simp [plainPairOppositeDirections,hpi,hqj],he.symm⟩
    · apply Finset.mem_union_left
      apply cap j
      simp only [max_lt_iff]; omega
  · apply Finset.mem_union_left
    apply cap i
    simp only [max_lt_iff]; omega

name: P23.Monomial.plain_pair_border_card_le_five
statement:
theorem plain_pair_border_card_le_five (p q : PlainExp) :
    (plainBorderFinset {p,q}).card ≤ 5
proof:
:= by
  have h := Finset.card_le_card (plainPair_border_subset p q)
  have hu := Finset.card_union_le
    (Finset.univ.image (plainPairAxisCap p q))
    ((plainPairOppositeDirections p q).image (plainPairCross p q))
  have ha := Finset.card_image_le (f := plainPairAxisCap p q) (s := Finset.univ)
  have hc := Finset.card_image_le (f := plainPairCross p q)
    (s := plainPairOppositeDirections p q)
  have ho := plainPair_opposite_card_le_two p q
  have hu3 : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 3)).card=3 := by simp
  omega

name: P23.Monomial.plain_type_two_border_card_le_five
statement:
theorem plain_type_two_border_card_le_five (R : Finset PlainExp)
    (_ha : PlainRootAntichain R) (h2 : R.card=2) (_hv : PlainVariablesSurvive R) :
    (plainBorderFinset R).card ≤ 5
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p,q,_,rfl⟩ := Finset.card_eq_two.mp h2
  exact plain_pair_border_card_le_five p q

name: P23.Monomial.plainDivides_refl
statement: theorem plainDivides_refl (p : PlainExp) : plainDivides p p
proof: := fun _ => le_rfl

name: P23.Monomial.plainDivides_trans
statement:
theorem plainDivides_trans {p q r : PlainExp} (h : plainDivides p q)
    (h' : plainDivides q r) : plainDivides p r
proof: := fun j => le_trans (h j) (h' j)

name: P23.Monomial.plainDivides_antisymm
statement:
theorem plainDivides_antisymm {p q : PlainExp} (h : plainDivides p q)
    (h' : plainDivides q p) : p = q
proof:
:= by
  ext j
  exact le_antisymm (h j) (h' j)

name: P23.Monomial.plainStandard_downward
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s,hs,hqs⟩ := hq
  exact ⟨s,hs,plainDivides_trans hpq hqs⟩

name: P23.Monomial.plain_zero_mem_standard
statement:
theorem plain_zero_mem_standard (R : Finset PlainExp) (hR : R.Nonempty) :
    (0 : PlainExp) ∈ plainStandardSet R
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s,hs⟩ := hR
  exact ⟨s,hs,fun j => by simp⟩

name: P23.Monomial.plainStandardSet_finite
statement: theorem plainStandardSet_finite (R : Finset PlainExp) : (plainStandardSet R).Finite
proof:
:= by
  have hf := R.finite_toSet.biUnion (fun s _ => Set.finite_Iic s)
  apply hf.subset
  rintro p ⟨s,hs,hps⟩
  exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨s,Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨hs,hps⟩⟩

name: P23.Monomial.mem_plainStandardFinset
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_plainStandardFinset (R : Finset PlainExp) (p : PlainExp) :
    p ∈ plainStandardFinset R ↔ p ∈ plainStandardSet R
proof: := Set.Finite.mem_toFinset _

name: P23.Monomial.plainUnitVector_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem plainUnitVector_apply (j r : Fin 3) :
    plainUnitVector j r = if j = r then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [plainUnitVector, Finsupp.single_apply]

name: P23.Monomial.plainPredecessor_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem plainPredecessor_apply (j : Fin 3) (p : PlainExp) (r : Fin 3) :
    plainPredecessor j p r = p r - if j = r then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [plainPredecessor, Finsupp.sub_apply]

name: P23.Monomial.plainPredecessor_add_unitVector
statement:
theorem plainPredecessor_add_unitVector (j : Fin 3) (p : PlainExp)
    (hp : 0 < p j) : plainPredecessor j p + plainUnitVector j = p
proof:
:= by
  ext r
  by_cases hr : j = r
  · subst r
    simp only [Finsupp.add_apply, plainPredecessor_apply, plainUnitVector_apply,
      eq_self_iff_true, ite_true]
    omega
  · simp [Finsupp.add_apply, hr]

name: P23.Monomial.plainPredecessor_divides
statement:
theorem plainPredecessor_divides (j : Fin 3) (p : PlainExp) :
    plainDivides (plainPredecessor j p) p
proof:
:= by
  intro r
  simp only [plainPredecessor_apply]
  exact Nat.sub_le _ _

name: P23.Monomial.plainPredecessor_ne
statement:
theorem plainPredecessor_ne (j : Fin 3) (p : PlainExp) (hp : 0 < p j) :
    plainPredecessor j p ≠ p
proof:
:= by
  intro he
  have hc := congrArg (fun q : PlainExp => q j) he
  simp only [plainPredecessor_apply, eq_self_iff_true, ite_true] at hc
  omega

name: P23.Monomial.plain_direction_active
statement:
theorem plain_direction_active (R : Finset PlainExp) (h : PlainVariablesSurvive R)
    (j : Fin 3) : ∃ s ∈ R, 0 < s j
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s,hs,hjs⟩ := h j
  refine ⟨s,hs,?_⟩
  have h1 : 1 ≤ s j := by simpa using hjs j
  omega

name: P23.Monomial.plainBorderCriterion_iff_minimalKilled
statement:
theorem plainBorderCriterion_iff_minimalKilled (R : Finset PlainExp) (p : PlainExp) :
    plainBorderCriterion R p ↔ plainMinimalKilled R p
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hp,hpred⟩
    refine ⟨hp,?_⟩
    intro q hqp hne
    have hex : ∃ j : Fin 3, q j < p j := by
      by_contra hn
      push_neg at hn
      apply hne
      ext j
      exact le_antisymm (hqp j) (hn j)
    obtain ⟨j,hj⟩ := hex
    have hpj : 0 < p j := by omega
    apply plainStandard_downward R (hpred j hpj)
    intro r
    by_cases hr : j = r
    · subst r
      simp only [plainPredecessor_apply, eq_self_iff_true, ite_true]
      omega
    · simpa [hr] using hqp r
  · rintro ⟨hp,hmin⟩
    exact ⟨hp,fun j hj => hmin _ (plainPredecessor_divides j p)
      (plainPredecessor_ne j p hj)⟩

name: P23.Monomial.mem_plainBorderFinset_iff
statement:
theorem mem_plainBorderFinset_iff (R : Finset PlainExp) (p : PlainExp) :
    p ∈ plainBorderFinset R ↔ p ∉ plainStandardSet R ∧
      ∀ j : Fin 3, 0 < p j → plainPredecessor j p ∈ plainStandardSet R
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change p ∈ (borderCandidates R).filter (plainBorderCriterion R) ↔ plainBorderCriterion R p
  rw [Finset.mem_filter]
  constructor
  · exact And.right
  · intro hp
    refine ⟨?_,hp⟩
    by_cases hzero : p = 0
    · simp [borderCandidates, hzero]
    · have hex : ∃ j : Fin 3, 0 < p j := by
        by_contra hn
        push_neg at hn
        apply hzero
        ext j
        simpa using hn j
      obtain ⟨j,hj⟩ := hex
      apply Finset.mem_insert_of_mem
      apply Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr
      refine ⟨plainPredecessor j p, (mem_plainStandardFinset _ _).mpr (hp.2 j hj), ?_⟩
      exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨j,Finset.mem_univ _,plainPredecessor_add_unitVector j p hj⟩

name: P23.Monomial.plain_border_iff_minimalKilled
statement:
theorem plain_border_iff_minimalKilled (R : Finset PlainExp) (p : PlainExp) :
    p ∈ plainBorderFinset R ↔ plainMinimalKilled R p
proof:
:=
  (mem_plainBorderFinset_iff R p).trans (plainBorderCriterion_iff_minimalKilled R p)

name: P23.Monomial.plain_centre_other_root_coordinates
statement:
theorem plain_centre_other_root_coordinates (R : Finset PlainExp)
    (hR : PlainRootAntichain R) {j : Fin 3} {c s : PlainExp}
    (hc : PlainDirectionalCentre R j c) (hs : s ∈ R) (hne : s ≠ c)
    (hpos : 0 < s j) : s j = c j + 1 ∧ ∀ r, r ≠ j → s r ≤ c r
proof:
:= by
  have hpred := hc.2 s hs hpos
  have hother : ∀ r, r ≠ j → s r ≤ c r := by
    intro r hr
    simpa [Ne.symm hr] using hpred r
  have hnot : ¬s j ≤ c j := by
    intro hj
    apply hne
    apply hR s hs c hc.1
    intro r
    by_cases hr : r = j
    · simpa [hr] using hj
    · exact hother r hr
  have hj := hpred j
  simp only [plainPredecessor_apply, eq_self_iff_true, ite_true] at hj
  exact ⟨by omega,hother⟩

name: P23.Monomial.plainCoordinatePerm_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem plainCoordinatePerm_apply (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) (p : PlainExp) (j : Fin 3) :
    plainCoordinatePerm e p j = p (e j)
proof: := by simp [plainCoordinatePerm]

name: P23.Monomial.plainDivides_coordinatePerm_iff
statement:
theorem plainDivides_coordinatePerm_iff (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) (p q : PlainExp) :
    plainDivides (plainCoordinatePerm e p) (plainCoordinatePerm e q) ↔ plainDivides p q
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h j; simpa using h (e.symm j)
  · intro h j; simpa using h (e j)

name: P23.Monomial.plainStandard_coordinatePerm_iff
statement:
theorem plainStandard_coordinatePerm_iff (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) (R : Finset PlainExp) (p : PlainExp) :
    plainCoordinatePerm e p ∈ plainStandardSet (R.image (plainCoordinatePerm e)) ↔
      p ∈ plainStandardSet R
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨s,hs,hps⟩
    obtain ⟨t,ht,rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hs
    exact ⟨t,ht,(plainDivides_coordinatePerm_iff e p t).mp hps⟩
  · rintro ⟨s,hs,hps⟩
    exact ⟨plainCoordinatePerm e s,Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨s,hs,rfl⟩,
      (plainDivides_coordinatePerm_iff e p s).mpr hps⟩

name: P23.Monomial.plainBorder_coordinatePerm_iff
statement:
theorem plainBorder_coordinatePerm_iff (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) (R : Finset PlainExp) (p : PlainExp) :
    plainCoordinatePerm e p ∈ plainBorderFinset (R.image (plainCoordinatePerm e)) ↔
      p ∈ plainBorderFinset R
proof:
:= by
  rw [plain_border_iff_minimalKilled,plain_border_iff_minimalKilled]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hn,hm⟩
    refine ⟨fun hp => hn ((plainStandard_coordinatePerm_iff e R p).mpr hp),?_⟩
    intro q hqp hne
    apply (plainStandard_coordinatePerm_iff e R q).mp
    exact hm _ ((plainDivides_coordinatePerm_iff e q p).mpr hqp)
      (fun h => hne ((plainCoordinatePerm e).injective h))
  · rintro ⟨hn,hm⟩
    refine ⟨fun hp => hn ((plainStandard_coordinatePerm_iff e R p).mp hp),?_⟩
    intro q hqp hne
    let t := (plainCoordinatePerm e).symm q
    have ht : plainCoordinatePerm e t=q := (plainCoordinatePerm e).apply_symm_apply q
    have htp : plainDivides t p := (plainDivides_coordinatePerm_iff e t p).mp (ht.symm ▸ hqp)
    have htn : t≠p := by intro h; exact hne (by simpa [h] using ht.symm)
    have hs := (plainStandard_coordinatePerm_iff e R t).mpr (hm t htp htn)
    simpa [ht] using hs

name: P23.Monomial.plainBorder_card_permutation
statement:
theorem plainBorder_card_permutation (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) (R : Finset PlainExp) :
    (plainBorderFinset (R.image (plainCoordinatePerm e))).card = (plainBorderFinset R).card
proof:
:= by
  have he : plainBorderFinset (R.image (plainCoordinatePerm e)) =
      (plainBorderFinset R).image (plainCoordinatePerm e) := by
    ext p
    constructor
    · intro hp
      let q := (plainCoordinatePerm e).symm p
      have hq := (plainBorder_coordinatePerm_iff e R q).mp
        (by simpa [q] using hp)
      exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨q,hq,(plainCoordinatePerm e).apply_symm_apply p⟩
    · rintro hp
      obtain ⟨q,hq,rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hp
      exact (plainBorder_coordinatePerm_iff e R q).mpr hq
  rw [he,Finset.card_image_of_injective _ (plainCoordinatePerm e).injective]

name: P23.Monomial.plainAntichain_coordinatePerm
statement:
theorem plainAntichain_coordinatePerm (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3))
    (R : Finset PlainExp) (ha : PlainRootAntichain R) :
    PlainRootAntichain (R.image (plainCoordinatePerm e))
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp q hq hd
  obtain ⟨s,hs,rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hp
  obtain ⟨t,ht,rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hq
  exact congrArg (plainCoordinatePerm e)
    (ha s hs t ht ((plainDivides_coordinatePerm_iff e s t).mp hd))

name: P23.Monomial.plainCentres_coordinatePerm
statement:
theorem plainCentres_coordinatePerm (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3))
    (R : Finset PlainExp) (hc : HasPlainDirectionalCentres R) :
    HasPlainDirectionalCentres (R.image (plainCoordinatePerm e))
proof:
:= by
  intro j
  obtain ⟨c,hc⟩ := hc (e j)
  refine ⟨plainCoordinatePerm e c,Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨c,hc.1,rfl⟩,?_⟩
  intro s hs hp
  obtain ⟨t,ht,rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hs
  have hb := hc.2 t ht (by simpa using hp)
  intro r
  have hr := hb (e r)
  by_cases h : r = j
  · subst r
    simpa [plainPredecessor_apply] using hr
  · have he : e r ≠ e j := fun he => h (e.injective he)
    simpa [plainPredecessor_apply,h,Ne.symm h,he,Ne.symm he] using hr

name: P23.Monomial.plainCentre_coordinatePerm
statement:
theorem plainCentre_coordinatePerm (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3))
    (R : Finset PlainExp) (j : Fin 3) (c : PlainExp)
    (hc : PlainDirectionalCentre R (e j) c) :
    PlainDirectionalCentre (R.image (plainCoordinatePerm e)) j (plainCoordinatePerm e c)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨c,hc.1,rfl⟩,?_⟩
  intro s hs hp
  obtain ⟨t,ht,rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hs
  have hb := hc.2 t ht (by simpa using hp)
  intro r
  have hr := hb (e r)
  by_cases h : r=j
  · subst r; simpa [plainPredecessor_apply] using hr
  · have he : e r ≠ e j := fun he => h (e.injective he)
    simpa [plainPredecessor_apply,h,Ne.symm h,he,Ne.symm he] using hr

name: P23.Monomial.plainVariables_coordinatePerm
statement:
theorem plainVariables_coordinatePerm (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3))
    (R : Finset PlainExp) (hv : PlainVariablesSurvive R) :
    PlainVariablesSurvive (R.image (plainCoordinatePerm e))
proof:
:= by
  intro j
  obtain ⟨s,hs,hjs⟩ := plain_direction_active R hv (e j)
  refine ⟨plainCoordinatePerm e s,Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨s,hs,rfl⟩,?_⟩
  intro r
  by_cases h : r=j
  · subst r; simp only [plainUnitVector_apply,ite_true,plainCoordinatePerm_apply]; omega
  · simp [plainUnitVector_apply,h,Ne.symm h]

name: P23.Monomial.plain_rootSource_isDirectionalCentre
statement:
theorem plain_rootSource_isDirectionalCentre (R : Finset PlainExp) (j : Fin 3)
    (hj : plainUnitVector j ∈ plainStandardFinset R)
    (F : PlainOmega k R →ₗ[PlainMonomialArtin k R] PlainMonomialArtin k R)
    (s : PlainExp) (hs : s ∈ R)
    (hc : plainCoeffAt R ⟨plainUnitVector j,hj⟩ (F (PU R (plainRootIndex R s hs))) ≠ 0) :
    PlainDirectionalCentre R j s
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hs,?_⟩
  intro r hr hpos
  let q := plainPredecessor j r
  have hqstd : q ∈ plainStandardFinset R := (mem_plainStandardFinset R q).mpr
    ⟨r,hr,plainPredecessor_divides j r⟩
  let qi : PlainMonomialIndex R := ⟨q,hqstd⟩
  let ei : PlainMonomialIndex R := ⟨plainUnitVector j,hj⟩
  let ri := plainRootIndex R r hr
  have hsum : qi.1+ei.1=ri.1 := plainPredecessor_add_unitVector j r hpos
  by_contra hnot
  have hann : PX R qi.1 qi.2 • PU R (plainRootIndex R s hs) = (0 : PlainOmega k R) :=
    (PX_smul_plainRootDual_eq_zero_iff R s hs qi).mpr hnot
  have hz : PX R qi.1 qi.2 * F (PU R (plainRootIndex R s hs)) = 0 := by
    have := F.map_smul (PX R qi.1 qi.2) (PU R (plainRootIndex R s hs))
    rw [hann,map_zero] at this
    exact this.symm
  have hcoeff := congrArg (plainCoeffAt (k := k) R ri) hz
  rw [plainCoeffAt_PX_mul R qi ei ri hsum] at hcoeff
  exact hc (by simpa [ei] using hcoeff)

name: P23.Monomial.plain_hasDirectionalCentres_of_variablesInTrace
statement:
theorem plain_hasDirectionalCentres_of_variablesInTrace (R : Finset PlainExp)
    (hR : R.Nonempty) (hcard : 2 ≤ R.card) (ha : PlainRootAntichain R)
    (hv : PlainVariablesSurvive R) (ht : PlainVariablesInTrace k R hv) :
    HasPlainDirectionalCentres R
proof:
:= by
  intro j
  let hj := (mem_plainStandardFinset R _).mpr (hv j)
  obtain ⟨F,s,hs,hc⟩ := plain_exists_root_image_with_variable_coeff_of_mem_trace
    R hR hcard ha j hj (ht j)
  exact ⟨s,plain_rootSource_isDirectionalCentre R j hj F s hs hc⟩

name: P23.Monomial.plain_PX_mem_augmentation
statement:
theorem plain_PX_mem_augmentation (R : Finset PlainExp) (hR : R.Nonempty)
    (p : PlainExp) (hp : p ∈ plainStandardFinset R) (hn : p ≠ 0) :
    PX (k := k) R p hp ∈ plainAugmentationIdeal R hR
proof:
:= by
  change plainConstantCoeff R hR (PX (k := k) R p hp)=0
  simp [plainConstantCoeff,plainUnitIndex,Ne.symm hn]

name: P23.Monomial.plain_nonvariable_mem_square
statement:
theorem plain_nonvariable_mem_square (R : Finset PlainExp) (hR : R.Nonempty)
    (p : PlainExp) (hp : p ∈ plainStandardFinset R) (hn : p≠0)
    (hv : ∀ j, p≠plainUnitVector j) :
    PX (k := k) R p hp ∈ (plainAugmentationIdeal R hR)^2
proof:
:= by
  have hex : ∃ j, 0 < p j := by
    by_contra h
    push Not at h
    apply hn
    ext j
    exact Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero (h j)
  obtain ⟨j,hj⟩ := hex
  let q := plainPredecessor j p
  have hsum : q+plainUnitVector j=p := plainPredecessor_add_unitVector j p hj
  have hq : q ∈ plainStandardFinset R :=
    mem_plainStandardFinset_of_add_mem_left R (hsum ▸ hp)
  have he : plainUnitVector j ∈ plainStandardFinset R :=
    mem_plainStandardFinset_of_add_mem_right R (hsum ▸ hp)
  have hqn : q≠0 := by intro h; exact hv j (by simpa [h] using hsum.symm)
  have hen : plainUnitVector j≠(0 : PlainExp) := by
    intro h; have := congrArg (fun p : PlainExp => p j) h; simpa using this
  have hm := Ideal.mul_mem_mul (plain_PX_mem_augmentation (k := k) R hR q hq hqn)
    (plain_PX_mem_augmentation (k := k) R hR _ he hen)
  simpa [pow_two,PX_mul_PX,hsum,hp] using hm

name: P23.Monomial.plain_variable_coeff_mul_zero
statement:
theorem plain_variable_coeff_mul_zero (R : Finset PlainExp) (hR : R.Nonempty)
    (j : PlainVariableIndex R) (u v : plainAugmentationIdeal (k := k) R hR) :
    plainCoeffAt (k := k) R ⟨plainUnitVector j.1,j.2⟩ (u.val*v.val)=0
proof:
:= by
  let ei : PlainMonomialIndex R := ⟨plainUnitVector j.1,j.2⟩
  have hu : plainConstantCoeff R hR u.val=0 := u.2
  have hv : plainConstantCoeff R hR v.val=0 := v.2
  rw [basis_expansion (u : PlainMonomialArtin k R)]
  rw [Finsupp.sum_mul,map_finsuppSum]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro p _
  change plainCoeffAt (k := k) R ei ((u.val.coeff p • PX R p.1 p.2)*v.val)=0
  rw [smul_mul_assoc',map_smul]
  by_cases hp0 : p.1=0
  · have hc : u.val.coeff p=0 := by
      have he : p=plainUnitIndex R hR := Subtype.ext hp0
      simpa [plainConstantCoeff,he] using hu
    simp [hc]
  · have hz : plainCoeffAt R ei (PX R p.1 p.2*v.val)=0 := by
      by_cases hpe : p.1=plainUnitVector j.1
      · have he : p=ei := Subtype.ext hpe
        rw [plainCoeffAt_PX_mul R p (plainUnitIndex R hR) ei (by simp [ei,hpe,plainUnitIndex])]
        exact hv
      · induction v.val using induction_linear with
        | zero => simp
        | add v w hv hw => rw [mul_add,map_add,hv,hw,add_zero]
        | single q r =>
          rw [←smul_PX r R q.1 q.2,mul_smul_comm',map_smul,PX_mul_PX]
          have hn : p.1+q.1≠plainUnitVector j.1 := by
            intro h
            rcases plain_variable_is_atom j.1 p.1 q.1 h with hp | hq
            · exact hp0 hp
            · exact hpe (by simpa [hq] using h)
          by_cases hs : p.1+q.1∈plainStandardFinset R <;>
            simp [hs,plainCoeffAt_apply,ei,Ne.symm hn]
    simp [hz]

name: P23.Monomial.plainCotangentCoeff_variable
statement:
@[simp] theorem plainCotangentCoeff_variable (R : Finset PlainExp) (hR : R.Nonempty)
    (j l : PlainVariableIndex R) :
    plainCotangentCoeff (k := k) R hR j (plainCotangentVariable R hR l) =
      if l=j then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  change plainCoeffAt (k := k) R ⟨plainUnitVector j.1,j.2⟩
    (PX R (plainUnitVector l.1) l.2) = _
  rw [plainCoeffAt_apply,coeff_PX]
  have he : plainUnitVector j.1=plainUnitVector l.1 ↔ j=l := by
    constructor
    · intro h
      apply Subtype.ext
      by_contra hn
      have hc := congrArg (fun p : PlainExp => p j.1) h
      simp [plainUnitVector,Finsupp.single_apply,Ne.symm hn] at hc
    · rintro rfl; rfl
  simp [he,eq_comm]

name: P23.Monomial.plainCotangentVariables_independent
statement:
theorem plainCotangentVariables_independent (R : Finset PlainExp) (hR : R.Nonempty) :
    LinearIndependent k (plainCotangentVariable (k := k) R hR)
proof:
:= by
  apply linearIndependent_iff'.mpr
  intro s c hz j hj
  have hc := congrArg (plainCotangentCoeff (k := k) R hR j) hz
  simpa [map_sum,hj] using hc

name: P23.Monomial.plainCotangentVariables_span
statement:
theorem plainCotangentVariables_span (R : Finset PlainExp) (hR : R.Nonempty) :
    Submodule.span k (Set.range (plainCotangentVariable (k := k) R hR)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  apply top_unique
  intro x _
  let I := plainAugmentationIdeal (k := k) R hR
  obtain ⟨v,rfl⟩ := I.toCotangent_surjective x
  let B : PlainMonomialIndex R → I := fun p => if hn : p.1=0 then 0 else
    ⟨PX R p.1 p.2,plain_PX_mem_augmentation R hR p.1 p.2 hn⟩
  have hex : v=v.val.coeff.sum (fun p c => c • B p) := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change v.val = (I.subtype.restrictScalars k) (v.val.coeff.sum (fun p c => c • B p))
    rw [map_finsuppSum]
    simp only [map_smul,Submodule.subtype_apply]
    conv_lhs => rw [basis_expansion v.val]
    apply Finsupp.sum_congr
    intro p _
    by_cases hp : p.1=0
    · have he : p=plainUnitIndex R hR := Subtype.ext hp
      have hc : v.val.coeff p=0 := by
        have hv : plainConstantCoeff R hR v.val=0 := v.2
        simpa [he,plainConstantCoeff] using hv
      simp [hc,B,hp]
    · simp [B,hp]
  rw [hex,map_finsuppSum]
  apply Submodule.sum_mem
  intro p _
  change (I.toCotangent.restrictScalars k) (v.val.coeff p • B p) ∈ _
  rw [map_smul]
  apply Submodule.smul_mem
  change I.toCotangent (B p) ∈ _
  by_cases hp : p.1=0
  · simp [B,hp]
  · by_cases he : ∃ j, p.1=plainUnitVector j
    · obtain ⟨j,hj⟩ := he
      let ji : PlainVariableIndex R := ⟨j,hj ▸ p.2⟩
      have hb : I.toCotangent (B p) = plainCotangentVariable R hR ji := by
        change I.toCotangent (B p) = I.toCotangent _
        apply congrArg I.toCotangent
        apply Subtype.ext
        simp only [B,dite_eq_right hp]
        change PX R p.1 p.2 = PX R (plainUnitVector j) ji.2
        apply PlainMonomialArtin.ext
        ext q
        simp only [coeff_PX,hj]
      rw [hb]
      exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨ji,rfl⟩
    · have hv : ∀ j, p.1≠plainUnitVector j := fun j h => he ⟨j,h⟩
      have hz : I.toCotangent (B p)=0 := by
        apply (I.toCotangent_eq_zero (B p)).mpr
        simpa [B,hp,I] using plain_nonvariable_mem_square (k := k) R hR p.1 p.2 hp hv
      rw [hz]
      exact Submodule.zero_mem _

name: P23.Monomial.plain_embeddingDimension_eq_three_iff_variablesSurvive
statement:
theorem plain_embeddingDimension_eq_three_iff_variablesSurvive (R : Finset PlainExp)

proof:

      (Finset.univ.filter (fun j : Fin 3 => plainUnitVector j ∈ plainStandardFinset R)).card :=

  rw [hcard]

proof:

    · exact h2

    have ho'' : p 1 < q 1 := by omega

    have he' : ({q,p,t} : Finset PlainExp) = plainPlaneAxisRoots (q 0) (p 0) (p 1) (q 1) (t 2) :=
      plain_three_finset_congr hq hp ht

proof:

  · apply plain_dominant_permuted_card (Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 3) 2) p q r ha hc

:= by
  obtain ⟨s,hs,hpos⟩ := plain_direction_active R hv j
  have hsj := Finset.le_sup (f := fun p : PlainExp => p j) hs
  have hR : R.Nonempty := ⟨s,hs⟩
  obtain ⟨t,ht,hmax⟩ := R.exists_max_image (fun p : PlainExp => p j) hR
  have hsup : R.sup (fun p => p j) = t j := le_antisymm
    (Finset.sup_le fun p hp => hmax p hp) (Finset.le_sup (f := fun p : PlainExp => p j) ht)
  refine ⟨by unfold plainAxisBound; omega, (mem_plainBorderFinset_iff _ _).mpr ⟨?_,?_⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨p,hp,hdiv⟩
    have hi := hdiv j
    have hpj := Finset.le_sup (f := fun p : PlainExp => p j) hp
    simp only [Finsupp.single_eq_same] at hi
    unfold plainAxisBound at hi
    omega
  · intro r hr
    have hrj : r = j := by
      by_contra hn
      simpa [Finsupp.single_apply,hn] using hr
    subst r
    refine ⟨t,ht,?_⟩
    intro r
    by_cases he : j = r
    · subst r
      simp [plainPredecessor_apply,plainAxisBound,hsup]
    · simp [plainPredecessor_apply,Finsupp.single_apply,he]

name: P23.Monomial.exists_plain_pure_axis_border
statement:
theorem exists_plain_pure_axis_border (k : Type*) [Field k] (G : Finset PlainExp)
    (hf : (plainSurvivors k G).Finite)
    (hv : PlainVariablesSurvive (plainSurvivorRoots k G hf)) (j : Fin 3) :
    ∃ A : ℕ, 2 ≤ A ∧ Finsupp.single j A ∈
      plainBorderFinset (plainSurvivorRoots k G hf)
proof:
:=
  ⟨_,plain_axis_bound_border _ hv j⟩

name: P23.Monomial.plain_axis_border_injective
statement:
theorem plain_axis_border_injective (R : Finset PlainExp) (hv : PlainVariablesSurvive R) :
    Function.Injective (fun j : Fin 3 => Finsupp.single j (plainAxisBound R j))
proof:
:= by
  intro j r he
  by_contra hn
  have hc := congrArg (fun p : PlainExp => p j) he
  have hp := (plain_axis_bound_border R hv j).1
  simp [Finsupp.single_apply,Ne.symm hn] at hc
  omega

name: P23.Monomial.plain_border_card_ge_three_of_variables_survive
statement:
theorem plain_border_card_ge_three_of_variables_survive (R : Finset PlainExp)
    (hv : PlainVariablesSurvive R) : 3 ≤ (plainBorderFinset R).card
proof:
:= by
  let f : Fin 3 → ↥(plainBorderFinset R) := fun j =>
    ⟨_,(plain_axis_bound_border R hv j).2⟩
  have hi : Function.Injective f := fun j r he =>
    plain_axis_border_injective R hv (congrArg Subtype.val he)
  simpa using Fintype.card_le_of_injective f hi

name: P23.Monomial.plain_small_border_eq_axis_triple
statement:
theorem plain_small_border_eq_axis_triple (R : Finset PlainExp)
    (hv : PlainVariablesSurvive R) (hc : (plainBorderFinset R).card ≤ 3) :
    plainBorderFinset R = Finset.univ.image
      (fun j : Fin 3 => Finsupp.single j (plainAxisBound R j))
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le
  · intro p hp
    
    have hsub : Finset.univ.image (fun j : Fin 3 => Finsupp.single j (plainAxisBound R j))
        ⊆ plainBorderFinset R := by
      rintro q hq
      obtain ⟨j,_,rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hq
      exact (plain_axis_bound_border R hv j).2
    have he := Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le hsub (by
      rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ (plain_axis_border_injective R hv)]
      simpa using hc)
    exact he.symm ▸ hp
  · rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ (plain_axis_border_injective R hv)]
    simpa using plain_border_card_ge_three_of_variables_survive R hv

name: P23.Monomial.plain_small_minimal_presentation_standard_box
statement:
theorem plain_small_minimal_presentation_standard_box (k : Type*) [Field k]
    (G : Finset PlainExp) (hf : (plainSurvivors k G).Finite)
    (hv : PlainVariablesSurvive (plainSurvivorRoots k G hf))
    (he : G = plainBorderFinset (plainSurvivorRoots k G hf)) (hc : G.card ≤ 3)
    (p : PlainExp) : p ∈ plainSurvivors k G ↔
      ∀ j, p j < plainAxisBound (plainSurvivorRoots k G hf) j
proof:
:= by
  have ht := plain_small_border_eq_axis_triple _ hv (he ▸ hc)
  have hg := he.trans ht
  change (MvPolynomial.monomial p (1 : k) ∉ plainMonomialIdeal k G) ↔ _
  rw [monomial_mem_plainMonomialIdeal_iff]
  constructor
  · intro hn j
    by_contra hj
    apply hn
    refine ⟨_,hg.symm ▸ Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨j,Finset.mem_univ _,rfl⟩,?_⟩
    intro r
    by_cases h : j = r
    · subst r; simp only [Finsupp.single_eq_same]; omega
    · simp [Finsupp.single_apply,h]
  · intro hs ⟨g,hgmem,hdiv⟩
    have him : g ∈ Finset.univ.image (fun j : Fin 3 =>
        Finsupp.single j (plainAxisBound (plainSurvivorRoots k G hf) j)) := by
      rw [← hg]
      exact hgmem
    obtain ⟨j,_,rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp him
    have h := hdiv j
    simp only [Finsupp.single_eq_same] at h
    have := hs j
    omega

name: P23.Monomial.plain_small_minimal_presentation_root_card_one
statement:
theorem plain_small_minimal_presentation_root_card_one (k : Type*) [Field k]
    (G : Finset PlainExp) (hf : (plainSurvivors k G).Finite)
    (hv : PlainVariablesSurvive (plainSurvivorRoots k G hf))
    (he : G = plainBorderFinset (plainSurvivorRoots k G hf)) (hc : G.card ≤ 3) :
    (plainSurvivorRoots k G hf).card = 1
proof:
:= by
  let R := plainSurvivorRoots k G hf
  let top : PlainExp := plainExp (plainAxisBound R 0 - 1)
    (plainAxisBound R 1 - 1) (plainAxisBound R 2 - 1)
  have htop (j : Fin 3) : top j = plainAxisBound R j - 1 := by
    fin_cases j <;> simp [top]
  have hpos (j : Fin 3) : 2 ≤ plainAxisBound R j := (plain_axis_bound_border R hv j).1
  have ht : top ∈ plainSurvivors k G :=
    (plain_small_minimal_presentation_standard_box k G hf hv he hc top).mpr
      (fun j => by change top j < plainAxisBound R j; rw [htop]; have := hpos j; omega)
  have hd (p : PlainExp) (hp : p ∈ plainSurvivors k G) : plainDivides p top := by
    intro j
    have hlt : p j < plainAxisBound R j :=
      (plain_small_minimal_presentation_standard_box k G hf hv he hc p).mp hp j
    rw [htop]
    omega
  have htR : top ∈ R := by
    apply Finset.mem_filter.mpr
    refine ⟨hf.mem_toFinset.mpr ht,?_⟩
    intro q hq htopq
    exact plainDivides_antisymm htopq (hd q (hf.mem_toFinset.mp hq))
  have hR : R = {top} := by
    apply Finset.ext
    intro p
    constructor
    · intro hp
      have hps : p ∈ plainSurvivors k G := hf.mem_toFinset.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).1
      exact Finset.mem_singleton.mpr ((Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).2 top
        (hf.mem_toFinset.mpr ht) (hd p hps))
    · intro hp
      exact (Finset.mem_singleton.mp hp).symm ▸ htR
  change R.card = 1
  rw [hR]
  simp

name: P23.Monomial.plain_two_same_centres_plane
statement:
private theorem plain_two_same_centres_plane (p q r : PlainExp)
    (hpq : p≠q) (hpr : p≠r) (hqr : q≠r)
    (ha : PlainRootAntichain {p,q,r}) (hv : PlainVariablesSurvive {p,q,r})

    (hc1 : PlainDirectionalCentre {p,q,r} 1 p)
    (hc2 : PlainDirectionalCentre {p,q,r} 2 q) :
    plainPlaneSplitPattern p q r
proof: := by have hp : p∈({p,q,r} : Finset PlainExp) := by simp have hq : q∈({p,q,r} : Finset PlainExp) := by simp have hr : r∈({p,q,r} : Finset PlainExp) := by simp have hnpq : ¬(p 0 ≤ q 0 ∧ p 1 ≤ q 1 ∧ p 2 ≤ q 2) := by rintro ⟨h0,h1,h2⟩ have h : plainDivides p q := by intro j fin_cases j · exact h0 · exact h1 · exact h2 exact hpq (ha p hp q hq h) have hnpr : ¬(p 0 ≤ r 0 ∧ p 1 ≤ r 1 ∧ p 2 ≤ r 2) := by rintro ⟨h0,h1,h2⟩ have h : plainDivides p r := by intro j fin_cases j · exact h0 · exact h1 · exact h2 exact hpr (ha p hp r hr h) have hnqp : ¬(q 0 ≤ p 0 ∧ q 1 ≤ p 1 ∧ q 2 ≤ p 2) := by rintro ⟨h0,h1,h2⟩ have h : plainDivides q p := by intro j fin_cases j · exact h0 · exact h1 · exact h2 exact hpq (ha q hq p hp h).symm have hnqr : ¬(q 0 ≤ r 0 ∧ q 1 ≤ r 1 ∧ q 2 ≤ r 2) := by rintro ⟨h0,h1,h2⟩ have h : plainDivides q r := by intro j fin_cases j · exact h0 · exact h1 · exact h2 exact hqr (ha q hq r hr h) have hnrp : ¬(r 0 ≤ p 0 ∧ r 1 ≤ p 1 ∧ r 2 ≤ p 2) := by rintro ⟨h0,h1,h2⟩ have h : plainDivides r p := by intro j fin_cases j · exact h0 · exact h1 · exact h2 exact hpr (ha r hr p hp h).symm have hnrq : ¬(r 0 ≤ q 0 ∧ r 1 ≤ q 1 ∧ r 2 ≤ q 2) := by rintro ⟨h0,h1,h2⟩ have h : plainDivides r q := by intro j fin_cases j · exact h0 · exact h1 · exact h2 exact hqr (ha r hr q hq h).symm have active (j : Fin 3) : 0

name: P23.Monomial.plain_distinct_centres_pattern

name: P23.Monomial.plain_centre_assignment_1
statement:
private theorem plain_centre_assignment_1 (p q r : PlainExp)
    (hpq : p≠q) (hpr : p≠r) (hqr : q≠r)
    (ha : PlainRootAntichain {p,q,r}) (hv : PlainVariablesSurvive {p,q,r})
    (hc0 : PlainDirectionalCentre {p,q,r} 0 p)
    (hc1 : PlainDirectionalCentre {p,q,r} 1 p)
    (hc2 : PlainDirectionalCentre {p,q,r} 2 q) :
    plainTrianglePattern p q r ∨ plainPlaneSplitPattern p q r ∨ plainDominantAxisPattern p q r
proof:
:= by
    let e := Equiv.swap (2 : Fin 3) 2
    have hi : ({p,q,r} : Finset PlainExp).image (plainCoordinatePerm e) =
        {plainCoordinatePerm e p,plainCoordinatePerm e q,plainCoordinatePerm e r} := by
      simp only [Finset.image_insert,Finset.image_singleton] <;>
        (ext s; simp only [Finset.mem_insert,Finset.mem_singleton] <;> tauto)
    have h := plain_two_same_centres_plane (plainCoordinatePerm e p)
      (plainCoordinatePerm e q) (plainCoordinatePerm e r)
      (fun h => hpq ((plainCoordinatePerm e).injective h))
      (fun h => hpr ((plainCoordinatePerm e).injective h))
      (fun h => hqr ((plainCoordinatePerm e).injective h))
      (by simpa only [hi] using plainAntichain_coordinatePerm e {p,q,r} ha)
      (by simpa only [hi] using plainVariables_coordinatePerm e {p,q,r} hv)
      (by simpa only [hi] using (plainCentre_coordinatePerm e {p,q,r} 0 p
        (by simpa [e,Equiv.swap_apply_def] using hc0)))
      (by simpa only [hi] using (plainCentre_coordinatePerm e {p,q,r} 1 p
        (by simpa [e,Equiv.swap_apply_def] using hc1)))
      (by simpa only [hi] using (plainCentre_coordinatePerm e {p,q,r} 2 q
        (by simpa [e,Equiv.swap_apply_def] using hc2)))
    right; left
    simp only [plainPlaneSplitPattern,plainCoordinatePerm_apply] at h
    norm_num [e,Equiv.swap_apply_def] at h
    rcases h with h | h | h | h | h | h | h | h | h
    · exact Or.inl (⟨h.1,h.2.1,h.2.2.1,h.2.2.2.1,h.2.2.2.2⟩)
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (⟨h.1,h.2.1,h.2.2.1,h.2.2.2.1,h.2.2.2.2⟩))
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl (⟨h.1,h.2.1,h.2.2.1,h.2.2.2.1,h.2.2.2.2⟩)))
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl (⟨h.1,h.2.1,h.2.2.1,h.2.2.2.1,h.2.2.2.2⟩))))
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl (⟨h.1,h.2.1,h.2.2.1,h.2.2.2.1,h.2.2.2.2⟩)))))
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl (⟨h.1,h.2.1,h.2.2.1,h.2.2.2.1,h.2.2.2.2⟩))))))
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl (⟨h.1,h.2.1,h.2.2.1,h.2.2.2.1,h.2.2.2.2⟩)))))))
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl (⟨h.1,h.2.1,h.2.2.1,h.2.2.2.1,h.2.2.2.2⟩))))))))
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (⟨h.1,h.2.1,h.2.2.1,h.2.2.2.1,h.2.2.2.2⟩))))))))

name: P23.Monomial.plain_centre_assignment_2
statement:
private theorem plain_centre_assignment_2 (p q r : PlainExp)
    (hpq : p≠q) (hpr : p≠r) (hqr : q≠r)
    (ha : PlainRootAntichain {p,q,r}) (hv : PlainVariablesSurvive {p,q,r})
    (hc0 : PlainDirectionalCentre {p,q,r} 0 p)
    (hc1 : PlainDirectionalCentre {p,q,r} 1 p)

    plainTrianglePattern p q r ∨ plainPlaneSplitPattern p q r ∨ plainDominantAxisPattern p q r
proof:
:= by

        {plainCoordinatePerm e p,plainCoordinatePerm e r,plainCoordinatePerm e q} := by
      simp only [Finset.image_insert,Finset.image_singleton] <;>
        (ext s; simp only [Finset.mem_insert,Finset.mem_singleton] <;> tauto)
    have h := plain_two_same_centres_plane (plainCoordinatePerm e p)
      (plainCoordinatePerm e r) (plainCoordinatePerm e q)
      (fun h => hpr ((plainCoordinatePerm e).injective h))
      (fun h => hpq ((plainCoordinatePerm e).injective h))
      (fun h => (Ne.symm hqr) ((plainCoordinatePerm e).injective h))
      (by simpa only [hi] using plainAntichain_coordinatePerm e {p,q,r} ha)
      (by simpa only [hi] using plainVariables_coordinatePerm e {p,q,r} hv)
      (by simpa only [hi] using (plainCentre_coordinatePerm e {p,q,r} 0 p
        (by simpa [e,Equiv.swap_apply_def] using hc0)))
      (by simpa only [hi] using (plainCentre_coordinatePerm e {p,q,r} 1 p
        (by simpa [e,Equiv.swap_apply_def] using hc1)))
      (by simpa only [hi] using (plainCentre_coordinatePerm e {p,q,r} 2 r
        (by simpa [e,Equiv.swap_apply_def] using hc2)))
    right; left
    simp only [plainPlaneSplitPattern,plainCoordinatePerm_apply] at h
    norm_num [e,Equiv.swap_apply_def] at h
    rcases h with h | h | h | h | h | h | h | h | h
    · exact Or.inl (⟨h.1,h.2.1,h.2.2.1,h.2.2.2.2,h.2.2.2.1⟩)
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl (⟨h.1,h.2.1,h.2.2.1,h.2.2.2.1,h.2.2.2.2⟩)))
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (⟨h.1,h.2.1,h.2.2.1,h.2.2.2.1,h.2.2.2.2⟩))
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl (⟨h.1,h.2.1,h.2.2.1,h.2.2.2.2,h.2.2.2.1⟩))))

name: P23.Monomial.plain_three_root_coordinate_patterns

theorem plain_three_root_coordinate_patterns (p q r : PlainExp)

name: P23.Monomial.plainMonomial_typeThree_nearlyGorenstein_mu_ne_five
statement:
theorem plainMonomial_typeThree_nearlyGorenstein_mu_ne_five
    (G : Finset PlainExp) (hf : (plainSurvivors k G).Finite)
    (h0 : (0 : PlainExp) ∈ plainSurvivors k G)
    (hm : P23.Presentation.HasMinimalGeneratorCard (plainMonomialIdeal k G) G.card)
    (hed : plainEmbeddingDimension k (plainSurvivorRoots k G hf)
      (plainSurvivorRoots_nonempty k G hf h0) = 3)
    (ht : plainDirectType k (plainSurvivorRoots k G hf)
      (plainSurvivorRoots_nonempty k G hf h0) = 3)
    (hn : PlainDirectNearlyGorenstein k (plainSurvivorRoots k G hf)
      (plainSurvivorRoots_nonempty k G hf h0)) :
    P23.Presentation.idealGeneratorMu (plainMonomialIdeal k G) ≠ 5
proof:
:= by
  let R := plainSurvivorRoots k G hf
  have hR : R.Nonempty := plainSurvivorRoots_nonempty k G hf h0
  have ha : PlainRootAntichain R := plainSurvivorRoots_antichain k G hf
  have hv : PlainVariablesSurvive R :=
    (plain_embeddingDimension_eq_three_iff_variablesSurvive R hR).mp hed
  have hcard : R.card = 3 := by
    rw [plainDirectType_eq_rootCard _ _ ha] at ht
    exact ht
  have htrace : PlainVariablesInTrace k R hv := by
    intro j
    apply hn
    apply plain_PX_mem_augmentation
    intro he
    have he' := congrArg (fun p : PlainExp => p j) he
    simpa using he'
  have hc : HasPlainDirectionalCentres R :=
    plain_hasDirectionalCentres_of_variablesInTrace R hR (by omega) ha hv htrace
  have hno := plain_three_root_no_five R ha hcard hv hc
  have hG := plainGenerators_antichain_of_minimal k G hm
  have he := plainGenerators_eq_border k G hf hG
  rw [plain_idealGeneratorMu_eq_of_minimal _ _ hm,he]
  exact hno

name: P23.Monomial.plain_type_three_ng_border_frontier
statement:
theorem plain_type_three_ng_border_frontier (R : Finset PlainExp)
    (ha : PlainRootAntichain R) (h3 : R.card=3) (hv : PlainVariablesSurvive R)
    (hc : HasPlainDirectionalCentres R) :
    (plainBorderFinset R).card=4 ∨ (plainBorderFinset R).card=6 ∨
      (plainBorderFinset R).card=7
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p,q,r,hpq,hpr,hqr,rfl⟩ := Finset.card_eq_three.mp h3
  rcases plain_three_root_coordinate_patterns p q r hpq hpr hqr ha hv hc with h | h | h
  · have hh := plain_triangle_pattern_card p q r h
    omega
  · have hh := plain_plane_pattern_card p q r hpq hpr hqr ha h
    omega
  · have hh := plain_dominant_pattern_card p q r hpq hpr hqr ha hc h
    omega

name: P23.Monomial.plain_type_three_border_seven_has_dominant_root
statement:
theorem plain_type_three_border_seven_has_dominant_root (R : Finset PlainExp)
    (ha : PlainRootAntichain R) (h3 : R.card=3) (hv : PlainVariablesSurvive R)
    (hc : HasPlainDirectionalCentres R) (h7 : (plainBorderFinset R).card=7) :
    ∃ s, PlainIsDominantRoot R s
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p,q,r,hpq,hpr,hqr,rfl⟩ := Finset.card_eq_three.mp h3
  rcases plain_three_root_coordinate_patterns p q r hpq hpr hqr ha hv hc with h | h | h
  · have hh := plain_triangle_pattern_card p q r h
    omega
  · have hh := plain_plane_pattern_card p q r hpq hpr hqr ha h
    omega
  · exact plain_dominant_axis_pattern_has_dominant p q r hc h

name: P23.Monomial.PlainMonomialArtin.PXall_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem PXall_zero (R : Finset PlainExp) : PXall (k := k) R 0 = 1
proof: := rfl

name: P23.Monomial.PlainMonomialArtin.PXall_add
statement:
theorem PXall_add (R : Finset PlainExp) (p q : PlainExp) :
    PXall (k := k) R (p+q) = PXall R p * PXall R q
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp : p ∈ plainStandardFinset R
  · by_cases hq : q ∈ plainStandardFinset R
    · simp [PXall,hp,hq,PX_mul_PX]
    · have hn : p+q ∉ plainStandardFinset R :=
        fun h => hq (mem_plainStandardFinset_of_add_mem_right R h)
      simp [PXall,hq,hn]
  · have hn : p+q ∉ plainStandardFinset R :=
      fun h => hp (mem_plainStandardFinset_of_add_mem_left R h)
    simp [PXall,hp,hn]

name: P23.Monomial.plainPolyToArtin_monomial
statement:
theorem plainPolyToArtin_monomial (k : Type*) [Field k] (R : Finset PlainExp)
    (p : PlainExp) (r : k) :
    plainPolyToArtin k R (MvPolynomial.monomial p r) =
      r • PlainMonomialArtin.PXall (k := k) R p
proof:
:=
  AddMonoidAlgebra.lift_single _ p r

name: P23.Monomial.plainPolyToArtin_surjective
statement:
theorem plainPolyToArtin_surjective (k : Type*) [Field k] (R : Finset PlainExp) :
    Function.Surjective (plainPolyToArtin k R)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  refine ⟨x.coeff.sum (fun p r => MvPolynomial.monomial p.1 r),?_⟩
  rw [map_finsuppSum]
  conv_rhs => rw [basis_expansion x]
  apply Finsupp.sum_congr
  intro p _
  simp [plainPolyToArtin_monomial,PlainMonomialArtin.PXall,p.2]

name: P23.Monomial.killed_iff_border_divisor
statement:
theorem killed_iff_border_divisor (R : Finset PlainExp) (p : PlainExp) :
    p ∉ plainStandardSet R ↔ ∃ g ∈ plainBorderFinset R, plainDivides g p
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hp
    let K := (Set.finite_Iic p).toFinset.filter (fun q => q ∉ plainStandardSet R)
    have hpK : p ∈ K := by simp [K,hp]
    obtain ⟨g,hg,hmin⟩ := K.exists_min_image plainWeight ⟨p,hpK⟩
    have hgp : plainDivides g p := by
      have hle : g ≤ p := by simpa [K] using (Finset.mem_filter.mp hg).1
      exact fun j => hle j
    have hgn := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hg).2
    refine ⟨g,(plain_border_iff_minimalKilled R g).mpr ⟨hgn,?_⟩,hgp⟩
    intro q hqg hqne
    by_contra hqn
    have hqK : q ∈ K := by
      simp only [K,Finset.mem_filter,Set.Finite.mem_toFinset,Set.mem_Iic]
      exact ⟨plainDivides_trans hqg hgp,hqn⟩
    have hle := hmin q hqK
    have hlt := plainWeight_strict hqg hqne
    omega
  · rintro ⟨g,hg,hgp⟩ hp
    exact ((plain_border_iff_minimalKilled R g).mp hg).1 (plainStandard_downward R hp hgp)

name: P23.Monomial.coeff_plainPolyToArtin
statement:
theorem coeff_plainPolyToArtin (k : Type*) [Field k] (R : Finset PlainExp)
    (f : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) k) (q : PlainMonomialIndex R) :
    (plainPolyToArtin k R f).coeff q = f.coeff q.1
proof:
:= by
  induction f using MvPolynomial.induction_on' with
  | add f g hf hg => simp [hf,hg]
  | monomial p r =>
    by_cases hp : p ∈ plainStandardFinset R
    · simp [plainPolyToArtin_monomial,PlainMonomialArtin.PXall,hp,
        PlainMonomialArtin.coeff_PX,MvPolynomial.coeff_monomial,Finsupp.single_apply,
        Subtype.ext_iff,eq_comm]
    · have hn : q.1 ≠ p := fun h => hp (h ▸ q.2)
      simp [plainPolyToArtin_monomial,PlainMonomialArtin.PXall,hp,
        MvPolynomial.coeff_monomial,hn,Ne.symm hn]

name: P23.Monomial.plainPolyToArtin_kernel
statement:
theorem plainPolyToArtin_kernel (k : Type*) [Field k] (R : Finset PlainExp) :
    RingHom.ker (plainPolyToArtin k R).toRingHom =
      plainMonomialIdeal k (plainBorderFinset R)
proof:
:= by
  ext f
  rw [RingHom.mem_ker,mem_plainMonomialIdeal_iff_support]
  constructor
  · intro hf p hp
    apply (killed_iff_border_divisor R p).mp
    intro hstd
    let q : PlainMonomialIndex R := ⟨p,(mem_plainStandardFinset R p).mpr hstd⟩
    have hc := congrArg (fun x : PlainMonomialArtin k R => x.coeff q) hf
    change (plainPolyToArtin k R f).coeff q = 0 at hc
    rw [coeff_plainPolyToArtin] at hc
    exact (MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff.mp hp) hc
  · intro hf
    apply PlainMonomialArtin.ext
    ext q
    change (plainPolyToArtin k R f).coeff q = 0
    rw [coeff_plainPolyToArtin]
    change f.coeff q.1 = 0
    by_contra hn
    have hb := hf q.1 (MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff.mpr hn)
    exact (killed_iff_border_divisor R q.1).mpr hb
      ((mem_plainStandardFinset R q.1).mp q.2)

name: P23.Monomial.plain_PXall_nonzero_iff
statement:
theorem plain_PXall_nonzero_iff (R : Finset PlainExp) (p : PlainExp) :
    PlainMonomialArtin.PXall (k := k) R p ≠ 0 ↔ p ∈ plainStandardSet R
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hp : p ∈ plainStandardFinset R
  · simp [PlainMonomialArtin.PXall, hp, PX_ne_zero,
