      (mem_plainStandardFinset R p).mp hp]
  · simp [PlainMonomialArtin.PXall, hp, ← mem_plainStandardFinset R p]

name: P23.Monomial.plainVariablesSurvive_iff_nonzero
statement:
theorem plainVariablesSurvive_iff_nonzero (R : Finset PlainExp) :
    PlainVariablesSurvive R ↔
      ∀ j, PlainMonomialArtin.PXall (k := k) R (plainUnitVector j) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [PlainVariablesSurvive, plain_PXall_nonzero_iff]

name: P23.Monomial.plain_root_variable_killed
statement:
theorem plain_root_variable_killed (R : Finset PlainExp) (ha : PlainRootAntichain R)
    (s : PlainExp) (hs : s ∈ R) (j : Fin 3) :
    PXall (k := k) R (plainUnitVector j) * PX R s (plainRootIndex R s hs).2 = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hn : plainUnitVector j+s ∉ plainStandardFinset R := by
    rintro h
    obtain ⟨t,ht,hst⟩ := (mem_plainStandardFinset R _).mp h
    have hle : plainDivides s t := fun r => le_trans (Nat.le_add_left _ _) (hst r)
    have he := ha s hs t ht hle
    subst t
    have hc := hst j
    simp at hc
  rw [←show PXall (k := k) R s = PX R s (plainRootIndex R s hs).2 by
    exact dite_eq_left (plainRootIndex R s hs).2,←PXall_add]
  simp [PXall,hn]

name: P23.Monomial.plain_root_mem_socle
statement:
theorem plain_root_mem_socle (R : Finset PlainExp) (hR : R.Nonempty)
    (ha : PlainRootAntichain R) (s : PlainExp) (hs : s ∈ R) :
    PX (k := k) R s (plainRootIndex R s hs).2 ∈ PlainDirectSocle R hR
proof:
:= by
  intro r hr
  rw [←plainVariableIdeal_eq_augmentationIdeal R hR] at hr
  refine Submodule.span_induction (p := fun r _ => r * PX R s (plainRootIndex R s hs).2=0)
    ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hr
  · rintro _ ⟨j,rfl⟩; exact plain_root_variable_killed R ha s hs j
  · simp
  · intro r t _ _ hr ht; rw [add_mul,hr,ht,add_zero]
  · intro a r _ hr; change (a*r)*_=0; rw [mul_assoc,hr,mul_zero]

name: P23.Monomial.plain_nonroot_extension
statement:
theorem plain_nonroot_extension (R : Finset PlainExp) (p : PlainMonomialIndex R)
    (hp : p.1 ∉ R) : ∃ j, plainUnitVector j+p.1 ∈ plainStandardFinset R
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s,hs,hps⟩ := (mem_plainStandardFinset R p.1).mp p.2
  have hn : p.1 ≠ s := fun h => hp (h ▸ hs)
  have hex : ∃ j, p.1 j < s j := by
    by_contra h
    push Not at h
    apply hn
    ext j
    exact le_antisymm (hps j) (h j)
  obtain ⟨j,hj⟩ := hex
  refine ⟨j,(mem_plainStandardFinset R _).mpr ⟨s,hs,?_⟩⟩
  intro r
  by_cases hr : r=j
  · subst r; simp; omega
  · simpa [plainUnitVector,Finsupp.single_apply,Ne.symm hr] using hps r

name: P23.Monomial.plain_nonroot_coeff_zero
statement:
theorem plain_nonroot_coeff_zero (R : Finset PlainExp) (hR : R.Nonempty)
    (v : PlainMonomialArtin k R) (hv : v ∈ PlainDirectSocle R hR)
    (p : PlainMonomialIndex R) (hp : p.1 ∉ R) : v.coeff p=0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j,hjp⟩ := plain_nonroot_extension R p hp
  have hj := mem_plainStandardFinset_of_add_mem_left R hjp
  let ji : PlainMonomialIndex R := ⟨plainUnitVector j,hj⟩
  let ti : PlainMonomialIndex R := ⟨plainUnitVector j+p.1,hjp⟩
  have hm : PX (k := k) R ji.1 ji.2 ∈ plainAugmentationIdeal R hR := by
    rw [←plainVariableIdeal_eq_augmentationIdeal R hR]
    simpa [plainVariableIdeal,PXall,hj,ji] using (Ideal.subset_span (s := Set.range
      (fun j : Fin 3 => PXall (k := k) R (plainUnitVector j))) ⟨j,rfl⟩)
  have hz := hv _ hm
  have hc := congrArg (plainCoeffAt (k := k) R ti) hz
  rw [plainCoeffAt_PX_mul R ji p ti rfl] at hc
  simpa using hc

name: P23.Monomial.plain_socle_eq_rootSpan
statement:
theorem plain_socle_eq_rootSpan (R : Finset PlainExp) (hR : R.Nonempty)
    (ha : PlainRootAntichain R) : PlainDirectSocle (k := k) R hR = plainRootSpan R
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro v hv
    rw [basis_expansion v]
    apply Submodule.sum_mem
    intro p _
    by_cases hp : p.1 ∈ R
    · apply Submodule.smul_mem
      exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨⟨p.1,hp⟩,rfl⟩
    · simp [plain_nonroot_coeff_zero R hR v hv p hp]
  · apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro _ ⟨s,rfl⟩
    exact plain_root_mem_socle R hR ha s.1 s.2

name: P23.Monomial.plain_rootBasis_independent
statement:
theorem plain_rootBasis_independent (R : Finset PlainExp) :
    LinearIndependent k (plainRootBasisVector (k := k) R)
proof:
:= by
  let f : ↥R → PlainMonomialIndex R := fun s => plainRootIndex R s.1 s.2
  have hinj : Function.Injective f := by
    intro s t h
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact congrArg (fun p : PlainMonomialIndex R => p.1) h
  exact (monomialBasis k R).linearIndependent.comp f hinj

name: P23.Monomial.plainDirectType_eq_rootCard
statement:
theorem plainDirectType_eq_rootCard (R : Finset PlainExp) (hR : R.Nonempty)
    (ha : PlainRootAntichain R) : plainDirectType k R hR = R.card
proof:
:= by
  unfold plainDirectType
  rw [plain_socle_eq_rootSpan R hR ha]
  unfold plainRootSpan
  rw [finrank_span_eq_card (plain_rootBasis_independent (k := k) R)]
  exact Fintype.card_coe R

name: P23.Monomial.PlainOmega.smul_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smul_apply (r : PlainMonomialArtin k S) (φ : PlainOmega k S)
    (x : PlainMonomialArtin k S) : (r • φ) x = φ (r * x)
proof: := rfl

name: P23.Monomial.PlainOmega.PU_apply_PX
statement:
@[simp]
theorem PU_apply_PX (S : Finset PlainExp) (p q : PlainMonomialIndex S) :
    PU (k := k) S p (PX (k := k) S q.1 q.2) = if p = q then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa [PU] using
    (Module.Basis.dualBasis_apply_self (PlainMonomialArtin.monomialBasis k S) p q)
      |>.trans (by simp [eq_comm])

name: P23.Monomial.PlainOmega.PX_smul_PU_apply_PX
statement:
theorem PX_smul_PU_apply_PX (S : Finset PlainExp)
    (m q s : PlainMonomialIndex S) :
    (PX (k := k) S m.1 m.2 • PU (k := k) S s)
        (PX (k := k) S q.1 q.2) =
      if m.1 + q.1 = s.1 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [smul_apply, PlainMonomialArtin.PX_mul_PX]
  by_cases hmq : m.1 + q.1 ∈ plainStandardFinset S
  · simp only [dif_pos hmq]
    let t : PlainMonomialIndex S := ⟨m.1 + q.1, hmq⟩
    change PU (k := k) S s (PX (k := k) S t.1 t.2) = _
    rw [PU_apply_PX]
    simp [t, Subtype.ext_iff, eq_comm]
  · have hne : m.1 + q.1 ≠ s.1 := by
      intro h
      apply hmq
      simpa [h] using s.2
    simp [hmq, hne]

name: P23.Monomial.PlainOmega.PX_smul_PU_eq_PU
statement:
theorem PX_smul_PU_eq_PU (S : Finset PlainExp)
    (m q s : PlainMonomialIndex S) (h : m.1 + q.1 = s.1) :
    PX (k := k) S m.1 m.2 • PU (k := k) S s = PU (k := k) S q
proof:
:= by
  apply (PlainMonomialArtin.monomialBasis k S).ext
  intro r
  simp only [PlainMonomialArtin.monomialBasis_apply]
  rw [PX_smul_PU_apply_PX, PU_apply_PX]
  have hiff : m.1 + r.1 = s.1 ↔ r = q := by
    constructor
    · intro hr
      apply Subtype.ext
      apply add_left_cancel
      exact hr.trans h.symm
    · rintro rfl
      exact h
  simp [hiff, eq_comm]

name: P23.Monomial.PlainOmega.PU_ne_zero
statement:
theorem PU_ne_zero (S : Finset PlainExp) (p : PlainMonomialIndex S) :
    PU (k := k) S p ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hc := congrArg (fun φ : PlainOmega k S ↦
    φ (PX (k := k) S p.1 p.2)) h
  simpa [PU_apply_PX] using hc

name: P23.Monomial.PlainOmega.PU_mem_plainRootDual_span
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s,hs,hps⟩ := (mem_plainStandardFinset S p.1).mp p.2
  have hle : p.1 ≤ s := hps
  obtain ⟨w,hw⟩ := le_iff_exists_add.mp hle
  have hwstd : w ∈ plainStandardFinset S := by
    apply PlainMonomialArtin.mem_plainStandardFinset_of_add_mem_right S (p := p.1)
    rw [←hw]
    exact (plainRootIndex S s hs).2
  let wi : PlainMonomialIndex S := ⟨w,hwstd⟩
  have hprod : wi.1 + p.1 = (plainRootIndex S s hs).1 := by
    simpa [wi,plainRootIndex,add_comm] using hw.symm
  have hroot : PU (k := k) S (plainRootIndex S s hs) ∈
      Submodule.span (PlainMonomialArtin k S) (plainRootDualSet k S) :=
    Submodule.subset_span ⟨s,hs,rfl⟩
  rw [←PX_smul_PU_eq_PU (k := k) S wi p (plainRootIndex S s hs) hprod]
  exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hroot

name: P23.Monomial.PlainOmega.plainRootDual_span_eq_top
statement:
theorem plainRootDual_span_eq_top (S : Finset PlainExp) :
    Submodule.span (PlainMonomialArtin k S) (plainRootDualSet k S) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  let P := Submodule.span (PlainMonomialArtin k S) (plainRootDualSet k S)
  apply top_unique
  intro φ _
  have hspan : Submodule.span k
      (Set.range (PlainMonomialArtin.monomialBasis k S).dualBasis) ≤
      P.restrictScalars k := by
    apply Submodule.span_le.2
    rintro _ ⟨p, rfl⟩
    exact PU_mem_plainRootDual_span (k := k) S p
  rw [(PlainMonomialArtin.monomialBasis k S).dualBasis.span_eq] at hspan
  exact hspan (Submodule.mem_top)

name: P23.Monomial.PlainOmega.PX_smul_plainRootDual_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem PX_smul_plainRootDual_eq_zero_iff (S : Finset PlainExp)
    (s : PlainExp) (hs : s ∈ S) (w : PlainMonomialIndex S) :
    PX (k := k) S w.1 w.2 • PU (k := k) S (plainRootIndex S s hs) = 0 ↔
      ¬ plainDivides w.1 s
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hzero hdiv
    have hle : w.1 ≤ s := hdiv
    obtain ⟨q,hq⟩ := le_iff_exists_add.mp hle
    have hqstd : q ∈ plainStandardFinset S := by
      apply PlainMonomialArtin.mem_plainStandardFinset_of_add_mem_right S (p := w.1)
      rw [←hq]
      exact (plainRootIndex S s hs).2
    let qi : PlainMonomialIndex S := ⟨q,hqstd⟩
    have hprod : w.1 + qi.1 = (plainRootIndex S s hs).1 := hq.symm
    rw [PX_smul_PU_eq_PU S w qi (plainRootIndex S s hs) hprod] at hzero
    exact PU_ne_zero S qi hzero
  · intro hndiv
    apply (PlainMonomialArtin.monomialBasis k S).ext
    intro q
    simp only [PlainMonomialArtin.monomialBasis_apply]
    rw [PX_smul_PU_apply_PX]
    have hne : w.1 + q.1 ≠ (plainRootIndex S s hs).1 := by
      intro heq
      apply hndiv
      intro j
      have hc := congrArg (fun p : PlainExp => p j) heq
      change w.1 j ≤ s j
      change w.1 j + q.1 j = s j at hc
      omega
    simp [hne]

name: P23.Monomial.mem_plainMonomialIdeal_iff_support
statement:
theorem mem_plainMonomialIdeal_iff_support (G : Finset PlainExp)
    (f : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) k) :
    f ∈ plainMonomialIdeal k G ↔ ∀ p ∈ f.support, ∃ g ∈ G, plainDivides g p
proof:
:= by
  exact MvPolynomial.mem_ideal_span_monomial_image

name: P23.Monomial.monomial_mem_plainMonomialIdeal_iff
statement:
theorem monomial_mem_plainMonomialIdeal_iff (G : Finset PlainExp) (p : PlainExp) :
    MvPolynomial.monomial p (1 : k) ∈ plainMonomialIdeal k G ↔
      ∃ g ∈ G, plainDivides g p
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_plainMonomialIdeal_iff_support]
  simp

name: P23.Monomial.plainSurvivors_downward
proof:
:= by
  intro hp
  obtain ⟨g,hg,hgp⟩ := (monomial_mem_plainMonomialIdeal_iff k G p).mp hp
  exact hq ((monomial_mem_plainMonomialIdeal_iff k G q).mpr
    ⟨g,hg,plainDivides_trans hgp hpq⟩)

name: P23.Monomial.plainMonomialIdeal_coeff_zero
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hn
  have hsup : p ∈ f.support := MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff.mpr hn
  exact hp ((monomial_mem_plainMonomialIdeal_iff k G p).mpr
    ((mem_plainMonomialIdeal_iff_support k G f).mp hf p hsup))

name: P23.Monomial.plain_surviving_quotient_monomials_independent
statement:
theorem plain_surviving_quotient_monomials_independent (G : Finset PlainExp) :
    LinearIndependent k (fun p : ↥(plainSurvivors k G) =>
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (plainMonomialIdeal k G) (MvPolynomial.monomial p.1 (1 : k)))
proof:
:= by
  apply linearIndependent_iff'.mpr
  intro s t hz j hj
  have hm : (∑ q ∈ s, t q • MvPolynomial.monomial q.1 (1 : k)) ∈ plainMonomialIdeal k G := by
    apply Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mp
    change (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k (plainMonomialIdeal k G))
      (∑ q ∈ s, t q • MvPolynomial.monomial q.1 (1 : k)) = 0
    simpa only [map_sum, map_smul, Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ_eq_mk] using hz
  have hc := plainMonomialIdeal_coeff_zero k G j.2 _ hm
  have hmono (q : ↥(plainSurvivors k G)) :
      (MvPolynomial.monomial q.1 (1 : k)).coeff j.1 = if q = j then 1 else 0 := by
    simp only [MvPolynomial.coeff_monomial, Subtype.val_inj]
  simpa [MvPolynomial.coeff_sum, MvPolynomial.coeff_smul, hmono, hj] using hc

name: P23.Monomial.plainSurvivors_finite
statement:
theorem plainSurvivors_finite (G : Finset PlainExp)
    [Module.Finite k (MvPolynomial (Fin 3) k ⧸ plainMonomialIdeal k G)] :
    (plainSurvivors k G).Finite
proof:
:= by
  haveI := (plain_surviving_quotient_monomials_independent k G).finite
  exact Set.toFinite _

name: P23.Monomial.plainSurvivorRoots_antichain
statement:
theorem plainSurvivorRoots_antichain (G : Finset PlainExp)
    (hf : (plainSurvivors k G).Finite) : PlainRootAntichain (plainSurvivorRoots k G hf)
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp q hq hpq
  exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).2 q (Finset.mem_filter.mp hq).1 hpq

name: P23.Monomial.plainWeight_strict
statement:
theorem plainWeight_strict {p q : PlainExp} (hpq : plainDivides p q) (hne : p ≠ q) :
    plainWeight p < plainWeight q
proof:
:= by
  have h0 := hpq 0
  have h1 := hpq 1
  have h2 := hpq 2
  have hex : p 0 ≠ q 0 ∨ p 1 ≠ q 1 ∨ p 2 ≠ q 2 := by
    by_contra hn
    push Not at hn
    apply hne
    ext j
    fin_cases j <;> simp_all
  unfold plainWeight
  omega

name: P23.Monomial.plainSurvivorRoots_standard_iff
statement:
theorem plainSurvivorRoots_standard_iff (G : Finset PlainExp)
    (hf : (plainSurvivors k G).Finite) (p : PlainExp) :
    p ∈ plainStandardSet (plainSurvivorRoots k G hf) ↔ p ∈ plainSurvivors k G
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨s,hs,hps⟩
    exact plainSurvivors_downward k G
      (hf.mem_toFinset.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hs).1) hps
  · intro hp
    let K := hf.toFinset.filter (fun q => plainDivides p q)
    have hpK : p ∈ K := Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hf.mem_toFinset.mpr hp,plainDivides_refl p⟩
    obtain ⟨s,hs,hmax⟩ := K.exists_max_image plainWeight ⟨p,hpK⟩
    have hsu := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hs).1
    have hps := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hs).2
    refine ⟨s,Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hsu,?_⟩,hps⟩
    intro q hq hsq
    by_contra hne
    have hqK : q ∈ K := Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hq,plainDivides_trans hps hsq⟩
    have hle := hmax q hqK
    have hlt := plainWeight_strict hsq hne
    omega

name: P23.Monomial.plainSurvivorRoots_nonempty
statement:
theorem plainSurvivorRoots_nonempty (G : Finset PlainExp)
    (hf : (plainSurvivors k G).Finite) (h0 : (0 : PlainExp) ∈ plainSurvivors k G) :
    (plainSurvivorRoots k G hf).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s,hs,_⟩ := (plainSurvivorRoots_standard_iff k G hf 0).mpr h0
  exact ⟨s,hs⟩

name: P23.Monomial.plainGenerators_eq_border
statement:
theorem plainGenerators_eq_border (G : Finset PlainExp)
    (hf : (plainSurvivors k G).Finite) (hG : PlainRootAntichain G) :
    G = plainBorderFinset (plainSurvivorRoots k G hf)
proof:
:= by
  ext g
  rw [plain_border_iff_minimalKilled]
  constructor
  · intro hg
    refine ⟨?_,?_⟩
    · intro hs
      have hsurv := (plainSurvivorRoots_standard_iff k G hf g).mp hs
      exact hsurv ((monomial_mem_plainMonomialIdeal_iff k G g).mpr ⟨g,hg,plainDivides_refl g⟩)
    · intro p hpg hpne
      apply (plainSurvivorRoots_standard_iff k G hf p).mpr
      intro hp
      obtain ⟨q,hq,hqp⟩ := (monomial_mem_plainMonomialIdeal_iff k G p).mp hp
      have he := hG q hq g hg (plainDivides_trans hqp hpg)
      have hgp : plainDivides g p := he ▸ hqp
      exact hpne (plainDivides_antisymm hpg hgp)
  · intro hb
    have hkill : MvPolynomial.monomial g (1 : k) ∈ plainMonomialIdeal k G := by
      by_contra hn
      exact hb.1 ((plainSurvivorRoots_standard_iff k G hf g).mpr hn)
    obtain ⟨q,hq,hqg⟩ := (monomial_mem_plainMonomialIdeal_iff k G g).mp hkill
    by_cases he : q = g
    · exact he ▸ hq
    · have hs := (plainSurvivorRoots_standard_iff k G hf q).mp (hb.2 q hqg he)
      exact False.elim (hs ((monomial_mem_plainMonomialIdeal_iff k G q).mpr ⟨q,hq,plainDivides_refl q⟩))

name: P23.Monomial.plainGenerators_antichain_of_minimal
statement:
theorem plainGenerators_antichain_of_minimal (G : Finset PlainExp)
    (hmin : P23.Presentation.HasMinimalGeneratorCard (plainMonomialIdeal k G) G.card) :
    PlainRootAntichain G
proof:
:= by
  intro g hg q hq hgq
  by_contra hne
  let H := (G.erase q).image (fun p => MvPolynomial.monomial p (1 : k))
  have hspan : Ideal.span (↑H : Set (MvPolynomial (Fin 3) k)) = plainMonomialIdeal k G := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
      intro f hf
      obtain ⟨p,hp,rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hf
      exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨p,(Finset.mem_erase.mp hp).2,rfl⟩
    · apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
      rintro f ⟨p,hp,rfl⟩
      by_cases he : p = q
      · subst p
        have hgH : MvPolynomial.monomial g (1 : k) ∈ Ideal.span (↑H : Set _) :=
          Ideal.subset_span (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨g,Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hne,hg⟩,rfl⟩)
        obtain ⟨d,hd⟩ := le_iff_exists_add.mp (show g ≤ q from hgq)
        have hm := (Ideal.span (↑H : Set (MvPolynomial (Fin 3) k))).mul_mem_left
          (MvPolynomial.monomial d 1) hgH
        simpa [MvPolynomial.monomial_mul,add_comm,← hd] using hm
      · exact Ideal.subset_span (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨p,Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨he,hp⟩,rfl⟩)
  have hlow := hmin.2 H hspan
  have hc : H.card = G.card - 1 := by
    dsimp only [H]
    rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ (MvPolynomial.monomial_left_injective one_ne_zero),
      Finset.card_erase_of_mem hq]
  have hpos : 0 < G.card := Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨q,hq⟩
  omega

name: P23.Monomial.plain_idealGeneratorMu_eq_of_minimal
statement:
theorem plain_idealGeneratorMu_eq_of_minimal
    (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin 3) k)) (n : ℕ)
    (hmin : P23.Presentation.HasMinimalGeneratorCard I n) :
    P23.Presentation.idealGeneratorMu I = n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases hmin.1 with ⟨G0, hG0, hcard0⟩
  have hex : ∃ m, ∃ G : Finset (MvPolynomial (Fin 3) k),
      Ideal.span (↑G : Set _) = I ∧ G.card = m := ⟨n, G0, hG0, hcard0⟩
  rw [P23.Presentation.idealGeneratorMu, dif_pos hex]
  apply Nat.le_antisymm
  · exact Nat.find_min' hex ⟨G0, hG0, hcard0⟩
  · rcases Nat.find_spec hex with ⟨G, hG, hcard⟩
    rw [← hcard]
    exact hmin.2 G hG

name: P23.Monomial.plainExp_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem plainExp_zero (x y z : ℕ) : plainExp x y z 0=x
proof: := by simp [plainExp]

name: P23.Monomial.plainExp_one
statement: @[simp] theorem plainExp_one (x y z : ℕ) : plainExp x y z 1=y
proof: := by simp [plainExp]

name: P23.Monomial.plainExp_two
statement: @[simp] theorem plainExp_two (x y z : ℕ) : plainExp x y z 2=z
proof: := by simp [plainExp]

name: P23.Monomial.plainExp_coordinates
statement: theorem plainExp_coordinates (p : PlainExp) : plainExp (p 0) (p 1) (p 2)=p
proof:
:= by
  ext j; fin_cases j <;> simp

name: P23.Monomial.plainExp_eq
statement:
@[simp] theorem plainExp_eq (x y z x' y' z' : ℕ) :
    plainExp x y z=plainExp x' y' z' ↔ x=x' ∧ y=y' ∧ z=z'
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨by simpa using congrArg (fun p : PlainExp=>p 0) h,
      by simpa using congrArg (fun p : PlainExp=>p 1) h,
      by simpa using congrArg (fun p : PlainExp=>p 2) h⟩
  · rintro ⟨rfl,rfl,rfl⟩; rfl

name: P23.Monomial.plainExp_eq_coordinates
statement:
theorem plainExp_eq_coordinates (p : PlainExp) (x y z : ℕ) :
    p=plainExp x y z ↔ p 0=x ∧ p 1=y ∧ p 2=z
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h; simp [h]
  · rintro ⟨hx,hy,hz⟩; simpa [hx,hy,hz] using (plainExp_coordinates p).symm

name: P23.Monomial.plainTriangle_border_exact
statement:
theorem plainTriangle_border_exact (r u v : ℕ) :
    plainBorderFinset (plainTriangleRoots r u v)=plainTriangleBorder r u v
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  rw [mem_plainBorderFinset_iff]
  simp only [plainStandardSet,plainTriangleRoots,Finset.mem_insert,Finset.mem_singleton,
    exists_eq_or_imp,exists_eq_left,plainDivides,Fin.forall_fin_succ,plainExp_zero,
    plainExp_one,plainExp_two,plainPredecessor_apply]
  simp [plainTriangleBorder,plainExp_eq_coordinates]
  omega

name: P23.Monomial.plainTriangle_border_card
statement:
theorem plainTriangle_border_card (r u v : ℕ) :
    (plainBorderFinset (plainTriangleRoots r u v)).card=4
proof:
:= by
  rw [plainTriangle_border_exact]
  simp [plainTriangleBorder,plainExp_eq]

name: P23.Monomial.plainDominantAxis_standard
statement:
theorem plainDominantAxis_standard (r u v : ℕ) (p : PlainExp) :
    p ∈ plainStandardSet (plainDominantAxisRoots r u v) ↔
      (p 0≤r ∧ p 1≤u ∧ p 2≤v) ∨
      (p 0≤r+1 ∧ p 1=0 ∧ p 2=0) ∨ (p 0=0 ∧ p 1≤u+1 ∧ p 2=0)
proof:
:= by
  simp [plainStandardSet,plainDominantAxisRoots,plainDivides,Fin.forall_fin_succ]

name: P23.Monomial.plainDominantAxis_border_exact
statement:
theorem plainDominantAxis_border_exact (r u v : ℕ) (hr : 0<r) (hu : 0<u) (hv : 0<v) :
    plainBorderFinset (plainDominantAxisRoots r u v)=plainDominantAxisBorder r u v
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  rw [mem_plainBorderFinset_iff]
  simp only [plainDominantAxis_standard,Fin.forall_fin_succ,plainPredecessor_apply]
  by_cases hz : p 2=0 <;> by_cases hx : p 0=0 <;> by_cases hy : p 1=0
  all_goals simp [plainDominantAxisBorder,plainExp_eq_coordinates,hz,hx,hy]
  all_goals omega

name: P23.Monomial.plainDominantAxis_border_card
statement:
theorem plainDominantAxis_border_card (r u v : ℕ) (hr : 0<r) (hu : 0<u) (hv : 0<v) :
    (plainBorderFinset (plainDominantAxisRoots r u v)).card=7
proof:
:= by
  rw [plainDominantAxis_border_exact r u v hr hu hv]
  have hrn : r+1≠1 := by omega
  have hun : u+1≠1 := by omega
  simp [plainDominantAxisBorder,Finset.card_insert_eq_ite,plainExp_eq,hrn,hun,Ne.symm hrn,Ne.symm hun]
  omega

name: P23.Monomial.plainPlaneAxis_standard
statement:
theorem plainPlaneAxis_standard (r u s v h : ℕ) (hru : r<u) (hsv : s<v) (p : PlainExp) :
    p ∈ plainStandardSet (plainPlaneAxisRoots r u s v h) ↔
      (p 2 = 0 ∧ p 0 ≤ u ∧ p 1 ≤ v ∧ (p 0 ≤ r ∨ p 1 ≤ s)) ∨
      (p 0 = 0 ∧ p 1 = 0 ∧ p 2 ≤ h)
proof:
:= by
  simp [plainStandardSet,plainPlaneAxisRoots,plainDivides,Fin.forall_fin_succ]
  omega

name: P23.Monomial.plainPlaneAxis_border_exact
statement:
theorem plainPlaneAxis_border_exact (r u s v h : ℕ) (hru : r<u) (hsv : s<v) (hh : 0<h) :
    plainBorderFinset (plainPlaneAxisRoots r u s v h)=plainPlaneAxisBorder r u s v h
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  rw [mem_plainBorderFinset_iff]
  simp only [plainPlaneAxis_standard r u s v h hru hsv,Fin.forall_fin_succ,plainPredecessor_apply]
  by_cases hz : p 2=0 <;> by_cases hx : p 0=0 <;> by_cases hy : p 1=0
  all_goals simp [plainPlaneAxisBorder,plainExp_eq_coordinates,hz,hx,hy]
  all_goals omega

name: P23.Monomial.plainPlaneAxis_border_card
statement:
theorem plainPlaneAxis_border_card (r u s v h : ℕ) (hru : r<u) (hsv : s<v) (hh : 0<h) :
    (plainBorderFinset (plainPlaneAxisRoots r u s v h)).card=6
proof:
:= by
  rw [plainPlaneAxis_border_exact r u s v h hru hsv hh]
  have hu : u+1≠1 := by omega
  have hv : v+1≠1 := by omega
  have hn : h+1≠1 := by omega
  simp [plainPlaneAxisBorder,Finset.card_insert_eq_ite,plainExp_eq,hu,hv,hn,Ne.symm hu,Ne.symm hv,Ne.symm hn]

name: P23.Monomial.plain_dominant_of_all_centres
statement:
theorem plain_dominant_of_all_centres (R : Finset PlainExp) (s : PlainExp)
    (hs : s ∈ R) (hc : ∀ j, PlainDirectionalCentre R j s) :
    PlainIsDominantRoot R s
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hs, ?_⟩
  rintro p ⟨r, hr, hpr⟩ hpn
  have hne : p ≠ r := by intro he; exact hpn (he ▸ hr)
  have hex : ∃ j, p j < r j := by
    by_contra hn
    push_neg at hn
    apply hne
    ext j
    exact le_antisymm (hpr j) (hn j)
  obtain ⟨j,hj⟩ := hex
  apply plainDivides_trans (q := plainPredecessor j r)
  · intro i
    by_cases hi : j=i
    · subst i; simp only [plainPredecessor_apply,ite_true]; omega
    · simpa [plainPredecessor_apply,hi] using hpr i
  · exact (hc j).2 r hr (by omega)

name: P23.Monomial.plain_dominant_coordinatePerm
statement:
theorem plain_dominant_coordinatePerm (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3))
    (R : Finset PlainExp) (s : PlainExp) (h : PlainIsDominantRoot R s) :
    PlainIsDominantRoot (R.image (plainCoordinatePerm e)) (plainCoordinatePerm e s)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨s,h.1,rfl⟩,?_⟩
  intro p hp hn
  let q := (plainCoordinatePerm e).symm p
  have hq : plainCoordinatePerm e q = p := (plainCoordinatePerm e).apply_symm_apply p
  have hqs := (plainStandard_coordinatePerm_iff e R q).mp (hq.symm ▸ hp)
  have hqn : q ∉ R := by
    intro hqr
    exact hn (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨q,hqr,hq⟩)
  have hd := (plainDivides_coordinatePerm_iff e q s).mpr (h.2 q hqs hqn)
  simpa [hq] using hd

name: P23.Monomial.plain_positive_two_axes_dominant
statement: theorem plain_positive_two_axes_dominant (p q r : PlainExp) (hc : HasPlainDirectionalCentres {p,q,r}) (hp : 0
proof:
:= by
  apply plain_dominant_of_all_centres _ p (by simp)
  intro j
  obtain ⟨s,hs⟩ := hc j
  have hd := hs.2 p (by simp) (by fin_cases j <;> simp_all)
  have h0 := hd 0
  have h1 := hd 1
  have h2 := hd 2
  have hm := hs.1
  simp only [Finset.mem_insert,Finset.mem_singleton] at hm
  rcases hm with he | he | he
  · simpa [he] using hs
  · subst s
    rcases hq with hq | hq | hq <;> fin_cases j <;>
      simp [plainPredecessor_apply] at h0 h1 h2 <;> omega
  · subst s
    rcases hr with hr | hr | hr <;> fin_cases j <;>
      simp [plainPredecessor_apply] at h0 h1 h2 <;> omega

name: P23.Monomial.plain_dominant_axis_pattern_has_dominant
statement:
theorem plain_dominant_axis_pattern_has_dominant (p q r : PlainExp)
    (hc : HasPlainDirectionalCentres {p,q,r}) (h : plainDominantAxisPattern p q r) :
    ∃ s, PlainIsDominantRoot {p,q,r} s
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with h | h | h
  · exact ⟨p,plain_positive_two_axes_dominant p q r hc ⟨h.1,h.2.1,h.2.2.1⟩
      h.2.2.2.1 h.2.2.2.2⟩
  · have he : ({p,q,r} : Finset PlainExp) = {q,r,p} := by ext s; simp; tauto
    rw [he] at hc ⊢
    exact ⟨q,plain_positive_two_axes_dominant q r p hc ⟨h.1,h.2.1,h.2.2.1⟩
      h.2.2.2.1 h.2.2.2.2⟩
  · have he : ({p,q,r} : Finset PlainExp) = {r,p,q} := by ext s; simp; tauto
    rw [he] at hc ⊢
    exact ⟨r,plain_positive_two_axes_dominant r p q hc ⟨h.1,h.2.1,h.2.2.1⟩
      h.2.2.2.1 h.2.2.2.2⟩

name: P23.Monomial.plainAugmentationIdeal_isMaximal
statement:
theorem plainAugmentationIdeal_isMaximal (R : Finset PlainExp) (hR : R.Nonempty) :
    (plainAugmentationIdeal (k := k) R hR).IsMaximal
proof:
:= by
  apply RingHom.ker_isMaximal_of_surjective
  intro r
  exact ⟨algebraMap k (PlainMonomialArtin k R) r,(plainConstantCoeffAlgHom R hR).commutes r⟩

name: P23.Monomial.plain_PX_mem_variableIdeal
statement:
theorem plain_PX_mem_variableIdeal (R : Finset PlainExp) (p : PlainExp)
    (hp : p ∈ plainStandardFinset R) (hn : p ≠ 0) :
    PX (k := k) R p hp ∈ plainVariableIdeal R
proof:
:= by
  have hex : ∃ j, 0 < p j := by
    by_contra h
    push Not at h
    apply hn
    ext j
    exact Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero (h j)
  obtain ⟨j,hj⟩ := hex
  let q := plainPredecessor j p
  have hq : q ∈ plainStandardFinset R := (mem_plainStandardFinset R q).mpr
    (plainStandard_downward R ((mem_plainStandardFinset R p).mp hp) (plainPredecessor_divides j p))
  have he : plainUnitVector j ∈ plainStandardFinset R := by
    apply mem_plainStandardFinset_of_add_mem_right R (p := q)
    simpa [q,plainPredecessor_add_unitVector j p hj] using hp
  have hv : PX (k := k) R (plainUnitVector j) he ∈ plainVariableIdeal R := by
    simpa [plainVariableIdeal,PXall,he] using (Ideal.subset_span (s := Set.range
      (fun j : Fin 3 => PXall (k := k) R (plainUnitVector j))) ⟨j,rfl⟩)
  have hm := (plainVariableIdeal (k := k) R).mul_mem_left (PX R q hq) hv
  simpa [PX_mul_PX,q,plainPredecessor_add_unitVector j p hj,hp] using hm

name: P23.Monomial.plainVariableIdeal_eq_augmentationIdeal
statement:
theorem plainVariableIdeal_eq_augmentationIdeal (R : Finset PlainExp) (hR : R.Nonempty) :
    plainVariableIdeal (k := k) R = plainAugmentationIdeal R hR
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
    rintro _ ⟨j,rfl⟩
    change plainConstantCoeff R hR (PXall (k := k) R (plainUnitVector j)) = 0
    have hn : (0 : PlainExp) ≠ plainUnitVector j := by
      intro h; have := congrArg (fun p : PlainExp => p j) h; simpa using this
    by_cases hj : plainUnitVector j ∈ plainStandardFinset R <;>
      simp [PXall,hj,plainConstantCoeff,plainUnitIndex,hn]
  · intro v hv
    change plainConstantCoeff R hR v = 0 at hv
    rw [basis_expansion v]
    apply Submodule.sum_mem
    intro p _
    by_cases hp : p.1 = 0
    · have he : p = plainUnitIndex R hR := Subtype.ext hp
      have hc : v.coeff p = 0 := by simpa [he,plainConstantCoeff] using hv
      simp [hc]
    · have hm := plain_PX_mem_variableIdeal (k := k) R p.1 p.2 hp
      simpa [Algebra.smul_def] using (plainVariableIdeal (k := k) R).mul_mem_left
        (algebraMap k (PlainMonomialArtin k R) (v.coeff p)) hm

name: P23.Monomial.plain_PXall_nsmul
statement:
theorem plain_PXall_nsmul (R : Finset PlainExp) (p : PlainExp) (n : ℕ) :
    PXall (k := k) R (n • p) = (PXall R p)^n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih => rw [succ_nsmul,PXall_add,ih,pow_succ]

name: P23.Monomial.plain_variable_nilpotent
statement:
theorem plain_variable_nilpotent (R : Finset PlainExp) (j : Fin 3) :
    IsNilpotent (PXall (k := k) R (plainUnitVector j))
proof:
:= by
  let N := (∑ p ∈ plainStandardFinset R, p j) + 1
  have hn : N • plainUnitVector j ∉ plainStandardFinset R := by
    intro h
    have hle := Finset.single_le_sum (fun p _ => Nat.zero_le (p j)) h
    have hc : (N • plainUnitVector j) j = N := by simp
    rw [hc] at hle
    dsimp [N] at hle
    omega
  refine ⟨N,?_⟩
  rw [←plain_PXall_nsmul]
  simp [PXall,hn]

name: P23.Monomial.plainIsLocalRing
statement:
theorem plainIsLocalRing (R : Finset PlainExp) (hR : R.Nonempty) :
    IsLocalRing (PlainMonomialArtin k R)
proof:
:= by
  apply IsLocalRing.of_unique_max_ideal
  refine ⟨plainAugmentationIdeal R hR,plainAugmentationIdeal_isMaximal R hR,?_⟩
  intro I hI
  have hle : plainVariableIdeal (k := k) R ≤ I := by
    apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
    rintro _ ⟨j,rfl⟩
    exact (nilpotent_iff_mem_prime.mp (plain_variable_nilpotent R j)) I hI.isPrime
  rw [plainVariableIdeal_eq_augmentationIdeal R hR] at hle
  exact ((plainAugmentationIdeal_isMaximal R hR).eq_of_le hI.ne_top hle).symm

name: P23.Monomial.plainMaximalIdeal_eq_augmentationIdeal
statement:
theorem plainMaximalIdeal_eq_augmentationIdeal (R : Finset PlainExp) (hR : R.Nonempty)
    (I : Ideal (PlainMonomialArtin k R)) (hI : I.IsMaximal) :
    I = plainAugmentationIdeal R hR
proof:
:= by
  have hle : plainVariableIdeal (k := k) R ≤ I := by
    apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
    rintro _ ⟨j,rfl⟩
    exact (nilpotent_iff_mem_prime.mp (plain_variable_nilpotent R j)) I hI.isPrime
  rw [plainVariableIdeal_eq_augmentationIdeal R hR] at hle
  exact ((plainAugmentationIdeal_isMaximal R hR).eq_of_le hI.ne_top hle).symm

name: P23.Artin.constantCoeffAlgHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem constantCoeffAlgHom_apply (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (hS : S.Nonempty) (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c)
    (v : MonomialArtin k S) :
    constantCoeffAlgHom (k := k) S hS hdom v =
      constantCoeff (k := k) S hS v
proof: := rfl

name: P23.Artin.mem_augmentationIdeal_iff
statement:
theorem mem_augmentationIdeal_iff (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (hS : S.Nonempty) (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c)
    (v : MonomialArtin k S) :
    v ∈ augmentationIdeal (k := k) S hS hdom ↔
      constantCoeff (k := k) S hS v = 0
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: P23.Artin.constantCoeffAlgHom_surjective
statement:
theorem constantCoeffAlgHom_surjective (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (hS : S.Nonempty) (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) :
    Function.Surjective (constantCoeffAlgHom (k := k) S hS hdom)
proof:
:= by
  intro r
  refine ⟨algebraMap k (MonomialArtin k S) r, ?_⟩
  exact (constantCoeffAlgHom (k := k) S hS hdom).commutes r

name: P23.Artin.augmentationIdeal_isMaximal
statement:
theorem augmentationIdeal_isMaximal (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (hS : S.Nonempty) (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) :
    (augmentationIdeal (k := k) S hS hdom).IsMaximal
proof:
:= by
  exact RingHom.ker_isMaximal_of_surjective
    (constantCoeffAlgHom (k := k) S hS hdom).toRingHom
    (constantCoeffAlgHom_surjective (k := k) S hS hdom)

name: P23.Artin.X_variable_mem_variableIdeal
statement:
theorem X_variable_mem_variableIdeal (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (hlive : IsLiveTie S) (e : Direction) :
    X (k := k) S e.generator
        ((mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet S _).2 (by
          cases e with
          | x => exact hlive.1
          | y => exact hlive.2.1
          | z => exact hlive.2.2.1)) ∈
      variableIdeal (k := k) S hlive
proof:
:= by
  apply Ideal.subset_span
  cases e <;> simp [variableBasisSet, Direction.generator]

name: P23.Artin.X_variable_mem_augmentationIdeal
statement:
theorem X_variable_mem_augmentationIdeal (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (hS : S.Nonempty) (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c)
    (hlive : IsLiveTie S) (e : Direction) :
    X (k := k) S e.generator
        ((mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet S _).2 (by
          cases e with
          | x => exact hlive.1
          | y => exact hlive.2.1
          | z => exact hlive.2.2.1)) ∈
      augmentationIdeal (k := k) S hS hdom
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_augmentationIdeal_iff]
  have hne : e.generator ≠ (1 : Normal a b c) :=
    variableGenerators_ne_one_of_two_le hdom.1 e
  have hval : (unitIndex S hS).1 ≠ e.generator := by
    simpa [unitIndex] using (Ne.symm hne)
  simp [constantCoeff, hval]

name: P23.Artin.X_mem_variableIdeal_of_ne_one
statement:
theorem X_mem_variableIdeal_of_ne_one (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (hlive : IsLiveTie S) (p : Normal a b c)
    (hp : p ∈ standardFinset S) (hp1 : p ≠ 1) :
    X (k := k) S p hp ∈ variableIdeal (k := k) S hlive
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, q, hpred⟩ := exists_predecessor_of_ne_one p hp1
  have hqp : q * e.generator = p :=
    (Normal.predecessor_eq_some_iff_mul e p q).1 hpred
  have hqSet : q ∈ standardSet S := by
    apply standardSet_dvd_closed S ((mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet S p).1 hp)
    exact ⟨e.generator, hqp.symm⟩
  have hq : q ∈ standardFinset S :=
    (mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet S q).2 hqSet
  have heSet : e.generator ∈ standardSet S := by
    cases e with
    | x => exact hlive.1
    | y => exact hlive.2.1
    | z => exact hlive.2.2.1
  have he : e.generator ∈ standardFinset S :=
    (mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet S e.generator).2 heSet
  have hxe : X (k := k) S e.generator he ∈ variableIdeal (k := k) S hlive :=
    X_variable_mem_variableIdeal (k := k) S hlive e
  have hprod := (variableIdeal (k := k) S hlive).mul_mem_left
    (X (k := k) S q hq) hxe
  simpa [MonomialArtin.X_mul_X, hqp, hp] using hprod

name: P23.Artin.variableIdeal_le_augmentationIdeal
statement:
theorem variableIdeal_le_augmentationIdeal (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (hS : S.Nonempty) (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c)
    (hlive : IsLiveTie S) :
    variableIdeal (k := k) S hlive ≤ augmentationIdeal (k := k) S hS hdom
proof:
:= by
  apply Ideal.span_le.2
  intro v hv
  simp only [variableBasisSet, Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hv
  rcases hv with rfl | rfl | rfl
  · exact X_variable_mem_augmentationIdeal (k := k) S hS hdom hlive .x
  · exact X_variable_mem_augmentationIdeal (k := k) S hS hdom hlive .y
  · exact X_variable_mem_augmentationIdeal (k := k) S hS hdom hlive .z

name: P23.Artin.augmentationIdeal_le_variableIdeal
statement:
theorem augmentationIdeal_le_variableIdeal (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (hS : S.Nonempty) (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c)
    (hlive : IsLiveTie S) :
    augmentationIdeal (k := k) S hS hdom ≤ variableIdeal (k := k) S hlive
proof:
:= by
  intro v hv
  have hv0 : constantCoeff (k := k) S hS v = 0 :=
    (mem_augmentationIdeal_iff (k := k) S hS hdom v).1 hv
  rw [MonomialArtin.basis_expansion v]
  apply Submodule.sum_mem
  intro p hpSupport
  by_cases hp1 : p.1 = 1
  · have hpUnit : p = unitIndex S hS := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact hp1
    have hcoeff : v.coeff p = 0 := by
      subst p
      exact hv0
    simp [hcoeff]
  · have hx := X_mem_variableIdeal_of_ne_one (k := k) S hlive p.1 p.2 hp1
    simpa [Algebra.smul_def] using
      (variableIdeal (k := k) S hlive).mul_mem_left
        (algebraMap k (MonomialArtin k S) (v.coeff p)) hx

name: P23.Artin.variableIdeal_eq_augmentationIdeal
statement:
theorem variableIdeal_eq_augmentationIdeal (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (hS : S.Nonempty) (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c)
    (hlive : IsLiveTie S) :
    variableIdeal (k := k) S hlive = augmentationIdeal (k := k) S hS hdom
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm
    (variableIdeal_le_augmentationIdeal (k := k) S hS hdom hlive)
    (augmentationIdeal_le_variableIdeal (k := k) S hS hdom hlive)

name: P23.Artin.directNearlyGorenstein_iff_variablesInTrace
statement:
theorem directNearlyGorenstein_iff_variablesInTrace
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) (hlive : IsLiveTie S) :
    DirectNearlyGorenstein k S hS hdom ↔ VariablesInTrace k S hlive
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hng
    exact ⟨hng (X_variable_mem_augmentationIdeal (k := k) S hS hdom hlive .x),
      hng (X_variable_mem_augmentationIdeal (k := k) S hS hdom hlive .y),
      hng (X_variable_mem_augmentationIdeal (k := k) S hS hdom hlive .z)⟩
  · intro htrace
    unfold DirectNearlyGorenstein
    rw [← variableIdeal_eq_augmentationIdeal (k := k) S hS hdom hlive]
    apply Ideal.span_le.2
    intro v hv
    simp only [variableBasisSet, Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hv
    rcases hv with rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact htrace.1
    · exact htrace.2.1
    · exact htrace.2.2

name: P23.Artin.nonempty_of_isLiveTie
statement:
theorem nonempty_of_isLiveTie (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (hlive : IsLiveTie S) : S.Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hS
  rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at hS
  subst S
  simpa [IsLiveTie, standardSet] using hlive.1

name: P23.Artin.mixed_directModel_HL5_of_nearlyGorenstein
statement:
theorem mixed_directModel_HL5_of_nearlyGorenstein
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hc : 1 ≤ c)
    (hcard : S.card = 3) (hlive : IsLiveTie S)
    (hanti : IsRootAntichain S)
    (hng : DirectNearlyGorenstein k S (nonempty_of_isLiveTie S hlive)
      ⟨ha, Or.inl ⟨hb, hc⟩⟩) :
    (borderFinset S).card ≠ 4
proof:
:= by
  apply mixed_directModel_HL5 (k := k) S ha hb hc hcard hlive hanti
  exact (directNearlyGorenstein_iff_variablesInTrace
    (k := k) S (nonempty_of_isLiveTie S hlive)
      ⟨ha, Or.inl ⟨hb, hc⟩⟩ hlive).1 hng

name: P23.Artin.pure_directModel_HL5_of_nearlyGorenstein
statement:
theorem pure_directModel_HL5_of_nearlyGorenstein
    (S : Finset (Normal a b 0)) (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 2 ≤ b)
    (hcard : S.card = 3) (hlive : IsLiveTie S)
    (hanti : IsRootAntichain S)
    (hng : DirectNearlyGorenstein k S (nonempty_of_isLiveTie S hlive)
      ⟨ha, Or.inr ⟨hb, rfl⟩⟩) :
    (borderFinset S).card ≠ 4
proof:
:= by
  apply pure_directModel_HL5 (k := k) S ha hb hcard hlive hanti
  exact (directNearlyGorenstein_iff_variablesInTrace
    (k := k) S (nonempty_of_isLiveTie S hlive)
      ⟨ha, Or.inr ⟨hb, rfl⟩⟩ hlive).1 hng

name: P23.Artin.directNearlyGorenstein_HL5
statement:
theorem directNearlyGorenstein_HL5 : DirectNearlyGorensteinHL5 (k := k) where
  mixed
proof:
:= by
    intro a b c _ S ha hb hc hcard hlive hanti hng
    exact mixed_directModel_HL5_of_nearlyGorenstein
      (k := k) S ha hb hc hcard hlive hanti hng
  pure := by
    intro a b _ S ha hb hcard hlive hanti hng
    exact pure_directModel_HL5_of_nearlyGorenstein
      (k := k) S ha hb hcard hlive hanti hng

name: P23.Artin.dual_relation_of_common_quotient
statement:
theorem dual_relation_of_common_quotient (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (m n q s t : MonomialIndex S)
    (hms : m.1 * q.1 = s.1) (hnt : n.1 * q.1 = t.1) :
    X (k := k) S m.1 m.2 • U (k := k) S s =
      X (k := k) S n.1 n.2 • U (k := k) S t
proof:
:= by
  rw [X_smul_U_eq_U (k := k) S m q s hms]
  rw [X_smul_U_eq_U (k := k) S n q t hnt]

name: P23.Artin.coeff_transfer_of_dual_relation
statement:
theorem coeff_transfer_of_dual_relation (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (F : Omega k S →ₗ[MonomialArtin k S] MonomialArtin k S)
    (m n e h w s t : MonomialIndex S)
    (hrel : X (k := k) S m.1 m.2 • U (k := k) S s =
      X (k := k) S n.1 n.2 • U (k := k) S t)
    (hmew : m.1 * e.1 = w.1) (hnhw : n.1 * h.1 = w.1) :
    coeffAt (k := k) S e (F (U (k := k) S s)) =
      coeffAt (k := k) S h (F (U (k := k) S t))
proof:
:= by
  have hmap :
      X (k := k) S m.1 m.2 * F (U (k := k) S s) =
        X (k := k) S n.1 n.2 * F (U (k := k) S t) := by
    simpa [smul_eq_mul] using congrArg F hrel
  have hcoeff := congrArg (coeffAt (k := k) S w) hmap
  rw [coeffAt_X_mul (k := k) S m e w hmew,
    coeffAt_X_mul (k := k) S n h w hnhw] at hcoeff
  exact hcoeff

name: P23.Artin.coeff_transfer_of_common_quotient
statement:
theorem coeff_transfer_of_common_quotient (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (F : Omega k S →ₗ[MonomialArtin k S] MonomialArtin k S)
    (m n q e h w s t : MonomialIndex S)
    (hms : m.1 * q.1 = s.1) (hnt : n.1 * q.1 = t.1)
    (hmew : m.1 * e.1 = w.1) (hnhw : n.1 * h.1 = w.1) :
    coeffAt (k := k) S e (F (U (k := k) S s)) =
      coeffAt (k := k) S h (F (U (k := k) S t))
proof:
:=
  coeff_transfer_of_dual_relation (k := k) S F m n e h w s t
    (dual_relation_of_common_quotient (k := k) S m n q s t hms hnt)
    hmew hnhw

name: P23.Artin.coeff_eq_zero_of_annihilator
statement:
theorem coeff_eq_zero_of_annihilator (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (F : Omega k S →ₗ[MonomialArtin k S] MonomialArtin k S)
    (l h g s : MonomialIndex S)
    (hzero : X (k := k) S l.1 l.2 • U (k := k) S s = 0)
    (hlhg : l.1 * h.1 = g.1) :
    coeffAt (k := k) S h (F (U (k := k) S s)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hmap :
      X (k := k) S l.1 l.2 * F (U (k := k) S s) = 0 := by
    simpa [smul_eq_mul] using congrArg F hzero
  have hcoeff := congrArg (coeffAt (k := k) S g) hmap
  rw [coeffAt_X_mul (k := k) S l h g hlhg] at hcoeff
  simpa using hcoeff

name: P23.Artin.Omega.smul_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smul_apply (r : MonomialArtin k S) (φ : Omega k S)
    (x : MonomialArtin k S) : (r • φ) x = φ (r * x)
proof: := rfl

name: P23.Artin.Omega.U_apply_X
statement:
@[simp]
theorem U_apply_X (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (p q : MonomialIndex S) :
    U (k := k) S p (X (k := k) S q.1 q.2) = if p = q then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa [U] using
    (Module.Basis.dualBasis_apply_self (MonomialArtin.monomialBasis k S) p q)
      |>.trans (by simp [eq_comm])

name: P23.Artin.Omega.X_smul_U_apply_X
statement:
theorem X_smul_U_apply_X (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (m q s : MonomialIndex S) :
    (X (k := k) S m.1 m.2 • U (k := k) S s)
        (X (k := k) S q.1 q.2) =
      if m.1 * q.1 = s.1 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [smul_apply, MonomialArtin.X_mul_X]
  by_cases hmq : m.1 * q.1 ∈ standardFinset S
  · simp only [dif_pos hmq]
    let t : MonomialIndex S := ⟨m.1 * q.1, hmq⟩
    change U (k := k) S s (X (k := k) S t.1 t.2) = _
    rw [U_apply_X]
    simp [t, Subtype.ext_iff, eq_comm]
  · have hne : m.1 * q.1 ≠ s.1 := by
      intro h
      apply hmq
      simpa [h] using s.2
    simp [hmq, hne]

name: P23.Artin.Omega.X_smul_U_eq_U
statement:
theorem X_smul_U_eq_U (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (m q s : MonomialIndex S) (h : m.1 * q.1 = s.1) :
    X (k := k) S m.1 m.2 • U (k := k) S s = U (k := k) S q
proof:
:= by
  apply (MonomialArtin.monomialBasis k S).ext
  intro r
  simp only [MonomialArtin.monomialBasis_apply]
  rw [X_smul_U_apply_X, U_apply_X]
  have hiff : m.1 * r.1 = s.1 ↔ r = q := by
    constructor
    · intro hr
      apply Subtype.ext
      apply Normal.mul_left_cancel
      exact hr.trans h.symm
    · rintro rfl
      exact h
  simp [hiff, eq_comm]

name: P23.Artin.Omega.U_ne_zero
statement:
theorem U_ne_zero (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (p : MonomialIndex S) :
    U (k := k) S p ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hc := congrArg (fun φ : Omega k S ↦
    φ (X (k := k) S p.1 p.2)) h
  simpa [U_apply_X] using hc

name: P23.Artin.Omega.U_mem_rootDual_span
proof:
:= by
  have hpstd : p.1 ∈ standardSet S :=
    (mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet S p.1).1 p.2
  rcases hpstd with ⟨s, hs, hpdiv⟩
  rcases hpdiv with ⟨w, hw⟩
  have hsstd : s ∈ standardSet S := ⟨s, hs, dvd_rfl⟩
  have hwstd : w ∈ standardSet S :=
    standardSet_dvd_closed S hsstd ⟨p.1, by simpa [mul_comm] using hw⟩
  let wi : MonomialIndex S :=
    ⟨w, (mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet S w).2 hwstd⟩
  have hprod : wi.1 * p.1 = (rootIndex S s hs).1 := by
    simpa [wi, rootIndex, mul_comm] using hw.symm
  have hroot : U (k := k) S (rootIndex S s hs) ∈
      Submodule.span (MonomialArtin k S) (rootDualSet k S) :=
    Submodule.subset_span ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
  rw [← X_smul_U_eq_U (k := k) S wi p (rootIndex S s hs) hprod]
  exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hroot

name: P23.Artin.Omega.rootDual_span_eq_top
statement:
theorem rootDual_span_eq_top (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) :
    Submodule.span (MonomialArtin k S) (rootDualSet k S) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  let P := Submodule.span (MonomialArtin k S) (rootDualSet k S)
  apply top_unique
  intro φ _
  have hspan : Submodule.span k
      (Set.range (MonomialArtin.monomialBasis k S).dualBasis) ≤
      P.restrictScalars k := by
    apply Submodule.span_le.2
    rintro _ ⟨p, rfl⟩
    exact U_mem_rootDual_span (k := k) S p
  rw [(MonomialArtin.monomialBasis k S).dualBasis.span_eq] at hspan
  exact hspan (Submodule.mem_top)

name: P23.Artin.Omega.X_smul_rootDual_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem X_smul_rootDual_eq_zero_iff (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (s : Normal a b c) (hs : s ∈ S) (w : MonomialIndex S) :
    X (k := k) S w.1 w.2 • U (k := k) S (rootIndex S s hs) = 0 ↔
      ¬ w.1 ∣ s
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hzero hdiv
    rcases hdiv with ⟨q, hq⟩
    have hsstd : s ∈ standardSet S := ⟨s, hs, dvd_rfl⟩
    have hqstd : q ∈ standardSet S :=
      standardSet_dvd_closed S hsstd ⟨w.1, by simpa [mul_comm] using hq⟩
    let qi : MonomialIndex S :=
      ⟨q, (mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet S q).2 hqstd⟩
    have hprod : w.1 * qi.1 = (rootIndex S s hs).1 := by
      simpa [qi, rootIndex, mul_comm] using hq.symm
    have hact := X_smul_U_eq_U (k := k) S w qi (rootIndex S s hs) hprod
    rw [hact] at hzero
    exact U_ne_zero (k := k) S qi hzero
  · intro hndiv
    apply (MonomialArtin.monomialBasis k S).ext
    intro q
    simp only [MonomialArtin.monomialBasis_apply]
    rw [X_smul_U_apply_X]
    have hne : w.1 * q.1 ≠ (rootIndex S s hs).1 := by
      intro heq
      apply hndiv
      exact ⟨q.1, by simpa [rootIndex] using heq.symm⟩
    simp [hne]

name: P23.Artin.normalWeight_pow
statement:
private theorem normalWeight_pow (p : Normal a b c) (n : ℕ) :
    normalWeight (p ^ n) = n * normalWeight p
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [normalWeight]
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [pow_succ, normalWeight_mul, ih]
      simp [Nat.succ_mul]

name: P23.Artin.normalWeight_le_standardWeightBound
statement:
private theorem normalWeight_le_standardWeightBound
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) {p : Normal a b c}
    (hp : p ∈ standardFinset S) :
    normalWeight p ≤ standardWeightBound S
proof:
:= by
  unfold standardWeightBound
  exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) hp

name: P23.Artin.variable_pow_not_mem_standardFinset
statement:
private theorem variable_pow_not_mem_standardFinset
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c)
    (e : Direction) :
    e.generator ^ (standardWeightBound S + 1) ∉ standardFinset S
proof:
:= by
  intro hmem
  have hle := normalWeight_le_standardWeightBound S hmem
  rw [normalWeight_pow] at hle
  have hpos : 0 < normalWeight (e.generator : Normal a b c) :=
    normalWeight_pos_of_ne_one hdom e.generator
      (variableGenerators_ne_one_of_two_le hdom.1 e)
  nlinarith

name: P23.Artin.X_pow_formula
statement:
private theorem X_pow_formula (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (hS : S.Nonempty) (p : Normal a b c) (hp : p ∈ standardFinset S) :
    ∀ n : ℕ,
      (X (k := k) S p hp) ^ n =
        if h : p ^ n ∈ standardFinset S then X (k := k) S (p ^ n) h else 0
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      have h1 := one_mem_standardFinset S hS
      simp [h1, MonomialArtin.X_one (k := k) S hS]
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [pow_succ, ih]
      by_cases hn : p ^ n ∈ standardFinset S
      · simp only [dif_pos hn]
        rw [MonomialArtin.X_mul_X]
        simp only [pow_succ]
      · have hsucc : p ^ (n + 1) ∉ standardFinset S := by
          intro hmem
          apply hn
          apply MonomialArtin.mem_standardFinset_of_mul_mem_left S
          simpa [pow_succ] using hmem
        simp [hn, hsucc]

name: P23.Artin.variableBasis_isNilpotent
statement:
theorem variableBasis_isNilpotent (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (hS : S.Nonempty) (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c)
    (hlive : IsLiveTie S) (e : Direction) :
    IsNilpotent
      (X (k := k) S e.generator
        ((mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet S _).2 (by
          cases e with
          | x => exact hlive.1
          | y => exact hlive.2.1
          | z => exact hlive.2.2.1)))
proof:
:= by
  let he : e.generator ∈ standardFinset S :=
    (mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet S _).2 (by
      cases e with
      | x => exact hlive.1
      | y => exact hlive.2.1
      | z => exact hlive.2.2.1)
  refine ⟨standardWeightBound S + 1, ?_⟩
  rw [X_pow_formula (k := k) S hS e.generator he]
  simp [variable_pow_not_mem_standardFinset S hdom e]

name: P23.Artin.xBasis_isNilpotent
statement:
theorem xBasis_isNilpotent (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (hS : S.Nonempty) (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c)
    (hlive : IsLiveTie S) :
    IsNilpotent
      (X (k := k) S Normal.xGenerator
        ((mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet S _).2 hlive.1))
proof:
:=
  variableBasis_isNilpotent (k := k) S hS hdom hlive .x

name: P23.Artin.yBasis_isNilpotent
statement:
theorem yBasis_isNilpotent (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (hS : S.Nonempty) (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c)
    (hlive : IsLiveTie S) :
    IsNilpotent
      (X (k := k) S Normal.yGenerator
        ((mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet S _).2 hlive.2.1))
proof:
:=
  variableBasis_isNilpotent (k := k) S hS hdom hlive .y

name: P23.Artin.zBasis_isNilpotent
statement:
theorem zBasis_isNilpotent (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (hS : S.Nonempty) (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c)
    (hlive : IsLiveTie S) :
    IsNilpotent
      (X (k := k) S Normal.zGenerator
        ((mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet S _).2 hlive.2.2.1))
proof:
:=
  variableBasis_isNilpotent (k := k) S hS hdom hlive .z

name: P23.Artin.maximalIdeal_eq_augmentationIdeal
statement:
theorem maximalIdeal_eq_augmentationIdeal
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) (hlive : IsLiveTie S)
    (I : Ideal (MonomialArtin k S)) (hI : I.IsMaximal) :
    I = augmentationIdeal (k := k) S hS hdom
proof:
:= by
  have hvars : variableIdeal (k := k) S hlive ≤ I := by
    apply Ideal.span_le.2
    intro v hv
    simp only [variableBasisSet, Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hv
    rcases hv with rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact (nilpotent_iff_mem_prime.mp
        (xBasis_isNilpotent (k := k) S hS hdom hlive)) I hI.isPrime
    · exact (nilpotent_iff_mem_prime.mp
        (yBasis_isNilpotent (k := k) S hS hdom hlive)) I hI.isPrime
    · exact (nilpotent_iff_mem_prime.mp
        (zBasis_isNilpotent (k := k) S hS hdom hlive)) I hI.isPrime
  have haug : augmentationIdeal (k := k) S hS hdom ≤ I := by
    rw [← variableIdeal_eq_augmentationIdeal (k := k) S hS hdom hlive]
    exact hvars
  exact (augmentationIdeal_isMaximal (k := k) S hS hdom).eq_of_le hI.ne_top haug |>.symm

name: P23.Artin.directIsLocalRing
statement:
theorem directIsLocalRing (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) (hlive : IsLiveTie S) :
    IsLocalRing (MonomialArtin k S)
proof:
:= by
  apply IsLocalRing.of_unique_max_ideal
  refine ⟨augmentationIdeal (k := k) S hS hdom,
    augmentationIdeal_isMaximal (k := k) S hS hdom, ?_⟩
  intro I hI
  exact maximalIdeal_eq_augmentationIdeal (k := k) S hS hdom hlive I hI

name: P23.Artin.localMaximalIdeal_eq_augmentationIdeal
statement:
theorem localMaximalIdeal_eq_augmentationIdeal
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) (hlive : IsLiveTie S) :
    letI
proof:
:= directIsLocalRing (k := k) S hS hdom hlive
    IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (MonomialArtin k S) =
      augmentationIdeal (k := k) S hS hdom := by
  letI := directIsLocalRing (k := k) S hS hdom hlive
  exact IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal
    (augmentationIdeal_isMaximal (k := k) S hS hdom) |>.symm

name: P23.Artin.mem_directSocle_iff
statement:
theorem mem_directSocle_iff (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (hS : S.Nonempty) (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c)
    (v : MonomialArtin k S) :
    v ∈ DirectSocle (k := k) S hS hdom ↔
      ∀ r ∈ augmentationIdeal (k := k) S hS hdom, r * v = 0
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: P23.Artin.mem_directSocle_iff_variables
statement:
theorem mem_directSocle_iff_variables
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) (hlive : IsLiveTie S)
    (v : MonomialArtin k S) :
    v ∈ DirectSocle (k := k) S hS hdom ↔
      X (k := k) S Normal.xGenerator
          ((mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet S _).2 hlive.1) * v = 0 ∧
      X (k := k) S Normal.yGenerator
          ((mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet S _).2 hlive.2.1) * v = 0 ∧
      X (k := k) S Normal.zGenerator
          ((mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet S _).2 hlive.2.2.1) * v = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hv
    exact ⟨hv _ (X_variable_mem_augmentationIdeal
        (k := k) S hS hdom hlive .x),
      hv _ (X_variable_mem_augmentationIdeal
        (k := k) S hS hdom hlive .y),
      hv _ (X_variable_mem_augmentationIdeal
        (k := k) S hS hdom hlive .z)⟩
  · rintro ⟨hx, hy, hz⟩
    intro r hr
    have hspan : variableIdeal (k := k) S hlive ≤
        elementAnnihilatorIdeal (k := k) S v := by
      apply Ideal.span_le.2
      intro t ht
      simp only [variableBasisSet, Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at ht
      rcases ht with rfl | rfl | rfl
      · exact hx
      · exact hy
      · exact hz
    apply hspan
    rw [variableIdeal_eq_augmentationIdeal (k := k) S hS hdom hlive]
    exact hr

name: P23.Artin.root_mul_variable_eq_zero
statement:
theorem root_mul_variable_eq_zero
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c)
    (hlive : IsLiveTie S) (hanti : IsRootAntichain S)
    {s : Normal a b c} (hs : s ∈ S) (e : Direction) :
    X (k := k) S s (root_mem_standardFinset S hs) *
        X (k := k) S e.generator
          ((mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet S _).2 (by
            cases e with
            | x => exact hlive.1
            | y => exact hlive.2.1
            | z => exact hlive.2.2.1)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hkill : s * e.generator ∉ standardFinset S := by
    intro hmem
    rcases (mem_standardFinset_iff S (s * e.generator)).1 hmem with
      ⟨t, ht, hdiv⟩
    have hst : s ∣ t := dvd_trans ⟨e.generator, rfl⟩ hdiv
    by_cases hts : t = s
    · subst t
      rcases hdiv with ⟨q, hq⟩
      have hcancel : e.generator * q = (1 : Normal a b c) := by
        apply Normal.mul_left_cancel (p := s)
        simpa [mul_assoc] using hq
      exact (variableGenerators_ne_one_of_two_le hdom.1 e)
        ((mul_eq_one_iff hdom e.generator q).1 hcancel).1
    · exact (hanti s hs t ht (Ne.symm hts)) hst
  simpa [MonomialArtin.X_mul_X, hkill]

name: P23.Artin.root_X_mem_directSocle
statement:
theorem root_X_mem_directSocle
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) (hlive : IsLiveTie S)
    (hanti : IsRootAntichain S) {s : Normal a b c} (hs : s ∈ S) :
    X (k := k) S s (root_mem_standardFinset S hs) ∈
      DirectSocle (k := k) S hS hdom
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_directSocle_iff_variables (k := k) S hS hdom hlive]
  exact ⟨by simpa [Direction.generator, mul_comm] using
      root_mul_variable_eq_zero (k := k) S hdom hlive hanti hs .x,
    by simpa [Direction.generator, mul_comm] using
      root_mul_variable_eq_zero (k := k) S hdom hlive hanti hs .y,
    by simpa [Direction.generator, mul_comm] using
      root_mul_variable_eq_zero (k := k) S hdom hlive hanti hs .z⟩

name: P23.Artin.exists_variable_mul_mem_standardFinset_of_not_root
statement:
theorem exists_variable_mul_mem_standardFinset_of_not_root
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (p : MonomialIndex S)
    (hp : p.1 ∉ S) :
    ∃ e : Direction, p.1 * e.generator ∈ standardFinset S
proof:
:= by
  rcases (mem_standardFinset_iff S p.1).1 p.2 with ⟨s, hs, hps⟩
  have hpne : p.1 ≠ s := fun h => hp (h ▸ hs)
  rcases properDivisor_factors_through_predecessor hps hpne with
    ⟨e, q, hpred, hpq⟩
  refine ⟨e, (mem_standardFinset_iff S _).2 ⟨s, hs, ?_⟩⟩
  rcases hpq with ⟨t, rfl⟩
  have hmul : (p.1 * t) * e.generator = s :=
    (Normal.predecessor_eq_some_iff_mul e s (p.1 * t)).1 hpred
  exact ⟨t, by simpa [mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm] using hmul.symm⟩

name: P23.Artin.monomial_mem_roots_of_mem_directSocle
statement:
theorem monomial_mem_roots_of_mem_directSocle
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) (hlive : IsLiveTie S)
    (hanti : IsRootAntichain S) (p : MonomialIndex S)
    (hpSoc : X (k := k) S p.1 p.2 ∈ DirectSocle (k := k) S hS hdom) :
    p.1 ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hp
  rcases exists_variable_mul_mem_standardFinset_of_not_root S p hp with
    ⟨e, hpe⟩
  have heSet : e.generator ∈ standardSet S := by
    cases e with
    | x => exact hlive.1
    | y => exact hlive.2.1
    | z => exact hlive.2.2.1
  let he : e.generator ∈ standardFinset S :=
    (mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet S _).2 heSet
  have hzero : X (k := k) S e.generator he * X (k := k) S p.1 p.2 = 0 := by
    have hvars := (mem_directSocle_iff_variables
      (k := k) S hS hdom hlive (X (k := k) S p.1 p.2)).1 hpSoc
    cases e with
    | x => simpa [he, Direction.generator] using hvars.1
    | y => simpa [he, Direction.generator] using hvars.2.1
    | z => simpa [he, Direction.generator] using hvars.2.2
  have hprod :
      X (k := k) S e.generator he * X (k := k) S p.1 p.2 =
        X (k := k) S (p.1 * e.generator) hpe := by
    simpa [MonomialArtin.X_mul_X, hpe, mul_comm]
  exact (MonomialArtin.X_ne_zero (k := k) S (p.1 * e.generator) hpe)
    (hprod.symm.trans hzero)

name: P23.Artin.coeff_eq_zero_of_mem_directSocle_of_not_root
statement:
private theorem coeff_eq_zero_of_mem_directSocle_of_not_root
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) (hlive : IsLiveTie S)
    (v : MonomialArtin k S) (hv : v ∈ DirectSocle (k := k) S hS hdom)
    (p : MonomialIndex S) (hp : p.1 ∉ S) : v.coeff p = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases exists_variable_mul_mem_standardFinset_of_not_root S p hp with
    ⟨e, hpe⟩
  have heSet : e.generator ∈ standardSet S := by
    cases e with
    | x => exact hlive.1
    | y => exact hlive.2.1
    | z => exact hlive.2.2.1
  let he : e.generator ∈ standardFinset S :=
    (mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet S _).2 heSet
  let ei : MonomialIndex S := ⟨e.generator, he⟩
  let ti : MonomialIndex S := ⟨p.1 * e.generator, hpe⟩
  have hzero : X (k := k) S e.generator he * v = 0 := by
    have hvars := (mem_directSocle_iff_variables
      (k := k) S hS hdom hlive v).1 hv
    cases e with
    | x => simpa [he, Direction.generator] using hvars.1
    | y => simpa [he, Direction.generator] using hvars.2.1
    | z => simpa [he, Direction.generator] using hvars.2.2
  calc
    v.coeff p = coeffAt (k := k) S p v := rfl
    _ = coeffAt (k := k) S ti (X (k := k) S e.generator he * v) := by
      symm
      apply coeffAt_X_mul (k := k) S ei p ti
      simp [ei, ti, mul_comm]
    _ = 0 := by rw [hzero]; simp

name: P23.Artin.directSocle_eq_rootSpan
statement:
theorem directSocle_eq_rootSpan
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) (hlive : IsLiveTie S)
    (hanti : IsRootAntichain S) :
    DirectSocle (k := k) S hS hdom = rootSpan (k := k) S
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro v hv
    rw [MonomialArtin.basis_expansion v]
    apply Submodule.sum_mem
    intro p hpSupport
    by_cases hp : p.1 ∈ S
    · apply Submodule.smul_mem
      apply Submodule.subset_span
      exact ⟨⟨p.1, hp⟩, by simp [rootBasisSet, rootBasisVector]⟩
    · have hc := coeff_eq_zero_of_mem_directSocle_of_not_root
        (k := k) S hS hdom hlive v hv p hp
      simp [hc]
  · apply Submodule.span_le.2
    rintro v ⟨s, rfl⟩
    exact root_X_mem_directSocle (k := k) S hS hdom hlive hanti s.2

name: P23.Artin.rootMonomialIndex_injective
statement:
private theorem rootMonomialIndex_injective (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) :
    Function.Injective (rootMonomialIndex S)
proof:
:= by
  intro s t h
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact congrArg (fun p : MonomialIndex S => p.1) h

name: P23.Artin.rootBasis_linearIndependent
statement:
theorem rootBasis_linearIndependent (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) :
    LinearIndependent k (rootBasisVector (k := k) S)
proof:
:= by
  change LinearIndependent k
    ((MonomialArtin.monomialBasis k S) ∘ rootMonomialIndex S)
  exact (MonomialArtin.monomialBasis k S).linearIndependent.comp
    (rootMonomialIndex S) (rootMonomialIndex_injective S)

name: P23.Artin.directSocle_finrank_eq_card
statement:
theorem directSocle_finrank_eq_card
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) (hlive : IsLiveTie S)
    (hanti : IsRootAntichain S) :
    Module.finrank k (DirectSocle (k := k) S hS hdom) = S.card
proof:
:= by
  rw [directSocle_eq_rootSpan (k := k) S hS hdom hlive hanti]
  unfold rootSpan rootBasisSet
  rw [finrank_span_eq_card (rootBasis_linearIndependent (k := k) S)]
  exact Fintype.card_coe S

name: P23.Artin.directType_eq_rootCard
statement:
theorem directType_eq_rootCard
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) (hlive : IsLiveTie S)
    (hanti : IsRootAntichain S) :
    directType k S hS hdom = S.card
proof:
:=
  directSocle_finrank_eq_card (k := k) S hS hdom hlive hanti

name: P23.Artin.directType_eq_three_iff
statement:
theorem directType_eq_three_iff
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) (hlive : IsLiveTie S)
    (hanti : IsRootAntichain S) :
    directType k S hS hdom = 3 ↔ S.card = 3
proof:
:= by
  rw [directType_eq_rootCard (k := k) S hS hdom hlive hanti]

name: P23.Artin.directNearlyGorenstein_iff_localMaximalIdeal_le_trace
statement:
theorem directNearlyGorenstein_iff_localMaximalIdeal_le_trace
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) (hlive : IsLiveTie S) :
    letI
proof:
:= directIsLocalRing (k := k) S hS hdom hlive
    DirectNearlyGorenstein k S hS hdom ↔
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (MonomialArtin k S) ≤ TraceSubmodule k S := by
  letI := directIsLocalRing (k := k) S hS hdom hlive
  rw [localMaximalIdeal_eq_augmentationIdeal (k := k) S hS hdom hlive]
  rfl

name: P23.Artin.directLocalArtinStructure
statement:
theorem directLocalArtinStructure
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) (hlive : IsLiveTie S)
    (hanti : IsRootAntichain S) :
    DirectLocalArtinStructure (k := k) (S := S) (hS := hS)
      (hdom := hdom) (hlive := hlive)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, directIsLocalRing (k := k) S hS hdom hlive,
    directSocle_eq_rootSpan (k := k) S hS hdom hlive hanti,
    directSocle_finrank_eq_card (k := k) S hS hdom hlive hanti,
    directType_eq_rootCard (k := k) S hS hdom hlive hanti, ?_⟩
  · intro I hI
    exact maximalIdeal_eq_augmentationIdeal (k := k) S hS hdom hlive I hI
  · exact directNearlyGorenstein_iff_localMaximalIdeal_le_trace
      (k := k) S hS hdom hlive

name: P23.Artin.one_mem_standardSet
statement:
theorem one_mem_standardSet (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (hS : S.Nonempty) :
    (1 : Normal a b c) ∈ standardSet S
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hS
  exact ⟨s, hs, one_dvd s⟩

name: P23.Artin.one_mem_standardFinset
statement:
theorem one_mem_standardFinset (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (hS : S.Nonempty) :
    (1 : Normal a b c) ∈ standardFinset S
proof:
:=
  (mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet S 1).2 (one_mem_standardSet S hS)

name: P23.Artin.MonomialArtin.coeff_injective
statement:
theorem coeff_injective :
    Function.Injective (coeff : MonomialArtin k S → MonomialIndex S →₀ k)
proof:
:=
  (coeffEquiv k S).injective

name: P23.Artin.MonomialArtin.ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem ext {x y : MonomialArtin k S} (h : x.coeff = y.coeff) : x = y
proof:
:=
  coeff_injective h

name: P23.Artin.MonomialArtin.coeff_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem coeff_zero :
    coeff (0 : MonomialArtin k S) = 0
proof: := rfl

name: P23.Artin.MonomialArtin.coeff_add
statement:
@[simp] theorem coeff_add (x y : MonomialArtin k S) :
    coeff (x + y) = coeff x + coeff y
proof: := rfl

name: P23.Artin.MonomialArtin.coeff_neg
statement:
@[simp] theorem coeff_neg (x : MonomialArtin k S) :
    coeff (-x) = -coeff x
proof: := rfl

name: P23.Artin.MonomialArtin.coeff_smul
statement:
@[simp] theorem coeff_smul (r : k) (x : MonomialArtin k S) :
    coeff (r • x) = r • coeff x
proof: := rfl

name: P23.Artin.MonomialArtin.induction_linear
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem induction_linear {P : MonomialArtin k S → Prop}
    (x : MonomialArtin k S) (zero : P 0)
    (add : ∀ x y, P x → P y → P (x + y))
    (single : ∀ p r, P (.ofCoeff (Finsupp.single p r))) : P x
proof:
:= by
  change P (.ofCoeff x.coeff)
  induction x.coeff using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => exact zero
  | add x y hx hy => exact add (.ofCoeff x) (.ofCoeff y) hx hy
  | single p r => exact single p r

name: P23.Artin.MonomialArtin.coeff_X
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeff_X (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (p : Normal a b c)
    (hp : p ∈ standardFinset S) (q : MonomialIndex S) :
    (X (k := k) S p hp).coeff q = if q.1 = p then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [X, Finsupp.single_apply, eq_comm, Subtype.ext_iff]

name: P23.Artin.MonomialArtin.smul_X
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smul_X (r : k) (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (p : Normal a b c)
    (hp : p ∈ standardFinset S) :
    r • X (k := k) S p hp =
      .ofCoeff (Finsupp.single ⟨p, hp⟩ r)
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp [X, Finsupp.single_apply]

name: P23.Artin.MonomialArtin.mul_def
statement:
theorem mul_def (x y : MonomialArtin k S) :
    x * y = x.coeff.sum fun p rp ↦
      y.coeff.sum fun q rq ↦ (rp * rq) • basisProduct (k := k) S p q
proof: := rfl

name: P23.Artin.MonomialArtin.X_mul_X
statement:
@[simp]
theorem X_mul_X (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (p q : Normal a b c)
    (hp : p ∈ standardFinset S) (hq : q ∈ standardFinset S) :
    X (k := k) S p hp * X (k := k) S q hq =
      if h : p * q ∈ standardFinset S then X (k := k) S (p * q) h else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [mul_def, X, basisProduct]

name: P23.Artin.MonomialArtin.smul_mul_raw
statement:
theorem smul_mul_raw (r : k) (x y : MonomialArtin k S) :
    (r • x) * y = r • (x * y)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [mul_def, coeff_smul]
  rw [Finsupp.sum_smul_index (h0 := by simp)]
  rw [Finsupp.smul_sum]
  apply Finsupp.sum_congr
  intro p _
  rw [Finsupp.smul_sum]
  apply Finsupp.sum_congr
  intro q _
  rw [smul_smul]
  apply congrArg (fun t : k ↦ t • basisProduct (k := k) S p q)
  ring

name: P23.Artin.MonomialArtin.mul_smul_raw
statement:
theorem mul_smul_raw (r : k) (x y : MonomialArtin k S) :
    x * (r • y) = r • (x * y)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [mul_def, coeff_smul]
  rw [Finsupp.smul_sum]
  apply Finsupp.sum_congr
  intro p _
  rw [Finsupp.sum_smul_index (h0 := by simp)]
  rw [Finsupp.smul_sum]
  apply Finsupp.sum_congr
  intro q _
  rw [smul_smul]
  apply congrArg (fun t : k ↦ t • basisProduct (k := k) S p q)
  ring

name: P23.Artin.MonomialArtin.mem_standardFinset_of_mul_mem_left
statement:
theorem mem_standardFinset_of_mul_mem_left (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    {p q : Normal a b c} (h : p * q ∈ standardFinset S) :
    p ∈ standardFinset S
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet] at h ⊢
  exact standardSet_dvd_closed S h ⟨q, rfl⟩

name: P23.Artin.MonomialArtin.mem_standardFinset_of_mul_mem_right
statement:
theorem mem_standardFinset_of_mul_mem_right (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    {p q : Normal a b c} (h : p * q ∈ standardFinset S) :
    q ∈ standardFinset S
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet] at h ⊢
  exact standardSet_dvd_closed S h ⟨p, by rw [mul_comm]⟩

name: P23.Artin.MonomialArtin.X_mul_X_mul_X
statement:
private theorem X_mul_X_mul_X (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (p q r : MonomialIndex S) :
    (X (k := k) S p.1 p.2 * X (k := k) S q.1 q.2) * X (k := k) S r.1 r.2 =
      X (k := k) S p.1 p.2 * (X (k := k) S q.1 q.2 * X (k := k) S r.1 r.2)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases htotal : (p.1 * q.1) * r.1 ∈ standardFinset S
  · have hpq : p.1 * q.1 ∈ standardFinset S :=
      mem_standardFinset_of_mul_mem_left S htotal
    have hqr : q.1 * r.1 ∈ standardFinset S := by
      apply mem_standardFinset_of_mul_mem_right S (p := p.1)
      simpa [mul_assoc] using htotal
    simp [X_mul_X, hpq, hqr, htotal, mul_assoc]
  · have htotal' : p.1 * (q.1 * r.1) ∉ standardFinset S := by
      simpa [mul_assoc] using htotal
    by_cases hpq : p.1 * q.1 ∈ standardFinset S <;>
      by_cases hqr : q.1 * r.1 ∈ standardFinset S <;>
      simp [X_mul_X, hpq, hqr, htotal, htotal', mul_assoc]

name: P23.Artin.MonomialArtin.X_mul_X_comm
statement:
private theorem X_mul_X_comm (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (p q : MonomialIndex S) :
    X (k := k) S p.1 p.2 * X (k := k) S q.1 q.2 =
      X (k := k) S q.1 q.2 * X (k := k) S p.1 p.2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [X_mul_X, mul_comm]

name: P23.Artin.MonomialArtin.one_def
statement:
theorem one_def : (1 : MonomialArtin k S) =
    if h : (1 : Normal a b c) ∈ standardFinset S then X (k := k) S 1 h else 0
proof: := rfl

name: P23.Artin.MonomialArtin.standardFinset_nonempty_of_index
statement: private theorem standardFinset_nonempty_of_index (p : MonomialIndex S) : S.Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  have hp := p.2
  rw [mem_standardFinset_iff] at hp
  rcases hp with ⟨s, hs, -⟩
  exact ⟨s, hs⟩

name: P23.Artin.MonomialArtin.one_mul_X
statement:
private theorem one_mul_X (p : MonomialIndex S) :
    (1 : MonomialArtin k S) * X (k := k) S p.1 p.2 = X (k := k) S p.1 p.2
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := one_mem_standardFinset S (standardFinset_nonempty_of_index p)
  simp [one_def, h1, X_mul_X]

name: P23.Artin.MonomialArtin.smul_mul_assoc'
statement:
theorem smul_mul_assoc' (r : k) (x y : MonomialArtin k S) :
    (r • x) * y = r • (x * y)
proof:
:= by
  exact smul_mul_raw r x y

name: P23.Artin.MonomialArtin.mul_smul_comm'
statement:
theorem mul_smul_comm' (r : k) (x y : MonomialArtin k S) :
    x * (r • y) = r • (x * y)
proof:
:= by
  exact mul_smul_raw r x y

name: P23.Artin.MonomialArtin.X_one
statement:
theorem X_one (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (hS : S.Nonempty) :
    X (k := k) S 1 (one_mem_standardFinset S hS) = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [one_def, one_mem_standardFinset S hS]

name: P23.Artin.MonomialArtin.X_ne_zero
statement:
theorem X_ne_zero (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (p : Normal a b c)
    (hp : p ∈ standardFinset S) : X (k := k) S p hp ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hc := congrArg (fun x : MonomialArtin k S ↦ x.coeff ⟨p, hp⟩) h
  simpa [coeff_X] using hc

name: P23.Artin.MonomialArtin.basisSurvives_iff
statement:
theorem basisSurvives_iff (k : Type*) [Field k]
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (p : Normal a b c) :
    BasisSurvives k S p ↔ p ∈ standardSet S
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hp, -⟩
    exact (mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet S p).1 hp
  · intro hp
    have hp' := (mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet S p).2 hp
    exact ⟨hp', X_ne_zero (k := k) S p hp'⟩

name: P23.Artin.MonomialArtin.isLiveTie_iff_basisSurvives
statement:
theorem isLiveTie_iff_basisSurvives (k : Type*) [Field k]
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) :
    IsLiveTie S ↔
      BasisSurvives k S Normal.xGenerator ∧
      BasisSurvives k S Normal.yGenerator ∧
      BasisSurvives k S Normal.zGenerator ∧
      BasisSurvives k S liveTiePoint
proof:
:= by
  simp only [IsLiveTie, basisSurvives_iff]

name: P23.Artin.MonomialArtin.monomialBasis_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem monomialBasis_apply (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (p : MonomialIndex S) :
    monomialBasis k S p = X (k := k) S p.1 p.2
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: P23.Artin.MonomialArtin.basis_expansion
statement:
theorem basis_expansion (x : MonomialArtin k S) :
    x = x.coeff.sum fun p r ↦ r • X (k := k) S p.1 p.2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction x using induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add x y hx hy =>
      rw [coeff_add, Finsupp.sum_add_index']
      · exact congrArg₂ (fun u v : MonomialArtin k S ↦ u + v) hx hy
      · simp
      · intro p r s
        exact add_smul r s _
  | single p r =>
      rw [Finsupp.sum_single_index]
      · exact (smul_X r S p.1 p.2).symm
      · simp

name: P23.Artin.MonomialArtin.finrank_monomialArtin
statement:
theorem finrank_monomialArtin (k : Type*) [Field k]
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) :
    Module.finrank k (MonomialArtin k S) = (standardFinset S).card
proof:
:= by
  rw [Module.finrank_eq_card_basis (monomialBasis k S), Fintype.card_coe]

name: P23.Artin.coeffAt_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeffAt_apply (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (p : MonomialIndex S)
    (v : MonomialArtin k S) : coeffAt (k := k) S p v = v.coeff p
proof: := rfl

name: P23.Artin.coeffAt_X
statement:
theorem coeffAt_X (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (p q : MonomialIndex S) :
    coeffAt (k := k) S p (X (k := k) S q.1 q.2) =
      if p = q then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  change (X (k := k) S q.1 q.2).coeff p = _
  rw [MonomialArtin.coeff_X]
  by_cases h : p = q <;> simp [h]

name: P23.Artin.constantCoeff_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem constantCoeff_one (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (hS : S.Nonempty) :
    constantCoeff (k := k) S hS 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← MonomialArtin.X_one (k := k) S hS]
  simp [constantCoeff, unitIndex]

name: P23.Artin.coeffAt_X_mul
statement:
theorem coeffAt_X_mul (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (m e t : MonomialIndex S) (hmet : m.1 * e.1 = t.1)
    (v : MonomialArtin k S) :
    coeffAt (k := k) S t (X (k := k) S m.1 m.2 * v) =
      coeffAt (k := k) S e v
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction v using MonomialArtin.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add v w hv hw =>
      rw [mul_add, map_add, map_add, hv, hw]
  | single q r =>
      rw [← MonomialArtin.smul_X (k := k) r S q.1 q.2]
      rw [MonomialArtin.mul_smul_comm']
      by_cases hqe : q = e
      · subst q
        simp [MonomialArtin.X_mul_X, hmet, t.2, coeffAt_X]
      · have hprod : m.1 * q.1 ≠ t.1 := by
          intro hp
          apply hqe
          apply Subtype.ext
          apply Normal.mul_left_cancel
          exact hp.trans hmet.symm
        by_cases hsurv : m.1 * q.1 ∈ standardFinset S
        · rw [MonomialArtin.X_mul_X]
          simp only [dif_pos hsurv, map_smul]
          simp only [coeffAt_apply, MonomialArtin.coeff_X]
          have ht : t ≠ ⟨m.1 * q.1, hsurv⟩ := by
            intro heq
            apply hprod
            exact (congrArg Subtype.val heq).symm
          have heq : e ≠ q := fun heq => hqe heq.symm
          have hval : t.1 ≠ m.1 * q.1 := fun hval => hprod hval.symm
          simp [ht, heq, hval]
        · simp [MonomialArtin.X_mul_X, hsurv, hqe, coeffAt_X]

name: P23.Artin.coeffAt_mul_X
statement:
theorem coeffAt_mul_X (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (m e t : MonomialIndex S) (hmet : e.1 * m.1 = t.1)
    (v : MonomialArtin k S) :
    coeffAt (k := k) S t (v * X (k := k) S m.1 m.2) =
      coeffAt (k := k) S e v
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm]
  exact coeffAt_X_mul (k := k) S m e t (by simpa [mul_comm] using hmet) v

name: P23.Artin.normal_eq_one_iff
statement:
private theorem normal_eq_one_iff (p : Normal a b c) :
    p = 1 ↔ p.x = 0 ∧ p.y = 0 ∧ p.z = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro rfl
    simp
  · rintro ⟨hx, hy, hz⟩
    apply Normal.ext <;> simp [hx, hy, hz]

name: P23.Artin.mul_eq_one_iff
statement:
theorem mul_eq_one_iff (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c)
    (p q : Normal a b c) : p * q = 1 ↔ p = 1 ∧ q = 1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hx := congrArg Normal.x h
    have hy := congrArg Normal.y h
    have hz := congrArg Normal.z h
    rw [normal_eq_one_iff p, normal_eq_one_iff q]
    unfold IsLiveParameterDomain at hdom
    rcases hdom with ⟨ha, hmixed | hpure⟩
    all_goals
      have hbpos : 0 < b := by omega
      simp only [Normal.mul_x, Normal.mul_y, Normal.mul_z,
        Normal.one_x, Normal.one_y, Normal.one_z] at hx hy hz
      have hmul : ((p.x + q.x) / a) * b = 0 := by
        by_contra hn
        have hg : 0 < ((p.x + q.x) / a) * b := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn
        omega
      have hdiv : (p.x + q.x) / a = 0 := by
        rcases Nat.mul_eq_zero.mp hmul with hzero | hzero
        · exact hzero
        · omega
      have hsumlt : p.x + q.x < a :=
        (Nat.div_eq_zero_iff_lt (by omega)).1 hdiv
      have hmod : (p.x + q.x) % a = p.x + q.x :=
        Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hsumlt
      rw [hmod] at hx
      omega
  · rintro ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    simp

name: P23.Artin.constantCoeff_X_mul_X
statement:
private theorem constantCoeff_X_mul_X (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (hS : S.Nonempty) (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c)
    (p q : MonomialIndex S) :
    constantCoeff (k := k) S hS
        (X (k := k) S p.1 p.2 * X (k := k) S q.1 q.2) =
      constantCoeff (k := k) S hS (X (k := k) S p.1 p.2) *
        constantCoeff (k := k) S hS (X (k := k) S q.1 q.2)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [MonomialArtin.X_mul_X]
  by_cases hpq : p.1 * q.1 ∈ standardFinset S
  · simp only [dif_pos hpq]
    have hu := mul_eq_one_iff (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) hdom p.1 q.1
    simp only [constantCoeff, coeffAt_X, unitIndex]
    by_cases hp : p.1 = 1 <;> by_cases hq : q.1 = 1 <;>
      simp_all [Subtype.ext_iff, eq_comm]
  · simp only [dif_neg hpq, map_zero]
    have hnotboth : ¬(p.1 = 1 ∧ q.1 = 1) := by
      rintro ⟨hp, hq⟩
      apply hpq
      simpa [hp, hq] using one_mem_standardFinset S hS
    simp only [constantCoeff, coeffAt_X, unitIndex]
    by_cases hp : p.1 = 1 <;> by_cases hq : q.1 = 1 <;>
      simp_all [Subtype.ext_iff, eq_comm]

name: P23.Artin.constantCoeff_mul
statement:
theorem constantCoeff_mul (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) (u v : MonomialArtin k S) :
    constantCoeff (k := k) S hS (u * v) =
      constantCoeff (k := k) S hS u * constantCoeff (k := k) S hS v
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction u using MonomialArtin.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add u₁ u₂ hu₁ hu₂ => rw [add_mul, map_add, map_add, hu₁, hu₂, add_mul]
  | single p rp =>
      rw [← MonomialArtin.smul_X (k := k) rp S p.1 p.2]
      induction v using MonomialArtin.induction_linear with
      | zero => simp
      | add v₁ v₂ hv₁ hv₂ =>
          rw [mul_add, map_add, map_add, hv₁, hv₂, mul_add]
      | single q rq =>
          rw [← MonomialArtin.smul_X (k := k) rq S q.1 q.2]
          simp only [MonomialArtin.smul_mul_assoc', MonomialArtin.mul_smul_comm',
            map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
          rw [constantCoeff_X_mul_X (k := k) S hS hdom p q]
          ring

name: P23.Artin.variableGenerator_is_atom
statement:
theorem variableGenerator_is_atom (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c)
    (e : Direction) (p q : Normal a b c) (h : p * q = e.generator) :
    p = 1 ∨ q = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hx := congrArg Normal.x h
  have hy := congrArg Normal.y h
  have hz := congrArg Normal.z h
  rw [normal_eq_one_iff p, normal_eq_one_iff q]
  unfold IsLiveParameterDomain at hdom
  rcases hdom with ⟨ha, hmixed | hpure⟩
  · rcases e with _ | _ | _
    · have ha1 : a ≠ 1 := by omega
      simp [Direction.generator, Normal.xGenerator, ha1, Normal.mul_x,
        Normal.mul_y, Normal.mul_z] at hx hy hz
      obtain ⟨⟨hpy, hqy⟩, hltOr⟩ := hy
      have hlt : p.x + q.x < a := by
        rcases hltOr with (ha0 | hlt) | hb0 <;> omega
      have hmod : (p.x + q.x) % a = p.x + q.x := Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hlt
      rw [hmod] at hx
      omega
    · simp only [Direction.generator, Normal.yGenerator, Normal.mul_x,
        Normal.mul_y, Normal.mul_z] at hx hy hz
      have hmul : ((p.x + q.x) / a) * c = 0 := by omega
      have hdiv : (p.x + q.x) / a = 0 := by
