        rcases Nat.mul_eq_zero.mp hmul with hzero | hzero <;> omega
      have hlt := (Nat.div_eq_zero_iff_lt (by omega)).1 hdiv
      have hmod : (p.x + q.x) % a = p.x + q.x := Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hlt
      rw [hmod] at hx
      omega
    · simp only [Direction.generator, Normal.zGenerator, Normal.mul_x,
        Normal.mul_y, Normal.mul_z] at hx hy hz
      have hmul : ((p.x + q.x) / a) * b = 0 := by omega
      have hdiv : (p.x + q.x) / a = 0 := by
        rcases Nat.mul_eq_zero.mp hmul with hzero | hzero <;> omega
      have hlt := (Nat.div_eq_zero_iff_lt (by omega)).1 hdiv
      have hmod : (p.x + q.x) % a = p.x + q.x := Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hlt
      rw [hmod] at hx
      omega
  · rcases e with _ | _ | _
    · have ha1 : a ≠ 1 := by omega
      simp [Direction.generator, Normal.xGenerator, ha1, Normal.mul_x,
        Normal.mul_y, Normal.mul_z] at hx hy hz
      obtain ⟨⟨hpy, hqy⟩, hltOr⟩ := hy
      have hlt : p.x + q.x < a := by
        rcases hltOr with (ha0 | hlt) | hb0 <;> omega
      have hmod : (p.x + q.x) % a = p.x + q.x := Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hlt
      rw [hmod] at hx
      omega
    · simp only [Direction.generator, Normal.yGenerator, Normal.mul_x,
        Normal.mul_y, Normal.mul_z] at hx hy hz
      have hdiv : (p.x + q.x) / a = 0 := by
        by_contra hn
        have hpos : 1 ≤ (p.x + q.x) / a := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 hn
        have hlarge : 2 ≤ ((p.x + q.x) / a) * b := by
          nlinarith [Nat.mul_le_mul hpos hpure.1]
        omega
      have hlt := (Nat.div_eq_zero_iff_lt (by omega)).1 hdiv
      have hmod : (p.x + q.x) % a = p.x + q.x := Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hlt
      rw [hmod] at hx
      omega
    · simp only [Direction.generator, Normal.zGenerator, Normal.mul_x,
        Normal.mul_y, Normal.mul_z] at hx hy hz
      have hmul : ((p.x + q.x) / a) * b = 0 := by omega
      have hdiv : (p.x + q.x) / a = 0 := by
        rcases Nat.mul_eq_zero.mp hmul with hzero | hzero <;> omega
      have hlt := (Nat.div_eq_zero_iff_lt (by omega)).1 hdiv
      have hmod : (p.x + q.x) % a = p.x + q.x := Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hlt
      rw [hmod] at hx
      omega

name: P23.Artin.coeffAt_mul_eq_zero_of_right
statement:
theorem coeffAt_mul_eq_zero_of_right (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (hS : S.Nonempty) (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c)
    (e : Direction) (heS : e.generator ∈ standardFinset S)
    (u v : MonomialArtin k S)
    (hv0 : constantCoeff (k := k) S hS v = 0)
    (hve : coeffAt (k := k) S ⟨e.generator, heS⟩ v = 0) :
    coeffAt (k := k) S ⟨e.generator, heS⟩ (u * v) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let ei : MonomialIndex S := ⟨e.generator, heS⟩
  have he_ne_one : e.generator ≠ (1 : Normal a b c) := by
    exact variableGenerators_ne_one_of_two_le hdom.1 e
  have hother (p : MonomialIndex S) (hp1 : p.1 ≠ 1)
      (hpe : p.1 ≠ e.generator) (w : MonomialArtin k S) :
      coeffAt (k := k) S ei (X (k := k) S p.1 p.2 * w) = 0 := by
    induction w using MonomialArtin.induction_linear with
    | zero => simp
    | add w₁ w₂ hw₁ hw₂ => rw [mul_add, map_add, hw₁, hw₂, add_zero]
    | single q r =>
        rw [← MonomialArtin.smul_X (k := k) r S q.1 q.2]
        rw [MonomialArtin.mul_smul_comm']
        rw [MonomialArtin.X_mul_X]
        by_cases hpq : p.1 * q.1 ∈ standardFinset S
        · simp only [dif_pos hpq, map_smul]
          have hprod : p.1 * q.1 ≠ e.generator := by
            intro hprod
            rcases variableGenerator_is_atom hdom e p.1 q.1 hprod with hp | hq
            · exact hp1 hp
            · apply hpe
              simpa [hq] using hprod
          have hidx : (⟨p.1 * q.1, hpq⟩ : MonomialIndex S) ≠ ei := by
            intro hidx
            apply hprod
            exact congrArg Subtype.val hidx
          have hprod' : e.generator ≠ p.1 * q.1 := fun h => hprod h.symm
          simp only [coeffAt_apply, MonomialArtin.coeff_X]
          simp [ei, hprod']
        · simp [hpq]
  have hbasis (p : MonomialIndex S) :
      coeffAt (k := k) S ei (X (k := k) S p.1 p.2 * v) = 0 := by
    by_cases hp1 : p.1 = 1
    · have hp : p = unitIndex S hS := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        exact hp1
      subst p
      have hX : X (k := k) S (unitIndex S hS).1 (unitIndex S hS).2 = 1 := by
        simpa [unitIndex] using MonomialArtin.X_one (k := k) S hS
      rw [hX, one_mul]
      exact hve
    by_cases hpe : p.1 = e.generator
    · have hp : p = ei := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        exact hpe
      subst p
      rw [coeffAt_X_mul (k := k) S ei (unitIndex S hS) ei]
      · exact hv0
      · simp [unitIndex]
    exact hother p hp1 hpe v
  induction u using MonomialArtin.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add u w hu hw => rw [add_mul, map_add, hu, hw, add_zero]
  | single p r =>
      rw [← MonomialArtin.smul_X (k := k) r S p.1 p.2]
      rw [MonomialArtin.smul_mul_assoc', map_smul, hbasis]
      simp

name: P23.Artin.mixed_dominant_four_border_not_variablesInTrace
statement:
theorem mixed_dominant_four_border_not_variablesInTrace
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hc : 1 ≤ c)
    (hcard : S.card = 3) (hlive : IsLiveTie S)
    (hanti : IsRootAntichain S) {C : Normal a b c}
    (hdom : IsDominantRoot S C) (hborder : (borderFinset S).card = 4) :
    ¬VariablesInTrace k S hlive
proof:
:= by
  intro htrace
  rcases mixed_dominant_four_border_survivor S ha hb hc hcard hlive hanti
      hdom hborder with
    ⟨hr, hr0, hb1, hc1, hu, hv, hroots⟩ |
    ⟨hr, hc1, hu, hv, hroots⟩ |
    ⟨hr, hb1, hu, hv, hroots⟩ |
    ⟨hr, hrlast, hu, hv, huv, hroots⟩
  · subst_vars
    exact mixedYZ_y_not_mem_trace (k := k) ha hu hv htrace.2.1
  · subst_vars
    exact mixedYQ_y_not_mem_trace (k := k) ha hb hu hv hr htrace.2.1
  · subst_vars
    exact mixedZP_z_not_mem_trace (k := k) ha hc hu hv hr htrace.2.2
  · subst_vars
    exact mixedPQ_not_variablesInTrace (k := k) ha hb hc hu hv huv hlive htrace

name: P23.Artin.mixed_directModel_HL5
statement:
theorem mixed_directModel_HL5
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hc : 1 ≤ c)
    (hcard : S.card = 3) (hlive : IsLiveTie S)
    (hanti : IsRootAntichain S) (htrace : VariablesInTrace k S hlive) :
    (borderFinset S).card ≠ 4
proof:
:= by
  intro hborder
  obtain ⟨C, _, hdom⟩ := mixed_four_border_trace_has_dominant
    (k := k) S ha hb hc hcard hlive hanti htrace hborder
  exact mixed_dominant_four_border_not_variablesInTrace
    (k := k) S ha hb hc hcard hlive hanti hdom hborder htrace

name: P23.Artin.pure_directModel_HL5
statement:
theorem pure_directModel_HL5
    (S : Finset (Normal a b 0)) (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 2 ≤ b)
    (hcard : S.card = 3) (hlive : IsLiveTie S)
    (hanti : IsRootAntichain S) (htrace : VariablesInTrace k S hlive) :
    (borderFinset S).card ≠ 4
proof:
:= by
  intro hborder
  rcases pure_four_border_trace_dominant_or_residual
      (k := k) S ha hb hcard hlive hanti htrace hborder with
    hdom | hresidual
  · obtain ⟨C, _, hCdom⟩ := hdom
    exact pure_dominant_border_card_ne_four_general
      S ha hb hcard hlive hanti hCdom hborder
  · rcases hresidual with
      ⟨V, ha', hb', hV, hroots⟩ | ⟨v, ha', hb', hv, hroots⟩
    · subst S
      exact p4Z_not_variablesInTrace (k := k) ha' hb' hV hlive htrace
    · subst S
      exact p5Z_not_variablesInTrace (k := k) ha' hb' hv hlive htrace

name: P23.Artin.directModel_HL5
statement:
theorem directModel_HL5 : DirectModelHL5 (k := k) where
  mixed
proof:
:= by
    intro a b c _ S ha hb hc hcard hlive hanti htrace
    exact mixed_directModel_HL5 (k := k) S ha hb hc hcard hlive hanti htrace
  pure := by
    intro a b _ S ha hb hcard hlive hanti htrace
    exact pure_directModel_HL5 (k := k) S ha hb hcard hlive hanti htrace

name: P23.Artin.coeffAt_X_mul_eq_zero_of_not_dvd
statement:
theorem coeffAt_X_mul_eq_zero_of_not_dvd (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (m t : MonomialIndex S) (hnt : ¬m.1 ∣ t.1) (v : MonomialArtin k S) :
    coeffAt (k := k) S t (X (k := k) S m.1 m.2 * v) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction v using MonomialArtin.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add v w hv hw => rw [mul_add,map_add,hv,hw,add_zero]
  | single q r =>
    rw [← MonomialArtin.smul_X (k := k) r S q.1 q.2, MonomialArtin.mul_smul_comm']
    have hprod : t.1 ≠ m.1 * q.1 := fun he => hnt ⟨q.1,he⟩
    by_cases hs : m.1 * q.1 ∈ standardFinset S
    · have hi : t ≠ (⟨m.1 * q.1,hs⟩ : MonomialIndex S) :=
        fun he => hprod (congrArg Subtype.val he)
      simp [MonomialArtin.X_mul_X,hs,coeffAt_apply,MonomialArtin.coeff_X,hi,hprod]
    · simp [MonomialArtin.X_mul_X,hs]

name: P23.Artin.root_coeff_zero_of_nondvd_and_surviving_product
statement:
theorem root_coeff_zero_of_nondvd_and_surviving_product (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (F : Omega k S →ₗ[MonomialArtin k S] MonomialArtin k S)
    (s : Normal a b c) (hs : s ∈ S) (l e : MonomialIndex S)
    (hn : ¬l.1 ∣ s) (hp : l.1 * e.1 ∈ standardFinset S) :
    coeffAt (k := k) S e (F (U (k := k) S (rootIndex S s hs))) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply coeff_eq_zero_of_annihilator S F l e ⟨l.1 * e.1,hp⟩ (rootIndex S s hs)
    ((X_smul_rootDual_eq_zero_iff S s hs l).mpr hn)
  rfl

name: P23.Artin.trace_range_le
statement:
theorem trace_range_le (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (F : Omega k S →ₗ[MonomialArtin k S] MonomialArtin k S) :
    F.range ≤ TraceSubmodule k S
proof:
:=
  le_iSup (fun G : Omega k S →ₗ[MonomialArtin k S] MonomialArtin k S ↦ G.range) F

name: P23.Artin.trace_eq_span_traceValueSet
statement:
theorem trace_eq_span_traceValueSet (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) :
    TraceSubmodule k S =
      Submodule.span (MonomialArtin k S) (traceValueSet k S)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · refine iSup_le ?_
    intro F
    rintro v ⟨φ, rfl⟩
    exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨F, φ, rfl⟩
  · apply Submodule.span_le.2
    rintro v ⟨F, φ, rfl⟩
    exact trace_range_le (k := k) S F ⟨φ, rfl⟩

name: P23.Artin.trace_eq_span_rootTraceValueSet
statement:
theorem trace_eq_span_rootTraceValueSet (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) :
    TraceSubmodule k S =
      Submodule.span (MonomialArtin k S) (rootTraceValueSet k S)
proof:
:= by
  rw [trace_eq_span_traceValueSet]
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply Submodule.span_le.2
    rintro v ⟨F, φ, rfl⟩
    have hφ : φ ∈ Submodule.span (MonomialArtin k S) (rootDualSet k S) := by
      rw [rootDual_span_eq_top]
      trivial
    refine Submodule.span_induction
      (p := fun ψ _ ↦ F ψ ∈
        Submodule.span (MonomialArtin k S) (rootTraceValueSet k S))
      ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hφ
    · rintro ψ ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
      exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨F, s, hs, rfl⟩
    · simp
    · intro x y _ _ ihx ihy
      rw [F.map_add]
      exact Submodule.add_mem _ ihx ihy
    · intro r x _ ihx
      rw [F.map_smul]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ r ihx
  · apply Submodule.span_mono
    rintro v ⟨F, s, hs, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨F, U (k := k) S (rootIndex S s hs), rfl⟩

name: P23.Artin.rootTraceValue_constantCoeff_eq_zero
statement:
theorem rootTraceValue_constantCoeff_eq_zero (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (hS : S.Nonempty) (hcard : 2 ≤ S.card) (hanti : IsRootAntichain S)
    (F : Omega k S →ₗ[MonomialArtin k S] MonomialArtin k S)
    (s : Normal a b c) (hs : s ∈ S) :
    constantCoeff (k := k) S hS
        (F (U (k := k) S (rootIndex S s hs))) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hex : ∃ r ∈ S, r ≠ s := by
    by_contra hn
    push_neg at hn
    have hsub : S ⊆ {s} := by
      intro r hr
      simp [hn r hr]
    have hc := Finset.card_le_card hsub
    simp at hc
    omega
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hrs⟩ := hex
  let ri := rootIndex S r hr
  let si := rootIndex S s hs
  have hndiv : ¬r ∣ s := hanti r hr s hs hrs
  have hann : X (k := k) S ri.1 ri.2 • U (k := k) S si = 0 :=
    (X_smul_rootDual_eq_zero_iff (k := k) S s hs ri).2 (by
      change ¬r ∣ s
      exact hndiv)
  have hzero : X (k := k) S ri.1 ri.2 * F (U (k := k) S si) = 0 := by
    calc
      X (k := k) S ri.1 ri.2 * F (U (k := k) S si) =
          X (k := k) S ri.1 ri.2 • F (U (k := k) S si) := by
            simp [smul_eq_mul]
      _ = F (X (k := k) S ri.1 ri.2 • U (k := k) S si) := by
            symm
            exact F.map_smul _ _
      _ = 0 := by rw [hann]; simp
  have hc := congrArg (coeffAt (k := k) S ri) hzero
  rw [coeffAt_X_mul (k := k) S ri (unitIndex S hS) ri] at hc
  · simpa [constantCoeff, si] using hc
  · simp [unitIndex]

name: P23.Artin.coeffAt_variable_eq_zero_of_trace
statement:
theorem coeffAt_variable_eq_zero_of_trace
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hcard : 2 ≤ S.card) (hanti : IsRootAntichain S)
    (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) (e : Direction)
    (heS : e.generator ∈ standardFinset S)
    (hroot : ∀ (F : Omega k S →ₗ[MonomialArtin k S] MonomialArtin k S)
      (s : Normal a b c) (hs : s ∈ S),
      coeffAt (k := k) S ⟨e.generator, heS⟩
        (F (U (k := k) S (rootIndex S s hs))) = 0)
    (t : MonomialArtin k S) (ht : t ∈ TraceSubmodule k S) :
    coeffAt (k := k) S ⟨e.generator, heS⟩ t = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [trace_eq_span_rootTraceValueSet] at ht
  let Z : Submodule (MonomialArtin k S) (MonomialArtin k S) := {
    carrier := {v | constantCoeff (k := k) S hS v = 0 ∧
      coeffAt (k := k) S ⟨e.generator, heS⟩ v = 0}
    zero_mem' := by simp
    add_mem' := by
      rintro x y ⟨hx0, hxe⟩ ⟨hy0, hye⟩
      constructor
      · rw [map_add, hx0, hy0, add_zero]
      · rw [map_add, hxe, hye, add_zero]
    smul_mem' := by
      rintro u v ⟨hv0, hve⟩
      constructor
      · simpa [smul_eq_mul, constantCoeff_mul (k := k) S hS hdom] using
          congrArg (fun z : k ↦ constantCoeff (k := k) S hS u * z) hv0
      · simpa [smul_eq_mul] using
          coeffAt_mul_eq_zero_of_right (k := k) S hS hdom e heS u v hv0 hve
  }
  have hrootZ : rootTraceValueSet k S ⊆ Z := by
    rintro v ⟨F, s, hs, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨rootTraceValue_constantCoeff_eq_zero (k := k) S hS hcard hanti F s hs,
      hroot F s hs⟩
  have hspanZ : Submodule.span (MonomialArtin k S) (rootTraceValueSet k S) ≤ Z :=
    Submodule.span_le.2 hrootZ
  exact (hspanZ ht).2

name: P23.Artin.exists_root_image_with_variable_coeff_of_mem_trace
statement:
theorem exists_root_image_with_variable_coeff_of_mem_trace
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hcard : 2 ≤ S.card) (hanti : IsRootAntichain S)
    (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) (e : Direction)
    (heS : e.generator ∈ standardFinset S)
    (htrace : X (k := k) S e.generator heS ∈ TraceSubmodule k S) :
    ∃ (F : Omega k S →ₗ[MonomialArtin k S] MonomialArtin k S)
      (s : Normal a b c) (hs : s ∈ S),
      coeffAt (k := k) S ⟨e.generator, heS⟩
        (F (U (k := k) S (rootIndex S s hs))) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hn
  push_neg at hn
  have hz := coeffAt_variable_eq_zero_of_trace (k := k) S hS hcard hanti
    hdom e heS hn _ htrace
  have hone : coeffAt (k := k) S ⟨e.generator, heS⟩
      (X (k := k) S e.generator heS) = 1 := by
    simpa using coeffAt_X (k := k) S
      (⟨e.generator, heS⟩ : MonomialIndex S) ⟨e.generator, heS⟩
  rw [hone] at hz
  exact one_ne_zero hz

name: P23.Artin.exists_root_image_with_x_coeff_of_mem_trace
statement:
theorem exists_root_image_with_x_coeff_of_mem_trace
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hcard : 2 ≤ S.card) (hanti : IsRootAntichain S)
    (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) (hlive : IsLiveTie S)
    (htrace : X (k := k) S Normal.xGenerator
      ((mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet S _).2 hlive.1) ∈ TraceSubmodule k S) :
    ∃ (F : Omega k S →ₗ[MonomialArtin k S] MonomialArtin k S)
      (s : Normal a b c) (hs : s ∈ S),
      coeffAt (k := k) S
        ⟨Normal.xGenerator, (mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet S _).2 hlive.1⟩
        (F (U (k := k) S (rootIndex S s hs))) ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  exists_root_image_with_variable_coeff_of_mem_trace (k := k) S hS hcard
    hanti hdom .x _ htrace

name: P23.Artin.exists_root_image_with_y_coeff_of_mem_trace
statement:
theorem exists_root_image_with_y_coeff_of_mem_trace
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hcard : 2 ≤ S.card) (hanti : IsRootAntichain S)
    (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) (hlive : IsLiveTie S)
    (htrace : X (k := k) S Normal.yGenerator
      ((mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet S _).2 hlive.2.1) ∈ TraceSubmodule k S) :
    ∃ (F : Omega k S →ₗ[MonomialArtin k S] MonomialArtin k S)
      (s : Normal a b c) (hs : s ∈ S),
      coeffAt (k := k) S
        ⟨Normal.yGenerator, (mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet S _).2 hlive.2.1⟩
        (F (U (k := k) S (rootIndex S s hs))) ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  exists_root_image_with_variable_coeff_of_mem_trace (k := k) S hS hcard
    hanti hdom .y _ htrace

name: P23.Artin.exists_root_image_with_z_coeff_of_mem_trace
statement:
theorem exists_root_image_with_z_coeff_of_mem_trace
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hcard : 2 ≤ S.card) (hanti : IsRootAntichain S)
    (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) (hlive : IsLiveTie S)
    (htrace : X (k := k) S Normal.zGenerator
      ((mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet S _).2 hlive.2.2.1) ∈ TraceSubmodule k S) :
    ∃ (F : Omega k S →ₗ[MonomialArtin k S] MonomialArtin k S)
      (s : Normal a b c) (hs : s ∈ S),
      coeffAt (k := k) S
        ⟨Normal.zGenerator, (mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet S _).2 hlive.2.2.1⟩
        (F (U (k := k) S (rootIndex S s hs))) ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  exists_root_image_with_variable_coeff_of_mem_trace (k := k) S hS hcard
    hanti hdom .z _ htrace

name: P23.Artin.variableTraceSources_of_variablesInTrace
statement:
theorem variableTraceSources_of_variablesInTrace
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hcard : 2 ≤ S.card) (hanti : IsRootAntichain S)
    (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) (hlive : IsLiveTie S) :
    VariablesInTrace k S hlive → VariableTraceSources k S hlive
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨hx, hy, hz⟩
  exact ⟨exists_root_image_with_variable_coeff_of_mem_trace (k := k) S hS
      hcard hanti hdom .x _ hx,
    exists_root_image_with_variable_coeff_of_mem_trace (k := k) S hS
      hcard hanti hdom .y _ hy,
    exists_root_image_with_variable_coeff_of_mem_trace (k := k) S hS
      hcard hanti hdom .z _ hz⟩

name: P23.Artin.directTrace_transport
statement:
theorem directTrace_transport (E : MonomialArtin k S ≃ₐ[k] MonomialArtin k T)
    {v : MonomialArtin k S} (hv : v ∈ TraceSubmodule k S) : E v ∈ TraceSubmodule k T
proof:
:= by
  rw [trace_eq_span_traceValueSet] at hv
  refine Submodule.span_induction (p := fun v _ => E v ∈ TraceSubmodule k T) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hv
  · rintro v ⟨F,φ,rfl⟩
    apply trace_range_le T (transportDirectCanonicalHom E F)
    refine ⟨φ.comp E.symm.toLinearMap,?_⟩
    change E (F ((φ.comp E.symm.toLinearMap).comp E.toLinearMap)) = E (F φ)
    congr 2
    ext x
    simp
  · simp
  · intro x y hx hy hx' hy'
    simpa only [map_add] using (TraceSubmodule k T).add_mem hx' hy'
  · intro r x hx hx'
    simpa [smul_eq_mul] using (TraceSubmodule k T).smul_mem (E r) hx'

name: P23.Artin.directTrace_mem_iff_algEquiv
statement:
theorem directTrace_mem_iff_algEquiv (E : MonomialArtin k S ≃ₐ[k] MonomialArtin k T)
    (v : MonomialArtin k S) : E v ∈ TraceSubmodule k T ↔ v ∈ TraceSubmodule k S
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    simpa using directTrace_transport E.symm h
  · exact directTrace_transport E

name: P23.Artin.normalModelCongr_X
statement:
theorem normalModelCongr_X (e : Normal a b c ≃* Normal a' b' c')
    (he : ∀ p, e p ∈ standardSet T ↔ p ∈ standardSet S)
    (p : Normal a b c) (hp : p ∈ standardFinset S) :
    normalModelCongr (k := k) e he (X (k := k) S p hp) =
      X (k := k) T (e p) ((mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet T _).mpr
        ((he p).mpr ((mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet S p).mp hp)))
proof:
:= by
  have hX := normalMonomialQuotientEquiv_monomial_of_mem (k := k) S p hp
  rw [← hX]
  dsimp only [normalModelCongr,AlgEquiv.trans_apply]
  rw [AlgEquiv.symm_apply_apply,Ideal.quotientEquivAlg_mk]
  simpa [monomial] using truncatedMonomial_of_mem (k := k) T (e p)
    ((mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet T _).mpr
      ((he p).mpr ((mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet S p).mp hp)))

name: P23.Artin.normalModelCongr_truncated
statement:
theorem normalModelCongr_truncated (e : Normal a b c ≃* Normal a' b' c')
    (he : ∀ p, e p ∈ standardSet T ↔ p ∈ standardSet S) (p : Normal a b c) :
    normalModelCongr (k := k) e he (truncatedMonomial (k := k) S p) =
      truncatedMonomial (k := k) T (e p)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp : p ∈ standardFinset S
  · rw [truncatedMonomial_of_mem S p hp,normalModelCongr_X]
    symm
    exact truncatedMonomial_of_mem T (e p) _
  · have hpt : e p ∉ standardFinset T := by
      intro hh
      exact hp ((mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet S _).mpr
        ((he p).mp ((mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet T _).mp hh)))
    simp [hp,hpt]

name: P23.Artin.swapYZVariablesInTrace
statement:
theorem swapYZVariablesInTrace (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (hd : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) (hl : IsLiveTie S)
    (hl' : IsLiveTie (swapYZFinset S)) (hv : VariablesInTrace k S hl) :
    VariablesInTrace k (swapYZFinset S) hl'
proof:
:= by
  have ha1 : a ≠ 1 := by have := hd.1; omega
  rcases hv with ⟨hx,hy,hz⟩
  have hx' := directTrace_transport (swapYZDirectEquiv (k := k) S) hx
  have hy' := directTrace_transport (swapYZDirectEquiv (k := k) S) hy
  have hz' := directTrace_transport (swapYZDirectEquiv (k := k) S) hz
  dsimp only [swapYZDirectEquiv] at hx' hy' hz'
  rw [normalModelCongr_X] at hx' hy' hz'
  refine ⟨?_,?_,?_⟩
  · simpa [swapYZMulEquiv,swapYZ,Normal.xGenerator,ha1] using hx'
  · simpa [swapYZMulEquiv,swapYZ,Normal.yGenerator,Normal.zGenerator] using hz'
  · simpa [swapYZMulEquiv,swapYZ,Normal.yGenerator,Normal.zGenerator] using hy'

name: P23.Artin.swapYZIsRootAntichain
statement:
theorem swapYZIsRootAntichain (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (ha : IsRootAntichain S) :
    IsRootAntichain (swapYZFinset S)
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp q hq hn hd
  obtain ⟨p',hp',rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_map.mp hp
  obtain ⟨q',hq',rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_map.mp hq
  exact ha p' hp' q' hq' (fun he => hn (he ▸ rfl)) ((swapYZ_divides_iff p' q').mp hd)

name: P23.Artin.swapYZIsLiveTie
statement:
theorem swapYZIsLiveTie (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (hd : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) (hl : IsLiveTie S) : IsLiveTie (swapYZFinset S)
proof:
:= by
  have ha1 : a ≠ 1 := by have := hd.1; omega
  refine ⟨?_,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · simpa [Normal.xGenerator,swapYZ,ha1] using
      (mem_standardSet_swapYZFinset_iff S Normal.xGenerator).mpr hl.1
  · simpa [Normal.yGenerator,Normal.zGenerator,swapYZ] using
      (mem_standardSet_swapYZFinset_iff S Normal.zGenerator).mpr hl.2.2.1
  · simpa [Normal.yGenerator,Normal.zGenerator,swapYZ] using
      (mem_standardSet_swapYZFinset_iff S Normal.yGenerator).mpr hl.2.1
  · simpa [liveTiePoint,swapYZ] using
      (mem_standardSet_swapYZFinset_iff S liveTiePoint).mpr hl.2.2.2

name: P23.Artin.predecessor_mul_generator
statement:

name: P23.Artin.predecessor_dvd_root

name: P23.Artin.predecessor_mem_standardSet

name: P23.Artin.root_mem_standardFinset
statement:
theorem root_mem_standardFinset (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    {r : Normal a b c} (hr : r ∈ S) : r ∈ standardFinset S
proof:
:=
  (rootIndex S r hr).2

name: P23.Artin.rootSource_isDirectionalCentre
statement:
theorem rootSource_isDirectionalCentre
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (e : Direction)
    (heS : e.generator ∈ standardFinset S)
    (F : Omega k S →ₗ[MonomialArtin k S] MonomialArtin k S)
    (s : Normal a b c) (hs : s ∈ S)
    (hcoeff : coeffAt (k := k) S ⟨e.generator, heS⟩
      (F (U (k := k) S (rootIndex S s hs))) ≠ 0) :
    IsDirectionalCentre S e s
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hs, ?_⟩
  intro r hr q hpred
  let qi : MonomialIndex S :=
    ⟨q, predecessor_mem_standardFinset S hr e hpred⟩
  let ei : MonomialIndex S := ⟨e.generator, heS⟩
  let ri : MonomialIndex S := rootIndex S r hr
  have hmul : qi.1 * ei.1 = ri.1 := by
    simpa [qi, ei, ri, rootIndex] using predecessor_mul_generator e hpred
  by_contra hnotmem
  have hnotdiv : ¬q ∣ s := by
    intro hdiv
    apply hnotmem
    exact (Normal.mem_divisorDownset_iff q s).2
      ((Normal.exact_divides_iff q s).1 hdiv)
  have hann :
      X (k := k) S qi.1 qi.2 • U (k := k) S (rootIndex S s hs) = 0 :=
    (X_smul_rootDual_eq_zero_iff (k := k) S s hs qi).2 (by
      simpa [qi] using hnotdiv)
  have hzero : X (k := k) S qi.1 qi.2 *
      F (U (k := k) S (rootIndex S s hs)) = 0 := by
    calc
      X (k := k) S qi.1 qi.2 * F (U (k := k) S (rootIndex S s hs)) =
          X (k := k) S qi.1 qi.2 • F (U (k := k) S (rootIndex S s hs)) := by
            simp [smul_eq_mul]
      _ = F (X (k := k) S qi.1 qi.2 •
          U (k := k) S (rootIndex S s hs)) := by
            symm
            exact F.map_smul _ _
      _ = 0 := by rw [hann]; simp
  have hc := congrArg (coeffAt (k := k) S ri) hzero
  rw [coeffAt_X_mul (k := k) S qi ei ri hmul] at hc
  have : coeffAt (k := k) S ei
      (F (U (k := k) S (rootIndex S s hs))) = 0 := by
    simpa using hc
  exact hcoeff (by simpa [ei] using this)

name: P23.Artin.exists_directionalCentre_of_variable_mem_trace
statement:
theorem exists_directionalCentre_of_variable_mem_trace
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hcard : 2 ≤ S.card) (hanti : IsRootAntichain S)
    (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) (e : Direction)
    (heS : e.generator ∈ standardFinset S)
    (htrace : X (k := k) S e.generator heS ∈ TraceSubmodule k S) :
    ∃ s ∈ S, IsDirectionalCentre S e s
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨F, s, hs, hcoeff⟩ :=
    exists_root_image_with_variable_coeff_of_mem_trace (k := k) S hS hcard
      hanti hdom e heS htrace
  exact ⟨s, hs, rootSource_isDirectionalCentre (k := k) S e heS F s hs hcoeff⟩

name: P23.Artin.exists_x_directionalCentre_of_mem_trace
statement:
theorem exists_x_directionalCentre_of_mem_trace
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (hS : S.Nonempty)

    (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) (hlive : IsLiveTie S)
    (htrace : X (k := k) S Normal.xGenerator
      ((mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet S _).2 hlive.1) ∈ TraceSubmodule k S) :

name: P23.Artin.exists_y_directionalCentre_of_mem_trace
statement:
theorem exists_y_directionalCentre_of_mem_trace
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hcard : 2 ≤ S.card) (hanti : IsRootAntichain S)
    (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) (hlive : IsLiveTie S)

name: P23.Artin.exists_z_directionalCentre_of_mem_trace
statement:
theorem exists_z_directionalCentre_of_mem_trace
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hcard : 2 ≤ S.card) (hanti : IsRootAntichain S)
    (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) (hlive : IsLiveTie S)
    (htrace : X (k := k) S Normal.zGenerator
      ((mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet S _).2 hlive.2.2.1) ∈ TraceSubmodule k S) :

name: P23.Artin.hasDirectionalCentres_of_variablesInTrace
statement:
theorem hasDirectionalCentres_of_variablesInTrace
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hcard : 2 ≤ S.card) (hanti : IsRootAntichain S)
    (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) (hlive : IsLiveTie S)
    (htrace : VariablesInTrace k S hlive) : HasDirectionalCentres S
proof:
:= by
  intro e
  cases e with
  | x =>
      obtain ⟨s, _hs, hcentre⟩ :=
        exists_x_directionalCentre_of_mem_trace (k := k) S hS hcard
          hanti hdom hlive htrace.1
      exact ⟨s, hcentre⟩
  | y =>
      obtain ⟨s, _hs, hcentre⟩ :=
        exists_y_directionalCentre_of_mem_trace (k := k) S hS hcard
          hanti hdom hlive htrace.2.1
      exact ⟨s, hcentre⟩
  | z =>
      obtain ⟨s, _hs, hcentre⟩ :=
        exists_z_directionalCentre_of_mem_trace (k := k) S hS hcard
          hanti hdom hlive htrace.2.2
      exact ⟨s, hcentre⟩

name: P23.Artin.mixed_four_border_trace_has_dominant
statement:
theorem mixed_four_border_trace_has_dominant
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hc : 1 ≤ c)
    (hcardS : S.card = 3) (hlive : IsLiveTie S)
    (hanti : IsRootAntichain S) (htrace : VariablesInTrace k S hlive)
    (hborder : (borderFinset S).card = 4) :
    ∃ C ∈ S, IsDominantRoot S C
proof:
:= by
  have hS : S.Nonempty := Finset.card_pos.mp (by omega)
  have hcard : 2 ≤ S.card := by omega
  have hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c := ⟨ha, Or.inl ⟨hb, hc⟩⟩
  have hcentres := hasDirectionalCentres_of_variablesInTrace (k := k) S hS
    hcard hanti hdom hlive htrace
  exact phaseOne_four_border_geometry.mixed a b c S ha hb hc hcardS hlive
    hanti hcentres hborder

name: P23.Artin.pure_four_border_trace_dominant_or_residual
statement:
theorem pure_four_border_trace_dominant_or_residual
    (S : Finset (Normal a b 0)) (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 2 ≤ b)
    (hcardS : S.card = 3) (hlive : IsLiveTie S)
    (hanti : IsRootAntichain S) (htrace : VariablesInTrace k S hlive)
    (hborder : (borderFinset S).card = 4) :
    (∃ C ∈ S, IsDominantRoot S C) ∨ IsPureResidualFourBorderShape S
proof:
:= by
  have hS : S.Nonempty := Finset.card_pos.mp (by omega)
  have hcard : 2 ≤ S.card := by omega
  have hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b 0 := ⟨ha, Or.inr ⟨hb, rfl⟩⟩
  have hcentres := hasDirectionalCentres_of_variablesInTrace (k := k) S hS
    hcard hanti hdom hlive htrace
  exact phaseOne_four_border_geometry.pure a b S ha hb hcardS hlive hanti
    hcentres hborder

name: P23.Artin.trace_four_border_geometry
statement:
theorem trace_four_border_geometry : TraceFourBorderGeometry k where
  mixed
proof:
:= by
    intro a b c _ S ha hb hc hcard hlive hanti htrace hborder
    exact mixed_four_border_trace_has_dominant (k := k) S ha hb hc hcard
      hlive hanti htrace hborder
  pure := by
    intro a b _ S ha hb hcard hlive hanti htrace hborder
    exact pure_four_border_trace_dominant_or_residual (k := k) S ha hb hcard
      hlive hanti htrace hborder

name: P23.Artin.a_pos_of_neZero
statement: private theorem a_pos_of_neZero {a : ℕ} [NeZero a] : 0 < a
proof:
:=
  Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne a)

name: P23.Artin.mixedYZ_card_eq_three
statement:
theorem mixedYZ_card_eq_three {a u v : ℕ} [NeZero a]
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hu : 1 ≤ u) (hv : 1 ≤ v) :
    let hr : 0 < a - 1
proof:
:= by omega
    (mixedSoclesYZ (a := a) (b := 1) (c := 1) 0 u v hr).card = 3 := by
  dsimp
  simp [mixedSoclesYZ, mixedCore, mixedY, mixedZ, Normal.ext_iff]

name: P23.Artin.mixedYZ_isRootAntichain
statement:
theorem mixedYZ_isRootAntichain {a u v : ℕ} [NeZero a]
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hu : 1 ≤ u) (hv : 1 ≤ v) :
    let hr : 0 < a - 1
proof:
:= by omega
    IsRootAntichain
      (mixedSoclesYZ (a := a) (b := 1) (c := 1) 0 u v hr) := by
  dsimp
  simp only [IsRootAntichain]
  intro p hp q hq hpq
  simp only [mixedSoclesYZ, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hp hq
  rcases hp with rfl | rfl | rfl <;> rcases hq with rfl | rfl | rfl
  all_goals
    simp_all [Normal.exact_divides_iff, Normal.DividesCriterion,
      mixedCore, mixedY, mixedZ, Normal.ext_iff]
  all_goals omega

name: P23.Artin.mixedYZ_isLiveTie
statement:
theorem mixedYZ_isLiveTie {a u v : ℕ} [NeZero a]
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hu : 1 ≤ u) (hv : 1 ≤ v) :
    let hr : 0 < a - 1
proof:
:= by omega
    IsLiveTie (mixedSoclesYZ (a := a) (b := 1) (c := 1) 0 u v hr) := by
  dsimp
  simp [IsLiveTie, standardSet, mixedSoclesYZ, liveTiePoint,
    Normal.exact_divides_iff, Normal.DividesCriterion,
    mixedCore, mixedY, mixedZ, Normal.xGenerator,
    show a ≠ 1 by omega, Normal.yGenerator, Normal.zGenerator]
  omega

name: P23.Artin.mixedYZ_y_not_mem_trace
statement:
theorem mixedYZ_y_not_mem_trace {a u v : ℕ} [NeZero a]
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hu : 1 ≤ u) (hv : 1 ≤ v) :
    let hr : 0 < a - 1
proof:
:= by omega
    let S := mixedSoclesYZ (a := a) (b := 1) (c := 1) 0 u v hr
    let hyS : (Normal.yGenerator : Normal a 1 1) ∈ standardFinset S :=
      (mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet S _).2
        (mixedYZ_isLiveTie ha hu hv).2.1
    X (k := k) S Normal.yGenerator hyS ∉ TraceSubmodule k S := by
  dsimp only
  let hr : 0 < a - 1 := by omega
  let S := mixedSoclesYZ (a := a) (b := 1) (c := 1) 0 u v hr
  let C : Normal a 1 1 := mixedCore 0 u v (by omega)
  let Y : Normal a 1 1 := mixedY u
  let Z : Normal a 1 1 := mixedZ v
  have hC : C ∈ S := by simp [S, C, mixedSoclesYZ]
  have hY : Y ∈ S := by simp [S, Y, mixedSoclesYZ]
  have hZ : Z ∈ S := by simp [S, Z, mixedSoclesYZ]
  have hcard3 : S.card = 3 := mixedYZ_card_eq_three ha hu hv
  have hS : S.Nonempty := Finset.card_pos.mp (by omega)
  have hanti : IsRootAntichain S := mixedYZ_isRootAntichain ha hu hv
  have hlive : IsLiveTie S := mixedYZ_isLiveTie ha hu hv
  have hyS : (Normal.yGenerator : Normal a 1 1) ∈ standardFinset S :=
    (mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet S _).2 hlive.2.1
  have hzS : (Normal.zGenerator : Normal a 1 1) ∈ standardFinset S :=
    (mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet S _).2 hlive.2.2.1
  let zv : Normal a 1 1 := ⟨0, 0, v, a_pos_of_neZero⟩
  let yu : Normal a 1 1 := ⟨0, u, 0, a_pos_of_neZero⟩
  let yzv : Normal a 1 1 := ⟨0, 1, v, a_pos_of_neZero⟩
  let yz : Normal a 1 1 := ⟨0, 1, 1, a_pos_of_neZero⟩
  let yy : Normal a 1 1 := ⟨0, 2, 0, a_pos_of_neZero⟩
  have hzvS : zv ∈ standardFinset S := by
    rw [mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet]
    rw [mem_standardSet_mixedSoclesYZ_iff (hb := by omega) (hc := by omega)
      (hu := hu) (hv := hv) (hr := hr)]
    simp [zv]
  have hyuS : yu ∈ standardFinset S := by
    rw [mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet]
    rw [mem_standardSet_mixedSoclesYZ_iff (hb := by omega) (hc := by omega)
      (hu := hu) (hv := hv) (hr := hr)]
    simp [yu]
  have hyzvS : yzv ∈ standardFinset S := by
    rw [mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet]
    rw [mem_standardSet_mixedSoclesYZ_iff (hb := by omega) (hc := by omega)
      (hu := hu) (hv := hv) (hr := hr)]
    simp [yzv]
    omega
  have hyzS : yz ∈ standardFinset S := by
    rw [mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet]
    rw [mem_standardSet_mixedSoclesYZ_iff (hb := by omega) (hc := by omega)
      (hu := hu) (hv := hv) (hr := hr)]
    simp [yz]
    omega
  have hyyS : yy ∈ standardFinset S := by
    rw [mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet]
    rw [mem_standardSet_mixedSoclesYZ_iff (hb := by omega) (hc := by omega)
      (hu := hu) (hv := hv) (hr := hr)]
    simp [yy]
    omega
  intro htrace
  obtain ⟨F, s, hs, hcoeff⟩ :=
    exists_root_image_with_variable_coeff_of_mem_trace (k := k) S
      hS (by omega) hanti
      (by exact ⟨ha, Or.inl ⟨by omega, by omega⟩⟩) .y hyS htrace
  have hs' : s = C ∨ s = Y ∨ s = Z := by
    simpa [S, C, Y, Z, mixedSoclesYZ] using hs
  rcases hs' with rfl | rfl | rfl
  · let mi : MonomialIndex S := ⟨zv, hzvS⟩
    let ni : MonomialIndex S := ⟨Normal.yGenerator, hyS⟩

name: P23.Artin.mixedYQ_y_not_mem_trace
statement:
theorem mixedYQ_y_not_mem_trace {a b r u v : ℕ} [NeZero a]
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hu : b ≤ u) (hv : 1 ≤ v)
    (hr : r < a - 1) :
    let S
proof:
:= mixedSoclesYQ (a := a) (b := b) (c := 1) r u v hr
    let hyS : (Normal.yGenerator : Normal a b 1) ∈ standardFinset S :=
      (mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet S _).2
        (mixedYQ_isLiveTie ha hb hu hv hr).2.1
    X (k := k) S Normal.yGenerator hyS ∉ TraceSubmodule k S := by
  dsimp only
  let S := mixedSoclesYQ (a := a) (b := b) (c := 1) r u v hr
  let C : Normal a b 1 := mixedCore r u v (by omega)
  let Y : Normal a b 1 := mixedY u
  let Q : Normal a b 1 := mixedQ r v hr
  have hC : C ∈ S := by simp [S, C, mixedSoclesYQ]
  have hY : Y ∈ S := by simp [S, Y, mixedSoclesYQ]
  have hQ : Q ∈ S := by simp [S, Q, mixedSoclesYQ]
  have hcard3 : S.card = 3 := mixedYQ_card_eq_three ha hb hu hv hr
  have hS : S.Nonempty := Finset.card_pos.mp (by omega)
  have hanti : IsRootAntichain S := mixedYQ_isRootAntichain ha hb hu hv hr
  have hlive : IsLiveTie S := mixedYQ_isLiveTie ha hb hu hv hr
  have hxS : (Normal.xGenerator : Normal a b 1) ∈ standardFinset S :=
    (mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet S _).2 hlive.1
  have hyS : (Normal.yGenerator : Normal a b 1) ∈ standardFinset S :=
    (mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet S _).2 hlive.2.1
  have hzS : (Normal.zGenerator : Normal a b 1) ∈ standardFinset S :=
    (mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet S _).2 hlive.2.2.1
  let m : Normal a b 1 := ⟨r, 0, v, by omega⟩
  let q : Normal a b 1 := ⟨0, u, 0, a_pos_of_neZero⟩
  let w : Normal a b 1 := ⟨r, 1, v, by omega⟩
  let yz : Normal a b 1 := ⟨0, 1, 1, a_pos_of_neZero⟩
  let yy : Normal a b 1 := ⟨0, 2, 0, a_pos_of_neZero⟩
  have hmS : m ∈ standardFinset S := by
    rw [mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet,
      mem_standardSet_mixedSoclesYQ_iff hb (by omega) hu hv hr]
    simp [m, mixedYQStandardNat]
  have hqS : q ∈ standardFinset S := by
    rw [mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet,
      mem_standardSet_mixedSoclesYQ_iff hb (by omega) hu hv hr]
    simp [q, mixedYQStandardNat]
  have hwS : w ∈ standardFinset S := by
    rw [mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet,
      mem_standardSet_mixedSoclesYQ_iff hb (by omega) hu hv hr]
    simp [w, mixedYQStandardNat]
    omega
  have hyzS : yz ∈ standardFinset S := by
    rw [mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet,
      mem_standardSet_mixedSoclesYQ_iff hb (by omega) hu hv hr]
    simp [yz, mixedYQStandardNat]
    omega
  have hyyS : yy ∈ standardFinset S := by
    rw [mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet,
      mem_standardSet_mixedSoclesYQ_iff hb (by omega) hu hv hr]
    simp [yy, mixedYQStandardNat]
    omega
  intro htrace
  obtain ⟨F, s, hs, hcoeff⟩ :=
    exists_root_image_with_variable_coeff_of_mem_trace (k := k) S hS
      (by omega) hanti (by exact ⟨ha, Or.inl ⟨hb, by omega⟩⟩) .y hyS htrace
  have hs' : s = C ∨ s = Y ∨ s = Q := by
    simpa [S, C, Y, Q, mixedSoclesYQ] using hs
  rcases hs' with rfl | rfl | rfl
  · have hrlt : r < a := by omega
    have hr1lt : 1 + r < a := by omega
    have htransfer := coeff_transfer_of_common_quotient (k := k) S F
      (⟨m, hmS⟩ : MonomialIndex S)
      (⟨Normal.yGenerator, hyS⟩ : MonomialIndex S)
      (⟨q, hqS⟩ : MonomialIndex S)
      (⟨Normal.yGenerator, hyS⟩ : MonomialIndex S)
      (⟨m, hmS⟩ : MonomialIndex S) (⟨w, hwS⟩ : MonomialIndex S)
      (rootIndex S C hC) (rootIndex S Y hY)
      (by apply Normal.ext <;>
        simp [m, q, C, mixedCore, rootIndex, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hrlt,
          Nat.div_eq_of_lt hrlt])
      (by apply Normal.ext <;>
        simp [q, Y, mixedY, Normal.yGenerator, rootIndex] <;> omega)
      (by apply Normal.ext <;>
        simp [m, w, Normal.yGenerator, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hrlt,
          Nat.div_eq_of_lt hrlt])
      (by apply Normal.ext <;>
        simp [m, w, Normal.yGenerator, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hrlt,
          Nat.div_eq_of_lt hrlt])
    have hnot : ¬(Normal.xGenerator : Normal a b 1) ∣ Y := by
      simp [Normal.exact_divides_iff, Normal.DividesCriterion,
        Normal.xGenerator, show a ≠ 1 by omega, Y, mixedY]
    have hzero : X (k := k) S Normal.xGenerator hxS •
        U (k := k) S (rootIndex S Y hY) = 0 :=
      (X_smul_rootDual_eq_zero_iff (k := k) S Y hY
        (⟨Normal.xGenerator, hxS⟩ : MonomialIndex S)).2 hnot
    have hvanish := coeff_eq_zero_of_annihilator (k := k) S F
      (⟨Normal.xGenerator, hxS⟩ : MonomialIndex S)
      (⟨m, hmS⟩ : MonomialIndex S) (rootIndex S Q hQ)
      (rootIndex S Y hY) hzero
      (by apply Normal.ext <;>
        simp [m, Q, mixedQ, Normal.xGenerator, show a ≠ 1 by omega,
          rootIndex, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hr1lt,
          Nat.div_eq_of_lt hr1lt] <;> omega)
    exact hcoeff (htransfer.trans hvanish)
  · have hnot : ¬(Normal.zGenerator : Normal a b 1) ∣ Y := by
      simp [Normal.exact_divides_iff, Normal.DividesCriterion,
        Normal.zGenerator, Y, mixedY]
    have hzero : X (k := k) S Normal.zGenerator hzS •
        U (k := k) S (rootIndex S Y hY) = 0 :=
      (X_smul_rootDual_eq_zero_iff (k := k) S Y hY
        (⟨Normal.zGenerator, hzS⟩ : MonomialIndex S)).2 hnot
    exact hcoeff (coeff_eq_zero_of_annihilator (k := k) S F
      (⟨Normal.zGenerator, hzS⟩ : MonomialIndex S)
      (⟨Normal.yGenerator, hyS⟩ : MonomialIndex S) ⟨yz, hyzS⟩
      (rootIndex S Y hY) hzero
      (by apply Normal.ext <;> simp [yz, Normal.yGenerator, Normal.zGenerator]))
  · have hnot : ¬(Normal.yGenerator : Normal a b 1) ∣ Q := by
      simp [Normal.exact_divides_iff, Normal.DividesCriterion,
        Normal.yGenerator, Q, mixedQ]
    have hzero : X (k := k) S Normal.yGenerator hyS •
        U (k := k) S (rootIndex S Q hQ) = 0 :=
      (X_smul_rootDual_eq_zero_iff (k := k) S Q hQ
        (⟨Normal.yGenerator, hyS⟩ : MonomialIndex S)).2 hnot
    exact hcoeff (coeff_eq_zero_of_annihilator (k := k) S F
      (⟨Normal.yGenerator, hyS⟩ : MonomialIndex S)
      (⟨Normal.yGenerator, hyS⟩ : MonomialIndex S) ⟨yy, hyyS⟩
      (rootIndex S Q hQ) hzero
      (by apply Normal.ext <;> simp [yy, Normal.yGenerator]))

  have hlive : IsLiveTie S := mixedZP_isLiveTie ha hc hu hv hr
  have hxS : (Normal.xGenerator : Normal a 1 c) ∈ standardFinset S :=

  let m : Normal a 1 c := ⟨r, u, 0, by omega⟩
  let q : Normal a 1 c := ⟨0, 0, v, a_pos_of_neZero⟩

  let yz : Normal a 1 c := ⟨0, 1, 1, a_pos_of_neZero⟩

  have hmS : m ∈ standardFinset S := by

    have hnot : ¬(Normal.xGenerator : Normal a 1 c) ∣ Z := by
      simp [Normal.exact_divides_iff, Normal.DividesCriterion,

name: P23.Artin.mixedPQ_card_eq_three
statement:
theorem mixedPQ_card_eq_three {a b c u v : ℕ} [NeZero a]
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hc : 1 ≤ c)
    (hu : b ≤ u) (hv : c ≤ v) :
    let hr : a - 2 < a - 1
proof:
:= by omega
    (mixedSoclesPQ (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) (a - 2) u v hr).card = 3 := by
  dsimp
  let hr : a - 2 < a - 1 := by omega
  let C : Normal a b c := mixedCore (a - 2) u v (by omega)
  let P : Normal a b c := mixedP (a - 2) u hr
  let Q : Normal a b c := mixedQ (a - 2) v hr
  have hCP : C ≠ P := by
    intro h
    have hx := congrArg Normal.x h

name: P23.Artin.mixedPQ_y_not_mem_trace_of_u_gt_one
statement:
theorem mixedPQ_y_not_mem_trace_of_u_gt_one
    {a b c u v : ℕ} [NeZero a]
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hc : 1 ≤ c)

proof:
:= by omega
    let S := mixedSoclesPQ (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) (a - 2) u v hr
    let hyS : (Normal.yGenerator : Normal a b c) ∈ standardFinset S :=
      (mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet S _).2
        (mixedPQ_isLiveTie ha hb hc hu hv).2.1
    X (k := k) S Normal.yGenerator hyS ∉ TraceSubmodule k S := by
  dsimp only
  let hr : a - 2 < a - 1 := by omega
  let S := mixedSoclesPQ (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) (a - 2) u v hr
  let C : Normal a b c := mixedCore (a - 2) u v (by omega)
  let P : Normal a b c := mixedP (a - 2) u hr
  let Q : Normal a b c := mixedQ (a - 2) v hr
  have hC : C ∈ S := by simp [S, C, mixedSoclesPQ]
  have hP : P ∈ S := by simp [S, P, mixedSoclesPQ]
  have hQ : Q ∈ S := by simp [S, Q, mixedSoclesPQ]
  have hcard3 : S.card = 3 := mixedPQ_card_eq_three ha hb hc hu hv
  have hS : S.Nonempty := Finset.card_pos.mp (by omega)
  have hanti : IsRootAntichain S := mixedPQ_isRootAntichain ha hb hc hu hv
  have hlive : IsLiveTie S := mixedPQ_isLiveTie ha hb hc hu hv
  have hxS : (Normal.xGenerator : Normal a b c) ∈ standardFinset S :=
    (mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet S _).2 hlive.1
  have hyS : (Normal.yGenerator : Normal a b c) ∈ standardFinset S :=
    (mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet S _).2 hlive.2.1
  have hzS : (Normal.zGenerator : Normal a b c) ∈ standardFinset S :=
    (mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet S _).2 hlive.2.2.1
  let m : Normal a b c := ⟨0, b - 1, v, a_pos_of_neZero⟩
  let q : Normal a b c := ⟨a - 2, u + 1 - b, 0, by omega⟩
  let w : Normal a b c := ⟨0, b, v, a_pos_of_neZero⟩
  let h : Normal a b c := ⟨a - 1, 0, v - c, by omega⟩
  let yz : Normal a b c := ⟨0, 1, 1, a_pos_of_neZero⟩
  let yy : Normal a b c := ⟨0, 2, 0, a_pos_of_neZero⟩
  have hmS : m ∈ standardFinset S := by
    rw [mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet,
      mem_standardSet_mixedSoclesPQ_iff hb hc hu hv hr]
    simp [m, mixedPQStandardNat]
    omega
  have hqS : q ∈ standardFinset S := by
    rw [mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet,
      mem_standardSet_mixedSoclesPQ_iff hb hc hu hv hr]
    simp [q, mixedPQStandardNat]
  have hwS : w ∈ standardFinset S := by
    rw [mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet,
      mem_standardSet_mixedSoclesPQ_iff hb hc hu hv hr]
    simp [w, mixedPQStandardNat]
    omega
  have hhS : h ∈ standardFinset S := by
    rw [mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet,
      mem_standardSet_mixedSoclesPQ_iff hb hc hu hv hr]
    simp [h, mixedPQStandardNat]
    omega
  have hyzS : yz ∈ standardFinset S := by
    rw [mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet,
      mem_standardSet_mixedSoclesPQ_iff hb hc hu hv hr]
    simp [yz, mixedPQStandardNat]
    omega
  have hyyS : yy ∈ standardFinset S := by
    rw [mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet,
      mem_standardSet_mixedSoclesPQ_iff hb hc hu hv hr]
    simp [yy, mixedPQStandardNat]
    omega
  intro htrace
  obtain ⟨F, s, hs, hcoeff⟩ :=
    exists_root_image_with_variable_coeff_of_mem_trace (k := k) S hS
      (by omega) hanti (by exact ⟨ha, Or.inl ⟨hb, hc⟩⟩) .y hyS htrace
  have hs' : s = C ∨ s = P ∨ s = Q := by
    simpa [S, C, P, Q, mixedSoclesPQ] using hs
  rcases hs' with rfl | rfl | rfl
  · have hrlt : a - 2 < a := by omega
    have hr1lt : 1 + (a - 2) < a := by omega
    have halast : a - 1 < a := by omega
    have hwrap : (Normal.xGenerator : Normal a b c) * h = w := by
      rw [mul_comm]
      simpa [h, w, Normal.wrappedXPredecessor] using
        (Normal.wrappedXPredecessor_mul w (by rfl) (by simp [w]) (by simp [w]; omega))
    have htransfer := coeff_transfer_of_common_quotient (k := k) S F
      (⟨m, hmS⟩ : MonomialIndex S)
      (⟨Normal.xGenerator, hxS⟩ : MonomialIndex S)
      (⟨q, hqS⟩ : MonomialIndex S)
      (⟨Normal.yGenerator, hyS⟩ : MonomialIndex S)
      (⟨h, hhS⟩ : MonomialIndex S) (⟨w, hwS⟩ : MonomialIndex S)
      (rootIndex S C hC) (rootIndex S P hP)
      (by apply Normal.ext <;>
        simp [m, q, C, mixedCore, rootIndex, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hrlt,
          Nat.div_eq_of_lt hrlt] <;> omega)
      (by apply Normal.ext <;>
        simp [q, P, mixedP, Normal.xGenerator, show a ≠ 1 by omega,
          rootIndex, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hr1lt,
          Nat.div_eq_of_lt hr1lt] <;> omega)
      (by apply Normal.ext <;> simp [m, w, Normal.yGenerator] <;> omega)
      hwrap
    have hnot : ¬(Normal.zGenerator : Normal a b c) ∣ P := by
      simp [Normal.exact_divides_iff, Normal.DividesCriterion,
        Normal.zGenerator, P, mixedP]
    have hzero : X (k := k) S Normal.zGenerator hzS •
        U (k := k) S (rootIndex S P hP) = 0 :=
      (X_smul_rootDual_eq_zero_iff (k := k) S P hP
        (⟨Normal.zGenerator, hzS⟩ : MonomialIndex S)).2 hnot
    have hvanish := coeff_eq_zero_of_annihilator (k := k) S F
      (⟨Normal.zGenerator, hzS⟩ : MonomialIndex S)
      (⟨h, hhS⟩ : MonomialIndex S) (rootIndex S Q hQ)
      (rootIndex S P hP) hzero
      (by apply Normal.ext <;>
        simp [h, Q, mixedQ, Normal.zGenerator, rootIndex,
          Nat.mod_eq_of_lt halast, Nat.div_eq_of_lt halast] <;> omega)
    exact hcoeff (htransfer.trans hvanish)
  · have hnot : ¬(Normal.zGenerator : Normal a b c) ∣ P := by
      simp [Normal.exact_divides_iff, Normal.DividesCriterion,
        Normal.zGenerator, P, mixedP]
    have hzero : X (k := k) S Normal.zGenerator hzS •
        U (k := k) S (rootIndex S P hP) = 0 :=
      (X_smul_rootDual_eq_zero_iff (k := k) S P hP
        (⟨Normal.zGenerator, hzS⟩ : MonomialIndex S)).2 hnot
    exact hcoeff (coeff_eq_zero_of_annihilator (k := k) S F
      (⟨Normal.zGenerator, hzS⟩ : MonomialIndex S)
      (⟨Normal.yGenerator, hyS⟩ : MonomialIndex S) ⟨yz, hyzS⟩
      (rootIndex S P hP) hzero
      (by apply Normal.ext <;> simp [yz, Normal.yGenerator, Normal.zGenerator]))
  · have hnot : ¬(Normal.yGenerator : Normal a b c) ∣ Q := by
      simp [Normal.exact_divides_iff, Normal.DividesCriterion,
        Normal.yGenerator, Q, mixedQ]
    have hzero : X (k := k) S Normal.yGenerator hyS •
        U (k := k) S (rootIndex S Q hQ) = 0 :=
      (X_smul_rootDual_eq_zero_iff (k := k) S Q hQ
        (⟨Normal.yGenerator, hyS⟩ : MonomialIndex S)).2 hnot
    exact hcoeff (coeff_eq_zero_of_annihilator (k := k) S F
      (⟨Normal.yGenerator, hyS⟩ : MonomialIndex S)
      (⟨Normal.yGenerator, hyS⟩ : MonomialIndex S) ⟨yy, hyyS⟩
      (rootIndex S Q hQ) hzero
      (by apply Normal.ext <;> simp [yy, Normal.yGenerator]))

  have hcard3 : S.card = 3 := p4Z_card_eq_three ha hb hV
  have hS : S.Nonempty := Finset.card_pos.mp (by omega)
  have hanti : IsRootAntichain S := p4Z_isRootAntichain ha hb hV
  have hlive : IsLiveTie S := p4Z_isLiveTie ha hb hV
  have hyS : (Normal.yGenerator : Normal a b 0) ∈ standardFinset S :=
    (mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet S _).2 hlive.2.1
  have hzS : (Normal.zGenerator : Normal a b 0) ∈ standardFinset S :=
    (mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet S _).2 hlive.2.2.1
  let m : Normal a b 0 := ⟨0, b - 1, 0, a_pos_of_neZero⟩
  let q : Normal a b 0 := ⟨0, 0, V, a_pos_of_neZero⟩
  let w : Normal a b 0 := ⟨0, b - 1, 1, a_pos_of_neZero⟩
  let yz : Normal a b 0 := ⟨0, 1, 1, a_pos_of_neZero⟩
  let zz : Normal a b 0 := ⟨0, 0, 2, a_pos_of_neZero⟩
  have hmS : m ∈ standardFinset S := by
    rw [mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet, mem_standardSet_p4Z_iff ha hb hV]
    simp [m, p4ZStandardNat]
  have hqS : q ∈ standardFinset S := by
    rw [mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet, mem_standardSet_p4Z_iff ha hb hV]
    simp [q, p4ZStandardNat]
  have hwS : w ∈ standardFinset S := by
    rw [mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet, mem_standardSet_p4Z_iff ha hb hV]
    simp [w, p4ZStandardNat]
    omega
  have hyzS : yz ∈ standardFinset S := by
    rw [mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet, mem_standardSet_p4Z_iff ha hb hV]
    simp [yz, p4ZStandardNat]
    omega
  have hzzS : zz ∈ standardFinset S := by
    rw [mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet, mem_standardSet_p4Z_iff ha hb hV]
    simp [zz, p4ZStandardNat]
    omega
  intro htrace
  obtain ⟨F, s, hs, hcoeff⟩ :=
    exists_root_image_with_variable_coeff_of_mem_trace (k := k) S hS
      (by omega) hanti (by exact ⟨ha, Or.inr ⟨hb, rfl⟩⟩) .z hzS htrace
  have hs' : s = C ∨ s = P ∨ s = Z := by
    simpa [S, C, P, Z, p4ZSocles] using hs
  rcases hs' with rfl | rfl | rfl
  · have hnot : ¬(Normal.zGenerator : Normal a b 0) ∣ C := by
      simp [Normal.exact_divides_iff, Normal.DividesCriterion,
        Normal.zGenerator, C]
    have hzero : X (k := k) S Normal.zGenerator hzS •
        U (k := k) S (rootIndex S C hC) = 0 :=
      (X_smul_rootDual_eq_zero_iff (k := k) S C hC
        (⟨Normal.zGenerator, hzS⟩ : MonomialIndex S)).2 hnot
    exact hcoeff (coeff_eq_zero_of_annihilator (k := k) S F
      (⟨Normal.zGenerator, hzS⟩ : MonomialIndex S)
      (⟨Normal.zGenerator, hzS⟩ : MonomialIndex S) ⟨zz, hzzS⟩
      (rootIndex S C hC) hzero
      (by apply Normal.ext <;> simp [zz, Normal.zGenerator]))
  · have htransfer := coeff_transfer_of_common_quotient (k := k) S F
      (⟨m, hmS⟩ : MonomialIndex S)
      (⟨Normal.zGenerator, hzS⟩ : MonomialIndex S)
      (⟨q, hqS⟩ : MonomialIndex S)
      (⟨Normal.zGenerator, hzS⟩ : MonomialIndex S)
      (⟨m, hmS⟩ : MonomialIndex S) (⟨w, hwS⟩ : MonomialIndex S)
      (rootIndex S P hP) (rootIndex S Z hZ)
      (by apply Normal.ext <;> simp [m, q, P, rootIndex] <;> omega)
      (by apply Normal.ext <;> simp [q, Z, Normal.zGenerator, rootIndex] <;> omega)
      (by apply Normal.ext <;> simp [m, w, Normal.zGenerator])
      (by apply Normal.ext <;> simp [m, w, Normal.zGenerator])
    have hnot : ¬(Normal.yGenerator : Normal a b 0) ∣ Z := by
      simp [Normal.exact_divides_iff, Normal.DividesCriterion,
        Normal.yGenerator, Z]
    have hzero : X (k := k) S Normal.yGenerator hyS •
        U (k := k) S (rootIndex S Z hZ) = 0 :=
      (X_smul_rootDual_eq_zero_iff (k := k) S Z hZ
        (⟨Normal.yGenerator, hyS⟩ : MonomialIndex S)).2 hnot
    have hvanish := coeff_eq_zero_of_annihilator (k := k) S F
      (⟨Normal.yGenerator, hyS⟩ : MonomialIndex S)
      (⟨m, hmS⟩ : MonomialIndex S) (rootIndex S C hC)
      (rootIndex S Z hZ) hzero
      (by apply Normal.ext <;>
        simp [m, C, Normal.yGenerator, rootIndex] <;> omega)
    exact hcoeff (htransfer.trans hvanish)
  · have hnot : ¬(Normal.yGenerator : Normal a b 0) ∣ Z := by
      simp [Normal.exact_divides_iff, Normal.DividesCriterion,
        Normal.yGenerator, Z]
    have hzero : X (k := k) S Normal.yGenerator hyS •
        U (k := k) S (rootIndex S Z hZ) = 0 :=
      (X_smul_rootDual_eq_zero_iff (k := k) S Z hZ
        (⟨Normal.yGenerator, hyS⟩ : MonomialIndex S)).2 hnot
    exact hcoeff (coeff_eq_zero_of_annihilator (k := k) S F
      (⟨Normal.yGenerator, hyS⟩ : MonomialIndex S)
      (⟨Normal.zGenerator, hzS⟩ : MonomialIndex S) ⟨yz, hyzS⟩
      (rootIndex S Z hZ) hzero
      (by apply Normal.ext <;> simp [yz, Normal.yGenerator, Normal.zGenerator]))

name: P23.Artin.p5Z_z_not_mem_trace
statement:
theorem p5Z_z_not_mem_trace {a b v : ℕ} [NeZero a]
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 2 ≤ b) (hv : 1 ≤ v) :
    let S
proof:
:= p5ZSocles (a := a) (b := b) ha v
    let hzS : (Normal.zGenerator : Normal a b 0) ∈ standardFinset S :=
      (mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet S _).2 (p5Z_isLiveTie ha hb hv).2.2.1
    X (k := k) S Normal.zGenerator hzS ∉ TraceSubmodule k S := by
  dsimp only
  let S := p5ZSocles (a := a) (b := b) ha v
  let R : Normal a b 0 := ⟨a - 1, 0, v, by omega⟩
  let C : Normal a b 0 := ⟨0, b, 0, a_pos_of_neZero⟩
  let Z : Normal a b 0 := ⟨0, 0, v + 1, a_pos_of_neZero⟩
  have hR : R ∈ S := by simp [S, R, p5ZSocles]
  have hC : C ∈ S := by simp [S, C, p5ZSocles]
  have hZ : Z ∈ S := by simp [S, Z, p5ZSocles]
  have hcard3 : S.card = 3 := p5Z_card_eq_three ha hb hv
  have hS : S.Nonempty := Finset.card_pos.mp (by omega)
  have hanti : IsRootAntichain S := p5Z_isRootAntichain ha hb hv
  have hlive : IsLiveTie S := p5Z_isLiveTie ha hb hv
  have hxS : (Normal.xGenerator : Normal a b 0) ∈ standardFinset S :=
    (mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet S _).2 hlive.1
  have hzS : (Normal.zGenerator : Normal a b 0) ∈ standardFinset S :=
    (mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet S _).2 hlive.2.2.1
  let m : Normal a b 0 := ⟨a - 1, 0, 0, by omega⟩
  let q : Normal a b 0 := ⟨0, 0, v, a_pos_of_neZero⟩
  let w : Normal a b 0 := ⟨a - 1, 0, 1, by omega⟩
  let xz : Normal a b 0 := ⟨1, 0, 1, by omega⟩
  let zz : Normal a b 0 := ⟨0, 0, 2, a_pos_of_neZero⟩
  have hmS : m ∈ standardFinset S := by
    rw [mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet, mem_standardSet_p5Z_iff ha hb hv]
    simp [m, p5ZStandardNat]
  have hqS : q ∈ standardFinset S := by
    rw [mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet, mem_standardSet_p5Z_iff ha hb hv]
    simp [q, p5ZStandardNat]
  have hwS : w ∈ standardFinset S := by
    rw [mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet, mem_standardSet_p5Z_iff ha hb hv]
    simp [w, p5ZStandardNat]
    omega
  have hxzS : xz ∈ standardFinset S := by
    rw [mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet, mem_standardSet_p5Z_iff ha hb hv]
    simp [xz, p5ZStandardNat]
    omega
  have hzzS : zz ∈ standardFinset S := by
    rw [mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet, mem_standardSet_p5Z_iff ha hb hv]
    simp [zz, p5ZStandardNat]
    omega
  intro htrace
  obtain ⟨F, s, hs, hcoeff⟩ :=
    exists_root_image_with_variable_coeff_of_mem_trace (k := k) S hS
      (by omega) hanti (by exact ⟨ha, Or.inr ⟨hb, rfl⟩⟩) .z hzS htrace
  have hs' : s = R ∨ s = C ∨ s = Z := by
    simpa [S, R, C, Z, p5ZSocles] using hs
  rcases hs' with rfl | rfl | rfl
  · have htransfer := coeff_transfer_of_common_quotient (k := k) S F
      (⟨m, hmS⟩ : MonomialIndex S)
      (⟨Normal.zGenerator, hzS⟩ : MonomialIndex S)
      (⟨q, hqS⟩ : MonomialIndex S)
      (⟨Normal.zGenerator, hzS⟩ : MonomialIndex S)
      (⟨m, hmS⟩ : MonomialIndex S) (⟨w, hwS⟩ : MonomialIndex S)
      (rootIndex S R hR) (rootIndex S Z hZ)
      (by apply Normal.ext <;>
        simp [m, q, R, rootIndex, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (show a - 1 < a by omega),
          Nat.div_eq_of_lt (show a - 1 < a by omega)] <;> omega)
      (by apply Normal.ext <;> simp [q, Z, Normal.zGenerator, rootIndex] <;> omega)
      (by apply Normal.ext <;> simp [m, w, Normal.zGenerator] <;> omega)
      (by apply Normal.ext <;> simp [m, w, Normal.zGenerator] <;> omega)
    have hnot : ¬(Normal.xGenerator : Normal a b 0) ∣ Z := by
      simp [Normal.exact_divides_iff, Normal.DividesCriterion,
        Normal.xGenerator, show a ≠ 1 by omega, Z]
      omega
    have hzero : X (k := k) S Normal.xGenerator hxS •
        U (k := k) S (rootIndex S Z hZ) = 0 :=
      (X_smul_rootDual_eq_zero_iff (k := k) S Z hZ
        (⟨Normal.xGenerator, hxS⟩ : MonomialIndex S)).2 hnot
    have hwrap : (Normal.xGenerator : Normal a b 0) * m = C := by
      rw [mul_comm]
      simpa [m, C, Normal.wrappedXPredecessor] using
        (Normal.wrappedXPredecessor_mul C (by rfl)
          (by simp [C]) (by simp [C]))
    have hvanish := coeff_eq_zero_of_annihilator (k := k) S F
      (⟨Normal.xGenerator, hxS⟩ : MonomialIndex S)
      (⟨m, hmS⟩ : MonomialIndex S) (rootIndex S C hC)
      (rootIndex S Z hZ) hzero
      (by simpa [rootIndex] using hwrap)
    exact hcoeff (htransfer.trans hvanish)
  · have hnot : ¬(Normal.zGenerator : Normal a b 0) ∣ C := by
      simp [Normal.exact_divides_iff, Normal.DividesCriterion,
        Normal.zGenerator, C]
    have hzero : X (k := k) S Normal.zGenerator hzS •
        U (k := k) S (rootIndex S C hC) = 0 :=
      (X_smul_rootDual_eq_zero_iff (k := k) S C hC
        (⟨Normal.zGenerator, hzS⟩ : MonomialIndex S)).2 hnot
    exact hcoeff (coeff_eq_zero_of_annihilator (k := k) S F
      (⟨Normal.zGenerator, hzS⟩ : MonomialIndex S)
      (⟨Normal.zGenerator, hzS⟩ : MonomialIndex S) ⟨zz, hzzS⟩
      (rootIndex S C hC) hzero
      (by apply Normal.ext <;> simp [zz, Normal.zGenerator]))
  · have hnot : ¬(Normal.xGenerator : Normal a b 0) ∣ Z := by
      simp [Normal.exact_divides_iff, Normal.DividesCriterion,
        Normal.xGenerator, show a ≠ 1 by omega, Z]
      omega
    have hzero : X (k := k) S Normal.xGenerator hxS •
        U (k := k) S (rootIndex S Z hZ) = 0 :=
      (X_smul_rootDual_eq_zero_iff (k := k) S Z hZ
        (⟨Normal.xGenerator, hxS⟩ : MonomialIndex S)).2 hnot
    exact hcoeff (coeff_eq_zero_of_annihilator (k := k) S F
      (⟨Normal.xGenerator, hxS⟩ : MonomialIndex S)
      (⟨Normal.zGenerator, hzS⟩ : MonomialIndex S) ⟨xz, hxzS⟩
      (rootIndex S Z hZ) hzero
      (by apply Normal.ext <;>
        simp [xz, Normal.xGenerator, show a ≠ 1 by omega, Normal.zGenerator,
          Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (show 1 < a by omega),
          Nat.div_eq_of_lt (show 1 < a by omega)]))

name: P23.Artin.canonicalTraceObstructions
statement:
theorem canonicalTraceObstructions : CanonicalTraceObstructions (k := k) where
  mixedYZ
proof:
:= mixedYZ_y_not_mem_trace

name: P23.OneTie.mixed_topDeletion_border_card_le_five
proof:
:= by
  rcases htop with ⟨T,h3,_,hstd⟩
  rcases T with ⟨r,u,v,hrA⟩
  have hne : S.Nonempty := Finset.card_pos.mp (by omega)
  have ht : liveTiePoint ∣ (⟨r,u,v,hrA⟩ : Normal a b c) := by
    have h := hlive.2.2.2
    rw [hstd] at h
    exact h.1
  have hbounds := (Normal.exact_divides_iff _ _).mp ht
  simp [liveTiePoint,Normal.DividesCriterion] at hbounds
  have hu : b≤u := by omega
  have hv : c≤v := by omega
  by_cases hlast : r=a-1
  · rw [topDeletionMixedLast_border_card S ha hb hc hu hv hlast hne hstd]
    omega

name: P23.OneTie.pure_topDeletion_border_card_le_five
proof:
:= by

  have hne : S.Nonempty := Finset.card_pos.mp (by omega)
  have ht : liveTiePoint ∣ (⟨r,u,v,hrA⟩ : Normal a b 0) := by

    rw [hstd] at h

    have h := hlive.2.2.1
    rw [hstd] at h
    exact h.1
  have hbounds := (Normal.exact_divides_iff _ _).mp ht
  have hzbounds := (Normal.exact_divides_iff _ _).mp hz
  simp [liveTiePoint,Normal.zGenerator,Normal.DividesCriterion] at hbounds hzbounds

name: P23.OneTie.topDeletion_border_card_le_five
statement:
theorem topDeletion_border_card_le_five {S : Finset (Normal a b c)}
    (h : CoverHypotheses S) (htop : IsTopDeletion S) : (borderFinset S).card≤5
proof:
:= by
  rcases h.live_domain with hm | ⟨hb,hc⟩
  · exact mixed_topDeletion_border_card_le_five h.a_ge_two hm.1 hm.2 h.live_tie htop
  · subst c
    exact pure_topDeletion_border_card_le_five h.a_ge_two hb h.live_tie htop

name: P23.OneTie.typeThreeBase_border_le_five
proof:
:= by
  cases hs with
  | topDeletion ht => exact topDeletion_border_card_le_five h ht
  | pureFibreProduct hf =>
      obtain ⟨hb,hc⟩ := h.live_domain.resolve_left (by omega)
      rw [pureFibreProductShape_border_card h.a_ge_two hb h3 hf h.antichain h.live_tie]
  | m2K ha hu hv hr => rw [m2K_border_card ha hu hv hr]; split <;> omega
  | m2Z ha hu hv hr => rw [m2Z_border_card ha hu hv hr]
  | m3K ha hb hc hv => rw [m3K_border_card ha hb hc hv]
  | m4Y ha hu => rw [m4Y_border_card ha hu]
  | m5Y ha hb hc hv => rw [m5Y_border_card ha hb hc hv]; split <;> omega
  | m5Z ha hb hc hv => rw [m5Z_border_card ha hb hc hv]
  | p4Z ha hb hv => rw [p4Z_border_card ha hb hv]; omega
  | p5Z ha hb hv => rw [p5Z_border_card ha hb hv]; omega

name: P23.OneTie.three_root_nondominant_border_card_le_five
statement:
theorem three_root_nondominant_border_card_le_five
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (h : CoverHypotheses S) (h3 : S.card=3) :
    (borderFinset S).card≤5
proof:
:= by
  cases h5_typeThree_specialized_cover S h h3 with
  | direct hs => exact typeThreeBase_border_le_five h h3 hs
  | reflected hb hc hs =>
      have hh := coverHypotheses_swapYZ h hb hc
      have hc3 : (swapYZFinset S).card=3 := by simpa [swapYZFinset] using h3
      have hp := typeThreeBase_border_le_five hh hc3 hs
      rwa [borderFinset_swapYZ_card] at hp

name: P23.OneTie.base_two_border_le_four
proof:
:= by
  cases hs with
  | topDeletion ht => obtain ⟨_,h3,_⟩ := ht; omega
  | pureFibreProduct hf =>
      obtain ⟨hb,_⟩ := h.live_domain.resolve_left (by omega)
      exact pureFibreProduct_two_border_card_le_four h.a_ge_two hb h2 hf h.live_tie
  | m2 ha hu hv hr => exact m2_core_border_card_le_four ha hu hv hr
  | m3 ha hb hc hv => exact m3_core_border_card_le_four ha hb hc hv
  | m4 ha hu => exact m4_core_border_card_le_four ha hu
  | m5 ha hb hc hv => exact m5_core_border_card_le_four ha hb hc hv
  | p3 ha hb => exact p3_core_border_card_le_four ha hb
  | p4 ha hb hv => exact p4_core_border_card_le_four ha hb hv
  | p5 ha hb hv => exact p5_core_border_card_le_four ha hb hv
  | p6 ha hb hv => exact p6_core_border_card_le_four ha hb hv
  | m2K ha hu hv hr =>
      simp [m2KSocles,m2Core,m2Partner,m2KRoot,Finset.card_insert_eq_ite,Normal.mk.injEq] at h2 <;> omega
  | m2Z ha hu hv hr =>
      simp [m2ZSocles,m2Core,m2Partner,m2ZRoot,Finset.card_insert_eq_ite,Normal.mk.injEq] at h2 <;> omega
  | m3K ha hb hc hv =>
      simp [m3KSocles,m3KCore,m3KPartner,m3KRoot,Finset.card_insert_eq_ite,Normal.mk.injEq] at h2 <;> omega
  | m4Y ha hu =>
      simp [m4YSocles,m4YCore,m4YPartner,m4YRoot,Finset.card_insert_eq_ite,Normal.mk.injEq] at h2 <;> omega
  | m5Y ha hb hc hv =>
      simp [m5YSocles,m5Core,m5Partner,m5YRoot,Finset.card_insert_eq_ite,Normal.mk.injEq] at h2 <;> omega
  | m5Z ha hb hc hv =>
      simp [m5ZSocles,m5Core,m5Partner,m5ZRoot,Finset.card_insert_eq_ite,Normal.mk.injEq] at h2
      split_ifs at h2 <;> omega
  | p4Z ha hb hv =>
      simp [p4ZSocles,Finset.card_insert_eq_ite,Normal.mk.injEq] at h2 <;> omega
  | p5Z ha hb hv =>
      simp [p5ZSocles,Finset.card_insert_eq_ite,Normal.mk.injEq] at h2 <;> omega

name: P23.OneTie.two_root_nondominant_border_card_le_four
statement:
theorem two_root_nondominant_border_card_le_four
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (h : CoverHypotheses S) (h2 : S.card=2) :
    (borderFinset S).card≤4
proof:
:= by
  cases h5_full_symbolic_cover S h with
  | direct hs => exact base_two_border_le_four h h2 hs
  | reflected hb hc hs =>
      have hh := coverHypotheses_swapYZ h hb hc
      have hc2 : (swapYZFinset S).card=2 := by simpa [swapYZFinset] using h2
      have hp := base_two_border_le_four hh hc2 hs
      rwa [borderFinset_swapYZ_card] at hp

name: P23.OneTie.oneTie_nondominant_border_card_le_type_plus_two
statement:
theorem oneTie_nondominant_border_card_le_type_plus_two
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (h : CoverHypotheses S) :
    (borderFinset S).card≤S.card+2
proof:
:= by

  rcases ht with ht | ht
  · have := two_root_nondominant_border_card_le_four S h ht; omega
  · have := three_root_nondominant_border_card_le_five S h ht; omega

name: P23.OneTie.mixed_three_border_support_classification
statement:
theorem mixed_three_border_support_classification (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (hS : S.Nonempty) (hd : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) (hl : IsLiveTie S)
    (ha : IsRootAntichain S) (hc : 0 < c)
    (ht : quotientType ℚ S hS hd hl = 3) (hcard : (borderFinset S).card = 3)
    (hnf : ∀ q ∈ borderFinset S, ¬NormalHasFullSupport q) :
    Nonempty (MixedThreeBorderData S) ∨
      Nonempty (MixedThreeBorderData (swapYZFinset S))
proof:
:= by
  have hb : 0 < b := by rcases hd.2 with hm | hp <;> omega
  obtain ⟨B,hB,hY⟩ := mixed_pure_y_border_exists S hS hd hc
  obtain ⟨C,hC,hZ⟩ := pure_z_border_exists S hS hd hb
  have hYZ : (yAxis B : Normal a b c) ≠ zAxis C := by
    intro he; have := congrArg Normal.y he; simp [yAxis,zAxis] at this; omega
  obtain ⟨q,hq,hqY,hqZ,he⟩ := three_border_exists_third S hcard (yAxis B) (zAxis C) hY hZ hYZ
  have hqy : q.y < B := by
    by_contra hn
    have hdq : yAxis B ∣ q := (Normal.exact_divides_iff _ _).mpr
      (by simp [Normal.DividesCriterion,yAxis]; omega)
    exact hqY (border_dvd_border_eq hS hd.1 hY hq hdq).symm
  have hqz : q.z < C := by
    by_contra hn
    have hdq : zAxis C ∣ q := (Normal.exact_divides_iff _ _).mpr
      (by simp [Normal.DividesCriterion,zAxis]; omega)
    exact hqZ (border_dvd_border_eq hS hd.1 hZ hq hdq).symm
  have hx : 0 < q.x := by
    by_contra hn
    have hx0 : q.x = 0 := by omega
    have hy : 0 < q.y := by
      by_contra hy
      have hy0 : q.y = 0 := by omega
      have hqe : q = zAxis q.z := by apply Normal.ext <;> simp [zAxis,hx0,hy0]
      have hzC := pure_z_border_unique hS hd.1 (hqe ▸ hq) hZ
      exact hqZ (hqe.trans (congrArg zAxis hzC))
    have hz : 0 < q.z := by
      by_contra hz
      have hz0 : q.z = 0 := by omega
      have hqe : q = yAxis q.y := by apply Normal.ext <;> simp [yAxis,hx0,hz0]
      have hyB := pure_y_border_unique hS hd.1 (hqe ▸ hq) hY
      exact hqY (hqe.trans (congrArg yAxis hyB))
    have hqe : q = yzPoint q.y q.z := by apply Normal.ext <;> simp [yzPoint,hx0]
    have he' : borderFinset S = {yAxis B,zAxis C,yzPoint q.y q.z} := by
      rw [he,hqe]
      rfl
    have htt := mixed_three_border_no_x_type_le_two S hS hd hl ha B C q.y q.z
      hy hqy hz hqz he'
    omega
  have hnp := border_not_pure_x hS hl hq
  have hn := hnf q hq
  unfold NormalHasFullSupport at hn
  by_cases hy0 : q.y = 0
  · have hz : 0 < q.z := by unfold NormalIsPureX at hnp; omega
    left
    refine ⟨⟨B,C,q.x,q.z,hb,hc,hB,hx,q.x_lt,hz,hqz,?_⟩⟩
    have hqe : q = (⟨q.x,0,q.z,q.x_lt⟩ : Normal a b c) := by
      apply Normal.ext <;> simp [hy0]
    rw [he,hqe]
  · have hz0 : q.z = 0 := by omega
    have hy : 0 < q.y := by omega
    right
    refine ⟨⟨C,B,q.x,q.y,hc,hb,hC,hx,q.x_lt,hy,hqy,?_⟩⟩
    rw [borderFinset_swapYZ_exact,he,swapYZFinset_triple]
    ext p
    simp [swapYZ,yAxis,zAxis,hz0]
    tauto

name: P23.OneTie.rho_four_mixed_canonical_impossible
statement:
theorem rho_four_mixed_canonical_impossible (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (hS : S.Nonempty) (hd : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) (hl : IsLiveTie S)
    (ha : IsRootAntichain S) (hc : 0 < c)
    (ht : quotientType ℚ S hS hd hl = 3) (hcard : (borderFinset S).card = 3)
    (hnf : ∀ q ∈ borderFinset S, ¬NormalHasFullSupport q)
    (hn : QuotientNearlyGorenstein ℚ S hS hd hl) : False
proof:
:= by
  rcases mixed_three_border_support_classification S hS hd hl ha hc ht hcard hnf with
    hM | hM
  · obtain ⟨M⟩ := hM
    exact mixed_three_border_not_nearlyGorenstein M hS hd hl ha ht hn
  · obtain ⟨M⟩ := hM
    have hb : 0 < b := by rcases hd.2 with hm | hp <;> omega
    have hd' : IsLiveParameterDomain a c b := ⟨hd.1,Or.inl ⟨by omega,by omega⟩⟩
    have hS' : (swapYZFinset S).Nonempty := by
      obtain ⟨s,hs⟩ := hS
      exact ⟨swapYZ s,Finset.mem_map.mpr ⟨s,hs,rfl⟩⟩
    have hl' := swapYZIsLiveTie S hd hl
    have ha' := swapYZIsRootAntichain S ha
    have ht' : quotientType ℚ (swapYZFinset S) hS' hd' hl' = 3 := by
      rw [quotientType_eq_rootCard _ _ _ _ ha',swapYZFinset,Finset.card_map]
      exact (quotientType_eq_three_iff S hS hd hl ha).mp ht
    have hn' := (quotientNearlyGorenstein_iff_directNearlyGorenstein S hS hd hl).mp hn
    have htr := (directNearlyGorenstein_iff_variablesInTrace S hS hd hl).mp hn'
    have htr' := swapYZVariablesInTrace S hd hl hl' htr
    exact mixed_three_border_z_not_trace M hS' hd' hl' ha' ht' htr'.2.2

name: P23.OneTie.border_scalar
statement:
private theorem border_scalar {S : Finset (Normal a b c)}
    (hS : S.Nonempty) (Std : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → Prop)
    (hstd : ∀ p, p ∈ standardSet S ↔ Std p.x p.y p.z)
    (m : Normal a b c) (hm : m ∈ borderFinset S) :
    ¬Std m.x m.y m.z ∧
    (if 0<m.x then Std (m.x-1) m.y m.z
     else if b≤m.y ∧ c≤m.z then Std (a-1) (m.y-b) (m.z-c) else True) ∧
    (0<m.y → Std m.x (m.y-1) m.z) ∧
    (0<m.z → Std m.x m.y (m.z-1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_borderFinset_iff hS] at hm
  rcases m with ⟨x,y,z,hxlt⟩
  by_cases hx : 0<x
  · simpa [IsMinimalBorder,ApplicablePredecessorsSurvive,hstd,Normal.predecessor,
      Normal.xPredecessor,Normal.yPredecessor,Normal.zPredecessor,hx] using hm
  · have hx0 : x=0 := by omega
    by_cases hy : b≤y <;> by_cases hz : c≤z <;>
      simpa [IsMinimalBorder,ApplicablePredecessorsSurvive,hstd,Normal.predecessor,
        Normal.wrappedXPredecessor,Normal.yPredecessor,Normal.zPredecessor,hx,hx0,hy,hz] using hm

name: P23.OneTie.m2_scalar
statement:
private theorem m2_scalar (r u v x y z : ℕ)
    (hn : ¬(y≤u ∧ z≤v ∧ (x≤r ∨ y<u) ∧ (x≤r+1 ∨ z<v)))
    (hx : 0<x → y≤u ∧ z≤v ∧ (x≤r+1 ∨ y<u) ∧ (x≤r+2 ∨ z<v))
    (hy : 0<y → y≤u+1 ∧ z≤v ∧ (x≤r ∨ y-1<u) ∧ (x≤r+1 ∨ z<v))
    (hz : 0<z → y≤u ∧ z≤v+1 ∧ (x≤r ∨ y<u) ∧ (x≤r+1 ∨ z-1<v)) :
    (x=0 ∧ y=u+1 ∧ z=0) ∨ (x=0 ∧ y=0 ∧ z=v+1) ∨
    (x=r+1 ∧ y=u ∧ z=0) ∨ (x=r+2 ∧ y=0 ∧ z=v)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx0 : x=0
  · subst x
    have hout : u<y ∨ v<z := by omega
    rcases hout with h | h
    · have hyp := hy (by omega)
      have hz0 : z=0 := by
        by_contra hh
        have hzp := hz (by omega)
        omega
      exact Or.inl ⟨rfl,by omega,hz0⟩
    · have hzp := hz (by omega)
      have hy0 : y=0 := by
        by_contra hh
        have hyp := hy (by omega)
        omega
      exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨rfl,hy0,by omega⟩)
  · have hxp := hx (by omega)
    have hout : (r<x ∧ u≤y) ∨ (r+1<x ∧ v≤z) := by
      clear hx hy hz
      omega
    rcases hout with h | h
    · have hz0 : z=0 := by
        by_contra hh
        have hzp := hz (by omega)
        omega
      exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨by omega,by omega,hz0⟩))
    · have hy0 : y=0 := by
        by_contra hh
        have hyp := hy (by omega)
        omega
      exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨by omega,hy0,by omega⟩))

name: P23.OneTie.m2_core_border_card_le_four
statement:
theorem m2_core_border_card_le_four (ha : 2≤a) (hu : 1≤u) (hv : 1≤v)
    (hr : r≤a-2) : (borderFinset (m2Socles (a:=a) ha r u v hr)).card ≤ 4
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hlast : r=a-2
  · let G : Finset (Normal a 1 1) := {⟨0,u+1,0,by omega⟩,
      ⟨0,0,v+1,by omega⟩,⟨r+1,u,0,by omega⟩}
    have hs : borderFinset (m2Socles (a:=a) ha r u v hr) ⊆ G := by
      intro m hm
      have hh := border_scalar (by simp [m2Socles]) (m2CoreStd r u v)
        (m2_core_standard ha hu hv hr) m hm
      clear hm
      rcases m with ⟨x,y,z,hxlt⟩
      simp [m2CoreStd] at hh
      simp [G,Normal.mk.injEq]
      have hp := m2_scalar r u v x y z (by simpa using hh.1)
        (by intro hx; simpa [hx] using hh.2.1) hh.2.2.1 hh.2.2.2
      clear hh
      rcases hp with hp | hp | hp | hp <;> omega
    have hc := Finset.card_le_card hs
    have hg : G.card≤3 := card_three_le _ _ _
    omega
  · let G : Finset (Normal a 1 1) := {⟨0,u+1,0,by omega⟩,
      ⟨0,0,v+1,by omega⟩,⟨r+1,u,0,by omega⟩,⟨r+2,0,v,by omega⟩}
    have hs : borderFinset (m2Socles (a:=a) ha r u v hr) ⊆ G := by
      intro m hm
      have hh := border_scalar (by simp [m2Socles]) (m2CoreStd r u v)
        (m2_core_standard ha hu hv hr) m hm
      clear hm
      rcases m with ⟨x,y,z,hxlt⟩
      simp [m2CoreStd] at hh
      simp [G,Normal.mk.injEq]
      have hp := m2_scalar r u v x y z (by simpa using hh.1)
        (by intro hx; simpa [hx] using hh.2.1) hh.2.2.1 hh.2.2.2
      clear hh
      exact hp
    exact le_trans (Finset.card_le_card hs) (card_four_le _ _ _ _)

name: P23.OneTie.m3_core_border_card_le_four
statement:
theorem m3_core_border_card_le_four (ha : 2≤a) (hb : 1≤b) (hc : 1≤c)
    (hv : c≤v) : (borderFinset (m3Socles (a:=a) (b:=b) (c:=c) v)).card ≤ 4
proof:
:= by
  let G : Finset (Normal a b c) := {⟨0,b+1,0,by omega⟩,
    ⟨0,0,v+2,by omega⟩,⟨1,1,0,by omega⟩,⟨1,0,v+1-c,by omega⟩}
  have hs : borderFinset (m3Socles (a:=a) (b:=b) (c:=c) v) ⊆ G := by
    intro m hm
    have hh := border_scalar (by simp [m3Socles])
      (pairStd (m3KCore v) (m3KPartner v))
      (by intro p; exact pair_standard _ _ _) m hm
    clear hm
    rcases m with ⟨x,y,z,hxlt⟩
    simp [pairStd,m3KCore,m3KPartner] at hh
    simp [G,Normal.mk.injEq]
    rcases hh with ⟨hn,hxp,hyp,hzp⟩
    by_cases hx : 0<x <;> by_cases hy : 0<y <;> by_cases hz : 0<z
    all_goals
      try have hy' := hyp hy
      try have hz' := hzp hz
      clear hyp hzp
      split_ifs at hxp
      all_goals
        try { have hx' := hxp (by omega) (by omega); clear hxp }
        try { have hx' := hxp (by omega); clear hxp }
        omega
  exact le_trans (Finset.card_le_card hs) (card_four_le _ _ _ _)
