    simp [G,Normal.mk.injEq]
    rcases hh with ⟨hn,hxp,hyp,hzp⟩
    by_cases hx : 0<x <;> by_cases hy : 0<y <;> by_cases hz : 0<z
    all_goals
      try have hy' := hyp hy
      try have hz' := hzp hz
      clear hyp hzp
      split_ifs at hxp
      all_goals
        try { have hx' := hxp (by omega) (by omega); clear hxp }
        try { have hx' := hxp (by omega); clear hxp }
        omega
  have hh := le_trans (Finset.card_le_card hs) (card_three_le _ _ _)
  omega

name: P23.OneTie.p6_core_border_card_le_four
statement:
theorem p6_core_border_card_le_four (ha : 2≤a) (hb : 2≤b) (hv : 1≤v) :
    (borderFinset (p6Socles (a:=a) (b:=b) ha v)).card ≤ 4
proof:
:= by
  let G : Finset (Normal a b 0) := {⟨1,1,0,by omega⟩,
    ⟨0,1,v,by omega⟩,⟨0,0,v+1,by omega⟩}
  have hs : borderFinset (p6Socles (a:=a) (b:=b) ha v) ⊆ G := by
    intro m hm
    have hh := border_scalar (by simp [p6Socles])
      (pairStd (⟨a-1,0,v,by omega⟩ : Normal a b 0) ⟨0,b,v-1,by omega⟩)
      (by intro p; exact pair_standard _ _ _) m hm
    clear hm
    rcases m with ⟨x,y,z,hxlt⟩
    simp [pairStd] at hh
    simp [G,Normal.mk.injEq]
    rcases hh with ⟨hn,hxp,hyp,hzp⟩
    by_cases hx : 0<x <;> by_cases hy : 0<y <;> by_cases hz : 0<z
    all_goals
      try have hy' := hyp hy
      try have hz' := hzp hz
      clear hyp hzp
      split_ifs at hxp
      all_goals
        try { have hx' := hxp (by omega) (by omega); clear hxp }
        try { have hx' := hxp (by omega); clear hxp }
        omega
  have hh := le_trans (Finset.card_le_card hs) (card_three_le _ _ _)
  omega

name: P23.OneTie.pure_fibre_pair_border_card_le_four
statement:
theorem pure_fibre_pair_border_card_le_four (ha : 2≤a) (hb : 2≤b)
    (r u k : ℕ) (hr : r<a) (hu : b≤u) (hk : 1≤k) :
    (borderFinset ({⟨r,u,0,hr⟩,⟨0,0,k,by omega⟩} : Finset (Normal a b 0))).card ≤ 4
proof:
:= by
  let C : Normal a b 0 := ⟨r,u,0,hr⟩
  let Z : Normal a b 0 := ⟨0,0,k,by omega⟩
  let G : Finset (Normal a b 0) := {pureH r u hr,
    ⟨1,0,1,by omega⟩,⟨0,1,1,by omega⟩,⟨0,0,k+1,by omega⟩}
  have hs : borderFinset {C,Z} ⊆ G := by
    intro m hm
    have hh := border_scalar (by simp) (pairStd C Z)
      (by intro p; exact pair_standard _ _ _) m hm
    rcases m with ⟨x,y,z,hxlt⟩
    simp [pairStd,C,Z] at hh
    by_cases hlast : r<a-1
    · simp [G,pureH,hlast,Normal.mk.injEq]
      rcases hh with ⟨hn,hxp,hyp,hzp⟩
      by_cases hx : 0<x <;> by_cases hy : 0<y <;> by_cases hz : 0<z
      all_goals
        try have hy' := hyp hy
        try have hz' := hzp hz
        clear hyp hzp
        split_ifs at hxp
        all_goals
          try { have hx' := hxp (by omega) (by omega); clear hxp }
          try { have hx' := hxp (by omega); clear hxp }
          omega
    · simp [G,pureH,hlast,Normal.mk.injEq]
      rcases hh with ⟨hn,hxp,hyp,hzp⟩
      by_cases hx : 0<x <;> by_cases hy : 0<y <;> by_cases hz : 0<z
      all_goals
        try have hy' := hyp hy
        try have hz' := hzp hz
        clear hyp hzp
        split_ifs at hxp
        all_goals
          try { have hx' := hxp (by omega) (by omega); clear hxp }
          try { have hx' := hxp (by omega); clear hxp }
          omega
  exact le_trans (Finset.card_le_card hs) (card_four_le _ _ _ _)

name: P23.OneTie.pureFibreProduct_two_border_card_le_four
statement:
theorem pureFibreProduct_two_border_card_le_four
    {S : Finset (Normal a b 0)} (ha : 2≤a) (hb : 2≤b)
    (h2 : S.card=2) (hshape : IsPureFibreProduct S) (hlive : IsLiveTie S) :
    (borderFinset S).card ≤ 4
proof:
:= by
  rcases hshape with ⟨_,k,hk,hZ,hplane⟩
  let Z : Normal a b 0 := ⟨0,0,k,by omega⟩
  have hZm : Z∈S := hZ
  have hec : (S.erase Z).card=1 := by rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem hZm,h2]
  obtain ⟨P,hP⟩ := Finset.card_eq_one.mp hec
  have hPm : P∈S := Finset.mem_of_mem_erase (by rw [hP]; simp)
  have hPZ : P≠Z := Finset.ne_of_mem_erase (by rw [hP]; simp)
  have hpz := hplane P hPm hPZ
  have he : S={P,Z} := by
    rw [← Finset.insert_erase hZm,hP]
    ext m; simp; tauto
  have hu : b≤P.y := by
    have ht := hlive.2.2.2
    rw [he] at ht
    simp [standardSet,Normal.exact_divides_iff,Normal.DividesCriterion,liveTiePoint,Z] at ht
    omega
  rw [he]
  rcases P with ⟨r,u,z,hr⟩
  dsimp at hpz
  subst z
  exact pure_fibre_pair_border_card_le_four ha hb r u k hr hu hk

name: P23.OneTie.Normal.mem_divisorDownset_iff
statement:
theorem mem_divisorDownset_iff (p s : Normal a b c) :
    p ∈ divisorDownset s ↔ DividesCriterion p s
proof:
:= by
  exact exact_divides_iff p s

name: P23.OneTie.Normal.mem_divisorDownset_iff_blocks
statement:
theorem mem_divisorDownset_iff_blocks (p s : Normal a b c) :
    p ∈ divisorDownset s ↔ OrdinaryBlock p s ∨ WrappedBlock p s
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_divisorDownset_iff]
  unfold DividesCriterion OrdinaryBlock WrappedBlock
  omega

name: P23.OneTie.Normal.mem_boundedNormals_iff
statement:
theorem mem_boundedNormals_iff (p s : Normal a b c) :
    p ∈ boundedNormals s ↔ p.y ≤ s.y ∧ p.z ≤ s.z
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hp
    rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hp with ⟨t, -, rfl⟩
    change t.2.1.val ≤ s.y ∧ t.2.2.val ≤ s.z
    exact ⟨by have := t.2.1.isLt; omega, by have := t.2.2.isLt; omega⟩
  · rintro ⟨hy, hz⟩
    let t : Fin a × Fin (s.y + 1) × Fin (s.z + 1) :=
      ⟨⟨p.x, p.x_lt⟩, ⟨⟨p.y, by omega⟩, ⟨p.z, by omega⟩⟩⟩
    apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
    refine ⟨t, Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
    apply Normal.ext <;> rfl

name: P23.OneTie.Normal.mem_divisorFinset_iff
statement:
theorem mem_divisorFinset_iff (p s : Normal a b c) :
    p ∈ divisorFinset s ↔ p ∣ s
proof:
:= by
  rw [divisorFinset, Finset.mem_filter, mem_boundedNormals_iff]
  constructor
  · exact fun h => (exact_divides_iff p s).2 h.2
  · intro h
    have hc := (exact_divides_iff p s).1 h
    exact ⟨⟨hc.1, hc.2.1⟩, hc⟩

name: P23.OneTie.Normal.divisorDownset_finite
statement:
theorem divisorDownset_finite (s : Normal a b c) :
    (divisorDownset s).Finite
proof:
:= by
  have heq : divisorDownset s = (divisorFinset s : Set (Normal a b c)) := by
    ext p
    rw [Finset.mem_coe, mem_divisorFinset_iff]
    rfl
  rw [heq]
  exact (divisorFinset s).finite_toSet

name: P23.OneTie.mem_standardSet_iff
statement:
theorem mem_standardSet_iff (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (p : Normal a b c) :
    p ∈ standardSet S ↔ ∃ s ∈ S, p ∣ s
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: P23.OneTie.mem_standardFinset_iff
statement:
theorem mem_standardFinset_iff (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (p : Normal a b c) :
    p ∈ standardFinset S ↔ ∃ s ∈ S, p ∣ s
proof:
:= by
  simp [standardFinset, Normal.mem_divisorFinset_iff]

name: P23.OneTie.mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet
statement:
theorem mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (p : Normal a b c) : p ∈ standardFinset S ↔ p ∈ standardSet S
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_standardFinset_iff, mem_standardSet_iff]

name: P23.OneTie.standardSet_finite
statement:
theorem standardSet_finite (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) :
    (standardSet S).Finite
proof:
:= by
  have heq : standardSet S = (standardFinset S : Set (Normal a b c)) := by
    ext p
    rw [Finset.mem_coe, mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet]

statement:
theorem xRoot_mem (hS : S.Nonempty) (hd : IsLiveParameterDomain a b 0)
    (ha : IsRootAntichain S) (huv : P.u < P.v) : P.xRoot ∈ S
proof:
:=
  Eq.mp (congrArg (fun T => P.xRoot ∈ T) (pure_three_border_roots_exact P hS hd ha huv).symm)

statement:

statement:

name: P23.OneTie.PureThreeBorderData.annihilator_scalars_survive
statement:
theorem annihilator_scalars_survive (hS : S.Nonempty) (hd : IsLiveParameterDomain a b 0) :
    (yAxis P.u : Normal a b 0) ∈ standardFinset S ∧
    (yAxis P.v : Normal a b 0) ∈ standardFinset S ∧
    (zAxis P.w : Normal a b 0) ∈ standardFinset S
proof:
:= by
  have hb := P.b_pos
  have hu := P.u_pos
  have hv := P.v_pos
  have hvu := P.v_lt
  have hr := P.r_pos
  have hw := P.w_pos
  have hwC := P.w_lt
  constructor
  · rw [mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet,pure_three_border_standard_slices P hS hd]
    simp [yAxis]
    omega
  · constructor
    · rw [mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet,pure_three_border_standard_slices P hS hd]
      simp [yAxis]
      omega
    · rw [mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet,pure_three_border_standard_slices P hS hd]
      simp [zAxis]
      omega

name: P23.OneTie.PureThreeBorderData.root_coeff_zero_of_annihilator_products
statement:
theorem root_coeff_zero_of_annihilator_products (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hd : IsLiveParameterDomain a b 0) (ha : IsRootAntichain S) (huv : P.u < P.v)
    (e : MonomialIndex S)
    (hyu : yAxis P.u * e.1 ∈ standardFinset S)
    (hyv : yAxis P.v * e.1 ∈ standardFinset S)
    (hzw : zAxis P.w * e.1 ∈ standardFinset S)
    (F : Omega k S →ₗ[MonomialArtin k S] MonomialArtin k S)
    (s : Normal a b 0) (hs : s ∈ S) :
    coeffAt (k := k) S e (F (U (k := k) S (rootIndex S s hs))) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hu := P.u_pos
  have hv := P.v_pos
  have hw := P.w_pos
  obtain ⟨huS,hvS,hwS⟩ := P.annihilator_scalars_survive hS hd
  have he := pure_three_border_roots_exact P hS hd ha huv
  have hs' : s = P.xRoot ∨ s = P.yRoot ∨ s = P.zRoot := by
    simpa [he,threeRoots] using hs
  rcases hs' with rfl | rfl | rfl
  · apply root_coeff_zero_of_nondvd_and_surviving_product S F P.xRoot hs ⟨yAxis P.u,huS⟩ e _ hyu
    simp [Normal.exact_divides_iff,Normal.DividesCriterion,yAxis,xRoot]
    omega
  · apply root_coeff_zero_of_nondvd_and_surviving_product S F P.yRoot hs ⟨yAxis P.v,hvS⟩ e _ hyv
    simp [Normal.exact_divides_iff,Normal.DividesCriterion,yAxis,yRoot]
    omega
  · apply root_coeff_zero_of_nondvd_and_surviving_product S F P.zRoot hs ⟨zAxis P.w,hwS⟩ e _ hzw
    simp [Normal.exact_divides_iff,Normal.DividesCriterion,zAxis,zRoot]
    omega

name: P23.OneTie.pure_three_border_x_trace_forces_r_one
statement:
theorem pure_three_border_x_trace_forces_r_one {S : Finset (Normal a b 0)}
    (P : PureThreeBorderData S) (hS : S.Nonempty) (hd : IsLiveParameterDomain a b 0)
    (hl : IsLiveTie S) (ha : IsRootAntichain S) (ht : quotientType ℚ S hS hd hl = 3)
    (hxtrace : let hxS := (mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet S Normal.xGenerator).mpr hl.1
      X (k := ℚ) S Normal.xGenerator hxS ∈ TraceSubmodule ℚ S) : P.r = 1
proof:
:= by
  have huv := (pure_three_border_type_three_iff P hS hd hl ha).mp ht
  have hr := P.r_pos
  have hu := P.u_pos
  have hv := P.v_pos
  have hvb := P.v_lt
  have hb := P.b_pos
  have hw := P.w_pos
  have hwC := P.w_lt
  have ha1 : a ≠ 1 := by have := hd.1; omega
  have hdiv : 1 / a = 0 := Nat.div_eq_of_lt (by have := hd.1; omega)
  have hmod : 1 % a = 1 := Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by have := hd.1; omega)
  by_contra hn
  have hr2 : 1 < P.r := by omega
  let ei : MonomialIndex S := ⟨Normal.xGenerator,
    (mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet S _).mpr hl.1⟩
  have hyu : yAxis P.u * ei.1 ∈ standardFinset S := by
    rw [mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet,pure_three_border_standard_slices P hS hd]
    simp [ei,yAxis,Normal.xGenerator,ha1,hdiv,hmod]
    omega
  have hyv : yAxis P.v * ei.1 ∈ standardFinset S := by
    rw [mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet,pure_three_border_standard_slices P hS hd]
    simp [ei,yAxis,Normal.xGenerator,ha1,hdiv,hmod]
    omega
  have hzw : zAxis P.w * ei.1 ∈ standardFinset S := by
    rw [mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet,pure_three_border_standard_slices P hS hd]
    simp [ei,zAxis,Normal.xGenerator,ha1,hdiv,hmod]
    omega
  have hcard : S.card = 3 := (quotientType_eq_three_iff S hS hd hl ha).mp ht
  obtain ⟨F,s,hs,hcoeff⟩ := exists_root_image_with_variable_coeff_of_mem_trace S hS
    (by omega) ha hd .x _ hxtrace
  exact hcoeff (P.root_coeff_zero_of_annihilator_products hS hd ha huv ei hyu hyv hzw F s hs)

name: P23.OneTie.pure_three_border_y_trace_forces_v_endpoint
statement:
theorem pure_three_border_y_trace_forces_v_endpoint {S : Finset (Normal a b 0)}
    (P : PureThreeBorderData S) (hS : S.Nonempty) (hd : IsLiveParameterDomain a b 0)
    (hl : IsLiveTie S) (ha : IsRootAntichain S) (ht : quotientType ℚ S hS hd hl = 3)
    (hytrace : let hyS := (mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet S Normal.yGenerator).mpr hl.2.1
      X (k := ℚ) S Normal.yGenerator hyS ∈ TraceSubmodule ℚ S) : P.v = P.u+b-1
proof:
:= by
  have huv := (pure_three_border_type_three_iff P hS hd hl ha).mp ht
  have hr := P.r_pos
  have hu := P.u_pos
  have hv := P.v_pos
  have hvb := P.v_lt
  have hb : 2 ≤ b := by rcases hd.2 with hm | hp <;> omega
  have hw := P.w_pos
  have hwC := P.w_lt
  by_contra hn
  have hv1 : P.v+1 < P.u+b := by omega
  let ei : MonomialIndex S := ⟨Normal.yGenerator,
    (mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet S _).mpr hl.2.1⟩
  have hyu : yAxis P.u * ei.1 ∈ standardFinset S := by
    rw [mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet,pure_three_border_standard_slices P hS hd]
    simp [ei,yAxis,Normal.yGenerator]
    omega
  have hyv : yAxis P.v * ei.1 ∈ standardFinset S := by
    rw [mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet,pure_three_border_standard_slices P hS hd]
    simp [ei,yAxis,Normal.yGenerator]
    omega
  have hzw : zAxis P.w * ei.1 ∈ standardFinset S := by
    rw [mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet,pure_three_border_standard_slices P hS hd]
    simp [ei,zAxis,Normal.yGenerator]
    omega
  have hcard : S.card = 3 := (quotientType_eq_three_iff S hS hd hl ha).mp ht
  obtain ⟨F,s,hs,hcoeff⟩ := exists_root_image_with_variable_coeff_of_mem_trace S hS
    (by omega) ha hd .y _ hytrace
  exact hcoeff (P.root_coeff_zero_of_annihilator_products hS hd ha huv ei hyu hyv hzw F s hs)

name: P23.OneTie.pure_three_border_z_trace_forces_w_endpoint
statement:
theorem pure_three_border_z_trace_forces_w_endpoint {S : Finset (Normal a b 0)}
    (P : PureThreeBorderData S) (hS : S.Nonempty) (hd : IsLiveParameterDomain a b 0)
    (hl : IsLiveTie S) (ha : IsRootAntichain S) (ht : quotientType ℚ S hS hd hl = 3)
    (hr : P.r = 1) (hv : P.v = P.u+b-1)
    (hztrace : let hzS := (mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet S Normal.zGenerator).mpr hl.2.2.1
      X (k := ℚ) S Normal.zGenerator hzS ∈ TraceSubmodule ℚ S) : P.w = P.C-1
proof:
:= by
  have huv := (pure_three_border_type_three_iff P hS hd hl ha).mp ht
  have hu := P.u_pos
  have hw := P.w_pos
  have hwC := P.w_lt
  have hb : 2 ≤ b := by rcases hd.2 with hm | hp <;> omega
  have ha2 := hd.1
  have ha1 : a ≠ 1 := by omega
  have ham : a-1 < a := by omega
  have hra : P.r < a := P.r_lt
  have hdiv : 1 / a = 0 := Nat.div_eq_of_lt (by omega)
  have hmod : 1 % a = 1 := Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)
  by_contra hn
  have hw1 : P.w+1 < P.C := by omega
  let xi : MonomialIndex S := ⟨Normal.xGenerator,(mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet S _).mpr hl.1⟩
  let yi : MonomialIndex S := ⟨Normal.yGenerator,(mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet S _).mpr hl.2.1⟩
  let zi : MonomialIndex S := ⟨Normal.zGenerator,(mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet S _).mpr hl.2.2.1⟩
  obtain ⟨huS,hvS,hwS⟩ := P.annihilator_scalars_survive hS hd
  let yu : MonomialIndex S := ⟨yAxis P.u,huS⟩
  let zw : MonomialIndex S := ⟨zAxis P.w,hwS⟩
  have hyuz : yu.1 * zi.1 ∈ standardFinset S := by
    rw [mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet,pure_three_border_standard_slices P hS hd]
    simp [yu,zi,yAxis,Normal.zGenerator]
    omega
  have hzwz : zw.1 * zi.1 ∈ standardFinset S := by
    rw [mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet,pure_three_border_standard_slices P hS hd]
    simp [zw,zi,zAxis,Normal.zGenerator]
    omega
  have hxz : xi.1 * zi.1 ∈ standardFinset S := by
    rw [mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet,pure_three_border_standard_slices P hS hd]
    simp [xi,zi,Normal.xGenerator,Normal.zGenerator,ha1,hdiv,hmod]
    omega
  let xzi : MonomialIndex S := ⟨xi.1 * zi.1,hxz⟩
  have hxmem := P.xRoot_mem hS hd ha huv
  have hymem := P.yRoot_mem hS hd ha huv
  let Ui := rootIndex S P.xRoot hxmem
  let Vi := rootIndex S P.yRoot hymem
  have hrel : X (k := ℚ) S yi.1 yi.2 • U (k := ℚ) S Ui =
      X (k := ℚ) S xi.1 xi.2 • U (k := ℚ) S Vi := by
    by_cases hu1 : P.u = 1
    · have hynd : ¬yi.1 ∣ P.xRoot := by
        simp [Normal.exact_divides_iff,Normal.DividesCriterion,yi,Normal.yGenerator,
          PureThreeBorderData.xRoot,hu1]
      have hxnd : ¬xi.1 ∣ P.yRoot := by
        simp [Normal.exact_divides_iff,Normal.DividesCriterion,xi,Normal.xGenerator,
          PureThreeBorderData.yRoot,hr,hu1,ha1,hdiv,hmod]
        omega
      rw [(X_smul_rootDual_eq_zero_iff S P.xRoot hxmem yi).mpr hynd,
        (X_smul_rootDual_eq_zero_iff S P.yRoot hymem xi).mpr hxnd]
    · let q : Normal a b 0 := ⟨a-1,P.u-2,P.C-1,by omega⟩
      have hqS : q ∈ standardFinset S := by
        rw [mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet,pure_three_border_standard_slices P hS hd]
        simp [q]
        omega
      apply dual_relation_of_common_quotient S yi xi ⟨q,hqS⟩ Ui Vi
      · apply Normal.ext <;> simp [yi,q,Ui,rootIndex,Normal.yGenerator,
          PureThreeBorderData.xRoot,Nat.div_eq_of_lt ham,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt ham] <;> omega
      · have hsum : 1 + (a-1) = a := by omega
        apply Normal.ext <;>
          simp [xi,q,Vi,rootIndex,Normal.xGenerator,PureThreeBorderData.yRoot,
            Normal.mul,Normal.raw,Normal.normalize,ha1,hdiv,hmod,hsum,hr,
            Nat.div_self (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne a))] <;> omega
  have hcard : S.card = 3 := (quotientType_eq_three_iff S hS hd hl ha).mp ht
  obtain ⟨F,s,hs,hcoeff⟩ := exists_root_image_with_variable_coeff_of_mem_trace S hS
    (by omega) ha hd .z _ hztrace
  have he := pure_three_border_roots_exact P hS hd ha huv
  have hs' : s = P.xRoot ∨ s = P.yRoot ∨ s = P.zRoot := by
    simpa [he,PureThreeBorderData.threeRoots] using hs
  rcases hs' with rfl | rfl | rfl
  · apply hcoeff
    apply root_coeff_zero_of_nondvd_and_surviving_product S F P.xRoot hs yu zi _ hyuz
    simp [Normal.exact_divides_iff,Normal.DividesCriterion,yu,yAxis,PureThreeBorderData.xRoot]
    omega
  · apply hcoeff
    have hmap : X (k := ℚ) S yi.1 yi.2 * F (U (k := ℚ) S Ui) =
        X (k := ℚ) S xi.1 xi.2 * F (U (k := ℚ) S Vi) := by
      simpa [smul_eq_mul] using congrArg F hrel
    have hh := congrArg (coeffAt (k := ℚ) S xzi) hmap
    rw [coeffAt_X_mul S xi zi xzi rfl] at hh
    have hny : ¬yi.1 ∣ xzi.1 := by
      simp [Normal.exact_divides_iff,Normal.DividesCriterion,yi,xzi,xi,zi,
        Normal.yGenerator,Normal.xGenerator,Normal.zGenerator,ha1,hdiv,hmod]
    rw [coeffAt_X_mul_eq_zero_of_not_dvd S yi xzi hny] at hh
    exact hh.symm
  · apply hcoeff
    apply root_coeff_zero_of_nondvd_and_surviving_product S F P.zRoot hs zw zi _ hzwz
    simp [Normal.exact_divides_iff,Normal.DividesCriterion,zw,zAxis,PureThreeBorderData.zRoot]
    omega

name: P23.OneTie.pure_three_border_ng_forces_endpoints
statement:
theorem pure_three_border_ng_forces_endpoints {S : Finset (Normal a b 0)}

    (hl : IsLiveTie S) (ha : IsRootAntichain S) (ht : quotientType ℚ S hS hd hl = 3)

    P.r = 1 ∧ P.v = P.u+b-1 ∧ P.w = P.C-1
proof:

  have htr := (directNearlyGorenstein_iff_variablesInTrace S hS hd hl).mp hn'
  have hr := pure_three_border_x_trace_forces_r_one P hS hd hl ha ht htr.1
  have hv := pure_three_border_y_trace_forces_v_endpoint P hS hd hl ha ht htr.2.1
  exact ⟨hr,hv,pure_three_border_z_trace_forces_w_endpoint P hS hd hl ha ht hr hv htr.2.2⟩

statement: private theorem fibre_a_pos : 0 < a
proof: := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne a)

name: P23.OneTie.fibre_border_arithmetic
statement:
private theorem fibre_border_arithmetic
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 2 ≤ b)
    (hpxq : px < qx) (hqyp : qy < py) (hstrip : py < qy + b)
    (hlive : b ≤ py) (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (x y z : ℕ) (hxlt : x < a) :
    ((¬fibreStd b px py qx qy k x y z ∧
      (if 0 < x then fibreStd b px py qx qy k (x - 1) y z
       else if b ≤ y ∧ 0 ≤ z then
         fibreStd b px py qx qy k (a - 1) (y - b) z
       else True) ∧
      (0 < y → fibreStd b px py qx qy k x (y - 1) z) ∧
      (0 < z → fibreStd b px py qx qy k x y (z - 1))) ↔
      fibreBorder a b px py qx qy k x y z)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : 0 < x <;> by_cases hy : 0 < y <;> by_cases hz : 0 < z <;>
    by_cases hqxlast : qx < a - 1 <;>
    simp [fibreStd, fibreBorder, hx, hy, hz, hqxlast] <;>
    grind (splits := 64)

name: P23.OneTie.pureFibreProduct_border_exact
statement:
theorem pureFibreProduct_border_exact
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 2 ≤ b)
    (hpx : px < a) (hqx : qx < a)
    (hpxq : px < qx) (hqyp : qy < py) (hstrip : py < qy + b)
    (hlive : b ≤ py) (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    borderFinset (pureFibreProductSocles (a := a) (b := b)
      px py qx qy k hpx hqx) =
      pureFibreProductExpectedBorder (a := a) (b := b)
        px py qx qy k ha (by omega) hqx
proof:
:= by
  let S := pureFibreProductSocles (a := a) (b := b)
    px py qx qy k hpx hqx
  let G := pureFibreProductExpectedBorder (a := a) (b := b)
    px py qx qy k ha (by omega) hqx
  apply borderFinset_eq_expected_of_nat S G
    (fibreStd b px py qx qy k) (fibreBorder a b px py qx qy k)
  · simp [S, pureFibreProductSocles]
  · intro p
    rcases p with ⟨x, y, z, hx⟩
    simp [S, pureFibreProductSocles, fibrePlaneLeft, fibrePlaneRight,
      fibreZRoot, standardSet, Normal.exact_divides_iff,
      Normal.DividesCriterion, fibreStd]
    omega
  · intro m
    rcases m with ⟨x, y, z, hx⟩
    by_cases hlast : qx < a - 1 <;>
      simp [G, pureFibreProductExpectedBorder, fibreMiddleBorder,
        fibreOuterBorder, fibreXZ, fibreYZ, fibreZNext, fibreBorder, hlast,
        Normal.mk.injEq]
  · exact fibre_border_arithmetic ha hb hpxq hqyp hstrip hlive hk

name: P23.OneTie.pureFibreProduct_border_card
statement:
theorem pureFibreProduct_border_card
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 2 ≤ b)
    (hpx : px < a) (hqx : qx < a)
    (hpxq : px < qx) (hqyp : qy < py) (hstrip : py < qy + b)
    (hlive : b ≤ py) (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    (borderFinset (pureFibreProductSocles (a := a) (b := b)
      px py qx qy k hpx hqx)).card = 5
proof:
:= by
  rw [pureFibreProduct_border_exact ha hb hpx hqx hpxq hqyp hstrip hlive hk]
  unfold pureFibreProductExpectedBorder
  rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem, Finset.card_insert_of_notMem,
    Finset.card_insert_of_notMem, Finset.card_insert_of_notMem]
  · simp
  all_goals
    by_cases hlast : qx < a - 1 <;>
      simp [fibreMiddleBorder, fibreOuterBorder, fibreXZ, fibreYZ,
        fibreZNext, hlast, Normal.mk.injEq] <;> omega

name: P23.OneTie.pureFibreProduct_border_card_ne_four
statement:
theorem pureFibreProduct_border_card_ne_four
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 2 ≤ b)
    (hpx : px < a) (hqx : qx < a)
    (hpxq : px < qx) (hqyp : qy < py) (hstrip : py < qy + b)
    (hlive : b ≤ py) (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    (borderFinset (pureFibreProductSocles (a := a) (b := b)
      px py qx qy k hpx hqx)).card ≠ 4
proof:
:= by
  rw [pureFibreProduct_border_card ha hb hpx hqx hpxq hqyp hstrip hlive hk]
  omega

name: P23.OneTie.pureFibreProduct_ordered_parameters
statement:
theorem pureFibreProduct_ordered_parameters
    {S : Finset (Normal a b 0)}
    (hb : 2 ≤ b) (hcard : S.card = 3)
    (hshape : IsPureFibreProduct S)
    (hanti : IsRootAntichain S) (hlive : IsLiveTie S) :
    ∃ px py qx qy k hpx hqx,
      1 ≤ k ∧ px < qx ∧ qy < py ∧ py < qy + b ∧ b ≤ py ∧
      S = pureFibreProductSocles (a := a) (b := b)
        px py qx qy k hpx hqx
proof:
:= by
  rcases hshape with ⟨_, k, hk, hZS, hplane⟩
  let Z : Normal a b 0 := fibreZRoot (a := a) (b := b) k
  have hZdef : Z = (⟨0, 0, k, fibre_a_pos⟩ : Normal a b 0) := rfl
  have hZmem : Z ∈ S := by simpa [Z, fibreZRoot] using hZS
  have heraseCard : (S.erase Z).card = 2 := by
    rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem hZmem, hcard]
  rcases Finset.card_eq_two.mp heraseCard with ⟨P, Q, hPQ, herase⟩
  have hPS : P ∈ S := Finset.mem_of_mem_erase (by rw [herase]; simp)
  have hQS : Q ∈ S := Finset.mem_of_mem_erase (by rw [herase]; simp)
  have hPZ : P ≠ Z := Finset.ne_of_mem_erase (by rw [herase]; simp)
  have hQZ : Q ≠ Z := Finset.ne_of_mem_erase (by rw [herase]; simp)
  have hPz : P.z = 0 := hplane P hPS (by simpa [Z, fibreZRoot] using hPZ)
  have hQz : Q.z = 0 := hplane Q hQS (by simpa [Z, fibreZRoot] using hQZ)
  have hxne : P.x ≠ Q.x := by
    intro hx
    by_cases hy : P.y ≤ Q.y
    · exact (hanti P hPS Q hQS hPQ) ((Normal.exact_divides_iff P Q).2 (by
        simp [Normal.DividesCriterion, hx, hPz, hQz, hy]))
    · exact (hanti Q hQS P hPS hPQ.symm) ((Normal.exact_divides_iff Q P).2 (by
        simp [Normal.DividesCriterion, hx, hPz, hQz]
        omega))
  have hLiveY := hlive.2.2.2
  rcases (mem_standardSet_iff S liveTiePoint).1 hLiveY with ⟨R, hRS, hdiv⟩
  have hRcases : R = Z ∨ R = P ∨ R = Q := by
    have hSin : S = insert Z (S.erase Z) := (Finset.insert_erase hZmem).symm
    rw [hSin, herase] at hRS
    simpa using hRS
  have hrootLive : b ≤ P.y ∨ b ≤ Q.y := by
    rcases hRcases with hRZ | hRP | hRQ
    · rw [hRZ] at hdiv
      have hd := (Normal.exact_divides_iff liveTiePoint Z).1 hdiv
      simp [liveTiePoint, Z, fibreZRoot, Normal.DividesCriterion] at hd
      omega
    · left
      rw [hRP] at hdiv
      have hd := (Normal.exact_divides_iff liveTiePoint P).1 hdiv
      simp [liveTiePoint, Normal.DividesCriterion] at hd
      omega
    · right
      rw [hRQ] at hdiv
      have hd := (Normal.exact_divides_iff liveTiePoint Q).1 hdiv
      simp [liveTiePoint, Normal.DividesCriterion] at hd
      omega
  have hSinsert : S = ({P, Q, Z} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) := by
    rw [show S = insert Z (S.erase Z) from (Finset.insert_erase hZmem).symm,
      herase]
    ext X
    simp [or_assoc, or_left_comm, or_comm]
  by_cases hx : P.x < Q.x
  · have hy : Q.y < P.y := by
      by_contra h
      have hle : P.y ≤ Q.y := by omega
      exact (hanti P hPS Q hQS hPQ) ((Normal.exact_divides_iff P Q).2 (by
        simp [Normal.DividesCriterion, hPz, hQz, hle]
        omega))
    have hstrip : P.y < Q.y + b := by
      by_contra h
      have hle : Q.y + b ≤ P.y := by omega
      exact (hanti Q hQS P hPS hPQ.symm) ((Normal.exact_divides_iff Q P).2 (by
        simp [Normal.DividesCriterion, hPz, hQz, hle]
        omega))
    have hbP : b ≤ P.y := by rcases hrootLive with h | h <;> omega
    refine ⟨P.x, P.y, Q.x, Q.y, k, P.x_lt, Q.x_lt, hk, hx, hy,
      hstrip, hbP, ?_⟩
    rw [hSinsert]
    ext R
    simp [pureFibreProductSocles, fibrePlaneLeft, fibrePlaneRight,
      Z, fibreZRoot, hPz, hQz, Normal.ext_iff]
  · have hx' : Q.x < P.x := by omega
    have hy : P.y < Q.y := by
      by_contra h
      have hle : Q.y ≤ P.y := by omega
      exact (hanti Q hQS P hPS hPQ.symm) ((Normal.exact_divides_iff Q P).2 (by
        simp [Normal.DividesCriterion, hPz, hQz, hle]
        omega))
    have hstrip : Q.y < P.y + b := by
      by_contra h
      have hle : P.y + b ≤ Q.y := by omega
      exact (hanti P hPS Q hQS hPQ) ((Normal.exact_divides_iff P Q).2 (by
        simp [Normal.DividesCriterion, hPz, hQz, hle]
        omega))
    have hbQ : b ≤ Q.y := by rcases hrootLive with h | h <;> omega
    refine ⟨Q.x, Q.y, P.x, P.y, k, Q.x_lt, P.x_lt, hk, hx', hy,
      hstrip, hbQ, ?_⟩
    rw [hSinsert]
    ext R
    simp [pureFibreProductSocles, fibrePlaneLeft, fibrePlaneRight,
      Z, fibreZRoot, hPz, hQz, Normal.ext_iff, or_left_comm]

name: P23.OneTie.pureFibreProductShape_border_exact
statement:
theorem pureFibreProductShape_border_exact
    {S : Finset (Normal a b 0)}
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 2 ≤ b) (hcard : S.card = 3)
    (hshape : IsPureFibreProduct S)
    (hanti : IsRootAntichain S) (hlive : IsLiveTie S) :
    ∃ (px py qx qy k : ℕ) (hpx : px < a) (hqx : qx < a)
        (hpxq : px < qx),
      S = pureFibreProductSocles (a := a) (b := b)
          px py qx qy k hpx hqx ∧
      borderFinset S = pureFibreProductExpectedBorder (a := a) (b := b)
          px py qx qy k ha (by omega) hqx
proof:
:= by
  rcases pureFibreProduct_ordered_parameters hb hcard hshape hanti hlive with
    ⟨px, py, qx, qy, k, hpx, hqx, hk, hpxq, hqyp, hstrip, hliveP, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨px, py, qx, qy, k, hpx, hqx, hpxq, rfl,
    pureFibreProduct_border_exact ha hb hpx hqx hpxq hqyp hstrip hliveP hk⟩

name: P23.OneTie.pureFibreProductShape_border_card
statement:
theorem pureFibreProductShape_border_card
    {S : Finset (Normal a b 0)}

    (hshape : IsPureFibreProduct S)
    (hanti : IsRootAntichain S) (hlive : IsLiveTie S) :

proof:

    ⟨px, py, qx, qy, k, hpx, hqx, hk, hpxq, hqyp, hstrip, hliveP, rfl⟩

name: P23.OneTie.pureFibreProductShape_border_card_ne_four
statement:
theorem pureFibreProductShape_border_card_ne_four
    {S : Finset (Normal a b 0)}
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 2 ≤ b) (hcard : S.card = 3)
    (hshape : IsPureFibreProduct S)

name: P23.OneTie.reduction_a_pos
statement: private theorem reduction_a_pos : 0 < a
proof: := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne a)

name: P23.OneTie.dominant_extra_root_mem_principalBorder
statement:
theorem dominant_extra_root_mem_principalBorder
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (ha : 2 ≤ a)
    (hanti : IsRootAntichain S) {C R : Normal a b c}
    (hdom : IsDominantRoot S C) (hR : R ∈ S) (hne : R ≠ C) :
    R ∈ borderFinset ({C} : Finset (Normal a b c))
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_borderFinset_iff (by simp)]
  apply (isMinimalBorder_iff_isDivisibilityMinimalKilled {C} R
    (variableGenerators_ne_one_of_two_le ha)).2
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro hRcore
    obtain ⟨T, hT, hRT⟩ := (mem_standardSet_iff {C} R).1 hRcore
    have hTC : T = C := by simpa using hT
    subst T
    have hRC : R ∣ C := hRT
    exact (hanti R hR C hdom.1 hne) hRC
  · intro d hdR hdne
    have hdstd : d ∈ standardSet S := (mem_standardSet_iff S d).2 ⟨R, hR, hdR⟩
    rw [hdom.2] at hdstd
    rcases hdstd with hdC | hdroot
    · exact (mem_standardSet_iff {C} d).2 ⟨C, by simp, hdC⟩
    · have hdS : d ∈ S := Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hdroot
      have hdCne : d ≠ C := Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hdroot
      exact False.elim ((hanti d hdS R hR hdne) hdR)

name: P23.OneTie.dominant_erase_card_eq_two
statement:
theorem dominant_erase_card_eq_two
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) {C : Normal a b c}
    (hcard : S.card = 3) (hdom : IsDominantRoot S C) :
    (S.erase C).card = 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem hdom.1, hcard]

name: P23.OneTie.mixed_dominant_tie_mem_core
statement:
theorem mixed_dominant_tie_mem_core
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hc : 1 ≤ c)
    (hlive : IsLiveTie S) (hanti : IsRootAntichain S)
    {C : Normal a b c} (hdom : IsDominantRoot S C) :
    liveTiePoint ∈ Normal.divisorDownset C
proof:
:= by
  have htstd := hlive.2.2.2
  rw [hdom.2] at htstd
  rcases htstd with htcore | htextra
  · exact htcore
  · have htS : liveTiePoint ∈ S := Finset.mem_of_mem_erase htextra
    have htne : liveTiePoint ≠ C := Finset.ne_of_mem_erase htextra
    have htborder := dominant_extra_root_mem_principalBorder S ha hanti hdom htS htne
    have htmin := (mem_borderFinset_iff (by simp) liveTiePoint).1 htborder
    have hpred := ((isMinimalBorder_iff (standardSet ({C} :
      Finset (Normal a b c))) liveTiePoint).1 htmin).2
    let qy : Normal a b c := ⟨0, b - 1, c, reduction_a_pos⟩
    let qz : Normal a b c := ⟨0, b, c - 1, reduction_a_pos⟩
    have hqyPred : Normal.predecessor .y liveTiePoint = some qy := by
      have hbpos : 0 < b := by omega
      simp [Normal.predecessor, Normal.yPredecessor, liveTiePoint, qy, hbpos]
    have hqzPred : Normal.predecessor .z liveTiePoint = some qz := by
      have hcpos : 0 < c := by omega
      simp [Normal.predecessor, Normal.zPredecessor, liveTiePoint, qz, hcpos]
    have hqyC : qy ∣ C := by
      obtain ⟨T, hmem, hdvd⟩ :=
        (mem_standardSet_iff ({C} : Finset (Normal a b c)) qy).1
          (hpred .y qy hqyPred)
      have : T = C := by simpa using hmem
      subst T
      exact hdvd
    have hqzC : qz ∣ C := by
      obtain ⟨T, hmem, hdvd⟩ :=
        (mem_standardSet_iff ({C} : Finset (Normal a b c)) qz).1
          (hpred .z qz hqzPred)
      have : T = C := by simpa using hmem
      subst T
      exact hdvd
    have hbounds : b ≤ C.y ∧ c ≤ C.z := by
      rw [Normal.exact_divides_iff] at hqyC hqzC
      simp [Normal.DividesCriterion, qy, qz] at hqyC hqzC
      omega
    have htC : liveTiePoint ∣ C := by
      rw [Normal.exact_divides_iff]
      simp [Normal.DividesCriterion, liveTiePoint, hbounds]
    exact ((hanti liveTiePoint htS C hdom.1 htne) htC).elim

name: P23.OneTie.mixed_dominant_core_bounds
statement:
theorem mixed_dominant_core_bounds
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hc : 1 ≤ c)
    (hlive : IsLiveTie S) (hanti : IsRootAntichain S)
    {C : Normal a b c} (hdom : IsDominantRoot S C) :
    b ≤ C.y ∧ c ≤ C.z
proof:
:= by
  have ht := mixed_dominant_tie_mem_core S ha hb hc hlive hanti hdom
  rw [Normal.mem_divisorDownset_iff] at ht
  simp [Normal.DividesCriterion, liveTiePoint] at ht
  exact ht

name: P23.OneTie.mixed_dominant_last_eq_family
statement:
theorem mixed_dominant_last_eq_family
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hc : 1 ≤ c)
    (hcard : S.card = 3) (hlive : IsLiveTie S)
    (hanti : IsRootAntichain S) {r u v : ℕ} (hr : r < a)
    (hlast : r = a - 1)
    (hdom : IsDominantRoot S (mixedCore r u v hr)) :
    S = mixedDominantSoclesLast (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) u v
proof:
:= by
  have huv := mixed_dominant_core_bounds S ha hb hc hlive hanti hdom
  have hu : b ≤ u := by simpa [mixedCore] using huv.1
  have hv : c ≤ v := by simpa [mixedCore] using huv.2
  have heraseCard := dominant_erase_card_eq_two S hcard hdom
  have hsub : S.erase (mixedCore r u v hr) ⊆
      ({mixedY u, mixedZ v} : Finset (Normal a b c)) := by
    intro R hR
    have hRS : R ∈ S := Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hR
    have hne : R ≠ mixedCore r u v hr := Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hR
    have hbdr := dominant_extra_root_mem_principalBorder S ha hanti hdom hRS hne
    have hp := mixedPrincipalBorder_last (r := r) (u := u) (v := v)
      ha hb hc hu hv hlast
    have hp' : borderFinset ({mixedCore r u v hr} :
        Finset (Normal a b c)) = {mixedY u, mixedZ v} := by
      simpa [mixedCore] using hp
    rw [hp'] at hbdr
    exact hbdr
  have htarget : ({mixedY u, mixedZ v} : Finset (Normal a b c)).card = 2 := by
    simp [mixedY, mixedZ]
  have herase : S.erase (mixedCore r u v hr) = {mixedY u, mixedZ v} :=
    Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le hsub (by rw [htarget, heraseCard])
  calc
    S = insert (mixedCore r u v hr) (S.erase (mixedCore r u v hr)) :=
      (Finset.insert_erase hdom.1).symm
    _ = insert (mixedCore r u v hr) {mixedY u, mixedZ v} := by rw [herase]
    _ = mixedDominantSoclesLast (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) u v := by
      subst r
      simp [mixedDominantSoclesLast, mixedCore]

name: P23.OneTie.mixed_dominant_last_border_card
statement:
theorem mixed_dominant_last_border_card
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hc : 1 ≤ c)
    (hcard : S.card = 3) (hlive : IsLiveTie S)
    (hanti : IsRootAntichain S) {r u v : ℕ} (hr : r < a)
    (hlast : r = a - 1)
    (hdom : IsDominantRoot S (mixedCore r u v hr)) :
    (borderFinset S).card = 6
proof:
:= by
  have huv := mixed_dominant_core_bounds S ha hb hc hlive hanti hdom
  have hu : b ≤ u := by simpa [mixedCore] using huv.1
  have hv : c ≤ v := by simpa [mixedCore] using huv.2
  rw [mixed_dominant_last_eq_family S ha hb hc hcard hlive hanti hr hlast hdom]
  exact mixedDominantLast_border_card ha hb hc hu hv

name: P23.OneTie.mixed_dominant_below_pair
statement:
theorem mixed_dominant_below_pair
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hc : 1 ≤ c)
    (hcard : S.card = 3) (hlive : IsLiveTie S)
    (hanti : IsRootAntichain S) {r u v : ℕ} (hrC : r < a)
    (hr : r < a - 1)
    (hdom : IsDominantRoot S (mixedCore r u v hrC)) :
    ∃ pair : MixedAddedPair,
      S = mixedSoclesForPair (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) pair r u v hr
proof:
:= by
  have huv := mixed_dominant_core_bounds S ha hb hc hlive hanti hdom
  have hu : b ≤ u := by simpa [mixedCore] using huv.1
  have hv : c ≤ v := by simpa [mixedCore] using huv.2
  have heraseCard := dominant_erase_card_eq_two S hcard hdom
  obtain ⟨R, T, hRT, herase⟩ := Finset.card_eq_two.mp heraseCard
  have hRerase : R ∈ S.erase (mixedCore r u v hrC) := by simp [herase]
  have hTerase : T ∈ S.erase (mixedCore r u v hrC) := by simp [herase]
  have hRborder := dominant_extra_root_mem_principalBorder S ha hanti hdom
    (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hRerase) (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hRerase)
  have hTborder := dominant_extra_root_mem_principalBorder S ha hanti hdom
    (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hTerase) (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hTerase)
  have hp := mixedPrincipalBorder_below (r := r) (u := u) (v := v)
    ha hb hc hu hv hr
  have hp' : borderFinset ({mixedCore r u v hrC} : Finset (Normal a b c)) =
      {mixedY u, mixedZ v, mixedP r u hr, mixedQ r v hr} := by
    simpa [mixedCore] using hp
  rw [hp'] at hRborder hTborder
  have hS : S = insert (mixedCore r u v hrC) {R, T} := by
    rw [← herase]
    exact (Finset.insert_erase hdom.1).symm
  simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hRborder hTborder
  rcases hRborder with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;>
    rcases hTborder with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
  all_goals try { exact False.elim (hRT rfl) }
  · refine ⟨.YZ, ?_⟩
    rw [hS]
    ext x
    simp [mixedSoclesForPair, mixedSoclesYZ, mixedCore, or_comm, or_left_comm, or_assoc]
  · refine ⟨.YP, ?_⟩
    rw [hS]
    ext x
    simp [mixedSoclesForPair, mixedSoclesYP, mixedCore, or_comm, or_left_comm, or_assoc]
  · refine ⟨.YQ, ?_⟩
    rw [hS]
    ext x
    simp [mixedSoclesForPair, mixedSoclesYQ, mixedCore, or_comm, or_left_comm, or_assoc]
  · refine ⟨.YZ, ?_⟩
    rw [hS]
    ext x
    simp [mixedSoclesForPair, mixedSoclesYZ, mixedCore, or_comm, or_left_comm, or_assoc]
  · refine ⟨.ZP, ?_⟩
    rw [hS]
    ext x
    simp [mixedSoclesForPair, mixedSoclesZP, mixedCore, or_comm, or_left_comm, or_assoc]
  · refine ⟨.ZQ, ?_⟩
    rw [hS]
    ext x
    simp [mixedSoclesForPair, mixedSoclesZQ, mixedCore, or_comm, or_left_comm, or_assoc]
  · refine ⟨.YP, ?_⟩
    rw [hS]
    ext x
    simp [mixedSoclesForPair, mixedSoclesYP, mixedCore, or_comm, or_left_comm, or_assoc]
  · refine ⟨.ZP, ?_⟩
    rw [hS]
    ext x
    simp [mixedSoclesForPair, mixedSoclesZP, mixedCore, or_comm, or_left_comm, or_assoc]
  · refine ⟨.PQ, ?_⟩
    rw [hS]
    ext x
    simp [mixedSoclesForPair, mixedSoclesPQ, mixedCore, or_comm, or_left_comm, or_assoc]
  · refine ⟨.YQ, ?_⟩
    rw [hS]
    ext x
    simp [mixedSoclesForPair, mixedSoclesYQ, mixedCore, or_comm, or_left_comm, or_assoc]
  · refine ⟨.ZQ, ?_⟩
    rw [hS]
    ext x
    simp [mixedSoclesForPair, mixedSoclesZQ, mixedCore, or_comm, or_left_comm, or_assoc]
  · refine ⟨.PQ, ?_⟩
    rw [hS]
    ext x
    simp [mixedSoclesForPair, mixedSoclesPQ, mixedCore, or_comm, or_left_comm, or_assoc]

name: P23.OneTie.mixed_dominant_four_border_survivor
statement:
theorem mixed_dominant_four_border_survivor
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hc : 1 ≤ c)
    (hcard : S.card = 3) (hlive : IsLiveTie S)
    (hanti : IsRootAntichain S) {C : Normal a b c}
    (hdom : IsDominantRoot S C) (hborder : (borderFinset S).card = 4) :
    MixedDominantFourBorderSurvivor S
proof:
:= by
  rcases C with ⟨r, u, v, hrC⟩
  have huv := mixed_dominant_core_bounds S ha hb hc hlive hanti hdom
  have hu : b ≤ u := by simpa [mixedCore] using huv.1
  have hv : c ≤ v := by simpa [mixedCore] using huv.2
  by_cases hlast : r = a - 1
  · have h6 := mixed_dominant_last_border_card S ha hb hc hcard hlive
      hanti hrC hlast hdom
    omega
  · have hr : r < a - 1 := by omega
    obtain ⟨pair, hS⟩ :=
      mixed_dominant_below_pair S ha hb hc hcard hlive hanti hrC hr hdom
    have hpairCard : mixedDominantBorderCard (a := a) (b := b) (c := c)
        pair r u v hr = 4 := by
      cases pair <;> simpa [mixedSoclesForPair, mixedDominantBorderCard, hS]
        using hborder
    rcases mixedDominant_card_eq_four_survivors pair ha hb hc hu hv hr
      hpairCard with hYZ | hYQ | hZP | hPQ
    · rcases hYZ with ⟨rfl, hr0, hb1, hc1⟩
      exact .yz hr (by omega) hb1 hc1 hu hv
        (by simpa [mixedSoclesForPair] using hS)
    · rcases hYQ with ⟨rfl, hc1⟩
      exact .yq hr hc1 hu hv (by simpa [mixedSoclesForPair] using hS)
    · rcases hZP with ⟨rfl, hb1⟩
      exact .zp hr hb1 hu hv (by simpa [mixedSoclesForPair] using hS)
    · rcases hPQ with ⟨rfl, hrlast, huv1⟩
      exact .pq hr (by omega) hu hv huv1
        (by simpa [mixedSoclesForPair] using hS)

name: P23.OneTie.pure_dominant_three_branch_reduction
statement:
theorem pure_dominant_three_branch_reduction
    (S : Finset (Normal a b 0)) (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 2 ≤ b)
    (hcard : S.card = 3) (hlive : IsLiveTie S)
    (hanti : IsRootAntichain S) {C : Normal a b 0}
    (hdom : IsDominantRoot S C) : PureDominantBranch S
proof:
:= by
  rcases C with ⟨r, u, v, hrC⟩
  have htstd := hlive.2.2.2
  rw [hdom.2] at htstd
  rcases htstd with htcore | htextra
  · have hu : b ≤ u := by
      rw [Normal.mem_divisorDownset_iff] at htcore
      simp [Normal.DividesCriterion, liveTiePoint] at htcore
      exact htcore
    by_cases hlast : r = a - 1
    · have heraseCard := dominant_erase_card_eq_two S hcard hdom
      have heraseCard' : (S.erase (pureCore r u v hrC)).card = 2 := by
        simpa [pureCore] using heraseCard
      have hsub : S.erase (pureCore r u v hrC) ⊆
          ({pureH r u hrC, pureZ v} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) := by
        intro R hR
        have hbdr := dominant_extra_root_mem_principalBorder S ha hanti hdom
          (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hR) (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hR)
        change R ∈ borderFinset ({pureCore r u v hrC} :
          Finset (Normal a b 0)) at hbdr
        have hp := purePrincipalBorder_last (r := r) (u := u) (v := v)
          ha hb (by omega) hlast
        have hp' : borderFinset ({pureCore r u v hrC} :
            Finset (Normal a b 0)) = {pureH r u hrC, pureZ v} := by
          simpa [pureCore, pureH] using hp
        rw [hp'] at hbdr
        exact hbdr
      have htarget : ({pureH r u hrC, pureZ v} :
          Finset (Normal a b 0)).card = 2 := by
        simp [pureH, pureZ, hlast]
      have herase : S.erase (pureCore r u v hrC) = {pureH r u hrC, pureZ v} :=
        Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le hsub (by rw [htarget, heraseCard'])
      apply PureDominantBranch.lastTieCore hu
      calc
        S = insert (pureCore r u v hrC) (S.erase (pureCore r u v hrC)) :=
          (Finset.insert_erase hdom.1).symm
        _ = insert (pureCore r u v hrC) {pureH r u hrC, pureZ v} := by rw [herase]
        _ = pureDominantSoclesLastCore (a := a) (b := b) u v := by
          subst r
          simp [pureDominantSoclesLastCore, pureCore, pureH, pureZ]
    · have hr : r < a - 1 := by omega
      have heraseCard := dominant_erase_card_eq_two S hcard hdom
      have heraseCard' : (S.erase (pureCore r u v hrC)).card = 2 := by
        simpa [pureCore] using heraseCard
      have hsub : S.erase (pureCore r u v hrC) ⊆
          ({pureH r u hrC, pureZ v} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) := by
        intro R hR
        have hbdr := dominant_extra_root_mem_principalBorder S ha hanti hdom
          (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hR) (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hR)
        change R ∈ borderFinset ({pureCore r u v hrC} :
          Finset (Normal a b 0)) at hbdr
        have hp := purePrincipalBorder_below (r := r) (u := u) (v := v)
          ha hb hu hr
        have hp' : borderFinset ({pureCore r u v hrC} :
            Finset (Normal a b 0)) = {pureH r u hrC, pureZ v} := by
          simpa [pureCore, pureH] using hp
        rw [hp'] at hbdr
        exact hbdr
      have htarget : ({pureH r u hrC, pureZ v} :
          Finset (Normal a b 0)).card = 2 := by
        simp [pureH, pureZ, hr]
      have herase : S.erase (pureCore r u v hrC) = {pureH r u hrC, pureZ v} :=
        Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le hsub (by rw [htarget, heraseCard'])
      apply PureDominantBranch.below hr hu
      calc
        S = insert (pureCore r u v hrC) (S.erase (pureCore r u v hrC)) :=
          (Finset.insert_erase hdom.1).symm
        _ = insert (pureCore r u v hrC) {pureH r u hrC, pureZ v} := by rw [herase]
        _ = pureDominantSoclesBelow (a := a) (b := b) r u v hr := by
          simp [pureDominantSoclesBelow, pureCore, pureH, pureZ, hr]
  · have htS : liveTiePoint ∈ S := Finset.mem_of_mem_erase htextra
    have htne : liveTiePoint ≠ pureCore r u v hrC := Finset.ne_of_mem_erase htextra
    have htborder := dominant_extra_root_mem_principalBorder S ha hanti hdom htS htne
    have htmin := (mem_borderFinset_iff (by simp) liveTiePoint).1 htborder
    have hpred := ((isMinimalBorder_iff (standardSet ({pureCore r u v hrC} :
      Finset (Normal a b 0))) liveTiePoint).1 htmin).2
    let qy : Normal a b 0 := ⟨0, b - 1, 0, reduction_a_pos⟩
    let qx : Normal a b 0 := ⟨a - 1, 0, 0, by omega⟩
    have hqyPred : Normal.predecessor .y liveTiePoint = some qy := by
      have hbpos : 0 < b := by omega
      simp [Normal.predecessor, Normal.yPredecessor, liveTiePoint, qy, hbpos]
    have hqxPred : Normal.predecessor .x liveTiePoint = some qx := by
      simp [Normal.predecessor, Normal.wrappedXPredecessor, liveTiePoint,
        qx, hb]
    have hqyC : qy ∣ pureCore r u v hrC := by
      obtain ⟨T, hT, hdvd⟩ :=
        (mem_standardSet_iff ({pureCore r u v hrC} :
          Finset (Normal a b 0)) qy).1 (hpred .y qy hqyPred)
      have : T = pureCore r u v hrC := by simpa using hT
      subst T
      exact hdvd
    have hqxC : qx ∣ pureCore r u v hrC := by
      obtain ⟨T, hT, hdvd⟩ :=
        (mem_standardSet_iff ({pureCore r u v hrC} :
          Finset (Normal a b 0)) qx).1 (hpred .x qx hqxPred)
      have : T = pureCore r u v hrC := by simpa using hT
      subst T
      exact hdvd
    have htNotCore : ¬(liveTiePoint : Normal a b 0) ∣
        (pureCore r u v hrC : Normal a b 0) := by
      intro htC
      exact (hanti liveTiePoint htS (pureCore r u v hrC) hdom.1 htne) htC
    rw [Normal.exact_divides_iff] at hqyC hqxC htNotCore
    simp [Normal.DividesCriterion, qy, qx, pureCore, liveTiePoint] at hqyC hqxC htNotCore
    have hlast : r = a - 1 := by omega
    have hu : u = b - 1 := by omega
    have heraseCard := dominant_erase_card_eq_two S hcard hdom
    have heraseCard' : (S.erase (pureCore r u v hrC)).card = 2 := by
      simpa [pureCore] using heraseCard
    have hsub : S.erase (pureCore r u v hrC) ⊆
        ({pureH r u hrC, pureZ v} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) := by
      intro R hR
      have hbdr := dominant_extra_root_mem_principalBorder S ha hanti hdom
        (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hR) (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hR)
      change R ∈ borderFinset ({pureCore r u v hrC} :
        Finset (Normal a b 0)) at hbdr
      have hp := purePrincipalBorder_last (r := r) (u := u) (v := v)
        ha hb (by omega) hlast
      have hp' : borderFinset ({pureCore r u v hrC} :
          Finset (Normal a b 0)) = {pureH r u hrC, pureZ v} := by
        simpa [pureCore, pureH] using hp
      rw [hp'] at hbdr
      exact hbdr
    have htarget : ({pureH r u hrC, pureZ v} :
        Finset (Normal a b 0)).card = 2 := by
      simp [pureH, pureZ, hlast]
    have herase : S.erase (pureCore r u v hrC) = {pureH r u hrC, pureZ v} :=
      Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le hsub (by rw [htarget, heraseCard'])
    apply PureDominantBranch.lastTieExtra
    calc
      S = insert (pureCore r u v hrC) (S.erase (pureCore r u v hrC)) :=
        (Finset.insert_erase hdom.1).symm
      _ = insert (pureCore r u v hrC) {pureH r u hrC, pureZ v} := by rw [herase]
      _ = pureDominantSoclesLast (a := a) (b := b) v := by
        subst r
        subst u
        simp [pureDominantSoclesLast, pureCore, pureH, pureZ]

name: P23.OneTie.pure_dominant_border_card_ne_four_general
statement:
theorem pure_dominant_border_card_ne_four_general
    (S : Finset (Normal a b 0)) (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 2 ≤ b)
    (hcard : S.card = 3) (hlive : IsLiveTie S)
    (hanti : IsRootAntichain S) {C : Normal a b 0}
    (hdom : IsDominantRoot S C) : (borderFinset S).card ≠ 4
proof:
:= by
  rcases pure_dominant_three_branch_reduction S ha hb hcard hlive hanti hdom with
    ⟨hr, hu, hroots⟩ | ⟨hroots⟩ | ⟨hu, hroots⟩
  · rw [hroots]
    exact (pureDominant_card_ne_four ha hb).1 hr hu
  · rw [hroots]
    exact (pureDominant_card_ne_four (r := 0) (u := 0) (v := _)
      ha hb).2
  · rw [hroots]
    exact pureDominantBorder_lastCore_card_ne_four ha hb hu

name: P23.OneTie.isMinimalBorder_iff
statement:
theorem isMinimalBorder_iff (O : Set (Normal a b c)) (m : Normal a b c) :
    IsMinimalBorder O m ↔
      m ∉ O ∧ ∀ e q, Normal.predecessor e m = some q → q ∈ O
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hm, hx, hy, hz⟩
    refine ⟨hm, ?_⟩
    intro e q hq
    cases e with
    | x => exact hx q hq
    | y => exact hy q hq
    | z => exact hz q hq
  · rintro ⟨hm, hpred⟩
    exact ⟨hm, hpred .x, hpred .y, hpred .z⟩

name: P23.OneTie.mem_borderCandidateFinset_iff
statement:
theorem mem_borderCandidateFinset_iff (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (m : Normal a b c) :
    m ∈ borderCandidateFinset S ↔
      m ∈ (standardFinset S).biUnion (fun p =>
        {p * Normal.xGenerator, p * Normal.yGenerator, p * Normal.zGenerator}) ∧
      IsMinimalBorder (standardSet S) m
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [borderCandidateFinset]

name: P23.OneTie.one_mem_standardSet_of_nonempty
statement:
theorem one_mem_standardSet_of_nonempty {S : Finset (Normal a b c)}
    (hS : S.Nonempty) : (1 : Normal a b c) ∈ standardSet S
proof:
:= by
  rcases hS with ⟨s, hs⟩
  exact ⟨s, hs, one_dvd s⟩

name: P23.OneTie.exists_predecessor_of_ne_one
statement:
theorem exists_predecessor_of_ne_one (m : Normal a b c) (hm : m ≠ 1) :
    ∃ e q, Normal.predecessor e m = some q
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : 0 < m.x
  · exact ⟨.x, Normal.xPredecessor m hx, Normal.predecessor_x_of_pos m hx⟩
  have hx0 : m.x = 0 := by omega
  by_cases hy : 0 < m.y
  · exact ⟨.y, Normal.yPredecessor m hy, Normal.predecessor_y_of_pos m hy⟩
  have hy0 : m.y = 0 := by omega
  by_cases hz : 0 < m.z
  · exact ⟨.z, Normal.zPredecessor m hz, Normal.predecessor_z_of_pos m hz⟩
  have hz0 : m.z = 0 := by omega
  exfalso
  apply hm
  apply Normal.ext <;> simp [hx0, hy0, hz0]

name: P23.OneTie.minimalBorder_mem_borderCandidateFinset
proof:
:= by
  have hm1 : m ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    subst m
    exact hm.1 (one_mem_standardSet_of_nonempty hS)
  rcases exists_predecessor_of_ne_one m hm1 with ⟨e, q, hpred⟩
  have hqSet : q ∈ standardSet S := (isMinimalBorder_iff _ _).1 hm |>.2 e q hpred
  have hqFin : q ∈ standardFinset S :=
    (mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet S q).2 hqSet
  apply (mem_borderCandidateFinset_iff S m).2
  refine ⟨Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨q, hqFin, ?_⟩, hm⟩
  have hmul := (Normal.predecessor_eq_some_iff_mul e m q).1 hpred
  cases e <;> simp_all [Direction.generator]

name: P23.OneTie.mem_borderFinset_iff
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hm
    exact ((mem_borderCandidateFinset_iff S m).1 hm).2
  · intro hm
    exact minimalBorder_mem_borderCandidateFinset hS hm

name: P23.OneTie.mixed_three_border_z_coeff_zero
statement:
theorem mixed_three_border_z_coeff_zero {S : Finset (Normal a b c)}
    (M : MixedThreeBorderData S) (hS : S.Nonempty) (hd : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c)
    (hl : IsLiveTie S) (hanti : IsRootAntichain S) (hbB : b < M.B) (hcvC : c+M.v < M.C)
    (F : Omega k S →ₗ[MonomialArtin k S] MonomialArtin k S)
    (s : Normal a b c) (hs : s ∈ S) :
    let hzS
proof:
:= (mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet S Normal.zGenerator).mpr hl.2.2.1
    coeffAt (k := k) S ⟨Normal.zGenerator,hzS⟩ (F (U (k := k) S (rootIndex S s hs))) = 0 := by
  classical
  dsimp only
  have hr := M.r_pos
  have hra := M.r_lt
  have hb := M.b_pos
  have hc := M.c_pos
  have hB := M.B_pos
  have hv := M.v_pos
  have hvC := M.v_lt
  have hrl : M.r-1 < a := by omega
  have hBB : M.B-b < M.B := by omega
  let gap := M.C-c-M.v
  have hgap : 0 < gap := by dsimp [gap]; omega
  have hgapC : gap < M.C := by dsimp [gap]; omega
  let yb : Normal a b c := yAxis b
  let xr : Normal a b c := ⟨M.r,0,0,hra⟩
  let zv : Normal a b c := zAxis M.v
  let zd : Normal a b c := zAxis gap
  let ye : Normal a b c := yAxis (M.B-b)
  let yz : Normal a b c := ⟨0,b,1,by omega⟩
  let zz : Normal a b c := zAxis (M.v+1)
  let xy : Normal a b c := ⟨M.r,M.B-b,0,hra⟩
  let yz' : Normal a b c := ⟨0,M.B-b,1,by omega⟩
  let q : Normal a b c := ⟨M.r-1,b-1,c+M.v-1,hrl⟩
  have surv (p : Normal a b c) (hp : p.y < M.B ∧ p.z < M.C ∧
      ((p.x < M.r ∧ (p.y < b ∨ p.z < c+M.v)) ∨ (M.r ≤ p.x ∧ p.z < M.v))) :
      p ∈ standardFinset S :=
    (mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet S p).mpr ((mixed_three_border_standard_slices M hS hd p).mpr hp)
  have hyb := surv yb (by dsimp [yb,yAxis]; omega)
  have hxr := surv xr (by dsimp [xr]; omega)
  have hzv := surv zv (by dsimp [zv,zAxis]; omega)
  have hzd := surv zd (by dsimp [zd,zAxis]; omega)
  have hye := surv ye (by dsimp [ye,yAxis]; omega)
  have hyz := surv yz (by dsimp [yz]; omega)
  have hzz := surv zz (by dsimp [zz,zAxis]; omega)
  have hxy := surv xy (by dsimp [xy]; omega)
  have hyz' := surv yz' (by dsimp [yz']; omega)
  have hq := surv q (by dsimp [q]; omega)
  let zi : MonomialIndex S := ⟨Normal.zGenerator,
    (mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet S _).mpr hl.2.2.1⟩
  let ybi : MonomialIndex S := ⟨yb,hyb⟩
  let xri : MonomialIndex S := ⟨xr,hxr⟩
  let zvi : MonomialIndex S := ⟨zv,hzv⟩
  let zdi : MonomialIndex S := ⟨zd,hzd⟩
  let yei : MonomialIndex S := ⟨ye,hye⟩
  let yzi : MonomialIndex S := ⟨yz,hyz⟩
  let zzi : MonomialIndex S := ⟨zz,hzz⟩
  let xyi : MonomialIndex S := ⟨xy,hxy⟩
  let yz'i : MonomialIndex S := ⟨yz',hyz'⟩
  let qi : MonomialIndex S := ⟨q,hq⟩
  have he := mixed_three_border_roots_exact M hS hd hanti hbB hcvC
  have hU : M.yCornerRoot ∈ S := Eq.mp (congrArg (fun T => M.yCornerRoot ∈ T) he.symm)
    (show M.yCornerRoot ∈ M.threeRoots from by simp [MixedThreeBorderData.threeRoots])
  have hV : M.zCornerRoot ∈ S := Eq.mp (congrArg (fun T => M.zCornerRoot ∈ T) he.symm)
    (show M.zCornerRoot ∈ M.threeRoots from by simp [MixedThreeBorderData.threeRoots])
  have hW : M.highRoot ∈ S := Eq.mp (congrArg (fun T => M.highRoot ∈ T) he.symm)
    (show M.highRoot ∈ M.threeRoots from by simp [MixedThreeBorderData.threeRoots])
  let Ui := rootIndex S M.yCornerRoot hU
  let Vi := rootIndex S M.zCornerRoot hV
  let Wi := rootIndex S M.highRoot hW
  have hUy : X (k := k) S yb hyb • U (k := k) S Ui = 0 := by
    apply (X_smul_rootDual_eq_zero_iff S M.yCornerRoot hU ybi).mpr
    simp [Normal.exact_divides_iff,Normal.DividesCriterion,ybi,yb,yAxis,
      MixedThreeBorderData.yCornerRoot]
    omega
  have hUx : X (k := k) S xr hxr • U (k := k) S Ui = 0 := by
    apply (X_smul_rootDual_eq_zero_iff S M.yCornerRoot hU xri).mpr
    simp [Normal.exact_divides_iff,Normal.DividesCriterion,xri,xr,
      MixedThreeBorderData.yCornerRoot]
    omega
  have hWz : X (k := k) S zv hzv • U (k := k) S Wi = 0 := by
    apply (X_smul_rootDual_eq_zero_iff S M.highRoot hW zvi).mpr
    simp [Normal.exact_divides_iff,Normal.DividesCriterion,zvi,zv,zAxis,
      MixedThreeBorderData.highRoot]
    omega
  have hrel : X (k := k) S zd hzd • U (k := k) S Ui =
      X (k := k) S ye hye • U (k := k) S Vi := by
    apply dual_relation_of_common_quotient S zdi yei qi Ui Vi
    · apply Normal.ext <;> simp [zdi,qi,Ui,rootIndex,zd,zAxis,q,
        MixedThreeBorderData.yCornerRoot,Normal.mul,Normal.raw,Normal.normalize,
        Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hrl,Nat.div_eq_of_lt hrl] <;> dsimp [gap] <;> omega
    · apply Normal.ext <;> simp [yei,qi,Vi,rootIndex,ye,yAxis,q,
        MixedThreeBorderData.zCornerRoot,Normal.mul,Normal.raw,Normal.normalize,
        Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hrl,Nat.div_eq_of_lt hrl] <;> omega
  have hUz : coeffAt (k := k) S zi (F (U (k := k) S Ui)) = 0 := by
    apply coeff_eq_zero_of_annihilator S F ybi zi yzi Ui hUy
    apply Normal.ext <;> simp [ybi,zi,yzi,yb,yAxis,yz,Normal.zGenerator]
  have hWzcoeff : coeffAt (k := k) S zi (F (U (k := k) S Wi)) = 0 := by
    apply coeff_eq_zero_of_annihilator S F zvi zi zzi Wi hWz
    apply Normal.ext <;> simp [zvi,zi,zzi,zv,zAxis,zz,Normal.zGenerator]
  have hVcoeff : coeffAt (k := k) S zi (F (U (k := k) S Vi)) = 0 := by
    have hmap : X (k := k) S zd hzd * F (U (k := k) S Ui) =
        X (k := k) S ye hye * F (U (k := k) S Vi) := by
      simpa [smul_eq_mul] using congrArg F hrel
    have hh := congrArg (coeffAt (k := k) S yz'i) hmap
    have hp : yei.1 * zi.1 = yz'i.1 := by
      apply Normal.ext <;> simp [yei,zi,yz'i,ye,yAxis,yz',Normal.zGenerator]
    rw [coeffAt_X_mul S yei zi yz'i hp] at hh
    by_cases hg : gap = 1
    · have hp' : zdi.1 * yei.1 = yz'i.1 := by
        apply Normal.ext <;> simp [zdi,yei,yz'i,zd,zAxis,ye,yAxis,yz',hg]
      rw [coeffAt_X_mul S zdi yei yz'i hp'] at hh
      have hvan : coeffAt (k := k) S yei (F (U (k := k) S Ui)) = 0 := by
        apply coeff_eq_zero_of_annihilator S F xri yei xyi Ui hUx
        apply Normal.ext <;> simp [xri,yei,xyi,xr,ye,yAxis,xy,Normal.mul,
          Normal.raw,Normal.normalize,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hra,Nat.div_eq_of_lt hra]
      exact hh.symm.trans hvan
    · have hnodiv : ¬zdi.1 ∣ yz'i.1 := by
        simp [Normal.exact_divides_iff,Normal.DividesCriterion,zdi,yz'i,zd,zAxis,yz']
        omega
      rw [coeffAt_X_mul_eq_zero_of_not_dvd S zdi yz'i hnodiv] at hh
      exact hh.symm
  have hs' : s = M.highRoot ∨ s = M.yCornerRoot ∨ s = M.zCornerRoot := by
    simpa [he,MixedThreeBorderData.threeRoots] using hs
  rcases hs' with rfl | rfl | rfl
  · exact hWzcoeff
  · exact hUz
  · exact hVcoeff

name: P23.OneTie.mixed_three_border_z_not_trace
statement:
theorem mixed_three_border_z_not_trace {S : Finset (Normal a b c)}
    (M : MixedThreeBorderData S) (hS : S.Nonempty) (hd : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c)
    (hl : IsLiveTie S) (hanti : IsRootAntichain S) (ht : quotientType ℚ S hS hd hl = 3) :
    let hzS
proof:
:= (mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet S Normal.zGenerator).mpr hl.2.2.1
    X (k := ℚ) S Normal.zGenerator hzS ∉ TraceSubmodule ℚ S := by
  dsimp only
  intro htrace
  obtain ⟨hb,hc⟩ := (mixed_three_border_type_three_iff M hS hd hl hanti).mp ht
  have hcard : S.card = 3 := (quotientType_eq_three_iff S hS hd hl hanti).mp ht
  obtain ⟨F,s,hs,hcoeff⟩ := exists_root_image_with_variable_coeff_of_mem_trace S hS
    (by omega) hanti hd .z _ htrace
  exact hcoeff (mixed_three_border_z_coeff_zero M hS hd hl hanti hb hc F s hs)

name: P23.OneTie.mixed_three_border_not_nearlyGorenstein
statement:
theorem mixed_three_border_not_nearlyGorenstein {S : Finset (Normal a b c)}
    (M : MixedThreeBorderData S) (hS : S.Nonempty) (hd : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c)
    (hl : IsLiveTie S) (ha : IsRootAntichain S) (ht : quotientType ℚ S hS hd hl = 3) :
    ¬QuotientNearlyGorenstein ℚ S hS hd hl
proof:
:= by
  intro hn
  have hn' := (quotientNearlyGorenstein_iff_directNearlyGorenstein S hS hd hl).mp hn
  have htr := (directNearlyGorenstein_iff_variablesInTrace S hS hd hl).mp hn'
  exact mixed_three_border_z_not_trace M hS hd hl ha ht htr.2.2

name: P23.OneTie.Raw.ext
statement:
@[ext] theorem ext {p q : Raw} (hx : p.x = q.x) (hy : p.y = q.y) (hz : p.z = q.z) :
    p = q
proof:
:= by
  cases p
  cases q
  simp_all

name: P23.OneTie.Raw.add_x
statement: @[simp] theorem add_x (p q : Raw) : (p + q).x = p.x + q.x
proof: := rfl

name: P23.OneTie.Raw.add_y
statement: @[simp] theorem add_y (p q : Raw) : (p + q).y = p.y + q.y
proof: := rfl

name: P23.OneTie.Raw.add_z
statement: @[simp] theorem add_z (p q : Raw) : (p + q).z = p.z + q.z

name: P23.OneTie.Normal.ext
statement:
@[ext] theorem ext {p q : Normal a b c}
    (hx : p.x = q.x) (hy : p.y = q.y) (hz : p.z = q.z) : p = q
proof:
:= by
  cases p
  cases q
  simp_all

name: P23.OneTie.Normal.positive
statement: private theorem positive (a : ℕ) [NeZero a] : 0 < a
proof:
:=
  Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne a)

name: P23.OneTie.Normal.normalize_x
statement:
@[simp] theorem normalize_x (ha : 0 < a) (p : Raw) :
    (normalize a b c ha p).x = p.x % a
proof: := rfl

name: P23.OneTie.Normal.normalize_y
statement:
@[simp] theorem normalize_y (ha : 0 < a) (p : Raw) :
    (normalize a b c ha p).y = p.y + (p.x / a) * b
proof: := rfl

name: P23.OneTie.Normal.normalize_z
statement:
@[simp] theorem normalize_z (ha : 0 < a) (p : Raw) :
    (normalize a b c ha p).z = p.z + (p.x / a) * c
proof: := rfl

name: P23.OneTie.Normal.normalize_raw
statement:
@[simp] theorem normalize_raw (ha : 0 < a) (p : Normal a b c) :
    normalize a b c ha p.raw = p
proof:
:= by
  ext <;> simp [normalize, raw, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt p.x_lt, Nat.div_eq_of_lt p.x_lt]

name: P23.OneTie.Normal.div_normalize_add
statement:
private theorem div_normalize_add (ha : 0 < a) (m n : ℕ) :
    m / a + (m % a + n) / a = (m + n) / a
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Nat.add_div ha]
  have hm : m % a < a := Nat.mod_lt _ ha
  simp [Nat.div_eq_of_lt hm, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hm, Nat.add_assoc]

name: P23.OneTie.Normal.normalize_normalize_add
statement:
theorem normalize_normalize_add (ha : 0 < a) (p q : Raw) :
    normalize a b c ha ((normalize a b c ha p).raw + q) =
      normalize a b c ha (p + q)
proof:
:= by
  apply Normal.ext
  · simp [normalize, raw, Nat.add_mod]
  · change (p.y + p.x / a * b + q.y) + (p.x % a + q.x) / a * b =
      p.y + q.y + (p.x + q.x) / a * b
    have hdiv := div_normalize_add (a := a) ha p.x q.x
    rw [← hdiv]
    simp only [Nat.add_mul]
    omega
  · change (p.z + p.x / a * c + q.z) + (p.x % a + q.x) / a * c =
      p.z + q.z + (p.x + q.x) / a * c
    have hdiv := div_normalize_add (a := a) ha p.x q.x
    rw [← hdiv]
    simp only [Nat.add_mul]
    omega

name: P23.OneTie.Normal.one_x
statement: @[simp] theorem one_x [NeZero a] : (1 : Normal a b c).x = 0
proof: := rfl

name: P23.OneTie.Normal.one_y
statement: @[simp] theorem one_y [NeZero a] : (1 : Normal a b c).y = 0
proof: := rfl

name: P23.OneTie.Normal.one_z
statement: @[simp] theorem one_z [NeZero a] : (1 : Normal a b c).z = 0
proof: := rfl

name: P23.OneTie.Normal.mul_x
statement:
@[simp] theorem mul_x [NeZero a] (p q : Normal a b c) :
    (p * q).x = (p.x + q.x) % a
proof: := rfl

name: P23.OneTie.Normal.mul_y
statement:
@[simp] theorem mul_y [NeZero a] (p q : Normal a b c) :
    (p * q).y = p.y + q.y + ((p.x + q.x) / a) * b
proof: := rfl

name: P23.OneTie.Normal.mul_z
statement:
@[simp] theorem mul_z [NeZero a] (p q : Normal a b c) :
    (p * q).z = p.z + q.z + ((p.x + q.x) / a) * c
proof: := rfl

name: P23.OneTie.Normal.mul_left_cancel
statement:
theorem mul_left_cancel [NeZero a] {p q r : Normal a b c}
    (h : p * q = p * r) : q = r
proof:
:= by
  have hmod : Nat.ModEq a (p.x + q.x) (p.x + r.x) := congrArg Normal.x h
  have hqr : Nat.ModEq a q.x r.x := Nat.ModEq.add_left_cancel' p.x hmod
  have hx : q.x = r.x := by
    unfold Nat.ModEq at hqr
    simpa [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt q.x_lt, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt r.x_lt] using hqr
  have hy := congrArg Normal.y h
  have hz := congrArg Normal.z h
  apply Normal.ext hx
  · simp only [mul_y] at hy
    rw [hx] at hy
    omega
  · simp only [mul_z] at hz
    rw [hx] at hz
    omega

name: P23.OneTie.Normal.mul_right_cancel
statement:
theorem mul_right_cancel [NeZero a] {p q r : Normal a b c}
    (h : q * p = r * p) : q = r
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm q p, mul_comm r p] at h
  exact mul_left_cancel h

name: P23.OneTie.Normal.normalize_idempotent
statement:
theorem normalize_idempotent [NeZero a] (p : Raw) :
    normalize a b c (positive a) (normalize a b c (positive a) p).raw =
      normalize a b c (positive a) p
proof:
:=
  normalize_raw _ _

name: P23.OneTie.pure_three_border_ng_residual
statement:
theorem pure_three_border_ng_residual {S : Finset (Normal a b 0)}
    (P : PureThreeBorderData S) (hS : S.Nonempty) (hd : IsLiveParameterDomain a b 0)
    (hl : IsLiveTie S) (ha : IsRootAntichain S) (ht : quotientType ℚ S hS hd hl = 3)
    (hn : QuotientNearlyGorenstein ℚ S hS hd hl) : Nonempty (PureResidualThreeBorder S)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hr,hv,hw⟩ := pure_three_border_ng_forces_endpoints P hS hd hl ha ht hn
  have hb : 2 ≤ b := by rcases hd.2 with hm | hp <;> omega
  refine ⟨⟨P.u,P.C,hd.1,hb,P.u_pos,by have := P.w_pos; have := P.w_lt; omega,?_⟩⟩
  simpa [hr,hv,hw] using P.border

name: P23.OneTie.pureResidual_roots_exact
statement:
theorem pureResidual_roots_exact {S : Finset (Normal a b 0)}
    (R : PureResidualThreeBorder S) (hS : S.Nonempty) (ha : IsRootAntichain S) : S = R.roots
proof:
:= by
  have hd : IsLiveParameterDomain a b 0 := ⟨R.a_ge_two,Or.inr ⟨R.b_ge_two,rfl⟩⟩
  have huv : R.generalData.u < R.generalData.v := by
    dsimp [PureResidualThreeBorder.generalData]
    have := R.u_pos; have := R.b_ge_two; omega
  have he := pure_three_border_roots_exact R.generalData hS hd ha huv
  convert he using 1
  simp [PureResidualThreeBorder.roots,PureThreeBorderData.threeRoots,
    PureThreeBorderData.xRoot,PureThreeBorderData.yRoot,PureThreeBorderData.zRoot,
    PureResidualThreeBorder.generalData,Nat.sub_sub]

name: P23.OneTie.pureResidual_type_three
statement:
theorem pureResidual_type_three {S : Finset (Normal a b 0)}
    (R : PureResidualThreeBorder S) (hS : S.Nonempty) (hl : IsLiveTie S)
    (ha : IsRootAntichain S) :
    quotientType ℚ S hS ⟨R.a_ge_two,Or.inr ⟨R.b_ge_two,rfl⟩⟩ hl = 3
proof:
:= by
  apply (pure_three_border_type_three_iff R.generalData hS _ hl ha).mpr
  dsimp [PureResidualThreeBorder.generalData]
  have := R.u_pos; have := R.b_ge_two; omega

name: P23.OneTie.polynomialLift_eq_variable_powers
statement:
theorem polynomialLift_eq_variable_powers (p : Normal a b 0) :
    polynomialLift (k := ℚ) p = polyX^p.x * polyY^p.y * polyZ^p.z
proof:
:= by
  simp [polynomialLift,normalExponent,MvPolynomial.X_pow_eq_monomial,
    MvPolynomial.monomial_mul,polyX,polyY,polyZ]

name: P23.OneTie.pureResidual_presentation_exact
proof:
:= by
  have hs : polynomialBorderSet (k := ℚ) S =
      {polyX*polyY^R.u,polyZ^R.C,polyY^(R.u+b-1)*polyZ^(R.C-1)} := by
    ext f
    simp only [polynomialBorderSet,R.border,Finset.mem_insert,Finset.mem_singleton]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨g,hg,rfl⟩
      rcases hg with rfl | rfl | rfl <;>
        simp [polynomialLift_eq_variable_powers,zAxis]
    · intro hf
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff,Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hf
      rcases hf with rfl | rfl | rfl
      · refine ⟨⟨1,R.u,0,by have := R.a_ge_two; omega⟩,Or.inl rfl,?_⟩
        simp [polynomialLift_eq_variable_powers]
      · refine ⟨zAxis R.C,Or.inr (Or.inl rfl),?_⟩
        simp [polynomialLift_eq_variable_powers,zAxis]
      · refine ⟨⟨0,R.u+b-1,R.C-1,Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne a)⟩,
          Or.inr (Or.inr rfl),?_⟩
        simp [polynomialLift_eq_variable_powers]
  rw [finitePresentationIdeal,polynomialBorderIdeal,hs,tieIdeal,← Ideal.span_union]
  congr 1
  ext f
  simp [tiePolynomial]
  tauto

name: P23.OneTie.pureResidual_top_equations
statement:
theorem pureResidual_top_equations {S : Finset (Normal a b 0)}
    (R : PureResidualThreeBorder S) (X Y Z : ℕ) (htie : a*X=b*Y) :
    (a-1)*X+(R.u-1)*Y+(R.C-1)*Z+X = R.formalTop Y Z ∧
    (R.u+b-2)*Y+(R.C-1)*Z+Y = R.formalTop Y Z ∧
    (R.u+b-1)*Y+(R.C-2)*Z+Z = R.formalTop Y Z
proof:
:= by
  have hau : a-1+1=a := by have := R.a_ge_two; omega
  have huu : R.u-1+1=R.u := by have := R.u_pos; omega
  have hvv : R.u+b-1+1=R.u+b := by have := R.u_pos; have := R.b_ge_two; omega
  have huub : R.u+b-2+1=R.u+b-1 := by have := R.u_pos; have := R.b_ge_two; omega
  have hCC : R.C-2+1=R.C-1 := by have := R.C_ge_two; omega
  dsimp [PureResidualThreeBorder.formalTop]
  constructor
  · have hh : (a-1)*X+X=a*X := by
      calc
        _ = (a-1+1)*X := by ring
        _ = a*X := by rw [hau]
    have hh' : (R.u+b-1)*Y = (R.u-1)*Y+b*Y := by
      rw [← Nat.add_mul]
      have he : R.u+b-1=R.u-1+b := by have := R.u_pos; omega
      rw [he]
    omega
  · constructor
    · have hh : (R.u+b-2)*Y+Y=(R.u+b-1)*Y := by
        calc
          _ = (R.u+b-2+1)*Y := by ring
          _ = (R.u+b-1)*Y := by rw [huub]
      omega
    · have hh : (R.C-2)*Z+Z=(R.C-1)*Z := by
        calc
          _ = (R.C-2+1)*Z := by ring
          _ = (R.C-1)*Z := by rw [hCC]
      omega

name: P23.OneTie.mem_singletonIf_iff
statement:
theorem mem_singletonIf_iff (condition : Prop) [Decidable condition]
    (m n : Normal a b c) :
    m ∈ singletonIf condition n ↔ condition ∧ m = n
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : condition <;> simp [singletonIf, h]

name: P23.OneTie.card_union_singletonProofIf
statement:
theorem card_union_singletonProofIf (s : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (condition : Prop) [Decidable condition] (m : condition → Normal a b c)
    (hnot : ∀ h, m h ∉ s) :
    (s ∪ singletonProofIf condition m).card = s.card + indicator condition
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : condition
  · simp [singletonProofIf, indicator, h, Finset.card_insert_of_notMem (hnot h)]
  · simp [singletonProofIf, indicator, h]

name: P23.OneTie.wrappedPredecessor_zY_c_eq_one
statement:
theorem wrappedPredecessor_zY_c_eq_one
    (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hu : b ≤ u) :
    Normal.predecessor .x (mixedYTimesZ (a := a) (b := b) (c := 1) u) =
      some (mixedWrappedZY (a := a) (b := b) u)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Normal.predecessor_x_wrapped]
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · simp [mixedYTimesZ]
    omega
  · simp [mixedYTimesZ]

name: P23.OneTie.mem_standardSet_mixedSoclesYZ_iff
statement:
theorem mem_standardSet_mixedSoclesYZ_iff
    (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hc : 1 ≤ c) (hu : b ≤ u) (hv : c ≤ v)
    (hr : r < a - 1) (p : Normal a b c) :
    p ∈ standardSet (mixedSoclesYZ (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) r u v hr) ↔
      (p.y ≤ u ∧ p.z ≤ v ∧
        (p.x ≤ r ∨ (p.y + b ≤ u ∧ p.z + c ≤ v))) ∨
      (p.x = 0 ∧ p.y ≤ u + 1 ∧ p.z = 0) ∨
      (p.x = 0 ∧ p.y = 0 ∧ p.z ≤ v + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rcases p with ⟨px, py, pz, hpx⟩
  simp [standardSet, mixedSoclesYZ, Normal.exact_divides_iff,
    Normal.DividesCriterion, mixedCore, mixedY, mixedZ]
  omega

name: P23.OneTie.mem_mixedExpectedBorderYZ_iff
statement:
theorem mem_mixedExpectedBorderYZ_iff
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (r u v : ℕ) (hr : r < a - 1) (m : Normal a b c) :
    m ∈ mixedExpectedBorderYZ (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) ha r u v hr ↔
      mixedYZBorderNat b c r u v m.x m.y m.z
proof:
:= by

statement:

    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hc : 1 ≤ c)
    (hu : b ≤ u) (hv : c ≤ v) (hr : r < a - 1) :
    (borderFinset
      (mixedSoclesYZ (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) r u v hr)).card =
      4 + 2 * indicator (1 < r + 1) + indicator (1 < b) +
        indicator (1 < c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mixedBorderYZ_exact ha hb hc hu hv hr]
  let s0 : Finset (Normal a b c) :=
    {mixedP r u hr, mixedQ r v hr, mixedYTimesY u, mixedZTimesZ v}
  let s1 := s0 ∪ singletonIf (1 < r + 1) (mixedYTimesX ha u)
  let s2 := s1 ∪ singletonIf (1 < r + 1) (mixedZTimesX ha v)
  let s3 := s2 ∪ singletonIf (1 < c) (mixedYTimesZ u)

      ({mixedQ (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) r v hr,
        mixedYTimesY (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) u,
        mixedZTimesZ (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) v} :
        Finset (Normal a b c)) := by
    simp [mixedP, mixedQ, mixedYTimesY, mixedZTimesZ]
    omega
  have hQ : mixedQ (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) r v hr ∉
      ({mixedYTimesY (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) u,
        mixedZTimesZ (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) v} :
        Finset (Normal a b c)) := by
    simp [mixedQ, mixedYTimesY, mixedZTimesZ]
  have hYY : mixedYTimesY (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) u ∉
      ({mixedZTimesZ (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) v} :
        Finset (Normal a b c)) := by
    simp [mixedYTimesY, mixedZTimesZ]
  have hs0 : s0.card = 4 := by
    dsimp [s0]
    rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hP]
    rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hQ]
    rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hYY]
    simp
  have hxY : 1 < r + 1 → mixedYTimesX (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) ha u ∉ s0 := by
    intro hh
    simp [s0, mixedP, mixedQ, mixedYTimesY, mixedZTimesZ, mixedYTimesX]
    omega
  have hs1 : s1.card = s0.card + indicator (1 < r + 1) := by
    exact card_union_singletonIf s0 _ _ hxY
  have hxZ : 1 < r + 1 → mixedZTimesX (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) ha v ∉ s1 := by
    intro hh
    simp [s1, s0, singletonIf, hh, mixedP, mixedQ, mixedYTimesY,
      mixedZTimesZ, mixedYTimesX, mixedZTimesX]
    omega
  have hs2 : s2.card = s1.card + indicator (1 < r + 1) := by
    exact card_union_singletonIf s1 _ _ hxZ
  have hzY : 1 < c → mixedYTimesZ (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) u ∉ s2 := by
    intro hc1
    simp [s2, s1, s0, singletonIf, mixedP, mixedQ, mixedYTimesY,
      mixedZTimesZ, mixedYTimesX, mixedZTimesX, mixedYTimesZ]
    split_ifs <;> simp_all <;> omega
  have hs3 : s3.card = s2.card + indicator (1 < c) := by
    exact card_union_singletonIf s2 _ _ hzY
  have hyZ : 1 < b → mixedZTimesY (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) v ∉ s3 := by
    intro hb1
    simp [s3, s2, s1, s0, singletonIf, mixedP, mixedQ, mixedYTimesY,
      mixedZTimesZ, mixedYTimesX, mixedZTimesX, mixedYTimesZ,
      mixedZTimesY]
    split_ifs <;> simp_all <;> omega
  have hs4 := card_union_singletonIf s3 (1 < b)
    (mixedZTimesY (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) v) hyZ
  change (s3 ∪ singletonIf (1 < b) (mixedZTimesY v)).card = _
  rw [hs4, hs3, hs2, hs1, hs0]
  omega

          Normal.zPredecessor, hx, hx0, hby, hcz] using harith
    · simpa [IsMinimalBorder, ApplicablePredecessorsSurvive,
        mem_standardSet_mixedSoclesYQ_iff hb hc hu hv hr,
        mixedYQStandardNat, Normal.predecessor, Normal.yPredecessor,
        Normal.zPredecessor, hx, hx0, hby] using harith

name: P23.OneTie.mixedBorderYQ_card
statement:
theorem mixedBorderYQ_card
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hc : 1 ≤ c)
    (hu : b ≤ u) (hv : c ≤ v) (hr : r < a - 1) :
    (borderFinset
      (mixedSoclesYQ (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) r u v hr)).card =
      3 + indicator (1 < r + 1) + indicator (r + 1 < a - 1) +
        2 * indicator (1 < c) + indicator (b < u)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mixedBorderYQ_exact ha hb hc hu hv hr]
  let s0 : Finset (Normal a b c) := {mixedZ v, mixedP r u hr, mixedYTimesY u}
  let s1 := s0 ∪ singletonIf (1 < r + 1) (mixedYTimesX ha u)
  let s2 := s1 ∪ singletonIf (1 < c) (mixedYTimesZ u)
  let s3 := s2 ∪ singletonIf (1 < c) (mixedQTimesZ r v hr)
  let s4 := s3 ∪ singletonProofIf (r + 1 < a - 1) (mixedQTimesX r v)
  have hs0 : s0.card = 3 := by
    simp [s0, mixedZ, mixedP, mixedYTimesY]
  have h1 : 1 < r + 1 → mixedYTimesX (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) ha u ∉ s0 := by
    intro h; simp [s0, mixedZ, mixedP, mixedYTimesY, mixedYTimesX]; omega
  have hs1 : s1.card = s0.card + indicator (1 < r + 1) :=
    card_union_singletonIf s0 _ _ h1
  have h2 : 1 < c → mixedYTimesZ (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) u ∉ s1 := by
    intro h; simp [s1, s0, singletonIf, mixedZ, mixedP, mixedYTimesY,
      mixedYTimesX, mixedYTimesZ]; split_ifs <;> simp_all <;> omega
  have hs2 : s2.card = s1.card + indicator (1 < c) :=
    card_union_singletonIf s1 _ _ h2
  have h3 : 1 < c → mixedQTimesZ (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) r v hr ∉ s2 := by
    intro h; simp [s2, s1, s0, singletonIf, mixedZ, mixedP, mixedYTimesY,
      mixedYTimesX, mixedYTimesZ, mixedQTimesZ]
    split_ifs <;> simp_all <;> omega
  have hs3 : s3.card = s2.card + indicator (1 < c) :=
    card_union_singletonIf s2 _ _ h3
  have h4 : ∀ hh : r + 1 < a - 1,
      mixedQTimesX (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) r v hh ∉ s3 := by
    intro hh; simp [s3, s2, s1, s0, singletonIf, mixedZ, mixedP,
      mixedYTimesY, mixedYTimesX, mixedYTimesZ, mixedQTimesZ,
      mixedQTimesX]
    split_ifs <;> simp_all <;> omega
  have hs4 : s4.card = s3.card + indicator (r + 1 < a - 1) :=
    card_union_singletonProofIf s3 _ _ h4
  have h5s3 : b < u →
      mixedQTimesY (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) r v hr ∉ s3 := by
    intro h
    have hn0 : mixedQTimesY (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) r v hr ∉ s0 := by
      simp [s0, mixedZ, mixedP, mixedYTimesY, mixedQTimesY]
      omega
    have hn1 : mixedQTimesY (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) r v hr ∉ s1 := by
      rw [show s1 = s0 ∪ singletonIf (1 < r + 1) (mixedYTimesX ha u) by rfl]
      simp only [Finset.mem_union, not_or]
      refine ⟨hn0, ?_⟩
      by_cases hcond : 1 < r + 1
      · simp [singletonIf, hcond, mixedYTimesX, mixedQTimesY]
        omega
      · simp [singletonIf, hcond]
    have hn2 : mixedQTimesY (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) r v hr ∉ s2 := by
      rw [show s2 = s1 ∪ singletonIf (1 < c) (mixedYTimesZ u) by rfl]
      simp only [Finset.mem_union, not_or]
      refine ⟨hn1, ?_⟩
      by_cases hcond : 1 < c
      · simp [singletonIf, hcond, mixedYTimesZ, mixedQTimesY]
      · simp [singletonIf, hcond]
    rw [show s3 = s2 ∪ singletonIf (1 < c) (mixedQTimesZ r v hr) by rfl]
    simp only [Finset.mem_union, not_or]
    refine ⟨hn2, ?_⟩
    by_cases hcond : 1 < c
    · simp [singletonIf, hcond, mixedQTimesZ, mixedQTimesY]
    · simp [singletonIf, hcond]
  have h5 : b < u → mixedQTimesY (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) r v hr ∉ s4 := by
    intro h
    have hs := h5s3 h
    by_cases hh : r + 1 < a - 1
    · rw [show s4 = s3 ∪ singletonProofIf (r + 1 < a - 1)
        (mixedQTimesX r v) by rfl]
      simp only [Finset.mem_union, not_or]
      refine ⟨hs, ?_⟩
      simp [singletonProofIf, hh, mixedQTimesX, mixedQTimesY]
    · rw [show s4 = s3 ∪ singletonProofIf (r + 1 < a - 1)
        (mixedQTimesX r v) by rfl]
      simp [singletonProofIf, hh, hs]
  have hs5 := card_union_singletonIf s4 (b < u)
    (mixedQTimesY (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) r v hr) h5
  change (s4 ∪ singletonIf (b < u) (mixedQTimesY r v hr)).card = _
  rw [hs5, hs4, hs3, hs2, hs1, hs0]
  by_cases hR : 1 < r + 1
  all_goals by_cases hh : r + 1 < a - 1
  all_goals by_cases hc1 : 1 < c
  all_goals by_cases hbu : b < u
  all_goals simp [indicator, hR, hh, hc1, hbu] <;> omega

name: P23.OneTie.mem_standardSet_swapYZFinset_iff

proof:

      simp [Normal.predecessor, hx, hw, hws, Normal.wrappedXPredecessor,
