name: P23.OneTie.isMinimalBorder_swapYZFinset_iff
statement:
theorem isMinimalBorder_swapYZFinset_iff (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (m : Normal a b c) :
    IsMinimalBorder (standardSet (swapYZFinset S)) (swapYZ m) ↔
      IsMinimalBorder (standardSet S) m
proof:
:= by
  simp only [IsMinimalBorder, ApplicablePredecessorsSurvive,
    mem_standardSet_swapYZFinset_iff, swapYZ_predecessor_x,
    swapYZ_predecessor_y, swapYZ_predecessor_z]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hm, hx, hy, hz⟩
    refine ⟨hm, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro q hq
      have := hx (swapYZ q)
      simp [hq, mem_standardSet_swapYZFinset_iff] at this
      exact this
    · intro q hq
      have := hz (swapYZ q)
      simp [hq, mem_standardSet_swapYZFinset_iff] at this
      exact this
    · intro q hq
      have := hy (swapYZ q)
      simp [hq, mem_standardSet_swapYZFinset_iff] at this
      exact this
  · rintro ⟨hm, hx, hy, hz⟩
    refine ⟨hm, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro q hq
      cases hp : Normal.predecessor .x m with
      | none => simp [hp, swapYZ_predecessor_x] at hq
      | some p =>
          have heq : swapYZ p = q := by
            simpa [swapYZ_predecessor_x, hp] using hq
          rw [← heq, mem_standardSet_swapYZFinset_iff]
          exact hx p hp
    · intro q hq
      cases hp : Normal.predecessor .z m with
      | none => simp [hp, swapYZ_predecessor_y] at hq
      | some p =>
          have heq : swapYZ p = q := by
            simpa [swapYZ_predecessor_y, hp] using hq
          rw [← heq, mem_standardSet_swapYZFinset_iff]
          exact hz p hp
    · intro q hq
      cases hp : Normal.predecessor .y m with
      | none => simp [hp, swapYZ_predecessor_z] at hq
      | some p =>
          have heq : swapYZ p = q := by
            simpa [swapYZ_predecessor_z, hp] using hq
          rw [← heq, mem_standardSet_swapYZFinset_iff]
          exact hy p hp

name: P23.OneTie.borderFinset_swapYZ_card
statement:
theorem borderFinset_swapYZ_card (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) :
    (borderFinset (swapYZFinset S)).card = (borderFinset S).card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hS : S.Nonempty
  · have hSwap : (swapYZFinset S).Nonempty := by
      rcases hS with ⟨s, hs⟩
      exact ⟨swapYZ s, Finset.mem_map.mpr ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩⟩
    refine Finset.card_bij (fun m _ => swapYZ m) ?_ ?_ ?_
    · intro m hm
      rw [mem_borderFinset_iff hS]
      exact (isMinimalBorder_swapYZFinset_iff S (swapYZ m)).1
        (by simpa using
          (mem_borderFinset_iff (S := swapYZFinset S) (m := m) hSwap).1 hm)
    · intro m₁ _ m₂ _ h
      exact swapYZEmbedding.injective h
    · intro q hq
      refine ⟨swapYZ q, ?_, by simp⟩
      rw [mem_borderFinset_iff hSwap]
      exact (isMinimalBorder_swapYZFinset_iff S q).2
        ((mem_borderFinset_iff (S := S) (m := q) hS).1 hq)
  · have hEmpty : S = ∅ := Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hS
    subst S
    rfl

name: P23.OneTie.borderFinset_swapYZ_exact
statement:
theorem borderFinset_swapYZ_exact (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) :
    borderFinset (swapYZFinset S) = swapYZFinset (borderFinset S)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hS : S.Nonempty
  · have hSwap : (swapYZFinset S).Nonempty := by
      rcases hS with ⟨s, hs⟩
      exact ⟨swapYZ s, Finset.mem_map.mpr ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩⟩
    apply Finset.ext
    intro m
    rw [mem_borderFinset_iff hSwap]
    rw [show m ∈ swapYZFinset (borderFinset S) ↔
        ∃ q ∈ borderFinset S, swapYZ q = m by
      exact Finset.mem_map]
    constructor
    · intro hm
      refine ⟨swapYZ m, ?_, swapYZ_swapYZ m⟩
      rw [mem_borderFinset_iff hS]
      exact (isMinimalBorder_swapYZFinset_iff S (swapYZ m)).1 (by simpa using hm)
    · rintro ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩
      exact (isMinimalBorder_swapYZFinset_iff S q).2
        ((mem_borderFinset_iff hS q).1 hq)
  · have hEmpty : S = ∅ := Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hS
    subst S
    rfl

name: P23.OneTie.mixedBorderZP_exact
statement:
theorem mixedBorderZP_exact
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hc : 1 ≤ c)
    (hu : b ≤ u) (hv : c ≤ v) (hr : r < a - 1) :
    swapYZFinset (borderFinset
      (mixedSoclesZP (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) r u v hr)) =

statement:
theorem mixedBorderZQ_exact
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hc : 1 ≤ c)
    (hu : b ≤ u) (hv : c ≤ v) (hr : r < a - 1) :
    swapYZFinset (borderFinset

name: P23.OneTie.mixedBorderZP_card
statement:
theorem mixedBorderZP_card
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hc : 1 ≤ c)
    (hu : b ≤ u) (hv : c ≤ v) (hr : r < a - 1) :
    (borderFinset
      (mixedSoclesZP (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) r u v hr)).card =
      3 + indicator (1 < r + 1) + indicator (r + 1 < a - 1) +
        2 * indicator (1 < b) + indicator (c < v)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = (borderFinset (swapYZFinset
        (mixedSoclesZP (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) r u v hr))).card :=
      (borderFinset_swapYZ_card
        (mixedSoclesZP (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) r u v hr)).symm
    _ = (borderFinset
        (mixedSoclesYQ (a := a) (b := c) (c := b) r v u hr)).card := by
      rw [swapYZFinset_mixedSoclesZP]
    _ = _ := mixedBorderYQ_card ha hc hb hv hu hr

name: P23.OneTie.mixedBorderZQ_card
statement:
theorem mixedBorderZQ_card
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hc : 1 ≤ c)
    (hu : b ≤ u) (hv : c ≤ v) (hr : r < a - 1) :
    (borderFinset
      (mixedSoclesZQ (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) r u v hr)).card =
      4 + indicator (1 < r + 1) + indicator (1 < c ∨ r + 1 = 1) +
        indicator (b < u) + indicator (1 < b ∧ r + 1 < a - 1)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = (borderFinset (swapYZFinset
        (mixedSoclesZQ (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) r u v hr))).card :=
      (borderFinset_swapYZ_card
        (mixedSoclesZQ (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) r u v hr)).symm
    _ = (borderFinset
        (mixedSoclesYP (a := a) (b := c) (c := b) r v u hr)).card := by
      rw [swapYZFinset_mixedSoclesZQ]
    _ = _ := mixedBorderYP_card ha hc hb hv hu hr

name: P23.OneTie.mem_standardSet_mixedSoclesPQ_iff
statement:
theorem mem_standardSet_mixedSoclesPQ_iff
    (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hc : 1 ≤ c) (hu : b ≤ u) (hv : c ≤ v)
    (hr : r < a - 1) (p : Normal a b c) :
    p ∈ standardSet (mixedSoclesPQ (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) r u v hr) ↔
      mixedPQStandardNat b c r u v p.x p.y p.z
proof:
:= by
  rcases p with ⟨px, py, pz, hpx⟩
  simp [standardSet, mixedSoclesPQ, Normal.exact_divides_iff,
    Normal.DividesCriterion, mixedCore, mixedP, mixedQ, mixedPQStandardNat]

name: P23.OneTie.mem_mixedExpectedBorderPQ_iff
statement:
theorem mem_mixedExpectedBorderPQ_iff
    (r u v : ℕ) (hr : r < a - 1) (m : Normal a b c) :
    m ∈ mixedExpectedBorderPQ (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) r u v hr ↔
      mixedPQBorderNat a b c r u v m.x m.y m.z
proof:
:= by
  rcases m with ⟨mx, my, mz, hmx⟩
  by_cases hh : r + 1 < a - 1
  · simp [mixedExpectedBorderPQ, singletonProofIf, hh,
      mem_singletonIf_iff,
      mixedPQBorderNat, mixedY, mixedZ, mixedPTimesX, mixedQTimesX,
      mixedPTimesY, mixedQTimesZ, mixedPTimesZ, mixedQTimesY, or_assoc]
  · simp [mixedExpectedBorderPQ, singletonProofIf, hh,
      mem_singletonIf_iff,
      mixedPQBorderNat, mixedY, mixedZ, mixedPTimesX, mixedQTimesX,
      mixedPTimesY, mixedQTimesZ, mixedPTimesZ, mixedQTimesY, or_assoc]

name: P23.OneTie.mixedPQ_border_arithmetic
statement:
theorem mixedPQ_border_arithmetic
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hc : 1 ≤ c)
    (hu : b ≤ u) (hv : c ≤ v) (hr : r < a - 1)
    (x y z : ℕ) (hxlt : x < a) :
    (¬mixedPQStandardNat b c r u v x y z ∧
      (if 0 < x then mixedPQStandardNat b c r u v (x - 1) y z
       else if b ≤ y ∧ c ≤ z then
         mixedPQStandardNat b c r u v (a - 1) (y - b) (z - c)
       else True) ∧
      (0 < y → mixedPQStandardNat b c r u v x (y - 1) z) ∧
      (0 < z → mixedPQStandardNat b c r u v x y (z - 1))) ↔
      mixedPQBorderNat a b c r u v x y z
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : 0 < x
  · by_cases hy : 0 < y <;> by_cases hz : 0 < z
    all_goals simp [hx, hy, hz, mixedPQStandardNat, mixedPQBorderNat]
      <;> grind (splits := 48)
  · have hx0 : x = 0 := by omega
    by_cases hby : b ≤ y
    · by_cases hcz : c ≤ z
      · by_cases hy : 0 < y <;> by_cases hz : 0 < z
        all_goals simp [hx0, hby, hcz, hy, hz, mixedPQStandardNat,
          mixedPQBorderNat] <;> grind (splits := 48)
      · by_cases hy : 0 < y <;> by_cases hz : 0 < z
        all_goals simp [hx0, hby, hcz, hy, hz, mixedPQStandardNat,
          mixedPQBorderNat] <;> grind (splits := 48)
    · by_cases hy : 0 < y <;> by_cases hz : 0 < z
      all_goals simp [hx0, hby, hy, hz, mixedPQStandardNat,
        mixedPQBorderNat] <;> grind (splits := 48)

name: P23.OneTie.mixedBorderPQ_exact
statement:
theorem mixedBorderPQ_exact
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hc : 1 ≤ c)
    (hu : b ≤ u) (hv : c ≤ v) (hr : r < a - 1) :
    borderFinset (mixedSoclesPQ (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) r u v hr) =
      mixedExpectedBorderPQ (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) r u v hr
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.ext
  intro m
  rw [mem_borderFinset_iff (by simp [mixedSoclesPQ])]
  rw [mem_mixedExpectedBorderPQ_iff r u v hr]
  rcases m with ⟨mx, my, mz, hmx⟩
  have harith := mixedPQ_border_arithmetic ha hb hc hu hv hr mx my mz hmx
  by_cases hx : 0 < mx
  · simpa [IsMinimalBorder, ApplicablePredecessorsSurvive,
      mem_standardSet_mixedSoclesPQ_iff hb hc hu hv hr,
      mixedPQStandardNat, Normal.predecessor, Normal.xPredecessor,
      Normal.yPredecessor, Normal.zPredecessor, hx] using harith
  · have hx0 : mx = 0 := by omega
    by_cases hby : b ≤ my
    · by_cases hcz : c ≤ mz
      · simpa [IsMinimalBorder, ApplicablePredecessorsSurvive,
          mem_standardSet_mixedSoclesPQ_iff hb hc hu hv hr,
          mixedPQStandardNat, Normal.predecessor, Normal.wrappedXPredecessor,
          Normal.yPredecessor, Normal.zPredecessor, hx, hx0, hby, hcz]
          using harith
      · simpa [IsMinimalBorder, ApplicablePredecessorsSurvive,
          mem_standardSet_mixedSoclesPQ_iff hb hc hu hv hr,
          mixedPQStandardNat, Normal.predecessor, Normal.yPredecessor,
          Normal.zPredecessor, hx, hx0, hby, hcz] using harith
    · simpa [IsMinimalBorder, ApplicablePredecessorsSurvive,
        mem_standardSet_mixedSoclesPQ_iff hb hc hu hv hr,
        mixedPQStandardNat, Normal.predecessor, Normal.yPredecessor,
        Normal.zPredecessor, hx, hx0, hby] using harith

name: P23.OneTie.mixedBorderPQ_card
statement:
theorem mixedBorderPQ_card
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hc : 1 ≤ c)
    (hu : b ≤ u) (hv : c ≤ v) (hr : r < a - 1) :
    (borderFinset
      (mixedSoclesPQ (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) r u v hr)).card =
      3 + 2 * indicator (r + 1 < a - 1) + indicator (1 < b) +
        indicator (1 < c) + indicator (b < u ∧ c < v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mixedBorderPQ_exact ha hb hc hu hv hr]
  let s0 : Finset (Normal a b c) := {mixedY u, mixedZ v}
  let s1 := s0 ∪ singletonProofIf (r + 1 < a - 1) (mixedPTimesX r u)
  let s2 := s1 ∪ singletonProofIf (r + 1 < a - 1) (mixedQTimesX r v)
  let s3 := s2 ∪ singletonIf (1 < b) (mixedPTimesY r u hr)
  let s4 := s3 ∪ singletonIf (1 < c) (mixedQTimesZ r v hr)
  have hs0 : s0.card = 2 := by simp [s0, mixedY, mixedZ]
  have h1 : ∀ hh : r + 1 < a - 1,
      mixedPTimesX (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) r u hh ∉ s0 := by
    intro hh; simp [s0, mixedY, mixedZ, mixedPTimesX]
  have hs1 : s1.card = s0.card + indicator (r + 1 < a - 1) :=
    card_union_singletonProofIf s0 _ _ h1
  have h2 : ∀ hh : r + 1 < a - 1,
      mixedQTimesX (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) r v hh ∉ s1 := by
    intro hh; simp [s1, s0, singletonProofIf, mixedY, mixedZ,
      mixedPTimesX, mixedQTimesX]
    split_ifs <;> simp_all <;> omega
  have hs2 : s2.card = s1.card + indicator (r + 1 < a - 1) :=
    card_union_singletonProofIf s1 _ _ h2
  have h3 : 1 < b → mixedPTimesY (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) r u hr ∉ s2 := by
    intro hb1; simp [s2, s1, s0, singletonProofIf, mixedY, mixedZ,
      mixedPTimesX, mixedQTimesX, mixedPTimesY]
    split_ifs <;> simp_all <;> omega
  have hs3 : s3.card = s2.card + indicator (1 < b) :=
    card_union_singletonIf s2 _ _ h3
  have h4 : 1 < c → mixedQTimesZ (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) r v hr ∉ s3 := by
    intro hc1; simp [s3, s2, s1, s0, singletonProofIf, singletonIf,
      mixedY, mixedZ, mixedPTimesX, mixedQTimesX, mixedPTimesY,
      mixedQTimesZ]
    split_ifs <;> simp_all <;> omega
  have hs4 : s4.card = s3.card + indicator (1 < c) :=
    card_union_singletonIf s3 _ _ h4
  have hp : mixedPTimesZ (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) r u hr ∉ s4 := by
    simp [s4, s3, s2, s1, s0, singletonProofIf, singletonIf,
      mixedY, mixedZ, mixedPTimesX, mixedQTimesX, mixedPTimesY,
      mixedQTimesZ, mixedPTimesZ]
    split_ifs <;> simp_all <;> omega
  have hq : mixedQTimesY (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) r v hr ∉ s4 := by
    simp [s4, s3, s2, s1, s0, singletonProofIf, singletonIf,
      mixedY, mixedZ, mixedPTimesX, mixedQTimesX, mixedPTimesY,
      mixedQTimesZ, mixedQTimesY]
    split_ifs <;> simp_all <;> omega
  change (s4 ∪ singletonIf (c < v ∨ (u + 1 - b = 1 ∧ v + 1 - c = 1))
      (mixedPTimesZ r u hr) ∪
      singletonIf (b < u ∨ (u + 1 - b = 1 ∧ v + 1 - c = 1))
        (mixedQTimesY r v hr)).card = _
  by_cases hdu : b < u <;> by_cases hev : c < v
  · have hne : mixedQTimesY (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) r v hr ≠
        mixedPTimesZ r u hr := by
      intro heq
      have hy := congrArg Normal.y heq
      have hz := congrArg Normal.z heq
      simp [mixedPTimesZ, mixedQTimesY] at hy hz
      omega
    have hpafter : mixedPTimesZ (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) r u hr ∉
        insert (mixedQTimesY r v hr) s4 := by
      simp only [Finset.mem_insert, not_or]
      exact ⟨hne.symm, hp⟩
    simp [singletonIf, hdu, hev]
    rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hpafter,
      Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hq, hs4, hs3, hs2, hs1, hs0]
    by_cases hh : r + 1 < a - 1 <;> by_cases hb1 : 1 < b <;>
      by_cases hc1 : 1 < c <;> simp [indicator, hh, hb1, hc1]
  · have hu1 : u + 1 - b ≠ 1 := by omega
    have hv1 : v + 1 - c = 1 := by omega
    simp [singletonIf, hdu, hev, hu1, hv1]
    rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hq, hs4, hs3, hs2, hs1, hs0]
    by_cases hh : r + 1 < a - 1 <;> by_cases hb1 : 1 < b <;>
      by_cases hc1 : 1 < c <;> simp [indicator, hh, hb1, hc1]
  · have hu1 : u + 1 - b = 1 := by omega
    have hv1 : v + 1 - c ≠ 1 := by omega
    simp [singletonIf, hdu, hev, hu1, hv1]
    rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hp, hs4, hs3, hs2, hs1, hs0]
    by_cases hh : r + 1 < a - 1 <;> by_cases hb1 : 1 < b <;>
      by_cases hc1 : 1 < c <;> simp [indicator, hh, hb1, hc1]
  · have hu1 : u + 1 - b = 1 := by omega
    have hv1 : v + 1 - c = 1 := by omega
    have heq : mixedPTimesZ (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) r u hr =
        mixedQTimesY r v hr := by
      ext <;> simp [mixedPTimesZ, mixedQTimesY, hu1, hv1]
    simp [singletonIf, hdu, hev, hu1, hv1, heq]
    rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hq, hs4, hs3, hs2, hs1, hs0]
    by_cases hh : r + 1 < a - 1 <;> by_cases hb1 : 1 < b <;>
      by_cases hc1 : 1 < c <;> simp [indicator, hh, hb1, hc1]

name: P23.OneTie.mixedDominant_card_eq_four_survivors
statement:
theorem mixedDominant_card_eq_four_survivors
    (pair : MixedAddedPair)
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hc : 1 ≤ c)
    (hu : b ≤ u) (hv : c ≤ v) (hr : r < a - 1)
    (hcard : mixedDominantBorderCard (a := a) (b := b) (c := c)
      pair r u v hr = 4) :
    (pair = .YZ ∧ r + 1 = 1 ∧ b = 1 ∧ c = 1) ∨
    (pair = .YQ ∧ c = 1) ∨
    (pair = .ZP ∧ b = 1) ∨
    (pair = .PQ ∧ r + 1 = a - 1 ∧ (1 < u ∨ 1 < v))
proof:
:= by
  cases pair with
  | YZ =>
      simp only [mixedDominantBorderCard] at hcard
      rw [mixedBorderYZ_card ha hb hc hu hv hr] at hcard
      unfold indicator at hcard
      split_ifs at hcard <;> simp_all <;> omega
  | YP =>
      simp only [mixedDominantBorderCard] at hcard
      rw [mixedBorderYP_card ha hb hc hu hv hr] at hcard
      unfold indicator at hcard
      split_ifs at hcard <;> omega
  | YQ =>
      simp only [mixedDominantBorderCard] at hcard
      rw [mixedBorderYQ_card ha hb hc hu hv hr] at hcard
      unfold indicator at hcard
      split_ifs at hcard <;> simp_all <;> omega
  | ZP =>
      simp only [mixedDominantBorderCard] at hcard
      rw [mixedBorderZP_card ha hb hc hu hv hr] at hcard
      unfold indicator at hcard
      split_ifs at hcard <;> simp_all <;> omega
  | ZQ =>
      simp only [mixedDominantBorderCard] at hcard
      rw [mixedBorderZQ_card ha hb hc hu hv hr] at hcard
      unfold indicator at hcard
      split_ifs at hcard <;> omega
  | PQ =>
      simp only [mixedDominantBorderCard] at hcard
      rw [mixedBorderPQ_card ha hb hc hu hv hr] at hcard
      unfold indicator at hcard
      split_ifs at hcard <;> simp_all <;> omega

name: P23.OneTie.pure_y_xz_three_border_roots_exact
statement:
theorem pure_y_xz_three_border_roots_exact (S : Finset (Normal a b 0))
    (hS : S.Nonempty) (hd : IsLiveParameterDomain a b 0)
    (ha : IsRootAntichain S) (B C r v : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r) (hra : r < a)
    (hv : 0 < v) (hvC : v < C) (hbB : b < B)
    (he : borderFinset S = {yAxis B,zAxis C,(⟨r,0,v,hra⟩ : Normal a b 0)}) :
    S = pureYXZRoots B C r v hra
proof:
:= by
  have hb : 0 < b := by rcases hd.2 with hm | hp <;> omega
  have hT : IsRootAntichain (pureYXZRoots (b := b) B C r v hra) := by
    intro p hp q hq hn hdvd
    simp only [pureYXZRoots,Finset.mem_insert,Finset.mem_singleton] at hp hq
    rcases hp with rfl | rfl <;> rcases hq with rfl | rfl
    · exact hn rfl
    · have h := (Normal.exact_divides_iff _ _).mp hdvd
      simp [Normal.DividesCriterion] at h
      omega
    · have h := (Normal.exact_divides_iff _ _).mp hdvd
      simp [Normal.DividesCriterion] at h
      omega
    · exact hn rfl
  apply roots_eq_of_standardSet_eq hd ha hT
  ext p
  rw [standard_iff_no_border_divisor S hS hd,he]
  simp [standardSet,pureYXZRoots,yAxis,zAxis,Normal.exact_divides_iff,Normal.DividesCriterion]
  have := p.x_lt
  omega

name: P23.OneTie.pure_y_xz_three_border_type_le_two
statement:
theorem pure_y_xz_three_border_type_le_two (S : Finset (Normal a b 0))
    (hS : S.Nonempty) (hd : IsLiveParameterDomain a b 0) (hl : IsLiveTie S)
    (ha : IsRootAntichain S) (B C r v : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r) (hra : r < a)
    (hv : 0 < v) (hvC : v < C) (hbB : b < B)
    (he : borderFinset S = {yAxis B,zAxis C,(⟨r,0,v,hra⟩ : Normal a b 0)}) :
    quotientType ℚ S hS hd hl ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hb : 0 < b := by rcases hd.2 with hm | hp <;> omega
  let T : Finset (Normal a b 0) :=
    {⟨a-1,B-1,v-1,by omega⟩,⟨r-1,b-1,C-1,by omega⟩}
  have hs : standardSet S = standardSet T := by
    ext p
    rw [standard_iff_no_border_divisor S hS hd,he]
    simp [standardSet,T,yAxis,zAxis,Normal.exact_divides_iff,Normal.DividesCriterion]
    have := p.x_lt
    omega
  rw [quotientType_eq_rootCard S hS hd hl ha]
  exact (roots_card_le_of_standardSet_eq hd ha hs).trans (by
    simpa [T] using Finset.card_insert_le
      (⟨a-1,B-1,v-1,by omega⟩ : Normal a b 0) {⟨r-1,b-1,C-1,by omega⟩})

name: P23.OneTie.pure_y_xy_three_border_type_le_two
statement:
theorem pure_y_xy_three_border_type_le_two (S : Finset (Normal a b 0))
    (hS : S.Nonempty) (hd : IsLiveParameterDomain a b 0) (hl : IsLiveTie S)
    (ha : IsRootAntichain S) (B C r u : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r) (hra : r < a)
    (hu : 0 < u) (hC : 0 < C) (hbB : b < B)
    (he : borderFinset S = {yAxis B,zAxis C,(⟨r,u,0,hra⟩ : Normal a b 0)}) :
    quotientType ℚ S hS hd hl ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hb : 0 < b := by rcases hd.2 with hm | hp <;> omega
  let E := min B (u+b)
  let V := min B u
  have hE : 0 < E := by dsimp [E]; omega
  have hV : 0 < V := by dsimp [V]; omega
  let T : Finset (Normal a b 0) :=
    {⟨r-1,E-1,C-1,by omega⟩,⟨a-1,V-1,C-1,by omega⟩}
  have hs : standardSet S = standardSet T := by
    ext p
    rw [standard_iff_no_border_divisor S hS hd,he]
    simp [standardSet,T,yAxis,zAxis,Normal.exact_divides_iff,Normal.DividesCriterion]
    have := p.x_lt
    dsimp [E,V] at *
    omega
  rw [quotientType_eq_rootCard S hS hd hl ha]
  exact (roots_card_le_of_standardSet_eq hd ha hs).trans (by
    simpa [T] using Finset.card_insert_le
      (⟨r-1,E-1,C-1,by omega⟩ : Normal a b 0) {⟨a-1,V-1,C-1,by omega⟩})

name: P23.OneTie.pure_two_xy_three_border_type_le_two
statement:
theorem pure_two_xy_three_border_type_le_two (S : Finset (Normal a b 0))

name: P23.OneTie.pureSwapXY_normalize
statement:
theorem pureSwapXY_normalize (p : Raw) :
    pureSwapXY (Normal.normalize a b 0 (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne a)) p) =
    Normal.normalize b a 0 (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne b)) (rawSwapXY p)
proof:
:= by
  have ha := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne a)
  have hb := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne b)
  apply Normal.ext
  · simp [pureSwapXY,rawSwapXY,Normal.raw,Normal.normalize,Nat.add_mul_mod_self_right]
  · simp only [pureSwapXY,rawSwapXY,Normal.raw,Normal.normalize]
    rw [Nat.add_mul_div_right _ _ hb]
    have h := Nat.mod_add_div p.x a
    rw [Nat.mul_comm a (p.x/a)] at h
    simp only [Nat.add_mul]
    omega
  · simp [pureSwapXY,rawSwapXY,Normal.raw,Normal.normalize]

name: P23.OneTie.pureSwapXY_pureSwapXY
statement: @[simp] theorem pureSwapXY_pureSwapXY (p : Normal a b 0) : pureSwapXY (pureSwapXY p) = p
proof:
:= by
  change pureSwapXY (Normal.normalize b a 0 (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne b))
    (rawSwapXY p.raw)) = p
  rw [pureSwapXY_normalize]
  simpa [rawSwapXY,Normal.raw] using Normal.normalize_raw (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne a)) p

name: P23.OneTie.normalEquiv_dvd_iff
statement:
theorem normalEquiv_dvd_iff {a' b' c c' : ℕ} [NeZero a']
    (e : Normal a b c ≃* Normal a' b' c') (p q : Normal a b c) : e p ∣ e q ↔ p ∣ q
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨r,hr⟩
    refine ⟨e.symm r,e.injective ?_⟩
    simpa using hr
  · rintro ⟨r,rfl⟩
    exact ⟨e r,map_mul e p r⟩

name: P23.OneTie.normalEquiv_standard_iff
statement:
theorem normalEquiv_standard_iff {a' b' c c' : ℕ} [NeZero a']
    (e : Normal a b c ≃* Normal a' b' c') (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (p : Normal a b c) :
    e p ∈ standardSet (normalEquivFinset e S) ↔ p ∈ standardSet S
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨q,hq,hd⟩
    obtain ⟨q',hq',rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_map.mp hq
    exact ⟨q',hq',(normalEquiv_dvd_iff e p q').mp hd⟩
  · rintro ⟨q,hq,hd⟩
    exact ⟨e q,Finset.mem_map.mpr ⟨q,hq,rfl⟩,(normalEquiv_dvd_iff e p q).mpr hd⟩

name: P23.OneTie.normalEquiv_border_mem_iff
statement:
theorem normalEquiv_border_mem_iff {a' b' c c' : ℕ} [NeZero a']
    (e : Normal a b c ≃* Normal a' b' c') (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (hS : S.Nonempty) (ha : 2 ≤ a) (ha' : 2 ≤ a') (p : Normal a b c) :
    e p ∈ borderFinset (normalEquivFinset e S) ↔ p ∈ borderFinset S
proof:
:= by
  have hS' : (normalEquivFinset e S).Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨s,hs⟩ := hS
    exact ⟨e s,Finset.mem_map.mpr ⟨s,hs,rfl⟩⟩
  rw [mem_borderFinset_iff hS',mem_borderFinset_iff hS,
    isMinimalBorder_iff_isDivisibilityMinimalKilled _ _ (variableGenerators_ne_one_of_two_le ha'),
    isMinimalBorder_iff_isDivisibilityMinimalKilled _ _ (variableGenerators_ne_one_of_two_le ha)]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hk,hmin⟩
    refine ⟨mt (normalEquiv_standard_iff e S p).mpr hk,?_⟩
    intro q hd hn
    exact (normalEquiv_standard_iff e S q).mp
      (hmin (e q) ((normalEquiv_dvd_iff e q p).mpr hd) (fun hh => hn (e.injective hh)))
  · rintro ⟨hk,hmin⟩
    refine ⟨mt (normalEquiv_standard_iff e S p).mp hk,?_⟩
    intro q hd hn
    have hd' : e.symm q ∣ p := (normalEquiv_dvd_iff e _ p).mp (by simpa using hd)
    have hn' : e.symm q ≠ p := fun hh => hn (by simpa using congrArg e hh)
    simpa using (normalEquiv_standard_iff e S (e.symm q)).mpr (hmin _ hd' hn')

name: P23.OneTie.pureSwapXYBorder
statement:
theorem pureSwapXYBorder (S : Finset (Normal a b 0))
    (hS : S.Nonempty) (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 2 ≤ b) :
    borderFinset (pureSwapXYFinset S) = (borderFinset S).map pureSwapXYMulEquiv.toEmbedding
proof:
:= by
  ext q
  constructor
  · intro hq
    refine Finset.mem_map.mpr ⟨pureSwapXY q,?_,by simp [pureSwapXYMulEquiv]⟩
    exact (normalEquiv_border_mem_iff pureSwapXYMulEquiv S hS ha hb _).mp (by
      simpa [pureSwapXYFinset,pureSwapXYMulEquiv] using hq)
  · rintro hq
    obtain ⟨p,hp,rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_map.mp hq
    exact (normalEquiv_border_mem_iff pureSwapXYMulEquiv S hS ha hb p).mpr hp

name: P23.OneTie.pureSwapXYAntichain
statement:
theorem pureSwapXYAntichain (S : Finset (Normal a b 0)) (ha : IsRootAntichain S) :
    IsRootAntichain (pureSwapXYFinset S)
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp q hq hn hd
  obtain ⟨p',hp',rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_map.mp hp
  obtain ⟨q',hq',rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_map.mp hq
  exact ha p' hp' q' hq' (fun he => hn (he ▸ rfl))
    ((normalEquiv_dvd_iff pureSwapXYMulEquiv p' q').mp hd)

name: P23.OneTie.pureSwapXYLive
statement:
theorem pureSwapXYLive (S : Finset (Normal a b 0))
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 2 ≤ b) (hl : IsLiveTie S) : IsLiveTie (pureSwapXYFinset S)
proof:
:= by
  have ha1 : a ≠ 1 := by omega
  have hb1 : b ≠ 1 := by omega
  have haL : 1 < a := by omega
  have hbL : 1 < b := by omega
  refine ⟨?_,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · simpa [pureSwapXYFinset,pureSwapXYMulEquiv,pureSwapXY,rawSwapXY,Normal.raw,Normal.normalize,
      Normal.yGenerator,Normal.xGenerator,ha1,hb1,Nat.div_eq_of_lt hbL,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hbL] using
      (normalEquiv_standard_iff pureSwapXYMulEquiv S Normal.yGenerator).mpr hl.2.1
  · simpa [pureSwapXYFinset,pureSwapXYMulEquiv,pureSwapXY,rawSwapXY,Normal.raw,Normal.normalize,
      Normal.yGenerator,Normal.xGenerator,ha1,hb1] using
      (normalEquiv_standard_iff pureSwapXYMulEquiv S Normal.xGenerator).mpr hl.1
  · simpa [pureSwapXYFinset,pureSwapXYMulEquiv,pureSwapXY,rawSwapXY,Normal.raw,Normal.normalize,
      Normal.zGenerator] using
      (normalEquiv_standard_iff pureSwapXYMulEquiv S Normal.zGenerator).mpr hl.2.2.1
  · simpa [pureSwapXYFinset,pureSwapXYMulEquiv,pureSwapXY,rawSwapXY,Normal.raw,Normal.normalize,
      liveTiePoint,Nat.div_self (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne b))] using
      (normalEquiv_standard_iff pureSwapXYMulEquiv S liveTiePoint).mpr hl.2.2.2

name: P23.OneTie.pureSwapXYVariablesInTrace
statement:
theorem pureSwapXYVariablesInTrace (S : Finset (Normal a b 0))
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 2 ≤ b) (hl : IsLiveTie S) (hv : VariablesInTrace ℚ S hl) :
    VariablesInTrace ℚ (pureSwapXYFinset S) (pureSwapXYLive S ha hb hl)
proof:
:= by
  have ha1 : a ≠ 1 := by omega
  have hb1 : b ≠ 1 := by omega
  have hbL : 1 < b := by omega
  rcases hv with ⟨hx,hy,hz⟩
  have hx' := directTrace_transport (pureSwapXYDirectEquiv S) hx
  have hy' := directTrace_transport (pureSwapXYDirectEquiv S) hy
  have hz' := directTrace_transport (pureSwapXYDirectEquiv S) hz
  dsimp only [pureSwapXYDirectEquiv] at hx' hy' hz'
  rw [normalModelCongr_X] at hx' hy' hz'
  refine ⟨?_,?_,?_⟩
  · simpa [pureSwapXYMulEquiv,pureSwapXY,rawSwapXY,Normal.raw,Normal.normalize,
      Normal.yGenerator,Normal.xGenerator,ha1,hb1,Nat.div_eq_of_lt hbL,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hbL] using hy'
  · simpa [pureSwapXYMulEquiv,pureSwapXY,rawSwapXY,Normal.raw,Normal.normalize,
      Normal.yGenerator,Normal.xGenerator,ha1,hb1] using hx'
  · simpa [pureSwapXYMulEquiv,pureSwapXY,rawSwapXY,Normal.raw,Normal.normalize,Normal.zGenerator] using hz'

name: P23.OneTie.pureXZ_reoriented_threeBorder
statement:
theorem pureXZ_reoriented_threeBorder (S : Finset (Normal a b 0))
    (P : PureXZThreeBorderData S) (hS : S.Nonempty) (hd : IsLiveParameterDomain a b 0)
    (hl : IsLiveTie S) (ha : IsRootAntichain S) (ht : quotientType ℚ S hS hd hl = 3)
    (hcard : (borderFinset S).card = 3) : Nonempty (PureThreeBorderData (pureSwapXYFinset S))
proof:
:= by
  have hb : 2 ≤ b := by rcases hd.2 with hm | hp <;> omega
  have hS' : (pureSwapXYFinset S).Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨s,hs⟩ := hS
    exact ⟨pureSwapXY s,Finset.mem_map.mpr ⟨s,hs,rfl⟩⟩
  have hd' : IsLiveParameterDomain b a 0 := ⟨hb,Or.inr ⟨hd.1,rfl⟩⟩
  have hl' := pureSwapXYLive S hd.1 hb hl
  have ha' := pureSwapXYAntichain S ha
  have ht' : quotientType ℚ (pureSwapXYFinset S) hS' hd' hl' = 3 := by
    rw [quotientType_eq_rootCard _ _ _ _ ha',pureSwapXYFinset,normalEquivFinset,Finset.card_map]
    exact (quotientType_eq_three_iff S hS hd hl ha).mp ht
  have hcard' : (borderFinset (pureSwapXYFinset S)).card = 3 := by
    rw [pureSwapXYBorder S hS hd.1 hb,Finset.card_map,hcard]
  let U := P.r + P.u/b*a
  have hU : 0 < U := by dsimp [U]; have := P.r_pos; omega
  have hborder : borderFinset (pureSwapXYFinset S) =
      {(⟨P.u%b,U,0,Nat.mod_lt _ (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne b))⟩ : Normal b a 0),
        zAxis P.C,(⟨0,P.s,P.w,Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne b)⟩ : Normal b a 0)} := by
    rw [pureSwapXYBorder S hS hd.1 hb,P.border]
    simp [pureSwapXYMulEquiv,pureSwapXY,rawSwapXY,Normal.raw,Normal.normalize,zAxis,U]
  have hnf : ∀ q ∈ borderFinset (pureSwapXYFinset S), ¬NormalHasFullSupport q := by
    intro q hq
    simp only [hborder,Finset.mem_insert,Finset.mem_singleton] at hq
    rcases hq with rfl | rfl | rfl <;> simp [NormalHasFullSupport,zAxis]
  have hr : 0 < P.u % b := by
    by_contra hn
    have hr0 : P.u % b = 0 := by omega
    have hY : yAxis U ∈ borderFinset (pureSwapXYFinset S) := by
      rw [hborder]
      simp [hr0,yAxis]
    exact pure_three_border_no_y_axis _ hS' hd' hl' ha' ht' hcard' hnf U hY
  refine ⟨⟨P.C,P.u%b,U,P.s,P.w,by have := hd.1; omega,hr,
    Nat.mod_lt _ (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne b)),hU,P.s_pos,?_,P.w_pos,P.w_lt,hborder⟩⟩
  have := P.s_lt
  omega

name: P23.OneTie.mixed_below_upper_direct_arithmetic
statement:
theorem mixed_below_upper_direct_arithmetic
    {u v U V b c : ℕ} (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hc : 1 ≤ c)
    (hu : b ≤ u) (hv : c ≤ v) (hU : U ≤ u) (hV : V ≤ v)
    (ey : u = U + 1 ∧ v ≤ V)
    (ez : V + c = v + 1 ∧ U + b ≤ u) :
    b = 1 ∧ c = 1 ∧ U = u - 1 ∧ V = v
proof:
:= by
  omega

name: P23.OneTie.mixed_below_lower_direct_arithmetic

    (hu : b ≤ u) (hv : c ≤ v)
    (hnw : ¬(b ≤ U ∧ c ≤ V))
    (ey : u + (if 0 < r then b else 0) = U + 1 ∧
      v + (if 0 < r then c else 0) ≤ V)
    (ez : V = v + 1 ∧ U ≤ u) :
    r = 0 ∧ u = b ∧ U = b - 1 ∧ V = v + 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hr : 0 < r <;> simp [hr] at ey <;> omega
