name: P23.OneTie.pure_fibre_of_zero_z_centres
statement:
theorem pure_fibre_of_zero_z_centres
    {S : Finset (Normal a b 0)} (C Y : Normal a b 0)
    (h : CoverHypotheses S)
    (hxC : IsDirectionalCentre S .x C) (hyY : IsDirectionalCentre S .y Y)
    (hCz : C.z = 0) (hYz : Y.z = 0) : IsPureFibreProduct S
proof:
:= by
  have purePower {Q : Normal a b 0} (hQS : Q ∈ S) (hQz : 0 < Q.z) :
      Q.x = 0 ∧ Q.y = 0 := by
    have hQC : Q ≠ C := by intro heq; subst Q; omega
    have hQx : Q.x = 0 := by
      by_cases hlast : C.x = a - 1
      · exact root_x_zero_at_last h.antichain hxC hQS hQC hlast
      · have hbelow : C.x < a - 1 := by have := C.x_lt; omega
        rcases root_shape_below_last h.antichain hxC hQS hQC hbelow with hQu | hQl
        · omega
        · exact hQl.1
    have hQY : Q ≠ Y := by intro heq; subst Q; omega
    have hQy : Q.y = 0 := by
      by_contra hqy
      have ey := h4_y_edge_exact h.antichain hyY hQS hQY (by omega)
      simp [hYz] at ey
      omega
    exact ⟨hQx, hQy⟩
  rcases exists_root_above_of_mem_standardSet h.live_tie.2.2.1 with
    ⟨Z, hZS, hzZ⟩
  have hZz := (Normal.zGenerator_dvd_iff Z).1 hzZ
  have hZpure := purePower hZS hZz
  have hEq : (⟨0, 0, Z.z, Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne a)⟩ : Normal a b 0) = Z := by
    apply Normal.ext <;> simp [hZpure.1, hZpure.2]
  refine ⟨rfl, Z.z, hZz, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa [hEq] using hZS
  · intro R hRS hRZ
    have hRZ' : R ≠ Z := by simpa [hEq] using hRZ
    by_contra hRz0
    have hRz : 0 < R.z := by omega
    have hRpure := purePower hRS hRz
    by_cases hle : R.z ≤ Z.z
    · have hd : R ∣ Z := (Normal.exact_divides_iff R Z).2 (by
        simp [Normal.DividesCriterion, hRpure.1, hRpure.2, hZpure.1, hZpure.2]
        omega)
      exact h.antichain R hRS Z hZS hRZ' hd
    · have hd : Z ∣ R := (Normal.exact_divides_iff Z R).2 (by
        simp [Normal.DividesCriterion, hRpure.1, hRpure.2, hZpure.1, hZpure.2]
        omega)
      exact h.antichain Z hZS R hRS (Ne.symm hRZ') hd

name: P23.OneTie.pure_below_direct_three
statement:
theorem pure_below_direct_three
    (C P R : Normal a b 0) (hCP : C ≠ P) (hCR : C ≠ R) (hPR : P ≠ R)
    (h : CoverHypotheses ({C, P, R} : Finset (Normal a b 0))) (hb : 2 ≤ b)
    (hxC : IsDirectionalCentre ({C, P, R} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) .x C)
    (hyP : IsDirectionalCentre ({C, P, R} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) .y P)
    (hzC : IsDirectionalCentre ({C, P, R} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) .z C)
    (hbelow : C.x < a - 1) :
    BaseCoverShape ({C, P, R} : Finset (Normal a b 0))
proof:
:= by
  have hCS : C ∈ ({C, P, R} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) := by simp
  have hPS : P ∈ ({C, P, R} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) := by simp
  have hRS : R ∈ ({C, P, R} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) := by simp
  have hbnd := below_last_live_bounds h hxC hbelow
  have ey := h4_y_edge_exact h.antichain hyP hCS hCP (by omega)
  rcases root_shape_below_last h.antichain hxC hPS (Ne.symm hCP) hbelow with hPu | hPl
  · have hnPC : ¬Normal.DividesCriterion P C := by
      intro hd
      exact (h.antichain P hPS C hCS (Ne.symm hCP))
        ((Normal.exact_divides_iff P C).2 hd)
    have hPz : P.z = C.z := by
      simp [Normal.DividesCriterion, hPu.1] at hnPC
      omega
    by_cases hCz0 : C.z = 0
    · have hPz0 : P.z = 0 := by omega
      rcases exists_root_above_of_mem_standardSet h.live_tie.2.2.1 with
        ⟨Q, hQS, hzQ⟩
      have hQmem : Q = C ∨ Q = P ∨ Q = R := by simpa using hQS
      have hQz := (Normal.zGenerator_dvd_iff Q).1 hzQ
      have hRz : 0 < R.z := by
        rcases hQmem with hQC | hQP | hQR
        · rw [hQC] at hQz
          omega
        · rw [hQP] at hQz
          omega
        · simpa [hQR] using hQz
      have hRx : R.x = 0 := by
        rcases root_shape_below_last h.antichain hxC hRS (Ne.symm hCR) hbelow with hRu | hRl
        · omega
        · exact hRl.1
      have hRy : R.y = 0 := by
        by_contra hry
        have eyR := h4_y_edge_exact h.antichain hyP hRS (Ne.symm hPR) (by omega)
        simp [hRx, hPu.1, hPz0] at eyR
        omega
      refine BaseCoverShape.pureFibreProduct ?_
      refine ⟨rfl, R.z, hRz, ?_, ?_⟩
      · have hZR : (⟨0, 0, R.z, by omega⟩ : Normal a b 0) = R := by
          apply Normal.ext <;> simp [hRx, hRy]
        simp [hZR]
      · intro Q hQS hQR
        have hQmem : Q = C ∨ Q = P ∨ Q = R := by simpa using hQS
        rcases hQmem with rfl | rfl | rfl
        · exact hCz0
        · exact hPz0
        · exact False.elim (hQR (by apply Normal.ext <;> simp [hRx, hRy]))
    · have ez := h4_z_edge_exact h.antichain hzC hPS (Ne.symm hCP) (by omega)
      simp [hPu.1, hPz] at ez
  · have hPx0 : P.x = 0 := by
      by_cases hr : 0 < C.x <;> simp [hPl.1, hr] at ey <;> omega
    have hnw : ¬b ≤ P.y := by simpa [hPx0] using hPl.2
    have har := pure_below_lower_direct_arithmetic hb hbnd.1 hnw
      (by simpa [hPl.1] using ey)
      (by
        have hPz : 0 < P.z := by
          by_contra hpz
          have hnPC : ¬Normal.DividesCriterion P C := by
            intro hd
            exact (h.antichain P hPS C hCS (Ne.symm hCP))
              ((Normal.exact_divides_iff P C).2 hd)
          simp [Normal.DividesCriterion, hPx0] at hnPC
          omega
        simpa [hPl.1] using
          h4_z_edge_exact h.antichain hzC hPS (Ne.symm hCP) hPz)
    have hCx : C.x = 0 := har.1
    have hCy : C.y = b := har.2.1
    have hPy : P.y = b - 1 := har.2.2.1
    have hPz : P.z = C.z + 1 := har.2.2.2
    have hnRC : ¬Normal.DividesCriterion R C := by
      intro hd
      exact (h.antichain R hRS C hCS (Ne.symm hCR))
        ((Normal.exact_divides_iff R C).2 hd)
    have hnRP : ¬Normal.DividesCriterion R P := by
      intro hd
      exact (h.antichain R hRS P hPS (Ne.symm hPR))
        ((Normal.exact_divides_iff R P).2 hd)
    exfalso
    rcases root_shape_below_last h.antichain hxC hRS (Ne.symm hCR) hbelow with hRu | hRl
    · by_cases hRy0 : R.y = 0
      · by_cases hRz0 : R.z = 0
        · simp [Normal.DividesCriterion, hCx, hCy, hRu.1, hRy0, hRz0] at hnRC
        · have ezR := h4_z_edge_exact h.antichain hzC hRS (Ne.symm hCR) (by omega)
          simp [hRu.1, hCx] at ezR
          omega
      · have eyR := h4_y_edge_exact h.antichain hyP hRS (Ne.symm hPR) (by omega)
        simp [hRu.1, hPx0, hPy] at eyR
        omega
    · by_cases hRy0 : R.y = 0
      · by_cases hRz0 : R.z = 0
        · simp [Normal.DividesCriterion, hCx, hCy, hRl.1, hRy0, hRz0] at hnRC
        · have ezR := h4_z_edge_exact h.antichain hzC hRS (Ne.symm hCR) (by omega)
          simp [hRl.1, hCx] at ezR
          simp [Normal.DividesCriterion, hPx0, hPy, hPz, hRl.1, hRy0] at hnRP
          omega
      · have eyR := h4_y_edge_exact h.antichain hyP hRS (Ne.symm hPR) (by omega)
        simp [hRl.1, hPx0, hPy] at eyR
        have hnwR := hRl.2
        simp at hnwR
        omega

name: P23.OneTie.pure_last_direct_three
statement:
theorem pure_last_direct_three
    (C P R : Normal a b 0) (hCP : C ≠ P) (hCR : C ≠ R) (hPR : P ≠ R)
    (h : CoverHypotheses ({C, P, R} : Finset (Normal a b 0))) (hb : 2 ≤ b)
    (hxC : IsDirectionalCentre ({C, P, R} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) .x C)
    (hyP : IsDirectionalCentre ({C, P, R} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) .y P)
    (hzC : IsDirectionalCentre ({C, P, R} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) .z C)
    (hlast : C.x = a - 1) :
    BaseCoverShape ({C, P, R} : Finset (Normal a b 0))
proof:
:= by
  have ha := h.a_ge_two
  have hCS : C ∈ ({C, P, R} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) := by simp
  have hPS : P ∈ ({C, P, R} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) := by simp
  have hRS : R ∈ ({C, P, R} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) := by simp
  have hxP := root_x_zero_at_last h.antichain hxC hPS (Ne.symm hCP) hlast
  have hxR := root_x_zero_at_last h.antichain hxC hRS (Ne.symm hCR) hlast
  by_cases hCy0 : C.y = 0
  · have hCz : 0 < C.z := by
      by_contra hcz
      have hCz0 : C.z = 0 := by omega
      rcases exists_root_above_of_mem_standardSet h.live_tie.2.2.2 with
        ⟨Q, hQS, htQ⟩
      have hQC : Q ≠ C := by
        intro heq
        subst Q
        have ht := (Normal.exact_divides_iff (liveTiePoint : Normal a b 0) C).1 htQ
        simp [liveTiePoint, Normal.DividesCriterion, hCy0] at ht
        omega
      have hxQ := root_x_zero_at_last h.antichain hxC hQS hQC hlast
      have ht := (Normal.exact_divides_iff (liveTiePoint : Normal a b 0) Q).1 htQ
      have hQy : b ≤ Q.y := by
        simp [liveTiePoint, Normal.DividesCriterion] at ht
        omega
      have hxw := h4_x_edge_wrapped_exact h.antichain hxC hQS hQC hxQ
        hQy
        (by simp)
      have hQz : Q.z = 0 := by omega
      have hQyEq : Q.y = b := by omega
      have hCQ : Normal.DividesCriterion C Q := by
        simp [Normal.DividesCriterion, hCy0, hCz0, hQz, hQyEq]
      exact (h.antichain C hCS Q hQS (Ne.symm hQC))
        ((Normal.exact_divides_iff C Q).2 hCQ)
    rcases exists_root_above_of_mem_standardSet h.live_tie.2.2.2 with
      ⟨Q, hQS, htQ⟩
    have hQC : Q ≠ C := by
      intro heq
      subst Q
      have ht := (Normal.exact_divides_iff (liveTiePoint : Normal a b 0) C).1 htQ
      simp [liveTiePoint, Normal.DividesCriterion, hCy0] at ht
      omega
    have hxQ := root_x_zero_at_last h.antichain hxC hQS hQC hlast
    have ht := (Normal.exact_divides_iff (liveTiePoint : Normal a b 0) Q).1 htQ
    have hQy : b ≤ Q.y := by
      simp [liveTiePoint, Normal.DividesCriterion] at ht
      omega
    have hxw := h4_x_edge_wrapped_exact h.antichain hxC hQS hQC hxQ hQy (by simp)
    have hQz0 : Q.z = 0 := by
      by_contra hqz
      have ezQ := h4_z_edge_exact h.antichain hzC hQS hQC (by omega)
      simp [hxQ, hlast] at ezQ
      omega
    have hQyEq : Q.y = b := by omega
    have hQmem : Q = C ∨ Q = P ∨ Q = R := by simpa using hQS
    have hQP : Q = P := by
      rcases hQmem with hQCeq | hQP | hQR
      · exact False.elim (hQC hQCeq)
      · exact hQP
      · exfalso
        rw [hQR] at hQyEq hQz0
        have eyR := h4_y_edge_exact h.antichain hyP hRS (Ne.symm hPR) (by omega)
        have hPC : P.x < C.x := by omega
        have hPyPos : 0 < P.y := by
          simp [hxP, hxR] at eyR
          omega
        have hPz0 : P.z = 0 := by
          by_contra hpz
          have ezP := h4_z_edge_exact h.antichain hzC hPS (Ne.symm hCP) (by omega)
          simp [hPC, show ¬C.x < P.x by omega, hCy0] at ezP
          omega
        have hnPR : ¬Normal.DividesCriterion P R := by
          intro hd
          exact (h.antichain P hPS R hRS hPR)
            ((Normal.exact_divides_iff P R).2 hd)
        simp [hxP, hxR] at eyR
        simp [Normal.DividesCriterion, hxP, hxR, hPz0, hQz0] at hnPR
        omega
    have hPy : P.y = b := by rw [← hQP]; exact hQyEq
    have hPz : P.z = 0 := by rw [← hQP]; exact hQz0
    have hRz : R.z = C.z + 1 := by
      by_cases hrz : R.z = 0
      · by_cases hry : R.y = 0
        · have hnRP : ¬Normal.DividesCriterion R P := by
            intro hd
            exact (h.antichain R hRS P hPS (Ne.symm hPR))
              ((Normal.exact_divides_iff R P).2 hd)
          simp [Normal.DividesCriterion, hxR, hxP, hry, hrz, hPy, hPz] at hnRP
        · have eyR := h4_y_edge_exact h.antichain hyP hRS (Ne.symm hPR) (by omega)
          have hnPR : ¬Normal.DividesCriterion P R := by
            intro hd
            exact (h.antichain P hPS R hRS hPR)
              ((Normal.exact_divides_iff P R).2 hd)
          simp [hxR, hxP, hPy, hPz, hrz, hry] at eyR
          exfalso
          apply hnPR
          simp [Normal.DividesCriterion, hxR, hxP, hPy, hPz, hrz]
          omega
      · have ezR := h4_z_edge_exact h.antichain hzC hRS (Ne.symm hCR) (by omega)
        simp [hxR, hlast] at ezR
        omega
    have hRy : R.y = 0 := by
      have ezR := h4_z_edge_exact h.antichain hzC hRS (Ne.symm hCR) (by omega)
      simp [hxR, hlast] at ezR
      omega
    have hC : C = (⟨a - 1, 0, C.z, by omega⟩ : Normal a b 0) := by
      apply Normal.ext <;> simp [hlast, hCy0]
    have hP : P = (⟨0, b, 0, by omega⟩ : Normal a b 0) := by
      apply Normal.ext <;> simp [hxP, hPy, hPz]
    have hR : R = (⟨0, 0, C.z + 1, by omega⟩ : Normal a b 0) := by
      apply Normal.ext <;> simp [hxR, hRy, hRz]
    have hS : ({C, P, R} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) = p5ZSocles ha C.z := by
      rw [hC, hP, hR]
      rfl
    rw [hS]
    exact BaseCoverShape.p5Z ha hb hCz
  · have hCy : 0 < C.y := by omega
    have ey := h4_y_edge_exact h.antichain hyP hCS hCP hCy
    have hPC : P.x < C.x := by omega
    have hPz0 : P.z = 0 := by
      by_contra hpz
      have ez := h4_z_edge_exact h.antichain hzC hPS (Ne.symm hCP) (by omega)
      simp [hPC, show ¬C.x < P.x by omega] at ey ez
      omega
    have hCz0 : C.z = 0 := by omega
    exact BaseCoverShape.pureFibreProduct
      (pure_fibre_of_zero_z_centres C P h hxC hyP hCz0 hPz0)

name: P23.OneTie.pure_reflected_three
statement:
theorem pure_reflected_three
    (C Z R : Normal a b 0) (hCZ : C ≠ Z) (hCR : C ≠ R) (hZR : Z ≠ R)
    (h : CoverHypotheses ({C, Z, R} : Finset (Normal a b 0))) (hb : 2 ≤ b)
    (hxC : IsDirectionalCentre ({C, Z, R} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) .x C)
    (hyC : IsDirectionalCentre ({C, Z, R} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) .y C)
    (hzZ : IsDirectionalCentre ({C, Z, R} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) .z Z) :
    BaseCoverShape ({C, Z, R} : Finset (Normal a b 0))
proof:
:= by
  have hCS : C ∈ ({C, Z, R} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) := by simp
  by_cases hCz0 : C.z = 0
  · exact BaseCoverShape.pureFibreProduct
      (pure_fibre_of_zero_z_centres C C h hxC hyC hCz0 hCz0)
  · have hCz : 0 < C.z := by omega
    have ez := h4_z_edge_exact h.antichain hzZ hCS hCZ hCz
    have hZS : Z ∈ ({C, Z, R} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) := by simp
    have hZy : 0 < Z.y := by
      by_cases hlast : C.x = a - 1
      · have hxZ := root_x_zero_at_last h.antichain hxC hZS (Ne.symm hCZ) hlast
        have hZC : Z.x < C.x := by have := h.a_ge_two; omega
        simp [hZC] at ez
        omega
      · have hbelow : C.x < a - 1 := by have := C.x_lt; omega
        have hbnd := below_last_live_bounds h hxC hbelow
        rcases root_shape_below_last h.antichain hxC hZS (Ne.symm hCZ) hbelow with hZu | hZl
        · simp [hZu.1] at ez
          omega
        · by_cases hCx0 : C.x = 0
          · have hnw := hZl.2
            simp [hZl.1, hCx0] at ez hnw
            omega
          · simp [hZl.1, show Z.x < C.x by omega] at ez
            omega
    have ey := h4_y_edge_exact h.antichain hyC hZS (Ne.symm hCZ) hZy
    have hxne : Z.x ≠ C.x := by
      intro hxeq
      by_cases hlast : C.x = a - 1
      · have hxZ := root_x_zero_at_last h.antichain hxC hZS (Ne.symm hCZ) hlast
        have := h.a_ge_two
        omega
      · have hbelow : C.x < a - 1 := by have := C.x_lt; omega
        have hbnd := below_last_live_bounds h hxC hbelow
        rcases root_shape_below_last h.antichain hxC hZS (Ne.symm hCZ) hbelow with hZu | hZl
        · omega
        · have hnw := hZl.2
          simp [hZl.1, hxeq] at ez hnw
          omega
    by_cases hZC : Z.x < C.x <;> by_cases hCZx : C.x < Z.x <;>
      simp [hZC, hCZx] at ey ez <;> omega

name: P23.OneTie.pure_last_common_three
statement:
theorem pure_last_common_three
    (C P R : Normal a b 0) (hCP : C ≠ P) (hCR : C ≠ R) (hPR : P ≠ R)
    (h : CoverHypotheses ({C, P, R} : Finset (Normal a b 0))) (hb : 2 ≤ b)
    (hxC : IsDirectionalCentre ({C, P, R} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) .x C)
    (hyP : IsDirectionalCentre ({C, P, R} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) .y P)
    (hzP : IsDirectionalCentre ({C, P, R} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) .z P)
    (hlast : C.x = a - 1) :
    BaseCoverShape ({C, P, R} : Finset (Normal a b 0))
proof:
:= by
  have hCS : C ∈ ({C, P, R} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) := by simp
  have hPS : P ∈ ({C, P, R} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) := by simp
  have hRS : R ∈ ({C, P, R} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) := by simp
  have hxP := root_x_zero_at_last h.antichain hxC hPS (Ne.symm hCP) hlast
  have hxR := root_x_zero_at_last h.antichain hxC hRS (Ne.symm hCR) hlast
  have hPC : P.x < C.x := by have := h.a_ge_two; omega
  by_cases hCz0 : C.z = 0
  · have hCy : 0 < C.y := by
      by_contra hcy
      have hCy0 : C.y = 0 := by omega
      rcases exists_root_above_of_mem_standardSet h.live_tie.2.2.2 with
        ⟨Q, hQS, htQ⟩
      have hQC : Q ≠ C := by
        intro heq
        subst Q
        have ht := (Normal.exact_divides_iff (liveTiePoint : Normal a b 0) C).1 htQ
        simp [liveTiePoint, Normal.DividesCriterion, hCy0] at ht
        omega
      have hxQ := root_x_zero_at_last h.antichain hxC hQS hQC hlast
      have ht := (Normal.exact_divides_iff (liveTiePoint : Normal a b 0) Q).1 htQ
      simp [liveTiePoint, Normal.DividesCriterion] at ht
      have hxw := h4_x_edge_wrapped_exact h.antichain hxC hQS hQC hxQ
        (by omega) (by simp)
      have hCQ : Normal.DividesCriterion C Q := by
        simp [Normal.DividesCriterion, hCy0, hCz0]
        omega
      exact (h.antichain C hCS Q hQS (Ne.symm hQC))
        ((Normal.exact_divides_iff C Q).2 hCQ)
    have ey := h4_y_edge_exact h.antichain hyP hCS hCP hCy
    have hPy : P.y = C.y + b - 1 := by simp [hPC] at ey; omega
    have hPz0 : P.z = 0 := by
      have hxw := h4_x_edge_wrapped_exact h.antichain hxC hPS (Ne.symm hCP)
        hxP (by omega) (by simp)
      omega
    exact BaseCoverShape.pureFibreProduct
      (pure_fibre_of_zero_z_centres C P h hxC hyP hCz0 hPz0)
  · have hCz : 0 < C.z := by omega
    by_cases hCy0 : C.y = 0
    · have ez := h4_z_edge_exact h.antichain hzP hCS hCP hCz
      have hPyLower : b ≤ P.y := by simp [hPC, hCy0] at ez; omega
      have hxw := h4_x_edge_wrapped_exact h.antichain hxC hPS (Ne.symm hCP)
        hxP hPyLower (by simp)
      have hPy : P.y = b := by omega
      have hPz : P.z = C.z - 1 := by simp [hPC] at ez; omega
      by_cases hRz0 : R.z = 0
      · by_cases hRy0 : R.y = 0
        · have hnRC : ¬Normal.DividesCriterion R C := by
            intro hd
            exact (h.antichain R hRS C hCS (Ne.symm hCR))
              ((Normal.exact_divides_iff R C).2 hd)
          simp [Normal.DividesCriterion, hxR, hRy0, hRz0, hCy0] at hnRC
        · have eyR := h4_y_edge_exact h.antichain hyP hRS (Ne.symm hPR) (by omega)
          simp [hxR, hxP, hPy] at eyR
          have hxw := h4_x_edge_wrapped_exact h.antichain hxC hRS (Ne.symm hCR)
            hxR (by omega) (by simp)
          omega
      · have ezR := h4_z_edge_exact h.antichain hzP hRS (Ne.symm hPR) (by omega)
        have hRz : R.z = C.z := by simp [hxR, hxP, hPz] at ezR; omega
        have hRy0 : R.y = 0 := by
          by_contra hry
          have eyR := h4_y_edge_exact h.antichain hyP hRS (Ne.symm hPR) (by omega)
          simp [hxR, hxP, hPy] at eyR ezR
          omega
        have hnRC : ¬Normal.DividesCriterion R C := by
          intro hd
          exact (h.antichain R hRS C hCS (Ne.symm hCR))
            ((Normal.exact_divides_iff R C).2 hd)
        simp [Normal.DividesCriterion, hxR, hRy0, hRz, hCy0] at hnRC
    · have hCy : 0 < C.y := by omega
      have ey := h4_y_edge_exact h.antichain hyP hCS hCP hCy
      have ez := h4_z_edge_exact h.antichain hzP hCS hCP hCz
      simp [hPC] at ey ez
      omega

name: P23.OneTie.pure_last_yzero_distinct_top
statement:
theorem pure_last_yzero_distinct_top
    (C Y Z : Normal a b 0) (hCY : C ≠ Y) (hCZ : C ≠ Z) (hYZ : Y ≠ Z)
    (h : CoverHypotheses ({C, Y, Z} : Finset (Normal a b 0))) (hb : 2 ≤ b)
    (hxC : IsDirectionalCentre ({C, Y, Z} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) .x C)
    (hyY : IsDirectionalCentre ({C, Y, Z} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) .y Y)
    (hzZ : IsDirectionalCentre ({C, Y, Z} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) .z Z)
    (hlast : C.x = a - 1) (hCy : C.y = 0) (hCz : 0 < C.z) :
    BaseCoverShape ({C, Y, Z} : Finset (Normal a b 0))
proof:
:= by
  have hCS : C ∈ ({C, Y, Z} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) := by simp
  have hYS : Y ∈ ({C, Y, Z} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) := by simp
  have hZS : Z ∈ ({C, Y, Z} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) := by simp
  have hxY := root_x_zero_at_last h.antichain hxC hYS (Ne.symm hCY) hlast
  have hxZ := root_x_zero_at_last h.antichain hxC hZS (Ne.symm hCZ) hlast
  have hZC : Z.x < C.x := by have := h.a_ge_two; omega
  have ezC := h4_z_edge_exact h.antichain hzZ hCS hCZ hCz
  have hZz : Z.z = C.z - 1 := by simp [hZC] at ezC; omega
  have hZyLower : b ≤ Z.y := by simp [hZC, hCy] at ezC; omega
  have hxwZ := h4_x_edge_wrapped_exact h.antichain hxC hZS (Ne.symm hCZ)
    hxZ hZyLower (by simp)
  have hZy : Z.y = b := by omega
  have eyZ := h4_y_edge_exact h.antichain hyY hZS (Ne.symm hYZ) (by omega)
  have hYy : Y.y = b - 1 := by simp [hxY, hxZ, hZy] at eyZ; omega
  have hYzPos : 0 < Y.z := by
    by_contra hyz
    have hnYZ : ¬Normal.DividesCriterion Y Z := by
      intro hd
      exact (h.antichain Y hYS Z hZS hYZ)
        ((Normal.exact_divides_iff Y Z).2 hd)
    simp [Normal.DividesCriterion, hxY, hxZ, hYy, hZy] at hnYZ eyZ
    omega
  have ezY := h4_z_edge_exact h.antichain hzZ hYS hYZ hYzPos
  have hYz : Y.z = C.z := by simp [hxY, hxZ, hZz] at ezY; omega
  let T : Normal a b 0 := ⟨0, b, C.z, Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne a)⟩
  have hpredX : Normal.predecessor .x T = some C := by
    rw [Normal.predecessor_x_wrapped T (by rfl) (by simp [T]) (by simp [T])]
    congr 1
    apply Normal.ext <;> simp [Normal.wrappedXPredecessor, T, hlast, hCy]
  have hpredY : Normal.predecessor .y T = some Y := by
    rw [Normal.predecessor_y_of_pos T (by simp [T]; omega)]
    congr 1
    apply Normal.ext <;> simp [Normal.yPredecessor, T, hxY, hYy, hYz]
  have hpredZ : Normal.predecessor .z T = some Z := by
    rw [Normal.predecessor_z_of_pos T (by simp [T]; omega)]
    congr 1
    apply Normal.ext <;> simp [Normal.zPredecessor, T, hxZ, hZy, hZz]
  have hroots : predecessorRootFinset T = ({C, Y, Z} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) := by
    ext q
    rw [mem_predecessorRootFinset_iff]
    simp [hpredX, hpredY, hpredZ, eq_comm]
  have hproper : ∀ q ∈ predecessorRootFinset T, ¬T ∣ q := by
    intro q hq hTq
    rw [hroots] at hq
    have hqmem : q = C ∨ q = Y ∨ q = Z := by simpa using hq
    have hd := (Normal.exact_divides_iff T q).1 hTq
    rcases hqmem with rfl | rfl | rfl <;>
      simp [Normal.DividesCriterion, T, hlast, hCy, hxY, hxZ, hYy, hYz,
        hZy, hZz] at hd <;> omega
  apply BaseCoverShape.topDeletion
  refine ⟨T, ?_, hroots.symm, ?_⟩
  · simp [hCY, hCZ, hYZ]
  · rw [← hroots]
    exact standardSet_predecessorRootFinset T hproper

name: P23.OneTie.pure_distinct_three
statement:
theorem pure_distinct_three
    (C Y Z : Normal a b 0) (hCY : C ≠ Y) (hCZ : C ≠ Z) (hYZ : Y ≠ Z)
    (h : CoverHypotheses ({C, Y, Z} : Finset (Normal a b 0))) (hb : 2 ≤ b)
    (hxC : IsDirectionalCentre ({C, Y, Z} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) .x C)
    (hyY : IsDirectionalCentre ({C, Y, Z} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) .y Y)
    (hzZ : IsDirectionalCentre ({C, Y, Z} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) .z Z) :
    BaseCoverShape ({C, Y, Z} : Finset (Normal a b 0))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hlast : C.x = a - 1
  · by_cases hCz0 : C.z = 0
    · have hCS : C ∈ ({C, Y, Z} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) := by simp
      have hYS : Y ∈ ({C, Y, Z} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) := by simp
      have hxY := root_x_zero_at_last h.antichain hxC hYS (Ne.symm hCY) hlast
      have hCy : 0 < C.y := by
        by_contra hcy
        have hCy0 : C.y = 0 := by omega
        rcases exists_root_above_of_mem_standardSet h.live_tie.2.2.2 with
          ⟨Q, hQS, htQ⟩
        have hQC : Q ≠ C := by
          intro heq
          subst Q
          have ht := (Normal.exact_divides_iff (liveTiePoint : Normal a b 0) C).1 htQ
          simp [liveTiePoint, Normal.DividesCriterion, hCy0] at ht
          omega
        have hxQ := root_x_zero_at_last h.antichain hxC hQS hQC hlast
        have ht := (Normal.exact_divides_iff (liveTiePoint : Normal a b 0) Q).1 htQ
        simp [liveTiePoint, Normal.DividesCriterion] at ht
        have hxw := h4_x_edge_wrapped_exact h.antichain hxC hQS hQC hxQ
          (by omega) (by simp)
        have hCQ : Normal.DividesCriterion C Q := by
          simp [Normal.DividesCriterion, hCy0, hCz0]
          omega
        exact (h.antichain C hCS Q hQS (Ne.symm hQC))
          ((Normal.exact_divides_iff C Q).2 hCQ)
      have ey := h4_y_edge_exact h.antichain hyY hCS hCY hCy
      have hYyLower : b ≤ Y.y := by
        have hYC : Y.x < C.x := by have := h.a_ge_two; omega
        simp [hYC] at ey
        omega
      have hxw := h4_x_edge_wrapped_exact h.antichain hxC hYS (Ne.symm hCY)
        hxY hYyLower (by simp)
      have hYz0 : Y.z = 0 := by omega
      exact BaseCoverShape.pureFibreProduct
        (pure_fibre_of_zero_z_centres C Y h hxC hyY hCz0 hYz0)
    · have hCz : 0 < C.z := by omega
      by_cases hCy0 : C.y = 0
      · exact pure_last_yzero_distinct_top C Y Z hCY hCZ hYZ h hb hxC hyY hzZ
          hlast hCy0 hCz
      · exact mixed_last_distinct_centres_top C Y Z hCY hCZ hYZ h (by omega)
          (by omega) hxC hyY hzZ hlast (by omega) hCz
  · have hbelow : C.x < a - 1 := by have := C.x_lt; omega
    have hbnd := below_last_live_bounds h hxC hbelow
    by_cases hCz0 : C.z = 0
    · have hCS : C ∈ ({C, Y, Z} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) := by simp
      have hYS : Y ∈ ({C, Y, Z} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) := by simp
      have ey := h4_y_edge_exact h.antichain hyY hCS hCY (by omega)
      rcases root_shape_below_last h.antichain hxC hYS (Ne.symm hCY) hbelow with hYu | hYl
      · have hnYC : ¬Normal.DividesCriterion Y C := by
          intro hd
          exact (h.antichain Y hYS C hCS (Ne.symm hCY))
            ((Normal.exact_divides_iff Y C).2 hd)
        have hYz0 : Y.z = 0 := by
          simp [Normal.DividesCriterion, hYu.1] at hnYC ey
          omega
        exact BaseCoverShape.pureFibreProduct
          (pure_fibre_of_zero_z_centres C Y h hxC hyY hCz0 hYz0)
      · have hCx0 : C.x = 0 := by
          by_contra hcx
          have hCxPos : 0 < C.x := by omega
          simp [hYl.1, hCxPos] at ey
          exact False.elim (hYl.2 ⟨by omega, by simp⟩)
        have hYy : Y.y = b - 1 := by simp [hYl.1, hCx0] at ey; omega
        by_cases hYz0 : Y.z = 0
        · exact BaseCoverShape.pureFibreProduct
            (pure_fibre_of_zero_z_centres C Y h hxC hyY hCz0 hYz0)
        · have hYz : 0 < Y.z := by omega
          have hZS : Z ∈ ({C, Y, Z} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) := by simp
          have ezY := h4_z_edge_exact h.antichain hzZ hYS hYZ hYz
          rcases root_shape_below_last h.antichain hxC hZS (Ne.symm hCZ) hbelow with hZu | hZl
          · have hZz0 : Z.z = 0 := by omega
            have hZy : 0 < Z.y := by simp [hZu.1, hYl.1] at ezY; omega
            have eyZ := h4_y_edge_exact h.antichain hyY hZS (Ne.symm hYZ) hZy
            simp [hZu.1, hYl.1, hYy, hZz0] at eyZ ezY
            omega
          · have hZy : 0 < Z.y := by simp [hZl.1, hYl.1] at ezY; omega
            have eyZ := h4_y_edge_exact h.antichain hyY hZS (Ne.symm hYZ) hZy
            have hnw := hZl.2
            simp [hZl.1, hYl.1, hYy] at eyZ ezY hnw
            omega
    · exact mixed_below_distinct_centres_top C Y Z hCY hCZ hYZ h (by omega)
        (by omega) hxC hyY hzZ hbelow (by omega) (by omega)

name: P23.OneTie.pure_below_common_three
statement:
theorem pure_below_common_three
    (C P R : Normal a b 0) (hCP : C ≠ P) (hCR : C ≠ R) (hPR : P ≠ R)
    (h : CoverHypotheses ({C, P, R} : Finset (Normal a b 0))) (hb : 2 ≤ b)
    (hxC : IsDirectionalCentre ({C, P, R} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) .x C)
    (hyP : IsDirectionalCentre ({C, P, R} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) .y P)
    (hzP : IsDirectionalCentre ({C, P, R} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) .z P)
    (hbelow : C.x < a - 1) :
    BaseCoverShape ({C, P, R} : Finset (Normal a b 0))
proof:
:= by
  have ha := h.a_ge_two
  have hCS : C ∈ ({C, P, R} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) := by simp
  have hPS : P ∈ ({C, P, R} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) := by simp
  have hRS : R ∈ ({C, P, R} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) := by simp
  have hbnd := below_last_live_bounds h hxC hbelow
  have ey := h4_y_edge_exact h.antichain hyP hCS hCP (by omega)
  rcases root_shape_below_last h.antichain hxC hPS (Ne.symm hCP) hbelow with hPu | hPl
  · have hCz0 : C.z = 0 := by
      by_contra hz0
      have ez := h4_z_edge_exact h.antichain hzP hCS hCP (by omega)
      simp [hPu.1] at ey ez
      omega
    have hPz0 : P.z = 0 := by omega
    rcases exists_root_above_of_mem_standardSet h.live_tie.2.2.1 with
      ⟨Q, hQS, hzQ⟩
    have hQmem : Q = C ∨ Q = P ∨ Q = R := by simpa using hQS
    rcases hQmem with hQC | hQP | hQR
    · subst Q
      exact False.elim (by have := (Normal.zGenerator_dvd_iff C).1 hzQ; omega)
    · subst Q
      exact False.elim (by have := (Normal.zGenerator_dvd_iff P).1 hzQ; omega)
    · subst Q
      have hRz := (Normal.zGenerator_dvd_iff R).1 hzQ
      have ezR := h4_z_edge_exact h.antichain hzP hRS (Ne.symm hPR) hRz
      have hRx0 : R.x = 0 := by
        rcases root_shape_below_last h.antichain hxC hRS (Ne.symm hCR) hbelow with hRu | hRl
        · omega
        · exact hRl.1
      by_cases hRy0 : R.y = 0
      · refine BaseCoverShape.pureFibreProduct ?_
        refine ⟨rfl, R.z, hRz, ?_, ?_⟩
        · have hReq :
              (⟨0, 0, R.z, by omega⟩ : Normal a b 0) = R := by
              apply Normal.ext <;> simp [hRx0, hRy0]
          simpa [hReq]
        · intro Q hQS hQne
          have hQmem : Q = C ∨ Q = P ∨ Q = R := by simpa using hQS
          rcases hQmem with rfl | rfl | rfl
          · exact hCz0
          · exact hPz0
          · exact False.elim (hQne (by apply Normal.ext <;> simp [hRx0, hRy0]))
      · have eyR := h4_y_edge_exact h.antichain hyP hRS (Ne.symm hPR) (by omega)
        simp [hPu.1, hRx0, hPz0] at ey eyR ezR
        omega
  · have hPx0 : P.x = 0 := by
      by_cases hr : 0 < C.x <;> simp [hPl.1, hr] at ey <;> omega
    have hnw : ¬b ≤ P.y := by simpa [hPx0] using hPl.2
    have hCx0 : C.x = 0 := by
      by_contra hc0
      have hCyB : b ≤ C.y := hbnd.1
      have hCxPos : 0 < C.x := by omega
      simp [hPx0, hCxPos] at ey
      omega
    have hCy : C.y = b := by
      simp [hPx0, hCx0] at ey
      omega
    have hPy : P.y = b - 1 := by simp [hPx0, hCx0] at ey; omega
    have hCz0 : C.z = 0 := by
      by_contra hz0
      have ez := h4_z_edge_exact h.antichain hzP hCS hCP (by omega)
      simp [hPx0, hCx0] at ez ey
      omega
    have hPzp : 0 < P.z := by
      by_contra hp0
      have hnPC : ¬Normal.DividesCriterion P C := by
        intro hd
        exact (h.antichain P hPS C hCS hCP.symm)
          ((Normal.exact_divides_iff P C).2 hd)
      simp [Normal.DividesCriterion, hPx0, hCx0, hCy, hPy, hCz0] at hnPC
      omega
    have hRzp : 0 < R.z := by
      by_contra hr0
      rcases root_shape_below_last h.antichain hxC hRS (Ne.symm hCR) hbelow with hRu | hRl
      · by_cases hRy0 : R.y = 0
        · have hnRC : ¬Normal.DividesCriterion R C := by
            intro hd
            exact (h.antichain R hRS C hCS (Ne.symm hCR))
              ((Normal.exact_divides_iff R C).2 hd)
          simp [Normal.DividesCriterion, hRy0, hCz0] at hnRC
          omega
        · have eyR := h4_y_edge_exact h.antichain hyP hRS (Ne.symm hPR) (by omega)
          simp [hRu.1, hPx0, hPy] at eyR
          omega
      · by_cases hRy0 : R.y = 0
        · have hnRC : ¬Normal.DividesCriterion R C := by
            intro hd
            exact (h.antichain R hRS C hCS (Ne.symm hCR))
              ((Normal.exact_divides_iff R C).2 hd)
          simp [Normal.DividesCriterion, hRl.1, hRy0, hCz0] at hnRC
          omega
        · have eyR := h4_y_edge_exact h.antichain hyP hRS (Ne.symm hPR) (by omega)
          simp [hRl.1, hPx0, hPy] at eyR
          have hnRC : ¬Normal.DividesCriterion R C := by
            intro hd
            exact (h.antichain R hRS C hCS (Ne.symm hCR))
              ((Normal.exact_divides_iff R C).2 hd)
          simp [Normal.DividesCriterion, hRl.1, hCx0, hCy, hCz0] at hnRC
          omega
    have ezR := h4_z_edge_exact h.antichain hzP hRS (Ne.symm hPR) hRzp
    have hRx0 : R.x = 0 := by
      rcases root_shape_below_last h.antichain hxC hRS (Ne.symm hCR) hbelow with hRu | hRl
      · by_contra hrx
        simp [hRu.1, hPx0, hPy] at ezR
        omega
      · exact hRl.1
    have hRz : R.z = P.z + 1 := by simp [hRx0, hPx0] at ezR; omega
    have hRy0 : R.y = 0 := by
      by_contra hry
      have eyR := h4_y_edge_exact h.antichain hyP hRS (Ne.symm hPR) (by omega)
      simp [hRx0, hPx0] at eyR ezR
      omega
    have hC : C = (⟨0, b, 0, by omega⟩ : Normal a b 0) := by
      apply Normal.ext <;> simp [hCx0, hCy, hCz0]
    have hP : P = (⟨0, b - 1, P.z, by omega⟩ : Normal a b 0) := by
      apply Normal.ext <;> simp [hPx0, hPy]
    have hR : R = (⟨0, 0, P.z + 1, by omega⟩ : Normal a b 0) := by
      apply Normal.ext <;> simp [hRx0, hRy0, hRz]
    have hS : ({C, P, R} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) = p4ZSocles ha P.z := by
      rw [hC, hP, hR]
      rfl
    rw [hS]
    exact BaseCoverShape.p4Z ha hb hPzp

name: P23.OneTie.h5_pure_three_cover
statement:
theorem h5_pure_three_cover
    (C P R : Normal a b 0) (hCP : C ≠ P) (hCR : C ≠ R) (hPR : P ≠ R)
    (h : CoverHypotheses ({C, P, R} : Finset (Normal a b 0))) (hb : 2 ≤ b)
    (hxC : IsDirectionalCentre ({C, P, R} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) .x C) :
    BaseCoverShape ({C, P, R} : Finset (Normal a b 0))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Y, hy⟩ := h.centres .y
  obtain ⟨Z, hz⟩ := h.centres .z
  have hYm : Y = C ∨ Y = P ∨ Y = R := by simpa using hy.1
  have hZm : Z = C ∨ Z = P ∨ Z = R := by simpa using hz.1
  have directCase (P R : Normal a b 0) (hCP : C ≠ P) (hCR : C ≠ R)
      (hPR : P ≠ R)
      (h' : CoverHypotheses ({C, P, R} : Finset (Normal a b 0)))
      (hx' : IsDirectionalCentre ({C, P, R} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) .x C)
      (hyP : IsDirectionalCentre ({C, P, R} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) .y P)
      (hzC : IsDirectionalCentre ({C, P, R} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) .z C) :
      BaseCoverShape ({C, P, R} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) := by
    by_cases hlast : C.x = a - 1
    · exact pure_last_direct_three C P R hCP hCR hPR h' hb hx' hyP hzC hlast
    · exact pure_below_direct_three C P R hCP hCR hPR h' hb hx' hyP hzC
        (by have := C.x_lt; omega)
  have commonCase (P R : Normal a b 0) (hCP : C ≠ P) (hCR : C ≠ R)
      (hPR : P ≠ R)
      (h' : CoverHypotheses ({C, P, R} : Finset (Normal a b 0)))
      (hx' : IsDirectionalCentre ({C, P, R} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) .x C)
      (hyP : IsDirectionalCentre ({C, P, R} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) .y P)
      (hzP : IsDirectionalCentre ({C, P, R} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) .z P) :
      BaseCoverShape ({C, P, R} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) := by
    by_cases hlast : C.x = a - 1
    · exact pure_last_common_three C P R hCP hCR hPR h' hb hx' hyP hzP hlast
    · exact pure_below_common_three C P R hCP hCR hPR h' hb hx' hyP hzP
        (by have := C.x_lt; omega)
  rcases hYm with hYC | hYP | hYR
  · subst Y
    rcases hZm with hZC | hZP | hZR
    · subst Z
      exact False.elim (directional_centres_not_all_equal h hxC hy hz ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)
    · subst Z
      exact pure_reflected_three C P R hCP hCR hPR h hb hxC hy hz
    · subst Z
      have h' : ({C, R, P} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) = {C, P, R} := by simp [Finset.pair_comm]
      have out := pure_reflected_three C R P hCR hCP (Ne.symm hPR)
        (by simpa [h'] using h) hb (by simpa [h'] using hxC)
        (by simpa [h'] using hy) (by simpa [h'] using hz)
      simpa [h'] using out
  · subst Y
    rcases hZm with hZC | hZP | hZR
    · subst Z
      exact directCase P R hCP hCR hPR h hxC hy hz
    · subst Z
      exact commonCase P R hCP hCR hPR h hxC hy hz
    · subst Z
      exact pure_distinct_three C P R hCP hCR hPR h hb hxC hy hz
  · subst Y
    rcases hZm with hZC | hZP | hZR
    · subst Z
      have h' : ({C, R, P} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) = {C, P, R} := by simp [Finset.pair_comm]
      have out := directCase R P hCR hCP (Ne.symm hPR)
        (by simpa [h'] using h) (by simpa [h'] using hxC)
        (by simpa [h'] using hy) (by simpa [h'] using hz)
      simpa [h'] using out
    · subst Z
      have h' : ({C, R, P} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) = {C, P, R} := by simp [Finset.pair_comm]
      have out := pure_distinct_three C R P hCR hCP (Ne.symm hPR)
        (by simpa [h'] using h) hb (by simpa [h'] using hxC)
        (by simpa [h'] using hy) (by simpa [h'] using hz)
      simpa [h'] using out
    · subst Z
      have h' : ({C, R, P} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) = {C, P, R} := by simp [Finset.pair_comm]
      have out := commonCase R P hCR hCP (Ne.symm hPR)
        (by simpa [h'] using h) (by simpa [h'] using hxC)
        (by simpa [h'] using hy) (by simpa [h'] using hz)
      simpa [h'] using out

name: P23.OneTie.h5_mixed_three_cover
statement:
theorem h5_mixed_three_cover
    (C P R : Normal a b c) (hCP : C ≠ P) (hCR : C ≠ R) (hPR : P ≠ R)
    (h : CoverHypotheses ({C, P, R} : Finset (Normal a b c)))
    (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hc : 1 ≤ c)
    (hxC : IsDirectionalCentre ({C, P, R} : Finset (Normal a b c)) .x C) :
    CoverShape ({C, P, R} : Finset (Normal a b c))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Y, hy⟩ := h.centres .y
  obtain ⟨Z, hz⟩ := h.centres .z
  have hYm : Y = C ∨ Y = P ∨ Y = R := by simpa using hy.1
  have hZm : Z = C ∨ Z = P ∨ Z = R := by simpa using hz.1
  have cornerImpossible : C.x = a - 1 → C.y = 0 → C.z = 0 → False := by
    intro hlast hCy hCz
    rcases exists_root_above_of_mem_standardSet h.live_tie.2.2.2 with
      ⟨Q, hQS, htQ⟩
    have ht := (Normal.exact_divides_iff (liveTiePoint : Normal a b c) Q).1 htQ
    simp [liveTiePoint, Normal.DividesCriterion] at ht
    have hQC : Q ≠ C := by
      intro heq
      subst Q
      omega
    have hxQ := root_x_zero_at_last h.antichain hxC hQS hQC hlast
    have hxw := h4_x_edge_wrapped_exact h.antichain hxC hQS hQC hxQ
      (by omega) (by omega)
    have hCQ : Normal.DividesCriterion C Q := by
      unfold Normal.DividesCriterion
      exact ⟨by omega, by omega, Or.inr ⟨by omega, by omega⟩⟩
    exact (h.antichain C hxC.1 Q hQS (Ne.symm hQC))
      ((Normal.exact_divides_iff C Q).2 hCQ)
  have topCase (Y Z : Normal a b c) (hCY : C ≠ Y) (hCZ : C ≠ Z)
      (hYZ : Y ≠ Z)
      (hx' : IsDirectionalCentre ({C, Y, Z} : Finset (Normal a b c)) .x C)
      (hyY : IsDirectionalCentre ({C, Y, Z} : Finset (Normal a b c)) .y Y)
      (hzZ : IsDirectionalCentre ({C, Y, Z} : Finset (Normal a b c)) .z Z)
      (h' : CoverHypotheses ({C, Y, Z} : Finset (Normal a b c))) :
      CoverShape ({C, Y, Z} : Finset (Normal a b c)) := by
    by_cases hlast : C.x = a - 1
    · by_cases hCy0 : C.y = 0
      · by_cases hCz0 : C.z = 0
        · exact False.elim (cornerImpossible hlast hCy0 hCz0)
        · exact CoverShape.direct (mixed_last_yzero_distinct_centres_top
            C Y Z hCY hCZ hYZ h' hb hc hx' hyY hzZ hlast hCy0 (by omega))
      · by_cases hCz0 : C.z = 0
        · exact mixed_last_zzero_distinct_centres_top
            C Y Z hCY hCZ hYZ h' hb hc hx' hyY hzZ hlast (by omega) hCz0
        · exact CoverShape.direct (mixed_last_distinct_centres_top
            C Y Z hCY hCZ hYZ h' hb (by omega) hx' hyY hzZ hlast (by omega) (by omega))
    · have hbelow : C.x < a - 1 := by have := C.x_lt; omega
      have hbnd := below_last_live_bounds h' hx' hbelow
      exact CoverShape.direct (mixed_below_distinct_centres_top
        C Y Z hCY hCZ hYZ h' hb (by omega) hx' hyY hzZ hbelow
          (by omega) (by omega))
  rcases hYm with hYC | hYP | hYR
  · subst Y
    rcases hZm with hZC | hZP | hZR
    · subst Z
      exact False.elim (directional_centres_not_all_equal h hxC hy hz ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)
    · subst Z
      by_cases hlast : C.x = a - 1
      · exact mixed_last_reflected_three C P R hCP hCR hPR h hb hc hxC hy hz hlast
      · exact mixed_below_reflected_three C P R hCP hCR hPR h hb hc hxC hy hz
          (by have := C.x_lt; omega)
    · subst Z
      have h' : ({C, R, P} : Finset (Normal a b c)) = {C, P, R} := by
        simp [Finset.pair_comm]
      have hh : CoverHypotheses ({C, R, P} : Finset (Normal a b c)) := by simpa [h'] using h
      have hx' : IsDirectionalCentre ({C, R, P} : Finset (Normal a b c)) .x C := by simpa [h'] using hxC
      have hy' : IsDirectionalCentre ({C, R, P} : Finset (Normal a b c)) .y C := by simpa [h'] using hy
      have hz' : IsDirectionalCentre ({C, R, P} : Finset (Normal a b c)) .z R := by simpa [h'] using hz
      have out : CoverShape ({C, R, P} : Finset (Normal a b c)) := by
        by_cases hlast : C.x = a - 1
        · exact mixed_last_reflected_three C R P hCR hCP (Ne.symm hPR) hh hb hc hx' hy' hz' hlast
        · exact mixed_below_reflected_three C R P hCR hCP (Ne.symm hPR) hh hb hc hx' hy' hz'
            (by have := C.x_lt; omega)
      simpa [h'] using out
  · subst Y
    rcases hZm with hZC | hZP | hZR
    · subst Z
      by_cases hlast : C.x = a - 1
      · exact CoverShape.direct (mixed_last_direct_three C P R hCP hCR hPR h hb hc hxC hy hz hlast)
      · exact CoverShape.direct (mixed_below_direct_three C P R hCP hCR hPR h hb hc hxC hy hz
          (by have := C.x_lt; omega))
    · subst Z
      by_cases hlast : C.x = a - 1
      · by_cases hCy0 : C.y = 0
        · exact CoverShape.direct (mixed_last_common_yzero_three
            C P R hCP hCR hPR h hb hc hxC hy hz hlast hCy0)
        · have hCz0 : C.z = 0 := by
            by_contra hz0
            have hCS : C ∈ ({C, P, R} : Finset (Normal a b c)) := by simp
            have hxP := root_x_zero_at_last h.antichain hxC hy.1 (Ne.symm hCP) hlast
            have ey := h4_y_edge_exact h.antichain hy hCS hCP (by omega)
            have ez := h4_z_edge_exact h.antichain hz hCS hCP (by omega)
            simp [hxP, hlast] at ey ez
            omega
          exact mixed_last_common_zzero_three
            C P R hCP hCR hPR h hb hc hxC hy hz hlast hCz0
      · exact False.elim (mixed_below_common_impossible_three C P R hCP h hb hc hxC hy hz
          (by have := C.x_lt; omega))
    · subst Z
      exact topCase P R hCP hCR hPR hxC hy hz h
  · subst Y
    rcases hZm with hZC | hZP | hZR
    · subst Z
      have h' : ({C, R, P} : Finset (Normal a b c)) = {C, P, R} := by simp [Finset.pair_comm]
      have out : CoverShape ({C, R, P} : Finset (Normal a b c)) := by
        by_cases hlast : C.x = a - 1
        · exact CoverShape.direct (mixed_last_direct_three C R P hCR hCP (Ne.symm hPR)
            (by simpa [h'] using h) hb hc (by simpa [h'] using hxC)
            (by simpa [h'] using hy) (by simpa [h'] using hz) hlast)
        · exact CoverShape.direct (mixed_below_direct_three C R P hCR hCP (Ne.symm hPR)
            (by simpa [h'] using h) hb hc (by simpa [h'] using hxC)
            (by simpa [h'] using hy) (by simpa [h'] using hz)
            (by have := C.x_lt; omega))
      simpa [h'] using out
    · subst Z
      have out := topCase R P hCR hCP (Ne.symm hPR)
        (by simpa [Finset.pair_comm] using hxC)
        (by simpa [Finset.pair_comm] using hy)
        (by simpa [Finset.pair_comm] using hz)
        (by simpa [Finset.pair_comm] using h)
      simpa [Finset.pair_comm] using out
    · subst Z
      by_cases hlast : C.x = a - 1
      · by_cases hCy0 : C.y = 0
        · have h' : ({C, R, P} : Finset (Normal a b c)) = {C, P, R} := by simp [Finset.pair_comm]
          have out := mixed_last_common_yzero_three C R P hCR hCP (Ne.symm hPR)
            (by simpa [h'] using h) hb hc (by simpa [h'] using hxC)
            (by simpa [h'] using hy) (by simpa [h'] using hz) hlast hCy0
          exact CoverShape.direct (by simpa [h'] using out)
        · have hCz0 : C.z = 0 := by
            by_contra hz0
            have hCS : C ∈ ({C, P, R} : Finset (Normal a b c)) := by simp
            have hxR := root_x_zero_at_last h.antichain hxC hy.1 (Ne.symm hCR) hlast
            have ey := h4_y_edge_exact h.antichain hy hCS hCR (by omega)
            have ez := h4_z_edge_exact h.antichain hz hCS hCR (by omega)
            simp [hxR, hlast] at ey ez
            omega
          have h' : ({C, R, P} : Finset (Normal a b c)) = {C, P, R} := by simp [Finset.pair_comm]
          have out := mixed_last_common_zzero_three C R P hCR hCP (Ne.symm hPR)
            (by simpa [h'] using h) hb hc (by simpa [h'] using hxC)
            (by simpa [h'] using hy) (by simpa [h'] using hz) hlast hCz0
          simpa [h'] using out
      · exact False.elim (mixed_below_common_impossible_three C R P hCR
          (by simpa [Finset.pair_comm] using h) hb hc
          (by simpa [Finset.pair_comm] using hxC)
          (by simpa [Finset.pair_comm] using hy)
          (by simpa [Finset.pair_comm] using hz)
          (by have := C.x_lt; omega))

name: P23.OneTie.h5_cover_with_xcentre
statement:
theorem h5_cover_with_xcentre
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (h : CoverHypotheses S)
    (C : Normal a b c) (hxC : IsDirectionalCentre S .x C) : CoverShape S
proof:
:= by
  have hcard : S.card = 2 ∨ S.card = 3 := by
    have := h.card_ge_two
    have := h.card_le_three
    omega
  rcases hcard with hcard | hcard
  · obtain ⟨P, Q, hPQ, hS⟩ := Finset.card_eq_two.mp hcard
    subst S
    have hCm : C = P ∨ C = Q := by simpa using hxC.1
    rcases hCm with hCP | hCQ
    · subst C
      exact h5_two_root_cover P Q hPQ h hxC
    · subst C
      have hswap : ({Q, P} : Finset (Normal a b c)) = {P, Q} := by simp [Finset.pair_comm]
      have out := h5_two_root_cover Q P (Ne.symm hPQ)
        (by simpa [hswap] using h) (by simpa [hswap] using hxC)
      simpa [hswap] using out
  · obtain ⟨P, Q, R, hPQ, hPR, hQR, hS⟩ := Finset.card_eq_three.mp hcard
    subst S
    have hCm : C = P ∨ C = Q ∨ C = R := by simpa using hxC.1
    rcases h.live_domain with hmix | hpure
    · rcases hmix with ⟨hb, hc⟩
      rcases hCm with hCP | hCQ | hCR
      · subst C
        exact h5_mixed_three_cover P Q R hPQ hPR hQR h hb hc hxC
      · subst C
        have hs : ({Q, P, R} : Finset (Normal a b c)) = {P, Q, R} := by
          ext x; simp [or_comm, or_left_comm, or_assoc]
        have out := h5_mixed_three_cover Q P R (Ne.symm hPQ) hQR hPR
          (by simpa [hs] using h) hb hc (by simpa [hs] using hxC)
        simpa [hs] using out
      · subst C
        have hs : ({R, P, Q} : Finset (Normal a b c)) = {P, Q, R} := by
          ext x; simp [or_comm, or_left_comm, or_assoc]
        have out := h5_mixed_three_cover R P Q (Ne.symm hPR) (Ne.symm hQR) hPQ
          (by simpa [hs] using h) hb hc (by simpa [hs] using hxC)
        simpa [hs] using out
    · rcases hpure with ⟨hb, hc⟩
      subst c
      rcases hCm with hCP | hCQ | hCR
      · subst C
        exact CoverShape.direct (h5_pure_three_cover P Q R hPQ hPR hQR h hb hxC)
      · subst C
        have hs : ({Q, P, R} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) = {P, Q, R} := by
          ext x; simp [or_comm, or_left_comm, or_assoc]
        have out := h5_pure_three_cover Q P R (Ne.symm hPQ) hQR hPR
          (by simpa [hs] using h) hb (by simpa [hs] using hxC)
        exact CoverShape.direct (by simpa [hs] using out)
      · subst C
        have hs : ({R, P, Q} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) = {P, Q, R} := by
          ext x; simp [or_comm, or_left_comm, or_assoc]
        have out := h5_pure_three_cover R P Q (Ne.symm hPR) (Ne.symm hQR) hPQ
          (by simpa [hs] using h) hb (by simpa [hs] using hxC)
        exact CoverShape.direct (by simpa [hs] using out)

name: P23.OneTie.h5_cover_below_last
statement:
theorem h5_cover_below_last
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (h : CoverHypotheses S)
    (C : Normal a b c) (hxC : IsDirectionalCentre S .x C)
    (hbelow : C.x < a - 1) : CoverShape S
proof:
:= by
  have hnotlast : C.x ≠ a - 1 := by omega
  by_cases hlast : C.x = a - 1
  · exact False.elim (hnotlast hlast)
  · exact h5_cover_with_xcentre S h C hxC

name: P23.OneTie.h5_cover_last_layer
statement:
theorem h5_cover_last_layer
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (h : CoverHypotheses S)
    (C : Normal a b c) (hxC : IsDirectionalCentre S .x C)
    (hlast : C.x = a - 1) : CoverShape S
proof:
:= by
  have hnotbelow : ¬ C.x < a - 1 := by omega
  by_cases hbelow : C.x < a - 1
  · exact False.elim (hnotbelow hbelow)
  · exact h5_cover_with_xcentre S h C hxC

name: P23.OneTie.h5_full_symbolic_cover
statement:
theorem h5_full_symbolic_cover
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (h : CoverHypotheses S) : CoverShape S
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hxC⟩ := h.centres .x
  by_cases hlast : C.x = a - 1
  · exact h5_cover_last_layer S h C hxC hlast
  · exact h5_cover_below_last S h C hxC (by have := C.x_lt; omega)

name: P23.OneTie.pair_card_ne_three
statement:
private theorem pair_card_ne_three {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] (p q : α) :
    ({p, q} : Finset α).card ≠ 3
proof:
:= by
  have hle := Finset.card_le_two (a := p) (b := q)
  omega

name: P23.OneTie.typeThreeBaseShape_of_base
statement:
theorem typeThreeBaseShape_of_base
    {S : Finset (Normal a b c)} (hcard : S.card = 3)
    (hs : BaseCoverShape S) : TypeThreeBaseShape S
proof:
:= by
  cases hs with
  | topDeletion h => exact TypeThreeBaseShape.topDeletion h
  | pureFibreProduct h => exact TypeThreeBaseShape.pureFibreProduct h
  | m2K ha hu hv hr => exact TypeThreeBaseShape.m2K ha hu hv hr
  | m2Z ha hu hv hr => exact TypeThreeBaseShape.m2Z ha hu hv hr
  | m3K ha hb hc hv => exact TypeThreeBaseShape.m3K ha hb hc hv
  | m4Y ha hu => exact TypeThreeBaseShape.m4Y ha hu
  | m5Y ha hb hc hv => exact TypeThreeBaseShape.m5Y ha hb hc hv
  | m5Z ha hb hc hv => exact TypeThreeBaseShape.m5Z ha hb hc hv
  | p4Z ha hb hv => exact TypeThreeBaseShape.p4Z ha hb hv
  | p5Z ha hb hv => exact TypeThreeBaseShape.p5Z ha hb hv
  | m2 ha hu hv hr =>
      exfalso
      exact pair_card_ne_three _ _ (by simpa only [m2Socles] using hcard)
  | m3 ha hb hc hv =>
      exfalso
      exact pair_card_ne_three _ _ (by simpa only [m3Socles] using hcard)
  | m4 ha hu =>
      exfalso
      exact pair_card_ne_three _ _ (by simpa only [m4Socles] using hcard)
  | m5 ha hb hc hv =>
      exfalso
      exact pair_card_ne_three _ _ (by simpa only [m5Socles] using hcard)
  | p3 ha hb =>
      exfalso
      exact pair_card_ne_three _ _ (by simpa only [p3Socles] using hcard)
  | p4 ha hb hv =>
      exfalso
      exact pair_card_ne_three _ _ (by simpa only [p4Socles] using hcard)
  | p5 ha hb hv =>
      exfalso
      exact pair_card_ne_three _ _ (by simpa only [p5Socles] using hcard)
  | p6 ha hb hv =>
      exfalso
      exact pair_card_ne_three _ _ (by simpa only [p6Socles] using hcard)

name: P23.OneTie.h5_typeThree_specialized_cover
statement:
theorem h5_typeThree_specialized_cover
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (h : CoverHypotheses S) (hcard : S.card = 3) :
    TypeThreeCoverShape S
proof:
:= by
  cases h5_full_symbolic_cover S h with
  | direct hs =>
    exact TypeThreeCoverShape.direct (typeThreeBaseShape_of_base hcard hs)
  | reflected hb hc hs =>
    apply TypeThreeCoverShape.reflected hb hc
    apply typeThreeBaseShape_of_base
    · simpa [swapYZFinset] using hcard
    · exact hs

name: P23.OneTie.standard_iff_no_border_divisor
statement:
theorem standard_iff_no_border_divisor (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (hS : S.Nonempty) (hd : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) (p : Normal a b c) :
    p ∈ standardSet S ↔ ∀ g ∈ borderFinset S, ¬g ∣ p
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hp g hg hgp
    exact ((mem_borderFinset_iff hS g).mp hg).1 (standardSet_dvd_closed S hp hgp)
  · intro hp
    by_contra hn
    obtain ⟨g,hg,hgp⟩ := killed_has_border_divisor S hS hd p hn
    exact hp g hg hgp

name: P23.OneTie.border_dvd_border_eq
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hn
  have hqmin := (isMinimalBorder_iff_isDivisibilityMinimalKilled S q
    (variableGenerators_ne_one_of_two_le ha)).mp ((mem_borderFinset_iff hS q).mp hq)
  exact ((mem_borderFinset_iff hS p).mp hp).1 (hqmin.2 p h hn)

name: P23.OneTie.pure_y_border_unique
statement:
theorem pure_y_border_unique {S : Finset (Normal a b c)} (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) {u v : ℕ} (hu : yAxis u ∈ borderFinset S)
    (hv : yAxis v ∈ borderFinset S) : u = v
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.le_total u v with h | h
  · have he : (yAxis u : Normal a b c) = yAxis v := border_dvd_border_eq hS ha hu hv
      ((Normal.exact_divides_iff _ _).mpr (by simp [Normal.DividesCriterion,yAxis,h]))
    exact congrArg Normal.y he
  · have he : (yAxis v : Normal a b c) = yAxis u := border_dvd_border_eq hS ha hv hu
      ((Normal.exact_divides_iff _ _).mpr (by simp [Normal.DividesCriterion,yAxis,h]))
    exact (congrArg Normal.y he).symm

name: P23.OneTie.pure_z_border_unique
statement:
theorem pure_z_border_unique {S : Finset (Normal a b c)} (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) {u v : ℕ} (hu : zAxis u ∈ borderFinset S)
    (hv : zAxis v ∈ borderFinset S) : u = v
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.le_total u v with h | h
  · have he : (zAxis u : Normal a b c) = zAxis v := border_dvd_border_eq hS ha hu hv
      ((Normal.exact_divides_iff _ _).mpr (by simp [Normal.DividesCriterion,zAxis,h]))
    exact congrArg Normal.z he
  · have he : (zAxis v : Normal a b c) = zAxis u := border_dvd_border_eq hS ha hv hu
      ((Normal.exact_divides_iff _ _).mpr (by simp [Normal.DividesCriterion,zAxis,h]))
    exact (congrArg Normal.z he).symm

name: P23.OneTie.three_border_exists_third
statement:
theorem three_border_exists_third (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (hcard : (borderFinset S).card = 3) (Y Z : Normal a b c)
    (hY : Y ∈ borderFinset S) (hZ : Z ∈ borderFinset S) (hne : Y ≠ Z) :
    ∃ q ∈ borderFinset S, q ≠ Y ∧ q ≠ Z ∧ borderFinset S = {Y,Z,q}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let G := borderFinset S
  let E := (G.erase Y).erase Z
  have hZ' : Z ∈ G.erase Y := Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hne.symm,hZ⟩
  have hcard' : E.card = 1 := by
    dsimp [E]
    rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem hZ',Finset.card_erase_of_mem hY,hcard]
  obtain ⟨q,hq⟩ := Finset.card_eq_one.mp hcard'
  have hqE : q ∈ E := hq.symm ▸ Finset.mem_singleton_self q
  have hqG : q ∈ G := Finset.mem_of_mem_erase (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hqE)
  have hqY : q ≠ Y := Finset.ne_of_mem_erase (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hqE)
  have hqZ : q ≠ Z := Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hqE
  have hr : insert Y (insert Z E) = G := by
    dsimp [E]
    rw [Finset.insert_erase hZ',Finset.insert_erase hY]
  rw [hq] at hr
  exact ⟨q,hqG,hqY,hqZ,hr.symm⟩

name: P23.OneTie.mixed_pure_y_border_exists
statement:
theorem mixed_pure_y_border_exists (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (hS : S.Nonempty) (hd : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) (hc : 0 < c) :
    ∃ B, 0 < B ∧ yAxis B ∈ borderFinset S
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let B := S.sup Normal.y + 1
  have hk : (yAxis B : Normal a b c) ∉ standardSet S := by
    rintro ⟨s,hs,hdiv⟩
    have hy := (Normal.exact_divides_iff _ _).mp hdiv |>.1
    have hb := Finset.le_sup (f := Normal.y) hs
    change B ≤ s.y at hy
    dsimp [B] at hy
    omega
  obtain ⟨g,hg,hgdiv⟩ := killed_has_border_divisor S hS hd (yAxis B) hk
  have hh := (Normal.exact_divides_iff _ _).mp hgdiv
  have gx : g.x = 0 := by
    simp only [Normal.DividesCriterion, yAxis] at hh
    omega
  have gz : g.z = 0 := by
    simp only [Normal.DividesCriterion, yAxis] at hh
    omega
  have gy : 0 < g.y := by
    by_contra hn
    have ge : g = 1 := by apply Normal.ext <;> simp [gx,gz] <;> omega
    have hkill := ((mem_borderFinset_iff hS g).mp hg).1
    rw [ge] at hkill
    exact hkill (one_mem_standardSet_of_nonempty hS)
  refine ⟨g.y,gy,?_⟩
  have ge : (yAxis g.y : Normal a b c) = g := by apply Normal.ext <;> simp [yAxis,gx,gz]
  rwa [ge]

name: P23.OneTie.pure_z_border_exists
statement:
theorem pure_z_border_exists (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (hS : S.Nonempty) (hd : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) (hb : 0 < b) :
    ∃ C, 0 < C ∧ zAxis C ∈ borderFinset S
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let C := S.sup Normal.z + 1
  have hk : (zAxis C : Normal a b c) ∉ standardSet S := by
    rintro ⟨s,hs,hdiv⟩
    have hz := (Normal.exact_divides_iff _ _).mp hdiv |>.2.1
    have hc := Finset.le_sup (f := Normal.z) hs
    change C ≤ s.z at hz
    dsimp [C] at hz
    omega
  obtain ⟨g,hg,hgdiv⟩ := killed_has_border_divisor S hS hd (zAxis C) hk
  have hh := (Normal.exact_divides_iff _ _).mp hgdiv
  have gx : g.x = 0 := by
    simp only [Normal.DividesCriterion, zAxis] at hh
    omega
  have gy : g.y = 0 := by
    simp only [Normal.DividesCriterion, zAxis] at hh
    omega
  have gz : 0 < g.z := by
    by_contra hn
    have ge : g = 1 := by apply Normal.ext <;> simp [gx,gy] <;> omega
    have hkill := ((mem_borderFinset_iff hS g).mp hg).1
    rw [ge] at hkill
    exact hkill (one_mem_standardSet_of_nonempty hS)
  refine ⟨g.z,gz,?_⟩
  have ge : (zAxis g.z : Normal a b c) = g := by apply Normal.ext <;> simp [zAxis,gx,gy]
  rwa [ge]

name: P23.OneTie.normal_dvd_antisymm_live
statement:
theorem normal_dvd_antisymm_live (hd : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c)
    {p q : Normal a b c} (hpq : p ∣ q) (hqp : q ∣ p) : p = q
proof:
:= by
  have h := (Normal.exact_divides_iff _ _).mp hpq
  have h' := (Normal.exact_divides_iff _ _).mp hqp
  have hb : 0 < b := by rcases hd.2 with hm | hp <;> omega
  unfold Normal.DividesCriterion at h h'
  apply Normal.ext <;> omega

name: P23.OneTie.roots_subset_of_standardSet_eq
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs
  have hsstd : s ∈ standardSet T := he ▸ (show s ∈ standardSet S from ⟨s,hs,dvd_refl _⟩)
  obtain ⟨t,ht,hst⟩ := hsstd
  have htstd : t ∈ standardSet S := he.symm ▸ (show t ∈ standardSet T from ⟨t,ht,dvd_refl _⟩)
  obtain ⟨s',hs',hts⟩ := htstd
  have hss : s = s' := by
    by_contra hn
    exact hS s hs s' hs' hn (dvd_trans hst hts)
  have heq : s = t := normal_dvd_antisymm_live hd hst (hss.symm ▸ hts)
  rwa [heq]

name: P23.OneTie.roots_card_le_of_standardSet_eq
proof:
:=
  Finset.card_le_card (roots_subset_of_standardSet_eq hd hS he)

name: P23.OneTie.roots_eq_of_standardSet_eq
proof:
:= by
  have hsub (S T : Finset (Normal a b c)) (hS : IsRootAntichain S)
      (he : standardSet S = standardSet T) : S ⊆ T := by
    intro s hs
    have hsstd : s ∈ standardSet T := he ▸ (show s ∈ standardSet S from ⟨s,hs,dvd_refl _⟩)
    obtain ⟨t,ht,hst⟩ := hsstd
    have htstd : t ∈ standardSet S := he.symm ▸ (show t ∈ standardSet T from ⟨t,ht,dvd_refl _⟩)
    obtain ⟨s',hs',hts⟩ := htstd
    have hss : s = s' := by
      by_contra hn
      exact hS s hs s' hs' hn (dvd_trans hst hts)
    have heq : s = t := normal_dvd_antisymm_live hd hst (hss.symm ▸ hts)
    rwa [heq]
  exact Finset.Subset.antisymm (hsub S T hS he) (hsub T S hT he.symm)

name: P23.OneTie.a_pos
statement: private theorem a_pos {a : ℕ} [NeZero a] : 0 < a
proof:
:=
  Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne a)

name: P23.OneTie.m2K_endpoint_xK
statement:
theorem m2K_endpoint_xK (ha : 2 ≤ a) (_hu : 1 ≤ u)
    (hr : r ≤ a - 2) (hend : r = a - 2) :
    m2KRoot (a := a) ha r u hr *
        (Normal.xGenerator : Normal a 1 1) =
      m2YBorder (a := a) u * (Normal.zGenerator : Normal a 1 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hsum : r + 1 + 1 = a := by omega
  have hdiv : a / a = 1 := Nat.div_self (by omega)
  apply Normal.ext
  · simp [m2KRoot, m2YBorder, Normal.xGenerator, Normal.zGenerator,
      show a ≠ 1 by omega, hsum]
  · simp [m2KRoot, m2YBorder, Normal.xGenerator, Normal.zGenerator,
      show a ≠ 1 by omega, hsum, hdiv]
  · simp [m2KRoot, m2YBorder, Normal.xGenerator, Normal.zGenerator,
      show a ≠ 1 by omega, hsum, hdiv]

statement:
theorem m2K_endpoint_xQ (ha : 2 ≤ a) (_hv : 1 ≤ v)
    (hr : r ≤ a - 2) (hend : r = a - 2) :
    (⟨r + 1, 0, v, by omega⟩ : Normal a 1 1) *
        (Normal.xGenerator : Normal a 1 1) =
      m2ZBorder (a := a) v * (Normal.yGenerator : Normal a 1 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hsum : r + 1 + 1 = a := by omega
  have hdiv : a / a = 1 := Nat.div_self (by omega)
  apply Normal.ext
  · simp [m2ZBorder, Normal.xGenerator, Normal.yGenerator,

  · simp [m2ZBorder, Normal.xGenerator, Normal.yGenerator,
      show a ≠ 1 by omega, hsum, hdiv]
  · simp [m2ZBorder, Normal.xGenerator, Normal.yGenerator,

statement:
theorem m2Z_endpoint_xQ (ha : 2 ≤ a) (_hv : 1 ≤ v)

    (⟨r + 1, 0, v, by omega⟩ : Normal a 1 1) *
        (Normal.xGenerator : Normal a 1 1) =
      (⟨0, 1, v + 1, a_pos⟩ : Normal a 1 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hsum : r + 1 + 1 = a := by omega
  have hdiv : a / a = 1 := Nat.div_self (by omega)
  apply Normal.ext
  · simp [Normal.xGenerator, show a ≠ 1 by omega, hsum]
  · simp [Normal.xGenerator, show a ≠ 1 by omega, hsum, hdiv]
  · simp [Normal.xGenerator, show a ≠ 1 by omega, hsum, hdiv]

name: P23.OneTie.mem_standardSet_m2K_iff
statement:
theorem mem_standardSet_m2K_iff (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hu : 1 ≤ u) (hr : r ≤ a - 2)
    (p : Normal a 1 1) :
    p ∈ standardSet (m2KSocles (a := a) ha r u v hr) ↔
      m2KStandardNat r u v p.x p.y p.z
proof:
:= by
  rcases p with ⟨px, py, pz, hpx⟩
  simp [standardSet, m2KSocles, m2Core, m2Partner, m2KRoot,
    Normal.exact_divides_iff, Normal.DividesCriterion, m2KStandardNat]

statement:

proof:

name: P23.OneTie.mem_m2KExpectedBorder_iff
statement:
theorem mem_m2KExpectedBorder_iff (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hr : r ≤ a - 2)
    (m : Normal a 1 1) :
    m ∈ m2KExpectedBorder (a := a) ha r u v hr ↔
      m2KBorderNat a r u v m.x m.y m.z
proof:
:= by
  rcases m with ⟨mx, my, mz, hmx⟩
  by_cases h : r = a - 2 <;>

statement:

name: P23.OneTie.m2K_border_arithmetic
statement:
theorem m2K_border_arithmetic (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hu : 1 ≤ u) (hv : 1 ≤ v)
    (hr : r ≤ a - 2) (x y z : ℕ) (hxlt : x < a) :
    (¬m2KStandardNat r u v x y z ∧
      (if 0 < x then m2KStandardNat r u v (x - 1) y z
       else if 1 ≤ y ∧ 1 ≤ z then
         m2KStandardNat r u v (a - 1) (y - 1) (z - 1)
       else True) ∧
      (0 < y → m2KStandardNat r u v x (y - 1) z) ∧
      (0 < z → m2KStandardNat r u v x y (z - 1))) ↔
      m2KBorderNat a r u v x y z
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hend : r = a - 2 <;>
    by_cases hx : 0 < x <;> by_cases hy : 1 ≤ y <;> by_cases hz : 1 ≤ z
  all_goals
    simp [hx, hy, hz, hend, Nat.lt_iff_add_one_le, m2KStandardNat,
      m2KBorderNat] <;> grind (splits := 32)

name: P23.OneTie.m2Z_border_arithmetic
statement:
theorem m2Z_border_arithmetic (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hu : 1 ≤ u) (hv : 1 ≤ v)
    (hr : r ≤ a - 2) (x y z : ℕ) (hxlt : x < a) :
    (¬m2ZStandardNat r u v x y z ∧
      (if 0 < x then m2ZStandardNat r u v (x - 1) y z
       else if 1 ≤ y ∧ 1 ≤ z then
         m2ZStandardNat r u v (a - 1) (y - 1) (z - 1)
       else True) ∧
      (0 < y → m2ZStandardNat r u v x (y - 1) z) ∧
      (0 < z → m2ZStandardNat r u v x y (z - 1))) ↔
      m2ZBorderNat a r u v x y z
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hend : r = a - 2 <;>
    by_cases hx : 0 < x <;> by_cases hy : 1 ≤ y <;> by_cases hz : 1 ≤ z

statement:

      if r = a - 2 then 3 else 5

:= by
  rw [m2K_border_exact ha hu hv hr]
  by_cases h : r = a - 2
  · simp [m2KExpectedBorder, h, m2YBorder, m2ZBorder, m2KDiagonal]
  · have hlt : r < a - 2 := by omega
    rw [show m2KExpectedBorder (a := a) ha r u v hr =
        {m2YBorder u, m2ZBorder v, m2KDiagonal ha r u hr,
          (⟨r + 2, u, 0, by omega⟩ : Normal a 1 1),
          (⟨r + 2, 0, v, by omega⟩ : Normal a 1 1)} by
      simp [m2KExpectedBorder, h]]
    have hY : m2YBorder (a := a) u ∉
        ({m2ZBorder (a := a) v, m2KDiagonal (a := a) ha r u hr,
          (⟨r + 2, u, 0, by omega⟩ : Normal a 1 1),
          (⟨r + 2, 0, v, by omega⟩ : Normal a 1 1)} :
          Finset (Normal a 1 1)) := by
      simp [m2YBorder, m2ZBorder, m2KDiagonal]
    have hZ : m2ZBorder (a := a) v ∉
        ({m2KDiagonal (a := a) ha r u hr,
          (⟨r + 2, u, 0, by omega⟩ : Normal a 1 1),
          (⟨r + 2, 0, v, by omega⟩ : Normal a 1 1)} :
          Finset (Normal a 1 1)) := by
      simp [m2ZBorder, m2KDiagonal]

        ({(⟨r + 2, u, 0, by omega⟩ : Normal a 1 1),
          (⟨r + 2, 0, v, by omega⟩ : Normal a 1 1)} :
          Finset (Normal a 1 1)) := by

    have hB : (⟨r + 2, u, 0, by omega⟩ : Normal a 1 1) ∉
        ({(⟨r + 2, 0, v, by omega⟩ : Normal a 1 1)} :
          Finset (Normal a 1 1)) := by
      simp
      omega

    rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hZ]
    rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hA]
    rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hB]

name: P23.OneTie.borderFinset_eq_expected_of_nat
statement:
theorem borderFinset_eq_expected_of_nat {a b c : ℕ} [NeZero a]
    (S G : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (Std Border : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → Prop)
    (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hstd : ∀ p, p ∈ standardSet S ↔ Std p.x p.y p.z)
    (hG : ∀ m, m ∈ G ↔ Border m.x m.y m.z)
    (harith : ∀ x y z, x < a →
      ((¬Std x y z ∧
        (if 0 < x then Std (x - 1) y z
         else if b ≤ y ∧ c ≤ z then Std (a - 1) (y - b) (z - c)
         else True) ∧
        (0 < y → Std x (y - 1) z) ∧
        (0 < z → Std x y (z - 1))) ↔ Border x y z)) :
    borderFinset S = G
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.ext
  intro m
  rw [mem_borderFinset_iff hS, hG m]
  rcases m with ⟨mx, my, mz, hmx⟩
  have h := harith mx my mz hmx
  by_cases hx : 0 < mx
  · simpa [IsMinimalBorder, ApplicablePredecessorsSurvive, hstd,
      Normal.predecessor, Normal.xPredecessor, Normal.yPredecessor,
      Normal.zPredecessor, hx] using h
  · have hx0 : mx = 0 := by omega
    by_cases hby : b ≤ my
    · by_cases hcz : c ≤ mz
      · simpa [IsMinimalBorder, ApplicablePredecessorsSurvive, hstd,
          Normal.predecessor, Normal.wrappedXPredecessor,
          Normal.yPredecessor, Normal.zPredecessor, hx, hx0, hby, hcz]
          using h
      · simpa [IsMinimalBorder, ApplicablePredecessorsSurvive, hstd,
          Normal.predecessor, Normal.yPredecessor, Normal.zPredecessor,
          hx, hx0, hby, hcz] using h
    · simpa [IsMinimalBorder, ApplicablePredecessorsSurvive, hstd,
        Normal.predecessor, Normal.yPredecessor, Normal.zPredecessor,
        hx, hx0, hby] using h

        (⟨1, 0, v + 1, by omega⟩ : Normal a b c)} : Finset (Normal a b c)) := by

  have hD : (⟨1, 1, 0, by omega⟩ : Normal a b c) ∉
      ({(⟨1, 0, v + 1, by omega⟩ : Normal a b c)} : Finset (Normal a b c)) := by
    simp
  rw [show m5ZExpectedBorder (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) ha v =
      {(⟨0, b + 1, 0, a_pos⟩ : Normal a b c),
        (⟨0, 0, v + c + 1, a_pos⟩ : Normal a b c),
        (⟨0, 1, v + c, a_pos⟩ : Normal a b c),
        (⟨1, 1, 0, by omega⟩ : Normal a b c),
        (⟨1, 0, v + 1, by omega⟩ : Normal a b c)} by rfl]
  rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hA]
  rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hB]
  rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hC]
  rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hD]
  simp

name: P23.OneTie.m5Y_c_eq_one_redundancy_yz
statement:
theorem m5Y_c_eq_one_redundancy_yz (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hc1 : c = 1) :

      (⟨a - 1, 0, 0, by omega⟩ : Normal a b c) *
        (⟨1, 1, 0, by omega⟩ : Normal a b c)
proof:

  have hdiv : a / a = 1 := Nat.div_self (by omega)
  apply Normal.ext
  · simp [hsum]
  · simp [hsum, hdiv]
    omega
  · simp [hsum, hdiv, hc1]

name: P23.OneTie.p4Z_border_arithmetic
statement:
theorem p4Z_border_arithmetic (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 2 ≤ b) (hV : 1 ≤ V)
    (x y z : ℕ) (hxlt : x < a) :
    (¬p4ZStandardNat b V x y z ∧
      (if 0 < x then p4ZStandardNat b V (x - 1) y z
       else if b ≤ y ∧ 0 ≤ z then p4ZStandardNat b V (a - 1) (y - b) z
       else True) ∧
      (0 < y → p4ZStandardNat b V x (y - 1) z) ∧
      (0 < z → p4ZStandardNat b V x y (z - 1))) ↔ p4ZBorderNat V x y z
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : 0 < x <;> by_cases hby : b ≤ y <;>
    by_cases hy : 0 < y <;> by_cases hz : 0 < z
  all_goals
    simp [hx, hby, hy, hz, p4ZStandardNat, p4ZBorderNat] <;>
      grind (splits := 32)

       else True) ∧
      (0 < y → p5ZStandardNat b v x (y - 1) z) ∧
      (0 < z → p5ZStandardNat b v x y (z - 1))) ↔ p5ZBorderNat v x y z
proof:

    by_cases hy : 0 < y <;> by_cases hz : 0 < z

name: P23.OneTie.standardSet_singleton
statement:
private theorem standardSet_singleton (T : Normal a b c) :

name: P23.OneTie.topDeletion_border_eq_insert_principal
statement:
theorem topDeletion_border_eq_insert_principal
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (T : Normal a b c)
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hstd : standardSet S = Normal.divisorDownset T \ {T})
    (hnodiv : ∀ m ∈ borderFinset ({T} : Finset (Normal a b c)), ¬T ∣ m) :
    borderFinset S = insert T (borderFinset ({T} : Finset (Normal a b c)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply Finset.ext
  intro m
  rw [mem_borderFinset_iff hS, Finset.mem_insert,
    mem_borderFinset_iff (by simp),
    isMinimalBorder_iff_isDivisibilityMinimalKilled S m
      (variableGenerators_ne_one_of_two_le ha),
    isMinimalBorder_iff_isDivisibilityMinimalKilled ({T} : Finset (Normal a b c)) m
      (variableGenerators_ne_one_of_two_le ha)]
  rw [hstd, standardSet_singleton]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hmout, hproper⟩
    by_cases hmT : m = T
    · exact Or.inl hmT
    · right
      have hmD : m ∉ Normal.divisorDownset T := by
        intro hmD
        exact hmout ⟨hmD, by simpa [hmT]⟩
      refine ⟨hmD, ?_⟩
      intro d hdm hne
      exact (hproper d hdm hne).1
  · rintro (rfl | hm)
    · refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · simp
      · intro d hdT hdne
        exact ⟨hdT, by simpa [eq_comm] using hdne⟩
    · rcases hm with ⟨hmout, hproper⟩
      have hmBorder : m ∈ borderFinset ({T} : Finset (Normal a b c)) := by
        rw [mem_borderFinset_iff (by simp),
          isMinimalBorder_iff_isDivisibilityMinimalKilled
            ({T} : Finset (Normal a b c)) m
            (variableGenerators_ne_one_of_two_le ha), standardSet_singleton]
        exact ⟨hmout, hproper⟩
      have hTnmid : ¬T ∣ m := hnodiv m hmBorder
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · intro hmD
        exact hmout hmD.1
      · intro d hdm hne
        refine ⟨hproper d hdm hne, ?_⟩
        intro hdT
        subst d
        exact hTnmid hdm

name: P23.OneTie.topDeletionMixedBelow_border_exact
statement:
theorem topDeletionMixedBelow_border_exact
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hc : 1 ≤ c)
    (hu : b ≤ u) (hv : c ≤ v) (hr : r < a - 1)
    (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hstd : standardSet S =
      Normal.divisorDownset (mixedCore (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) r u v (by omega)) \
        {mixedCore (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) r u v (by omega)}) :
    borderFinset S =
      topDeletionMixedBelowExpected (u := u) (v := v)
        (mixedCore (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) r u v (by omega)) hr
proof:
:= by
  let T := mixedCore (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) r u v (by omega)
  rw [topDeletionMixedBelowExpected]
  rw [← mixedPrincipalBorder_below ha hb hc hu hv hr]
  apply topDeletion_border_eq_insert_principal S T ha hS hstd
  intro m hm hdiv
  rw [mixedPrincipalBorder_below ha hb hc hu hv hr] at hm
  rcases (Finset.mem_insert.mp hm) with rfl | hm
  · simp [T, mixedCore, mixedY, Normal.exact_divides_iff,
      Normal.DividesCriterion] at hdiv
    omega
  rcases (Finset.mem_insert.mp hm) with rfl | hm
  · simp [T, mixedCore, mixedZ, Normal.exact_divides_iff,
      Normal.DividesCriterion] at hdiv
    omega
  rcases (Finset.mem_insert.mp hm) with rfl | hm
  · simp [T, mixedCore, mixedP, Normal.exact_divides_iff,
      Normal.DividesCriterion] at hdiv
    omega
  · simp only [Finset.mem_singleton] at hm
    subst m
    simp [T, mixedCore, mixedQ, Normal.exact_divides_iff,
      Normal.DividesCriterion] at hdiv
    omega

name: P23.OneTie.topDeletionMixedBelow_border_card
statement:
theorem topDeletionMixedBelow_border_card
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hc : 1 ≤ c)
    (hu : b ≤ u) (hv : c ≤ v) (hr : r < a - 1)
    (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hstd : standardSet S =

        {mixedCore (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) r u v (by omega)}) :
    (borderFinset S).card = 5
proof:
:= by
  rw [topDeletionMixedBelow_border_exact S ha hb hc hu hv hr hS hstd]
  rw [topDeletionMixedBelowExpected,
    ← mixedPrincipalBorder_below ha hb hc hu hv hr]
  rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem]
  · rw [mixedPrincipalBorder_below_card ha hb hc hu hv hr]
  · rw [mem_borderFinset_iff (by simp)]
    simp [IsMinimalBorder, standardSet]

name: P23.OneTie.topDeletionMixedLast_border_exact
statement:
theorem topDeletionMixedLast_border_exact
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hc : 1 ≤ c)
    (hu : b ≤ u) (hv : c ≤ v) (hr : r = a - 1)

proof:

  intro m hm hdiv
  rw [mixedPrincipalBorder_last ha hb hc hu hv hr] at hm
  rcases (Finset.mem_insert.mp hm) with rfl | hm

name: P23.OneTie.topDeletionMixedLast_border_card
statement:
theorem topDeletionMixedLast_border_card
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hc : 1 ≤ c)
    (hu : b ≤ u) (hv : c ≤ v) (hr : r = a - 1)

name: P23.OneTie.topDeletionPure_border_exact
statement:
theorem topDeletionPure_border_exact
    (S : Finset (Normal a b 0))
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 2 ≤ b) (hu : b ≤ u) (hv : 1 ≤ v)
    (hr : r < a) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hstd : standardSet S =
      Normal.divisorDownset (pureCore (a := a) (b := b) r u v hr) \
        {pureCore (a := a) (b := b) r u v hr}) :
    borderFinset S = topDeletionPureExpected (u := u) (v := v)
      (pureCore (a := a) (b := b) r u v hr) hr
proof:
:= by
  let T := pureCore (a := a) (b := b) r u v hr
  rw [topDeletionPureExpected]
  by_cases hlast : r = a - 1
  · rw [← purePrincipalBorder_last ha hb (by omega) hlast]
    apply topDeletion_border_eq_insert_principal S T ha hS hstd
    intro m hm hdiv
    rw [purePrincipalBorder_last ha hb (by omega) hlast] at hm
    rcases (Finset.mem_insert.mp hm) with rfl | hm
    · simp [T, pureCore, pureH, hlast, Normal.exact_divides_iff,
        Normal.DividesCriterion] at hdiv
      omega
    · simp only [Finset.mem_singleton] at hm
      subst m
      simp [T, pureCore, pureZ, Normal.exact_divides_iff,
        Normal.DividesCriterion] at hdiv
      omega
  · have hbelow : r < a - 1 := by omega
    rw [← purePrincipalBorder_below ha hb hu hbelow]
    apply topDeletion_border_eq_insert_principal S T ha hS hstd
    intro m hm hdiv
    rw [purePrincipalBorder_below ha hb hu hbelow] at hm
    rcases (Finset.mem_insert.mp hm) with rfl | hm
    · simp [T, pureCore, pureH, hbelow, Normal.exact_divides_iff,
        Normal.DividesCriterion] at hdiv
      omega
    · simp only [Finset.mem_singleton] at hm
      subst m
      simp [T, pureCore, pureZ, Normal.exact_divides_iff,
        Normal.DividesCriterion] at hdiv
      omega

name: P23.OneTie.topDeletionPure_border_card
statement:
theorem topDeletionPure_border_card
    (S : Finset (Normal a b 0))
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 2 ≤ b) (hu : b ≤ u) (hv : 1 ≤ v)
    (hr : r < a) (hS : S.Nonempty)

      Normal.divisorDownset (pureCore (a := a) (b := b) r u v hr) \
        {pureCore (a := a) (b := b) r u v hr}) :
    (borderFinset S).card = 3
proof:
:= by
  rw [topDeletionPure_border_exact S ha hb hu hv hr hS hstd]
  by_cases hlast : r = a - 1
  · simp [topDeletionPureExpected, pureCore, pureH, hlast, pureZ]

name: P23.OneTie.typeThreeTopDeletion_border_card
statement:
theorem typeThreeTopDeletion_border_card
    {S : Finset (Normal a b c)}
    (ha : 2 ≤ a)
    (hdomain : (1 ≤ b ∧ 1 ≤ c) ∨ (2 ≤ b ∧ c = 0))
    (hcardS : S.card = 3) (hlive : IsLiveTie S)
    (htop : IsTopDeletion S) :
    (borderFinset S).card = 3 ∨ (borderFinset S).card = 5
proof:
:= by
  rcases htop with ⟨T, _, _, hstd⟩
  rcases T with ⟨r, u, v, hrA⟩
  have hnonempty : S.Nonempty := Finset.card_pos.mp (by omega)
  rcases (mem_standardSet_iff S liveTiePoint).1 hlive.2.2.2 with
    ⟨q, hqS, hqdiv⟩
  have hqstd : q ∈ standardSet S :=
    (mem_standardSet_iff S q).2 ⟨q, hqS, dvd_refl q⟩
  rw [hstd] at hqstd
  have htieT : liveTiePoint ∣ (⟨r, u, v, hrA⟩ : Normal a b c) :=
    dvd_trans hqdiv hqstd.1
  have hbounds := (Normal.exact_divides_iff liveTiePoint
    (⟨r, u, v, hrA⟩ : Normal a b c)).1 htieT
  have hu : b ≤ u := by
    simp [liveTiePoint, Normal.DividesCriterion] at hbounds
    omega
  rcases hdomain with ⟨hb, hc⟩ | ⟨hb, hc0⟩
  · have hv : c ≤ v := by
      simp [liveTiePoint, Normal.DividesCriterion] at hbounds
      omega
    by_cases hlast : r = a - 1
    · exact Or.inl (topDeletionMixedLast_border_card S ha hb hc hu hv hlast
        hnonempty hstd)
    · have hbelow : r < a - 1 := by omega
      exact Or.inr (topDeletionMixedBelow_border_card S ha hb hc hu hv hbelow
        hnonempty hstd)
  · subst c
    rcases (mem_standardSet_iff S (Normal.zGenerator : Normal a b 0)).1
        hlive.2.2.1 with ⟨qz, hqzS, hzdiv⟩
    have hqzstd : qz ∈ standardSet S :=
      (mem_standardSet_iff S qz).2 ⟨qz, hqzS, dvd_refl qz⟩
    rw [hstd] at hqzstd
    have hzT : (Normal.zGenerator : Normal a b 0) ∣
        (⟨r, u, v, hrA⟩ : Normal a b 0) := dvd_trans hzdiv hqzstd.1
    have hv : 1 ≤ v := by
      have hz := (Normal.exact_divides_iff
        (Normal.zGenerator : Normal a b 0)
        (⟨r, u, v, hrA⟩ : Normal a b 0)).1 hzT
      simp [Normal.zGenerator, Normal.DividesCriterion] at hz
      omega
    exact Or.inl (topDeletionPure_border_card S ha hb hu hv hrA
      hnonempty hstd)

name: P23.OneTie.topDeletion_border_card_ne_four
statement:
theorem topDeletion_border_card_ne_four
    {S : Finset (Normal a b c)}
    (ha : 2 ≤ a)
    (hdomain : (1 ≤ b ∧ 1 ≤ c) ∨ (2 ≤ b ∧ c = 0))
    (hcardS : S.card = 3) (hlive : IsLiveTie S)
    (htop : IsTopDeletion S) : (borderFinset S).card ≠ 4
proof:
:= by
  rcases typeThreeTopDeletion_border_card ha hdomain hcardS hlive htop with
    h3 | h5 <;> omega

name: P23.OneTie.a_pos
statement: private theorem a_pos : 0 < a
proof: := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne a)

name: P23.OneTie.mixedPrincipalBorder_last
statement:
theorem mixedPrincipalBorder_last
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hc : 1 ≤ c)
    (hu : b ≤ u) (hv : c ≤ v) (hr : r = a - 1) :
    borderFinset ({mixedCore (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) r u v (by omega)} :
      Finset (Normal a b c)) =
      {mixedY (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) u,
        mixedZ (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) v}
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.ext
  intro m
  rw [mem_borderFinset_iff (by simp)]
  rcases m with ⟨mx, my, mz, hmx⟩
  by_cases hx : 0 < mx
  · simp [IsMinimalBorder, ApplicablePredecessorsSurvive, standardSet,
      Normal.predecessor, Normal.exact_divides_iff, Normal.DividesCriterion,
      Normal.xPredecessor, Normal.yPredecessor,
      Normal.zPredecessor, mixedCore, mixedY, mixedZ, hx]
    omega
  · have hx0 : mx = 0 := by omega
    by_cases hby : b ≤ my
    · by_cases hcz : c ≤ mz
      · simp [IsMinimalBorder, ApplicablePredecessorsSurvive, standardSet,
          Normal.predecessor, Normal.exact_divides_iff, Normal.DividesCriterion,
          Normal.wrappedXPredecessor, Normal.yPredecessor,
          Normal.zPredecessor, mixedCore, mixedY, mixedZ, hx0, hby, hcz]
        omega
      · simp [IsMinimalBorder, ApplicablePredecessorsSurvive, standardSet,
          Normal.predecessor, Normal.exact_divides_iff, Normal.DividesCriterion,

name: P23.OneTie.mixedPrincipalBorder_below
statement:
theorem mixedPrincipalBorder_below
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hc : 1 ≤ c)

    omega
  · have hx0 : mx = 0 := by omega
    by_cases hby : b ≤ my
    · by_cases hcz : c ≤ mz
      · simp [IsMinimalBorder, ApplicablePredecessorsSurvive, standardSet,
          Normal.predecessor, Normal.exact_divides_iff, Normal.DividesCriterion,
          Normal.wrappedXPredecessor, Normal.yPredecessor,

name: P23.OneTie.mixedPrincipalBorder_below_card
statement:
theorem mixedPrincipalBorder_below_card
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hc : 1 ≤ c)
    (hu : b ≤ u) (hv : c ≤ v) (hr : r < a - 1) :
    (borderFinset ({mixedCore (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) r u v (by omega)} :
      Finset (Normal a b c))).card = 4
proof:
:= by
  rw [mixedPrincipalBorder_below ha hb hc hu hv hr]
  have hPQ :
      mixedP (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) r u hr ≠
        mixedQ (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) r v hr := by
    intro heq
    have hy := congrArg Normal.y heq
    simp [mixedP, mixedQ] at hy
    omega
  have hY : mixedY (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) u ∉
      ({mixedZ (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) v,
        mixedP (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) r u hr,
        mixedQ (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) r v hr} :
          Finset (Normal a b c)) := by
    simp [mixedY, mixedZ, mixedP, mixedQ]
  have hZ : mixedZ (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) v ∉
      ({mixedP (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) r u hr,
        mixedQ (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) r v hr} :
          Finset (Normal a b c)) := by
    simp [mixedZ, mixedP, mixedQ]
  have hP : mixedP (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) r u hr ∉
      ({mixedQ (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) r v hr} :
        Finset (Normal a b c)) := by
    simpa using hPQ
  rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hY]
  rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hZ]
  rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hP]
  simp
