name: P23.OneTie.mixed_topDeletion_card_ne_four
statement:
private theorem mixed_topDeletion_card_ne_four
    {S : Finset (Normal a b c)}
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hc : 1 ≤ c)
    (hcardS : S.card = 3) (hlive : IsLiveTie S)
    (htop : IsTopDeletion S) : (borderFinset S).card ≠ 4
proof:
:= by
  rcases htop with ⟨T, _, _, hstd⟩
  rcases T with ⟨r, u, v, hrA⟩
  have hnonempty : S.Nonempty := Finset.card_pos.mp (by omega)
  rcases (mem_standardSet_iff S liveTiePoint).1 hlive.2.2.2 with ⟨q, hqS, hqdiv⟩
  have hqstd : q ∈ standardSet S := (mem_standardSet_iff S q).2 ⟨q, hqS, dvd_refl q⟩
  rw [hstd] at hqstd
  have htieT : liveTiePoint ∣ (⟨r, u, v, hrA⟩ : Normal a b c) :=
    dvd_trans hqdiv hqstd.1
  have hbounds := (Normal.exact_divides_iff liveTiePoint
    (⟨r, u, v, hrA⟩ : Normal a b c)).1 htieT
  have hu : b ≤ u := by
    simp [liveTiePoint, Normal.DividesCriterion] at hbounds
    omega
  have hv : c ≤ v := by
    simp [liveTiePoint, Normal.DividesCriterion] at hbounds
    omega
  by_cases hlast : r = a - 1
  · have hc3 := topDeletionMixedLast_border_card S ha hb hc hu hv hlast
      hnonempty hstd
    omega
  · have hbelow : r < a - 1 := by omega
    have hc5 := topDeletionMixedBelow_border_card S ha hb hc hu hv hbelow
      hnonempty hstd
    omega

name: P23.OneTie.pure_topDeletion_card_ne_four
statement:
private theorem pure_topDeletion_card_ne_four
    {S : Finset (Normal a b 0)}
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 2 ≤ b)
    (hcardS : S.card = 3) (hlive : IsLiveTie S)
    (htop : IsTopDeletion S) : (borderFinset S).card ≠ 4
proof:
:= by
  rcases htop with ⟨T, _, _, hstd⟩
  rcases T with ⟨r, u, v, hrA⟩
  have hnonempty : S.Nonempty := Finset.card_pos.mp (by omega)
  rcases (mem_standardSet_iff S liveTiePoint).1 hlive.2.2.2 with ⟨q, hqS, hqdiv⟩
  have hqstd : q ∈ standardSet S := (mem_standardSet_iff S q).2 ⟨q, hqS, dvd_refl q⟩
  rw [hstd] at hqstd
  have htieT : liveTiePoint ∣ (⟨r, u, v, hrA⟩ : Normal a b 0) :=
    dvd_trans hqdiv hqstd.1
  have hbounds := (Normal.exact_divides_iff liveTiePoint
    (⟨r, u, v, hrA⟩ : Normal a b 0)).1 htieT
  have hu : b ≤ u := by
    simp [liveTiePoint, Normal.DividesCriterion] at hbounds
    omega
  rcases (mem_standardSet_iff S (Normal.zGenerator : Normal a b 0)).1
      hlive.2.2.1 with ⟨qz, hqzS, hzdiv⟩
  have hqzstd : qz ∈ standardSet S :=
    (mem_standardSet_iff S qz).2 ⟨qz, hqzS, dvd_refl qz⟩
  rw [hstd] at hqzstd
  have hzT : (Normal.zGenerator : Normal a b 0) ∣
      (⟨r, u, v, hrA⟩ : Normal a b 0) := dvd_trans hzdiv hqzstd.1
  have hv : 1 ≤ v := by
    have hz := (Normal.exact_divides_iff
      (Normal.zGenerator : Normal a b 0) (⟨r, u, v, hrA⟩ : Normal a b 0)).1 hzT
    simp [Normal.zGenerator, Normal.DividesCriterion] at hz
    omega
  have hc3 := topDeletionPure_border_card S ha hb hu hv hrA hnonempty hstd

name: P23.OneTie.mixed_base_card_ne_four
statement:
private theorem mixed_base_card_ne_four
    {S : Finset (Normal a b c)}
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hc : 1 ≤ c)
    (hcardS : S.card = 3) (hlive : IsLiveTie S)
    (hshape : TypeThreeBaseShape S) : (borderFinset S).card ≠ 4
proof:
:= by
  cases hshape with
  | topDeletion h => exact mixed_topDeletion_card_ne_four ha hb hc hcardS hlive h
  | pureFibreProduct h => simp_all [IsPureFibreProduct]
  | m2K ha' hu hv hr =>
      rw [m2K_border_card ha' hu hv hr]
      split <;> omega
  | m2Z ha' hu hv hr =>
      rw [m2Z_border_card ha' hu hv hr]
      omega
  | m3K ha' hb' hc' hv =>
      rw [m3K_border_card ha' hb' hc' hv]
      omega
  | m4Y ha' hu =>
      rw [m4Y_border_card ha' hu]
      omega
  | m5Y ha' hb' hc' hv =>
      rw [m5Y_border_card ha' hb' hc' hv]
      split <;> omega
  | m5Z ha' hb' hc' hv =>
      rw [m5Z_border_card ha' hb' hc' hv]
      omega
  | p4Z ha' hb' hV => simp_all
  | p5Z ha' hb' hv => simp_all

name: P23.OneTie.pure_base_four_residual
statement:
private theorem pure_base_four_residual
    {S : Finset (Normal a b 0)}
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 2 ≤ b)
    (hcardS : S.card = 3) (hlive : IsLiveTie S)
    (hanti : IsRootAntichain S) (hborder : (borderFinset S).card = 4)
    (hshape : TypeThreeBaseShape S) : IsPureResidualFourBorderShape S
proof:
:= by
  cases hshape with
  | topDeletion h => exact False.elim ((pure_topDeletion_card_ne_four ha hb hcardS hlive h) hborder)
  | pureFibreProduct h =>
      exact False.elim ((pureFibreProductShape_border_card_ne_four
        ha hb hcardS h hanti hlive) hborder)
  | m3K ha' hb' hc' hv =>
      omega
  | m5Y ha' hb' hc' hv =>
      omega
  | m5Z ha' hb' hc' hv =>
      omega
  | p4Z ha' hb' hV => exact Or.inl ⟨_, ha', hb', hV, rfl⟩
  | p5Z ha' hb' hv => exact Or.inr ⟨_, ha', hb', hv, rfl⟩

name: P23.OneTie.mixed_four_border_has_dominant
statement:
theorem mixed_four_border_has_dominant
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hc : 1 ≤ c)
    (hcardS : S.card = 3) (hlive : IsLiveTie S)
    (hanti : IsRootAntichain S) (hcentres : HasDirectionalCentres S)
    (hborder : (borderFinset S).card = 4) :
    ∃ C ∈ S, IsDominantRoot S C
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hdom
  push_neg at hdom
  let hcover : CoverHypotheses S :=
    { a_ge_two := ha
      live_domain := Or.inl ⟨hb, hc⟩
      live_tie := hlive
      card_ge_two := by omega
      card_le_three := by omega
      antichain := hanti
      centres := hcentres
      no_dominant := hdom }
  have hshape := h5_typeThree_specialized_cover S hcover hcardS
  cases hshape with
  | direct h => exact (mixed_base_card_ne_four ha hb hc hcardS hlive h) hborder
  | reflected hb' hc' h =>
      have hcardSwap : (borderFinset (swapYZFinset S)).card = 4 := by
        rw [borderFinset_swapYZ_card]
        exact hborder
      have hcardRoots : (swapYZFinset S).card = 3 := by
        simpa [swapYZFinset] using hcardS
      have hliveSwap : IsLiveTie (swapYZFinset S) := by
        exact (coverHypotheses_swapYZ hcover hb hc).live_tie
      exact (mixed_base_card_ne_four ha hc hb hcardRoots hliveSwap h) hcardSwap

name: P23.OneTie.pure_four_border_dominant_or_residual
statement:
theorem pure_four_border_dominant_or_residual
    (S : Finset (Normal a b 0))
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 2 ≤ b)
    (hcardS : S.card = 3) (hlive : IsLiveTie S)
    (hanti : IsRootAntichain S) (hcentres : HasDirectionalCentres S)
    (hborder : (borderFinset S).card = 4) :
    (∃ C ∈ S, IsDominantRoot S C) ∨ IsPureResidualFourBorderShape S
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hdom : ∃ C ∈ S, IsDominantRoot S C
  · exact Or.inl hdom
  · right
    push_neg at hdom
    let hcover : CoverHypotheses S :=
      { a_ge_two := ha
        live_domain := Or.inr ⟨hb, rfl⟩
        live_tie := hlive
        card_ge_two := by omega
        card_le_three := by omega
        antichain := hanti
        centres := hcentres
        no_dominant := hdom }
    have hshape := h5_typeThree_specialized_cover S hcover hcardS
    cases hshape with
    | direct h => exact pure_base_four_residual ha hb hcardS hlive hanti hborder h
    | reflected hb' hc' h => omega

name: P23.OneTie.mixed_live_border_card_ge_two
statement:
theorem mixed_live_border_card_ge_two (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (hS : S.Nonempty) (hd : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) (hc : 0 < c) :
    2 ≤ (borderFinset S).card
proof:
:= by
  have hb : 0 < b := by rcases hd.2 with hm | hp <;> omega
  obtain ⟨B,hB,hY⟩ := mixed_pure_y_border_exists S hS hd hc
  obtain ⟨C,hC,hZ⟩ := pure_z_border_exists S hS hd hb
  have hn : (yAxis B : Normal a b c) ≠ zAxis C := by
    intro he; have := congrArg Normal.y he; simp [yAxis,zAxis] at this; omega
  have hsub : ({yAxis B,zAxis C} : Finset (Normal a b c)) ⊆ borderFinset S := by
    intro p hp; simp only [Finset.mem_insert,Finset.mem_singleton] at hp
    rcases hp with rfl | rfl <;> assumption
  simpa [hn] using Finset.card_le_card hsub

name: P23.OneTie.pure_live_border_card_ge_two
statement:
theorem pure_live_border_card_ge_two (S : Finset (Normal a b 0))
    (hS : S.Nonempty) (hd : IsLiveParameterDomain a b 0) :
    2 ≤ (borderFinset S).card
proof:
:= by
  have hb : 0 < b := by rcases hd.2 with hm | hp <;> omega
  obtain ⟨C,hC,hZ⟩ := pure_z_border_exists S hS hd hb
  let B := S.sup Normal.y + 1
  have hk : (yAxis B : Normal a b 0) ∉ standardSet S := by
    rintro ⟨s,hs,hdiv⟩
    have hy := ((Normal.exact_divides_iff _ _).mp hdiv).1
    have hh := Finset.le_sup (f := Normal.y) hs
    change B ≤ s.y at hy
    dsimp [B] at hy
    omega
  obtain ⟨g,hg,hgp⟩ := killed_has_border_divisor S hS hd (yAxis B) hk
  have hz : g.z = 0 := by
    have hh := ((Normal.exact_divides_iff _ _).mp hgp).2.1
    change g.z ≤ 0 at hh
    omega
  have hn : g ≠ zAxis C := by
    intro he; have := congrArg Normal.z he; simp [zAxis,hz] at this; omega
  have hsub : ({g,zAxis C} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) ⊆ borderFinset S := by
    intro p hp; simp only [Finset.mem_insert,Finset.mem_singleton] at hp
    rcases hp with rfl | rfl <;> assumption
  simpa [hn] using Finset.card_le_card hsub

name: P23.OneTie.live_one_tie_border_card_ge_two
statement:
theorem live_one_tie_border_card_ge_two (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (hS : S.Nonempty) (hd : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) (_hl : IsLiveTie S) :
    2 ≤ (borderFinset S).card
proof:
:= by
  rcases hd.2 with hm | hp
  · exact mixed_live_border_card_ge_two S hS hd (by omega)
  · obtain ⟨_,rfl⟩ := hp
    exact pure_live_border_card_ge_two S hS hd

name: P23.OneTie.two_border_eq_pair
proof:
:= by
  apply (Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le ?_ ?_).symm
  · intro t ht

    rcases ht with rfl | rfl <;> assumption
  · simp [hc,hn]

name: P23.OneTie.singleton_normal_root_antichain
statement:
theorem singleton_normal_root_antichain (R : Normal a b c) :
    IsRootAntichain ({R} : Finset (Normal a b c))

name: P23.OneTie.mixed_live_two_border_root_card_one
statement:
theorem mixed_live_two_border_root_card_one (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (hS : S.Nonempty) (hd : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) (hl : IsLiveTie S)
    (ha : IsRootAntichain S) (hc : 0 < c) (hg : (borderFinset S).card = 2) :
    S.card = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hb : 0 < b := by rcases hd.2 with hm | hp <;> omega
  obtain ⟨B,hB,hY⟩ := mixed_pure_y_border_exists S hS hd hc
  obtain ⟨C,hC,hZ⟩ := pure_z_border_exists S hS hd hb
  have hn : (yAxis B : Normal a b c) ≠ zAxis C := by
    intro he; have := congrArg Normal.y he; simp [yAxis,zAxis] at this; omega
  have he := two_border_eq_pair hg hY hZ hn
  have hbB : b < B := by
    by_contra hn
    have hdv : yAxis B ∣ (liveTiePoint : Normal a b c) :=
      (Normal.exact_divides_iff _ _).mpr (by simp [Normal.DividesCriterion,yAxis,liveTiePoint]; omega)
    exact ((mem_borderFinset_iff hS _).mp hY).1 (standardSet_dvd_closed S hl.2.2.2 hdv)
  have hcC : c < C := by
    by_contra hn
    have hdv : zAxis C ∣ (liveTiePoint : Normal a b c) :=
      (Normal.exact_divides_iff _ _).mpr (by simp [Normal.DividesCriterion,zAxis,liveTiePoint]; omega)
    exact ((mem_borderFinset_iff hS _).mp hZ).1 (standardSet_dvd_closed S hl.2.2.2 hdv)
  let R : Normal a b c := mixedCore (a-1) (B-1) (C-1) (by have := hd.1; omega)
  have hp : borderFinset ({R} : Finset (Normal a b c)) = {yAxis B,zAxis C} := by
    rw [mixedPrincipalBorder_last hd.1 (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) rfl]
    have hYeq : mixedY (a:=a) (b:=b) (c:=c) (B-1) = yAxis B := by
      apply Normal.ext <;> simp [mixedY,yAxis] <;> omega
    have hZeq : mixedZ (a:=a) (b:=b) (c:=c) (C-1) = zAxis C := by
      apply Normal.ext <;> simp [mixedZ,zAxis] <;> omega
    rw [hYeq,hZeq]
  have hs := standardSet_eq_of_borderFinset_eq hS (by simp : ({R} : Finset _).Nonempty)
    hd (he.trans hp.symm)
  have hr := rootFinset_eq_of_standardSet_eq hd ha (singleton_normal_root_antichain R) hs
  rw [hr]
  simp

name: P23.OneTie.pure_live_two_border_root_card_one
statement:
theorem pure_live_two_border_root_card_one (S : Finset (Normal a b 0))
    (hS : S.Nonempty) (hd : IsLiveParameterDomain a b 0) (hl : IsLiveTie S)
    (ha : IsRootAntichain S) (hg : (borderFinset S).card = 2) : S.card = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hb : 2 ≤ b := by rcases hd.2 with hm | hp <;> omega
  obtain ⟨C,hC,hZ⟩ := pure_z_border_exists S hS hd (by omega)
  let B := S.sup Normal.y + 1
  have hk : (yAxis B : Normal a b 0) ∉ standardSet S := by
    rintro ⟨s,hs,hdiv⟩
    have hy := ((Normal.exact_divides_iff _ _).mp hdiv).1
    have hh := Finset.le_sup (f := Normal.y) hs
    change B ≤ s.y at hy
    dsimp [B] at hy
    omega
  obtain ⟨H,hH,hHd⟩ := killed_has_border_divisor S hS hd (yAxis B) hk
  have hHz : H.z = 0 := by
    have hz := ((Normal.exact_divides_iff _ _).mp hHd).2.1
    change H.z ≤ 0 at hz
    omega
  have hn : H ≠ zAxis C := by
    intro he; have := congrArg Normal.z he; simp [zAxis,hHz] at this; omega
  have he := two_border_eq_pair hg hH hZ hn
  have hnotx := border_not_pure_x hS hl hH
  have hHy : 0 < H.y := by
    by_contra hy
    have hy0 : H.y = 0 := by omega
    by_cases hx : 0 < H.x
    · exact hnotx ⟨hx,hy0,hHz⟩
    · have hone : H = 1 := by apply Normal.ext <;> simp [hy0,hHz] <;> omega
      have hz := ((mem_borderFinset_iff hS _).mp hH).1
      exact hz (hone.symm ▸ one_mem_standardSet_of_nonempty hS)
  have finish (R : Normal a b 0)
      (hp : borderFinset ({R} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) = {H,zAxis C}) : S.card = 1 := by
    have hs := standardSet_eq_of_borderFinset_eq hS (by simp : ({R} : Finset _).Nonempty)
      hd (he.trans hp.symm)
    have hr := rootFinset_eq_of_standardSet_eq hd ha (singleton_normal_root_antichain R) hs
    rw [hr]; simp
  by_cases hx : H.x = 0
  · have hB : b < H.y := by
      by_contra hn
      have hdv : H ∣ (liveTiePoint : Normal a b 0) :=
        (Normal.exact_divides_iff _ _).mpr (by simp [Normal.DividesCriterion,liveTiePoint,hx,hHz]; omega)
      exact ((mem_borderFinset_iff hS _).mp hH).1 (standardSet_dvd_closed S hl.2.2.2 hdv)
    let R : Normal a b 0 := pureCore (a-1) (H.y-1) (C-1) (by have := hd.1; omega)
    apply finish R
    rw [purePrincipalBorder_last hd.1 hb (by omega) rfl]
    have hh : pureH (a:=a) (b:=b) (a-1) (H.y-1) (by have := hd.1; omega) = H := by
      apply Normal.ext <;> simp [pureH,hx,hHz] <;> omega
    have hz : pureZ (a:=a) (b:=b) (C-1) = zAxis C := by
      apply Normal.ext <;> simp [pureZ,zAxis] <;> omega
    rw [hh,hz]
  · have hpos : 0 < H.x := by omega
    let r := H.x-1
    let u := H.y+b-1
    have hr : r < a-1 := by have := H.x_lt; dsimp [r]; omega
    have hu : b ≤ u := by dsimp [u]; omega
    let R : Normal a b 0 := pureCore r u (C-1) (by omega)
    apply finish R
    rw [purePrincipalBorder_below hd.1 hb hu hr]
    have hh : pureH (a:=a) (b:=b) r u (by omega) = H := by
      apply Normal.ext <;> simp [pureH,hr,r,u,hHz] <;> omega
    have hz : pureZ (a:=a) (b:=b) (C-1) = zAxis C := by
      apply Normal.ext <;> simp [pureZ,zAxis] <;> omega
    rw [hh,hz]

name: P23.OneTie.live_two_border_root_card_one
statement:
theorem live_two_border_root_card_one (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (hS : S.Nonempty) (hd : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) (hl : IsLiveTie S)
    (ha : IsRootAntichain S) (hg : (borderFinset S).card = 2) : S.card = 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases hd.2 with hm | hp
  · exact mixed_live_two_border_root_card_one S hS hd hl ha (by omega) hg
  · obtain ⟨_,rfl⟩ := hp
    exact pure_live_two_border_root_card_one S hS hd hl ha hg

name: P23.OneTie.live_two_border_quotient_type_eq_one
statement:
theorem live_two_border_quotient_type_eq_one (k : Type*) [Field k]
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hd : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) (hl : IsLiveTie S)
    (ha : IsRootAntichain S) (hg : (borderFinset S).card = 2) :
    quotientType k S hS hd hl = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [quotientType_eq_rootCard S hS hd hl ha]
  exact live_two_border_root_card_one S hS hd hl ha hg

name: P23.OneTie.standardSet_dvd_closed
statement:
theorem standardSet_dvd_closed (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    {p q : Normal a b c} (hq : q ∈ standardSet S) (hpq : p ∣ q) :
    p ∈ standardSet S
proof:
:= by
  rcases (mem_standardSet_iff S q).1 hq with ⟨s, hs, hqs⟩
  exact (mem_standardSet_iff S p).2 ⟨s, hs, dvd_trans hpq hqs⟩

name: P23.OneTie.properDivisor_factors_through_predecessor
statement:
theorem properDivisor_factors_through_predecessor
    {d m : Normal a b c} (hdm : d ∣ m) (hne : d ≠ m) :
    ∃ e q, Normal.predecessor e m = some q ∧ d ∣ q
proof:
:= by
  rcases hdm with ⟨t, rfl⟩
  have ht : t ≠ 1 := by
    intro ht
    subst t
    exact hne (by simp)
  rcases exists_predecessor_of_ne_one t ht with ⟨e, q, hpred⟩
  have hmul : q * e.generator = t :=
    (Normal.predecessor_eq_some_iff_mul e t q).1 hpred
  refine ⟨e, d * q, ?_, ⟨q, rfl⟩⟩
  apply (Normal.predecessor_eq_some_iff_mul e (d * t) (d * q)).2
  simp only [mul_assoc, hmul]

name: P23.OneTie.variableGenerators_ne_one_of_two_le
statement:
theorem variableGenerators_ne_one_of_two_le (ha : 2 ≤ a) :
    ∀ e : Direction, (e.generator : Normal a b c) ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  intro e heq
  cases e with
  | x =>
      have hx := congrArg Normal.x heq
      simp [Direction.generator, Normal.xGenerator, show a ≠ 1 by omega] at hx
  | y =>
      have hy := congrArg Normal.y heq
      simp [Direction.generator, Normal.yGenerator] at hy
  | z =>
      have hz := congrArg Normal.z heq
      simp [Direction.generator, Normal.zGenerator] at hz

name: P23.OneTie.isMinimalBorder_iff_isDivisibilityMinimalKilled
statement:
theorem isMinimalBorder_iff_isDivisibilityMinimalKilled
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (m : Normal a b c)
    (hgen : ∀ e : Direction, (e.generator : Normal a b c) ≠ 1) :
    IsMinimalBorder (standardSet S) m ↔
      IsDivisibilityMinimalKilled (standardSet S) m
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hm
    refine ⟨hm.1, ?_⟩
    intro d hdm hne
    rcases properDivisor_factors_through_predecessor hdm hne with
      ⟨e, q, hpred, hdq⟩
    have hq : q ∈ standardSet S :=
      ((isMinimalBorder_iff (standardSet S) m).1 hm).2 e q hpred
    exact standardSet_dvd_closed S hq hdq
  · rintro ⟨hm, hproper⟩
    apply (isMinimalBorder_iff (standardSet S) m).2
    refine ⟨hm, ?_⟩
    intro e q hpred
    have hmul : q * e.generator = m :=
      (Normal.predecessor_eq_some_iff_mul e m q).1 hpred
    have hqm : q ∣ m := ⟨e.generator, hmul.symm⟩
    have hne : q ≠ m := by
      intro hq
      subst q
      apply hgen e
      apply Normal.mul_left_cancel (p := m)
      simpa using hmul
    exact hproper q hqm hne

name: P23.OneTie.mixed_isMinimalBorder_iff_isDivisibilityMinimalKilled
statement:
theorem mixed_isMinimalBorder_iff_isDivisibilityMinimalKilled
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (m : Normal a b c)
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (_hb : 1 ≤ b) (_hc : 1 ≤ c) :
    IsMinimalBorder (standardSet S) m ↔
      IsDivisibilityMinimalKilled (standardSet S) m
proof:
:=
  isMinimalBorder_iff_isDivisibilityMinimalKilled S m
    (variableGenerators_ne_one_of_two_le ha)

name: P23.OneTie.pure_isMinimalBorder_iff_isDivisibilityMinimalKilled
statement:
theorem pure_isMinimalBorder_iff_isDivisibilityMinimalKilled
    (S : Finset (Normal a b 0)) (m : Normal a b 0)
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (_hb : 2 ≤ b) :
    IsMinimalBorder (standardSet S) m ↔
      IsDivisibilityMinimalKilled (standardSet S) m
proof:
:=
  isMinimalBorder_iff_isDivisibilityMinimalKilled S m
    (variableGenerators_ne_one_of_two_le ha)

name: P23.OneTie.standardSet_eq_of_borderFinset_eq
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  rw [standard_iff_no_border_divisor S hS hd,
    standard_iff_no_border_divisor T hT hd,he]

name: P23.OneTie.rootFinset_eq_of_standardSet_eq
proof:
:=
  Finset.Subset.antisymm (roots_subset_of_standardSet_eq hd hS he)
    (roots_subset_of_standardSet_eq hd hT he.symm)

name: P23.OneTie.Normal.exact_divides_iff
statement:
theorem exact_divides_iff (p s : Normal a b c) :
    p ∣ s ↔ DividesCriterion p s
proof:
:= by
  have ha : 0 < a := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne a)
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨q, rfl⟩
    unfold DividesCriterion
    have hp_lt := p.x_lt
    have hq_lt := q.x_lt
    have hsum_lt : p.x + q.x < 2 * a := by omega
    by_cases hnowrap : p.x + q.x < a
    · have hdiv : (p.x + q.x) / a = 0 := Nat.div_eq_of_lt hnowrap
      have hmod : (p.x + q.x) % a = p.x + q.x := Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hnowrap
      simp only [mul_x, mul_y, mul_z, hdiv, hmod, Nat.zero_mul, Nat.add_zero]
      exact ⟨by omega, by omega, Or.inl (by omega)⟩
    · have hdiv : (p.x + q.x) / a = 1 := by
        apply Nat.div_eq_of_lt_le
        · omega
        · omega
      have hdecomp := Nat.mod_add_div (p.x + q.x) a
      rw [hdiv] at hdecomp
      have hmod : (p.x + q.x) % a = p.x + q.x - a := by omega
      simp only [mul_x, mul_y, mul_z, hdiv, hmod, Nat.one_mul]
      exact ⟨by omega, by omega, Or.inr ⟨by omega, by omega⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨hy, hz, hx⟩
    by_cases hordinary : p.x ≤ s.x
    · let q : Normal a b c :=
        ⟨s.x - p.x, s.y - p.y, s.z - p.z, by have := s.x_lt; omega⟩
      refine ⟨q, ?_⟩
      have hsum : p.x + q.x = s.x := by
        simpa [q] using Nat.add_sub_of_le hordinary
      have hdiv : (p.x + q.x) / a = 0 := by rw [hsum]; exact Nat.div_eq_of_lt s.x_lt
      have hmod : (p.x + q.x) % a = s.x := by rw [hsum]; exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt s.x_lt
      apply Normal.ext
      · simp [hmod]
      · simp [q, hdiv]
        omega
      · simp [q, hdiv]
        omega
    · rcases hx with hx | hwrap
      · omega
      · let q : Normal a b c :=
          ⟨a + s.x - p.x, s.y - p.y - b, s.z - p.z - c, by omega⟩
        refine ⟨q, ?_⟩
        have hp_lt := p.x_lt
        have hsum : p.x + q.x = a + s.x := by simp [q]; omega
        have hsdiv : s.x / a = 0 := Nat.div_eq_of_lt s.x_lt
        have hsmod : s.x % a = s.x := Nat.mod_eq_of_lt s.x_lt
        have hdiv : (p.x + q.x) / a = 1 := by
          rw [hsum, Nat.add_div_left s.x ha, hsdiv]
        have hmod : (p.x + q.x) % a = s.x := by
          rw [hsum, Nat.add_mod_left, hsmod]
        apply Normal.ext
        · simp [hmod]
        · simp [q, hdiv]
          omega
        · simp [q, hdiv]
          omega

name: P23.OneTie.Normal.yPredecessor_mul
statement:
theorem yPredecessor_mul (p : Normal a b c) (hy : 0 < p.y) :
    yPredecessor p hy * yGenerator = p
proof:
:= by
  have hdiv : p.x / a = 0 := Nat.div_eq_of_lt p.x_lt
  have hmod : p.x % a = p.x := Nat.mod_eq_of_lt p.x_lt
  apply Normal.ext
  · simp [yPredecessor, yGenerator, hmod]
  · simp [yPredecessor, yGenerator, hdiv]
    omega
  · simp [yPredecessor, yGenerator, hdiv]

name: P23.OneTie.Normal.zPredecessor_mul
statement:
theorem zPredecessor_mul (p : Normal a b c) (hz : 0 < p.z) :
    zPredecessor p hz * zGenerator = p
proof:
:= by
  have hdiv : p.x / a = 0 := Nat.div_eq_of_lt p.x_lt
  have hmod : p.x % a = p.x := Nat.mod_eq_of_lt p.x_lt
  apply Normal.ext
  · simp [zPredecessor, zGenerator, hmod]
  · simp [zPredecessor, zGenerator, hdiv]
  · simp [zPredecessor, zGenerator, hdiv]
    omega

name: P23.OneTie.Normal.xPredecessor_mul
statement:
theorem xPredecessor_mul (p : Normal a b c) (hx : 0 < p.x) :
    xPredecessor p hx * xGenerator = p
proof:
:= by
  have ha2 : 2 ≤ a := by have := p.x_lt; omega
  have ha1 : a ≠ 1 := by omega
  have hsum : p.x - 1 + 1 = p.x := by omega
  have hdiv : (p.x - 1 + 1) / a = 0 := by
    rw [hsum]
    exact Nat.div_eq_of_lt p.x_lt
  have hmod : (p.x - 1 + 1) % a = p.x := by
    rw [hsum]
    exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt p.x_lt
  apply Normal.ext <;> simp [xPredecessor, xGenerator, ha1, hdiv, hmod]

name: P23.OneTie.Normal.wrappedXPredecessor_mul
statement:
theorem wrappedXPredecessor_mul (p : Normal a b c)
    (hpx : p.x = 0) (hy : b ≤ p.y) (hz : c ≤ p.z) :
    wrappedXPredecessor p hpx hy hz * xGenerator = p
proof:
:= by
  have ha : 0 < a := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne a)
  by_cases ha1 : a = 1
  · subst a
    apply Normal.ext <;> simp [wrappedXPredecessor, xGenerator, hpx] <;> omega
  · have ha2 : 2 ≤ a := by omega
    have hsum : a - 1 + 1 = a := by omega
    have hdiv : (a - 1 + 1) / a = 1 := by simp [hsum, ha]
    have hmod : (a - 1 + 1) % a = 0 := by simp [hsum]
    apply Normal.ext
    · simp [wrappedXPredecessor, xGenerator, ha1, hmod, hpx]
    · simp [wrappedXPredecessor, xGenerator, ha1, hdiv]
      omega
    · simp [wrappedXPredecessor, xGenerator, ha1, hdiv]
      omega

name: P23.OneTie.Normal.yPredecessor_unique
statement:
theorem yPredecessor_unique (p : Normal a b c) (hy : 0 < p.y)
    (q : Normal a b c) (hq : q * yGenerator = p) : q = yPredecessor p hy
proof:
:= by
  have hxq : q.x = p.x := by
    have h := congrArg Normal.x hq
    simpa [yGenerator, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt q.x_lt] using h
  have hyq : q.y + 1 = p.y := by
    have h := congrArg Normal.y hq
    simpa [yGenerator, Nat.div_eq_of_lt q.x_lt] using h
  have hzq : q.z = p.z := by
    have h := congrArg Normal.z hq
    simpa [yGenerator, Nat.div_eq_of_lt q.x_lt] using h
  apply Normal.ext
  · simp [yPredecessor, hxq]
  · simp [yPredecessor]
    omega
  · simp [yPredecessor, hzq]

name: P23.OneTie.Normal.zPredecessor_unique
statement:
theorem zPredecessor_unique (p : Normal a b c) (hz : 0 < p.z)
    (q : Normal a b c) (hq : q * zGenerator = p) : q = zPredecessor p hz
proof:
:= by
  have hxq : q.x = p.x := by
    have h := congrArg Normal.x hq
    simpa [zGenerator, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt q.x_lt] using h
  have hyq : q.y = p.y := by
    have h := congrArg Normal.y hq
    simpa [zGenerator, Nat.div_eq_of_lt q.x_lt] using h
  have hzq : q.z + 1 = p.z := by
    have h := congrArg Normal.z hq
    simpa [zGenerator, Nat.div_eq_of_lt q.x_lt] using h
  apply Normal.ext
  · simp [zPredecessor, hxq]
  · simp [zPredecessor, hyq]
  · simp [zPredecessor]
    omega

name: P23.OneTie.Normal.xPredecessor_unique
statement:
theorem xPredecessor_unique (p : Normal a b c) (hx : 0 < p.x)
    (q : Normal a b c) (hq : q * xGenerator = p) : q = xPredecessor p hx
proof:
:= by
  have ha2 : 2 ≤ a := by have := p.x_lt; omega
  have ha1 : a ≠ 1 := by omega
  have hqx_lt := q.x_lt
  have hle : q.x + 1 ≤ a := by omega
  have hxcoord := congrArg Normal.x hq
  have hnowrap : q.x + 1 < a := by
    by_contra h
    have heq : q.x + 1 = a := by omega
    simp [xGenerator, ha1, heq] at hxcoord
    omega
  have hdiv : (q.x + 1) / a = 0 := Nat.div_eq_of_lt hnowrap
  have hmod : (q.x + 1) % a = q.x + 1 := Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hnowrap
  have hxq : q.x + 1 = p.x := by
    simpa [xGenerator, ha1, hmod] using hxcoord
  have hyq : q.y = p.y := by
    have h := congrArg Normal.y hq
    simpa [xGenerator, ha1, hdiv] using h
  have hzq : q.z = p.z := by
    have h := congrArg Normal.z hq
    simpa [xGenerator, ha1, hdiv] using h
  apply Normal.ext
  · simp [xPredecessor]
    omega
  · simp [xPredecessor, hyq]
  · simp [xPredecessor, hzq]

name: P23.OneTie.Normal.wrappedXPredecessor_unique
statement:
theorem wrappedXPredecessor_unique (p : Normal a b c)
    (hpx : p.x = 0) (hy : b ≤ p.y) (hz : c ≤ p.z)
    (q : Normal a b c) (hq : q * xGenerator = p) :
    q = wrappedXPredecessor p hpx hy hz
proof:
:= by
  have ha : 0 < a := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne a)
  by_cases ha1 : a = 1
  · subst a
    have hqx : q.x = 0 := by have := q.x_lt; omega
    have hyq := congrArg Normal.y hq
    have hzq := congrArg Normal.z hq
    apply Normal.ext
    · simp [wrappedXPredecessor, hqx]
    · simp [xGenerator, hqx] at hyq
      simp [wrappedXPredecessor]
      omega
    · simp [xGenerator, hqx] at hzq
      simp [wrappedXPredecessor]
      omega
  · have ha2 : 2 ≤ a := by omega
    have hqx_lt := q.x_lt
    have hle : q.x + 1 ≤ a := by omega
    have hxcoord := congrArg Normal.x hq
    have hsum : q.x + 1 = a := by
      by_contra h
      have hlt : q.x + 1 < a := by omega
      have hmod : (q.x + 1) % a = q.x + 1 := Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hlt
      simp [xGenerator, ha1, hmod, hpx] at hxcoord
    have hdiv : (q.x + 1) / a = 1 := by simp [hsum, ha]
    have hyq : q.y + b = p.y := by
      have h := congrArg Normal.y hq
      simpa [xGenerator, ha1, hdiv] using h
    have hzq : q.z + c = p.z := by
      have h := congrArg Normal.z hq
      simpa [xGenerator, ha1, hdiv] using h
    apply Normal.ext
    · simp [wrappedXPredecessor]
      omega
    · simp [wrappedXPredecessor]
      omega
    · simp [wrappedXPredecessor]
      omega

name: P23.OneTie.Normal.yGenerator_dvd_iff
statement:
theorem yGenerator_dvd_iff (p : Normal a b c) :
    yGenerator ∣ p ↔ 0 < p.y
proof:
:= by
  rw [exact_divides_iff]
  simp [DividesCriterion, yGenerator]
  omega

name: P23.OneTie.Normal.zGenerator_dvd_iff
statement:
theorem zGenerator_dvd_iff (p : Normal a b c) :
    zGenerator ∣ p ↔ 0 < p.z
proof:
:= by
  rw [exact_divides_iff]
  simp [DividesCriterion, zGenerator]
  omega

name: P23.OneTie.Normal.xGenerator_dvd_iff
statement:
theorem xGenerator_dvd_iff (p : Normal a b c) :
    xGenerator ∣ p ↔ 0 < p.x ∨ (b ≤ p.y ∧ c ≤ p.z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [exact_divides_iff]
  have ha : 0 < a := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne a)
  by_cases ha1 : a = 1
  · subst a
    have hpx : p.x = 0 := by have := p.x_lt; omega
    simp [DividesCriterion, xGenerator, hpx]
  · simp [DividesCriterion, xGenerator, ha1]
    omega

name: P23.OneTie.Normal.predecessor_eq_some_iff_mul
statement:
theorem predecessor_eq_some_iff_mul (e : Direction) (s q : Normal a b c) :
    predecessor e s = some q ↔ q * e.generator = s
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    cases e with
    | x =>
        simp only [predecessor] at h
        split at h
        next hx =>
          simp only [Option.some.injEq] at h
          subst q
          exact xPredecessor_mul s hx
        next hx =>
          split at h
          next hw =>
            simp only [Option.some.injEq] at h
            subst q
            exact wrappedXPredecessor_mul s (by omega) hw.1 hw.2
          next => contradiction
    | y =>
        simp only [predecessor] at h
        split at h
        next hy =>
          simp only [Option.some.injEq] at h
          subst q
          exact yPredecessor_mul s hy
        next => contradiction
    | z =>
        simp only [predecessor] at h
        split at h
        next hz =>
          simp only [Option.some.injEq] at h
          subst q
          exact zPredecessor_mul s hz
        next => contradiction
  · intro h
    cases e with
    | x =>
        by_cases hx : 0 < s.x
        · rw [predecessor_x_of_pos s hx]
          congr
          exact (xPredecessor_unique s hx q h).symm
        · have hsx : s.x = 0 := by omega
          have hdvd : xGenerator ∣ s := by
            refine ⟨q, ?_⟩
            rw [mul_comm]
            exact h.symm
          have hw : b ≤ s.y ∧ c ≤ s.z := by
            rcases (xGenerator_dvd_iff s).1 hdvd with hpos | hwrap
            · omega
            · exact hwrap
          rw [predecessor_x_wrapped s hsx hw.1 hw.2]
          congr
          exact (wrappedXPredecessor_unique s hsx hw.1 hw.2 q h).symm
    | y =>
        have hy : 0 < s.y := by
          have hdvd : yGenerator ∣ s := by
            refine ⟨q, ?_⟩
            rw [mul_comm]
            exact h.symm
          exact (yGenerator_dvd_iff s).1 hdvd
        rw [predecessor_y_of_pos s hy]
        congr
        exact (yPredecessor_unique s hy q h).symm
    | z =>
        have hz : 0 < s.z := by
          have hdvd : zGenerator ∣ s := by
            refine ⟨q, ?_⟩
            rw [mul_comm]
            exact h.symm
          exact (zGenerator_dvd_iff s).1 hdvd
        rw [predecessor_z_of_pos s hz]
        congr
        exact (zPredecessor_unique s hz q h).symm

name: P23.OneTie.Normal.predecessor_isSome_iff_dvd
statement:
theorem predecessor_isSome_iff_dvd (e : Direction) (s : Normal a b c) :
    (predecessor e s).isSome ↔ e.generator ∣ s
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases Option.isSome_iff_exists.mp h with ⟨q, hq⟩
    refine ⟨q, ?_⟩
    rw [mul_comm]
    exact (predecessor_eq_some_iff_mul e s q).1 hq |>.symm
  · rintro ⟨q, hq⟩
    apply Option.isSome_iff_exists.mpr
    refine ⟨q, (predecessor_eq_some_iff_mul e s q).2 ?_⟩
    rw [mul_comm]
    exact hq.symm

name: P23.OneTie.exact_divides_iff
statement:

    (p s : Normal a b c) : p ∣ s ↔ Normal.DividesCriterion p s
proof:
:=

name: P23.OneTie.pure_three_border_reoriented_residual
statement:
theorem pure_three_border_reoriented_residual (S : Finset (Normal a b 0))
    (hS : S.Nonempty) (hd : IsLiveParameterDomain a b 0) (hl : IsLiveTie S)
    (ha : IsRootAntichain S) (ht : quotientType ℚ S hS hd hl = 3)
    (hcard : (borderFinset S).card = 3)
    (hnf : ∀ q ∈ borderFinset S, ¬NormalHasFullSupport q)
    (hn : QuotientNearlyGorenstein ℚ S hS hd hl) : Nonempty (ReorientedPureResidual S)
proof:
:= by
  have hb : 2 ≤ b := by rcases hd.2 with hm | hp <;> omega
  rcases pure_three_border_support_classification S hS hd hl ha ht hcard hnf with hP | hP
  · obtain ⟨P⟩ := hP
    obtain ⟨R⟩ := pure_three_border_ng_residual P hS hd hl ha ht hn
    refine ⟨⟨a,b,hd.1,hb,S,R,hS,ha,hl,ht,hn,AlgEquiv.refl,
      Equiv.refl _,false,rfl,MulEquiv.refl _,fun _ => Iff.rfl,fun _ => rfl,?_⟩⟩
    intro p
    simp [polynomialLift,finitePolynomialQuotientEquiv_monomial]
  · letI : NeZero b := ⟨by omega⟩
    obtain ⟨P⟩ := hP
    obtain ⟨P'⟩ := pureXZ_reoriented_threeBorder S P hS hd hl ha ht hcard
    have hS' : (pureSwapXYFinset S).Nonempty := by
      obtain ⟨s,hs⟩ := hS
      exact ⟨pureSwapXY s,Finset.mem_map.mpr ⟨s,hs,rfl⟩⟩
    have hd' : IsLiveParameterDomain b a 0 := ⟨hb,Or.inr ⟨hd.1,rfl⟩⟩
    have hl' := pureSwapXYLive S hd.1 hb hl
    have ha' := pureSwapXYAntichain S ha
    have ht' : quotientType ℚ (pureSwapXYFinset S) hS' hd' hl' = 3 := by
      rw [quotientType_eq_rootCard _ _ _ _ ha',pureSwapXYFinset,normalEquivFinset,Finset.card_map]
      exact (quotientType_eq_three_iff S hS hd hl ha).mp ht
    have hn' : QuotientNearlyGorenstein ℚ (pureSwapXYFinset S) hS' hd' hl' := by
      apply (quotientNearlyGorenstein_iff_directNearlyGorenstein _ _ _ _).mpr
      apply (directNearlyGorenstein_iff_variablesInTrace _ _ _ _).mpr
      apply pureSwapXYVariablesInTrace S hd.1 hb hl
      exact (directNearlyGorenstein_iff_variablesInTrace S hS hd hl).mp
        ((quotientNearlyGorenstein_iff_directNearlyGorenstein S hS hd hl).mp hn)
    obtain ⟨R⟩ := pure_three_border_ng_residual P' hS' hd' hl' ha' ht' hn'
    let E := (finitePolynomialQuotientEquiv (k := ℚ) S hS hd).trans
      ((pureSwapXYDirectEquiv S).trans (finitePolynomialQuotientEquiv (k := ℚ)
        (pureSwapXYFinset S) hS' hd').symm)
    refine ⟨⟨b,a,hb,hd.1,pureSwapXYFinset S,R,hS',ha',hl',ht',hn',E,
      Equiv.swap 0 1,true,rfl,pureSwapXYMulEquiv,
      normalEquiv_standard_iff pureSwapXYMulEquiv S,?_,?_⟩⟩
    · intro j
      have ha1 : a ≠ 1 := by have := hd.1; omega
      have hb1 : b ≠ 1 := by omega
      have hbL : 1 < b := by omega
      fin_cases j <;> simp [coordinateGenerator,Equiv.swap_apply_def,pureSwapXYMulEquiv,pureSwapXY,
        rawSwapXY,Normal.raw,Normal.normalize,Normal.xGenerator,Normal.yGenerator,
        Normal.zGenerator,ha1,hb1,Nat.div_eq_of_lt hbL,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hbL]
    · intro p
      dsimp [E]
      rw [AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
      have hh : finitePolynomialQuotientEquiv (k := ℚ) S hS hd
          (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (polynomialLift (k := ℚ) p)) = truncatedMonomial (k := ℚ) S p := by
        simp [polynomialLift,finitePolynomialQuotientEquiv_monomial]
      rw [hh]
      exact normalModelCongr_truncated pureSwapXYMulEquiv
        (normalEquiv_standard_iff pureSwapXYMulEquiv S) p

name: P23.OneTie.three_border_ng_reoriented_residual
statement:
theorem three_border_ng_reoriented_residual (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (hS : S.Nonempty) (hd : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) (hl : IsLiveTie S)
    (ha : IsRootAntichain S) (ht : quotientType ℚ S hS hd hl = 3)
    (hcard : (borderFinset S).card = 3)
    (hnf : ∀ q ∈ borderFinset S, ¬NormalHasFullSupport q)
    (hn : QuotientNearlyGorenstein ℚ S hS hd hl) : Nonempty (ReorientedPureResidual S)
proof:
:= by
  cases c with
  | zero => exact pure_three_border_reoriented_residual S hS hd hl ha ht hcard hnf hn
  | succ c => exact False.elim (rho_four_mixed_canonical_impossible S hS hd hl ha
      (by omega) ht hcard hnf hn)

name: P23.OneTie.pure_three_border_standard_slices
statement:
theorem pure_three_border_standard_slices {S : Finset (Normal a b 0)}
    (P : PureThreeBorderData S) (hS : S.Nonempty) (hd : IsLiveParameterDomain a b 0)
    (p : Normal a b 0) : p ∈ standardSet S ↔
      p.y < P.u+b ∧ p.z < P.C ∧ (p.x < P.r ∨ p.y < P.u) ∧
        (p.y < P.v ∨ p.z < P.w)
proof:
:= by
  rw [standard_iff_no_border_divisor S hS hd p,P.border]
  simp [Normal.exact_divides_iff,Normal.DividesCriterion,zAxis]
  omega

name: P23.OneTie.pure_three_border_roots_exact
proof:
:= by
  have hanti' : IsRootAntichain P.threeRoots := by
    intro s hs t ht hne hdiv
    simp only [PureThreeBorderData.threeRoots,Finset.mem_insert,Finset.mem_singleton] at hs ht
    rcases hs with rfl | rfl | rfl <;> rcases ht with rfl | rfl | rfl
    all_goals try exact hne rfl
    all_goals have hh := (Normal.exact_divides_iff _ _).mp hdiv
    all_goals simp only [Normal.DividesCriterion,PureThreeBorderData.xRoot,
      PureThreeBorderData.yRoot,PureThreeBorderData.zRoot] at hh
    all_goals
      have := P.r_pos
      have := P.r_lt
      have := P.b_pos
      have := P.u_pos
      have := P.v_pos
      have := P.v_lt
      have := P.w_pos
      have := P.w_lt
      omega
  apply roots_eq_of_standardSet_eq hd hanti hanti'
  ext p
  rw [pure_three_border_standard_slices P hS hd]
  have := P.r_pos
  have := P.r_lt
  have := P.b_pos
  have := P.u_pos
  have := P.v_pos
  have := P.v_lt
  have := P.w_pos
  have := P.w_lt
  have hx := p.x_lt
  simp [standardSet,PureThreeBorderData.threeRoots,PureThreeBorderData.xRoot,
    PureThreeBorderData.yRoot,PureThreeBorderData.zRoot,
    Normal.exact_divides_iff,Normal.DividesCriterion] <;> omega

name: P23.OneTie.pure_three_border_two_roots_exact
proof:
:= by
  have hanti' : IsRootAntichain P.twoRoots := by
    intro s hs t ht hne hdiv
    simp only [PureThreeBorderData.twoRoots,Finset.mem_insert,Finset.mem_singleton] at hs ht
    rcases hs with rfl | rfl <;> rcases ht with rfl | rfl
    all_goals try exact hne rfl
    all_goals have hh := (Normal.exact_divides_iff _ _).mp hdiv
    all_goals simp only [Normal.DividesCriterion,PureThreeBorderData.smallRoot,
      PureThreeBorderData.zRoot] at hh
    all_goals
      have := P.r_pos
      have := P.r_lt
      have := P.b_pos
      have := P.u_pos
      have := P.v_pos
      have := P.v_lt
      have := P.w_pos
      have := P.w_lt
      omega
  apply roots_eq_of_standardSet_eq hd hanti hanti'
  ext p
  rw [pure_three_border_standard_slices P hS hd]
  have := P.r_pos
  have := P.r_lt
  have := P.b_pos
  have := P.u_pos
  have := P.v_pos
  have := P.v_lt
  have := P.w_pos
  have := P.w_lt
  have hx := p.x_lt
  simp [standardSet,PureThreeBorderData.twoRoots,PureThreeBorderData.smallRoot,
    PureThreeBorderData.zRoot,Normal.exact_divides_iff,Normal.DividesCriterion] <;> omega

name: P23.OneTie.pure_three_border_type_formula
statement:
theorem pure_three_border_type_formula {S : Finset (Normal a b 0)}
    (P : PureThreeBorderData S) (hS : S.Nonempty) (hd : IsLiveParameterDomain a b 0)
    (hl : IsLiveTie S) (hanti : IsRootAntichain S) :
    quotientType ℚ S hS hd hl = 2 + if P.u < P.v then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [quotientType_eq_rootCard S hS hd hl hanti]
  by_cases huv : P.u < P.v
  · rw [if_pos huv,pure_three_border_roots_exact P hS hd hanti huv]
    have h12 : P.xRoot ≠ P.yRoot := by
      intro he
      have hh := congrArg Normal.x he
      dsimp [PureThreeBorderData.xRoot,PureThreeBorderData.yRoot] at hh
      have := P.r_pos
      have := P.r_lt
      omega
    have h13 : P.xRoot ≠ P.zRoot := by
      intro he
      have hh := congrArg Normal.x he
      dsimp [PureThreeBorderData.xRoot,PureThreeBorderData.zRoot] at hh
      have := P.r_pos
      have := P.r_lt
      omega
    have h23 : P.yRoot ≠ P.zRoot := by
      intro he
      have hh := congrArg Normal.y he
      dsimp [PureThreeBorderData.yRoot,PureThreeBorderData.zRoot] at hh
      have := P.v_pos
      have := P.v_lt
      omega
    simp [PureThreeBorderData.threeRoots,h12,h13,h23]
  · rw [if_neg huv,pure_three_border_two_roots_exact P hS hd hanti (by omega)]
    have h12 : P.smallRoot ≠ P.zRoot := by
      intro he
      have hh := congrArg Normal.x he
      dsimp [PureThreeBorderData.smallRoot,PureThreeBorderData.zRoot] at hh
      have := P.r_pos
      have := P.r_lt
      omega
    simp [PureThreeBorderData.twoRoots,h12]

name: P23.OneTie.pure_three_border_type_three_iff
statement:
theorem pure_three_border_type_three_iff {S : Finset (Normal a b 0)}
    (P : PureThreeBorderData S) (hS : S.Nonempty) (hd : IsLiveParameterDomain a b 0)
    (hl : IsLiveTie S) (hanti : IsRootAntichain S) :
    quotientType ℚ S hS hd hl = 3 ↔ P.u < P.v
proof:
:= by
  rw [pure_three_border_type_formula P hS hd hl hanti]
  split_ifs <;> omega

name: P23.OneTie.no_x_three_border_standard
statement:
theorem no_x_three_border_standard (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (hS : S.Nonempty) (hd : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) (B C u v : ℕ)
    (he : borderFinset S = {yAxis B,zAxis C,yzPoint u v}) (p : Normal a b c) :
    p ∈ standardSet S ↔ p.y < B ∧ p.z < C ∧ (p.y < u ∨ p.z < v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [standard_iff_no_border_divisor S hS hd p, he]
  simp [Normal.exact_divides_iff, Normal.DividesCriterion, yAxis,zAxis,yzPoint] <;> omega

name: P23.OneTie.no_x_three_border_roots_exact
statement:
theorem no_x_three_border_roots_exact (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (hS : S.Nonempty) (hd : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) (ha : IsRootAntichain S)
    (B C u v : ℕ) (hu : 0 < u) (huB : u < B) (hv : 0 < v) (hvC : v < C)
    (he : borderFinset S = {yAxis B,zAxis C,yzPoint u v}) :
    S = noXThreeBorderRoots B C u v
proof:
:= by
  have hanti : IsRootAntichain (noXThreeBorderRoots (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) B C u v) := by
    intro s hs t ht hne hdiv
    simp only [noXThreeBorderRoots, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hs ht
    rcases hs with rfl | rfl <;> rcases ht with rfl | rfl
    · exact hne rfl
    · have hh := (Normal.exact_divides_iff _ _).mp hdiv
      simp only [Normal.DividesCriterion] at hh
      omega
    · have hh := (Normal.exact_divides_iff _ _).mp hdiv
      simp only [Normal.DividesCriterion] at hh
      omega
    · exact hne rfl
  apply roots_eq_of_standardSet_eq hd ha hanti
  ext p
  rw [no_x_three_border_standard S hS hd B C u v he]
  have hx := p.x_lt
  simp [standardSet,noXThreeBorderRoots,Normal.exact_divides_iff,Normal.DividesCriterion] <;> omega

name: P23.OneTie.mixed_three_border_no_x_type_le_two
statement:
theorem mixed_three_border_no_x_type_le_two (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (hS : S.Nonempty) (hd : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) (hl : IsLiveTie S)
    (ha : IsRootAntichain S) (B C u v : ℕ) (hu : 0 < u) (huB : u < B)
    (hv : 0 < v) (hvC : v < C)
    (he : borderFinset S = {yAxis B,zAxis C,yzPoint u v}) :
    quotientType ℚ S hS hd hl ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [quotientType_eq_rootCard S hS hd hl ha,
    no_x_three_border_roots_exact S hS hd ha B C u v hu huB hv hvC he]
  simpa [noXThreeBorderRoots] using Finset.card_insert_le
    (⟨a-1,B-1,v-1,by have := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne a); omega⟩ : Normal a b c)
    {⟨a-1,u-1,C-1,by have := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne a); omega⟩}

name: P23.OneTie.mixed_three_border_standard_slices
statement:
theorem mixed_three_border_standard_slices {S : Finset (Normal a b c)}
    (M : MixedThreeBorderData S) (hS : S.Nonempty) (hd : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c)
    (p : Normal a b c) : p ∈ standardSet S ↔ p.y < M.B ∧ p.z < M.C ∧
      ((p.x < M.r ∧ (p.y < b ∨ p.z < c+M.v)) ∨ (M.r ≤ p.x ∧ p.z < M.v))
proof:
:= by
  rw [standard_iff_no_border_divisor S hS hd p, M.border]
  simp [Normal.exact_divides_iff,Normal.DividesCriterion,yAxis,zAxis]
  omega

name: P23.OneTie.mixed_three_border_roots_exact
statement:
theorem mixed_three_border_roots_exact {S : Finset (Normal a b c)}
    (M : MixedThreeBorderData S) (hS : S.Nonempty) (hd : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c)
    (hanti : IsRootAntichain S) (hbB : b < M.B) (hcvC : c+M.v < M.C) :
    S = M.threeRoots
proof:
:= by
  have hanti' : IsRootAntichain M.threeRoots := by
    intro s hs t ht hne hdiv
    simp only [MixedThreeBorderData.threeRoots,Finset.mem_insert,Finset.mem_singleton] at hs ht
    rcases hs with rfl | rfl | rfl <;> rcases ht with rfl | rfl | rfl
    all_goals try exact hne rfl
    all_goals have hh := (Normal.exact_divides_iff _ _).mp hdiv
    all_goals simp only [Normal.DividesCriterion,MixedThreeBorderData.highRoot,
      MixedThreeBorderData.yCornerRoot,MixedThreeBorderData.zCornerRoot] at hh
    all_goals
      have := M.r_pos
      have := M.r_lt
      have := M.b_pos
      have := M.c_pos
      have := M.B_pos
      have := M.v_pos
      omega
  apply roots_eq_of_standardSet_eq hd hanti hanti'
  ext p
  rw [mixed_three_border_standard_slices M hS hd]
  have := M.r_pos; have := M.r_lt; have := M.b_pos; have := M.c_pos
  have := M.B_pos; have := M.v_pos; have hx := p.x_lt
  simp [standardSet,MixedThreeBorderData.threeRoots,MixedThreeBorderData.highRoot,
    MixedThreeBorderData.yCornerRoot,MixedThreeBorderData.zCornerRoot,
    Normal.exact_divides_iff,Normal.DividesCriterion] <;> omega

name: P23.OneTie.mixed_three_border_two_roots_of_degenerate
proof:
:= by
  have hanti' : IsRootAntichain M.twoRoots := by
    intro s hs t ht hne hdiv
    simp only [MixedThreeBorderData.twoRoots,Finset.mem_insert,Finset.mem_singleton] at hs ht
    rcases hs with rfl | rfl <;> rcases ht with rfl | rfl
    all_goals try exact hne rfl
    all_goals have hh := (Normal.exact_divides_iff _ _).mp hdiv
    all_goals simp only [Normal.DividesCriterion,MixedThreeBorderData.highRoot,
      MixedThreeBorderData.lowBoxRoot] at hh
    all_goals
      have := M.r_pos
      have := M.r_lt
      have := M.b_pos
      have := M.c_pos
      have := M.B_pos
      have := M.v_pos
      have := M.v_lt
      omega
  apply roots_eq_of_standardSet_eq hd hanti hanti'
  ext p
  rw [mixed_three_border_standard_slices M hS hd]
  have := M.r_pos; have := M.r_lt; have := M.b_pos; have := M.c_pos
  have := M.B_pos; have := M.v_pos; have := M.v_lt; have hx := p.x_lt
  simp [standardSet,MixedThreeBorderData.twoRoots,MixedThreeBorderData.highRoot,
    MixedThreeBorderData.lowBoxRoot,Normal.exact_divides_iff,Normal.DividesCriterion] <;> omega

name: P23.OneTie.mixed_three_border_type_three_iff
statement:
theorem mixed_three_border_type_three_iff {S : Finset (Normal a b c)}
    (M : MixedThreeBorderData S) (hS : S.Nonempty) (hd : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c)
    (hl : IsLiveTie S) (hanti : IsRootAntichain S) :
    quotientType ℚ S hS hd hl = 3 ↔ b < M.B ∧ c+M.v < M.C
proof:
:= by
  rw [quotientType_eq_rootCard S hS hd hl hanti]
  constructor
  · intro ht
    by_contra hn
    have hdeg : M.B ≤ b ∨ M.C ≤ c+M.v := by omega
    have he := mixed_three_border_two_roots_of_degenerate M hS hd hanti hdeg
    have hc : M.twoRoots.card ≤ 2 := by
      simpa [MixedThreeBorderData.twoRoots] using Finset.card_insert_le M.highRoot {M.lowBoxRoot}
    rw [he] at ht
    omega
  · rintro ⟨hb,hc⟩
    rw [mixed_three_border_roots_exact M hS hd hanti hb hc]
    have h12 : M.highRoot ≠ M.yCornerRoot := by
      intro he; have := congrArg Normal.x he; dsimp [MixedThreeBorderData.highRoot,
        MixedThreeBorderData.yCornerRoot] at this; have := M.r_pos; have := M.r_lt; omega
    have h13 : M.highRoot ≠ M.zCornerRoot := by
      intro he; have := congrArg Normal.x he; dsimp [MixedThreeBorderData.highRoot,
        MixedThreeBorderData.zCornerRoot] at this; have := M.r_pos; have := M.r_lt; omega
    have h23 : M.yCornerRoot ≠ M.zCornerRoot := by
      intro he; have := congrArg Normal.y he; dsimp [MixedThreeBorderData.yCornerRoot,
        MixedThreeBorderData.zCornerRoot] at this; have := M.b_pos; omega
    simp [MixedThreeBorderData.threeRoots,h12,h13,h23]

name: P23.OneTie.mem_pureDominantExpectedBorderBelow_iff
statement:
theorem mem_pureDominantExpectedBorderBelow_iff
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (r u v : ℕ) (hr : r < a - 1) (m : Normal a b 0) :
    m ∈ pureDominantExpectedBorderBelow (a := a) (b := b) ha r u v hr ↔
      pureBelowBorderNat a b r u v m.x m.y m.z
proof:
:= by
  rcases m with ⟨mx, my, mz, hmx⟩
  by_cases hh : r + 1 < a - 1
  · by_cases hv : 0 < v <;>
      simp [pureDominantExpectedBorderBelow, pureBelowXH, pureBelowYH,
        pureBelowZH, pureZX, pureZY, pureZZ, pureBelowBorderNat, hh, hv]
  · by_cases hv : 0 < v <;>
      simp [pureDominantExpectedBorderBelow, pureBelowXH, pureBelowYH,
        pureBelowZH, pureZX, pureZY, pureZZ, pureBelowBorderNat, hh, hv]

name: P23.OneTie.pureBelow_border_arithmetic
statement:
theorem pureBelow_border_arithmetic
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 2 ≤ b) (hu : b ≤ u) (hr : r < a - 1)
    (x y z : ℕ) (hxlt : x < a) :
    (¬pureBelowStandardNat a b r u v x y z ∧
      (if 0 < x then pureBelowStandardNat a b r u v (x - 1) y z
       else if b ≤ y then pureBelowStandardNat a b r u v (a - 1) (y - b) z
       else True) ∧
      (0 < y → pureBelowStandardNat a b r u v x (y - 1) z) ∧
      (0 < z → pureBelowStandardNat a b r u v x y (z - 1))) ↔
      pureBelowBorderNat a b r u v x y z
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : 0 < x
  · by_cases hy : 0 < y <;> by_cases hz : 0 < z <;>
      by_cases hh : r + 1 < a - 1
    all_goals simp [hx, hy, hz, hh, pureBelowStandardNat,
      pureBelowBorderNat] <;> grind (splits := 64)
  · have hx0 : x = 0 := by omega
    by_cases hby : b ≤ y
    · by_cases hy : 0 < y <;> by_cases hz : 0 < z <;>
        by_cases hh : r + 1 < a - 1
      all_goals simp [hx, hx0, hby, hy, hz, hh, pureBelowStandardNat,
        pureBelowBorderNat] <;> grind (splits := 64)
    · by_cases hy : 0 < y <;> by_cases hz : 0 < z <;>
        by_cases hh : r + 1 < a - 1
      all_goals simp [hx, hx0, hby, hy, hz, hh, pureBelowStandardNat,
        pureBelowBorderNat] <;> grind (splits := 64)

name: P23.OneTie.pureDominantBorder_below_exact
statement:
theorem pureDominantBorder_below_exact
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 2 ≤ b) (hu : b ≤ u) (hr : r < a - 1) :
    borderFinset (pureDominantSoclesBelow (a := a) (b := b) r u v hr) =
      pureDominantExpectedBorderBelow (a := a) (b := b) ha r u v hr
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.ext
  intro m
  rw [mem_borderFinset_iff (by simp [pureDominantSoclesBelow])]
  rw [mem_pureDominantExpectedBorderBelow_iff ha r u v hr]
  rcases m with ⟨mx, my, mz, hmx⟩
  have harith := pureBelow_border_arithmetic (v := v) ha hb hu hr mx my mz hmx
  by_cases hx : 0 < mx
  · simp [IsMinimalBorder, ApplicablePredecessorsSurvive,
      standardSet, pureDominantSoclesBelow, Normal.exact_divides_iff,
      Normal.DividesCriterion, pureBelowStandardNat, Normal.predecessor,
      Normal.xPredecessor, Normal.yPredecessor, Normal.zPredecessor,
      pureCore, pureH, pureZ, hx, hr] at harith ⊢
    grind
  · have hx0 : mx = 0 := by omega
    by_cases hby : b ≤ my
    · simp [IsMinimalBorder, ApplicablePredecessorsSurvive,
        standardSet, pureDominantSoclesBelow, Normal.exact_divides_iff,
        Normal.DividesCriterion, pureBelowStandardNat, Normal.predecessor,
        Normal.wrappedXPredecessor, Normal.yPredecessor,
        Normal.zPredecessor, pureCore, pureH, pureZ, hx, hx0, hby, hr]
        at harith ⊢
      grind
    · simp [IsMinimalBorder, ApplicablePredecessorsSurvive,
        standardSet, pureDominantSoclesBelow, Normal.exact_divides_iff,
        Normal.DividesCriterion, pureBelowStandardNat, Normal.predecessor,
        Normal.yPredecessor, Normal.zPredecessor, pureCore, pureH, pureZ,
        hx, hx0, hby, hr] at harith ⊢
      grind

name: P23.OneTie.pureDominantBorder_below_card
statement:
theorem pureDominantBorder_below_card
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 2 ≤ b) (hu : b ≤ u) (hr : r < a - 1) :
    (borderFinset (pureDominantSoclesBelow (a := a) (b := b) r u v hr)).card =
      if 0 < v then 6 else 5
proof:
:= by
  rw [pureDominantBorder_below_exact ha hb hu hr]
  let A := pureBelowXH (a := a) (b := b) r u hr
  let B := pureBelowYH (a := a) (b := b) r u hr
  let C := pureZX (a := a) (b := b) ha v
  let D := pureZY (a := a) (b := b) v
  let E := pureZZ (a := a) (b := b) v
  let F := pureBelowZH (a := a) (b := b) r u hr
  let s : Finset (Normal a b 0) := {A, B, C, D, E}
  by_cases hh : r + 1 < a - 1
  · have hA : A ∉ ({B, C, D, E} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) := by
      simp [A, B, C, D, E, pureBelowXH, pureBelowYH, pureZX, pureZY,
        pureZZ, hh]
    have hB : B ∉ ({C, D, E} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) := by
      simp [B, C, D, E, pureBelowYH, pureZX, pureZY, pureZZ]
    have hC : C ∉ ({D, E} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) := by
      simp [C, D, E, pureZX, pureZY, pureZZ]
    have hD : D ∉ ({E} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) := by
      simp [D, E, pureZY, pureZZ]
    have hs : s.card = 5 := by
      dsimp [s]
      rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hA, Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hB,
        Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hC, Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hD]
      simp
    by_cases hv : 0 < v
    · have hF : F ∉ s := by
        simp [F, s, A, B, C, D, E, pureBelowZH, pureBelowXH,
          pureBelowYH, pureZX, pureZY, pureZZ, hh]
        omega
      rw [if_pos hv]
      simp only [pureDominantExpectedBorderBelow, if_pos hv]
      change (s ∪ {F}).card = 6
      simp [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hF, hs]
    · simpa [pureDominantExpectedBorderBelow, hv, s, A, B, C, D, E]
        using hs
  · have hA : A ∉ ({B, C, D, E} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) := by
      simp [A, B, C, D, E, pureBelowXH, pureBelowYH, pureZX, pureZY,
        pureZZ, hh]
    have hB : B ∉ ({C, D, E} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) := by
      simp [B, C, D, E, pureBelowYH, pureZX, pureZY, pureZZ]
    have hC : C ∉ ({D, E} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) := by
      simp [C, D, E, pureZX, pureZY, pureZZ]
    have hD : D ∉ ({E} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) := by
      simp [D, E, pureZY, pureZZ]
    have hs : s.card = 5 := by
      dsimp [s]
      rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hA, Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hB,
        Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hC, Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hD]
      simp
    by_cases hv : 0 < v
    · have hF : F ∉ s := by
        simp [F, s, A, B, C, D, E, pureBelowZH, pureBelowXH,
          pureBelowYH, pureZX, pureZY, pureZZ, hh]
        omega
      rw [if_pos hv]
      simp only [pureDominantExpectedBorderBelow, if_pos hv]
      change (s ∪ {F}).card = 6
      simp [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hF, hs]
    · simpa [pureDominantExpectedBorderBelow, hv, s, A, B, C, D, E]
        using hs

name: P23.OneTie.mem_pureDominantExpectedBorderLast_iff
statement:
theorem mem_pureDominantExpectedBorderLast_iff
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (v : ℕ) (m : Normal a b 0) :
    m ∈ pureDominantExpectedBorderLast (a := a) (b := b) ha v ↔
      pureLastBorderNat b v m.x m.y m.z
proof:
:= by
  rcases m with ⟨mx, my, mz, hmx⟩
