    simp [pureDominantExpectedBorderLast, pureLastXH, pureLastYH,
      pureLastZH, pureZX, pureZY, pureZZ, pureLastBorderNat, hv]

name: P23.OneTie.pureLast_border_arithmetic
statement:
theorem pureLast_border_arithmetic
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 2 ≤ b) (x y z : ℕ) (hxlt : x < a) :
    (¬pureLastStandardNat a b v x y z ∧
      (if 0 < x then pureLastStandardNat a b v (x - 1) y z
       else if b ≤ y then pureLastStandardNat a b v (a - 1) (y - b) z
       else True) ∧
      (0 < y → pureLastStandardNat a b v x (y - 1) z) ∧
      (0 < z → pureLastStandardNat a b v x y (z - 1))) ↔
      pureLastBorderNat b v x y z
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : 0 < x
  · by_cases hy : 0 < y <;> by_cases hz : 0 < z <;>
      by_cases hx1 : x = 1 <;> by_cases hy0 : y = 0 <;>
      by_cases hyb : y = b <;> by_cases hz0 : z = 0 <;>
      by_cases hzv : z = v + 1
    all_goals simp_all [pureLastStandardNat, pureLastBorderNat] <;> omega
  · have hx0 : x = 0 := by omega
    by_cases hby : b ≤ y
    · by_cases hy : 0 < y <;> by_cases hz : 0 < z <;>
        by_cases hy0 : y = 0 <;> by_cases hy1 : y = 1 <;>
        by_cases hyb : y = b <;> by_cases hybp : y = b + 1 <;>
        by_cases hz0 : z = 0 <;> by_cases hz1 : z = 1 <;>
        by_cases hzv : z = v + 1 <;> by_cases hzv2 : z = v + 2
      all_goals simp_all [pureLastStandardNat, pureLastBorderNat] <;> omega
    · by_cases hy : 0 < y <;> by_cases hz : 0 < z <;>
        by_cases hy0 : y = 0 <;> by_cases hy1 : y = 1 <;>
        by_cases hyb : y = b <;> by_cases hybp : y = b + 1 <;>
        by_cases hz0 : z = 0 <;> by_cases hz1 : z = 1 <;>
        by_cases hzv : z = v + 1 <;> by_cases hzv2 : z = v + 2
      all_goals simp_all [pureLastStandardNat, pureLastBorderNat] <;> omega

name: P23.OneTie.pureDominantBorder_last_exact
statement:
theorem pureDominantBorder_last_exact
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 2 ≤ b) :
    borderFinset (pureDominantSoclesLast (a := a) (b := b) v) =
      pureDominantExpectedBorderLast (a := a) (b := b) ha v
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.ext
  intro m
  rw [mem_borderFinset_iff (by simp [pureDominantSoclesLast])]
  rw [mem_pureDominantExpectedBorderLast_iff ha v]
  rcases m with ⟨mx, my, mz, hmx⟩
  have harith := pureLast_border_arithmetic (v := v) ha hb mx my mz hmx
  have hlast : ¬a - 1 < a - 1 := by omega
  by_cases hx : 0 < mx
  · simp [IsMinimalBorder, ApplicablePredecessorsSurvive, standardSet,
      pureDominantSoclesLast, Normal.exact_divides_iff,
      Normal.DividesCriterion, pureLastStandardNat, Normal.predecessor,
      Normal.xPredecessor, Normal.yPredecessor, Normal.zPredecessor,
      pureCore, pureH, pureZ, hx, hlast] at harith ⊢
    grind
  · have hx0 : mx = 0 := by omega
    by_cases hby : b ≤ my
    · simp [IsMinimalBorder, ApplicablePredecessorsSurvive, standardSet,
        pureDominantSoclesLast, Normal.exact_divides_iff,
        Normal.DividesCriterion, pureLastStandardNat, Normal.predecessor,
        Normal.wrappedXPredecessor, Normal.yPredecessor,
        Normal.zPredecessor, pureCore, pureH, pureZ, hx, hx0, hby, hlast]
        at harith ⊢
      grind
    · simp [IsMinimalBorder, ApplicablePredecessorsSurvive, standardSet,
        pureDominantSoclesLast, Normal.exact_divides_iff,
        Normal.DividesCriterion, pureLastStandardNat, Normal.predecessor,
        Normal.yPredecessor, Normal.zPredecessor, pureCore, pureH, pureZ,
        hx, hx0, hby, hlast] at harith ⊢
      grind

name: P23.OneTie.pureDominantBorder_last_card
statement:
theorem pureDominantBorder_last_card
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 2 ≤ b) :
    (borderFinset (pureDominantSoclesLast (a := a) (b := b) v)).card =
      if 0 < v then 6 else 5
proof:
:= by
  rw [pureDominantBorder_last_exact ha hb]
  let A := pureLastXH (a := a) (b := b) ha
  let B := pureLastYH (a := a) (b := b)
  let C := pureZX (a := a) (b := b) ha v
  let D := pureZY (a := a) (b := b) v
  let E := pureZZ (a := a) (b := b) v
  let F := pureLastZH (a := a) (b := b)
  let s : Finset (Normal a b 0) := {A, B, C, D, E}
  have hA : A ∉ ({B, C, D, E} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) := by
    simp [A, B, C, D, E, pureLastXH, pureLastYH, pureZX, pureZY,
      pureZZ]
  have hB : B ∉ ({C, D, E} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) := by
    simp [B, C, D, E, pureLastYH, pureZX, pureZY, pureZZ]
  have hC : C ∉ ({D, E} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) := by
    simp [C, D, E, pureZX, pureZY, pureZZ]
  have hD : D ∉ ({E} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) := by
    simp [D, E, pureZY, pureZZ]
  have hs : s.card = 5 := by
    dsimp [s]
    rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hA, Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hB,
      Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hC, Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hD]
    simp
  by_cases hv : 0 < v
  · have hF : F ∉ s := by
      simp [F, s, A, B, C, D, E, pureLastZH, pureLastXH,
        pureLastYH, pureZX, pureZY, pureZZ]
      omega
    rw [if_pos hv]
    simp only [pureDominantExpectedBorderLast, if_pos hv]
    change (s ∪ {F}).card = 6
    simp [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hF, hs]
  · simpa [pureDominantExpectedBorderLast, hv, s, A, B, C, D, E]
      using hs

name: P23.OneTie.pureDominant_card_of_pos
statement:
theorem pureDominant_card_of_pos
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 2 ≤ b) (hv : 1 ≤ v) :
    (∀ (hr : r < a - 1), b ≤ u →
      (borderFinset (pureDominantSoclesBelow (a := a) (b := b)
        r u v hr)).card = 6) ∧
    (borderFinset (pureDominantSoclesLast (a := a) (b := b) v)).card = 6
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hr hu
    have hv' : 0 < v := by omega
    simpa [hv'] using
      (pureDominantBorder_below_card (v := v) ha hb hu hr)
  · have hv' : 0 < v := by omega
    simpa [hv'] using pureDominantBorder_last_card (v := v) ha hb

name: P23.OneTie.pureDominant_card_of_zero
statement:
theorem pureDominant_card_of_zero
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 2 ≤ b) :
    (∀ (hr : r < a - 1), b ≤ u →
      (borderFinset (pureDominantSoclesBelow (a := a) (b := b)
        r u 0 hr)).card = 5) ∧
    (borderFinset (pureDominantSoclesLast (a := a) (b := b) 0)).card = 5
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hr hu
    simpa using pureDominantBorder_below_card (v := 0) ha hb hu hr
  · simpa using pureDominantBorder_last_card (v := 0) ha hb

name: P23.OneTie.pureDominant_card_ne_four
statement:
theorem pureDominant_card_ne_four
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 2 ≤ b) :
    (∀ (hr : r < a - 1), b ≤ u →
      (borderFinset (pureDominantSoclesBelow (a := a) (b := b)
        r u v hr)).card ≠ 4) ∧
    (borderFinset (pureDominantSoclesLast (a := a) (b := b) v)).card ≠ 4
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hr hu
    rw [pureDominantBorder_below_card ha hb hu hr]
    split <;> decide
  · rw [pureDominantBorder_last_card (v := v) ha hb]
    split <;> decide

name: P23.OneTie.cover_a_pos
statement: private theorem cover_a_pos : 0 < a
proof: := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne a)

name: P23.OneTie.predecessor_ne_self
statement:
private theorem predecessor_ne_self (ha : 2 ≤ a) {e : Direction}
    {s q : Normal a b c} (hq : Normal.predecessor e s = some q) : q ≠ s
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  subst q
  have hmul := (Normal.predecessor_eq_some_iff_mul e s s).1 hq
  have hmul' : s * e.generator = s * 1 := by simpa using hmul
  exact (variableGenerators_ne_one_of_two_le ha e)
    (Normal.mul_left_cancel hmul')

name: P23.OneTie.isDominantRoot_iff_all_directionalCentre
statement:
theorem isDominantRoot_iff_all_directionalCentre
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (C : Normal a b c)
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hanti : IsRootAntichain S) :
    IsDominantRoot S C ↔
      C ∈ S ∧ ∀ e : Direction, IsDirectionalCentre S e C
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hCS, hdom⟩
    refine ⟨hCS, ?_⟩
    intro e
    refine ⟨hCS, ?_⟩
    intro s hs q hq
    have hqs : q ∣ s := by
      exact ⟨e.generator,
        ((Normal.predecessor_eq_some_iff_mul e s q).1 hq).symm⟩
    have hqstd : q ∈ standardSet S := ⟨s, hs, hqs⟩
    rw [hdom] at hqstd
    rcases hqstd with hqC | hqroot
    · exact hqC
    · have hqS : q ∈ S := Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hqroot
      have hqneC : q ≠ C := Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hqroot
      have hqnes : q ≠ s := predecessor_ne_self ha hq
      exact False.elim ((hanti q hqS s hs hqnes) hqs)
  · rintro ⟨hCS, hcentres⟩
    refine ⟨hCS, ?_⟩
    ext p
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨s, hs, hps⟩
      by_cases hpself : p = s
      · subst p
        by_cases hsC : s = C
        · subst s
          exact Or.inl dvd_rfl
        · exact Or.inr (Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hsC, hs⟩)
      · rcases properDivisor_factors_through_predecessor hps hpself with
          ⟨e, q, hq, hpq⟩
        have hqC : q ∈ Normal.divisorDownset C :=
          (hcentres e).2 s hs q hq
        exact Or.inl (dvd_trans hpq hqC)
    · intro hp
      rcases hp with hpC | hpRoot
      · exact ⟨C, hCS, hpC⟩
      · have hpS : p ∈ S := Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hpRoot
        exact ⟨p, hpS, dvd_rfl⟩

name: P23.OneTie.not_divides_of_distinct_roots
proof:
:= by
  intro hdiv
  exact (hanti R hR C hC hne) ((Normal.exact_divides_iff R C).2 hdiv)

name: P23.OneTie.h4_y_edge_exact
statement:
theorem h4_y_edge_exact {S : Finset (Normal a b c)} {C R : Normal a b c}
    (hanti : IsRootAntichain S) (hcentre : IsDirectionalCentre S .y C)
    (hR : R ∈ S) (hne : R ≠ C) (hy : 0 < R.y) :
    R.y + (if C.x < R.x then b else 0) = C.y + 1 ∧
      R.z + (if C.x < R.x then c else 0) ≤ C.z
proof:
:= by
  have hc := ((isDirectionalCentre_y_iff S C).1 hcentre).2 R hR hy
  have hnd := not_divides_of_distinct_roots hanti hcentre.1 hR hne
  unfold Normal.DividesCriterion at hnd
  by_cases hx : C.x < R.x
  · simp [hx]
    omega
  · simp [hx]
    omega

name: P23.OneTie.h4_z_edge_exact
statement:
theorem h4_z_edge_exact {S : Finset (Normal a b c)} {C R : Normal a b c}
    (hanti : IsRootAntichain S) (hcentre : IsDirectionalCentre S .z C)
    (hR : R ∈ S) (hne : R ≠ C) (hz : 0 < R.z) :
    R.z + (if C.x < R.x then c else 0) = C.z + 1 ∧
      R.y + (if C.x < R.x then b else 0) ≤ C.y
proof:
:= by
  have hc := ((isDirectionalCentre_z_iff S C).1 hcentre).2 R hR hz
  have hnd := not_divides_of_distinct_roots hanti hcentre.1 hR hne
  unfold Normal.DividesCriterion at hnd
  by_cases hx : C.x < R.x
  · simp [hx]
    omega
  · simp [hx]
    omega

name: P23.OneTie.h4_x_edge_ordinary_exact
statement:
theorem h4_x_edge_ordinary_exact {S : Finset (Normal a b c)}
    {C R : Normal a b c} (hanti : IsRootAntichain S)
    (hcentre : IsDirectionalCentre S .x C) (hR : R ∈ S)
    (hne : R ≠ C) (hx : 0 < R.x) :
    R.x = C.x + 1 ∧ R.y ≤ C.y ∧ R.z ≤ C.z
proof:
:= by
  have hc := (((isDirectionalCentre_x_iff S C).1 hcentre).2 R hR).1 hx
  have hnd := not_divides_of_distinct_roots hanti hcentre.1 hR hne
  unfold Normal.DividesCriterion at hnd
  omega

name: P23.OneTie.h4_x_edge_wrapped_exact
statement:
theorem h4_x_edge_wrapped_exact {S : Finset (Normal a b c)}
    {C R : Normal a b c} (hanti : IsRootAntichain S)
    (hcentre : IsDirectionalCentre S .x C) (hR : R ∈ S)
    (hne : R ≠ C) (hx : R.x = 0) (hy : b ≤ R.y) (hz : c ≤ R.z) :
    C.x = a - 1 ∧ R.y ≤ C.y + b ∧ R.z ≤ C.z + c
proof:
:= by
  have hc := (((isDirectionalCentre_x_iff S C).1 hcentre).2 R hR).2 hx hy hz
  have hnd := not_divides_of_distinct_roots hanti hcentre.1 hR hne
  unfold Normal.DividesCriterion at hnd
  have hClt := C.x_lt
  omega

name: P23.OneTie.coverShape_a_pos
statement: private theorem coverShape_a_pos : 0 < a
proof: := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne a)

name: P23.OneTie.mem_optionSingleton_iff
proof:
:= by
  cases o with
  | none => simp [optionSingleton]
  | some r => simp [optionSingleton, eq_comm]

name: P23.OneTie.mem_predecessorRootFinset_iff
statement:
theorem mem_predecessorRootFinset_iff (T q : Normal a b c) :
    q ∈ predecessorRootFinset T ↔
      Normal.predecessor .x T = some q ∨
      Normal.predecessor .y T = some q ∨
      Normal.predecessor .z T = some q
proof:
:= by
  simp [predecessorRootFinset, mem_optionSingleton_iff]

name: P23.OneTie.standardSet_predecessorRootFinset
proof:
:= by
  have predDvd : ∀ {e : Direction} {q : Normal a b c},
      Normal.predecessor e T = some q → q ∣ T := by
    intro e q hpred
    exact ⟨e.generator,
      ((Normal.predecessor_eq_some_iff_mul e T q).1 hpred).symm⟩
  ext p
  constructor
  · intro hp
    rcases (mem_standardSet_iff _ _).1 hp with ⟨q, hq, hpq⟩
    rcases (mem_predecessorRootFinset_iff T q).1 hq with hpred | hpred | hpred
    all_goals
      have hqT : q ∣ T := predDvd hpred
      have hpT := dvd_trans hpq hqT
      refine ⟨hpT, ?_⟩
      intro hpEq
      subst p
      exact hproper q hq hpq
  · rintro ⟨hpT, hpne⟩
    rcases properDivisor_factors_through_predecessor hpT (by simpa using hpne) with
      ⟨e, q, hpred, hpq⟩
    apply (mem_standardSet_iff _ _).2
    refine ⟨q, (mem_predecessorRootFinset_iff T q).2 ?_, hpq⟩
    cases e <;> simp_all

name: P23.OneTie.normalSupport_card_le_three
statement: theorem normalSupport_card_le_three (q : Normal a b c) : (normalSupport q).card ≤ 3
proof:
:= by
  simpa [normalSupport] using Finset.card_le_card (Finset.filter_subset
    (fun j : Fin 3 => if j = 0 then 0 < q.x else if j = 1 then 0 < q.y else 0 < q.z) Finset.univ)

name: P23.OneTie.normalSupport_eq_univ_iff
statement:
theorem normalSupport_eq_univ_iff (q : Normal a b c) :
    normalSupport q = Finset.univ ↔ NormalHasFullSupport q
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro he
    have h0 : (0 : Fin 3) ∈ normalSupport q := he ▸ Finset.mem_univ _
    have h1 : (1 : Fin 3) ∈ normalSupport q := he ▸ Finset.mem_univ _
    have h2 : (2 : Fin 3) ∈ normalSupport q := he ▸ Finset.mem_univ _
    simpa [normalSupport, NormalHasFullSupport] using And.intro h0 (And.intro h1 h2)
  · rintro ⟨hx,hy,hz⟩
    ext j
    fin_cases j <;> simp [normalSupport,hx,hy,hz]

name: P23.OneTie.normalSupport_card_le_two_of_not_full
statement:
theorem normalSupport_card_le_two_of_not_full (q : Normal a b c)
    (h : ¬NormalHasFullSupport q) : (normalSupport q).card ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hne : normalSupport q ≠ Finset.univ := by
    intro he; exact h ((normalSupport_eq_univ_iff q).mp he)
  have hlt := Finset.card_lt_card (Finset.ssubset_iff_subset_ne.mpr
    ⟨Finset.subset_univ _, hne⟩)
  have hu : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 3)).card = 3 := by decide
  omega

name: P23.OneTie.pure_x_divides_liveTiePoint
statement:
theorem pure_x_divides_liveTiePoint (q : Normal a b c) (hq : NormalIsPureX q) :
    q ∣ (liveTiePoint : Normal a b c)
proof:
:= by
  apply (Normal.exact_divides_iff q liveTiePoint).mpr
  rcases hq with ⟨hx,hy,hz⟩
  simp [Normal.DividesCriterion, liveTiePoint, hy,hz]

name: P23.OneTie.border_not_pure_x
proof:
:= by
  intro hp
  have hk := ((mem_borderFinset_iff hS q).mp hq).1
  exact hk (standardSet_dvd_closed S hl.2.2.2 (pure_x_divides_liveTiePoint q hp))

name: P23.OneTie.isDirectionalCentre_y_criterion_iff
statement:
private theorem isDirectionalCentre_y_criterion_iff (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (centre : Normal a b c) :
    IsDirectionalCentre S .y centre ↔
      centre ∈ S ∧ ∀ s ∈ S, ∀ hy : 0 < s.y,
        Normal.DividesCriterion (Normal.yPredecessor s hy) centre
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hc, hpred⟩
    refine ⟨hc, ?_⟩
    intro s hs hy
    apply (Normal.mem_divisorDownset_iff _ _).1
    exact hpred s hs _ (Normal.predecessor_y_of_pos s hy)
  · rintro ⟨hc, hcoord⟩
    refine ⟨hc, ?_⟩
    intro s hs q hq
    by_cases hy : 0 < s.y
    · have heq := Normal.predecessor_y_of_pos s hy
      rw [heq] at hq
      have hq' : q = Normal.yPredecessor s hy := by simpa using hq.symm
      subst q
      exact (Normal.mem_divisorDownset_iff _ _).2 (hcoord s hs hy)
    · have hzero : s.y = 0 := by omega
      rw [Normal.predecessor_y_none s hzero] at hq
      contradiction

name: P23.OneTie.isDirectionalCentre_z_criterion_iff
statement:
private theorem isDirectionalCentre_z_criterion_iff (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (centre : Normal a b c) :
    IsDirectionalCentre S .z centre ↔
      centre ∈ S ∧ ∀ s ∈ S, ∀ hz : 0 < s.z,
        Normal.DividesCriterion (Normal.zPredecessor s hz) centre
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hc, hpred⟩
    refine ⟨hc, ?_⟩
    intro s hs hz
    apply (Normal.mem_divisorDownset_iff _ _).1
    exact hpred s hs _ (Normal.predecessor_z_of_pos s hz)
  · rintro ⟨hc, hcoord⟩
    refine ⟨hc, ?_⟩
    intro s hs q hq
    by_cases hz : 0 < s.z
    · have heq := Normal.predecessor_z_of_pos s hz
      rw [heq] at hq
      have hq' : q = Normal.zPredecessor s hz := by simpa using hq.symm
      subst q
      exact (Normal.mem_divisorDownset_iff _ _).2 (hcoord s hs hz)
    · have hzero : s.z = 0 := by omega
      rw [Normal.predecessor_z_none s hzero] at hq
      contradiction

name: P23.OneTie.isDirectionalCentre_x_criterion_iff
statement:
private theorem isDirectionalCentre_x_criterion_iff (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (centre : Normal a b c) :
    IsDirectionalCentre S .x centre ↔
      centre ∈ S ∧ ∀ s ∈ S,
        (∀ hx : 0 < s.x,
          Normal.DividesCriterion (Normal.xPredecessor s hx) centre) ∧
        (∀ hsx : s.x = 0, ∀ hy : b ≤ s.y, ∀ hz : c ≤ s.z,
          Normal.DividesCriterion (Normal.wrappedXPredecessor s hsx hy hz)
            centre)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hc, hpred⟩
    refine ⟨hc, ?_⟩
    intro s hs
    constructor
    · intro hx
      apply (Normal.mem_divisorDownset_iff _ _).1
      exact hpred s hs _ (Normal.predecessor_x_of_pos s hx)
    · intro hsx hy hz
      apply (Normal.mem_divisorDownset_iff _ _).1
      exact hpred s hs _ (Normal.predecessor_x_wrapped s hsx hy hz)
  · rintro ⟨hc, hcoord⟩
    refine ⟨hc, ?_⟩
    intro s hs q hq
    by_cases hx : 0 < s.x
    · have heq := Normal.predecessor_x_of_pos s hx
      rw [heq] at hq
      have hq' : q = Normal.xPredecessor s hx := by simpa using hq.symm
      subst q
      exact (Normal.mem_divisorDownset_iff _ _).2 ((hcoord s hs).1 hx)
    · have hsx : s.x = 0 := by omega
      by_cases hw : b ≤ s.y ∧ c ≤ s.z
      · have heq := Normal.predecessor_x_wrapped s hsx hw.1 hw.2
        rw [heq] at hq
        have hq' : q = Normal.wrappedXPredecessor s hsx hw.1 hw.2 := by
          simpa using hq.symm
        subst q
        exact (Normal.mem_divisorDownset_iff _ _).2
          ((hcoord s hs).2 hsx hw.1 hw.2)
      · rw [Normal.predecessor_x_none s hsx hw] at hq
        contradiction

name: P23.OneTie.isDirectionalCentre_y_iff
statement:
theorem isDirectionalCentre_y_iff (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (centre : Normal a b c) :
    IsDirectionalCentre S .y centre ↔
      centre ∈ S ∧ ∀ s ∈ S, ∀ _hy : 0 < s.y,
        s.y - 1 ≤ centre.y ∧ s.z ≤ centre.z ∧
          (s.x ≤ centre.x ∨
            (s.y - 1 + b ≤ centre.y ∧ s.z + c ≤ centre.z))
proof:
:= by
  simpa [Normal.DividesCriterion, Normal.yPredecessor] using
    (isDirectionalCentre_y_criterion_iff S centre)

name: P23.OneTie.isDirectionalCentre_z_iff
statement:
theorem isDirectionalCentre_z_iff (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (centre : Normal a b c) :
    IsDirectionalCentre S .z centre ↔
      centre ∈ S ∧ ∀ s ∈ S, ∀ _hz : 0 < s.z,
        s.y ≤ centre.y ∧ s.z - 1 ≤ centre.z ∧
          (s.x ≤ centre.x ∨
            (s.y + b ≤ centre.y ∧ s.z - 1 + c ≤ centre.z))
proof:
:= by
  simpa [Normal.DividesCriterion, Normal.zPredecessor] using
    (isDirectionalCentre_z_criterion_iff S centre)

name: P23.OneTie.isDirectionalCentre_x_iff
statement:
theorem isDirectionalCentre_x_iff (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (centre : Normal a b c) :
    IsDirectionalCentre S .x centre ↔
      centre ∈ S ∧ ∀ s ∈ S,
        (∀ _hx : 0 < s.x,
          s.y ≤ centre.y ∧ s.z ≤ centre.z ∧
            (s.x - 1 ≤ centre.x ∨
              (s.y + b ≤ centre.y ∧ s.z + c ≤ centre.z))) ∧
        (∀ _hsx : s.x = 0, ∀ _hy : b ≤ s.y, ∀ _hz : c ≤ s.z,
          s.y - b ≤ centre.y ∧ s.z - c ≤ centre.z ∧
            (a - 1 ≤ centre.x ∨
              (s.y - b + b ≤ centre.y ∧ s.z - c + c ≤ centre.z)))
proof:
:= by
  simpa [Normal.DividesCriterion, Normal.xPredecessor,
    Normal.wrappedXPredecessor] using
    (isDirectionalCentre_x_criterion_iff S centre)

name: P23.OneTie.pure_three_border_no_y_axis
statement:
theorem pure_three_border_no_y_axis (S : Finset (Normal a b 0))
    (hS : S.Nonempty) (hd : IsLiveParameterDomain a b 0) (hl : IsLiveTie S)
    (ha : IsRootAntichain S) (ht : quotientType ℚ S hS hd hl = 3)
    (hcard : (borderFinset S).card = 3)
    (hnf : ∀ q ∈ borderFinset S, ¬NormalHasFullSupport q) :
    ∀ B, yAxis B ∉ borderFinset S
proof:
:= by
  intro B hY
  have hb : 0 < b := by rcases hd.2 with hm | hp <;> omega
  have hbB : b < B := by
    by_contra hn
    have hdv : yAxis B ∣ (liveTiePoint : Normal a b 0) :=
      (Normal.exact_divides_iff _ _).mpr (by simp [Normal.DividesCriterion,yAxis,liveTiePoint]; omega)
    exact ((mem_borderFinset_iff hS _).mp hY).1 (standardSet_dvd_closed S hl.2.2.2 hdv)
  obtain ⟨C,hC,hZ⟩ := pure_z_border_exists S hS hd hb
  have hYZ : (yAxis B : Normal a b 0) ≠ zAxis C := by
    intro he; have := congrArg Normal.y he; simp [yAxis,zAxis] at this; omega
  obtain ⟨q,hq,hqY,hqZ,he⟩ := three_border_exists_third S hcard (yAxis B) (zAxis C) hY hZ hYZ
  have hyB : q.y < B := by
    by_contra hn
    have hdq : yAxis B ∣ q := (Normal.exact_divides_iff _ _).mpr
      (by simp [Normal.DividesCriterion,yAxis]; omega)
    exact hqY (border_dvd_border_eq hS hd.1 hY hq hdq).symm
  have hzC : q.z < C := by
    by_contra hn
    have hdq : zAxis C ∣ q := (Normal.exact_divides_iff _ _).mpr
      (by simp [Normal.DividesCriterion,zAxis]; omega)
    exact hqZ (border_dvd_border_eq hS hd.1 hZ hq hdq).symm
  have hn := hnf q hq
  have hnp := border_not_pure_x hS hl hq
  by_cases hx0 : q.x = 0
  · have hy : 0 < q.y := by
      by_contra hy
      have hy0 : q.y = 0 := by omega
      have heq : q = zAxis q.z := by apply Normal.ext <;> simp [zAxis,hx0,hy0]
      have hzc := pure_z_border_unique hS hd.1 (heq ▸ hq) hZ
      exact hqZ (heq.trans (congrArg zAxis hzc))
    have hz : 0 < q.z := by
      by_contra hz
      have hz0 : q.z = 0 := by omega
      have heq : q = yAxis q.y := by apply Normal.ext <;> simp [yAxis,hx0,hz0]
      have hyb := pure_y_border_unique hS hd.1 (heq ▸ hq) hY
      exact hqY (heq.trans (congrArg yAxis hyb))
    have heq : q = yzPoint q.y q.z := by apply Normal.ext <;> simp [yzPoint,hx0]
    have he' : borderFinset S = {yAxis B,zAxis C,yzPoint q.y q.z} := by rw [he,heq]; rfl
    have htt := mixed_three_border_no_x_type_le_two S hS hd hl ha B C q.y q.z hy hyB hz hzC he'
    omega
  · have hx : 0 < q.x := by omega
    by_cases hy0 : q.y = 0
    · have hz : 0 < q.z := by unfold NormalIsPureX at hnp; omega
      have heq : q = (⟨q.x,0,q.z,q.x_lt⟩ : Normal a b 0) := by apply Normal.ext <;> simp [hy0]
      have he' : borderFinset S = {yAxis B,zAxis C,(⟨q.x,0,q.z,q.x_lt⟩ : Normal a b 0)} := by rw [he,heq]
      have htt := pure_y_xz_three_border_type_le_two S hS hd hl ha B C q.x q.z hx q.x_lt hz hzC hbB he'
      omega
    · have hy : 0 < q.y := by omega
      have hz0 : q.z = 0 := by unfold NormalHasFullSupport at hn; omega
      have heq : q = (⟨q.x,q.y,0,q.x_lt⟩ : Normal a b 0) := by apply Normal.ext <;> simp [hz0]
      have he' : borderFinset S = {yAxis B,zAxis C,(⟨q.x,q.y,0,q.x_lt⟩ : Normal a b 0)} := by rw [he,heq]
      have htt := pure_y_xy_three_border_type_le_two S hS hd hl ha B C q.x q.y hx q.x_lt hy hC hbB he'
      omega

name: P23.OneTie.pure_three_border_support_classification
statement:
theorem pure_three_border_support_classification (S : Finset (Normal a b 0))
    (hS : S.Nonempty) (hd : IsLiveParameterDomain a b 0) (hl : IsLiveTie S)
    (ha : IsRootAntichain S) (ht : quotientType ℚ S hS hd hl = 3)
    (hcard : (borderFinset S).card = 3)
    (hnf : ∀ q ∈ borderFinset S, ¬NormalHasFullSupport q) :
    Nonempty (PureThreeBorderData S) ∨ Nonempty (PureXZThreeBorderData S)
proof:
:= by
  have hb : 0 < b := by rcases hd.2 with hm | hp <;> omega
  have hny := pure_three_border_no_y_axis S hS hd hl ha ht hcard hnf
  obtain ⟨C,hC,hZ⟩ := pure_z_border_exists S hS hd hb
  let N := S.sup Normal.y + 1
  have hk : (yAxis N : Normal a b 0) ∉ standardSet S := by
    rintro ⟨s,hs,hdv⟩
    have hh := (Normal.exact_divides_iff _ _).mp hdv |>.1
    have hh' := Finset.le_sup (f := Normal.y) hs
    change N ≤ s.y at hh
    dsimp [N] at hh
    omega
  obtain ⟨p,hp,hdp⟩ := killed_has_border_divisor S hS hd (yAxis N) hk
  have hpz : p.z = 0 := by
    have hh := (Normal.exact_divides_iff _ _).mp hdp |>.2.1
    change p.z ≤ 0 at hh; omega
  have hpx : 0 < p.x := by
    by_contra hn
    have hx0 : p.x = 0 := by omega
    have heq : p = yAxis p.y := by apply Normal.ext <;> simp [yAxis,hx0,hpz]
    exact hny p.y (heq ▸ hp)
  have hpy : 0 < p.y := by
    have hh := border_not_pure_x hS hl hp
    unfold NormalIsPureX at hh
    omega
  have hpZ : p ≠ zAxis C := by intro heq; have := congrArg Normal.x heq; simp [zAxis] at this; omega
  obtain ⟨q,hq,hqp,hqZ,he⟩ := three_border_exists_third S hcard p (zAxis C) hp hZ hpZ
  have hqzC : q.z < C := by
    by_contra hn
    have hdq : zAxis C ∣ q := (Normal.exact_divides_iff _ _).mpr
      (by simp [Normal.DividesCriterion,zAxis]; omega)
    exact hqZ (border_dvd_border_eq hS hd.1 hZ hq hdq).symm
  have hpq : ¬p ∣ q := fun hh => hqp (border_dvd_border_eq hS hd.1 hp hq hh).symm
  have hqp' : ¬q ∣ p := fun hh => hqp (border_dvd_border_eq hS hd.1 hq hp hh)
  have hqz : 0 < q.z := by
    by_contra hn
    have hqz0 : q.z = 0 := by omega
    have hqx : 0 < q.x := by
      by_contra hnx
      have hx0 : q.x = 0 := by omega
      have heq : q = yAxis q.y := by apply Normal.ext <;> simp [yAxis,hx0,hqz0]
      exact hny q.y (heq ▸ hq)
    have hqy : 0 < q.y := by
      have hh := border_not_pure_x hS hl hq
      unfold NormalIsPureX at hh; omega
    have hneq : p.x ≠ q.x := by
      intro hx
      have h1 := hpq
      have h2 := hqp'
      simp [Normal.exact_divides_iff,Normal.DividesCriterion,hpz,hqz0,hx] at h1 h2
      omega
    have hpdef : p = (⟨p.x,p.y,0,p.x_lt⟩ : Normal a b 0) := by apply Normal.ext <;> simp [hpz]
    have hqdef : q = (⟨q.x,q.y,0,q.x_lt⟩ : Normal a b 0) := by apply Normal.ext <;> simp [hqz0]
    have h1 := hpq
    have h2 := hqp'
    simp only [Normal.exact_divides_iff,Normal.DividesCriterion,hpz,hqz0] at h1 h2
    rcases Nat.lt_or_gt_of_ne hneq with hlt | hgt
    · have he' : borderFinset S = {(⟨p.x,p.y,0,p.x_lt⟩ : Normal a b 0),zAxis C,⟨q.x,q.y,0,q.x_lt⟩} := by
        rw [he,hpdef,hqdef]
      have htt := pure_two_xy_three_border_type_le_two S hS hd hl ha C p.x q.x p.y q.y
        hpx hlt q.x_lt hqy (by omega) (by omega) hC he'
      omega
    · have he' : borderFinset S = {(⟨q.x,q.y,0,q.x_lt⟩ : Normal a b 0),zAxis C,⟨p.x,p.y,0,p.x_lt⟩} := by
        rw [he,hpdef,hqdef]
        ext t; simp; tauto
      have htt := pure_two_xy_three_border_type_le_two S hS hd hl ha C q.x p.x q.y p.y
        hqx hgt p.x_lt hpy (by omega) (by omega) hC he'
      omega
  have hpdef : p = (⟨p.x,p.y,0,p.x_lt⟩ : Normal a b 0) := by apply Normal.ext <;> simp [hpz]
  by_cases hqx0 : q.x = 0
  · have hqy : 0 < q.y := by
      by_contra hn
      have hy0 : q.y = 0 := by omega
      have heq : q = zAxis q.z := by apply Normal.ext <;> simp [zAxis,hqx0,hy0]
      have hzc := pure_z_border_unique hS hd.1 (heq ▸ hq) hZ
      exact hqZ (heq.trans (congrArg zAxis hzc))
    have hqyp : q.y < p.y+b := by
      simp only [Normal.exact_divides_iff,Normal.DividesCriterion,hpz,hqx0] at hpq
      omega
    left
    refine ⟨⟨C,p.x,p.y,q.y,q.z,hb,hpx,p.x_lt,hpy,hqy,hqyp,hqz,hqzC,?_⟩⟩
    have hqdef : q = (⟨0,q.y,q.z,Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne a)⟩ : Normal a b 0) := by
      apply Normal.ext <;> simp [hqx0]
    rw [he,hpdef,hqdef]
  · have hqx : 0 < q.x := by omega
    have hqy0 : q.y = 0 := by
      have hh := hnf q hq
      unfold NormalHasFullSupport at hh; omega
    right
    refine ⟨⟨C,p.x,p.y,q.x,q.z,hb,hpx,p.x_lt,hpy,hqx,q.x_lt,hqz,hqzC,?_⟩⟩
    have hqdef : q = (⟨q.x,0,q.z,q.x_lt⟩ : Normal a b 0) := by apply Normal.ext <;> simp [hqy0]
    rw [he,hpdef,hqdef]

name: P23.OneTie.mem_standardSet_mixedDominantSoclesLast_iff
statement:
theorem mem_standardSet_mixedDominantSoclesLast_iff
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hc : 1 ≤ c)
    (p : Normal a b c) :
    p ∈ standardSet (mixedDominantSoclesLast (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) u v) ↔
      dominantLastStandardNat u v p.x p.y p.z
proof:
:= by
  rcases p with ⟨px, py, pz, hpx⟩
  simp [standardSet, mixedDominantSoclesLast, mixedCore, mixedY, mixedZ,
    Normal.exact_divides_iff, Normal.DividesCriterion,
    dominantLastStandardNat]

name: P23.OneTie.mem_mixedDominantExpectedBorderLast_iff
statement:
theorem mem_mixedDominantExpectedBorderLast_iff
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (m : Normal a b c) :
    m ∈ mixedDominantExpectedBorderLast (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) ha u v ↔
      mixedDominantLastBorderNat u v m.x m.y m.z
proof:
:= by
  rcases m with ⟨mx, my, mz, hmx⟩
  simp [mixedDominantExpectedBorderLast, mixedDominantLastBorderNat,
    mixedYTimesX, mixedYTimesY, mixedYTimesZ, mixedZTimesX,
    mixedZTimesY, mixedZTimesZ, Normal.ext_iff]

name: P23.OneTie.mixedDominantLast_border_arithmetic
statement:
theorem mixedDominantLast_border_arithmetic
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hc : 1 ≤ c)
    (hu : b ≤ u) (hv : c ≤ v) (x y z : ℕ) (hxlt : x < a) :
    ((¬dominantLastStandardNat u v x y z ∧
      (if 0 < x then dominantLastStandardNat u v (x - 1) y z
       else if b ≤ y ∧ c ≤ z then
         dominantLastStandardNat u v (a - 1) (y - b) (z - c)
       else True) ∧
      (0 < y → dominantLastStandardNat u v x (y - 1) z) ∧
      (0 < z → dominantLastStandardNat u v x y (z - 1))) ↔
      mixedDominantLastBorderNat u v x y z)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : 0 < x <;> by_cases hby : b ≤ y <;> by_cases hcz : c ≤ z
  all_goals
    simp [hx, hby, hcz, dominantLastStandardNat,
      mixedDominantLastBorderNat] <;> grind (splits := 32)

name: P23.OneTie.mixedDominantLast_border_exact
statement:
theorem mixedDominantLast_border_exact
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hc : 1 ≤ c)
    (hu : b ≤ u) (hv : c ≤ v) :
    borderFinset (mixedDominantSoclesLast (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) u v) =
      mixedDominantExpectedBorderLast (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) ha u v
proof:
:= by
  apply borderFinset_eq_expected_of_nat _ _
    (dominantLastStandardNat u v) (mixedDominantLastBorderNat u v)
  · simp [mixedDominantSoclesLast]
  · intro p
    exact mem_standardSet_mixedDominantSoclesLast_iff ha hb hc p
  · intro m
    exact mem_mixedDominantExpectedBorderLast_iff ha m
  · exact mixedDominantLast_border_arithmetic ha hb hc hu hv

name: P23.OneTie.mixedDominantLast_border_card
statement:
theorem mixedDominantLast_border_card
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hc : 1 ≤ c)
    (hu : b ≤ u) (hv : c ≤ v) :
    (borderFinset
      (mixedDominantSoclesLast (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) u v)).card = 6
proof:
:= by
  rw [mixedDominantLast_border_exact ha hb hc hu hv]
  let A := mixedYTimesX (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) ha u
  let B := mixedYTimesY (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) u
  let C := mixedYTimesZ (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) u
  let D := mixedZTimesX (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) ha v
  let E := mixedZTimesY (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) v
  let F := mixedZTimesZ (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) v
  have hA : A ∉ ({B, C, D, E, F} : Finset (Normal a b c)) := by
    simp [A, B, C, D, E, F, mixedYTimesX, mixedYTimesY,
      mixedYTimesZ, mixedZTimesX, mixedZTimesY, mixedZTimesZ]
  have hB : B ∉ ({C, D, E, F} : Finset (Normal a b c)) := by
    simp [B, C, D, E, F, mixedYTimesY, mixedYTimesZ,
      mixedZTimesX, mixedZTimesY, mixedZTimesZ]
  have hC : C ∉ ({D, E, F} : Finset (Normal a b c)) := by
    simp [C, D, E, F, mixedYTimesZ, mixedZTimesX,
      mixedZTimesY, mixedZTimesZ]
    omega
  have hD : D ∉ ({E, F} : Finset (Normal a b c)) := by
    simp [D, E, F, mixedZTimesX, mixedZTimesY, mixedZTimesZ]
  have hE : E ∉ ({F} : Finset (Normal a b c)) := by
    simp [E, F, mixedZTimesY, mixedZTimesZ]
  change ({A, B, C, D, E, F} : Finset (Normal a b c)).card = 6
  rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hA, Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hB,
    Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hC, Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hD,
    Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hE]
  simp

name: P23.OneTie.pureDominantLastCore_border_arithmetic
statement:
theorem pureDominantLastCore_border_arithmetic
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 2 ≤ b) (hu : b ≤ u)
    (x y z : ℕ) (hxlt : x < a) :
    ((¬dominantLastStandardNat u v x y z ∧
      (if 0 < x then dominantLastStandardNat u v (x - 1) y z
       else if b ≤ y ∧ 0 ≤ z then
         dominantLastStandardNat u v (a - 1) (y - b) (z - 0)
       else True) ∧
      (0 < y → dominantLastStandardNat u v x (y - 1) z) ∧
      (0 < z → dominantLastStandardNat u v x y (z - 1))) ↔
      pureDominantLastCoreBorderNat u v x y z)

name: P23.OneTie.pureDominantBorder_lastCore_exact
statement:

proof:

    (dominantLastStandardNat u v) (pureDominantLastCoreBorderNat u v)

  · intro p
    exact mem_standardSet_pureDominantSoclesLastCore_iff ha hb hu p
  · intro m

name: P23.OneTie.pureDominantBorder_lastCore_card
statement:
theorem pureDominantBorder_lastCore_card
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 2 ≤ b) (hu : b ≤ u) :
    (borderFinset
      (pureDominantSoclesLastCore (a := a) (b := b) u v)).card =
      if 0 < v then 6 else 5
proof:
:= by
  rw [pureDominantBorder_lastCore_exact ha hb hu]
  let A := pureLastCoreXH (a := a) (b := b) ha u
  let B := pureLastCoreYH (a := a) (b := b) u
  let C := pureLastCoreXZ (a := a) (b := b) ha v
  let D := pureLastCoreYZ (a := a) (b := b) v
  let E := pureLastCoreZZ (a := a) (b := b) v
  let F := pureLastCoreZH (a := a) (b := b) u
  let s : Finset (Normal a b 0) := {A, B, C, D, E}
  have hA : A ∉ ({B, C, D, E} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) := by
    simp [A, B, C, D, E, pureLastCoreXH, pureLastCoreYH,
      pureLastCoreXZ, pureLastCoreYZ, pureLastCoreZZ]
  have hB : B ∉ ({C, D, E} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) := by
    simp [B, C, D, E, pureLastCoreYH, pureLastCoreXZ,
      pureLastCoreYZ, pureLastCoreZZ]
  have hC : C ∉ ({D, E} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) := by
    simp [C, D, E, pureLastCoreXZ, pureLastCoreYZ, pureLastCoreZZ]
  have hD : D ∉ ({E} : Finset (Normal a b 0)) := by
    simp [D, E, pureLastCoreYZ, pureLastCoreZZ]
  have hs : s.card = 5 := by
    dsimp [s]
    rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hA, Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hB,
      Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hC, Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hD]
    simp
  by_cases hv : 0 < v
  · have hF : F ∉ s := by
      simp [F, s, A, B, C, D, E, pureLastCoreZH, pureLastCoreXH,
        pureLastCoreYH, pureLastCoreXZ, pureLastCoreYZ, pureLastCoreZZ]
      omega
    rw [if_pos hv]
    simp only [pureDominantExpectedBorderLastCore, if_pos hv]
    change (s ∪ {F}).card = 6
    simp [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hF, hs]
  · simpa [pureDominantExpectedBorderLastCore, hv, s, A, B, C, D, E]
      using hs

name: P23.OneTie.pureDominantBorder_lastCore_card_ne_four

name: P23.Presentation.add_div_remainders
statement:
private theorem add_div_remainders (m n a : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) :
    m / a + n / a + (m % a + n % a) / a = (m + n) / a
proof:
:= by
  have hm : m % a < a := Nat.mod_lt _ ha
  have hn : n % a < a := Nat.mod_lt _ ha
  have hrem : (m % a + n % a) / a =
      if a ≤ m % a + n % a then 1 else 0 := by
    by_cases h : a ≤ m % a + n % a
    · rw [if_pos h]
      exact Nat.div_eq_of_lt_le (k := 1) (by simpa using h) (by omega)
    · rw [if_neg h]
      exact Nat.div_eq_of_lt (by omega)
  calc
    m / a + n / a + (m % a + n % a) / a =
        m / a + n / a + (if a ≤ m % a + n % a then 1 else 0) := by rw [hrem]
    _ = (m + n) / a := (Nat.add_div ha).symm

name: P23.Presentation.normalizeExponent_add
statement:
theorem normalizeExponent_add (d e : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) :
    normalizeExponent a b c (d + e) =
      normalizeExponent a b c d * normalizeExponent a b c e
proof:
:= by
  apply Normal.ext
  · simp [normalizeExponent, exponentRaw, Normal.mul, Normal.raw, Nat.add_mod]
  · simp only [normalizeExponent, exponentRaw, Normal.normalize_y, Finsupp.add_apply,
      Normal.mul_y, Normal.normalize_x]
    rw [← add_div_remainders (d 0) (e 0) a (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne a))]
    ring
  · simp only [normalizeExponent, exponentRaw, Normal.normalize_z, Finsupp.add_apply,
      Normal.mul_z, Normal.normalize_x]
    rw [← add_div_remainders (d 0) (e 0) a (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne a))]
    ring

name: P23.Presentation.monomial_normalizeExponent_prod
proof:
:= by
  induction d using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add d e hd he =>
      rw [Finsupp.prod_add_index' (fun _ => pow_zero _) (fun _ _ _ => pow_add _ _ _)]
      simp [hd, he, normalizeExponent_add]
  | single i n =>
      rw [Finsupp.prod_single_index]
      · induction n with
        | zero => simp
        | succ n ih =>
            rw [pow_succ, ih]
            change monomial (k := k) (normalizeExponent a b c (Finsupp.single i n)) *
                monomial (k := k) (normalizeExponent a b c (Finsupp.single i 1)) = _
            rw [monomial_mul, ← normalizeExponent_add]
            congr 2
            ext j
            simp [Finsupp.single_apply, Nat.succ_eq_add_one]
      · simp

      r • monomial (k := k) (normalizeExponent a b c d)
proof:
:= by
  rw [polyToNormalAlg, MvPolynomial.aeval_monomial]
  rw [monomial_normalizeExponent_prod]

proof:
:= by
  have hnorm :
      normalizeExponent a b c (Finsupp.single 0 a) =
        normalizeExponent a b c (Finsupp.single 1 b + Finsupp.single 2 c) := by
    apply Normal.ext <;>
      simp [normalizeExponent, exponentRaw, Normal.normalize,
        Nat.mod_eq_zero_of_dvd (dvd_refl a), Nat.div_self (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne a))]
  simp only [tiePolynomial, polyX, polyY, polyZ, map_sub, map_mul,
    MvPolynomial.X_pow_eq_monomial, polyToNormalAlg_monomial, one_smul]
  rw [monomial_mul, ← normalizeExponent_add, hnorm]
  simp

    Function.Surjective (polyToNormalAlg (k := k) (a := a) (b := b) (c := c))
proof:
:= by
  intro f
  induction f using MonoidAlgebra.induction_linear with
  | zero => exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
  | add f g hf hg =>
      rcases hf with ⟨pf, rfl⟩
      rcases hg with ⟨pg, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨pf + pg, by simp⟩
  | single p r =>
      refine ⟨MvPolynomial.monomial (normalExponent p) r, ?_⟩
      simp [monomial, MonoidAlgebra.smul_single]

name: P23.Presentation.tieIdeal_le_polyToNormalAlg_ker
statement:
theorem tieIdeal_le_polyToNormalAlg_ker :
    tieIdeal k a b c ≤
      RingHom.ker (polyToNormalAlg (k := k) (a := a) (b := b) (c := c)).toRingHom
proof:
:= by
  apply Ideal.span_le.2
  intro f hf
  rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hf]
  exact RingHom.mem_ker.2 polyToNormalAlg_tiePolynomial

name: P23.Presentation.polyToNormalAlg_ker_le_tieIdeal
statement:
theorem polyToNormalAlg_ker_le_tieIdeal :
    RingHom.ker (polyToNormalAlg (k := k) (a := a) (b := b) (c := c)).toRingHom ≤
      tieIdeal k a b c
proof:
:= by
  intro f hf
  have hf0 : polyToNormalAlg (k := k) (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) f = 0 :=
    RingHom.mem_ker.1 hf
  have hdiff := sub_reducedRepresentative_mem_tieIdeal
    (k := k) (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) f
  have hdiff0 :
      polyToNormalAlg (k := k) (a := a) (b := b) (c := c)
          (f - reducedRepresentative a b c f) = 0 :=
    RingHom.mem_ker.1 (tieIdeal_le_polyToNormalAlg_ker
      (k := k) (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) hdiff)
  have hrem0 :
      polyToNormalAlg (k := k) (a := a) (b := b) (c := c)
          (reducedRepresentative a b c f) = 0 := by
    simpa only [map_sub, hf0, zero_sub, neg_eq_zero] using hdiff0
  have hrem : reducedRepresentative a b c f = 0 :=
    polyToNormalAlg_injective_on_reduced
      (reducedRepresentative_isReduced (k := k) (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) f) hrem0
  simpa [hrem] using hdiff

name: P23.Presentation.polyToNormalAlg_ker
statement:
theorem polyToNormalAlg_ker :
    RingHom.ker (polyToNormalAlg (k := k) (a := a) (b := b) (c := c)).toRingHom =
      tieIdeal k a b c
proof:

name: P23.Presentation.killedMonomialIdeal_le_ker

    killedMonomialIdeal (k := k) S ≤
      RingHom.ker (truncateAlgHom (k := k) S).toRingHom
proof:
:= by
  apply Ideal.span_le.2
  rintro f ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
  apply RingHom.mem_ker.2
  apply truncateAlgHom_monomial_of_not_mem
  exact fun hfin => hp ((mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet S p).1 hfin)

name: P23.Presentation.ker_le_killedMonomialIdeal
statement:
theorem ker_le_killedMonomialIdeal (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) :
    RingHom.ker (truncateAlgHom (k := k) S).toRingHom ≤
      killedMonomialIdeal (k := k) S
proof:
:= by
  intro f hf
  have hf0 : truncateAlgHom (k := k) S f = 0 := RingHom.mem_ker.1 hf
  rw [← MonoidAlgebra.sum_coeff_single f]
  apply Submodule.sum_mem
  intro p hpSupport
  by_cases hp : p ∈ standardSet S
  · have hpFin : p ∈ standardFinset S :=
      (mem_standardFinset_iff_standardSet S p).2 hp
    have hc := congrArg
      (fun v : MonomialArtin k S => v.coeff ⟨p, hpFin⟩) hf0
    have hcoeff : f.coeff p = 0 := by
      simpa [coeff_truncateAlgHom] using hc
    simp [hcoeff]
  · have hm := monomial_mem_killedMonomialIdeal (k := k) S p hp
    have hsmul := (killedMonomialIdeal (k := k) S).mul_mem_left
      (algebraMap k (NormalMonoidAlgebra k a b c) (f.coeff p)) hm
    simpa [monomial, Algebra.smul_def] using hsmul

proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact ker_le_killedMonomialIdeal (k := k) S
  · exact killedMonomialIdeal_le_ker (k := k) S

name: P23.Presentation.normalWeight_mul
statement:
theorem normalWeight_mul (p q : Normal a b c) :
    normalWeight (p * q) = normalWeight p + normalWeight q
proof:
:= by
  have hdiv := Nat.mod_add_div (p.x + q.x) a
  simp only [normalWeight, Normal.mul_x, Normal.mul_y, Normal.mul_z]
  calc
    (b + c) * ((p.x + q.x) % a) +
          a * (p.y + q.y + (p.x + q.x) / a * b) +
          a * (p.z + q.z + (p.x + q.x) / a * c) =
        a * p.y + a * q.y + a * p.z + a * q.z +
          (b + c) * ((p.x + q.x) % a + a * ((p.x + q.x) / a)) := by ring
    _ = a * p.y + a * q.y + a * p.z + a * q.z +
          (b + c) * (p.x + q.x) := by rw [hdiv]
    _ = ((b + c) * p.x + a * p.y + a * p.z) +
          ((b + c) * q.x + a * q.y + a * q.z) := by ring

name: P23.Presentation.normalWeight_pos_of_ne_one
statement:
theorem normalWeight_pos_of_ne_one (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c)
    (p : Normal a b c) (hp : p ≠ 1) : 0 < normalWeight p
proof:
:= by
  have ha : 0 < a := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne a)
  have hbc : 0 < b + c := by
    rcases hdom.2 with hmix | hpure
    · omega
    · omega
  by_cases hx : 0 < p.x
  · have hpos : 0 < (b + c) * p.x := Nat.mul_pos hbc hx
    unfold normalWeight
    omega
  by_cases hy : 0 < p.y
  · have hpos : 0 < a * p.y := Nat.mul_pos ha hy
    unfold normalWeight
    omega
  by_cases hz : 0 < p.z
  · have hpos : 0 < a * p.z := Nat.mul_pos ha hz
    unfold normalWeight
    omega
  exfalso
  apply hp
  apply Normal.ext <;> simp <;> omega

name: P23.Presentation.normalWeight_lt_of_proper_dvd
statement:
theorem normalWeight_lt_of_proper_dvd (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c)
    {d p : Normal a b c} (hdp : d ∣ p) (hne : d ≠ p) :
    normalWeight d < normalWeight p
proof:
:= by
  rcases hdp with ⟨t, rfl⟩
  have ht : t ≠ 1 := by
    intro ht
    subst t
    exact hne (by simp)
  rw [normalWeight_mul]
  have hpos := normalWeight_pos_of_ne_one hdom t ht
  omega

name: P23.Presentation.killed_has_border_divisor
statement:
theorem killed_has_border_divisor (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (hS : S.Nonempty) (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c)
    (p : Normal a b c) (hp : p ∉ standardSet S) :
    ∃ g ∈ borderFinset S, g ∣ p
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let K := (Normal.divisorFinset p).filter fun q => q ∉ standardSet S
  have hpK : p ∈ K := by
    simp [K, Normal.mem_divisorFinset_iff, hp]
  obtain ⟨g, hgK, hmin⟩ := K.exists_min_image normalWeight ⟨p, hpK⟩
  have hgp : g ∣ p := (Normal.mem_divisorFinset_iff g p).1 (Finset.mem_filter.1 hgK).1
  have hgkill : g ∉ standardSet S := (Finset.mem_filter.1 hgK).2
  have hgminimal : IsDivisibilityMinimalKilled (standardSet S) g := by
    refine ⟨hgkill, ?_⟩
    intro d hdg hdne
    by_contra hdkill
    have hdK : d ∈ K := by
      apply Finset.mem_filter.2
      exact ⟨(Normal.mem_divisorFinset_iff d p).2 (dvd_trans hdg hgp), hdkill⟩
    have hle := hmin d hdK
    have hlt := normalWeight_lt_of_proper_dvd hdom hdg hdne
    omega
  have hborder : IsMinimalBorder (standardSet S) g :=
    (isMinimalBorder_iff_isDivisibilityMinimalKilled S g
      (variableGenerators_ne_one_of_two_le hdom.1)).2 hgminimal
  exact ⟨g, (mem_borderFinset_iff hS g).2 hborder, hgp⟩

name: P23.Presentation.borderMonomialIdeal_comap
statement:
theorem borderMonomialIdeal_comap (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) :
    Ideal.comap
        (polyToNormalAlg (k := k) (a := a) (b := b) (c := c)).toRingHom
        (borderMonomialIdeal (k := k) S) =
      finitePresentationIdeal (k := k) S
proof:
:= by
  rw [← polynomialBorderIdeal_map (k := k) S]
  rw [Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective
    (polyToNormalAlg (k := k) (a := a) (b := b) (c := c)).toRingHom
    (polyToNormalAlg_surjective (k := k) (a := a) (b := b) (c := c))]
  rw [← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot, polyToNormalAlg_ker]
  simpa only [finitePresentationIdeal] using
    (sup_comm (polynomialBorderIdeal (k := k) S) (tieIdeal k a b c))

name: P23.Presentation.polyToDirectAlg_ker
statement:
theorem polyToDirectAlg_ker (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (hS : S.Nonempty) (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) :
    RingHom.ker (polyToDirectAlg (k := k) S).toRingHom =
      finitePresentationIdeal (k := k) S
proof:
:= by
  calc
    RingHom.ker (polyToDirectAlg (k := k) S).toRingHom =
        Ideal.comap
          (polyToNormalAlg (k := k) (a := a) (b := b) (c := c)).toRingHom
          (RingHom.ker (truncateAlgHom (k := k) S).toRingHom) := by
            change RingHom.ker
                ((truncateAlgHom (k := k) S).comp
                  (polyToNormalAlg (k := k) (a := a) (b := b) (c := c))) =
              Ideal.comap
                (polyToNormalAlg (k := k) (a := a) (b := b) (c := c))
                (RingHom.ker (truncateAlgHom (k := k) S))
            exact (AlgHom.comap_ker (truncateAlgHom (k := k) S)
              (polyToNormalAlg (k := k) (a := a) (b := b) (c := c))).symm
    _ = Ideal.comap
          (polyToNormalAlg (k := k) (a := a) (b := b) (c := c)).toRingHom
          (killedMonomialIdeal (k := k) S) := by
            rw [truncateAlgHom_ker]
    _ = finitePresentationIdeal (k := k) S :=
      killedMonomialIdeal_comap (k := k) S hS hdom

proof:
:= quotientIsLocalRing (k := k) S hS hdom hlive

name: P23.Presentation.mem_quotientSocle_iff_equiv_mem_directSocle
statement:
theorem mem_quotientSocle_iff_equiv_mem_directSocle
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) (hlive : IsLiveTie S)
    (q : Q k S) :
    q ∈ QuotientSocle (k := k) S hS hdom hlive ↔
      finitePolynomialQuotientEquiv (k := k) S hS hdom q ∈
        DirectSocle (k := k) S hS hdom
proof:
:= by
  let E := finitePolynomialQuotientEquiv (k := k) S hS hdom
  letI := quotientIsLocalRing (k := k) S hS hdom hlive
  constructor
  · intro hq r hr
    let q' : Q k S := E.symm r
    have hq'max : q' ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Q k S) :=
      (quotientMaximalIdeal_mem_iff (k := k) S hS hdom hlive q').2 (by
        simpa [q', E] using hr)
    have hz := hq q' hq'max
    have := congrArg E hz
    simpa [q', E] using this
  · intro hq r hr
    have hEr : E r ∈ augmentationIdeal (k := k) S hS hdom :=
      (quotientMaximalIdeal_mem_iff (k := k) S hS hdom hlive r).1 hr
    have hz := hq (E r) hEr
    apply E.injective
    simpa [E] using hz

    idealGeneratorMu (finitePresentationIdeal (k:=k) S) ≤ S.card+3
proof:
:= by
  have hm := polyToDirectAlg_kernel_mu_eq_one_add_borderCard (k:=k) S hS hd h.live_tie
  rw [polyToDirectAlg_ker (k:=k) S hS hd] at hm

name: P23.Presentation.oneTie_ng_kernel_mu_ge_type_plus_four_has_dominant
statement:
theorem oneTie_ng_kernel_mu_ge_type_plus_four_has_dominant
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hd : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) (hl : IsLiveTie S)
    (ha : IsRootAntichain S) (ht : S.card=2 ∨ S.card=3)
    (hn : QuotientNearlyGorenstein k S hS hd hl)
    (hm : S.card+4 ≤ idealGeneratorMu (finitePresentationIdeal (k:=k) S)) :
    ∃ s∈S, IsDominantRoot S s
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hh
  have hno : ∀ s∈S, ¬IsDominantRoot S s := by simpa using hh
  have hlo : 2≤S.card := by omega
  have hhi : S.card≤3 := by omega
  have hc := canonical_ng_hasDirectionalCentres S hS hd hl ha hlo hn
  have hb := oneTie_nondominant_kernel_mu_le_type_plus_three (k:=k) S hS hd
    ⟨hd.1,hd.2,hl,hlo,hhi,ha,hc,hno⟩
  omega

name: P23.Presentation.reducedRepresentative_isReduced
statement:
theorem reducedRepresentative_isReduced (f : ThreePoly k) :
    IsXReduced a (reducedRepresentative a b c f)
proof:
:= by
  intro d hd
  let g := threePolyEquivIterated (k := k) f %ₘ iteratedTiePolynomial (k := k) a b c
  have hd' : d 0 ∈ g.support := by
    have hi : d 0 ∈ Finset.image (fun e : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ => e 0)
        (reducedRepresentative a b c f).support :=
      Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨d, hd, rfl⟩
    have hi' : d 0 ∈
        (threePolyEquivIterated (k := k) (reducedRepresentative a b c f)).support := by
      change d 0 ∈
        (MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv k 2 (reducedRepresentative a b c f)).support
      rw [MvPolynomial.support_finSuccEquiv]
      exact hi
    simpa [g] using hi'
  have hle : d 0 ≤ g.natDegree := Polynomial.le_natDegree_of_mem_supp _ hd'
  have hlt : g.natDegree < a := by
    simpa [g] using Polynomial.natDegree_modByMonic_lt
      (threePolyEquivIterated (k := k) f)
      (iteratedTiePolynomial_monic (k := k) (a := a) (b := b) (c := c))
      (by
        intro h
        have := congrArg Polynomial.natDegree h
        simp at this
        exact (NeZero.ne a this).elim)
  exact hle.trans_lt hlt

name: P23.Presentation.sub_reducedRepresentative_mem_tieIdeal
statement:
theorem sub_reducedRepresentative_mem_tieIdeal (f : ThreePoly k) :
    f - reducedRepresentative a b c f ∈ tieIdeal k a b c
proof:
:= by
  let E := threePolyEquivIterated (k := k)
  let q := iteratedTiePolynomial (k := k) a b c
  let h : ThreePoly k := E.symm (E f /ₘ q)
  have hdecomp : reducedRepresentative a b c f + tiePolynomial (k := k) a b c * h = f := by
    apply E.injective
    simp only [map_add, map_mul, threePolyEquivIterated_reducedRepresentative,
      threePolyEquivIterated_tiePolynomial, E, q, h, AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    exact Polynomial.modByMonic_add_div _ _
  have hsub : f - reducedRepresentative a b c f = tiePolynomial (k := k) a b c * h := by
    nth_rewrite 1 [← hdecomp]
    simp only [add_sub_cancel_left]
  rw [hsub]
  exact Ideal.mul_mem_right h (tieIdeal k a b c)
    (tiePolynomial_mem_tieIdeal (k := k) (a := a) (b := b) (c := c))

name: P23.Presentation.coeff_polyToNormalAlg
statement:
theorem coeff_polyToNormalAlg (f : ThreePoly k) (p : Normal a b c) :
    (polyToNormalAlg (k := k) (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) f).coeff p =
      ∑ d ∈ f.support,
        if normalizeExponent a b c d = p then f.coeff d else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hf := congrArg (polyToNormalAlg (k := k) (a := a) (b := b) (c := c))
    (MvPolynomial.as_sum f)
  calc
    (polyToNormalAlg (k := k) (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) f).coeff p =
        (polyToNormalAlg (k := k) (a := a) (b := b) (c := c)
          (∑ d ∈ f.support, MvPolynomial.monomial d (f.coeff d))).coeff p :=
      congrArg (fun z : NormalMonoidAlgebra k a b c => z.coeff p) hf
    _ = ∑ d ∈ f.support,
        if normalizeExponent a b c d = p then f.coeff d else 0 := by
      simp_rw [map_sum, polyToNormalAlg_monomial]
      have hcoeff := congrArg (fun g => g p)
        (MonoidAlgebra.coeff_sum f.support
          (fun d => f.coeff d • monomial (k := k) (normalizeExponent a b c d)))
      rw [hcoeff]
      have happ :
          (∑ d ∈ f.support,
            (f.coeff d • monomial (k := k) (normalizeExponent a b c d)).coeff) p =
          ∑ d ∈ f.support,
            (f.coeff d • monomial (k := k) (normalizeExponent a b c d)).coeff p := by
        exact map_sum (Finsupp.applyAddHom p)
          (fun d => (f.coeff d • monomial (k := k) (normalizeExponent a b c d)).coeff)
          f.support
      rw [happ]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro d hd
      simp [Finsupp.single_apply]

name: P23.Presentation.normalizeExponent_injective_of_x_lt
proof:
:= by
  have hx := congrArg Normal.x h
  have hy := congrArg Normal.y h
  have hz := congrArg Normal.z h
  simp only [normalizeExponent, exponentRaw, Normal.normalize_x,
    Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hd, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt he] at hx
  simp only [normalizeExponent, exponentRaw, Normal.normalize_y,
    Nat.div_eq_of_lt hd, Nat.div_eq_of_lt he, zero_mul, add_zero] at hy
  simp only [normalizeExponent, exponentRaw, Normal.normalize_z,
    Nat.div_eq_of_lt hd, Nat.div_eq_of_lt he, zero_mul, add_zero] at hz
  ext i
  fin_cases i
  · exact hx
  · exact hy
  · exact hz

name: P23.Presentation.polyToNormalAlg_injective_on_reduced
statement:
theorem polyToNormalAlg_injective_on_reduced {f : ThreePoly k}
    (hred : IsXReduced a f)
    (hmap : polyToNormalAlg (k := k) (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) f = 0) :
    f = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext d
  by_cases hd0 : f.coeff d = 0
  · simp [hd0]
  · have hd : d ∈ f.support := MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff.mpr hd0
    have hdx : d 0 < a := hred d hd
    have hc := congrArg (fun z : NormalMonoidAlgebra k a b c =>
      z.coeff (normalizeExponent a b c d)) hmap
    rw [coeff_polyToNormalAlg] at hc
    change (∑ e ∈ f.support,
        if normalizeExponent a b c e = normalizeExponent a b c d then f.coeff e else 0) = 0 at hc
    have hsum : (∑ e ∈ f.support,
        if normalizeExponent a b c e = normalizeExponent a b c d then f.coeff e else 0) =
        f.coeff d := by
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single d]
      · simp
      · intro e he hed
        have hex : e 0 < a := hred e he
        have hne : normalizeExponent a b c e ≠ normalizeExponent a b c d := by
          intro hnorm
          exact hed (normalizeExponent_injective_of_x_lt hex hdx hnorm)
        simp [hne]
      · intro hnot
        exact (hnot hd).elim
    rw [hsum] at hc
    exact (hd0 hc).elim

name: P23.Presentation.coeff_truncateAlgHom
statement:
theorem coeff_truncateAlgHom (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (f : NormalMonoidAlgebra k a b c) (p : MonomialIndex S) :
    (truncateAlgHom (k := k) S f).coeff p = f.coeff p.1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction f using MonoidAlgebra.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add f g hf hg => simp [hf, hg]
  | single q r =>
      by_cases hq : q ∈ standardFinset S
      · by_cases hqp : q = p.1
        · subst q
          simp [truncatedMonomial, hq]
        · have hpne : p ≠ (⟨q, hq⟩ : MonomialIndex S) := by
            intro h
            apply hqp
            exact (congrArg Subtype.val h).symm
          simp [truncatedMonomial, hq, hqp, hpne]
      · have hne : q ≠ p.1 := by
          intro h
          apply hq
          simpa [h] using p.2
        simp [truncatedMonomial, hq, Finsupp.single_apply, hne]

name: P23.Presentation.truncateAlgHom_surjective
statement:
theorem truncateAlgHom_surjective (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) :
    Function.Surjective (truncateAlgHom (k := k) S)
proof:
:= by
  intro v
  induction v using MonomialArtin.induction_linear with
  | zero => exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
  | add x y hx hy =>
      rcases hx with ⟨fx, hfx⟩
      rcases hy with ⟨fy, hfy⟩
      exact ⟨fx + fy, by simp [hfx, hfy]⟩
  | single p r =>
      refine ⟨MonoidAlgebra.single p.1 r, ?_⟩
      simp [truncatedMonomial, p.2, MonomialArtin.smul_X]

name: P23.Presentation.quotientOmegaEquivDirectOmega_apply_equiv

        (finitePolynomialQuotientEquiv (k := k) S hS hdom q) = φ q
proof:
:= by

    (finitePolynomialQuotientEquiv (k := k) S hS hdom q)) = φ q

name: P23.Presentation.quotientOmegaEquivDirectOmega_smul
statement:
theorem quotientOmegaEquivDirectOmega_smul
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) (q : Q k S)
    (φ : QuotientOmega k S) :
    quotientOmegaEquivDirectOmega (k := k) S hS hdom (q • φ) =
      finitePolynomialQuotientEquiv (k := k) S hS hdom q •
        quotientOmegaEquivDirectOmega (k := k) S hS hdom φ
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro r
  change φ (q * (finitePolynomialQuotientEquiv (k := k) S hS hdom).symm r) =
    φ ((finitePolynomialQuotientEquiv (k := k) S hS hdom).symm
      (finitePolynomialQuotientEquiv (k := k) S hS hdom q * r))
  congr 1
  simp

name: P23.Presentation.quotientOmegaEquivDirectOmega_symm_smul

    (F : QuotientOmega k S →ₗ[Q k S] Q k S) :

proof:
:=
  le_iSup (fun G : QuotientOmega k S →ₗ[Q k S] Q k S => G.range) F

name: P23.Presentation.mem_quotientTrace_iff_equiv_mem_directTrace
statement:
theorem mem_quotientTrace_iff_equiv_mem_directTrace
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) (q : Q k S) :
    q ∈ QuotientTraceSubmodule k S ↔
      finitePolynomialQuotientEquiv (k := k) S hS hdom q ∈
        TraceSubmodule k S
proof:
:= by
  let E := finitePolynomialQuotientEquiv (k := k) S hS hdom
  constructor
  · intro hq
    refine Submodule.iSup_induction
      (fun F : QuotientOmega k S →ₗ[Q k S] Q k S => F.range)
      (motive := fun x => E x ∈ TraceSubmodule k S) hq ?_ (by simp) ?_
    · intro F x hx
      rcases hx with ⟨φ, rfl⟩
      exact trace_range_le (k := k) S (pushCanonicalHom (k := k) S hS hdom F)
        ⟨quotientOmegaEquivDirectOmega (k := k) S hS hdom φ,
          by simp [pushCanonicalHom, E]⟩
    · intro x y hx hy
      simpa using (TraceSubmodule k S).add_mem hx hy
  · intro hq
    have hback : E.symm (E q) ∈ QuotientTraceSubmodule k S := by
      refine Submodule.iSup_induction
        (fun F : Omega k S →ₗ[A k S] A k S => F.range)
        (motive := fun x => E.symm x ∈ QuotientTraceSubmodule k S) hq ?_ (by simp) ?_
      · intro F x hx
        rcases hx with ⟨ψ, rfl⟩
        exact quotientTrace_range_le (k := k) S
          (pullCanonicalHom (k := k) S hS hdom F)
          ⟨(quotientOmegaEquivDirectOmega (k := k) S hS hdom).symm ψ,
            by simp [pullCanonicalHom, E]⟩
      · intro x y hx hy
        simpa using (QuotientTraceSubmodule k S).add_mem hx hy
    simpa [E] using hback

name: P23.Presentation.quotientNearlyGorenstein_iff_directNearlyGorenstein
statement:
theorem quotientNearlyGorenstein_iff_directNearlyGorenstein
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) (hlive : IsLiveTie S) :
    QuotientNearlyGorenstein k S hS hdom hlive ↔
      DirectNearlyGorenstein k S hS hdom
proof:
:= by
  let E := finitePolynomialQuotientEquiv (k := k) S hS hdom
  unfold QuotientNearlyGorenstein DirectNearlyGorenstein
  letI := quotientIsLocalRing (k := k) S hS hdom hlive
  rw [quotientMaximalIdeal_eq_augmentationIdeal (k := k) S hS hdom hlive]
  constructor
  · intro hng r hr
    let q : Q k S := E.symm r
    have hqaug : q ∈ quotientAugmentationIdeal (k := k) S hS hdom := by
      change E q ∈ augmentationIdeal (k := k) S hS hdom
      simpa [q, E] using hr
    have hqt := hng hqaug
    have ht := (mem_quotientTrace_iff_equiv_mem_directTrace
      (k := k) S hS hdom q).1 hqt
    simpa [q, E] using ht
  · intro hng q hq
    have hEq : E q ∈ augmentationIdeal (k := k) S hS hdom := hq
    have hEt := hng hEq
    exact (mem_quotientTrace_iff_equiv_mem_directTrace
      (k := k) S hS hdom q).2 hEt

name: P23.Presentation.finiteQuotientArtinTransport
statement:
theorem finiteQuotientArtinTransport
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) (hlive : IsLiveTie S)
    (hanti : IsRootAntichain S) :
    FiniteQuotientArtinTransport (k := k) S hS hdom hlive hanti
proof:
:=
  ⟨quotientIsLocalRing (k := k) S hS hdom hlive,
    quotientSocle_finrank_eq_card (k := k) S hS hdom hlive hanti,
    quotientType_eq_rootCard (k := k) S hS hdom hlive hanti,
    mem_quotientTrace_iff_equiv_mem_directTrace (k := k) S hS hdom,
    quotientNearlyGorenstein_iff_directNearlyGorenstein
      (k := k) S hS hdom hlive⟩

name: P23.Presentation.polyVariableIdeal_eq_span_variables
statement:
theorem polyVariableIdeal_eq_span_variables :
    polyVariableIdeal (k := k) =
      Ideal.span ({polyX, polyY, polyZ} : Set (ThreePoly k))
proof:
:= by
  ext f
  rw [mem_polyVariableIdeal_iff]
  have hvars : ({polyX, polyY, polyZ} : Set (ThreePoly k)) =
      MvPolynomial.X '' (Set.univ : Set (Fin 3)) := by
    ext p
    constructor
    · simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff,
        Set.mem_image, Set.mem_univ, true_and]
      rintro (rfl | rfl | rfl)
      · exact ⟨0, rfl⟩
      · exact ⟨1, rfl⟩
      · exact ⟨2, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨i, -, rfl⟩
      fin_cases i <;> simp [polyX, polyY, polyZ]
  rw [hvars, MvPolynomial.mem_ideal_span_X_image]
  constructor
  · intro hzero m hm
    have hm0 : m ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      subst m
      exact (MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff.mp hm) hzero
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Finsupp.ne_iff.mp hm0
    refine ⟨i, Set.mem_univ i, hi⟩
  · intro hsupport
    by_contra hzero
    have hmem : (0 : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) ∈ f.support :=
      MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff.mpr hzero
    obtain ⟨i, -, hi⟩ := hsupport 0 hmem
    exact hi rfl

  rw [presentationGeneratorFinset, Finset.card_insert_of_notMem]
  · rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _
      (polynomialLift_injective (k := k) (a := a) (b := b) (c := c))]
    omega
  · simp only [Finset.mem_image, not_exists, not_and]
