name: P23.Presentation.relationDetector_some
statement:
@[simp]
theorem relationDetector_some (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (f : ThreePoly k) (g : ↥(borderFinset S)) :
    relationDetector (k := k) S f (some g) =
      (polyToNormalAlg (k := k) f).coeff g.1
proof: := rfl

name: P23.Presentation.liveDomain_b_pos
statement: private theorem liveDomain_b_pos (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) : 0 < b
proof:
:= by
  rcases hdom with ⟨-, hmix | hpure⟩ <;> omega

name: P23.Presentation.normalExponent_ne_tieXExponent
statement:
private theorem normalExponent_ne_tieXExponent (p : Normal a b c) :
    normalExponent p ≠ tieXExponent a
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hx := congrArg (fun d : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ => d 0) h
  simp [tieXExponent] at hx
  have hp := p.x_lt
  omega

name: P23.Presentation.normalExponent_eq_liveTieExponent_iff
statement:
private theorem normalExponent_eq_liveTieExponent_iff (p : Normal a b c) :
    normalExponent p =
        Finsupp.single 1 b + Finsupp.single 2 c ↔
      p = (liveTiePoint : Normal a b c)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    apply Normal.ext
    · have hx := congrArg (fun d : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ => d 0) h
      simpa [liveTiePoint] using hx
    · have hy := congrArg (fun d : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ => d 1) h
      simpa [liveTiePoint] using hy
    · have hz := congrArg (fun d : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ => d 2) h
      simpa [liveTiePoint] using hz
  · rintro rfl
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [normalExponent, liveTiePoint]

name: P23.Presentation.border_not_standard
statement:
private theorem border_not_standard
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    {g : Normal a b c} (hg : g ∈ borderFinset S) :
    g ∉ standardSet S
proof:
:=
  ((mem_borderFinset_iff hS g).1 hg).1

name: P23.Presentation.border_dvd_border_eq
statement:
private theorem border_dvd_border_eq
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c)
    {g h : Normal a b c} (hg : g ∈ borderFinset S)
    (hh : h ∈ borderFinset S) (hdvd : h ∣ g) : h = g
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  have hgmin : IsDivisibilityMinimalKilled (standardSet S) g :=
    (isMinimalBorder_iff_isDivisibilityMinimalKilled S g
      (variableGenerators_ne_one_of_two_le hdom.1)).1
      ((mem_borderFinset_iff hS g).1 hg)
  exact border_not_standard S hS hh (hgmin.2 h hdvd hne)

name: P23.Presentation.normalExponent_le_implies_dvd
statement:
private theorem normalExponent_le_implies_dvd
    {p q : Normal a b c} (h : normalExponent p ≤ normalExponent q) : p ∣ q
proof:
:= by
  apply (Normal.exact_divides_iff p q).2
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, Or.inl ?_⟩
  · simpa using h 1
  · simpa using h 2
  · simpa using h 0

name: P23.Presentation.border_normalExponent_not_le_tieX
statement:
private theorem border_normalExponent_not_le_tieX
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hlive : IsLiveTie S) {g : Normal a b c}
    (hg : g ∈ borderFinset S) :
    ¬normalExponent g ≤ tieXExponent a
proof:
:= by
  intro hle
  have hgy : g.y = 0 := by
    have hgyLe : g.y ≤ 0 := by
      simpa [normalExponent, tieXExponent] using hle 1
    exact Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero hgyLe
  have hgz : g.z = 0 := by
    have hgzLe : g.z ≤ 0 := by
      simpa [normalExponent, tieXExponent] using hle 2
    exact Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero hgzLe
  have hdvd : g ∣ (liveTiePoint : Normal a b c) := by
    apply (Normal.exact_divides_iff g liveTiePoint).2
    simp [Normal.DividesCriterion, liveTiePoint, hgy, hgz]
  exact border_not_standard S hS hg (standardSet_dvd_closed S hlive.2.2.2 hdvd)

name: P23.Presentation.relationDetector_tie_none
statement:
@[simp]
theorem relationDetector_tie_none
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) :
    relationDetector (k := k) S (tiePolynomial (k := k) a b c) none = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hne :
      (Finsupp.single 1 b + Finsupp.single 2 c : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) ≠
        tieXExponent a := by
    intro h
    have hy := congrArg (fun d : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ => d 1) h
    simp [tieXExponent] at hy
    exact (Nat.ne_of_gt (liveDomain_b_pos hdom)) hy
  rw [tiePolynomial]
  rw [show (polyX : ThreePoly k) ^ a =
      MvPolynomial.monomial (tieXExponent a) (1 : k) by
    unfold polyX tieXExponent
    rw [MvPolynomial.X_pow_eq_monomial]]
  rw [show (polyY : ThreePoly k) ^ b * polyZ ^ c =
      MvPolynomial.monomial
        (Finsupp.single 1 b + Finsupp.single 2 c) (1 : k) by
    unfold polyY polyZ
    rw [MvPolynomial.X_pow_eq_monomial, MvPolynomial.X_pow_eq_monomial,
      MvPolynomial.monomial_mul]
    simp]
  simp [relationDetector, MvPolynomial.coeff_monomial, hne]

name: P23.Presentation.relationDetector_lift_none
statement:
@[simp]
theorem relationDetector_lift_none
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hlive : IsLiveTie S) (g : ↥(borderFinset S)) :
    relationDetector (k := k) S (polynomialLift (k := k) g.1) none = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [relationDetector, polynomialLift, MvPolynomial.coeff_monomial,
    normalExponent_ne_tieXExponent (p := g.1)]

name: P23.Presentation.relationDetector_tie_some
statement:
@[simp]
theorem relationDetector_tie_some
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) (hlive : IsLiveTie S)
    (g : ↥(borderFinset S)) :
    relationDetector (k := k) S (tiePolynomial (k := k) a b c) (some g) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [relationDetector]

name: P23.Presentation.relationDetector_lift_some
statement:
@[simp]
theorem relationDetector_lift_some
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (g h : ↥(borderFinset S)) :
    relationDetector (k := k) S (polynomialLift (k := k) h.1) (some g) =
      if g = h then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [relationDetector_some, polyToNormalAlg_polynomialLift]
  change (monomial (k := k) h.1).coeff g.1 = _
  by_cases e : g = h
  · subst h
    simp
  · have hval : g.1 ≠ h.1 := by
      intro hv
      exact e (Subtype.ext hv)
    simp [monomial_coeff, hval, Ne.symm hval, e]

name: P23.Presentation.normalizeExponent_eq_one_iff
statement:
private theorem normalizeExponent_eq_one_iff
    (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) (d : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) :
    normalizeExponent a b c d = (1 : Normal a b c) ↔ d = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hx := congrArg Normal.x h
    have hy := congrArg Normal.y h
    have hz := congrArg Normal.z h
    simp [normalizeExponent, exponentRaw, Normal.normalize, Normal.one] at hx hy hz
    have hb : 0 < b := liveDomain_b_pos hdom
    have hlt : d 0 < a := by
      rcases hy.2 with (ha0 | hlt) | hb0
      · exact (NeZero.ne a ha0).elim
      · exact hlt
      · exact (Nat.ne_of_gt hb hb0).elim
    have hd0 : d 0 = 0 := by
      simpa [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hlt] using hx
    apply Finsupp.ext
    intro i
    fin_cases i
    · simpa using hd0
    · simpa using hy.1
    · simpa using hz.1
  · rintro rfl
    apply Normal.ext <;>
      simp [normalizeExponent, exponentRaw, Normal.normalize, Normal.one]

name: P23.Presentation.coeff_one_polyToNormalAlg
statement:
private theorem coeff_one_polyToNormalAlg
    (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) (f : ThreePoly k) :
    (polyToNormalAlg (k := k) (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) f).coeff 1 =
      MvPolynomial.constantCoeff f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [coeff_polyToNormalAlg]
  simp [normalizeExponent_eq_one_iff hdom,
    MvPolynomial.constantCoeff_eq, eq_comm]

name: P23.Presentation.relationDetector_mul_tie_none
statement:
private theorem relationDetector_mul_tie_none
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) (q : ThreePoly k) :
    relationDetector (k := k) S
        (q * tiePolynomial (k := k) a b c) none =
      MvPolynomial.constantCoeff q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let yz : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ := Finsupp.single 1 b + Finsupp.single 2 c
  have hnle : ¬yz ≤ tieXExponent a := by
    intro h
    have hy := h 1
    simp [yz, tieXExponent] at hy
    exact (Nat.ne_of_gt (liveDomain_b_pos hdom)) hy
  rw [tiePolynomial, mul_sub]
  rw [show (polyX : ThreePoly k) ^ a =
      MvPolynomial.monomial (tieXExponent a) (1 : k) by
    unfold polyX tieXExponent
    rw [MvPolynomial.X_pow_eq_monomial]]
  rw [show (polyY : ThreePoly k) ^ b * polyZ ^ c =
      MvPolynomial.monomial yz (1 : k) by
    unfold polyY polyZ yz
    rw [MvPolynomial.X_pow_eq_monomial, MvPolynomial.X_pow_eq_monomial,
      MvPolynomial.monomial_mul]
    simp]
  simp [relationDetector, MvPolynomial.coeff_mul_monomial', hnle,
    MvPolynomial.constantCoeff_eq]

name: P23.Presentation.relationDetector_mul_lift_none
statement:
private theorem relationDetector_mul_lift_none
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hlive : IsLiveTie S) (q : ThreePoly k)
    (g : ↥(borderFinset S)) :
    relationDetector (k := k) S
        (q * polynomialLift (k := k) g.1) none = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [relationDetector, polynomialLift, MvPolynomial.coeff_mul_monomial',
    border_normalExponent_not_le_tieX S hS hlive g.2]

name: P23.Presentation.relationDetector_mul_tie_some
statement:
private theorem relationDetector_mul_tie_some
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (q : ThreePoly k)
    (g : ↥(borderFinset S)) :
    relationDetector (k := k) S
        (q * tiePolynomial (k := k) a b c) (some g) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [relationDetector]

name: P23.Presentation.relationDetector_mul_lift_some
statement:
private theorem relationDetector_mul_lift_some
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) (q : ThreePoly k)
    (g h : ↥(borderFinset S)) :
    relationDetector (k := k) S
        (q * polynomialLift (k := k) h.1) (some g) =
      if g = h then MvPolynomial.constantCoeff q else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [relationDetector_some, map_mul, polyToNormalAlg_polynomialLift]
  change ((polyToNormalAlg (k := k) q) * MonoidAlgebra.single h.1 1).coeff g.1 = _
  by_cases e : g = h
  · subst h
    rw [MonoidAlgebra.coeff_mul_single_eq_coeff_mul (m₂ := 1)]
    · simp [coeff_one_polyToNormalAlg (k := k) hdom]
    · intro d hd
      constructor
      · intro heq
        exact Normal.mul_right_cancel (p := g.1) (by simpa using heq)
      · rintro rfl
        simp
  · have hne : ∀ d : Normal a b c, d * h.1 ≠ g.1 := by
      intro d hd
      apply e
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact (border_dvd_border_eq S hS hdom g.2 h.2
        ⟨d, by simpa [mul_comm] using hd.symm⟩).symm
    simp [MonoidAlgebra.coeff_mul_single_of_forall_mul_ne, hne, e]

name: P23.Presentation.relationDetector_mul_displayed_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem relationDetector_mul_displayed_eq_zero
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) (hlive : IsLiveTie S)
    {q f : ThreePoly k} (hq : q ∈ polyVariableIdeal (k := k))
    (hf : f ∈ presentationGeneratorFinset (k := k) S) :
    relationDetector (k := k) S (q * f) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hq0 : MvPolynomial.constantCoeff q = 0 :=
    (mem_polyVariableIdeal_iff q).1 hq
  rw [presentationGeneratorFinset] at hf
  rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hf with rfl | hf
  · ext i
    cases i with
    | none => simp [relationDetector_mul_tie_none (k := k) S hdom q, hq0]
    | some g => simp [relationDetector_mul_tie_some (k := k) S q g]
  · rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hf with ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩
    ext i
    cases i with
    | none =>
        exact relationDetector_mul_lift_none (k := k) S hS hlive q ⟨g, hg⟩
    | some r =>
        simp [relationDetector_mul_lift_some (k := k) S hS hdom q r ⟨g, hg⟩,
          hq0]

name: P23.Presentation.relationDetector_mul_presentationGenerator_eq_zero
statement:
theorem relationDetector_mul_presentationGenerator_eq_zero
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) (hlive : IsLiveTie S)
    (q : ThreePoly k) (hq : q ∈ polyVariableIdeal (k := k))
    (f : ThreePoly k) (hf : f ∈ presentationGeneratorFinset (k := k) S) :
    relationDetector (k := k) S (q * f) = 0
proof:
:=
  relationDetector_mul_displayed_eq_zero S hS hdom hlive hq hf

name: P23.Presentation.relationDetector_eq_zero_of_mem_mul
statement:
private theorem relationDetector_eq_zero_of_mem_mul
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) (hlive : IsLiveTie S)
    {f : ThreePoly k}
    (hf : f ∈ polyVariableIdeal (k := k) *
      finitePresentationIdeal (k := k) S) :
    relationDetector (k := k) S f = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hf' : f ∈ polyVariableIdeal (k := k) •
      Submodule.span (ThreePoly k)
        ((id : ThreePoly k → ThreePoly k) ''
          (↑(presentationGeneratorFinset (k := k) S) : Set (ThreePoly k))) := by
    change f ∈ polyVariableIdeal (k := k) •
      (finitePresentationIdeal (k := k) S : Submodule (ThreePoly k) (ThreePoly k)) at hf
    rw [← span_presentationGeneratorFinset (k := k) S] at hf
    simpa using hf
  obtain ⟨coeff, hcoeff, hsum⟩ :=
    (Submodule.mem_ideal_smul_span_iff_exists_sum'
      (polyVariableIdeal (k := k))
      (↑(presentationGeneratorFinset (k := k) S) : Set (ThreePoly k))
      (id : ThreePoly k → ThreePoly k) f).1 hf'
  rw [← hsum]
  simp only [Finsupp.sum, id_eq, smul_eq_mul, map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro i hi
  exact relationDetector_mul_displayed_eq_zero S hS hdom hlive
    (hcoeff i) i.2

name: P23.Presentation.mem_presentationRelationSubmodule_iff
statement:
private theorem mem_presentationRelationSubmodule_iff
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c))
    (f : finitePresentationIdeal (k := k) S) :
    f ∈ presentationRelationSubmodule (k := k) S ↔
      (f : ThreePoly k) ∈ polyVariableIdeal (k := k) *
        finitePresentationIdeal (k := k) S
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: P23.Presentation.relationSpaceDetector_relationClass
statement:
@[simp]
theorem relationSpaceDetector_relationClass
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) (hlive : IsLiveTie S)
    (f : ThreePoly k) (hf : f ∈ finitePresentationIdeal (k := k) S) :
    relationSpaceDetector (k := k) S hS hdom hlive (relationClass S f hf) =
      relationDetector (k := k) S f
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: P23.Presentation.relationClass_mul_eq_smul
statement:
private theorem relationClass_mul_eq_smul
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (q f : ThreePoly k)
    (hf : f ∈ finitePresentationIdeal (k := k) S) :
    relationClass S (q * f) ((finitePresentationIdeal (k := k) S).mul_mem_left q hf) =
      MvPolynomial.constantCoeff q • relationClass S f hf
proof:
:= by
  change Submodule.Quotient.mk
      (⟨q * f, (finitePresentationIdeal (k := k) S).mul_mem_left q hf⟩ :
        finitePresentationIdeal (k := k) S) =
    MvPolynomial.constantCoeff q • Submodule.Quotient.mk
      (⟨f, hf⟩ : finitePresentationIdeal (k := k) S)
  rw [← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul]
  apply (Submodule.Quotient.eq (presentationRelationSubmodule (k := k) S)).2
  apply (mem_presentationRelationSubmodule_iff S _).2
  have hmem : q * f - MvPolynomial.C (MvPolynomial.constantCoeff q) * f ∈
      polyVariableIdeal (k := k) * finitePresentationIdeal (k := k) S := by
    rw [← sub_mul]
    apply Ideal.mul_mem_mul
    · apply (mem_polyVariableIdeal_iff _).2
      simp
    · exact hf
  simpa [Algebra.smul_def] using hmem

name: P23.Presentation.relationClass_add
statement:
private theorem relationClass_add
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (f g : ThreePoly k)
    (hf : f ∈ finitePresentationIdeal (k := k) S)
    (hg : g ∈ finitePresentationIdeal (k := k) S) :
    relationClass S (f + g) ((finitePresentationIdeal (k := k) S).add_mem hf hg) =
      relationClass S f hf + relationClass S g hg
proof:
:= by
  change Submodule.Quotient.mk
      (⟨f + g, (finitePresentationIdeal (k := k) S).add_mem hf hg⟩ :
        finitePresentationIdeal (k := k) S) =
    Submodule.Quotient.mk (⟨f, hf⟩ : finitePresentationIdeal (k := k) S) +
      Submodule.Quotient.mk (⟨g, hg⟩ : finitePresentationIdeal (k := k) S)
  convert Submodule.Quotient.mk_add
    (presentationRelationSubmodule (k := k) S) using 1
  apply congrArg Submodule.Quotient.mk
  ext
  rfl

name: P23.Presentation.relationSpaceDetector_displayedRelation
statement:
@[simp]
theorem relationSpaceDetector_displayedRelation
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) (hlive : IsLiveTie S)
    (i : RelationDetectorIndex S) :
    relationSpaceDetector (k := k) S hS hdom hlive
        (displayedRelation (k := k) S i) =
      Pi.single i 1
proof:
:= by
  funext j
  cases i with
  | none =>
      cases j with
      | none => simp [displayedRelation, relationDetector_tie_none (k := k) S hdom]
      | some g =>
          simp [displayedRelation,
            relationDetector_tie_some (k := k) S hS hdom hlive]
  | some g =>
      cases j with
      | none =>
          simp [displayedRelation,
            relationDetector_lift_none (k := k) S hS hlive]
      | some r =>
          change relationSpaceDetector (k := k) S hS hdom hlive
              (relationClass S (polynomialLift (k := k) g.1)
                (polynomialLift_mem_finitePresentationIdeal_of_border
                  (k := k) S g.2)) (some r) = _
          rw [relationSpaceDetector_relationClass,
            relationDetector_lift_some (k := k) S]
          by_cases h : r = g
          · subst r
            simp
          · simp [h]

name: P23.Presentation.generatorRelationClasses_span_eq_top
statement:
theorem generatorRelationClasses_span_eq_top
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (G : Finset (ThreePoly k))
    (hG : Ideal.span (↑G : Set (ThreePoly k)) =
      finitePresentationIdeal (k := k) S) :
    Submodule.span k (Set.range (generatorRelationClass (k := k) S G hG)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  apply top_unique
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ :=
    (presentationRelationSubmodule (k := k) S).mkQ_surjective z
  change relationClass S f.1 f.2 ∈
    Submodule.span k (Set.range (generatorRelationClass (k := k) S G hG))
  have hf : (f : ThreePoly k) ∈ Ideal.span (↑G : Set (ThreePoly k)) := by
    rw [hG]
    exact f.2
  let W := Submodule.span k
    (Set.range (generatorRelationClass (k := k) S G hG))
  have hclaim : ∀ (x : ThreePoly k)
      (hx : x ∈ Ideal.span (↑G : Set (ThreePoly k))),
      relationClass S x (by rw [← hG]; exact hx) ∈ W := by
    intro x hx
    induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem x hx =>
        apply Submodule.subset_span
        refine ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, ?_⟩
        rfl
    | zero =>
        exact Submodule.zero_mem W
    | add x y hx hy ihx ihy =>
        have hxI : x ∈ finitePresentationIdeal (k := k) S := by
          rw [← hG]
          exact hx
        have hyI : y ∈ finitePresentationIdeal (k := k) S := by
          rw [← hG]
          exact hy
        rw [relationClass_add S x y hxI hyI]
        exact W.add_mem ihx ihy
    | smul q x hx ih =>
        have hxI : x ∈ finitePresentationIdeal (k := k) S := by
          rw [← hG]
          exact hx
        change relationClass S (q * x) _ ∈ W
        rw [relationClass_mul_eq_smul S q x hxI]
        exact W.smul_mem _ ih
  exact hclaim f.1 hf

name: P23.Presentation.relationDetectorIndex_card
statement:
@[simp]
theorem relationDetectorIndex_card (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) :
    Fintype.card (RelationDetectorIndex S) = 1 + (borderFinset S).card
proof:
:= by
  simp [RelationDetectorIndex, Nat.add_comm]

name: P23.Presentation.relationSpaceDetector_surjective
statement:
theorem relationSpaceDetector_surjective
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) (hlive : IsLiveTie S) :
    Function.Surjective (relationSpaceDetector (k := k) S hS hdom hlive)
proof:
:= by
  intro v
  refine ⟨∑ i, v i • displayedRelation (k := k) S i, ?_⟩
  rw [map_sum]
  simp_rw [map_smul,
    relationSpaceDetector_displayedRelation (k := k) S hS hdom hlive]
  ext j
  simp only [Finset.sum_apply, Pi.single_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j]
  · simp
  · intro i hi hij
    simp [Pi.single_apply, hij, Ne.symm hij]
  · simp

name: P23.Presentation.presentationRelationSpace_finrank
statement:
theorem presentationRelationSpace_finrank
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) (hlive : IsLiveTie S) :
    Module.finrank k (PresentationRelationSpace (k := k) S) =
      1 + (borderFinset S).card
proof:
:= by
  let G := presentationGeneratorFinset (k := k) S
  have hG : Ideal.span (↑G : Set (ThreePoly k)) =
      finitePresentationIdeal (k := k) S :=
    span_presentationGeneratorFinset (k := k) S
  have hspan := generatorRelationClasses_span_eq_top (k := k) S G hG
  letI : Module.Finite k (PresentationRelationSpace (k := k) S) :=
    Module.Finite.of_fg_top <| by
      rw [← hspan]
      exact Submodule.fg_span (Set.finite_range _)
  apply Nat.le_antisymm
  · have hu := finrank_le_of_span_eq_top hspan
    simpa [G, presentationGeneratorFinset_card (k := k) S, Nat.add_comm] using hu
  · have hl := LinearMap.finrank_le_finrank_of_surjective
        (relationSpaceDetector_surjective (k := k) S hS hdom hlive)
    simp [RelationDetectorIndex] at hl
    omega

name: P23.Presentation.relationSpaceDetector_bijective
statement:
theorem relationSpaceDetector_bijective
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) (hlive : IsLiveTie S) :
    Function.Bijective (relationSpaceDetector (k := k) S hS hdom hlive)
proof:
:= by
  let G := presentationGeneratorFinset (k := k) S
  have hG : Ideal.span (↑G : Set (ThreePoly k)) =
      finitePresentationIdeal (k := k) S :=
    span_presentationGeneratorFinset (k := k) S
  have hspan := generatorRelationClasses_span_eq_top (k := k) S G hG
  letI : Module.Finite k (PresentationRelationSpace (k := k) S) :=
    Module.Finite.of_fg_top <| by
      rw [← hspan]
      exact Submodule.fg_span (Set.finite_range _)
  apply OrzechProperty.bijective_of_surjective_of_finrank_le
  · exact relationSpaceDetector_surjective (k := k) S hS hdom hlive
  · rw [presentationRelationSpace_finrank (k := k) S hS hdom hlive]
    simp [RelationDetectorIndex]
    omega

name: P23.Presentation.finitePresentationIdeal_generator_card_lower_bound
statement:
theorem finitePresentationIdeal_generator_card_lower_bound
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) (hlive : IsLiveTie S)
    (G : Finset (ThreePoly k))
    (hG : Ideal.span (↑G : Set (ThreePoly k)) =
      finitePresentationIdeal (k := k) S) :
    1 + (borderFinset S).card ≤ G.card
proof:
:= by
  have hspan := generatorRelationClasses_span_eq_top (k := k) S G hG
  have hle := finrank_le_of_span_eq_top hspan
  rw [presentationRelationSpace_finrank (k := k) S hS hdom hlive] at hle
  simpa using hle

name: P23.Presentation.finitePresentationIdeal_minimalGeneratorCard
statement:
theorem finitePresentationIdeal_minimalGeneratorCard
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) (hlive : IsLiveTie S) :
    HasMinimalGeneratorCard (k := k) (finitePresentationIdeal (k := k) S)
      (1 + (borderFinset S).card)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · refine ⟨presentationGeneratorFinset (k := k) S,
      span_presentationGeneratorFinset (k := k) S, ?_⟩
    exact presentationGeneratorFinset_card (k := k) S
  · intro G hG
    exact finitePresentationIdeal_generator_card_lower_bound
      (k := k) S hS hdom hlive G hG

name: P23.Presentation.polyToDirectAlg_kernel_minimalGeneratorCard
statement:
theorem polyToDirectAlg_kernel_minimalGeneratorCard
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) (hlive : IsLiveTie S) :
    HasMinimalGeneratorCard (k := k)
      (RingHom.ker (polyToDirectAlg (k := k) S).toRingHom)
      (1 + (borderFinset S).card)
proof:
:= by
  rw [polyToDirectAlg_ker (k := k) S hS hdom]
  exact finitePresentationIdeal_minimalGeneratorCard
    (k := k) S hS hdom hlive

name: P23.Presentation.idealGeneratorMu_eq_of_minimal
statement:
private theorem idealGeneratorMu_eq_of_minimal
    (I : Ideal (ThreePoly k)) (n : ℕ)
    (hmin : HasMinimalGeneratorCard (k := k) I n) :
    idealGeneratorMu (k := k) I = n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases hmin.1 with ⟨G₀, hG₀, hcard₀⟩
  have hex : ∃ m : ℕ, ∃ G : Finset (ThreePoly k),
      Ideal.span (↑G : Set (ThreePoly k)) = I ∧ G.card = m :=
    ⟨n, G₀, hG₀, hcard₀⟩
  rw [idealGeneratorMu, dif_pos hex]
  apply Nat.le_antisymm
  · exact Nat.find_min' hex ⟨G₀, hG₀, hcard₀⟩
  · rcases Nat.find_spec hex with ⟨G, hG, hcard⟩
    rw [← hcard]
    exact hmin.2 G hG

name: P23.Presentation.polyToDirectAlg_kernel_mu_eq_one_add_borderCard
statement:
theorem polyToDirectAlg_kernel_mu_eq_one_add_borderCard

    idealGeneratorMu (k := k)
        (RingHom.ker (polyToDirectAlg (k := k) S).toRingHom) =
      1 + (borderFinset S).card
proof:
:=
  idealGeneratorMu_eq_of_minimal (k := k) _ _
    (polyToDirectAlg_kernel_minimalGeneratorCard
      (k := k) S hS hdom hlive)

name: P23.Presentation.kernel_mu_eq_five_iff_border_card_eq_four
statement:
theorem kernel_mu_eq_five_iff_border_card_eq_four

    (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) (hlive : IsLiveTie S) :

        (RingHom.ker (polyToDirectAlg (k := k) S).toRingHom) = 5 ↔

    (k := k) S hS hdom hlive]

name: P23.Presentation.polynomialKernelBorderCount
statement:
theorem polynomialKernelBorderCount
    (S : Finset (Normal a b c)) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hdom : IsLiveParameterDomain a b c) (hlive : IsLiveTie S) :
    PolynomialKernelBorderCount (k := k) S hS hdom hlive where

proof:
:= polyToDirectAlg_ker (k := k) S hS hdom

name: P23.Algebra.boxResidues_mem
statement:
theorem boxResidues_mem (X Y Z : ZMod q)
    (hb : Function.Bijective (sevenBoxResidue (A:=A) (B:=B) (C:=C) X Y Z))
    (w : ZMod q) : w∈boxResidues (A:=A) (B:=B) (C:=C) X Y Z ↔
      w≠(A:ZMod q)*X ∧ w≠(B:ZMod q)*Y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro hw
    obtain ⟨p,_,hp⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hw
    constructor
    · intro he
      have hh := hb.1 (a₁:=Sum.inl p) (a₂:=Sum.inr 0) (by
        simpa [sevenBoxResidue] using hp.trans he)
      cases hh
    · intro he
      have hh := hb.1 (a₁:=Sum.inl p) (a₂:=Sum.inr 1) (by
        simpa [sevenBoxResidue] using hp.trans he)
      cases hh
  · rintro ⟨hr,hs⟩
    obtain ⟨p,hp⟩ := hb.2 w
    cases p with
    | inl p => exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨p,Finset.mem_univ _,hp⟩
    | inr j => fin_cases j <;> simp [sevenBoxResidue] at hp
               · exact False.elim (hr hp.symm)
               · exact False.elim (hs hp.symm)

name: P23.Algebra.boxWeight_reflection
statement:
theorem boxWeight_reflection (hA : 0<A) (hB : 0<B) (hC : 0<C)
    (X Y Z : ZMod q) (p : Fin A × Fin B × Fin C) :
    boxWeight X Y Z (p.1.rev,p.2.1.rev,p.2.2.rev)=
      ((A-1:ℕ):ZMod q)*X+((B-1:ℕ):ZMod q)*Y+((C-1:ℕ):ZMod q)*Z-
        boxWeight X Y Z p
proof:
:= by
  have hx : p.1.rev.val+p.1.val=A-1 := by simp [Fin.rev]; omega
  have hy : p.2.1.rev.val+p.2.1.val=B-1 := by simp [Fin.rev]; omega
  have hz : p.2.2.rev.val+p.2.2.val=C-1 := by simp [Fin.rev]; omega
  have hx' : (p.1.rev.val:ZMod q)+(p.1.val:ZMod q)=((A-1:ℕ):ZMod q) := by
    simpa only [Nat.cast_add] using congrArg (fun n : ℕ => (n : ZMod q)) hx
  have hy' : (p.2.1.rev.val:ZMod q)+(p.2.1.val:ZMod q)=((B-1:ℕ):ZMod q) := by
    simpa only [Nat.cast_add] using congrArg (fun n : ℕ => (n : ZMod q)) hy
  have hz' : (p.2.2.rev.val:ZMod q)+(p.2.2.val:ZMod q)=((C-1:ℕ):ZMod q) := by
    simpa only [Nat.cast_add] using congrArg (fun n : ℕ => (n : ZMod q)) hz
  unfold boxWeight
  linear_combination hx'*X+hy'*Y+hz'*Z

name: P23.Algebra.boxResidues_reflection
statement:
theorem boxResidues_reflection (hA : 0<A) (hB : 0<B) (hC : 0<C)
    (X Y Z : ZMod q) (w : ZMod q) :
    (((A-1:ℕ):ZMod q)*X+((B-1:ℕ):ZMod q)*Y+((C-1:ℕ):ZMod q)*Z-w)
      ∈boxResidues (A:=A) (B:=B) (C:=C) X Y Z ↔
      w∈boxResidues (A:=A) (B:=B) (C:=C) X Y Z
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let T := ((A-1:ℕ):ZMod q)*X+((B-1:ℕ):ZMod q)*Y+((C-1:ℕ):ZMod q)*Z
  have forward (w : ZMod q) (hw : w∈boxResidues (A:=A) (B:=B) (C:=C) X Y Z) :
      T-w∈boxResidues (A:=A) (B:=B) (C:=C) X Y Z := by
    obtain ⟨p,_,hp⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hw
    exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨(p.1.rev,p.2.1.rev,p.2.2.rev),Finset.mem_univ _,
      (boxWeight_reflection hA hB hC X Y Z p).trans (by rw [hp])⟩
  constructor
  · intro hw
    have hh := forward (T-w) hw
    simpa [T] using hh
  · exact forward w

name: P23.Algebra.sevenBox_extensions
statement:
theorem sevenBox_extensions (hA : 0<A) (hB : 0<B) (hC : 0<C)
    (X Y Z : ZMod q)
    (hb : Function.Bijective (sevenBoxResidue (A:=A) (B:=B) (C:=C) X Y Z)) :
    (A:ZMod q)*X≠(B:ZMod q)*Y ∧ (A:ZMod q)*X≠0 ∧ (B:ZMod q)*Y≠0
proof:
:= by
  have hxy : (A:ZMod q)*X≠(B:ZMod q)*Y := by
    intro he
    have hh := hb.1 (a₁:=Sum.inr 0) (a₂:=Sum.inr 1) (by simpa [sevenBoxResidue] using he)
    have : (0 : Fin 2)=1 := Sum.inr.inj hh
    omega
  have hzero : (0 : ZMod q)∈boxResidues (A:=A) (B:=B) (C:=C) X Y Z :=
    Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨(⟨0,hA⟩,⟨0,hB⟩,⟨0,hC⟩),Finset.mem_univ _,by simp [boxWeight]⟩
  have hz := (boxResidues_mem X Y Z hb 0).mp hzero
  exact ⟨hxy,Ne.symm hz.1,Ne.symm hz.2⟩

name: P23.Algebra.sevenBox_reflection_cases
statement:
theorem sevenBox_reflection_cases (hA : 0<A) (hB : 0<B) (hC : 0<C)
    (X Y Z : ZMod q)
    (hb : Function.Bijective (sevenBoxResidue (A:=A) (B:=B) (C:=C) X Y Z)) :
    let T
proof:
:= ((A-1:ℕ):ZMod q)*X+((B-1:ℕ):ZMod q)*Y+((C-1:ℕ):ZMod q)*Z
    (T-(A:ZMod q)*X=(B:ZMod q)*Y) ∨
      (T-(A:ZMod q)*X=(A:ZMod q)*X ∧ T-(B:ZMod q)*Y=(B:ZMod q)*Y) := by
  classical
  dsimp
  let T := ((A-1:ℕ):ZMod q)*X+((B-1:ℕ):ZMod q)*Y+((C-1:ℕ):ZMod q)*Z
  have nmem (w : ZMod q) (hw : w=(A:ZMod q)*X ∨ w=(B:ZMod q)*Y) :
      T-w=(A:ZMod q)*X ∨ T-w=(B:ZMod q)*Y := by
    have hn : ¬w∈boxResidues (A:=A) (B:=B) (C:=C) X Y Z := by
      rw [boxResidues_mem X Y Z hb]; tauto
    have hn' : ¬T-w∈boxResidues (A:=A) (B:=B) (C:=C) X Y Z := by
      exact fun h=>hn ((boxResidues_reflection hA hB hC X Y Z w).mp h)
    rw [boxResidues_mem X Y Z hb] at hn'
    tauto
  rcases nmem ((A:ZMod q)*X) (Or.inl rfl) with hr | hr
  · right
    refine ⟨hr,?_⟩
    rcases nmem ((B:ZMod q)*Y) (Or.inr rfl) with hs | hs
    · have he : (A:ZMod q)*X=(B:ZMod q)*Y := by linear_combination hs-hr
      exact False.elim ((sevenBox_extensions hA hB hC X Y Z hb).1 he)
    · exact hs
  · exact Or.inl hr

name: P23.Algebra.sevenBox_swap_impossible
statement:
theorem sevenBox_swap_impossible (hA : 2≤A) (hB : 2≤B) (hC : 2≤C)
    (X Y Z : ZMod q)
    (hinj : Function.Injective (sevenBoxResidue (A:=A) (B:=B) (C:=C) X Y Z))
    (hs : ((A-1:ℕ):ZMod q)*X+((B-1:ℕ):ZMod q)*Y+((C-1:ℕ):ZMod q)*Z-
      (A:ZMod q)*X=(B:ZMod q)*Y) : False
proof:
:= by
  have ha : ((A-1:ℕ):ZMod q)+1=(A:ZMod q) := by
    simpa only [Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one] using
      congrArg (fun n : ℕ => (n : ZMod q)) (Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega : 1≤A))
  have hb : ((B-1:ℕ):ZMod q)+1=(B:ZMod q) := by
    simpa only [Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one] using
      congrArg (fun n : ℕ => (n : ZMod q)) (Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega : 1≤B))
  have hrel : X+Y=((C-1:ℕ):ZMod q)*Z := by linear_combination -hs+ha*X+hb*Y
  have he := hinj (a₁:=Sum.inl (⟨1,by omega⟩,⟨1,by omega⟩,⟨0,by omega⟩))
    (a₂:=Sum.inl (⟨0,by omega⟩,⟨0,by omega⟩,⟨C-1,by omega⟩))
    (by simpa [sevenBoxResidue,boxWeight] using hrel)
  have he' := congrArg (fun p : SevenBoxShape A B C =>
    match p with | .inl p => p.1.val | .inr _ => 0) he
  simp at he'

name: P23.Algebra.boxResidues_half_translation
statement:
theorem boxResidues_half_translation (X Y Z : ZMod q)
    (hb : Function.Bijective (sevenBoxResidue (A:=A) (B:=B) (C:=C) X Y Z))
    (h2 : ((A:ZMod q)*X-(B:ZMod q)*Y)+((A:ZMod q)*X-(B:ZMod q)*Y)=0) :
    (boxResidues (A:=A) (B:=B) (C:=C) X Y Z).image
      (fun w=>w+((A:ZMod q)*X-(B:ZMod q)*Y))=boxResidues (A:=A) (B:=B) (C:=C) X Y Z
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let r := (A:ZMod q)*X
  let s := (B:ZMod q)*Y
  have hswap : r+(r-s)=s := by dsimp [r,s]; linear_combination h2
  have hswap' : s+(r-s)=r := by ring
  ext w
  simp only [Finset.mem_image]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨v,hv,rfl⟩
    have hv' := (boxResidues_mem X Y Z hb v).mp hv
    apply (boxResidues_mem X Y Z hb _).mpr
    constructor
    · intro he; apply hv'.2
      have : v=s := by dsimp [r,s] at *; linear_combination he
      exact this
    · intro he; apply hv'.1
      have : v=r := by dsimp [r,s] at *; linear_combination he-h2
      exact this
  · intro hw
    refine ⟨w+(r-s),?_,?_⟩
    · have hw' := (boxResidues_mem X Y Z hb w).mp hw
      apply (boxResidues_mem X Y Z hb _).mpr
      constructor
      · intro he; apply hw'.2
        have : w=s := by dsimp [r,s] at *; linear_combination he
        exact this
      · intro he; apply hw'.1
        have : w=r := by dsimp [r,s] at *; linear_combination he-h2
        exact this
    · dsimp [r,s]; linear_combination h2

name: P23.Algebra.boxResidues_character_sum
statement:
theorem boxResidues_character_sum (X Y Z : ZMod q)
    (hinj : Function.Injective (sevenBoxResidue (A:=A) (B:=B) (C:=C) X Y Z)) :
    (∑ w∈boxResidues (A:=A) (B:=B) (C:=C) X Y Z,cyclicCharacter w)=
      cyclicBoxSum A B C X Y Z
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [boxResidues,Finset.sum_image]
  · simp only [Fintype.sum_prod_type,boxWeight,cyclicBoxSum,nsmul_eq_mul]
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun x => ∑ y : Fin B, ∑ z : Fin C,
      cyclicCharacter ((x:ZMod q)*X+(y.val:ZMod q)*Y+(z.val:ZMod q)*Z))]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro x hx
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun y => ∑ z : Fin C,
      cyclicCharacter ((x:ZMod q)*X+(y:ZMod q)*Y+(z.val:ZMod q)*Z))]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro y hy
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun z =>
      cyclicCharacter ((x:ZMod q)*X+(y:ZMod q)*Y+(z:ZMod q)*Z))]
  · intro p _ r _ he
    exact Sum.inl.inj (hinj (a₁:=Sum.inl p) (a₂:=Sum.inl r) he)

name: P23.Algebra.sevenBox_z_order
statement:
theorem sevenBox_z_order (hA : 0<A) (hB : 0<B) (hC : 0<C)
    (X Y Z : ZMod q)
    (hinj : Function.Injective (sevenBoxResidue (A:=A) (B:=B) (C:=C) X Y Z))
    (hz : C • Z=0) : addOrderOf Z=C
proof:
:= by
  apply (addOrderOf_eq_iff hC).mpr
  refine ⟨hz,?_⟩
  intro m hm hpos he
  have hh := hinj (a₁:=Sum.inl (⟨0,hA⟩,⟨0,hB⟩,⟨m,hm⟩))
    (a₂:=Sum.inl (⟨0,hA⟩,⟨0,hB⟩,⟨0,hC⟩))
    (by simpa [sevenBoxResidue,boxWeight,nsmul_eq_mul] using he)
  have hh' := congrArg (fun p : SevenBoxShape A B C =>
    match p with | .inl p => p.2.2.val | .inr _ => 0) hh
  simp at hh'
  omega

name: P23.Algebra.sevenBox_character_XY_nonzero
statement:
theorem sevenBox_character_XY_nonzero (hA : 0<A) (hB : 0<B) (hC : 0<C)
    (X Y Z : ZMod q)
    (hb : Function.Bijective (sevenBoxResidue (A:=A) (B:=B) (C:=C) X Y Z)) :
    cyclicGeometricSum A X≠0 ∧ cyclicGeometricSum B Y≠0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hz
    have he := geometric_sum_zero_nsmul A X hz
    exact (sevenBox_extensions hA hB hC X Y Z hb).2.1 (by simpa [nsmul_eq_mul] using he)
  · intro hz
    have he := geometric_sum_zero_nsmul B Y hz
    exact (sevenBox_extensions hA hB hC X Y Z hb).2.2 (by simpa [nsmul_eq_mul] using he)

name: P23.Algebra.sevenBox_fixed_impossible
statement:
theorem sevenBox_fixed_impossible (hA : 2≤A) (hB : 2≤B) (hC : 2≤C)
    (X Y Z : ZMod q)
    (hb : Function.Bijective (sevenBoxResidue (A:=A) (B:=B) (C:=C) X Y Z))
    (hr : ((A-1:ℕ):ZMod q)*X+((B-1:ℕ):ZMod q)*Y+((C-1:ℕ):ZMod q)*Z-
      (A:ZMod q)*X=(A:ZMod q)*X)
    (hs : ((A-1:ℕ):ZMod q)*X+((B-1:ℕ):ZMod q)*Y+((C-1:ℕ):ZMod q)*Z-
      (B:ZMod q)*Y=(B:ZMod q)*Y) : False
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hAp : 0<A := by omega
  have hBp : 0<B := by omega
  have hCp : 0<C := by omega
  have hcard : q=A*B*C+2 := by
    have he := Fintype.card_congr (Equiv.ofBijective _ hb)
    simpa [sevenBoxShape_card,ZMod.card,Nat.mul_assoc] using he.symm
  let r := (A:ZMod q)*X
  let s := (B:ZMod q)*Y
  let h := r-s
  have hne : h≠0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr (sevenBox_extensions hAp hBp hCp X Y Z hb).1
  have h2 : h+h=0 := by dsimp [h,r,s]; linear_combination hs-hr
  have hhalf := nonzero_two_torsion_eq_half h hne h2
  have hsum := cyclicCharacter_translation_sum_zero
    (boxResidues (A:=A) (B:=B) (C:=C) X Y Z) h hne h2
    (boxResidues_half_translation X Y Z hb h2)
  rw [boxResidues_character_sum X Y Z hb.1,cyclicCharacter_box_product] at hsum
  obtain ⟨hx,hy⟩ := sevenBox_character_XY_nonzero hAp hBp hCp X Y Z hb
  have hz : cyclicGeometricSum C Z=0 := (mul_eq_zero.mp hsum).resolve_left (mul_ne_zero hx hy)
  have hCZ := geometric_sum_zero_nsmul C Z hz
  have hord := sevenBox_z_order hAp hBp hCp X Y Z hb.1 hCZ
  have hdq : C∣q := by simpa [hord,ZMod.card] using (addOrderOf_dvd_card (x:=Z))
  have hd2 : C∣2 := by
    have hp : C∣A*B*C := ⟨A*B,by ring⟩
    have hh : C∣A*B*C+2 := hcard ▸ hdq
    simpa using (Nat.dvd_sub hh hp)
  have hC2 : C=2 := by have := Nat.le_of_dvd (by decide : 0<2) hd2; omega
  have hZne : Z≠0 := by
    intro he
    have hh := hb.1 (a₁:=Sum.inl (⟨0,hAp⟩,⟨0,hBp⟩,⟨1,by omega⟩))
      (a₂:=Sum.inl (⟨0,hAp⟩,⟨0,hBp⟩,⟨0,hCp⟩)) (by simp [sevenBoxResidue,boxWeight,he])
    have hh' := congrArg (fun p : SevenBoxShape A B C =>
      match p with | .inl p => p.2.2.val | .inr _ => 0) hh
    simp at hh'
  have hZ2 : Z+Z=0 := by simpa [hC2,two_nsmul,two_mul] using hCZ
  have hZh : Z=h := (nonzero_two_torsion_eq_half Z hZne hZ2).2.trans hhalf.2.symm
  have ha : ((A-1:ℕ):ZMod q)+1=(A:ZMod q) := by
    simpa only [Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one] using
      congrArg (fun n : ℕ => (n : ZMod q)) (Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega : 1≤A))
  have hbb : ((B-1:ℕ):ZMod q)+1=(B:ZMod q) := by
    simpa only [Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one] using
      congrArg (fun n : ℕ => (n : ZMod q)) (Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega : 1≤B))
  have he : X+Y=0 := by
    simp only [hC2,show 2-1=1 by decide,Nat.cast_one,one_mul] at hr
    dsimp [h,r,s] at hZh
    linear_combination hZh-hr+ha*X+hbb*Y
  have hh := hb.1 (a₁:=Sum.inl (⟨1,by omega⟩,⟨1,by omega⟩,⟨0,hCp⟩))
    (a₂:=Sum.inl (⟨0,hAp⟩,⟨0,hBp⟩,⟨0,hCp⟩))
    (by simpa [sevenBoxResidue,boxWeight] using he)
  have hh' := congrArg (fun p : SevenBoxShape A B C =>
    match p with | .inl p => p.1.val | .inr _ => 0) hh
  simp at hh'

name: P23.Algebra.sevenBox_residue_bijective_impossible
statement:
theorem sevenBox_residue_bijective_impossible (hA : 2≤A) (hB : 2≤B) (hC : 2≤C)
    (X Y Z : ZMod q)
    (hb : Function.Bijective (sevenBoxResidue (A:=A) (B:=B) (C:=C) X Y Z)) : False
proof:
:= by
  rcases sevenBox_reflection_cases (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) X Y Z hb with hs | ⟨hr,hs⟩
  · exact sevenBox_swap_impossible hA hB hC X Y Z hb.1 hs
  · exact sevenBox_fixed_impossible hA hB hC X Y Z hb hr hs

name: P23.Algebra.nonzero_two_torsion_eq_half
statement:
theorem nonzero_two_torsion_eq_half (h : ZMod q) (hne : h ≠ 0)
    (h2 : h + h = 0) : 2 ∣ q ∧ h = ((q / 2 : ℕ) : ZMod q)
proof:
:= by
  have hv : 0 < h.val := by
    by_contra hn
    have hz : h.val = 0 := by omega
    apply hne
    simpa [hz] using (ZMod.natCast_zmod_val h).symm
  have hlt := ZMod.val_lt h
  have hc : ((2 * h.val : ℕ) : ZMod q) = 0 := by
    simpa [Nat.cast_mul, ZMod.natCast_zmod_val, two_mul] using h2
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := (ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff _ _).mp hc
  have hq : 0 < q := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne q)
  have hk1 : k = 1 := by nlinarith
  have he : q = 2 * h.val := by simpa [hk1] using hk.symm
  constructor
  · exact ⟨h.val, he⟩
  · have hh : q / 2 = h.val := by omega
    rw [hh, ZMod.natCast_zmod_val]

name: P23.Algebra.cyclicCharacter_two_torsion
statement:
theorem cyclicCharacter_two_torsion (h : ZMod q) (hne : h≠0) (h2 : h+h=0) :
    cyclicCharacter h = -1
proof:
:= by
  have he : cyclicCharacter h * cyclicCharacter h = 1 := by
    rw [←AddChar.map_add_eq_mul,h2,AddChar.map_zero_eq_one]
  have hn : cyclicCharacter h ≠ 1 := by
    intro hh
    apply hne
    apply ZMod.injective_stdAddChar
    simpa using hh
  have hh : (cyclicCharacter h - 1) * (cyclicCharacter h + 1)=0 := by
    calc _ = cyclicCharacter h * cyclicCharacter h - 1 := by ring
         _ = 0 := by rw [he]; ring
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hh with hh | hh
  · exact False.elim (hn (sub_eq_zero.mp hh))
  · exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left hh

name: P23.Algebra.geometric_sum_zero_nsmul
statement:
theorem geometric_sum_zero_nsmul (n : ℕ) (w : ZMod q)
    (hz : cyclicGeometricSum n w=0) : n • w=0
proof:
:= by
  have hs : ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, cyclicCharacter w ^ j=0 := by
    simpa only [cyclicGeometricSum,AddChar.map_nsmul_eq_pow] using hz
  have he := geom_sum_mul (cyclicCharacter w) n
  rw [hs,zero_mul] at he
  have hp : cyclicCharacter w ^ n=1 := by linear_combination -he
  apply ZMod.injective_stdAddChar
  simpa only [AddChar.map_nsmul_eq_pow,AddChar.map_zero_eq_one] using hp

name: P23.Algebra.cyclicGeometricSum_zero
statement:
theorem cyclicGeometricSum_zero (n : ℕ) :
    cyclicGeometricSum (q:=q) n 0=(n:ℂ)
proof: := by simp [cyclicGeometricSum]

name: P23.Algebra.cyclicCharacter_translation_sum_zero
statement:
theorem cyclicCharacter_translation_sum_zero (S : Finset (ZMod q)) (h : ZMod q)
    (hne : h≠0) (h2 : h+h=0) (hS : S.image (fun x=>x+h)=S) :
    ∑ x∈S, cyclicCharacter x=0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have he : (∑ x∈S,cyclicCharacter x) = (∑ x∈S,cyclicCharacter x)*cyclicCharacter h := by
    calc
      _ = ∑ x∈S.image (fun x=>x+h),cyclicCharacter x := by rw [hS]
      _ = ∑ x∈S,cyclicCharacter (x+h) := Finset.sum_image (by
        intro x _ y _ hh; exact add_right_cancel hh)
      _ = _ := by simp_rw [AddChar.map_add_eq_mul]; rw [Finset.sum_mul]
  rw [cyclicCharacter_two_torsion h hne h2] at he
  linear_combination (1/2:ℂ)*he

name: P23.Algebra.cyclicCharacter_box_product
statement:
theorem cyclicCharacter_box_product (A B C : ℕ) (X Y Z : ZMod q) :
    cyclicBoxSum A B C X Y Z=
      cyclicGeometricSum A X*cyclicGeometricSum B Y*cyclicGeometricSum C Z
proof:
:= by
  unfold cyclicBoxSum cyclicGeometricSum
  simp_rw [AddChar.map_add_eq_mul]
  symm
  rw [Finset.sum_mul_sum (Finset.range A) (Finset.range B)]
  rw [Finset.sum_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro x hx
  rw [Finset.sum_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro y hy
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]

    weightedDegreeOf nFour u ≠ nFour j
proof:
:= by
  intro j u hu heq
  rw [weightedDegree_four] at heq
  simp only [nFour_0, nFour_1, nFour_2, nFour_3] at heq
  fin_cases j <;> simp at hu <;> simp [hu] at heq

    have h2 : u 2 ≤ 1 := by omega
    have h3 : u 3 ≤ 1 := by omega

name: P23.Semigroup.Run20Concrete.nFour_large_mem
statement:
private theorem nFour_large_mem (s : ℕ) (hs : 4 ≤ s) :
    s ∈ generatedByFour nFour
proof:
:= by
  rw [generatedByFour, AddMonoidHom.mem_mrange]
  let u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ :=
    if s % 4 = 0 then Finsupp.single 0 (s / 4)
    else if s % 4 = 1 then Finsupp.single 0 (s / 4 - 1) + Finsupp.single 1 1
    else if s % 4 = 2 then Finsupp.single 0 (s / 4 - 1) + Finsupp.single 2 1
    else Finsupp.single 0 (s / 4 - 1) + Finsupp.single 3 1
  refine ⟨u, ?_⟩
  change weightedDegreeOf nFour u = s
  rw [weightedDegree_four]
  have hm := Nat.mod_lt s (by omega : 0 < 4)
  have hd := Nat.mod_add_div s 4
  interval_cases h : s % 4 <;>
    simp [u, h, nFour, Finsupp.single_apply] <;> omega

private theorem nFive_large_mem (s : ℕ) (hs : 10 ≤ s) :

proof:

  let u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ :=
    if s % 5 = 0 then Finsupp.single 0 (s / 5)
    else if s % 5 = 1 then Finsupp.single 0 (s / 5 - 1) + Finsupp.single 1 1
    else if s % 5 = 2 then Finsupp.single 0 (s / 5 - 1) + Finsupp.single 2 1
    else if s % 5 = 3 then Finsupp.single 0 (s / 5 - 1) + Finsupp.single 3 1
    else Finsupp.single 0 (s / 5 - 2) + Finsupp.single 2 2
  refine ⟨u, ?_⟩
  change weightedDegreeOf nFive u = s
  rw [weightedDegree_four]
  have hm := Nat.mod_lt s (by omega : 0 < 5)
  have hd := Nat.mod_add_div s 5
  interval_cases h : s % 5 <;>
    simp [u, h, nFive, Finsupp.single_apply] <;> omega
